## MTWABV Canon

> **Rex Invictus canon.** This material is adapted into the Rex Invictus world at the lowest priority: Rex Invictus wins any conflict, then the Flamel material, then MTWABV. Events of the MTWABV timeline (Victor's conquests, the fall of the pantheons, the [[Elderblood Empire]]) are distant background or rumor unless a chapter puts them on the page. See [[MTWABV Series#Integration rules]].

Adapted from the MTWABV wiki page "Victor Elderblood". In MTWABV continuity this figure belongs to the world of [[Victor Elderblood]] and the [[Elderblood Empire]]. Nothing here overrides the [[Rex Invictus]] sections above.

#### Chronological / Physical Age
Confirmed / Quantified Stages
- 21 years (Beginning of the story)[10]
- 22–23 years (Early story: six-month Scarlett training and eighteen-month [[Nightingale]]/Earth separation; the Gates of Limbo explicitly records 22, whereas the passage of external years is not a precise birthday calculation)[34][9]
- Approximately 723 years (After about 700 subjective years ruling and fighting in Hell)[35]
- Approximately 724–725 years (Subsequent one-year period and later pre-ascension developments)[36][37]
- Unmeasurable additional Time (Battle at the [[Edge of the Cosmos]]: Victor could not determine whether 100, 1,000 or 100,000 years had elapsed; no fixed total can be calculated)[38]
- +2,000 subjective years (Accelerated training and development before the new generation)[39]
- +10 years (Later Imperial skip)[40]
- +1,500 subjective years (1,000 with Ariel, followed by another 500 associated with Nyx)[41]
- +2,000 subjective years (Temporal sphere with Violet and Jeanne)[42]
- Almost +2,000 subjective years (Temporal sphere with Hela)[43]
Imperial Great Acceleration — Important Distinction
- 200,000 internal Imperial years / approximately one external year (The accelerated galaxy and its inhabitants receive roughly 200,000 years; Victor and the Empresses outside the ritual experience the shorter external duration while operating avatars inside. Do not add 200,000 years to Victor's personal age.)[44][45]
- Around Imperial Year 170,000 (The Nikolai incident is dated on the accelerated [[Imperial Calendar]], not Victor's personal birthday)[46]
- Around Imperial Years 190,000–200,000 (The late ritual's final stage; the timekeeping belongs to the accelerated civilization)[47][48]
Additional Personal Temporal Experiences
- Unknown duration (Repeated reconstruction/interrogation under isolated altered Time; 623,596,777,174 repetitions do not establish the years experienced)[46]
- Approximately +1,000 subjective years (Anna/Scarlett-family private time-sphere sequence; subject to continuity and overlap with other personal temporal episodes)[49][50]
- Four subjective months (Time-bubble family discussion; less than two external hours)[51]
- Approximately +300 subjective years (The period spent with [[Tyche]] before Moira's birth; distinct from the Empire's general 200,000-year calendar)[52]
- 10,000 years was a possible interval, not elapsed Time (Victor could have sustained a private time sphere with Tyche for this long; the narration does not confirm that the full interval passed)[53]
- Seven subjective months (Private reconstruction operation while outside Time remained effectively stopped; minor addition and potentially overlapping other period estimates)[54]
Current Assessment
- At least roughly nine millennia; approximately 9,000–10,000+ directly reconstructible subjective years (Lower-order estimate from the explicitly quantified private periods, before the indeterminate Edge-of-Cosmos interval and any unrecorded or overlapping temporal experiences. Not an exact chronological age.)
- Exact subjective / chronological age: Unknown (Independent and parallel bodies, time spheres, accelerated civilizations and the unmeasurable Edge-of-Cosmos period prevent a precise age.)

### Energy & Power Sources

#### Current Energy Source(s)
Current Fundamental Energy Sources
- Attributeless Energy (Primary native Energy / Creator's Energy; a single, undifferentiated foundation for all ordinary Energies of his Universe. Victor's body no longer maintains multiple discrete native Energy systems, and he can freely assign properties to his Energy.)[219][220][68][221]
- [[Eldritch Energy]] (Separate source belonging to his Eldritch [[Chaos]] / Outer God existence; originates beyond the native Universe and is intrinsically corruptive to its laws. It is not simply another native attribute of Creator's Energy.)[142][221]
Energy Supply and Conduits, Not Separate Primary Types
- [[Dragon Heart]] (The physical organ generating and maintaining his vast Energy reserves, not a distinct current foundational Energy type)[6][222]
- [[World Trees]] (Roxanne, Amara and the wider internal World Tree network continuously sustain, replenish and refine Energy; their support does not change the identity of his unified primary Energy source)[74][222]
Note: Attributeless Energy is the source of his native Energy system, not a prohibition against Divine, Draconic, Positive, Negative, Demonic, Nature, Spirit or other expressions. He can still generate and use these by giving attributes to his unified Energy. Eldritch Energy is independently available, although Victor avoids releasing it into ordinary Imperial infrastructure because of its corruptive effects.[68][221][222]

#### Former Energy Source(s)
Former Stand-Alone Energy Foundations / Still Usable Expressions
- [[Vampiric Energy]] (Original Noble Vampire and Vampire Progenitor Energy; still expressible through Blood and Vampiric abilities, but no longer an independent primary internal source)[8][9][68]
- [[Draconic Energy]] (Former stand-alone Blood Dragon / Dragon God racial Energy. His [[Dragon Heart]] remains active; Draconic power is now an expression of the unified native Energy foundation, not evidence that his body still maintains several parallel foundational sources)[6][68]
- [[Divine Energy]] (Earlier independent Godhood/Divinity Energy. Victor retains his Divine Concepts and can generate Divine Energy from Attributeless Energy.)[186][221]
- [[Primordial Energy]] (Attributed / Unaltered Primordial Energy, which Victor can reconstruct from the Attributeless origin. Distinct from Attributeless Energy itself.)[220][221]
- Negative Energy (Former distinct foundation through Negativity, Roxanne and other negative-aligned [[World Trees]]; now an accessible attributed expression)[208][68]
- Positive Energy (Former distinct foundation through Beginnings, Amara and other positive-aligned World Trees; now an accessible attributed expression)[186][68]
- Existence Energy (Earlier Blood Dragon Primogenitor energy associated with the native powers of Existence; retains its applications through the unified foundation)[6][68]
- Demonic Energy / Hell Miasma (Former independent infernal system developed as King of Hell; still producible and applicable, including Demonic and Hell-based techniques)[61][223][221]
- Nature Energy (Earlier World Tree and environmental Energy expression; still accessible)[73][221]
- [[Senjutsu]] Energy (Earlier separately cultivated Nature-derived spiritual expression; still usable through the common native Energy origin)[73][221]
- Spirit Energy / Mana / Ki (Other native attributed Energy systems; Victor explicitly identifies and can reproduce their common foundation)[221]
- Elemental Energy (Fire, Ice, Lightning and other elementary expressions; former independently manifested racial Energies, not permanently lost abilities)[16][221]
- [[Holy Energy]] (Positive/Holy expression available through his Divine and [[Chaos]]-related powers; not a separate primary reserve)[139][221]
- Dream Energy (Conceptual expression available through his Dream Divinity; not a separate foundational Energy system)[211][221]
Important distinction: Former denotes the former status of each type as a separate, internally maintained source; it does not mean Victor lost those Energies or abilities. All native Energy types arise from Attributeless Energy and can be generated or transformed by Victor's control. [[Eldritch Energy]] remains the exception, as a distinct Outer-God Energy originating beyond this Universe.[68][221]

#### Debut
[[Ch01 - Rex Imperator I|Chapter 1]]
A noble and brave warrior once asked me, are you an honorable fighter or a monster cursed by God? Hearing the noble warrior's question; do you know what I said? I am a monster created by God.
—Victor to Natasha, Chapter 112: An insane man.
Victor Elderblood, formerly known as Victor Walker and for a large portion of his supernatural life as Victor Alucard, is the main protagonist of [[MTWABV Series|My Three Wives Are Beautiful Vampires]]. He was born Human with RH-null blood and later revealed [[Walker Bloodline]], an extraordinarily rare blood type whose supernatural significance was initially unknown to him, but his Human body was chronically weakened by anemia and he was expected to live a short and physically restricted life.[10] That life ended when Violet Snow used a Vampire marriage ritual to save him after a mortal injury, transforming Victor into a Vampire rather than allowing him to die.[4] The ritual had not proceeded normally: Ruby Scarlett and Sasha Fulger had also become involved in the process, resulting in all three women being supernaturally bound to Victor as his wives and leaving him with characteristics connected to the Snow, Scarlett and Fulger Bloodlines.[8][18][17] His transformation therefore did not merely cure the illness that had dominated his Human life; it created an anomalous Vampire whose biology, blood and capacity for growth immediately violated many of the rules governing ordinary transformed Vampires.[24]
Victor's rise began with an obsession that would remain central to his identity: he refused to regard his present limitations as permanent. His first encounter with [[Scathach Elderblood Scarlett|Scathach Scarlett]] showed him a warrior so overwhelmingly superior that his instincts initially responded with genuine fear, yet recovering from that fear only made him eager to reach her level.[16] [[Scathach]] subsequently became his master and rebuilt his fighting foundations through an exceptionally brutal training regime, teaching Victor to continue thinking while injured, eliminate wasted movement and turn his enormous natural potential into actual combat skill.[166] Only months after becoming a Vampire, Victor was elevated into the political structure of [[Nightingale]] when [[Vlad III Tepes|Vlad Tepes]] formally created a Fifth Pillar of Vampire Society under the newly founded Clan Alucard, with Victor as its Count and founder.[75] His blood soon proved to represent something much greater than an unusually talented Noble Vampire bloodline: vampires created directly from him could inherit characteristics of their progenitor, and Limbo eventually identified Victor himself as the Second Progenitor.[111][9] From that point onward, Alucard ceased being merely a provocative surname or political Clan and increasingly became a lineage originating directly from Victor.
His growth in power was accompanied by an equally important transformation from fighter into ruler. During the Demonic War, Victor stopped relying upon the established supernatural order to protect the people around him and organized Counts, allies and independent factions around himself rather than exclusively beneath Nightingale's Crown.[31][26] When he was later trapped inside Hell, Victor responded not by searching desperately for an escape but by conquering the realm from within: Demon Legions were given the choice to submit or die, competent followers were rewarded, hostile rulers were destroyed and the ancient infernal hierarchy was progressively replaced by one centered upon Victor's authority.[232][233] Hell itself eventually recognized him at its throne, stripping [[Diablo]] of the kingdom upon which much of his authority depended.[23] The Legions that had once served his enemy openly acknowledged Victor as the King of Demons.[179] Victor later experienced roughly seven centuries within Hell, using those centuries not only to fight and accumulate power but to reorganize its cities, administration, military and social structure, returning to his family as a substantially more experienced monarch rather than merely the young Vampire who had entered the realm.[234][235][236]
Victor's subsequent evolution progressively destroyed the usefulness of describing him through a single Race. His bond with the Dragon Zaladrac Zeovnur connected his existing Progenitor nature to genuine Draconic physiology and became the foundation for another stage of development.[91] During the fall of [[Olympus]], the pressure of battle finally caused his Vampire and Dragon characteristics to cease functioning as separate systems and fuse into a genuinely new existence.[5] The cosmic authorities consequently recognized Victor as the Primogenitor of the Draconic Vampires—the First and Beginning of a new lineage combining the fundamental qualities of Vampires and Dragons rather than a Vampire who had merely acquired Dragon abilities.[6] His evolution continued during the war against the Elder Gods, when Victor crossed into genuine Godhood and awakened an extraordinary collection of fifteen Divinities reflecting both the powers and personal characteristics accumulated throughout his life.[186] The result was the Dragon God of [[Chaos]], whose principal Divine nature included fundamental Concepts such as Blood, Beginning and Negativity alongside authorities tied to family, combat, predation and other defining aspects of Victor himself.[12][237]
Even this Divine identity eventually proved incomplete. After his ascension, Victor encountered within himself an incomprehensible existence that he had previously perceived almost as something separate from the body and identities through which he interacted with Reality; instead of rejecting it, he recognized the entity as another expression of himself—his True Self.[71] Later examination of his nature established that Victor was developing into an Eldritch Chaos, an existence no longer entirely dependent upon the native Divine framework or the ordinary Rules through which his Cosmos classified Gods, Dragons and other supernatural beings.[142][238] His familiar Human, Vampire, Demon King, Blood Dragon and Divine forms consequently became increasingly inadequate as complete definitions of what Victor was; they represented stages, manifestations and identities accumulated by a Being whose fundamental existence continued evolving beyond the systems that had originally produced him.
The same progression transformed the collection of people around Victor into a civilization. At the [[Supernatural Gathering]], Victor explicitly rejected the idea that morality was determined by Race, arguing that Demons, Humans, Vampires, Gods and other intelligent peoples should be judged by their conduct rather than by species alone.[37] He then formally established Dragon's Nest, a System-recognized multiracial Pantheon accepting Dragons, Vampires, Demons, Angels, [[Werewolves]], Youkai, Humans, extraterrestrial peoples and other species beneath a common authority.[37] That structure eventually developed into the [[Elderblood Empire]]: after the major supernatural powers of Earth were absorbed, subordinated or brought beneath the new order, Victor established Imperial citizenship above racial identity and formally reorganized the planet around a civilization no longer defined by the rivalries of the old Pantheons.[167][178] Victor's rule remained absolute at its highest level, but he increasingly rejected the need to personally control every lesser decision; wives, daughters, commanders and specialists were given genuine authority within their fields because he considered a civilization dependent upon one person for every action fundamentally incomplete.[30][239]
Family nevertheless remains the foundation around which Victor's identity, ambitions and civilization are constructed. From the beginning, he distinguished political losses from genuine threats to the people he loved: when Sasha's family lost its Count title, Victor cared primarily about whether Sasha herself was safe and what she wanted rather than recovering prestige for its own sake.[240] During the Demonic War, this principle expanded beyond his wives until family became more important within his household than Clan or racial origin; anyone accepted as family was defended regardless of whether they were Vampire, Human, Demon, God or another species.[241] His treatment of subjects developed along similar lines: Victor can be exceptionally vindictive and ruthless toward enemies, betrayers and those who deliberately harm people under his protection, but he also rewards loyalty, recognizes competence and repeatedly accepts former enemies or traditionally hostile races when their actions prove them capable of living beneath his laws.[181][242][37]
By the current era, the distance between Victor Walker and Victor Elderblood has become astronomical in both the literal and figurative sense. The sick Human who once struggled to survive ordinary physical exertion became the God Emperor of a civilization whose citizens and colonies spread across galaxies, while Imperial infrastructure came to include [[World Trees]], artificial worlds, interstellar military Legions, afterlife and reincarnation systems, Galactic-scale engineering and technologies created in preparation for civilizations beyond his native region.[74][78] After encountering the Empire of Light, Victor deliberately accelerated the Elderblood Empire through approximately two hundred thousand years of internal development because the powers waiting in the higher regions of the Cosmos operated on scales far beyond the ancient Pantheons that had once appeared supreme to him.[28][44] By the end of that development, the Empire extended across countless Galactic territories and Mars had become its new capital, connected to Imperial worlds through the vast World Tree network.[243] Victor is also explicitly recognized as an Overlord, a title given to a ruler who has obtained complete control over their Sector; his influence has since expanded further as the smaller Sectors associated with Nightingale, Samar and Arcane were drawn into the domain under his control.[244] The central trajectory of Victor's story is therefore not simply the accumulation of increasingly powerful forms, but the expansion of what he considers his—first his own life, then his wives and family, then a Clan, a kingdom, multiple [[Races (Flamel)|Races]], an Empire and ultimately the cosmic territory he intends to protect, develop and rule.
Victor's domestic and cosmic responsibilities are no longer separate concerns. As Imperial society approached its two-hundred-thousand-year milestone, he supported the relocation of the administrative capital to Mars, intending to preserve [[Yggdrasil]] as a protected garden world rather than subject his birth planet to unlimited urban expansion.[243] His daughter Moira's unusual relationship with the Universe subsequently brought him into direct disagreement with the System and the [[Regulators of Existence]]. Victor refused to surrender her individuality to a cosmic office even under threats concerning the stability of Reality, reaffirming that the position of Emperor would never supersede his obligations as a father.[69][245] As external factions attempted to penetrate his Sector, he completed further structural changes to his territories, placed the Empire on a war footing and entrusted War with the first direct offensive against the Upper-Sector powers.[244][175] He did not take part in that opening strike. When War refused to be handed to any of the patrons, Victor entered the battle himself as that same galaxy-holding True Dragon.[246]
