### Trivia
Victor Elderblood — Trivia Archive
Character facts, curiosities, records and unusual details. Scroll to view the complete archive.
Character Inspiration & Personality
- Victor associates the meaning of his name with being “the victorious,” using it to express his determination to keep winning and growing stronger.[285]
- Victor inherited much of his directness, unconventional humor and attitude toward women from Anna, while [[Scathach]] transformed his desire to fight into disciplined martial ability.[247][166]
- Victor openly favors devoted, possessive and obsessive romantic partners, describing the personalities commonly called Yandere. His attraction concerns their emotional intensity and loyalty, not only their physical appearance.[286]
- Victor's obsession with fighting predates his transformation into a Vampire. Edward recalled that Victor already possessed an unusual fixation on fighting while he was still a sick Human.[287]
- Victor regards limitations as problems to understand and overcome through training, rather than permanent reasons to abandon a goal. His approach was apparent during Scathach's earliest instruction and remained central to his later martial development.[166][173]
- Although Victor enjoys overwhelming power, he repeatedly returns to the importance of fundamentals. After reaching extraordinarily advanced levels of martial and supernatural power, he concluded that higher techniques were useless without sufficiently refined foundations.[173][288]
- Despite possessing extremely advanced precognition, Victor deliberately avoids depending excessively upon distant future sight. He considers long-range possibilities unreliable when dealing with Beings capable of altering their own futures and instead prefers applying foresight across extremely short intervals during combat.[289]
- Victor has felt genuine danger even while possessing extraordinary power. His documented struggles include early confrontations with Natashia and Scathach, training against Mizuki, and the battle involving [[Erebus]], [[Tartarus (Realm)|Tartarus]] and [[Nocturnus]]:[25][16][170][290]
- His early confrontation with Natashia.[25]
- His first encounters and training battles with Scathach.[16][166]
- His fight against Mizuki.[170]
- His battle against Erebus, Tartarus and Nocturnus.[290]
Names, Aliases & Running Gags
- Shortly after becoming a Vampire, Victor created the deliberately generic false identity James Smith. June supplied forged identification, financial documentation and records so that he could operate anonymously without connecting supernatural activities to Victor Walker.[164]
- The surname Alucard was deliberately chosen because it is “Dracula” written backwards. Victor selected it after learning [[Vlad Dracula Tepes]]' full name, effectively turning the identity of his new Clan into a provocation toward the First Progenitor.[75]
- Victor once secretly recorded one of Ruby's embarrassed reactions because he considered seeing his normally composed wife openly displaying her emotions something worth preserving for the future.[80]
- Victor once offered Eleonor exactly sixty-nine copies of the [[Hammer of Hephaestus]]. When she asked what he wanted in exchange, he pointed at her and answered “You”, deliberately allowing her to interpret the statement romantically before revealing that he actually wanted her to accompany him on hunts.[143][144]
- Victor's pet Zack eventually developed a harem of his own. Victor claimed Zack stopped acquiring new mates once their number equaled Victor's number of wives because Zack would never have more women than his friend. Victor summarized this logic simply by declaring that Zack was “a bro.”[291]
Human Life & Personal Curiosities
- Before becoming a Vampire, Victor weighed only 50 kg.[72]
- Victor suffered from RH-null blood and severe anemia throughout his Human life. Even moderate physical exertion could leave him hospitalized for days, despite his strong desire to participate in athletics.[229]
- At around eleven years old, Victor found and secretly hid some adult magazines. Although he had long forgotten about them, Violet remembered, having watched him closely since childhood.[292]
- On his twenty-first birthday, Anna took him outside a brothel and threatened to leave him there if he did not find a girlfriend.[247]
- Victor had a folder named “hardest game ever” on his computer containing over two terabytes of videos, but deleted it out of fear that Violet would discover his secret.[293]
- Before becoming supernatural, Victor had been attending college and still carried a long-standing grudge against [[Luan Davis]], who had mocked his inability to participate normally in sports. After becoming a Vampire, one of Victor's earliest uses of his new physical condition was humiliating Luan in a basketball game.[229][259]
- Victor considered obtaining money by targeting criminals after becoming a Vampire, while using forged records and the identity James Smith to separate his supernatural activities from his former civilian life.[293][164]
- Despite possessing Vampiric Charm capable of manipulating Humans, Victor refused to use it on Leon or Anna when revealing the supernatural world to them. Their acceptance mattered to him specifically because it was freely given.[294]
- Victor learned a massage technique from Scathach that originated as an assassin's method for completely relaxing the body. With her modifications, the technique could kill someone by relaxing their body to the point that it ceased functioning. Victor combines the technique with his electrical abilities for intimate pleasure.[59]
- Before learning what [[World Trees]] actually were, Victor primarily recognized the term through fantasy media and stories involving [[Yggdrasil]]. After discovering Roxanne's true nature, he voluntarily began studying books about World Trees, surprising Ruby because Victor rarely pursued academic reading unless the subject genuinely interested him.[295][296]
- For a period Victor essentially stopped sleeping. His enormous vitality allowed his body to function without ordinary physical rest, but one reason was that sleeping allowed [[Persephone]]'s curse to pull him into her spiritual domain, and Victor simply did not want to keep dealing with her.[297]
- Victor was described as possessing wealth sufficient to buy Earth five times over. The comparison refers to his resources during that period rather than a precise current valuation of his much larger Imperial economy.[298]
Family & Relationships
- Victor distinguishes between relationships based only on marriage or political association and the people he personally accepts as family. His unwavering protection is centered on his wives, children and those he has deliberately taken into his household.[241][30]
- Victor treats those he has accepted into his family as his own regardless of their race, Bloodline or former allegiance. His concept of family became more important than the traditional Clan divisions of Vampire society.[241][37]
- After returning home, Victor spent an entire year with his harem, which consisted of twenty-six women at the time.[299]
- Victor has blessed all of his wives with the Divinity of Beauty.[183]
- As a Progenitor and a God of Beginnings, Victor can control whom he impregnates, when conception occurs, and how many children result. However, he prefers to leave conception to nature. His powers nevertheless respond passively to his unconscious will: his paranoia and feelings concerning male children caused his children to overwhelmingly manifest as daughters even without his deliberate intervention.[43]
- The tendency of Victor's wives to give birth to one True Dragon child each was a deliberate family decision, influenced by the Primordials' scrutiny of the Dragon race. Twins or triplets were not ruled out by simple infertility or an inability to survive pregnancy; Victor and his wives restrained reproduction rather than creating more [[True Dragons]] indiscriminately.[204]
- Whenever Victor was intimate with his wives, the future of those particular events was described as converging on a single inevitable outcome, rather than forming the branching possibilities normally associated with other events.[300]
- Victor eventually accepted that the number of his wives could reach triple digits because of the structure and traditions developing within his enormous family.[301]
- Victor briefly considered using his powers to help Vlad find someone who would genuinely love him, but rejected the idea. The memories inherited from [[Adonis Snow]] had demonstrated to him how destructive supernatural interference with affection could become, and Victor refused to manufacture another person's love simply because he believed the outcome might benefit them.[127]
- Every one of Victor's biological daughters inherits some variation of his unusual ocular perception. Their abilities differ in strength, but all possess the characteristic violet Dragon Eyes and the potential to further develop their perception of deeper aspects of Reality.[129]
- During one enormous gathering of the Imperial Princesses, Victor increased the height of his humanoid body to approximately three metres specifically so his increasingly tall daughters could gather around him more comfortably.[108]
- During the same gathering, Victor reaffirmed that his daughters were free to compete, argue, spar and challenge one another, but genuine hatred between sisters was unacceptable. Regardless of rivalry, Elderblood sisters were expected to protect one another.[108]
- Ophis once exploited Victor's weakness toward his daughters by assuming the small childlike appearance she possessed when the two first met, immediately making several of her adult sisters realize they could potentially use the same tactic on him.[127]
Physiology & Evolution
- Victor tells Velnorah that form and appearance have no fixed meaning for him, explaining that he can change them at will.[76]
- According to Ruby, after Roxanne evolved into a teenager, Victor weighed between 6,000 and 8,000 kg, primarily because of his muscle mass.[73]
- According to Vlad, Victor reached adulthood in [[Biblical Hell]].[302]
- His transformation into a Blood Dragon allowed Victor to consume normal food again.[253]
- After multiple evolutions, Victor no longer possessed an ordinary Human physiology, although he retained his Human origins and memories. His progression through his Dragon God stage included:[303]
- Human → Vampire Progenitor → Dragon Rider → Blood Dragon Primogenitor → Dragon God.[10][9][91][6][186]
- At this stage, he was described as 100% Blood Dragon.[97]
- Unlike the usual golden blood associated with Gods, Victor possesses pure black blood rather than golden blood.[304]
- Investigation of Victor's Human ancestry revealed that the [[Walker Bloodline]] had apparently accumulated potential extremely slowly across generations before eventually producing Victor's RH-null Golden Blood. Victor further concluded that several predatory characteristics later magnified through Vampirism and Dragonhood had already existed latently within his Human ancestry.[14]
- Victor believed that his eventual entrance into supernatural society was probably unavoidable. If Violet had not transformed him into a Vampire, his connection to Leona or some other supernatural event would likely have exposed him to another lineage or supernatural system.[14]
- Victor deliberately avoids distributing his Blood or True Dragon lineage indiscriminately. Despite being theoretically capable of creating additional Dragons, he regards the [[Elderblood Bloodline]] and True Dragonhood as defining foundations of the Imperial Family rather than ordinary upgrades for citizens or political allies.[204]
Unusual Titles & Supernatural Assessments
- When Limbo analyzed Victor, it identified him as the Second Progenitor before that status was universally understood by the supernatural world.[9]
- Limbo's examination also produced several unusual titles that reflected Victor's character and supernatural connections:[9]
- King of Those Who Dwell in the Night.[9]
- Loved by the Night.[9]
- Battle Maniac.[9]
- Marked by the [[Chaos]] Witch.[9]
- Loved by Animals.[9]
- Loved by the Lightning Spirits.[9]
- One Who Has the Protection of the Goddess [[Aphrodite]].[9]
- Loving Father.[9]
- Several of those titles confused Victor himself, particularly Marked by the Chaos Witch, Loved by Animals and Loved by the Lightning Spirits.[9]
- Victor distrusted Limbo's analysis enough to demand that the entity repeat it. The second examination again recognized him as the Second Progenitor but also began producing extrapolations concerning relationships that had not yet occurred, convincing Victor that not every result should be interpreted as a literal statement of his current circumstances.[197]
- Limbo's recognition of Victor as the Second Progenitor was notable because it was not reading a political title bestowed by Vlad. The prison analyzed the actual nature and Energy of the Being standing before it.[9]
Godhood & Notable Firsts
- Victor was twenty-one at the beginning of the story and had ascended to Godhood by the age of twenty-five, as measured by the passage of time on Earth.[37][186]
- Victor personally created [[Etherea]], an extraordinary world used by his family, rather than merely conquering or settling an existing planet.[76]
- Vlad stated that an exceptionally large number of Goddesses had blessed Victor, including virtually every Goddess associated with Victor's Faction.[305]
- After erasing the [[Greek Pantheon]], Victor's newly formed [[Dragons Nest Pantheon]] was temporarily designated “Pantheon 7475909777” by the System.[306]
- Victor's ascension disrupted ordinary expectations for Godhood by awakening an exceptionally large number of Divinities, including major Concepts and personal Divinities reflecting the characteristics of his existence:[186][12]
- His awakening included Negativity, a Concept far more fundamental than the ordinary Divine offices possessed by the Gods of his original Sector.[186]
- His ascension was described as involving fifteen Divinities, rather than a conventional small Divine portfolio.[186]
- The highly unusual Yandere Divinity reflects characteristics of his personality and obsessive devotion to those he loves.[186][101]
- He possessed connections to both Positivity and Negativity, making his Draconic Godhood unusual even within the known Divine hierarchy.[186]
- Victor spent approximately 2,000 subjective years refining his major and minor Divinities. Most reached extremely advanced stages, while Negativity remained at approximately 3% and Begin/Beginnings remained at approximately 20%.[101]
Outer God Nature & Cosmic Standing
- The System records Victor under the name 〈CHAOS〉 rather than his ordinary personal name.[3]
- Victor's Eldritch God form contains Concepts born from his Chaos, as he functions as the [[Primordial Chaos|Primal Chaos]] associated with his own Pantheon. This process operates instinctively and influences the development and distribution of Concepts connected to his descendants.[307]
- Ophis' 〈Infinity〉 and [[Nero]]'s 〈Apocalypse〉 possess Eldritch connections ultimately rooted through Victor's deeper existence.[307]
- By the end of Volume 8, Victor had reached tenth place on the System leaderboard, sharing that position with Law. He was also identified as the fourth most knowledgeable Overlord concerning Creation and its workings, excluding the Regulators.[231]
- A clone possessing only 10% of Victor's power was already classified as a High-Level Entity by the System when Victor attempted to use it to access the portal leading from [[The Arcane Realm]] toward the [[Magic]] World. The attempt drew the attention of the Regulators and was abandoned.[231]
- By Volume 9, Victor's unrestricted true scale had grown beyond ordinary galaxies, while his commonly used humanoid appearances had become a matter of preference rather than a meaningful indication of his actual physical scale.[74]
Imperial & Cosmic Curiosities
- Victor deliberately allowed small groups of dissatisfied Imperial citizens to remain visible rather than eliminating every opposing voice. His reasoning was that visible dissent gave genuinely dangerous conspirators somewhere predictable to gather and made them easier to monitor before they became actual threats.[289]
- While maintaining the enormous Imperial Time-acceleration ritual, Victor discovered that the continuous Energy expenditure was itself useful training because the strain forced him to refine the efficiency and control of his power.[289]
- Victor admitted that he initially underestimated how expensive the temporal ritual would be. Without his wives sharing the burden, he believed he could eventually have been reduced to an unconscious living battery sustaining the process.[289]
- Victor deliberately limited the creation of additional True Dragons despite possessing the means to expand his race. His restraint reflected both concern about the Primordials' oversight and his conviction that the Elderblood Bloodline should remain an important foundation of his family.[204]
- Victor removed two scales from his own True Dragon body to give to his daughters [[Stheno]] and [[Euryale]]. Even after reducing their apparent size, the scales remained unexpectedly heavy until he further adjusted their burden through Energy.[135]
- Victor casually regarded those scales as unimportant, but Scathach corrected him and stated that a single scale from the mature Dragon Emperor could theoretically sustain an ordinary civilization for more than 100,000 years.[135]
- Victor's true Dragon body had become so enormous that the scales given to his daughters came from a body whose unrestricted dimensions exceeded multiple galaxies.[135]
- When the Elderblood family became too large for a conventional dinner arrangement, Victor solved the problem by creating a literal celestial banquet. Furniture and decorations were shaped from stars, supernovae, nebulae, black holes and lifeless celestial bodies.[135]
- Victor specifically avoided using inhabited worlds or planets containing World Trees as decorations for the banquet.[135]
- During the celestial banquet, Victor created clothing reflecting astronomical phenomena for members of his family. Natalia received a dress formed from the fabric of the Cosmos itself, with galaxies visible across it.[135]
- Despite the absurd scale of the banquet, Victor's intention was not to demonstrate Imperial authority. He created it as a family dinner and personally thanked his wives for everything they had contributed to the family and Empire.[135]
Time, Luxury & Later Family Life
- Victor prepared [[Tyche]] a personal “room” whose interior was actually a pocket dimension approximately comparable in area to South America, containing forests, animals, Fairy Spirits, waterfalls, a sea and a Temple designed around her preferences.[64]
- Victor regarded Tyche's enormous private dimension as relatively ordinary by the standards of his household, as several of his wives possessed similarly vast residences and Scathach's personal territory approached planetary scale.[64]
- Victor designed the entrance to Tyche's private chamber on a scale suitable for Dragons hundreds of meters in length. Under Earth-like conditions, the door was compared with [[Pluto]] in mass—approximately 13 sextillion kilograms—yet he treated it as a normally usable part of his family home.[64]
- When Tyche struggled to open the door despite possessing exceptional power by ordinary standards, Victor's reaction was not amazement but concern that she required additional physical training because a future Dragon Goddess should not struggle with a door intended to remain usable by members of his family.[64]
- Victor waited patiently for approximately seven hours while Tyche explored the South America-sized private dimension he had constructed for her, allowing her to discover the environment without rushing her.[64]
- When Tyche attempted to accelerate their intimacy because she believed becoming Victor's wife created an obligation to do so, Victor stopped her and told her there was no reason to force the relationship when they effectively possessed unlimited Time.[64]
- Victor distorted Time around himself and Tyche so extensively that they could theoretically spend approximately 10,000 subjective years together while almost no Time passed outside.[64]
- Another body continued dealing with Imperial responsibilities during this period, but Victor deliberately kept the version accompanying Tyche personally focused on her rather than treating the relationship as something an inattentive clone could handle.[64]
Additional Family, Imperial & Cosmic Records
- Victor established an Eldritch rule concerning the surname Elderblood: only people he personally recognized as belonging to his family could legitimately bear it. The family-protection measure was written through Eldritch language, which an outsider could not casually read or comprehend.[105]
- During the hundred-thousand-year Imperial celebration, Victor addressed the Empire on a scale encompassing countless worlds and promised to safeguard his subjects' Souls even if his own physical body were destroyed. His declaration also reinforced the absolute spiritual obligations associated with Imperial citizenship.[130]
- Victor occasionally enlarges his social humanoid appearance specifically to accommodate the growing numbers and physical sizes of his daughters, including adopting an approximately three-meter form when greeting them as a group.[108]
- During Scathach's instruction of the Elderblood family, Victor intervened when a session threatened to escalate from training into potentially lethal combat, distinguishing educational hardship from an attack that might seriously endanger a family member.[308]
- The Emperor planned to preserve Yggdrasil as an extensively protected garden world and remove its permanent resident population, while Mars became the Imperial capital at the approach of the 200,000-year milestone.[243]
- Victor personally conducted advanced lessons for his daughters on the origins of Energy, the differences between Draconic Runes and Eldritch Runes, and the structure of the Cosmos. His instruction distinguished Attributeless Energy, from which native forms of Energy arise, from [[Eldritch Energy]], which originates outside their Universe.[309][310]
- When [[Valentina Victoria Elderblood]] described Attributeless Energy as a blank canvas from which all ordinary Energies could be created, Victor agreed with the comparison.[310]
- Some of Victor's daughters asked cosmological questions to which even he did not know definitive answers. Rather than fabricate explanations, he admitted uncertainty while taking pride in their curiosity and intellectual development.[311]
- When teaching his daughters, Victor distinguished between altering native laws through his Attributeless Energy and releasing Eldritch Energy, whose corruption could damage the structure of their Universe. He did not treat unconstrained Eldritch power as a solution to every advanced theoretical problem.[310][312]
- Victor refused to surrender Moira to a cosmic office merely because of her extraordinary relationship with the Universe. He maintained that his duty as her father came before demands from the System and Primordial authorities.[69][245]
- Victor personally drew the smaller Sectors associated with [[Nightingale]], Samar and Arcane into his own Middle Sector with help from the Universal Tree, and then reorganized their young galaxies and Solar Systems rather than leaving the regions in their previous positions.[244][254]
- Victor gave his Herald War the sentient greatsword [[Gol-goroth]], intending its extraordinary Eldritch and Draconic properties to enable direct action against the major Upper-Sector factions. The declaration accompanying War's departure marked the beginning of a direct Imperial offensive; Victor himself did not personally join War's first confrontation with the [[Black Eclipse Pantheon]]'s Chief Gods.[175][228] He entered later in person, once War refused to be handed to the patrons, as the galaxy-holding True Dragon.[246]
- Shortly before that offensive, Victor visited his original childhood friends [[Frederick Winter]], [[Andrew Walter]] and [[Edward Jonathan Elizabeth Lykos]] and offered each access to the strongest form of the Tower of Nightmare. He deliberately left the decision to undertake the training to them rather than compelling their participation.[225]
- Victor considered the protection of his childhood friends' families more important than deploying them recklessly into a war against enemies far beyond their established strength. Their choice to prioritize their families relieved him.[225]

### Abilities

VICTOR ELDERBLOOD • ABILITY ARCHIVE
Powers, Skills & Abilities
A categorized archive of Victor's demonstrated powers, racial traits, conceptual authorities, forms, techniques, spells, skills and resistances.
Power is good, but Power without control is useless against someone of my level.
—Victor Elderblood to [[Diablo]], Chapter 688
About this archive: Victor's arsenal is exceptionally broad, and several powers naturally overlap between racial, conceptual, Eldritch, Progenitor and learned systems. The story also establishes that he possesses thousands of active and passive powers that have never been individually demonstrated, derived from the countless beings he has killed or absorbed and the enormous number of divine blessings attached to him. The entries below therefore prioritize powers that have been explicitly shown, stated or otherwise indexed in the story.
[[Velnorah Xyphora Elderblood Thaloria II]] further notes that Victor's range of abilities is so varied that even her A.I. cannot reliably predict how he will use them in battle.[1]

01 · CORE ARSENAL

#### General Powers, Skills & Abilities
Conceptual, cosmic, physical and sovereign abilities.
This section indexes Victor's abilities by their general functional effect rather than treating every Divinity, Energy source, race or Concept he possesses as a separate power. For example, powers capable of removing a target from existence are indexed under Existence Erasure, while powers that alter the operating structure of a Reality are indexed under Reality Manipulation. Pure Eldritch abilities are covered separately under Eldritch Nature; only composite applications are included here when Victor combines his Eldritch side with otherwise broader powers such as Time, Space, Soul manipulation or conceptual authority.
- Conceptual Manipulation: Victor can interact directly with abstract Concepts and the metaphysical authority attached to them rather than being limited to their physical manifestations. His abilities include distributing compatible Concepts, reinforcing them with other powers, embedding them into created structures and exerting influence through Concepts that permeate large portions of Reality.[2][3]
- Concept Bestowal: Victor can grant Concepts he sufficiently understands to another Being when the Concept is compatible with the recipient's existence. His demonstrated range is not limited to conventional physical phenomena and includes abstract ideas such as <Research>.[2][4][5]
- Conceptual Amplification: Victor can reinforce a Concept through another compatible source of power. He has pushed a Concept toward a more advanced Synchronization by feeding it Eldritch Essence and his Negative-side authority, without the full understanding that Synchronization normally takes.[3]
- Conceptual Anchoring: Victor can embed high-order Concepts directly into the metaphysical foundation of a created existence. When constructing a miniature galaxy for [[Norabell Elderblood]], he used <Negativity> and <Begin> as foundational anchors, producing a structure with far greater existential weight than a conventional subordinate dimension.[6][7]
- Conceptual Rule Embedding: Concepts incorporated during Victor's creation process can become part of what the resulting structure fundamentally is, rather than remaining temporary powers applied externally to it.[6][7]
- Conceptual Authority Interaction: Victor understands that sufficiently fundamental Concepts function as metaphysical "keys" to Reality. Raw Energy alone does not necessarily allow a Being to overwrite a structure if it lacks authority over the principles supporting that structure, while Victor can deliberately construct and interact with Reality through compatible Conceptual authority.[7]
- Universal Conceptual Influence: After being selected as the successor of Negativity, Victor gained influence through the Negative component permeating the native Universe. The System estimates that this places approximately 50% of the Universe within the broad sphere of Victor's Negative-side influence, particularly Concepts associated with spiritual, emotional and non-physical phenomena. This represents conceptual influence rather than unrestricted control over half of Reality.[8]
- Administrative-System Influence: Because the System itself exists inside and operates through the same native cosmological framework, it is not completely outside Victor's Conceptual reach. The System judged that isolating him through its administrative authority would fail, because Negativity had already chosen him as successor.[8]
- Instinct of Negativity: Entering the Upper Sectors woke more of Negativity. She appeared as a feminine body of pure red energy, named herself the instinct of what he calls [[Primordial Chaos]], and said Positivity is the reason and kept the knowledge. She does not teach techniques. She told him to feel, as he already had, and then she entered his body as that red energy. He can hear her afterward. Her later claim, which he does not simply grant, is that he can move Beings whose Concepts sit close to her domain only because she chose him. The demonstrated result in that fight was the capture of [[Aetherys]] and [[Oryndal]], not a general rule stated by Victor.[9][10]
- Conceptual Energy Condensation: Victor can gather both the Energy associated with a Concept and the Conceptual power itself into a concentrated manifestation. During the confrontation with the Primordial Beings he condensed all the Negativity Energy available to him into an enormous red sphere together with the authority of Negativity itself.[8]
- Conceptual Detonation (Unperformed): Victor threatened to destabilize the Negative half of the cosmic Duality rather than simply use the gathered Energy as an ordinary projectile. The assembled Primordials treated the threat as credible because the resulting damage would propagate through the portion of the Universe dependent upon that Concept. Victor ultimately did not perform the detonation.[8]
- Existence Erasure: Victor can remove targets from existence rather than merely inflicting lethal physical damage. He could select targets dispersed across different planets within a galaxy and erase everything he desired without individually travelling to each location.[11]
- Mass Existence Erasure: The same application can operate against numerous distant targets rather than being restricted to one individual immediately in front of Victor.[11]
- Selective Erasure: Victor can erase unwanted phenomena while preserving the surrounding system. During Earth's restoration, garbage and buried waste were expelled before disappearing while pollution itself was erased and the planet's environment was restored without destroying the ecosystem being repaired.[12]
- Power Removal / De-Ascension: Victor can attack the metaphysical structure supporting another Being's supernatural status and permanently remove that power instead of simply suppressing it temporarily. Against Ra, Victor attacked the structure of his Soul, extracted the Divine foundation connecting him to the Sun and consumed it. Victor then repaired Ra's damaged body while deliberately leaving the former Primordial Sun God as an ordinary mortal.[13]
- Metaphysical Power Extraction: Victor can physically separate a supernatural foundation from the Soul carrying it rather than requiring the target's complete destruction.[13]
- Permanent Power Loss: Ra's lost Divine status did not return when Victor restored his body; Victor intentionally reconstructed him without the supernatural foundation that previously defined his existence.[13]
- Existential Downgrading: The resulting transformation reduced an ancient Primordial God to a Mortal existence while preserving Ra himself as a living individual.[13]
- Existential Transformation: Victor can fundamentally rewrite the nature of sufficiently compatible or inferior Beings rather than merely disguising their physical appearance.
- Race Transformation: Victor can convert individuals into supernatural races such as Vampires, [[Werewolves]] and other species when he possesses the necessary understanding and power.[14][15]
- Complete Racial Reconstruction: Victor did not merely add Vampiric traits to Frederick. Using multiple powers together, he reconstructed Frederick into a complete Noble Vampire while preserving the Onmyō abilities he had acquired as a Human.[14]
- Trait Preservation: A transformed target does not necessarily need to lose useful abilities belonging to its previous state; Victor can preserve compatible supernatural systems while rebuilding the target's racial foundation.[14]
- Lineage Purification: Victor can strengthen a diluted supernatural lineage back toward its ancestral quality. After [[Ryujin Ikaros]] brought a sealed fragment to the Empire, Victor judged the man's Japanese dragon lineage — a Ryu, not one of his own [[True Dragons]] — too diluted for a dragon who should seek strength. The adjustment was small on Victor's own scale. On Ryujin's, it restored the lineage toward the quality of his ancestors and opened the potential of an elite warrior capable of destroying entire Solar Systems. That is still below a galaxy-threatening herald such as War. Victor left the outcome to Ryujin himself and told Akasha to watch him. The Empire already had hundreds of elite warriors; Ryujin would be one more if he used what he had been given.[16]
- Existential Elevation / Reduction: Victor explains that against a sufficiently weaker target whose Soul he can manipulate, the difference between something insignificant and something Divine can itself become subject to alteration, using the example of changing an ant into a God or a God into an ant.[15]
- Temporal-Existential / History Manipulation (Hybrid Application): While teaching his daughters, Victor distinguished two steps. Looking at a mortal, he can see that mortal's entire past, present and countless possibilities if he chooses to. With his understanding of Time and Space he can treat that life like a toy in his hands. His Eldritch side goes further: if he corrupts the mortal and pulls that existence out of this Reality's rules, the present, the past, the future and the whole existence come under his control. He can set such a life as having begun as an ant rather than as a humanoid. He told them he would not do it. Playing with mortal lives is not something he enjoys, and he treated the old Greek, Norse and Egyptian abuses of weaker beings as a lesson not to repeat. The separate comparison he made in the same lesson — an ordinary high-ranking God beside a Dragon God being like an ant beside a human — is a statement about levels of existence, not this technique.[7]
- Singular Existence / Timeline Uniqueness: Victor exists as a unique individual rather than possessing conventional alternate counterparts across the surviving timeline structure. Following the events surrounding the erased Primordial Destiny and the collapse/convergence of the former branching timelines, alternate, parallel and causal versions of Victor ceased to remain as independent counterparts.[17]
- Alternate-Self Absence: Ordinary alternate versions of Victor are no longer distributed throughout parallel timeline possibilities.[17]
- Main-Timeline Record Preservation: Victor's surviving existence and the Records associated with his family remained protected inside the surviving Main Timeline.[17]
- Fate Independence (Cosmological Condition): With the Primordial Destiny responsible for the Universe's former predetermined course erased, Victor is no longer subject to the same cosmic predestination that once governed the original Timeline.[17] This is a condition created by the wider cosmological change rather than a personal active Fate-manipulation technique unique to Victor.
- Reality Manipulation: Victor can directly alter Reality itself, allowing one broad authority to reproduce effects that would otherwise require numerous narrower abilities.
- Physical-Law Alteration: At a family gathering he snapped his fingers and Reality changed. Every person and object around him became weightless until he restored the ordinary condition.[18]
- Environmental Transmutation: Victor converted a nearby cloud of fog into stable ground, allowing everyone present to land safely after ending the weightless state.[18]
- Cosmic Matter Manipulation: Victor can reshape astronomical matter and cosmic phenomena into functional objects. During the same gathering he produced furniture using stars, supernovae, lifeless planets, nebulae and even a [[Black Hole]].[18]
- Galaxy Manipulation: Victor's Reality control operates upon complete galaxies. During the Imperial superproject he manipulated the structure surrounding a galaxy and its central Black Hole, while his later Sector reconstruction allowed him to completely envelop and physically move entire galaxies.[19][20]
- Multi-Galaxy Manipulation: He guides groups of galaxies at the same time, sending separate Galactic structures toward separate destinations.[20]
- Orbital Preservation: Moving a galaxy does not require Victor to scatter or destroy its internal structure. He transported billions of stars while Solar Systems remained in their orbits and not a single star was adversely affected by the movement.[20]
- Physical Galaxy Grasp: Separate from moving galaxies through Reality, Victor's Dragon body can hold an entire galaxy in its hands. When he answered War in the Upper Sectors he appeared as that Dragon, and the true body kept the hold and hardly moved while a combat projection fought [[Vaelthar]] and the Gods. He released the galaxy only when the projection left. The galaxy was no longer under his influence, and the Dragon began to drift between the galaxies again. Ruby later notes that some galaxies in that Sector reach 10,000 times the size of the Milky Way. That figure is her measure of galaxies in the Sector. It is not a stated size for the one galaxy in his hands.[21][22][23]
- Supergalaxy Merger: Once the Empire was in the Upper Sectors, scattered galaxies were the wrong shape for a realm he meant to hold. He merged every galaxy already under his rule into one supergalaxy, six regions along the arms and an Imperial Core at the center. He told Ruby he was not creating anything. He was reshaping what already existed. Even for him, a galaxy made from nothing is an enormous burden. Creating has always been the most difficult of the three, shaping easier, and destroying ridiculously easy. Fully recovered, he treated this reshaping as a trifle and began at once. His creator divinity had been freed of the restrictions it carried before the transition, so the change ran across the whole territory together instead of piece by piece.[24][9]
- Distance Redefinition: Attributeless Energy enveloped the galaxies. Previous distances stopped mattering, borders between the old territories ceased to apply, and the systems took the places he had already drawn. He moved through that space in a Dragon body larger than entire galaxies, wings and tail spread across regions that had been separate, and he did not have to perform each change by hand.[9]
- Supergalaxy Domain Seal: When the merger was finished he enveloped the whole territory in his Energy and made the place inaccessible. From that moment he had complete knowledge of every corner in real time, the same practical omniscience he already holds inside a world of his own, available whenever he wishes. Outside gazes vanished. What remained visible was the supergalaxy. [[Aetheryon]] later refused to send elites into it. His reading was that the domain of the Chosen of Negativity would mean death or imprisonment for them, and that only Victor himself could enter. That reading is the enemy leader's, not a claim Victor stated.[9][25]
- Cosmic Spatial Reorganization: Victor personally reorganized the Galactic geography of the newly merged Lower Sectors, measuring relative distances and placing younger galaxies where they could continue developing without colliding with older Imperial regions.[20]
- Solar-System Relocation: Victor can reposition complete Solar Systems while keeping their internal astronomical arrangement functional, as demonstrated when arranging [[Nightingale]] and Samar after their Sectors were merged into his own.[20]
- Reality Stabilization: Victor can stabilize enormous structures while they are being manipulated. During the Imperial development ritual he acted as a principal stabilizing force around Galactic-scale operations; later, when Norabell's attempt to seize his artificial galaxy caused Reality to tremble, Victor stabilized the entire structure with a thought.[19][6]
- Reality Restoration: Victor can repair extensive dimensional or spatial damage. He restored the massive dimensional rift caused by one of his Grandmaster sword attacks and later repaired [[Scathach]]'s devastated training dimension with a simple action after stopping her attack.[26][27]
- Reality-Restoration Interference: Victor can release enough existential pressure to prevent even another extremely high-level Reality manipulator from immediately repairing his damage. Infinity's first attempt to restore the region he had torn failed. A greater Authority was required to repair it, and his roar destroyed what had just been restored.[8]
- Reality-Shattering Presence: Victor's released existence can physically fracture surrounding Space and Reality without requiring a conventional attack. During the confrontation with the System, the surrounding fabric of the Middle Sector cracked like broken glass under his presence.[28]
- Reality-Shattering Voice: Victor's laughter further damaged the surrounding Reality and his roar destroyed the area Infinity had just restored.[8]
- Law Manipulation / Reality Administration: Inside a Reality over which Victor possesses sufficient sovereignty, he can alter the operating Rules themselves rather than individually countering every phenomenon through force.
- Local Rule Imposition: Victor can declare behavioral and supernatural restrictions within his inner Reality and have the environment enforce them.[29]
- Power Nullification: When Violet manifested the power of Order inside Victor's realm, Victor declared that the power of Order was forbidden there and the manifested authority immediately vanished.[29]
- Aggression Suppression: Victor imposed a prohibition against fighting inside the same environment rather than individually restraining every family member present.[29]
- Fundamental Law Reconfiguration: Victor's sovereign authority can alter local Rules governing Time, supernatural powers, Souls, dimensions and other functions of a Reality under his control.[30][31][7]
- Reincarnation-System Exclusion: Indexed under Soul Manipulation. It is the same act as keeping his Souls out of the native cycle, not a separate Law.[31]
- Anomalous Influence Suppression: Victor states that he can block most of the passive Reality-favoring influence produced by [[Moira Eutychia Elderblood]]. The exact mechanism is not identified, so this demonstrates suppression of most of the observed phenomenon rather than complete immunity to every possible Luck-based effect.[32]
- Cosmological Stasis / Evolution Suppression: Victor can actively prevent an entire Sector from following its natural cosmological progression. After integrating several Lower Sectors, the barrier of his own Sector became extremely thin and the surrounding Reality naturally attempted to advance to its next state. Victor continuously expended power to forcibly keep the complete Sector from advancing.[33]
- Sector-Wide Stabilization: Anna describes Victor as the one holding everything together while maintaining the enlarged Sector in its current condition.[33]
- Natural-Process Suppression: The Universe itself attempted to continue along its normal developmental course, while Victor actively refused that progression and held the surrounding cosmological structure in place.[33]
- Sustained Cosmological Control: This was not a momentary interruption. Victor maintained the suppression continuously while simultaneously sustaining the final stages of the enormous Imperial temporal project.[34][33]
- Creation Manipulation: Victor can generate matter, celestial bodies, living organisms, dimensions and complex cosmic structures rather than being limited to manipulating pre-existing material.
- Matter Creation: Victor can directly produce ordinary and supernatural materials from Energy.[35]
- Matter Transmutation: Victor has casually transformed ordinary dirt into Divine Metal and produced material combining properties belonging to normally distinct supernatural substances.[35]
- Cosmic-Material Transmutation: Victor's later control allows him to transform astronomical phenomena into stable usable matter. At that same gathering he turned stars, supernovae, planets, nebulae, fog and a Black Hole into furniture, ground and other usable structures.[18]
- Clothing Manipulation: The same broad Matter and Reality control lets Victor alter clothing without physical contact. At the star-beast banquet he remade what everyone wore while he was rearranging the cosmos around them. His own clothes became a black suit that reflected the darkness of space, and his hair changed with it. Nyx received a dress made from the starry night. [[Amaterasu]] received a golden dress woven from the light of a yellow star. Natalia wore a dress made from the fabric of the cosmos, with galaxies shimmering in it. Violet wore white woven from supernova light. [[Tyche]] wore a gown made from the light of white stars. Each person received a dress corresponding to a star or another cosmic phenomenon.[36][18]
- Resource Generation: Victor can manufacture large quantities of mundane and supernatural resources instead of depending exclusively upon naturally occurring deposits.[37]
- Star Creation: He creates miniature stars. For Moira he formed a perfect small replica of a yellow Milky Way star in his palm and let her consume it.[38][32]
- Eldritch Weapon Manifestation: Victor can call a weapon out of Dragon power and wake it with an Eldritch declaration. Before sending War through the Sector barrier he summoned a massive purple greatsword of pure Dragon power, brought the blade to his face, and spoke in the Eldritch language that whoever wields the weapon and is recognized by the Emperor becomes war personified. A gigantic eye opened in the blade. The uncanny Energy that manifested was suppressed at once. The eye addressed him as Great [[Chaos]], accepted its purpose, and received the name [[Gol-goroth]]. When War took the hilt the sword merged with his arm for a moment and then became a weapon again. What it granted was not ordinary Divine war. It was chaotic Eldritch war, a fight in which life and death are meaningless and there are no rules, only unpredictable chaos. Victor treated it as a power for fighting alone, surrounded by enemies, and not as something to use beside allies.[39]
- Moon Creation: Victor can create moons and reinforce them to endure supernatural stresses far beyond those experienced by ordinary celestial bodies.[40]
- Planet Creation: Victor can create complete planets for specific civilizations or members of his family, including worlds intended to preserve Greek and Shinto culture.[26][41]
- Resource-Rich Planet Creation: Victor can create planets already containing useful resources ranging from ordinary metals to supernatural materials.[37]
- Instant Large-Scale Construction: After reconstructing Mars, Victor created an enormous castle upon one of its floating islands with a single thought.[42]
- Planetary Manipulation / Terraforming: Victor can reconstruct the physical and supernatural environment of an entire planet instead of being limited to conventional terrain alteration.
- Planetary Expansion: During the reconstruction of Mars, Victor enlarged the planet into a megaplanet capable of supporting trillions of inhabitants.[42]
- Planetary Structural Manipulation: Victor altered the planet's overall structure rather than merely modifying its surface.[42]
- Environmental Zone Creation: He created regions of pure magma, eternal ice, extreme gravity, weightlessness and locations that continuously emitted Miasma, alongside numerous other specialized environments.[42]
- Floating Landmass Creation: Victor created several enormous floating islands in the planetary atmosphere.[42]
- Planetary Monster Ecosystem Creation: Victor populated the altered Mars with imported Leviathans and Monsters while also creating new primeval and mutated species intended to function as dangerous native fauna.[42]
- Planetary Life-Support Substitution: Victor was capable of personally serving the sustaining role normally fulfilled by a World Tree, although he rejected doing so permanently because his own Energy was too powerful and unusual to safely expose ordinary future populations to over long periods.[42]
- Planetary Regeneration Infrastructure: Victor placed the true World Tree structures within the protection of his Soul while their external connections supported the planets. Because the Trees survive even if an external planet is destroyed, a connected world can theoretically be regenerated as long as its World Tree remains intact.[42]
- Planet-Wide Automated Defense: Victor filled Mars with hundreds of traps specifically configured to activate against enemies rather than ordinary Imperial citizens.[42]
- Planetary Restoration: Victor previously restored Earth after the Demonic War and Human environmental damage, eliminating pollution and accumulated waste while returning the planet to an exceptionally healthy condition.[12]
- Conceptual Reality Architecture: Victor can build cosmic structures whose metaphysical foundations extend beyond ordinary matter, Space and Energy.
- Subordinate Reality Creation: Victor can casually create ordinary alternate dimensions that borrow the pre-existing Laws of the greater Reality containing them.[6]
- Conceptually Anchored Cosmic Creation: He can create structures of much greater complexity by incorporating high-order Concepts directly into their foundation. The miniature galaxy he made for Norabell was supported by Negativity, Beginning and Eldritch power, not by filling an empty dimension with stars.[6]
- Existence & Reality Bestowal: Victor explicitly describes the process as giving the miniature galaxy existence and Reality.[6]
- Existential Weight Bestowal: By embedding stronger and more fundamental principles into a created structure, Victor can make it metaphysically "heavier" and therefore substantially harder to alter than an ordinary dimension.[6][7]
- Reality-Usurpation Resistance: Norabell could effortlessly seize ownership of Victor's ordinary cube-shaped dimension when permitted to interact with it, but she could not similarly seize the conceptually anchored miniature galaxy despite reinforcing her attempt with her own Space-Time authority and Dragon Language.[6]
- Conceptual Foundation Reinforcement: Victor can reinforce a created Reality by increasing the quality and number of principles incorporated into its foundation, making external manipulation progressively more difficult.[7]
- Proto-Reality Creation: The miniature galaxy approached the structure of an independent Reality and possessed multiple levels of existence, but Victor explicitly distinguishes it from a fully autonomous Universe.[6][7]
- Spatial Manipulation: Victor can manipulate distance, position and spatial relationships from local scales to Galactic and Sector-wide operations.
- Spatial Folding / Wormhole Creation: Victor can fold Space between separated points until the intervening distance effectively disappears.[14]
- Teleportation: Victor can instantly cross immense astronomical distances rather than physically travelling through every point between his origin and destination.[43]
- Sector-Barrier Portal: Victor can open a portal through the barrier of his own Sector. After arming War, he opened one in the barrier the enemy was trying to thin. War crossed it and entered the Upper Sectors alone. With Gol-goroth he was treated as super-elite, a being who threatens entire galaxies, and as a herald bound to Victor. Victor was not spending a disposable body. If War died, he would return to Victor and be revived.[39]
- Space-Rift Impact: A throw from the combat projection hit space hard enough to open a rift under Vaelthar, as if the cosmos had turned to glass.[22]
- Teleportation [[Radar Warning Receiver (RWR)|Interception]] / Spatial Redirection: Victor can intercept another person's teleportation and replace the intended destination with one of his choosing. When Pepper attempted to teleport directly to her room, Victor redirected her and caused her to appear on his lap.[44]
- Personal Spatial Storage: Victor constructed a large inventory space accessible through a dark spatial opening by combining his understanding of Space with Runic principles and dimensional storage technology. Its practical capacity is infinite as it expands with the Energy supplied to it.[45]
- Dimensional Manipulation: Victor can create, reinforce, isolate, relocate, repair, govern and destroy dimensions.
- Dimension Creation: Victor can create self-contained dimensions, including spaces nested inside larger dimensions already existing within his own Soul.[37]
- Habitable Pocket-Reality Creation: Victor created a private Reality for Tyche Elderblood comparable in area to South America, containing forests, waterfalls, a sea, wildlife, hundreds of Fairy Spirits and a complete temple environment.[46]
- Dimensional Ownership Manipulation: Victor can determine who possesses administrative ownership of a created dimension and deliberately permit another compatible manipulator to assume that authority.[6]
- Dimensional Isolation: He prepared an interrogation facility inside a Reality isolated from the outside world and reinforced it so the captured foreign entity could neither escape nor easily communicate with its source.[43]
- Regional Military Isolation: Victor can cut a hostile region off from its own ruler. When the Imperial attack opened, [[Vharzath]]'s planets were being struck from every side. He sensed more than twenty elite fighters, all women, at the level of a Throne or stronger. He could neither recall his forces nor send relief, because Victor had already isolated the area.[21]
- Dimensional Reinforcement: Victor strengthened Scathach's training dimension sufficiently to withstand combat between True Dragon Goddesses and continued reinforcing it while attacks capable of destroying the original structure were released.[47]
- Dimensional Relocation: Victor can move an entire existing dimension together with all inhabitants and objects inside it. He moved Scathach's entire training dimension, and everything inside it, onto the Elderblood family's personal superplanet.[18]
- Dimensional Destruction: Victor can destroy dimensions that are no longer required, including the isolated facility used for the Upper-Sector interrogation.[43]
- Dimensional Restoration: He can repair severely damaged dimensions instead of recreating them from nothing.[26][27]
- Cosmological Anchoring / Sector Attraction: Victor can use fragments of his own existence as long-term anchors capable of influencing the cosmological destination of developing Sectors.
- Existence Fragmentation: The spheres distributed through Samar, Nightingale and Arcane were explicitly revealed to be small fragments of Victor himself.[48]
- Remote Cosmological Influence: Victor saturated the Lower Sectors with those fragments so their development became cosmologically biased toward his own Sector instead of an unrelated region.[48][49]
- Sector Attraction: Once saturation was sufficient, Victor could use the fragments as anchors and actively pull complete Lower Sectors toward himself.[48][49]
- Sector Relocation / Merger: Victor drew Samar, Nightingale and Arcane into his Mid-Level Sector, causing their complete Galactic territories to emerge inside his barrier rather than transporting only their inhabited planets.[49]
- Multi-Sector Manipulation: Victor performed the operation on all three Lower Sectors during the same merger process.[49]
- Cosmological Boundary Expansion: His Sector's barrier expanded to accommodate the incoming Galactic regions as the merger completed.[49]
- Time Manipulation: Victor can directly alter temporal flow inside spaces under his influence.
- Time Dilation: Victor has repeatedly created extreme differences between internal and external Time. Earlier applications produced ratios such as one external minute to one internal year and accelerated his internal worlds through enormous subjective periods.[50]
- Localized Time Bubbles: Victor can isolate comparatively small regions under independent temporal flow while continuing to monitor external events. Approximately four subjective months passed during one private interaction while less than two external hours elapsed.[51]
- Extreme Dimensional Time Acceleration: Victor later created temporal ratios where thousands of subjective years could theoretically pass while only a moment elapsed outside. During Albedo's punishment, he changed the training dimension so that one external day equaled approximately one hundred internal years.[46][47]
- Temporal State Restoration: Victor can incorporate Time into restoration techniques, returning destroyed physical and spiritual structures toward a previous viable state while reconstructing them through additional powers.[43]
- Past Event Projection: Through his conceptual connection and access to the [[Akashic Records]], Victor can access recorded events from the Past and bring a previous event into the Present.[3]
- Extratemporal Movement (Hybrid Application): By combining Conceptual power with his Eldritch nature, he has stepped outside ordinary Time and moved in a region that should have required Primordial-level synchronization.[3]
- Soul Manipulation: Victor possesses extensive control over Souls, Soul fragments and the information defining spiritual existence.
- Soul Severing: Victor can cut directly through Souls rather than merely destroying bodies. During the Greek conflict, Gods struck by Victor's attacks died permanently instead of entering the recoverable incapacitated state normally available to Divine Beings.[52]
- Permanent Spiritual Death: The Soul-severing property made Victor's attacks genuinely fatal to the affected Gods rather than allowing their Divine existence to restore them after ordinary bodily destruction.[52]
- High Level-God Soul Execution: Victor can strike a High Level God's Soul directly, erase the body, and keep the Soul in his hand. In his God Emperor form he judged the Gods around War a disappointment, then killed the restored [[Kaelith]] this way. Only the patrons perceived the method. The body was gone. The Soul remained in his hand.[21]
- Invading-Concept Extraction: Victor can pull a foreign Divine fragment off a living Soul and repair the injury the removal leaves. A fragment of a Light deity had wrapped itself around Ryujin Ikaros's Soul and clung to his chest. Victor raised a hand and, with Soul manipulation, cut that fragment out precisely. Removing part of a Soul still damages it, even for him. As the chosen successor of Negativity, repairing and nurturing the Soul afterward was simple. The sphere fell into his hand with its power sealed. It was only a fragment, not a complete possession, and the sealed fragment itself was not something he could influence. He identified it as a fragment of invaders into the Empire. Had Ryujin waited longer, his body would have become the enemy's vessel without his noticing. Victor then gave the sealed sphere to Ruby as a research subject.[16]
- Soul Fragment Recovery: Victor recovered the divided fragments of [[Metis]] Elderblood from the structures preserving them and placed the fragments within his Personal Universe so the damaged Soul could begin reconstructing itself.[53]
- Soul Repair: Victor can repair severe spiritual damage instead of merely transferring a Soul into a replacement body. He repaired Natashia's damaged spiritual foundation after discovering the separate presences of Natasha and Carmila within her Soul.[54]
- Spiritual Independence Restoration: Natashia's repaired spiritual foundation no longer required the foreign Soul fragments inside her to remain structurally stable.[54]
- Soul Modification: Victor can alter the structure and Records of a Soul as part of race transformation, Life creation and reconstruction.[15][55]
- Soul Sharing: Victor can separate portions of his own Soul and distribute them to individuals connected to him for protection or other purposes.[2]
- [[Soul Marriage]] / Soul Binding: Victor can use his supernatural authority to establish a direct Soul Marriage, binding his Soul to that of an accepted partner rather than relying exclusively upon an externally imposed contract. When Amaterasu formally entered his family, Victor's Divinity bound their Souls through a Soul Marriage, transforming the proposed political marriage into a permanent supernatural bond.[56]
- Reincarnation-System Exclusion: Victor can keep Souls that belong to his Reality out of the native [[Reincarnation System]]. They stay in the system governed through his own Reality instead of returning to the cosmic administrators.[31] The same act is not indexed again under Law Manipulation, Life and Death, or the domain.
- Akashic / Soul-Record Reconstruction: Victor can use preserved information from the Akashic Records together with Soul manipulation to reconstruct an existence whose original condition has already been lost.
- Informational Echo Reconstruction: He rebuilt an echo of [[Adonis Snow]] from preserved Soul information and the Akashic Records. The echo carried Adonis' memories and personality from the preserved period. It was a reconstruction of that record, not a reversal of the original death.[57]
- Identity Restoration: Victor later reconstructed [[Vanessa Alekerth]] using the surviving Records of her former existence together with the positive and negative components necessary to restore her Soul and identity.[58]
- Record-Based Resurrection: Victor can restore an individual after ordinary Soul information has been lost so long as usable Records still remain and the target has not been irreversibly processed beyond recovery by the Reincarnation system.[58]
- Existential Reconstruction / Ultimate Restoration: Victor's restoration abilities eventually developed beyond conventional resurrection. An existential Soul Contract tore apart both the body and the Soul of a captured Upper-Sector fragment. Victor forced that existence back together, more than once.[43]
- Soul Reconstruction: Victor gathered the shattered Soul and forcibly reconstructed it after its destruction.[43]
- Physical Reconstruction: The body was restored together with the Soul rather than requiring a separate reincarnation process.[43]
- Temporal Restoration: Victor incorporated Time into the reconstruction and reversed portions of the destruction toward an earlier viable state.[43]
- Existential Restoration: The complete technique combined Soul manipulation, Life, Beginning, Negativity, Time, Space, Draconic Reality manipulation, Runes, dimensional isolation and a limited Eldritch component to rebuild the target after an existential-level self-destruction mechanism activated.[43]
- Death Interception: Victor explicitly refused to allow the target to enter the Akashic Records before he obtained the information he wanted, reconstructing the Being before the death could become final.[43]
- Mental / Sanity Restoration: The prisoner's mind repeatedly collapsed during the process, yet Victor restored its mental state sufficiently for the interrogation to continue.[43]
- Extreme Iterative Restoration: Victor repeated this death-and-restoration cycle 623,596,777,174 times across years of subjective Time inside the isolated dimension.[43]
- Life Creation: Victor can generate genuine living Beings rather than merely constructing artificial bodies.
- Life Initiation: In the World of Water, Victor deliberately initiated new Life rather than altering an old sea. Creation was the material and Beginning was the extra boost. He spoke Leviathans into a dimension of water: from the water they were born, and with water they brought both life and destruction. The words were a birth, not a summoning of animals that already existed. The sub-concept tied to making monsters would not bind without the Concept of Creation. The resulting Leviathans were proud in the way Dragons are proud, carried the will of the Blood Dragon Progenitor, and were not given Souls that would enter the native reincarnation cycle.[59]
- Mortal Creation: Victor can take Souls from the sea inside his Soul, alter their Records and construct complete Mortal bodies around them. He demonstrated the process by creating new Humans and stated that it could be repeated on a massive scale.[55]
- Race Creation: Victor can create members of races derived from his existing biological and supernatural lineages without requiring the ordinary transfer of his blood, including multiple Vampire and Draconic species.[60]
- Chimera Creation: Victor can create new Beings combining useful properties originating from different species rather than reproducing one pre-existing race unchanged. This principle was incorporated into the creation of the Emperor's specialized soldiers and commanders.[61]
- Progenitor / Lineage Creation: Victor can reconstruct an existing supernatural Being into the founding Progenitor of an entirely new lineage. Using Chaos, Beginning, Negativity and his understanding of opposing Essences, Victor reconstructed War into a new Progenitor capable of containing Darkness together with Positive and Holy characteristics; the resulting existence became the origin of the Bearers of Damnation.[62]
- Synthetic Sentience / Independent Ego Creation: Victor can create a genuine independent consciousness for a purpose-built artificial or systemic existence rather than merely programming a sophisticated imitation of thought. He directly created [[Akasha Elderblood]] as a new daughter and independent ego connected to the Imperial System, granting her individuality, enormous inherited knowledge and authority over the infrastructure she was created to protect.[63][64]
- Purpose-Built Hybrid Servant Creation: Victor can deliberately create combat-oriented subordinate species and hybrid servants rather than relying entirely upon naturally born populations. When he needed more subordinates who could protect his wives in a coming war, he judged that beings like War are rare. He can make servants the way he made the Bloodhunters, but even as hybrids their power stays limited. He can make them stronger, and he can make Beings from his own Bloodline, but he will not use a design that buys power by taking the created Being's sanity, and he would use his own Bloodline only if it were absolutely necessary. He set himself as the starting point through the Soul Marriage and decided to create more Eldritch beings and Eldritch beasts, strong enough to defeat Leviathans, Dragons and the royal guard and able to destroy entire Solar Systems. Even that standard did not satisfy him.[65]
- Elemental Life Creation: Victor can create sentient Energy-based life without requiring the ordinary approval or registration processes associated with the native World Tree and Abyssal systems.[66]
- Imaginary-to-Real Life Creation: Victor's power contributed to Natasha, originally an imaginary personality existing only within Natashia, developing into an independent consciousness possessing her own body and complete Soul.[54]
- Monster Creation: During the reconstruction of Mars, Victor directly created various primeval and mutated species resembling supernatural Monsters as part of the new planetary ecosystem.[42]
- Life & Death Manipulation (Domain-Limited): Within Realities governed by his authority, Victor can regulate Life, Death, Soul retention and resurrection rather than allowing every death to automatically enter the external cosmological cycle.[67]
- Soul-Cycle Redirection: Indexed under Soul Manipulation. Same act.[31]
- Resurrection: Victor can restore deceased Beings using Soul and Akashic information when the necessary existential information remains recoverable.[58]
- Imperial Soul Covenant: Victor can establish large-scale spiritual covenants directly connecting other Souls to himself. During his Imperial declaration, those present—including Gods—felt a permanent connection form as Victor promised that their Souls would remain protected with him even if their bodies fell.[68]
- Soul Safeguarding: Souls bound through the covenant are protected from being casually seized, abused or claimed by external Beings after death.[68]
- Post-Mortem Connection: The bond persists beyond ordinary physical death rather than ending with destruction of the body.[68]
- Soul Ownership / Recall: Victor can structure created Imperial Beings so their Souls return directly to him upon death or self-destruction instead of falling into an enemy's possession or entering an unrelated external system.[69]
- Herald Recall: War is irrevocably bound to Victor as his herald. Victor did not send him into the Upper Sectors as a body he was willing to lose. If War died there, he would return to Victor and be revived.[39]
- Universal Energy Manipulation: Victor's understanding has advanced beyond simply controlling several unrelated Energy types. He treats Divine, Demonic, Spirit, Mana, Ki and the rest as the same Energy wearing different attributes, and he works the medium underneath those names.[70]
- Energy Attribute Conversion: Victor directly drew a thread of Attributeless Energy and shaped it into [[Divine Energy]], demonstrating that he can impose an attribute upon a more fundamental Energy source.[70]
- Multi-Energy Compatibility: Victor explains that Beings possessing sufficiently extreme control and understanding can bypass many of the normal distinctions between attributed Energy systems and manipulate them through their common foundation.[70]
- Energy Refinement: Victor's control spends Energy without wasting the bulk of it. After the long Imperial ritual his expenditure still outran that control: about 96 percent of what he had available was gone, and regeneration no longer covered the cost.[34]
- Energy Transfer: Victor can transfer Energy through the network connecting him to his wives and [[World Trees]] rather than requiring direct physical contact with every recipient.[71]
- Remote Combat Empowerment: The same transfer can be driven into wives who are already in a fight. When he gave the order to kill after Scathach's creation-attack, his voice reached them and his Energy ran through their bodies before they moved.[72]
- Mass Energy Restoration: After the confrontation with the Primordials, Victor drew upon the interconnected Energy reserves surrounding him and released a wave that completely restored Jeanne and the others who had exhausted themselves supporting him, returning what they had contributed.[71]
- Hostile Energy Seizure: Victor can take Energy another God has already fired and end it. The combat projection gathered beams strong enough to destroy solar systems into one sphere and crushed that sphere in a fist.[22]
- Attributeless / Origin Energy Manipulation: Victor can manipulate the undifferentiated Energy described as the blank foundation from which native attributed Energy systems are created.[73][70]
- Source-State Manipulation: Victor compares Attributeless Energy to the source code or blank canvas underlying Creation because attributes have not yet been imposed upon it.[70]
- Return-to-Origin Manipulation: Attributeless Energy can force phenomena toward a foundational state associated with the beginning of their existence.[73]
- Existential Record Alteration: Damage caused through this Energy can become registered as part of the target's current original state rather than as conventional damage waiting to heal. When Scathach's skin was burned through an Attributeless effect, ordinary restoration could not simply return it to its previous condition.[74]
- Existential Record Restoration: Victor later used Attributeless Energy to reconstruct the missing state of Scathach's skin, effectively "painting" the correct information back into existence when conventional restoration could not recover it.[74]
- Self-Taught Mastery: Positivity and Aurethys watched the merger and recognized attributeless Energy. Positivity holds the knowledge of their former self and taught that use to Aurethys. Negativity received the instincts, not the knowledge. Both concluded that Victor had learned the Energy alone. Positivity's position was that even Primordial Beings do not know how to use it correctly, and that it is not something one simply learns.[24]
- Universal Compatibility: Because this is the Energy with which everything in the Universe was created, it is compatible with everything. Under Victor that compatibility is what let one working envelop separate galaxies, drop the old meaning of the distances between them, and fuse those regions into the supergalaxy. The merger is that application. It is not a second power. Negativity, more conscious because the two Chosen Ones now stood near each other, judged the first pass short on precision and said later work could still tighten it.[9]
- [[Primordial Energy]] Manipulation: After acquiring sufficient reference points by studying Primordial-level Beings and his own family, Victor became capable of reproducing pure Primordial Energy rather than merely using ordinary Divine Energy.[74]
- Primal Release: The power he released against the Primordials was primal and formless, the Energy things are made from. It left him colorless and turned deep red when he put Negativity into it.[8]
- Concept-Energy Fusion: That same release is the demonstrated fusion. The Negativity is what turned the colorless primal Energy red. It is not an application of Attributeless Energy.[8][70]
- Near-Inexhaustible Energy Regeneration: Victor's own reserves, his [[Dragon Heart]], the worlds inside his Soul, and the World Tree network return spent Energy fast enough that ordinary cosmic work does not empty him. At this height of the cosmology, a source being called infinite, inexhaustible, or immeasurable is normal. It means the quantity cannot be measured and does not run dry in ordinary use. It does not mean unlimited release in one instance, an unlimited channel, or an output that stays ahead of Creation-scale work.[75][76][34]
- World Trees: A World Tree able to sustain a planet is an inexhaustible Energy battery. The quantity those Beings hold is immeasurable. What stays finite is how much of that Energy they can release at any one moment.[75]
- Dragon Heart: Victor took an artifact meant only as the prototype of a future infinite battery and, through the properties of [[Junketsu]], a fragment of his Soul, and a change imposed on Reality, made it the living infinite battery itself. Velnorah identified the result as his heart, built of Divine materials and Draconic Runes. Its production left the prototype's 100% and passed 10,000% while still rising, and the Energy it made carried no Negative, Positive, or Draconic attribute.[76] Natalia later treated that core as an Energy source of practically infinite capacity. It was still not built to release, in one expenditure, the Energy the galactic time-acceleration required. Using it as that generator would have meant a second Heart and a rebuilt Imperial system, so the two outputs would not clash.[77] Once the World Cores existed, the Heart did more than produce Energy on its own. It also channeled every World Tree bound to Victor. Those Trees feed their planets and the Heart, and the Heart feeds the planets back. [[Siren Elderblood]] called that exchange an infinite Energy loop. Akasha Elderblood's remaining problem was not the supply. The Empire already had plenty of Energy. The problem was transmitting that quantity.[78]
- Blessed Supply: Victor's Blessing brought Natalia's lineage talent into full bloom, and because he himself was the Energy supplying her, she practically had infinite Energy. The limit that remained was her body, not the source.[79]
- Storage Scaled to the Supply: The inventory Victor made from his Black Hole, his understanding of Space, and the Runes on [[Alexios Alioth]]'s dimensional bag has no fixed volume. Its capacity changes with the Energy supplied to it, and because he had so much Energy, that space was essentially infinite.[45]
- Yellow-Star Core: A yellow star used as a power core is already treated, in Imperial engineering, as an infinite Energy source. Velnorah built [[Shiro-Hime]] around a yellow-star core stabilized so its gravity would not interfere with the ship. Violet, presenting that vessel, stated that the core effectively granted it infinite Energy and left the ship self-sustaining, including a cannon able to reduce a planet to cosmic dust.[80]
- Multi-Galactic Energy Supply: Scathach judged him able to sustain work across multiple galaxies. One scale taken from his main Dragon body holds enough Energy to keep an ordinary Empire running for more than 100,000 years.[18]
- World Tree Substitution: Victor can himself occupy the Energy and Life-support place a World Tree normally holds for an inhabited world.[81][42]
- Creation-Scale Expenditure: None of those sources is infinite at the scale of Creation. Sustaining the Imperial ritual across galaxies for about 200,000 subjective years, moving those galaxies, and reshaping worlds spent faster than the return. During the rebuilding of Mars, more than 80% of what he had available was already committed. By the end of that strain the figure was 96%. His own planet was losing vitality. Roxanne, Amara, and the World Trees were still sending him Energy, and that aid was only a drop in the ocean. He was consuming more than he generated. The inexhaustible Trees, the living infinite Heart, the infinite loop, Natalia's blessed supply, and the yellow-star core remained what they were. What does not follow from any of them is an output that can pay for an entire Sector's worth of altered Time without falling behind.[42][34]
- Cosmic Awareness: Victor can extend his perception and consciousness across astronomical regions far beyond ordinary sensory range.
- Sector-Wide Consciousness: Victor can extend his consciousness throughout his own Sector until reaching its cosmological boundary.[81]
- Cosmic Vision: Victor's enhanced senses can perceive vast astronomical structures throughout the surrounding Cosmos rather than functioning only at planetary distances.[82]
