- Spatial-Anomaly Detection: Victor can detect dimensional breaches and abnormalities in Space.[83][84]
- Remote Surveillance: Victor can maintain awareness over enormous portions of Imperial territory without consciously staring at every location. Vlad describes the Emperor's gaze as effectively ever-present within his territories, while later Imperial dissidents operate under continuous observation.[85][86]
- Transdimensional Vision: Victor can see through separated Realities and dimensional defenses rather than being stopped by conventional spatial barriers. He used this perception to locate Kali and Ariel despite their Pantheons occupying protected dimensional regions.[86]
- Fundamental Reality Perception / Source-Code Vision: Victor can perceive the underlying organization of dimensional Reality. While teaching Norabell, this class of perception is described as seeing the "source code of Reality".[6]
- Dimensional-Layer Perception: Victor can identify the layer of Reality in which another Being or dimensional structure is hiding, reducing the effectiveness of concealment dependent upon moving between dimensional layers.[6]
- Conceptual Structure Perception: Victor can perceive differences between structures based upon the Concepts and levels of existence supporting them.[6]
- Cosmic Life-Force Perception: During the Sector merger, Victor could perceive the "life" of astronomical structures ranging from small matter to stars and developing galaxies rather than limiting Life perception to conventional organisms.[49]
- Cosmic Age Perception: Through his understanding of Time, Victor could perceive the true age of the younger Galactic structures entering his Sector.[49]
- System Observation Detection: Victor can detect attempts by the System to secretly observe his family. After Moira's birth, he noticed its concealed attention and directly forced it to reveal itself.[28]
- Lie / Deception Detection: During his confrontation with the System, Victor immediately recognized its deliberate manipulation of language; lies cannot remain hidden from the Eyes of the Blood Dragon Progenitor.[28]
- Campaign-Scale Perception: In the Upper Sectors his senses take in the whole war in real time, and he treats that sense as better than the data his commanders can bring him. He followed the state of conquered planets without reading Akasha's report. He separates that firsthand knowledge from secondhand information. The early losses outside his galaxy were left open on purpose, so he would learn how the Upper Sectors actually move instead of reading reports about them.[24][25]
- Split Presence: He can stand physically in his office at home while his presence still extends through the Upper Sectors, kept there so that anyone entering his territory has to face him.[24]
- Clairvoyance / Precognition: Victor can observe possible future events rather than being limited to the Present.
- Short-Term Combat Precognition: Victor uses extremely short future intervals during combat to anticipate an opponent's next actions, preferring this method because short projections are more reliable than distant futures.[87][86]
- Long-Range Future Sight: Victor has perceived possible events hundreds of years into the future, including future developments involving his daughters.[88]
- Retrocognition / Temporal-Existential Perception: Victor can inspect historical information rather than relying exclusively upon memories supplied by witnesses.
- Akashic Retrocognition: Victor can use his Eyes and connection to the Akashic Records to observe events that previously occurred in a location.[89]
- Chrono Vision: Victor can focus upon an individual and inspect the target's Past, Present and possible Future as existential information.[90]
- Ancestral History Tracing: He used this perception to trace events backward through another person's lineage and reconstruct the life, migration and death of an ancestor centuries earlier.[90]
- Memory Manipulation: Victor can directly alter the memories of other Beings. Even as a Vampire, he consciously used his increasingly developed Charm to manipulate the memories of ordinary Humans who had been exposed to supernatural events that needed to remain hidden.[91]
- Memory Erasure: Victor's later Contracts can remove protected memories when their conditions are violated, including information the target attempted to preserve through other methods.[92]
- Blood Memory Reading / Extraction: Victor can use Blood as a medium for accessing memories belonging to another Being. During his experiments on Carlos, Victor manipulated the altered supernatural material within his Blood and searched through the man's memories, obtaining information concerning General James.[93] Victor later explained that this ability to read memories through Blood had developed during the eighteen months he spent with Ruby outside Nightingale; at that stage his control was still imperfect enough that he could not always determine which memories would be received.[94]
- Memory Projection / Sharing: Victor can transmit his own memories directly to other people. After the Upper-Sector interrogation, he shared the relevant experience with his wives from a third-person perspective.[69]
- Stored Memory / Knowledge Bestowal: Victor can transmit useful knowledge and techniques preserved within the memories he has accumulated from other Beings rather than limiting memory sharing to experiences originally belonging to himself. He passed accumulated combat knowledge to members of his family and allowed Natashia to access exceptionally refined Lightning knowledge obtained from [[Zeus]], while Victor himself continued adapting the techniques contained within those memories.[95]
- Information Filtering: Victor can remove or suppress dangerous portions of a memory before transmitting it, preventing recipients from being exposed to information their minds cannot safely process.[69]
- Mind Manipulation: Victor can directly influence the thoughts, subconscious processes and mental state of other Beings.
- Mind Control: Victor has directly dominated weaker targets to extract or control information, including during his interrogation of Fenir concerning [[New Dawn]].[96]
- Subconscious Manipulation: Victor possesses control over subconscious memories, desires, emotions, traumas and hidden information, allowing him to organize and deliberately access otherwise buried mental material.[97]
- Parallel Processing: Victor operates multiple independent internal thought processes simultaneously and can create far more when greater processing capacity is necessary.[97]
- Divided Consciousness: Separate portions of Victor's consciousness can independently process different tasks while remaining parts of the same Victor.[98]
- Mental Library: Victor maintains an internal archive containing immense quantities of information and memories collected from Beings he has consumed, including memories originating from entities thousands of years old.[99][97]
- Telepathy: Victor can communicate directly with another person's mind across distance, including while his primary body remains elsewhere.[100]
- Dream Manipulation: Victor can enter, construct and regulate supernatural Dream environments.
- Dream Walking: Victor can enter another Being's Dream rather than merely projecting an illusion into the waking world.[101]
- Dream-Reality Creation: Victor can create complete false Realities containing coherent environments, histories and altered identities, including the world used during [[Nero]] and Ophis' development.[102]
- Dream-World Time Dilation: Dream Realities can possess their own accelerated temporal flow, allowing years to pass internally while only minutes pass outside.[101][103]
- Dream-Based Transformation / Power Modification: Within a Dream Reality Victor can change the apparent race of participants, seal existing abilities and assign new powers suitable for the constructed scenario.[104]
- Damage Negation: Victor can use Dream-related authority to treat sustained damage as though it were merely a Dream, negating the injury instead of accepting it as an ordinary persistent condition.[105]
- Rune Manipulation: Victor can use supernatural languages of power to issue instructions to Reality. Early Runic instruction defines Runes as the combination of language, Energy and intention used to make Reality execute a desired command, while Victor identifies the principle as a method of accessing information stored within the Akashic structure and bringing the corresponding effect into Reality.[106][107][70]
- Reality Command: Victor can formulate Runic instructions that cause Reality to reproduce a desired supernatural effect rather than manipulating the physical phenomenon manually.[106][70]
- Akashic Effect Invocation: Victor explains that using a Rune such as a Fire Rune effectively accesses a tiny portion of the Akashic Records where the corresponding information exists and manifests that stored effect into Reality.[70]
- Runic Property Imposition: Runes can impose specific properties, commands and restrictions upon objects, locations or supernatural structures.[106][70]
- Silence Manipulation: Victor can impose supernatural Silence through Draconic Runes.[108]
- Power Sealing: Victor can construct Runes that seal or restrict another Being's supernatural powers.[109]
- Dimensional Sealing: Victor can combine Runes with dimensional isolation to prevent a target from escaping, communicating with an outside source or bypassing the prepared Reality.[43]
- Barrier Generation: Victor can simultaneously maintain thousands of specialized defensive effects rather than relying upon one generic shield. One preparation involved more than 6,666 layered protections around a sensitive operation.[110]
- Anti-Corruption Barrier: Victor can construct protection intended to stop supernatural corruption from reaching the protected area while the attacking influence remains within the defensive system's effective range.[110]
- Anti-Manipulation Barrier: His barriers can defend against mental domination, supernatural Charm and similar control effects.[110]
- Anti-Invasion Barrier: Victor can seal spatial openings and prevent unwanted passage into a protected area.[110]
- Anti-Observation Barrier: He can block external observation of protected locations and information.[110]
- Reality-Authority Barrier: Victor can establish local authority over a protected space so an outside entity cannot freely manipulate the Reality inside it.[110]
- Soul Barrier: Dedicated layers can protect the Souls of individuals inside the defensive structure.[110]
- Contract Manipulation: Victor is highly proficient with supernatural Contracts capable of imposing effects directly upon another Being's deeper spiritual existence.
- Absolute Contract Enforcement: Victor's Contracts can remain effective upon Gods and other powerful supernatural Beings rather than functioning only against Mortals.[92]
- Memory-Erasure Clause: A Contract can automatically erase protected information if its conditions are violated.[92]
- Persistent Soul Binding: Victor's Contractual influence can become attached deeply enough to a Being's spiritual existence that interference involving End Energy did not simply remove the connection.[111]
- Contract-Based Empowerment: Victor's contract with [[Valeria Alekerth]] restored her youth, increased her capacity for future growth and established a direct connection through which she could use power derived from Victor.[112]
- Age Restoration: The same contract returned Valeria's body to a younger condition rather than merely disguising her age.[112]
- Mental / Perceptual Enhancement: Valeria's contract strengthened her mind and perception enough for her to absorb Victor's teachings at an accelerated rate.[112]
- Information Restriction: Victor can use Contracts to prevent protected information from being freely processed or disclosed.[113]
- Cognitohazardous Security: Attempting to inspect the protected section of Tyche's secrecy agreement caused severe mental pain until she stopped trying to read it.[113]
- Name / Identity Authority: Victor established a metaphysical order upon the Elderblood name so that merely claiming the surname does not grant its genuine dynastic recognition. The status applies only to individuals Victor himself recognizes as Elderbloods.[113]
- Command / Compulsion: Victor can impose his [[Will Solace|Will]] directly upon sufficiently inferior Beings through supernatural commands rather than relying only upon persuasion.[114]
- Cross-Species Compulsion: Victor's command authority is not limited exclusively to ordinary Vampire targets and can affect Beings outside the basic Vampiric hierarchy when the difference in power is sufficient.[114]
- Deepest-Desire Compulsion: Victor can force a spoken answer to a question of desire even when the target does not want to give it. He asked Ryujin Ikaros what he wished for. Ryujin did not want to speak. His body answered that he wanted to become stronger. Ryujin himself had expected the answer to be women. Victor accepted the spoken desire, said he would pave the way, and left whether Ryujin actually became strong up to Ryujin.[16]
- Reality-Reinforced Command: His command suppressed a prisoner's attempted escape strongly enough that the isolated dimension itself reacted to the force of his Will.[43]
- Telekinesis: Victor can move, levitate and restrain targets directly without physical contact. He caused Nikolai's body to float and positioned him upon the prepared stone structure through direct supernatural control.[43]
- Shapeshifting / Physiological Manipulation: Victor can radically alter his body and reproduce compatible physiological characteristics belonging to other species.
- Selective Transformation: Victor can transform only specific portions of his body rather than assuming a complete alternate form. He turned only his arms into their Draconic form so [[Stheno]] and [[Euryale]] could take scales from them. The two are his daughters, named for [[Medusa]]'s deceased sisters.[18]
- Physiological Mimicry: Through Shapeshifting and abilities assimilated from other Beings, Victor can reproduce useful physiological characteristics belonging to entities such as [[Diablo]], [[Gabriel]], Michael, [[Erebus]] and [[Nocturnus]] while maintaining his core identity.[115]
- Hybrid Physiology: Victor can combine advantageous characteristics originating from multiple species instead of becoming a simple copy of one source organism.[115]
- Slime Mimicry: Victor can transform his physiology into a Slime-like state when he wishes to relax his body.[109]
- Black Hole Mimicry: Victor can transform parts of his body into structures displaying the properties and density associated with a Black Hole.[116]
- Star Mimicry: Victor can transform into a stellar state whose surface reaches star-like temperatures and whose emitted power can burn supernatural Energy.[117]
- Size Manipulation: Victor can compress a main Dragon body larger than entire galaxies into a comparatively small humanoid form and selectively alter the scale of his manifestation without changing his fundamental identity.[118][18][28]
- Adaptation: Victor possesses extremely advanced adaptive properties allowing his existence to develop resistance and countermeasures toward phenomena that successfully affect him.
- Reactive Adaptation: Damage and harmful supernatural phenomena can trigger increasing resistance rather than remaining equally effective through repeated exposure.[119][120]
- Conceptual Adaptation: By the Imperial era Victor's adaptation is explicitly treated as deeper than purely physical adaptation; Liriel's rapid biological evolution is directly compared with and described as inferior to Victor's more advanced Conceptual adaptation.[68]
- Post-Restoration Adaptation: A method that successfully kills or catastrophically injures Victor can become less effective after his restoration as his adaptive mechanisms respond to the previous cause of damage.[119][120]
- Regeneration & [[Immortality]]: Victor possesses extreme regenerative ability, spiritual resilience and multiple survival mechanisms that make conventional physical death insufficient to permanently eliminate him.[119][120][8]
- Extreme Regeneration: Victor can recover from catastrophic physical injuries that would permanently kill ordinary supernatural Beings.[119][120]
- Spiritual Survival: Destruction of Victor's physical body does not automatically constitute permanent death while the deeper structures of his Soul and existence remain functional.
- Composite Survival: Victor's continued existence is supported by multiple systems—including regeneration, Soul resilience, adaptation and his inner existence—rather than one biological healing mechanism alone.[121][8]
- Mass / Weight Manipulation: Victor can directly alter effective weight and mass.
- Extreme Mass Compression: Victor has manipulated cosmic-scale mass into much smaller forms that can be physically handled.[122]
- Object Weight Reduction: Two scales removed from Victor's true body were initially so heavy that Stheno and Euryale struggled to lift them; Victor passed Energy through the scales and reduced their effective weight until they could be carried normally.[18]
- Gravity Manipulation: Victor can regulate gravitational effects rather than merely endure them.
- Self-Gravity Suppression: The natural gravity generated by Victor's fully developed Dragon body is strong enough to destabilize neighboring galaxies, yet Victor consciously suppresses the field so surrounding Galactic structures remain intact.[28]
- Extreme Physical Strength: Victor possessed extraordinary lifting strength even without relying upon his complete Dragon Form or broad Reality manipulation, casually supporting approximately 9.69 × 10²³ tons before additional Positive and Negative Energy made that weight comparatively insignificant.[122]
- Extreme Durability: Victor's developed body can withstand astronomical environments that would destroy conventional supernatural organisms. He has come out of a Black Hole unharmed.[123]
- Cosmic-Body Integrity: Victor can maintain a coherent physical body at sizes surpassing galaxies while simultaneously regulating its Energy and gravitational consequences.[28]
- Aura / Presence Manipulation: Victor can consciously release or restrain supernatural pressure produced by his existence.
- Murderous Intent: Victor's killing intent can force powerful Gods to experience repeated visions of their own deaths, while sufficiently weaker observers risk being incapacitated by the shock alone.[99]
- Conceptual Aura Manifestation: When Victor increased his power against the System, enormous clouds composed of Divine Concepts formed around him rather than his aura manifesting only as ordinary Energy pressure.[28]
- Environmental Presence Suppression: Victor normally regulates the amount of power, gravity and Reality distortion produced by his body so merely existing does not devastate the environment around him.[28]
- Ability-Control Suppression: The pressure of the combat projection's aura took the Gods' control of their own powers away. He did not chase them.[22]
- Cross-Species Instinctive Dominance: Victor's existence can provoke instinctive submission, fear or recognition from supernatural species whose biological hierarchies should be unrelated to one another. The phenomenon was explicitly noted to exceed the normal limits of a Vampire Progenitor affecting Vampires or an Alpha affecting Wolves, with several unrelated species reacting to Victor as though recognizing a common superior existence.[124][125] This passive response is distinct from Victor's active Command / Compulsion ability.
- Clone Creation: Victor can divide portions of his enormous Soul and power into additional bodies possessing access to most of his abilities. He normally operates a comparatively small number of such clones because controlling increasing numbers simultaneously becomes unnecessarily demanding.[126]
- Simultaneous Multi-Body Control: Victor can consciously operate a clone and his primary body at the same time without abandoning either perspective.[46]
- [[Victor Walker (Clone)|Independent Clone]] Operation: Victor's clones can perform complex tasks away from his original body rather than functioning as mindless projections.[126][127]
- Energy Clone Creation: For exploration beyond his known territories, Victor created an independent clone formed from Energy rather than sending his genuine body.[127]
- Metaphysical Link Severance: Victor deliberately severed the scouting clone from the dangerous connections leading back to his family, World Trees and deeper structures of his true existence, preventing an enemy capable of tracing spiritual or metaphysical links from simply following the clone back to the original.[127]
- Selective Memory Restriction: The scouting clone lacked Victor's intimate emotional memories and sensitive personal connections while retaining modern combat knowledge and Grandmaster-level experience.[127]
- Disposable Strategic Decoy: The clone could explore hostile foreign territory, fight, collect intelligence and ultimately be destroyed without exposing the original Victor's deeper metaphysical network.[127][128]
- Remote Information Transmission: Before its destruction, the foreign-territory clone transmitted captured information from the Empire of Light back to the original Victor and his Empire.[128]
- Astral Projection / Soul-Form Manifestation: Victor can operate independently of his resting physical body through a manifested spiritual form.
- Soul-Form Activity: He has left his body asleep to cut Energy use and kept working in Soul Form.[33]
- Consciousness Independence: His consciousness remains active while his physical body sleeps rather than entering ordinary unconsciousness.[34][33]
- Energy-Saving State: Victor can place his physical body into a low-consumption sleeping state while continuing intellectual and social activity through his Soul, reducing the Energy demanded by his physical manifestation.[34][33]
- Avatar / Remote Projection: Victor can manifest representations of himself at locations distant from his primary body.
- Avatar Manifestation: An avatar of Victor appeared publicly during the Imperial Year 100,000 celebrations while his true body remained occupied with greater operations.[85]
- Remote Image Projection: Victor can create a visible manifestation of his humanoid image at another location while observing and communicating from elsewhere.[100]
- Telepresence: Remote perception, projection and telepathy can be combined so Victor can effectively participate in a distant interaction without physically relocating his primary body.[100]
- Independent Combat Projection: Distinct from the Soul-divided clones, the sleeping Soul-form, and a speaking image. Victor can leave his true body in place and fight through a projection that carries his combat power. In the Upper Sectors the true body was the dragon holding the galaxy, and it hardly moved. The projection took the attack of Vaelthar and the Gods with him.[22]
- Retreat Interdiction: A dragon's eye opened above Aetherys and Oryndal when a stored return of Time put them back at the start of their fight and they tried to leave. The projection stopped the escape. Eleanor, Rose, Kaguya and Nyx came out of four spatial distortions, took the two Thrones, and brought them into Victor's galaxy with Kali and Haruna.[10]
- Peer-Scale Manifestation: Vharzath answered in a body of pure Darkness, larger than a galaxy, with hundreds of arms, and demanded his subordinates. Aetheryon came with him as golden energy of the same scale. Victor grew to that size in the colossal Dragon form. Pure Negativity poured off the body. Hundreds of thousands of eyes opened across it, and both leaders smelled death. He offered to end the war then. They did not take the offer. He shrank and returned to his galaxy.[10]
- Absorption Ambush (Prepared): The appearance was bait. If either leader attacked him, he meant to absorb that Being and throw him into the place where he had once fought, and taken in, the Eldest God of Nightingale. He knows that place because that God is inside him. If the absorption failed, the other contingency was the Realm of Death. Neither throw was performed.[10]
- Invisibility / Presence Concealment: Victor can remove himself from ordinary perception through multiple methods. By combining powers associated with Darkness, Void, Dreams and Reality manipulation, his presence can become more comparable to a dream or mirage than an ordinarily detectable physical Being.[129]
- Reality-Based Concealment: Victor can make Reality itself fail to distinguish his presence in the ordinary manner rather than depending entirely upon optical invisibility.[129]
- Domain-Limited Practical Omnipotence: Within a Reality that completely belongs to Victor, his authority becomes sufficiently comprehensive that he is practically omnipotent. This does not grant unrestricted omnipotence outside his own sovereign domain.[30]
- Absolute Local Mobility: Distance within Victor's own worlds can cease to be a meaningful restriction; even during the earlier development of [[Etherea]], Victor could appear elsewhere on the planet simply by willing himself there.[130]
- Local Time Authority: Victor can freely alter temporal flow throughout a Reality under his control rather than being restricted to small Time spells.[30]
- Local Reality Control: Matter, environmental conditions, supernatural powers and other aspects of the domain can be manipulated through Victor's sovereign authority rather than requiring separate specialized abilities for every result.[30][29]
- Soul-System Sovereignty: Indexed under Soul Manipulation. Same act, limited here to a Reality he governs.[31]
- Domain-Limited Omniscience / Information Awareness: Victor is described as Omniscient or practically Omniscient inside dimensions and territories that form part of his own enormous internal existence.[131][123]
- Territorial Information Awareness: Because major Imperial territories, Souls and administrative structures exist within or are directly connected to Victor's Soul, events occurring throughout those systems can fall within his awareness.[123]
- Remote Imperial Awareness: Victor can maintain awareness across distant Imperial locations without devoting his primary attention to each location continuously.[85][86]
- Soul-[[Rex Invictus|Home]] Death Zone: The planet his family lives on lies inside his Soul. Scathach treats an invasion of that place as an invasion of their home. The intruder finds only death.[23]
- Eldritch Territorial Defense (Held in Reserve): He has stationed subordinates through the galaxy as an Eldritch defense. He left it off during the opening of the Upper-Sector war because he wanted to see how the Empire answered without it. Violet's judgment, which is the source of the claim, is that no one would get through if he turned it on.[23]
- World Tree Network Integration: Victor is connected to a vast network of World Trees spread throughout Imperial territory.
- Universe-Wide Communication Network: After the Mars project, the connected World Trees allowed transport and communication across the Empire to occur virtually instantaneously despite Galactic distances.[42]
- Planetary Connection Awareness: Victor closed his eyes after establishing the network and perceived his connection to planets distributed throughout countless galaxies.[42]
- Protected Network Core: The true World Trees reside inside Victor's Soul, while external planets function through their connections to those protected Trees.[42]
- Distributed Planetary Restoration: Because the Tree remains protected even if its external world is destroyed, the connected planetary system can theoretically be rebuilt from its surviving World Tree foundation.[42]
- Confiscated World Tree Intake: After Aetheryon spent hundreds of World Trees to pull three elites out of Scathach's Heptagrammakos, the Universal Tree cut that faction off from the Trees and sent Victor the ones that leader tried to reach. Victor accepted them. They merged into his body. Each added Tree keeps increasing his Energy. He houses them in the inner realm, crowded enough that Roxanne protested. The intake is not every World Tree. The Universal Tree's own limit, said to the other Primordials, is the Trees Aetheryon comes into contact with.[72][132]
- Self-Sustenance / Sleeplessness: Victor no longer requires ordinary sleep to remain functional and can remain continuously active for extreme periods.[100]
- Energy-Conservation Sleep: When his expenditure finally exceeded even his extraordinary regeneration during the 200,000-year ritual, Victor used sleep as an Energy-saving measure rather than because his consciousness required rest.[34]
- Active Consciousness During Sleep: Victor remained fully conscious while his body slept and immediately continued working through his Soul Form.[34][33]
- Power Bestowal: Victor can grant or enable powers through several independent methods, including conceptual bestowal, Contracts, racial transformation, Soul modification and Reality-based systems.[112][2][55]
- Contract-Based Power Sharing: Individuals directly connected to Victor through sufficiently advanced Contracts can draw powers derived from him.[112]
- Conceptual Power Bestowal: Compatible abstract Concepts can be copied or distributed to suitable recipients.[2][5]
- Racial Ability Bestowal: Transforming a target into another race can grant the physiological and supernatural characteristics belonging to the new existence.[14]
- Dream-Based Temporary Power Assignment: Victor can assign different powers and racial abilities to participants inside controlled Dream Realities.[104]
- Faith / Pantheon Power Channeling: Victor can function as a Divine source through the religious and Pantheon systems connected to him, allowing compatible followers to draw supernatural power through Faith. [[Andrew Walter]]'s Imperial Inquisition techniques draw directly upon Victor and the Gods formally belonging to the [[Dragons Nest Pantheon]]. On an alien world he renounced his mortal body as the God Emperor's instrument. His body shone gold, a golden bolt that crossed space and time fell into his hand, and in that Vampiric state he fought as a lesser image of Victor, erasing enemies with two plasma swords. The technique can call on Victor, Violet, and Dragon Gods under Victor's direct command, including Amaterasu and Kali. It does not treat subordinate pantheons as his own: Susanoo and [[Shiva]] remained foreign to it. At full release, Andrew and Frederick were rated V-05, a threat that can obliterate a Solar System. Their ordinary demonstrated level at that time was planetary.[133]
- Biological / Genetic Manipulation: Victor possesses extensive control over his own biology and can influence heredity, reproduction and the racial foundations of his descendants.
- Complete Fertility Control: Victor can consciously determine whether conception occurs; He stopped further pregnancies for a long stretch because he did not want more children then.[51]
- Genetic Dominance: Victor's True Dragon genes are described as exceptionally dominant, preventing his direct offspring from simply losing the Draconic foundation when combined with another race.[7]
- Hereditary Trait Assimilation: Compatible characteristics from another parent can be integrated around the dominant Draconic foundation instead of being rejected or producing the instability commonly associated with hybrids.[7]
- Power Heredity: Victor's descendants repeatedly inherit specialized manifestations of his Eyes, conceptual affinities, creation-related powers and other supernatural characteristics.[134][135][118][6]
- Hereditary Knowledge Transmission: Victor's daughters are born with basic inherited knowledge and dormant techniques derived from their ancient True Dragon lineage, which become usable as they learn to access them.[32]
