02 · ELDRITCH NATURE

#### Outer God / Eldritch Abilities
Outer God, [[Chaos]] and Eldritch-derived powers.
Victor possesses an additional existential nature fundamentally different from his Blood Dragon, God and native cosmological characteristics. Although its earliest visible manifestations appeared as the grotesque Nightmare Form, Victor eventually recognized the incomprehensible cosmic horror within himself as another expression of his own existence—his True Self.[79] [[Azathoth Elderblood]] later identifies Victor more precisely as an Eldritch Chaos, an Outer God and simultaneously a High-Level God belonging to the current Creation. She states that Victor possesses the same fundamental nature and underlying powers as herself, although his Eldritch development was still immature when this was first explained.[136]
Victor's Outer God nature manifests most completely through his Nightmare Form, also referred to as his Eldritch Form. This is not simply another physical transformation layered over his Blood Dragon body. It represents the deepest Eldritch aspect of Victor's Soul and is fundamentally formless rather than restricted to one permanent anatomy.[137] Deeper than the ordinary Core of his Soul sits an Eldritch region where his [[Heralds of Chaos]] and the other Eldritch existences tied to him reside.[123] That Soul belongs to a cosmic horror of the highest order, and he is an Eldritch God of the highest rank.[28][8]
The abilities below specifically concern powers demonstrated or directly attributed to Victor's Outer God/Eldritch existence. Powers originating primarily from his Blood Dragon race, conventional Divinities, Predation, martial arts, absorbed abilities or other independent systems remain separate even when Victor can combine them with Eldritch Essence.
- Eldritch Chaos Physiology: Victor is an Eldritch Chaos, placing him at the foundational level of an [[Eldritch Pantheon]] rather than merely making him a conventional native God using foreign Energy. Azathoth explicitly identifies Victor as the same fundamental kind of existence as herself and states that he possesses the same underlying powers, although his Eldritch development was considerably less mature at the time.[136]
- Outer God Physiology: Victor's Eldritch existence is not constructed solely through the Divine framework of his native Creation. His Essence consequently interacts with Reality, Concepts, Laws and cosmological Rules differently from native Gods.[136][138]
- Chaos Incarnation: Victor does not simply manipulate an Energy called Chaos. His Outer God existence is itself an expression of Eldritch Chaos, placing him among the foundational Chaos existences from which lesser Eldritch Gods and related powers can emerge.[136][137]
- Dual Existential Nature: Victor is abnormal even among [[Outer Gods]] because he was actually born within the current Creation. He is simultaneously an Eldritch Chaos whose deeper nature can operate beyond portions of the local cosmological framework and a Being legitimately recognized as native to that same Creation.[138]
- Hybrid Cosmological Nature: He stands on two foundations. If the native tie through Negativity were destroyed, he would not end. He would sit more completely on Azathoth's side and function as a pure Eldritch God.[8]
- Highest-Rank Eldritch Existence: His Eldritch side is past its earlier immature state. His Soul is that of a cosmic horror of the highest order, and he is an Eldritch God of the highest rank.[28][8]
- Native-Eldritch Exception: Because Victor is an Eldritch Chaos that originated inside the native Cosmos, he possesses compatibility unavailable to ordinary foreign Chaos. Azathoth specifically treats this as the reason Victor may be capable of interacting with or eventually occupying positions in the native cosmological hierarchy that an external Chaos could not simply claim.[138]
- Existence Concealment / Rule-Based Concealment: Victor's abnormal nature was partially hidden by the very Rules of the Creation in which he was born. Azathoth notes that Creation itself had concealed important aspects of Victor's existence rather than identifying him in the same manner as an ordinary foreign Outer God.[136]
- Cosmological Independence: Victor's Eldritch side does not depend completely upon the native Divine framework for continued existence. Even catastrophic damage to one of his native cosmological components would not automatically erase the foreign Chaos forming his deeper existence.[136][8]
- Contradictory Nature: Eldritch existence can support properties that would ordinarily be incompatible within the native conceptual system. This is repeatedly demonstrated through Victor's Eldritch creations and descendants, whose powers can embody contradictory states without simply annihilating one another.[137][64]
- Corruptive Nature: Eldritch Chaos possesses an inherently distortive Essence. Victor later explains that [[Eldritch Energy]] originates outside the Universe and, because its underlying logic belongs to another Reality, its presence corrupts local structures according to foreign Rules.[138][70]
- Chaos [[Immortality]] / Nonstandard Death: Chaos is not treated as something that can simply be killed through conventional destruction. Azathoth explains that the native Primordials were incapable of permanently eliminating her fundamental Chaos and that another Chaos would instead have to consume or assimilate it.[136] Because Victor is explicitly the same fundamental kind of existence, the Chaos layer of his existence possesses the same abnormal relationship with death.
- Extreme Existential Recovery: Destroying the Negativity-based portion of him would blow apart an enormous part of his Soul. The deeper Eldritch existence would still recover, because the Soul is immense and the cosmic-horror foundation remains.[8]
- Chaos Assimilation: Eldritch Chaos can consume another Chaos rather than destroying it conventionally, assimilating the defeated existence into the dominant one.[136] Victor has not yet personally demonstrated complete assimilation of another fully developed Chaos on-screen, so this remains a racial property rather than a repeatedly demonstrated combat technique.
- True Soul Form / Nightmare Form: The Nightmare Form represents Victor's genuine Eldritch Soul Form rather than merely an external transformation layered over his normal body.[137]
- True Self: After becoming the Dragon God of Chaos, Victor encountered the incomprehensible cosmic entity hidden within himself and instinctively recognized it not as another personality or parasite but as his own True Self.[79]
- Formlessness: Victor's Eldritch Soul has no fundamentally fixed anatomy and is described as a formless something capable of assuming whatever configuration his existence requires.[137]
- Shapeshifting / Biomorphing: Victor can alter the form assumed by his Eldritch existence rather than remaining restricted to humanoid or conventional Draconic anatomy.[137]
- Variable Anatomy: The Nightmare Form can manifest enormous quantities of eyes, mouths, tendrils and other structures without being restricted by Victor's normal biology.[79][137]
- Dragon–Nightmare Hybridization: Victor can impose a familiar Draconic structure upon his formless Nightmare Form, combining properties of his True Dragon body with his deeper Eldritch existence.[137]
- Size Manipulation / Cosmic Size: Victor's formless Soul can manifest at astronomical scales. One manifestation of that Soul can swallow Solar Systems. The deeper Eldritch body consumes galaxies.[137][139]
- Controlled Manifestation: Victor normally restrains his complete existence so that ordinary beings can interact with him safely rather than being exposed to his unrestricted Soul.[113]
- Eldritch Form Suppression: Victor can actively suppress the deeper cosmic horror from erupting completely. During his confrontation with the native Primordials, his body began failing while he held the cosmic horror within himself back because releasing it completely would cross a threshold he did not yet intend to cross.[8]
- Cosmic Horror Manifestation: Victor's complete Eldritch Form is an incomprehensible cosmic existence whose appearance, information and presence are fundamentally dangerous to lesser observers.[140]
- Incomprehensible Appearance: Even extraordinarily brief exposure to Victor's complete Eldritch Form can overwhelm the perception of Beings incapable of properly processing his existence.[140]
- Observer-Dependent Perception: The amount of Victor's true existence another Being can safely perceive depends upon the observer's nature, power and compatibility with Eldritch phenomena.[140][113]
- Existential Exposure: Looking at Victor's unrestricted form exposes the observer not merely to a frightening body but to supernatural information and cosmological principles embedded within his existence.[140][139]
- Extreme Exposure Compression: Victor exposed his complete Eldritch Form for approximately 0.2 nanoseconds. The lesser Eldritch creatures observing him experienced the moment as though it lasted for an immensely extended period and were permanently changed by the encounter.[140]
- Presence Suppression / Perception Regulation: Victor can consciously regulate how much of his existence others are allowed to perceive. He keeps most of what he is out of other people's sight, because unrestricted perception of him can kill an ordinary mortal through information overload.[113]
- Higher-Dimensional Manifestation Analogy: The difference between unrestricted Victor and ordinary mortals is explicitly compared to a higher-dimensional Being attempting to manifest before a lower-dimensional existence incapable of understanding what it is seeing.[113]
- Enhanced Eldritch Manifestation: Victor notes that the danger becomes significantly worse if he manifests his actual Eldritch nature rather than simply allowing another Being to perceive his normal controlled existence.[113]
- Existential Information Pressure: Victor's existence contains an enormous quantity of supernatural information. Lesser observers attempting to comprehend him without sufficient protection can suffer catastrophic mental, spiritual or physical consequences.[139][113]
- Passive Knowledge Transmission: Albedo began understanding information concerning Victor's existence and wider Reality simply by observing his deeper Soul Form.[139]
- Forbidden Knowledge Bestowal: Information embedded within Victor's Eldritch existence can simultaneously function as enlightenment and as a lethal cognitohazard because an observer may receive knowledge their mind and Soul cannot withstand.[139]
- Extra-Cosmological Knowledge: Victor's deeper Soul contains information connected to principles beyond the ordinary native Universe and its conventional supernatural systems.[139]
- Mental Overload: Attempting to process too much of the information contained in Victor's Eldritch Form can cause cognitive collapse, insanity and physical breakdown.[139]
- Soul Overload: Victor was forced to remove Albedo from the deepest region of his Soul before her attempt to fully process what she was perceiving could destroy both her mind and her Soul.[139]
- Madness Inducement: Victor's genuine Nightmare Form possesses a passive cognitohazard capable of destroying the sanity of observers through exposure alone.[141][140]
- Visual Madness Inducement: Directly seeing Victor's grotesque Eldritch manifestation can overwhelm a Being whose mind is incapable of processing his existence.[141]
- Passive Insanity Inducement: The effect does not require Victor to deliberately perform a mental attack; continued exposure to his Eldritch existence can destabilize another Being automatically.[140]
- Complete-Form Madness: [[Hela Elderblood]] would have been driven completely insane by Victor's approximately 0.2-nanosecond complete manifestation if War had not protected her from the exposure.[140]
- Intrusion-Induced Madness: His Soul is a protected inner sanctuary. Forcing a way in ends in madness.[42]
- Fear Inducement: Victor's Eldritch nature can produce a supernatural fear associated with the incomprehensible Unknown rather than ordinary intimidation or killing intent.[142][140]
- Primordial Fear of the Unknown: Eldritch Runes manifested through Victor's weapon generated pressure associated with the instinctive fear of something the observer could not understand.[142]
- Paralyzing Terror: Lesser Eldritch creatures immediately abandoned their predatory behavior after perceiving Victor's complete form.[140]
- Eldritch Hierarchy Recognition: Their fear was accompanied by instinctive recognition that Victor occupied a vastly superior position within their own Eldritch hierarchy.[140]
- Eldritch Energy Manipulation: Victor naturally generates and manipulates Eldritch Energy, the foreign Energy produced by his Outer God existence.[136][140]
- Extra-Universal Energy: Victor explicitly explains that Eldritch Energy comes from outside the Universe and does not belong to the native Reality.[70]
- Foreign Attributeless Energy: Victor describes Eldritch Energy as broadly comparable to the attributeless Energy of another Universe. Its corruptive property arises because the Energy belongs to a different cosmological system.[70]
- Foreign-Logic Corruption: Because Eldritch Energy does not belong to the native Reality, its use causes affected structures to distort according to the logic of the Reality from which that Energy originates.[70]
- Eldritch Energy Generation: Victor generates Eldritch Energy directly through his own Essence rather than requiring an external supply.[136][140]
- Eldritch Energy Control: Victor can consciously regulate the amount of Eldritch Energy and influence he releases.[140]
- Eldritch Energy Suppression: Victor can suppress the outward effects of his Eldritch Energy when unrestricted release would distort the environment or attract unwanted attention.[140]
- Energy Amplification: Victor can use Eldritch Essence to drastically reinforce another compatible form of Energy. Before properly understanding genuine Negativity Synchronization, he used Eldritch power to force his Negative Energy to a level imitating portions of that superior state.[3]
- Conceptual Power Amplification: Eldritch Energy can push Conceptual effects beyond the level Victor's ordinary comprehension would otherwise produce, although this forced amplification is not equivalent to complete mastery of the Concept.[3]
- Eldritch Energy Infusion: Other compatible Beings can accumulate portions of Victor's Eldritch Energy through prolonged exposure, inheritance or deep Soul connections. Victor's wives had already accumulated Eldritch Energy through their relationship with him, while his daughters inherited greater compatibility from birth.[136]
- Eldritch Adaptation Bestowal: Exposure to Victor's Eldritch Energy can make compatible Beings increasingly resistant to Outer God phenomena. Members of Victor's family were able to communicate with Azathoth without immediately succumbing to her natural madness-inducing existence partly because their connection with Victor had already adapted them toward Eldritch Energy.[136]
- Existential Corruption / Reality Distortion: Victor's Eldritch Essence naturally distorts beings, information and Reality because its properties do not conform to the ordered Rules of the native Creation.[138][70]
- Passive Corruption: Eldritch corruption does not always require Victor to activate a separately named technique; distortion is an inherent consequence of sufficiently intense contact with his foreign Essence.[138]
- Lethal Eldritch Contamination: Extreme contact with Victor's cosmic-horror existence can corrupt a native Divine Being to death. During the Chapter 1158 interrogation, the foreign God operating through Nikolai eventually died from corruption caused by prolonged exposure to Victor's Eldritch nature.[43]
- Reality Displacement: Victor explains that Eldritch corruption can push an inferior target outside the ordinary Rules protecting and defining its existence within local Reality.[7]
- Existential Information Corruption: Once sufficiently corrupted, the information defining a target's existence can itself be altered rather than merely damaging its physical body or Soul.[7]
- Past, Present and Future Corruption: Victor specifically explains that Eldritch corruption can reach the information defining a Being throughout its Past, Present and Future.[7]
- Historical / Existential Rewriting (Explained Capability): Victor uses the example that, after completely removing an inferior Being from the native Reality's protection, he could alter its existential information so fundamentally that its history could define it as having been born as a completely different creature.[7]
- Creation Incompatibility: Completely ordered creation is difficult for an Eldritch Chaos to produce without portions of its own foreign and corruptive characteristics entering the result.[138]
- Universal Eldritch Corruption (Extreme/Conditional): During Victor's confrontation with the native Primordial Beings, he can use his relationship with <Negativity> as a carrier and flood the Concept itself with Eldritch Energy.[8]
- Universal-Scale Contamination: Because Negativity permeates approximately half of the native Universe's structure, corrupting it in this manner would spread Victor's Eldritch influence throughout Reality instead of remaining confined to one target or location.[8]
- Universal Logic Distortion: The effect is compared to a virus infiltrating every function of a system until the system is progressively transformed into something else.[8]
- Conceptual Carrier Corruption: This demonstrates that Victor can use a sufficiently interconnected Conceptual structure as the medium through which Eldritch corruption propagates.[8]
- Catastrophic Self-Damage: The technique is not a casual attack. Victor would simultaneously be destroying an enormous portion of the Negativity-based structure of his own Soul and would be severely weakened despite eventually recovering through his deeper Eldritch existence.[8]
Note: The universal corruption method was presented as an extreme threatened measure and should not be treated as a consequence-free standard attack.
- Reality Warping: Victor's Nightmare Form can impose its Eldritch influence directly upon Reality. Unlike ordinary Draconic Reality manipulation, this effect originates from an existence whose Energy and Rules do not belong completely to the local Creation.[141][70]
- Eldritch Reality Override: Victor initially attempted to control [[Yog-Sothoth]]'s unstable powers through Draconic Language, but Reality ignored his command. After accessing Nightmare Form and imposing his Eldritch influence, he became capable of suppressing the phenomenon and restoring Reality.[141]
- Eldritch Power Suppression: Victor can suppress uncontrolled Eldritch phenomena originating from sufficiently related or inferior Outer Gods.[141]
- Conceptual Regulation: Victor could regulate Yog-Sothoth's unstable Eldritch Concepts sufficiently to prevent them from continuing to distort their surroundings.[141]
- Reality Stabilization: After overpowering the uncontrolled manifestation, Victor restored the surrounding Reality instead of simply destroying the affected area.[141]
- Passive Reality Distortion: Victor's unrestricted Eldritch manifestation can distort surrounding Reality without requiring a deliberate command.[140]
- Spatial Distortion: Space around Victor's Nightmare Form can become unstable as the local Reality reacts to an existence that does not fully conform to its Rules.[140]
- Gravity Distortion: Victor's manifestation can interfere with local gravity, causing surrounding matter to behave abnormally before normal conditions reassert themselves.[140]
- Time Distortion: Victor's Eldritch presence can interfere with the normal experience of Time independently from his conventional Time Manipulation.[140]
- Temporal Perception Distortion: The approximately 0.2-nanosecond manifestation experienced by the lesser Eldritch creatures was subjectively perceived as an enormously extended event.[140]
- Law Transcendence / Rule Bypassing: Victor's Outer God nature allows him to resist, circumvent or function outside certain Rules that ordinarily govern Beings existing entirely within the native Creation.[3][138]
- Cosmological Rule Resistance: Azathoth describes herself and Victor as fundamentally different from native Beings and explains that the local Cosmos cannot bind their complete existence in exactly the same manner.[138]
- Primordial-Domain Movement: Victor used Eldritch power to continue moving inside a condition where only Beings possessing the proper Primordial-level relationship with Negativity should normally have been capable of acting.[3]
- Foreign-Rule Imposition: Chapter 1185 clarifies the underlying mechanism of Eldritch power: rather than simply breaking a local Rule through brute force, Eldritch Energy can impose the foreign logic belonging to another Reality upon what it affects.[70]
- Eldritch Law Imposition: Victor can establish persistent supernatural orders through his Eldritch authority. The surname Elderblood is protected by an Eldritch-written rule so that only individuals recognized by Victor can legitimately possess the name.[113]
- Eldritch Perception: Activating Nightmare Form allows Victor to perceive foreign Eldritch properties that ordinary supernatural perception may fail to properly classify.[141]
- Eldritch Concept Perception: Victor immediately identified the three principal Eldritch Concepts manifested by the young Yog-Sothoth as Space, Intangibility and Nullity.[141]
- Outer God Power Perception: Victor can perceive the nature and leakage of another Outer God's power and determine how it is affecting surrounding Reality.[141]
- Eldritch Being Detection: Victor can detect enormous populations of Eldritch creatures and distinguish broad differences in their power. In the dead region he perceived millions of weaker creatures, hundreds of stronger entities and the comparatively small number powerful enough to attract his personal attention.[140]
- Eldritch Domination: Victor occupies a vastly superior position within the hierarchy of lesser Eldritch creatures and can impose his authority upon sufficiently inferior entities through the qualitative superiority of his existence.[140]
- Hierarchy Suppression: Creatures that initially attempted to consume Victor immediately abandoned the attempt after perceiving his genuine Form.[140]
- Existential Submission: The creatures changed from viewing Victor as possible prey to instinctively recognizing him with fear and respect.[140]
- Command: After Victor communicated through Eldritch Language, the creatures obeyed him and widened the dimensional opening necessary for him to enter their territory.[140]
Note: This does not establish unconditional Mind Control over every Outer God. The entities demonstrated were substantially beneath Victor in the Eldritch hierarchy.
- Eldritch Language: Victor can naturally communicate through a language belonging to Eldritch Gods rather than conventional mortal, Divine, Draconic or System languages.[140]
- Incomprehensible Language: The language is fundamentally alien to ordinary native communication systems and carries more than simple spoken vocabulary.[140]
- Intent Communication: Compatible Eldritch Beings can understand the intent and meaning carried by Victor's speech without requiring a conventional linguistic relationship.[140]
- Eldritch Comprehension: Victor naturally understands and employs this communication system because of his own Outer God nature.[140]
- Corruptive Linguistics: The language carries information rooted in a foreign cosmological system and can be dangerous for incompatible Beings attempting to understand it.[140][70]
- Higher-Dimensional Communication: By the late Imperial era, Victor's deeper ritual speech could become so alien that even War and the Heralds perceived it as though a higher-dimensional Being were attempting to communicate with lower-dimensional existences.[43]
- Eldritch Rune Manipulation: Victor can create and utilize Runes derived from his Outer God nature rather than conventional native or Draconic Runic systems.[142]
- External-God Runic Language: Victor explicitly explains that Eldritch Runes are essentially the language of an external God.[70]
- Foreign Reality Distortion: Using Eldritch Runes causes surrounding structures to distort according to their foreign Rules rather than simply reproducing a native Runic effect.[70]
- Unknown Runes: When Victor's Eldritch influence manifested through his Greatsword, unknown violet Runes appeared that conventional observers could not properly comprehend.[142]
- Forbidden Information Encoding: Eldritch Runes can encode information whose attempted comprehension causes madness and extreme psychological strain.[142]
- Runic Cognitohazard: Merely trying to understand the deeper information contained in the script can become dangerous to an observer lacking Eldritch compatibility.[142]
- Fear Aura: Their manifestation produces supernatural pressure associated with the primordial Fear of the Unknown rather than ordinary killing intent.[142]
- Runic Amplification: Victor can combine Eldritch Runes with other Runic Languages. Because individual Eldritch characters possess disproportionately powerful effects, a small number can enormously reinforce a much larger conventional formula.[143]
- Eldritch Rune Mastery: Victor's proficiency was later explicitly classified at Master Level in Eldritch Runic Script.[77]
- Controlled Symbol Limitation: Victor deliberately restricts the number of Eldritch symbols he uses because excessive use would cause the surrounding Reality to become increasingly distorted according to their foreign logic.[70]
- Creation Consumption / Existential Feeding: Eldritch Chaos develops by consuming portions of Creation and converting what is consumed into further growth. Azathoth directly explains that Victor must continue feeding upon Creation for his Outer God existence to mature.[136]
- Divinity Absorption: Victor's Eldritch Chaos can consume Divinities as nourishment for its continued development.[136]
- [[Divine Energy]] Absorption: Divine Energy can be incorporated as fuel supporting Victor's Eldritch growth.[136]
- Conceptual Consumption: Because Divinity represents conceptual authority rather than merely ordinary Energy, Eldritch feeding can involve powers associated with Divine Concepts.[136]
- Cosmic Matter Consumption: Stars, planets, black holes and other enormous astronomical structures can serve as nourishment for a developing Eldritch Chaos.[136]
- Growth Through Consumption: Consumption advances the maturation and scale of Victor's Eldritch existence rather than merely replenishing an Energy reserve.[136]
Note: This does not prove that Victor can automatically consume every possible existence or Concept regardless of hierarchy or resistance.
- Cosmic Consumption / Galaxy Devouring: Victor's deeper Eldritch Form can directly consume structures on Galactic scales.[139]
- Galaxy Consumption: When Albedo entered the deepest region of Victor's Soul, she directly observed his massive Eldritch Form eating galaxies.[139]
- Cosmic-Scale Feeding: This demonstrates that astronomical consumption is a natural function available to Victor's deeper Eldritch existence and is not limited to ordinary humanoid-scale Predation.[139]
- Mass Cosmic Consumption (Inner Manifestation): Victor's earlier Chapter 889 encounter with his True Self depicted eyes larger than galaxies, mouths resembling black holes and tendrils whose contact caused galaxies to disappear before the surrounding galaxies were ultimately consumed.[79]
Note: Swallowing galaxies inside an internal vision is not the same feat as the developed Eldritch Form consuming galaxies inside the deeper Reality of his Soul. The second is the demonstrated use.[139]
- Eldritch Essence Bestowal: Victor can transmit portions of his Outer God Essence to other Beings, allowing that foreign Essence to alter their fundamental existence.[64][138]
- Eldritch Transformation: Victor deliberately granted [[Akasha Elderblood]] his Essence because he did not want her existence to belong completely to one of the native Primordial systems. Akasha consequently developed into an Eldritch Being directly connected to Victor.[64]
- Existential Source Conversion: Victor can progressively shift a Being away from complete dependence upon the native Divine framework and toward an Eldritch source.[136][64]
- Young-God Conversion: The process is comparatively natural for Victor's daughters and other young Gods born with his Essence because the Eldritch component already exists within them.[136]
- Mature-God Conversion: Converting an already fully developed native Goddess is vastly more difficult because most of her existence is already structured around native Rules and Energy. Azathoth explains that Victor could perform such a conversion, but doing so while immature could severely weaken the target.[136]
- Descendant Inheritance: Victor's daughters naturally inherit portions of his Eldritch nature and therefore possess greater compatibility with Eldritch development from birth.[136][138]
- Familial Eldritch Adaptation: Victor's wives accumulated Eldritch Energy through prolonged connection and Soul bonds with him, giving them greater tolerance toward phenomena that would be dangerous to ordinary native Gods.[136][138]
- Eldritch Concept Inheritance: Victor's descendants can inherit one of his powers or Concepts while expressing it through their own Eldritch nature rather than reproducing an exact native copy.
- [[Nero]]'s Apocalypse: [[Nero Elderblood]] developed the Eldritch Divinity of Apocalypse, demonstrating that Victor's descendants can produce foreign Divinities rooted through his Eldritch source.[136][144]
- Nigredo's Eldritch Darkness: Nigredo Elderblood inherited Victor's Darkness but expressed it as an abnormal Eldritch Darkness associated with a black-hole-like collapse and the boundary between Being and Non-Being.[118]
- Eldritch Primordial Development (Potential): Victor later explains that a descendant such as Kassandra, whose body and Soul already contain his Eldritch foundation, could potentially become an Eldritch Primordial Force of Destruction belonging to Victor's Pantheon rather than replacing the native embodiment of Destruction.[70]
- Foreign Primordial Path (Potential): Victor states that even Kali could theoretically pursue an Eldritch Primordial path in the future, although Kassandra's inherited Eldritch Soul makes the process significantly easier for her.[70]
Note: These examples establish the flexibility and inheritance potential of Victor's Eldritch Pantheon. They do not mean Victor automatically possesses every individually manifested Domain of his descendants.
- Conceptual Imprinting / Domain Bestowal: Victor can influence the conceptual nature that emerges within an Eldritch Being fundamentally created or transformed through his Essence.[64]
- Domain Creation: When Victor created Akasha's Eldritch existence, his intention that she govern and supervise his Empire manifested within her as a Domain associated with Control.[64]
- Contradictory Concept Generation: Because Victor simultaneously desired that Akasha remain impossible for outsiders to control, her Eldritch nature also developed the contradictory property of loss of control.[64]
- Eldritch Pantheon Empowerment: Eldritch Goddesses connected to Victor can draw their foreign Divine foundation through him in a structure broadly comparable to native Gods receiving power through their Pantheon's higher cosmological source.[137]
Note: Acting as the source of these Domains does not prove Victor personally possesses every exact Concept generated in every descendant.
- Eldritch Entity Creation: Victor can create and participate in the creation of genuine Eldritch life rather than merely strengthening native creatures. Earlier demonstrations were collaborative with Azathoth, while Chapter 1188 later explicitly establishes Victor himself as one of the two Creators capable of producing Eldritch Gods.[69][145]
- Yog-Sothoth's Creation (Collaborative/Essence-Based): Azathoth combined her own Essence with a small quantity of Victor's Essence to produce Yog-Sothoth Elderblood, demonstrating that Victor's fundamental Essence can participate in creating genuine Eldritch offspring.[141]
- [[Abhoth]]'s Creation (Collaborative): Victor and Azathoth deliberately created Abhoth, a genuine Eldritch entity whose fundamental nature manifests as living corruption.[69]
- Creator-Class Eldritch God Creation: When discussing the new Eldritch Being created by his daughters, Victor explicitly states that they had not created an Eldritch God because only Azathoth and Victor can create such Beings. Chapter 1188 consequently removes the earlier uncertainty over whether Victor's role in genuine Eldritch creation was limited to supplying Essence to Azathoth.[145]
- Eldritch Pantheon Creator Hierarchy: The same explanation places Victor and Azathoth at the highest position of the Eldritch hierarchy as the Creators. Beneath them are the Eldritch/Outer Gods they create, followed by Divine subordinate creations categorized as Great Old Ones, and then lesser servants lacking Divinity.[145]
- Great Old One Creation: Victor is capable of creating subordinate Eldritch Beings possessing Divinity. Chapter 1188 classifies Divine Beings created by Victor or his daughters as Great Old Ones, distinguishing them from full Eldritch Gods while still placing them above ordinary Eldritch servants.[145]
- Lesser Eldritch Servant Creation: Victor can also populate his territories with lesser Eldritch entities below the Great Old One tier. He has already scattered lesser Eldritch Beings through galaxies. In his hierarchy they sit beneath Abhoth.[145]
Note: Victor being explicitly capable of creating Eldritch Gods does not automatically grant him every creation feat or cosmological function belonging to a fully completed [[Primordial Chaos]]. The demonstrated hierarchy establishes genuine Creator status within his Eldritch Pantheon while the narrative still distinguishes Victor's current hybrid existence from the supreme Chaos responsible for establishing an entire autonomous Universe.[7][145]
- Eldritch Cosmic Construction: Victor can incorporate his Eldritch power directly into the metaphysical foundation of a created cosmic structure rather than merely using it as an Energy source.[6][7]
- Eldritch Galaxy Shaping: While teaching [[Norabell Elderblood]], Victor combined <Negativity>, <Beginning> and Eldritch power to construct a miniature galaxy.[6][7]
- Existence and Reality Anchoring: Victor explicitly states that he used Negativity, Beginning and Eldritch power to give the galaxy existence and Reality.[6]
- Eldritch Reality Shaping: The construct is an Eldritch galaxy. It took that nature only because he shaped it with his Eldritch powers.[7]
- Existential Weight Reinforcement: Incorporating higher Concepts and Eldritch power into the galaxy made it vastly more deeply entrenched within Reality than the ordinary cube-shaped dimension Victor created beside it.[6][7]
- Resistance to Dimensional Authority: Norabell could casually seize control of the ordinary subordinate dimension when Victor permitted it, but failed to rewrite the conceptual galaxy even when applying her Space-Time authority and Dragon Language.[6]
- Simulated Eldritch Entity Manifestation: Several objects resembling stars within the miniature galaxy were actually enormous cosmic-horror-shaped constructs.[6][7]
- High-Fidelity Pseudo-Life: Victor reproduced the form, Energy and behavior of Eldritch organisms convincingly enough that his daughters initially perceived them as genuine.[7]
- True Eldritch Galaxy Creation (Conditional/Collaborative): Victor internally states that directly merging his power with Azathoth could produce a genuine Eldritch galaxy rather than the extraordinarily realistic imitation used in Norabell's lesson.[7]
- Primordial Foundation Requirement: Victor explains that a completely autonomous Reality requires a full Conceptual foundation established by a supreme Chaos rather than merely matter, Energy and several high-level Concepts.[7]
- Concealment Limitation: Victor deliberately refuses to create the genuine version because combining with Azathoth at that level would act like an enormous signal announcing their activity to higher cosmic authorities.[7]
Note: The creatures inside Victor's artificial galaxy were explicitly described as existentially "empty" replicas rather than independent true life. This should therefore not be indexed as complete Life Creation.[7]
- Eldritch Creature Empowerment: Victor can strengthen and modify Eldritch entities beneath him rather than merely commanding them.[85]
- Existential Enhancement: Victor and Azathoth strengthened the creatures incorporated into the [[Elderblood Empire]]'s Galactic defensive infrastructure.[85]
- Environmental Adaptation: The modified creatures could inhabit extreme astronomical environments including asteroids, stellar regions and black holes.[85]
- Sustenance Modification: Victor altered the organisms so that they did not require conventional feeding and could remain dormant without consuming the surrounding ecosystem.[85]
- Sensory Enhancement: Some of the enhanced entities could monitor territories extending across complete Solar Systems.[85]
- Galactic Defensive Integration: The creatures could hide throughout the Imperial galaxy and transform apparently ordinary astronomical structures into living defensive positions.[85]
- Imperial Corruption Security Network: Through Abhoth, Victor developed a distributed Eldritch anti-corruption system intended to protect Imperial personnel while turning hostile corruption attempts against their source.[69]
- Corruption Design: Abhoth naturally corrupts whatever it touches, but Victor can engineer how fragments of the creature are incorporated into the Imperial defensive system.[69]
- Fragment Distribution: Pieces of Abhoth can be distributed among Imperial personnel while remaining metaphysically connected to the greater Eldritch entity and Victor.[69]
- Counter-Corruption: An outside entity attempting to corrupt a protected individual can instead expose itself to Abhoth's corruption through the connection it created.[69]
- Corruption Detection: Because every fragment remains connected to the network, hostile corruption attempts can alert Victor that external interference is occurring.[69]
- Betrayal Detection: The same system can reveal hostile actions from an individual carrying an Abhoth fragment.[69]
- Reverse Connection / Counter-Control: The connection created by the hostile influence can potentially provide Victor with a metaphysical route back toward the source responsible for the corruption attempt.[69]
- Distributed Guardian Network: Victor planned to combine the system with the [[World Trees]] and his enormous parallel-processing capability so that protection could operate throughout Imperial territory without requiring his primary consciousness to manually monitor every individual.[69]
- Soul Fragmentation / Essence Fragmentation: Victor can separate extremely small fragments of his Soul while those fragments continue retaining qualitative characteristics belonging to his deeper existence.[111]
- Eldritch Essence Retention: Even tiny pieces of Victor's Soul retain traces of his Nightmare/Eldritch nature.[111]
- Persistent Source Nature: Victor cannot make a Soul fragment completely ordinary merely by reducing its Energy because the fragment remains fundamentally part of him.[111]
- Incompatibility Hazard: Victor's Soul fragments can be dangerously incompatible with bodies and Souls lacking sufficient affinity with his existence.[111]
- Soul Inviolability: Victor's Soul possesses an exceptionally high degree of protection because its deepest nature includes foreign Chaos. Azathoth explicitly describes both her own Soul and Victor's as inviolable.[138]
- Soul Manipulation Resistance: Conventional native spiritual interference is extraordinarily ineffective against Victor's deepest Eldritch spiritual foundation.[138]
- Existential Integrity: His Chaos nature protects the deepest layers of his identity and Essence from being manipulated in the same manner as the Soul of an ordinary native Being.[138]
- Deep Eldritch Core: Victor possesses an additional Eldritch region located deeper than the conventional Core of his Soul, functioning as a home for his Heralds and other Eldritch existences connected directly to him.[123]
- Internal Cosmic Environment: The deepest region of Victor's Soul is not represented as a conventional small spiritual space. Albedo observes an immense environment where Victor's deeper Eldritch body interacts with entire galaxies.[139]
- Soul Sanctuary: Victor can shelter important existences within this internal realm. The World Trees are kept inside his inner world, so they survive even if the planets tied to them are destroyed.[42]
- Impenetrable Soul: Chapter 1178 directly describes Victor's Soul as the Empire's true protection because outsiders cannot casually penetrate it and attempts to force their way inside result in madness.[42]
- System Observation Resistance: Even the System, despite possessing extraordinary administrative authority over the native Universe, cannot penetrate Victor's Eldritch Soul to inspect what he protects within it.[28]
- Systemic Concealment: When the System attempted to observe [[Moira Eutychia Elderblood]], who was hidden within Victor's Soul, it obtained nothing despite its intended authority over the native cosmological structure.[28]
- Administrative Intrusion Resistance: Victor's foreign Eldritch foundation therefore prevents native cosmological administration from automatically gaining access to his deepest inner existence.[28]
Note: This directly establishes resistance to the System's demonstrated observation attempt. It does not prove that literally every conceivable superior foreign existence is incapable of interacting with Victor's Soul.
- Cosmological Takeover / Authority Usurpation (Theoretical): Victor's unique status as a Chaos born inside the native Creation gives him a possibility unavailable to ordinary foreign Chaos: he may be capable of taking over positions normally belonging to fundamental native authorities.[138]
- Native Authority Compatibility: Azathoth explains that an ordinary foreign Chaos cannot simply replace an established native existence because the corresponding Rules are already fixed, while Victor may be an exception because he is simultaneously Chaos and a legitimate Being of the same Cosmos.[138]
- Primordial Throne Succession (Theoretical): Azathoth theorizes that Victor could potentially assume the vacant position associated with the original Chaos of the native Cosmos.[138]
Note: Azathoth presented this as a highly probable theory rather than an accomplished feat.
- Higher-Dimensional Evolution (Potential): Victor's Eldritch Chaos possesses a developmental route capable of eventually carrying his existence beyond the capacity of his native Creation to contain him.[136]
- Unbound Growth: Unlike a native God whose existence and Concepts are permanently rooted in one Creation, Victor's Eldritch development is not permanently restricted to his native cosmological framework.[136]
- Reality Transcendence (Potential): Azathoth explains that if Victor continues consuming and developing, his existence will eventually become too great for his native Reality to contain normally.[136]
- Higher-Dimensional Existence (Future Development): Azathoth describes the eventual result as Victor becoming a Being of a Higher Dimension.[136]
- Multiversal Being (Future Development): Azathoth further refers to the completed state as Victor becoming a Multiversal Being.[136]
- Current Eldritch Advancement: The late Imperial chapters demonstrate that Victor has advanced enormously beyond the immature state described in Chapter 1015—his Soul is recognized as a cosmic horror of the highest order and he is called an Eldritch God of the highest rank—but this does not automatically prove that every predicted future stage described by Azathoth has already been completed.[28][8]

##### Outer God Form Resistances
The Nightmare Form's foreign nature provides several protections that are distinct from Victor's ordinary Blood Dragon durability and general resistances.
- Madness Resistance: Victor can safely perceive and interact with Eldritch Beings whose appearance, language and Essence would drive ordinary native observers insane.[141][140]
- [[Eldritch Energy]] Resistance: Victor naturally generates, withstands and manipulates Eldritch Energy instead of suffering the uncontrolled corruption experienced by incompatible native Beings.[140][70]
- Eldritch Corruption Resistance: Victor's own Essence belongs to the same foreign cosmological class responsible for Eldritch corruption, granting natural compatibility with phenomena that can catastrophically distort ordinary native existences.[138][70]
- Reality Distortion Resistance: Victor can remain functional while Reality is being distorted by another Eldritch existence and can actively regulate sufficiently inferior Eldritch distortions, as demonstrated with [[Yog-Sothoth]].[141]
- Rule and Law Resistance: Victor's Outsider nature allows him to resist or circumvent restrictions that ordinarily bind native Beings.[3][138]
- Soul Manipulation Resistance: Victor's foreign [[Chaos]] foundation renders his Soul extraordinarily difficult to violate through conventional native spiritual authority.[138]
- Soul Intrusion Resistance: Victor's deepest Soul cannot be casually penetrated; forcing a way into it ends in madness.[42]
- System Observation Resistance: The System was unable to penetrate Victor's Eldritch Soul and observe Moira despite its immense administrative authority over the native Universe.[28]
- Information Hazard Resistance: Victor can comprehend Eldritch information, language and Runic principles that are dangerous or completely incomprehensible to ordinary minds.[142][140][139]
- Existential Information Resistance: Victor can perceive and interact with his own unrestricted True Self and with foreign Eldritch structures without suffering the information-overload effects his existence inflicts upon lesser observers.[79][139]
- Foreign-Language Resistance: Victor naturally understands and uses Eldritch Language rather than suffering the corruptive effects that an incompatible native Being could experience when attempting to process it.[140]
- Cosmic-Horror Exposure Resistance: Victor can directly interact with Azathoth, Yog-Sothoth and other Eldritch creatures without suffering the madness or existential destabilization ordinary native Beings may experience.[141][136][140]

##### Scope and Distinctions
Victor's Outer God nature should not be interpreted as automatically granting him every individually named power demonstrated by every Eldritch Being connected to him. [[Yog-Sothoth]] Elderblood possessing Space, Intangibility and Nullity, [[Nero Elderblood]] possessing Apocalypse, [[Akasha Elderblood]] possessing Control / Loss of Control, [[Nigredo Elderblood]] possessing her own Eldritch manifestation of Darkness, or Kassandra possessing the potential to become an Eldritch Primordial of Destruction demonstrates the conceptual freedom and inherited potential of Victor's [[Eldritch Pantheon]], but does not by itself prove that Victor consciously possesses every exact Domain expressed by every descendant.[141][137][64][118][70]
Likewise, Victor's ordinary Divinities, Blood Dragon Predation, Vampire Progenitor Soul Manipulation, Dragon Progenitor Creation Manipulation, Attributeless Energy, martial arts, absorbed abilities and other independent systems remain distinct even when his Eldritch Essence can interact with or amplify them. The Chapter 1167–1168 miniature galaxy is especially important to classify correctly: the apparent cosmic horrors within it were replicas, not independently living Eldritch entities, and the galaxy itself was a Conceptually reinforced imitation of Reality rather than a completed autonomous Universe.[6][7]
The late-story explanation of [[Eldritch Energy]] also distinguishes Eldritch corruption from other forms of Reality alteration used by Victor or his family. Eldritch Energy specifically corrupts and distorts native structures by imposing foreign cosmological logic upon them; not every paradox, Conceptual attack or Reality-warping effect used by Victor should therefore be categorized as Eldritch.[70]
Finally, Victor should not automatically be indexed as possessing every ability of a fully completed [[Primordial Chaos]] merely because that represents one possible endpoint of his development. The narrative distinguishes Victor's present hybrid existence from the supreme [[Chaos]] responsible for establishing the complete foundational Rules of an autonomous Universe. Chapter 1188 nevertheless advances Victor beyond the earlier uncertainty surrounding Eldritch creation by explicitly placing him beside Azathoth as one of the two Creators capable of producing Eldritch Gods. This confirmed Creator status should be indexed where demonstrated, while unrelated powers belonging exclusively to a completed supreme Primordial Chaos should still only be added once Victor personally acquires or demonstrates them.[28][8][70][145]
