03 · PROGENITOR AUTHORITY

#### Progenitor Abilities
Abilities tied to Victor's Progenitor nature and bloodline.
Victor is the Primogenitor of the [[Blood Dragons]], also referred to as Draconic Vampires or Vampyric Dragons. The race resulted from the complete fusion of his Vampire Progenitor and Dragon Progenitor characteristics rather than Victor simply possessing the two Progenitor states simultaneously. The term Primogenitor refers to Victor being the first Progenitor and origin of this newly created race rather than representing a separate rank inherently superior to all other Progenitors.[146][82][147]
- Blood Dragon Primogenitor Powers
- Vampire Progenitor Powers
- Dragon Progenitor Powers
As the first Blood Dragon and Primogenitor of the race, Victor possesses the completely merged racial characteristics and Progenitor authorities of Vampires and Dragons. The fusion did more than preserve the abilities of both sides; the interaction between the Vampire Progenitor's authority over Blood and Souls and the Dragon Progenitor's affinity with Creation actively strengthened the talents inherited from both lineages.[82][147]
- Superior Race / Perfect Hybrid Physiology: Victor's evolution created a new race through the complete fusion of Noble Vampire and True Dragon characteristics. His existence is not half Vampire and half Dragon; his racial essence was reconstructed into a single Blood Dragon physiology in which both sets of traits operate as parts of one coherent existence.[146][82][35]
- Complete Racial Fusion: Victor's Vampiric and Draconic characteristics ceased functioning as separately layered racial states after his evolution. The properties of both races became inherent characteristics of the newly established Blood Dragon race.[82][35]
- Combined Racial Traits: Blood Dragons possess the racial advantages and fundamental characteristics of both Noble Vampires and [[True Dragons]].[35][148]
- Power Retention: Becoming a Blood Dragon does not automatically erase supernatural characteristics possessed before transformation. Powers compatible with the resulting Dragon existence can remain and may improve further because of the Race's exceptional compatibility with Creation.[35]
- Racial Shapeshifting: Blood Dragons retain the mutable physiology of both Vampires and Dragons, allowing them to reproduce characteristics belonging to previous racial states without ceasing to be Blood Dragons.[35]
- Progenitor Fusion Enhancement: The complete fusion of Vampire and Dragon Progenitor authorities strengthened the talents belonging to both racial foundations rather than merely placing them beside one another.[147]
- Enhanced Soul Authority: Victor's already exceptional Vampire Progenitor affinity with Souls became further strengthened after merging with the superior spiritual nature of a Dragon Progenitor.[147]
- Enhanced Creation Affinity: The Dragon Progenitor's natural compatibility with Creation benefits from Victor's abnormal Vampiric nature and the other systems incorporated into his new Race.[147]
- Enhanced Draconic Language and Runic Affinity: Victor's instinctive understanding and control of Draconic Language and Draconic Runes became one of the abilities specifically enhanced by his status as a Dragon Progenitor and its merger with the Vampire Progenitor.[147][148]
- Enhanced Reality Manipulation: The Dragon Progenitor's innate capacity to alter Reality remained part of Victor after the fusion and was strengthened together with his other Progenitor talents.[147]
- Creation Compatibility: Dragons possess extraordinarily high compatibility with Creation. Everything naturally belonging to Creation is fundamentally compatible with Dragon existence, allowing Blood Dragons to assimilate otherwise disparate racial characteristics and supernatural abilities without those traits necessarily destroying one another.[35]
- Adaptation / Power Integration: Blood Dragons can incorporate compatible traits belonging to separate supernatural races into a single racial existence.[149]
- Hybridization: Victor can combine compatible biological and supernatural characteristics originating from numerous species while maintaining the Blood Dragon as the dominant foundation of his existence.[149]
- Progenitor Dominance: When one Progenitor attempts to convert another Progenitor through racial Essence, their respective Progenitor authorities enter into a struggle for supremacy. The stronger authority determines which racial foundation dominates the resulting existence.[35]
- Race Conversion: Victor can transform compatible beings into Blood Dragons by transmitting his racial Essence to them.[35]
- Lesser Dragon / Dragon Branch Conversion: Victor's Progenitor authority is not restricted to producing full Blood Dragons or True Dragons. The late Imperial explanation of his lineage establishes that qualified individuals can be admitted into the Lesser Dragon and ordinary Dragon branches, and that these branches ultimately remain subordinate to Victor as their Progenitor. True Dragonhood is maintained as a far more exclusive lineage rather than being automatically granted to every relative or subordinate.[150]
- Trait Preservation: Conversion does not necessarily erase every feature of the target's former species. Characteristics compatible with Blood Dragon existence can remain incorporated into the resulting body, Soul and supernatural nature.[35]
- Lineage Suppression: Victor's evolved Progenitor Bloodline can naturally suppress inferior Bloodlines. Even another Vampire Progenitor can instinctively experience suppression in Victor's presence because the Blood Dragon lineage occupies a superior position relative to conventional Vampire Bloodlines.[82]
- Creation Manipulation: Victor gained an extremely high degree of interaction with Creation through his Dragon Progenitor nature. Immediately after his evolution, the interaction between his Dragon authority, Vampiric characteristics and connection with [[Roxanne Elderblood]] allowed him to influence approximately 70% of Creation.[82]
- Existence Interaction: Victor can directly perceive and interact with structures, matter and Energies constituting existence itself.[82]
- Negative Aspect Manipulation: A normal Dragon Progenitor does not naturally possess authority over the fundamental Positive and Negative Energies. Victor partially bypassed this restriction through his abnormal Vampiric nature and connection with Roxanne, giving him access to the Negative side of Creation.[82]
- Pseudo-Divinity: Through Negative Energy and the lesser Concepts falling beneath it, Victor could reproduce effects comparable to those of a Minor God while still technically remaining a mortal existence.[82]
- Matter Manipulation: Victor can directly manipulate physical matter through his authority over Creation.[35]
- Material Transmutation: He can convert ordinary matter into supernatural material, demonstrated when he transformed common earth into Divine Material.[35]
- Material Fusion: Victor can combine supernatural substances possessing normally opposing properties, including Divine and Infernal materials.[35]
- Restoration: He can use Creation-related authority to restore damaged terrain and reconstruct destroyed environmental structures.[35]
- Cosmic Perception: Victor's senses underwent an enormous qualitative evolution when he became the Blood Dragon Primogenitor, allowing his perception to extend across cosmic distances and directly perceive Energies involved in maintaining Creation.[82]
- Energy Perception: Victor can perceive Positive Energy, Negative Energy and the numerous lesser supernatural Energies existing beneath them.[82]
- Primordial Detection: His senses became capable of identifying immense sources of power existing beyond ordinary dimensional boundaries even when he could not directly perceive the Primordial Entity responsible.[82]
- Existence Perception: Victor can perceive aspects of existence normally hidden from conventional supernatural senses.[82]
- Enhanced Comprehension: Victor's evolved Draconic perception allows him to study supernatural structures through observation and understand the principles responsible for their operation.[82]
- Ability Reproduction: After observing Witch and Alioth magical constructions, Victor became capable of understanding their structure and reproducing comparable [[Magic]] Circles.[82]
- Power Combination: His comprehension allows compatible supernatural systems to be combined into effects that their original users may not have independently possessed.[82]
- Enhanced Soul Authority: Victor retained the Soul-related authority belonging to his Vampire Progenitor existence, with that affinity becoming even more potent after its fusion with his Draconic nature.[151][152][147]
- Divinity-Soul Perception: Victor can perceive the metaphysical connection between a God's Divinity and their Soul.[152]
- Soul Information Perception: His Soul affinity allows him to inspect extremely complex information contained within the spiritual structure of living beings.
- Draconic Runic Affinity: Blood Dragons inherit the natural Runic aptitude of True Dragons. Victor states that Draconic Runes come naturally to Dragons, to the point that even Blood Dragons possessing comparatively little talent can create basic Draconic Runes.[148]
- Superior Progenitor Aptitude: As the Dragon Progenitor component of the Blood Dragon Primogenitor, Victor's understanding and manipulation of Draconic Runes vastly exceeds the minimum racial aptitude possessed by ordinary Blood Dragons.[147][148]
- Dragon Breath / Elemental Breath: As a Blood Dragon, Victor can channel enormous quantities of Energy and elemental properties through Draconic Breath attacks. Different Energies can be incorporated or combined according to his available affinities and understanding.[148]
Before becoming a Blood Dragon, Victor possessed the authority of a Vampire Progenitor through [[Sanguis Noctis Regis]]. These characteristics were not lost following his evolution; they became permanently incorporated into the Soul, Blood and racial foundation of the Blood Dragon Primogenitor.[153][154][152]
- Blood of the Night King: Also called the Golden Blood or Blood of the Night King, Sanguis Noctis Regis is the abnormal Bloodline shared by Victor and Vlad. It places its bearer at the highest natural level of their respective Night Race and provides several innate advantages even before the deeper Progenitor authorities are considered.[153]
- Accelerated Learning: Victor learns and assimilates knowledge, supernatural abilities and techniques at a dramatically greater rate than ordinary Vampires.[153]
- Superior Adaptation: The Blood greatly enhances Victor's natural capacity to adapt to new powers and circumstances.[153]
- Accelerated Growth: Victor converts training and accumulated experience into strength with far greater efficiency than ordinary Vampires.[153]
- Mind Manipulation Immunity: Sanguis Noctis Regis naturally grants immunity to ordinary mind-related damage and extremely high protection against supernatural interference with the mind.[153]
- Enhanced Vampiric Charm: The Blood greatly enhances the racial Charm of Vampires and allows Victor to control targets that ordinary Vampiric hypnosis may fail to affect.[153]
- Night King Hierarchy: The deeper property of the Blood places its bearer at the top of the natural hierarchy of the Night Race into which they develop, serving as the foundation for Victor's emergence as a Vampire Progenitor.[153]
- Progenitor Authority — Souls and Blood: The specialized authority of a Vampire Progenitor revolves around the Blood of the living and the Souls of the dead. Vampire Progenitors are repeatedly described as beings standing between Life and Death, using Blood as the medium through which they interact with Souls.[154][155]
- Soul Manipulation: Vampire Progenitors possess an intrinsic and extremely broad affinity for Souls. Victor eventually describes the basic limits of this racial authority directly: a Vampire Progenitor can destroy and edit Souls, but cannot naturally create an entirely new Soul from nothing.[154][54]
- Soul Perception: Victor can perceive Souls and spiritual structures inaccessible to ordinary physical senses.[154]
- Soul Interaction: By manifesting his Progenitor nature around his body, Victor can directly touch and interact with otherwise intangible Souls and spiritual connections.[154]
- Soul Extraction: Victor can remove a Soul from its physical vessel when the target falls within the scope of his authority.[154]
- Soul Destruction: Victor can destroy a Soul directly, producing spiritual death rather than merely destroying the physical body.[154][54]
- Soul Consumption: Vampire Progenitors can consume Souls connected to beings they have killed or whose Blood falls within their authority.[156][155]
- Soul Storage: Souls acquired by a Vampire Progenitor can be stored within the internal spiritual world generated by the Progenitor's own Soul.[157][155]
- Soul Editing: Victor can directly alter the information composing another Being's Soul. Because the Soul contains information describing the complete individual, sufficiently precise editing can alter the target's body, race, biological characteristics and supernatural potential.[158][54]
- Body Alteration through the Soul: Changes made to the information stored within a Soul can subsequently alter the physical body generated from that information.[158]
- Biological Modification: Victor can modify biological characteristics by rewriting the relevant information within a Soul.[158]
- Racial Modification: Victor can alter the racial structure of another Being by changing the corresponding Soul information.[158][54]
- Genetic Rewriting: A Vampire Progenitor can fundamentally rewrite the racial/genetic foundation of a compatible humanoid. When a Progenitor turns another species into a Vampire, approximately 99.99% of the target's genetic structure becomes that of a Noble Vampire while approximately 0.01% of their previous racial foundation remains.[159]
- Noble Vampire Creation: Unlike an ordinary Noble Vampire's turning ritual, which normally produces a Plebeian Vampire, a Vampire Progenitor can directly transform compatible humanoids into true Noble Vampires by rewriting their racial foundation.[159]
- Racial Trait Preservation: Because the previous Race is not erased with absolute completeness, useful characteristics belonging to that Race can remain integrated into the resulting Noble Vampire.[159]
- Offspring Race Manipulation: Victor can alter a developing Soul so that a child develops according to a chosen compatible racial structure instead of becoming an unstable hybrid.[158]
- Latent Potential Acceleration: Victor can identify characteristics that possess the potential to naturally appear in later generations and forcibly accelerate that development so the trait manifests in the current individual.[54]
- Spirit-Like Vampire Transformation: Victor used this principle when transforming Natashia, Carmila and Natasha, forcing a potential that should have manifested in a later generation to appear immediately and producing Vampires possessing Spirit-like characteristics.[54]
- Soul Repair: Victor's Soul Editing has developed far enough that he can repair damaged spiritual foundations rather than merely alter or destroy them.[160][54]
- Spiritual Reconstruction: Victor repaired the abnormalities within Natashia's Soul sufficiently for the foreign spiritual existences connected to her condition to be separated from her without destroying Natashia herself.[160][54]
- Soul Stabilization: He can restructure a damaged Soul into a stable state while preserving the identity of the individual being treated.[54]
- Soul Creation Limitation: Conventional Vampire Progenitor Soul authority does not allow the creation of a completely new Soul from nothing. Victor explicitly states that Vampire Progenitors can destroy and edit Souls but that true Soul creation normally belongs to Primordials or Gods possessing appropriate Creation authority.[54] Victor's later ability to create living Beings and participate in the production of new Souls comes from additional powers acquired long after his original Vampire Progenitor state and should not be attributed solely to this racial ability.
- Precise Soul Manipulation: Victor's affinity possesses sufficient precision to manipulate extraordinarily complex Soul structures and spiritual information.[151]
- Limited [[Akashic Records]] — Souls: Victor compares the Vampire Progenitor's relationship with Souls to a highly restricted version of the Akashic Records. Unlike the actual Records, the racial ability deals primarily with information connected to Souls rather than Creation as a whole.[151]
- Divinity-Soul Perception: Victor can identify the metaphysical connection anchoring a God's Divinity within their Soul, allowing him to examine spiritual structures ordinary Soul users may be unable to perceive.[152]
- Soul World: Vampire Progenitors possess an internal spiritual world partly because their enormously expanded mortal Souls require a method of managing the foreign Souls accumulated through their racial authority.[157]
- Soul Storage: Souls absorbed or acquired by the Progenitor can remain stored within this internal domain.[157][155]
- Mass Soul Storage: Vampire Progenitors can maintain enormous numbers of Souls. Vlad's living Blood alone contained hundreds of thousands of Souls he had collected throughout his existence.[155]
- Victor's Inner World: Victor's original Progenitor Soul World became the foundation from which his later Personal Universe developed. Its later cosmic properties should not be treated as standard abilities of every Vampire Progenitor.
- Blood Authority: Blood is one of the principal mediums through which a Vampire Progenitor exercises racial authority over living Beings.[154][155]
- Blood Manipulation: Vampire Progenitors possess extremely advanced control over their own Blood and can control Blood belonging to weaker targets when the difference in authority allows it.[155]
- Blood Mimicry: The Progenitor can transform their body into a living liquid-Blood state.[155]
- Body Reformation: In this state, the body can deform, divide and reconstruct itself into different configurations.[155]
- Blood Constructs: Living Blood can be shaped into additional limbs, spikes, weapons and other offensive or defensive structures.[155]
- Blood Memory Reading: Blood can function as an informational medium through which Victor accesses memories belonging to another Being. He used Carlos' altered Blood to search his memories and identify General James,[93] and later stated that he had developed the ability to read memories through Blood during his eighteen months outside [[Nightingale]].[94]
- Bloodline Empowerment: Victor's Blood can strengthen compatible Vampires, raise their racial potential and improve their ability to develop beyond previous limitations.
- Bloodline Transmission: As a Progenitor, Victor's Blood can serve as the foundation through which his racial characteristics are transmitted to others.
- Selective Characteristic Transmission: Victor can pass an individual characteristic from himself into a Vampire created through his Progenitor lineage. Eve demonstrated this by manifesting black Fire inherited from Victor, establishing that members of his direct lineage can receive specific characteristics of their Progenitor rather than merely generic Noble Vampire physiology.[161]
- Bloodline Evolution / Soul-Core Assimilation: Victor's Progenitor Blood can force compatible racial information to evolve and reorganize at the level of the Soul Core rather than merely increasing raw power. During the transformation experiments involving his family, Morgana's Vampiric foundation completely assimilated her Demonic side instead of leaving her as an unstable hybrid, producing a genuine Demonic Vampire subspecies. The event established that Victor's lineage can reproduce in moments a form of racial evolution that would ordinarily require Bloodlines or entire species generations to accomplish naturally.[162]
- Subspecies Creation: By restructuring how pre-existing racial information is incorporated into a Vampire foundation, Victor's Progenitor Blood can generate new stable Vampire subspecies rather than only reproducing an unchanged standard Noble Vampire.[162]
- Progenitor Soul: A Vampire Progenitor possesses an abnormally large and robust Soul adapted to containing and manipulating other Souls.[157]
- Exceptional Soul Size: A Vampire Progenitor Soul can be substantially larger than the Soul of an ordinary God.[157]
- Inferior Natural Quality (Former Limitation): Despite its size, an ordinary mortal Progenitor Soul naturally possesses lower qualitative refinement than a genuine Divine Soul because the Progenitor remains fundamentally mortal.[157]
- Victor's Refinement: This original weakness was gradually overcome in Victor through Roxanne Elderblood, Dragon evolution, Godhood and his subsequent transformations, meaning the limitation no longer accurately describes his current Soul.
- Progenitor Racial Growth: The age-based growth stages of Noble Vampires also apply to Vampire Progenitors, but the benefits gained at each threshold are explicitly greater than those received by ordinary Nobles.[163]
- Experience Conversion: Experience and development accumulated before a racial growth threshold are converted into additional raw power when the Vampire enters the next stage.[163]
- Enhanced Progenitor Benefit: The same process provides stronger results to Progenitors, with an ordinary Progenitor reaching the Old Vampire stage already being considered an exceptional monster by Vampire standards.[163]
- Victor's Exception: Victor ceased following the normal Vampire-only development path after his existence became the Blood Dragon Primogenitor, although the growth accumulated during his Vampire period remained part of his racial foundation.
- Progenitor Form: Victor could fully manifest the supernatural characteristics of his Vampire Progenitor existence before its eventual fusion with his Dragon nature.[157][164]
- Liquid Body: His complete Progenitor state possessed characteristics comparable to Vlad's living-Blood form, allowing Victor's physical body to behave as an abnormal fluid existence capable of extensive deformation and reconstruction.[155][164]
Victor acquired the authority of a Dragon Progenitor when his developing Draconic existence and Vampire Progenitor nature completely fused and produced the Blood Dragon Race.[146][82] The Dragon Progenitor represents the highest racial expression of the Dragon Race's innate relationship with Nature, Creation, Energy and Draconic Language.[147]
- Dragon Progenitor Authority: A Dragon Progenitor possesses the highest natural expression of the Dragon Race's connection to Creation. This authority greatly expands the range of Energies and phenomena Victor can naturally perceive, comprehend and manipulate.[82][147]
- Dragon Eyes: The Eyes of a Dragon Progenitor possess extremely advanced perception of existence itself.[82]
- Existence Perception: Victor can perceive structures and Energies constituting existence beyond what ordinary supernatural senses can detect.[82]
- Energy Perception: Victor can visually perceive the Energies underlying Creation, including Positive Energy, Negative Energy and lesser supernatural Energies.[82]
- Essence Perception: Victor can perceive important properties and underlying structures of supernatural phenomena simply by observing them.[82]
- Comprehension: Observation through his evolved perception allows Victor to rapidly understand how supernatural constructions function.[82]
- Replication: Once Victor possesses sufficient understanding, he can reproduce comparable phenomena through the Energies and supernatural systems available to him.[82]
- Fundamental Reality Perception / Source-Code Vision: Victor's Eyes can perceive the deeper structure underlying Reality rather than being limited to surface matter or Energy. The sight he passed to [[Norabell Elderblood]] is the source code of Reality. [[Melida Charlotte Elderblood]] inherited a more complete version of those Eyes.[6]
- Dimensional-Layer Perception: Victor can perceive alternate levels of dimensional existence that would normally conceal their occupants from beings limited to the ordinary layer of Reality.[6]
- Conceptual Structure Perception: His ocular framework is capable of recognizing the Divine Concepts and levels of existence supporting a dimensional or cosmic structure, allowing the underlying hierarchy of a Reality to be analyzed rather than merely its visible appearance.[6]
- Cosmic Sensing: Victor's perception can extend across immense cosmic distances.[82]
- Universal Energy Manipulation: Dragon Progenitors possess authority over the ordinary Energies existing beneath the fundamental Positive and Negative Energies of Creation.[82]
- Elemental Manipulation: This includes elemental Energies such as Fire, Water, Ice, Earth and the countless derivative Elements produced from them.[82]
- Magic Manipulation: Magic falls within the range of Energies a Dragon Progenitor can naturally perceive, interact with and control.[82]
- Foreign Energy Interaction: Unlike beings restricted primarily to Energies matching their natural affinity, a Dragon Progenitor can interact with an exceptionally broad range of Energies belonging to Creation.[82]
- Positive and Negative Energy Limitation: The ordinary Dragon Progenitor authority does not inherently grant control over the primordial Positive and Negative Energies themselves. Victor's access to those higher Energies originates from additional circumstances and powers rather than from the Dragon Progenitor Race alone.[82]
- Creation Manipulation: The Dragon Progenitor possesses direct interaction with Creation because Dragons are intrinsically connected to Nature and the structures that constitute the created world.[82]
- Matter Manipulation: Victor can manipulate physical matter through this authority.[35]
- Transmutation: He can convert ordinary substances into supernatural materials, demonstrated when he transformed normal earth into Divine Material.[35]
- Material Fusion: Victor can combine supernatural substances with otherwise opposing characteristics, including Divine and Infernal materials.[35]
- Restoration: He can reconstruct damaged terrain and restore environmental structures through his control over Creation.[35]
- Reality Manipulation: Dragon Progenitors possess an innate ability to alter Reality. This is explicitly identified as one of the natural benefits Victor obtained from the Dragon Progenitor component of his existence rather than being solely a product of his later Divinities.[147]
- Reality Alteration: Victor can impose changes upon the surrounding Reality through the interaction between his Draconic authority, Energy and intent.[147]
- Runic Reality Manipulation: His natural Reality alteration combines particularly effectively with Draconic Language and Runes, allowing him to construct persistent Reality-altering effects through Runic formulas.[148]
- Later Enhancement: Victor's later Reality Manipulation became drastically stronger after Godhood, Attributeless Energy and his Eldritch development. Those later feats should not be attributed exclusively to this racial ability.
- Creation Compatibility: Dragons possess exceptional compatibility with virtually everything naturally belonging to Creation.[35]
- Ability Retention: Supernatural abilities belonging to another racial existence can remain functional following transformation into a Dragon-derived Race when they are compatible with the resulting existence.[35]
- Racial Integration: Compatible characteristics belonging to separate species can be incorporated into a Dragon-based existence instead of automatically being rejected.[35]
- Power Enhancement: Existing powers can benefit from the superior biological, spiritual and Energy foundation supplied by Draconic physiology.[35]
- Creation Enhancement / Environmental Enrichment: Dragons possess a naturally beneficial relationship with Creation. Despite the destruction they can cause through their power and temperament, the continued presence of a Dragon within one location causes that region to become increasingly abundant in Life over time.[147]
- Life Enrichment: A Dragon existing in the same territory for sufficiently long periods naturally strengthens and enriches the surrounding Life and environment.[147]
- Progenitor Affinity: As a Dragon Progenitor, Victor possesses the highest racial expression of this compatibility, although the exact environmental scale of this passive property is not separately quantified for him.[147]
- Superior Draconic Language Aptitude: Dragon Progenitors possess exceptionally high instinctive comprehension and control of the Draconic Language and its Runic applications.[147]
- Draconic Speech of Power: Victor can combine Draconic words, Energy and intent to directly impose supernatural effects upon the world.[107]
- Intent-Based Casting: Draconic Language is heavily governed by the user's intent rather than rigid pronunciation alone, allowing Victor to modify the effect produced by a Rune if he supplies sufficient understanding and Energy.[148]
- Runic Flexibility: Victor can deliberately force a Draconic Rune associated with one phenomenon to produce a different intended result, although doing so consumes significantly more Energy than using the correct Rune.[148]
- Complex Runic Construction: Victor can create advanced Draconic Runic formulas far beyond the simple characters available to ordinary Dragons.[148]
- Draconic Runic Affinity: Understanding and producing Draconic Runes is an inherent characteristic of True Dragons and is consequently inherited by the Blood Dragon Race.[148]
- Innate Rune Creation: Even comparatively untalented Blood Dragons can create basic Draconic Runes because the ability is part of their Draconic nature.[148]
- Progenitor-Level Mastery: Victor's Dragon Progenitor authority raises this natural aptitude vastly beyond the racial minimum, eventually allowing him to operate at Grandmaster-level mastery of Draconic Runic Script.[147][148]
- Limited System Interaction: The System is integrated into the wider structures of Creation. Victor's Dragon Progenitor nature consequently allowed him limited perception and interference with System-related mechanisms despite complete administrative authority over those systems belonging to much higher existences.[151]
- Progenitor Bloodline Suppression: A superior Progenitor Bloodline can naturally suppress weaker Bloodlines through the hierarchy established between their racial Essences.[82]
- Dragon Progenitor Soul: Victor's racial evolution completed the spiritual component he previously lacked while developing Dragon traits through Zaladrac. His Soul itself became Draconic, combining the exceptional spiritual quality of a Dragon with the enormous capacity and Soul authority he possessed as a Vampire Progenitor.[165][53]
- Superior Soul Quality: A normal Dragon Soul possesses substantially greater natural quality than Victor's original mortal Vampire Progenitor Soul.[53]
- Merged Soul Foundation: Victor's Blood Dragon evolution combined the large Progenitor Soul foundation with the superior spiritual characteristics of a Dragon rather than discarding either side.[53][147]

04 · FORMS

#### Different Forms
Current, transitional and former transformations.
Because Victor is a Blood Dragon Primogenitor with Draconic and Vampire Progenitor characteristics, as well as a later-developed Eldritch nature, his physical appearance is extremely mutable. His Shapeshifting allows him to assume innumerable appearances, alter his age, change his physiology, and imitate characteristics of beings he has consumed. As such, not every change in Victor's appearance constitutes an independent transformation.
The forms listed below are limited to transformations that represent a distinct racial, existential, or major combat state. Simple shapeshifting, partial transformations, equipment such as [[Junketsu]], and temporary cosmetic changes are not treated as separate forms.

##### Current Forms

###### Humanoid Blood Dragon Form
Victor's default appearance is a humanoid body resembling his former human and Vampire appearance. Despite its appearance, it should not be classified as a Human Form. Victor ceased being a Vampire Progenitor in the conventional sense when his Draconic and Vampyric Progenitor characteristics completely fused and produced an entirely new Race. He became the Primogenitor of the Vampyric Dragons, standing above both Dragon and Vampire subspecies.[82]
Victor's humanoid appearance is therefore better understood as the compact form he normally chooses to inhabit rather than a separate human physiology. Even after attaining his enormous True Dragon Form, Victor could freely return to his humanoid appearance.[166] This becomes even more explicit after Victor's Eldritch development. As an Eldritch [[Chaos]], Victor is no longer fundamentally limited to a fixed shape; he continues using a humanoid body primarily because it is the appearance with which he identifies and finds convenient.[137] Because of his extreme Shapeshifting, Victor can drastically modify this form without actually transforming into another major form, including altering his age, size, racial characteristics, organs, limbs, and external features. These changes should therefore not be separately catalogued as transformations.

###### True Dragon Form
Victor's True Dragon Form is his genuine draconic body. Unlike his earlier partial draconic transformations, this is a true racial form tied directly to his existence and soul. Victor fully manifested this body after ascending as a God. During the transformation, his body continued increasing in size until it exceeded the size of a planet. Victor deliberately compressed the form to approximately 500 meters rather than remaining unnecessarily enormous, reasoning that a smaller body would provide greater density and concentration of power.[166] The 500-meter body was explicitly identified as Victor's true appearance registered within his soul and the form in which his existence naturally felt comfortable. At the time, however, Victor lacked experience operating such a massive body and quickly returned to humanoid form.[166]
Upon its manifestation, [[The Universal Tree]] identified Victor as a [[Chaos]] Dragon God, an unprecedented Dragon God simultaneously possessing powers associated with both sides of the Balance, Positivity and Negativity.[166] Victor's True Dragon Form does not possess a permanently fixed maximum size. Its scale has increased enormously alongside Victor's growth. After further developing his Divinities, Victor transformed into a gigantic black Dragon with violet hues. His body grew several times larger than [[Jupiter]] before eventually exceeding the size of the entire Solar System. At that stage, he reached a size at which he could hold the Solar System within one hand. Victor was forced to distort Reality around himself so that his enormous physical presence would not disrupt the surrounding space.[167] Following Victor's understanding and adoption of Attributeless Energy as the primary foundation of his power, his True Draconic Body underwent another fundamental increase. By this point, the form had grown so enormous that Victor could theoretically swallow entire galaxies.[168]
In its current observed state, Victor appears as an immense Black Western Dragon with violet hues and eyes glowing crimson-violet. His body's natural presence possesses such tremendous weight in the fabric of space that nearby stars, planets, and black holes are naturally drawn toward him, requiring Reality itself to be adjusted to prevent the surrounding celestial bodies from being displaced.[168]
Therefore, Victor's 500-meter, Solar-System-scale, and later galactic-scale appearances should not be listed as three different Dragon transformations. They are different stages in the growth of the same True Dragon Form.

###### Nightmare Form
The Nightmare Form, also explicitly known as Victor's Eldritch Form, is Victor's Eldritch aspect and eventually develops into the closest thing he possesses to a true soul form. Its earliest known manifestation occurred during the Egyptian conflict when Victor's rage caused the powers contained within his existence to react chaotically. His body became an amorphous mass of crimson darkness filled with numerous eyes and tendrils. Jeanne attributed the transformation to the combination of Victor's Blood Dragon shapeshifting, his hatred, and the enormous number of powers contained within his body reacting without proper control.[169] At this point, the transformation was largely instinctive and uncontrolled rather than a consciously perfected combat form. Victor subsequently encountered a much greater manifestation of this existence within a dream. Floating among countless galaxies, he witnessed an indescribable entity composed of violet, red, and black, possessing thousands of enormous eyes, mouths resembling black holes, and immense tentacles. Victor recognized this entity as another version of himself, even referring to it as his True Self.[79]
The cosmic scale shown during this encounter should be treated specifically as an internal dream or vision rather than being conflated with Victor physically transforming in normal reality at that point in the story.[79] As Victor's Eldritch nature developed, the Nightmare Form became a genuine part of his existence. Victor later described his true soul form as a formless something capable of expanding into a massive entity that could consume entire Solar Systems. Unlike conventional beings, an Eldritch [[Chaos]] such as Victor is not intrinsically restricted to a single physical shape.[137]
The name was later explicitly confirmed when [[Akasha Elderblood]] referred to the transformation as the Nightmare Form, also known as the Eldritch Form. The influence of this form was responsible for Akasha possessing an Eldritch nature connected directly to Victor rather than to the conventional Divine system of Creation.[64]
The Eldritch Form resides at the deepest level of Victor's Soul. Even beyond the region containing his [[World Trees]] and the conventional Core of his Soul exists another hidden Core containing Victor's Eldritch Form. This region is also where Victor's Heralds normally reside.[123] When Albedo was later exposed to Victor's Eldritch Form, the entity was observed consuming galaxies. Its numerous eyes were themselves enormous, and merely observing the form exposed Albedo to extraordinary amounts of forbidden knowledge concerning Reality.[139] Unlike an ordinary transformation with a rigid anatomy, the Nightmare Form is fundamentally formless. Its exact shape and size can consequently vary according to Victor's will and the degree to which he allows his Eldritch nature to manifest.[137]

###### Dragon–Nightmare Hybrid
Victor can deliberately combine his True Dragon Form with his Nightmare Form. Rather than allowing his Eldritch nature to exist as a completely formless cosmic entity, he can impose his familiar draconic shape upon it and blend the properties of both forms.[137] This is best treated as a hybrid configuration rather than an entirely independent racial transformation. Victor explicitly possesses no absolute limitation requiring his Eldritch existence to maintain one particular form, and the Dragon–Nightmare state represents him controlling his formless Eldritch nature through his preferred Dragon body.[137]

##### Former and Transitional Forms
The following transformations belonged to earlier stages of Victor's evolution. Their powers and characteristics were eventually incorporated into or superseded by his evolution as the Blood Dragon Primogenitor.

###### Vampire Progenitor Form
Before becoming a Blood Dragon Primogenitor, Victor could fully access the characteristic combat form of a Vampire Progenitor. In this state, Victor's body entered an abnormal liquid-like condition capable of freely forming and deforming itself. Numerous eyes representing Souls stored within Victor could appear throughout the form, making it similar in principle to [[Vlad III Tepes|Vlad Tepes]]' own Progenitor state.[164] [[Scathach]] recognized this transformation as Victor finally obtaining complete access to his Progenitor Power. Victor could subsequently suppress the transformation and return to his standard humanoid appearance.[164] This form became obsolete as an independent transformation when Victor's Vampiric Progenitor nature completely fused with his Draconic nature, resulting in the birth of the Blood/Vampyric Dragon Primogenitor.[82]

###### Draconic Humanoid Form
The Draconic Humanoid Form was a transitional combat state Victor used while his Vampiric and Draconic characteristics were still developing toward their eventual complete fusion. During the Greek War, Victor appeared with long Dragon wings, long floating black hair, and immense Negative Energy covering his body. The appearance strongly resembled the Progenitor state he had previously used against [[Diablo]], but incorporated his newly developing Draconic characteristics.[170] This form should not be listed alongside the later Humanoid Blood Dragon Primogenitor Form as though the two are equivalent transformations. The former was an intermediate state. Victor's later evolution resulted in his Draconic and Vampyric Progenitor features completely fusing into an entirely new existence.[82] When that evolution occurred, Victor's Draconic and Vampyric characteristics ceased functioning as two separately layered forms and became the natural characteristics of his new Race.[82]

##### Former Vampire Count Forms
Before becoming a Vampire Progenitor and eventually a Blood Dragon Primogenitor, Victor possessed an abnormal relationship with the [[Vampire Count Form]]. Unlike ordinary Noble Vampires, Victor inherited powers from several Vampire Count bloodlines and consequently developed multiple Count transformations. These forms are now obsolete and their relevant characteristics were eventually absorbed into Victor's increasingly unified physiology. They are preserved here because they represent important stages of Victor's combat evolution.

###### Blood Count Form
Victor's personal Blood Count Form was fundamentally different from the transformations associated with the three Count Clans. Rather than focusing upon a single inherited element, the transformation combined Victor's fire, ice, water, lightning, and blood abilities into one chaotic state.[171] At the incomplete first level, Victor's abnormal Count Form granted approximately a threefold increase in power rather than the ordinary twofold increase expected from a Vampire Count transformation. [[Scathach]] attributed the abnormal increase to Victor possessing the powers of three Count Houses simultaneously.[171] The transformation caused Victor to grow taller, his skin to acquire a gray coloration, his eyes to become completely red, his teeth to become predatory fangs, his hands to become claws, and a large bat-like wing to manifest behind him. Pure blood moved around his body under his control.[171] Its power came with severe recoil while Victor was inexperienced. Using the form before mastering his constituent abilities damaged his Soul and previously left him comatose, causing Scathach to restrict its use.[171]

###### Snow Clan Vampire Count Form
Through [[Violet Elderblood Snow]], Victor inherited access to the fire-oriented Count transformation of [[Snow Clan]]. When Victor used the form, fire engulfed his body while his ears became pointed, his teeth sharpened, his hands transformed into claws, his feet became more monstrous, and large wings composed of fire manifested from his back.[172] Of Victor's inherited Clan transformations, the Snow Clan form was the first he awakened and consequently one of the forms with which he was initially most familiar.[172] The form focused Victor's powers on the Snow Clan's fire and associated racial characteristics rather than combining his entire power set as his personal Blood Count Form did.

###### Scarlett Clan Vampire Count Form
Through [[Ruby Elderblood Scarlett]], Victor inherited access to the ice-oriented Count transformation of [[Scarlett Clan]]. Upon transforming, Victor's body became pale white and his hair turned snow-white. Ice claws appeared upon his hands and feet, his ears became sharper, large bat-like wings emerged from his back, and white scale-like structures spread over his body to form protective armor.[173] Victor noted the extremely high output of his ice while transformed. This compatibility was particularly natural for him because ice had been the first elemental ability he had extensively trained under [[Scathach Elderblood Scarlett]].[173] The form greatly enhanced Victor's Cryokinesis and allowed him to use large-scale ice abilities while maintaining a substantially greater output than his ordinary state at the time.[173]

###### Fulger Clan Vampire Count Form
Through [[Sasha Elderblood Fulger]], Victor inherited the lightning-oriented Count transformation of [[Fulger Clan]]. Victor later demonstrated that his Count Forms were not immutable. During his battle against General Leonardo, he modified the Fulger transformation using characteristics and memories obtained from Demonic Beasts previously absorbed through the World Tree.[174] In this altered state, Victor crouched in an animalistic posture while enormous quantities of golden lightning covered his body. A lightning strike altered the transformation further, producing two golden wings, a large tail, monstrous claws, and the features of a lightning-based Demonic Beast. His head became covered by a beast-like manifestation of lightning while his ears sharpened and his mouth took on a distinctly predatory appearance.[174] The transformation heavily emphasized speed and offensive power. Victor's combat behavior also became noticeably more feral and instinctive while utilizing the altered form.[174]

##### Nature of Victor's Forms
Victor's transformations should not be interpreted as a conventional sequence in which every newer form simply provides a numerical multiplier over the previous one. Several of his transformations represent fundamental changes in Race or existence rather than conventional power-up states. His development can broadly be summarized as:
Vampire
↓
Multiple Vampire Count Forms
↓
Vampire Progenitor
↓
Vampire Progenitor Form
↓
Dragon Rider / Transitional Draconic Humanoid Form
↓
Blood/Vampyric Dragon Primogenitor
↓
[[Chaos]] Dragon God / True Dragon Form
↓
Eldritch Chaos / Nightmare Form
The final stages overlap rather than completely replacing one another. Victor remains capable of assuming a humanoid body, manifesting his True Dragon Form, releasing his formless Nightmare/Eldritch nature, or combining the latter two together.[137] Because Victor's current Eldritch existence is not intrinsically limited to a single form, the distinction between his transformations has increasingly become a matter of which aspects of his existence he chooses to manifest rather than rigid biological transformations.[137]

05 · ADDITIONAL POWERS

#### Additional Powers
Specialized abilities that do not fit cleanly into the primary groups.
In addition to the abilities inherent to his own race, Divinities, Blessings, martial arts, and other personal powers, Victor possesses a large number of additional abilities acquired through his abnormal vampire bloodline, synchronization with [[World Trees]], his Soul Marriages, his bond with [[Zaladrac Zeovnur Elderblood]], and the souls and existences he has consumed.
Because Victor can absorb the memories, experiences, traits, and powers of other beings, particularly after obtaining Predation, it is effectively impossible to enumerate every ability available to him. The abilities below therefore cover the powers that have been directly identified, demonstrated, or whose source has been explicitly established in the novel.
- Synchronization Powers
- Dragon-Rider Powers
- Vampire Bloodline Powers
- Combined Powers
- Consumed Powers
Through his soul connection and synchronization with [[Roxanne Elderblood]] and later [[Amara Elderblood]], Victor can directly access many of the functions and abilities of the World Trees residing inside his soul. His connection with them is much deeper than an ordinary blessing; the World Trees are literally connected to his soul and constantly influence, strengthen, and supply him with energy.[175][176]
- World Tree Synchronization: Victor can consciously synchronize himself with the World Trees connected to his soul, allowing him to directly draw upon their abilities and Energy. Even before consciously synchronizing, the connection passively affects and strengthens him.[175]
- Passive Physical Enhancement: Roxanne's growth causes corresponding improvements in Victor. When Roxanne reached her adult stage, Victor received an enormous improvement to his physical body and Energy even though Victor himself had not undergone a separate racial evolution.[157]
- Body Refinement: The World Trees continuously improve the quality of Victor's physical existence. This became even more apparent after Amara's addition, whose influence further refined Victor's body and increased the quality and toughness of his physical form.[177]
- Soul Refinement: Because the World Trees reside within and are directly connected to Victor's soul, their growth and energy also reinforce and refine his soul.[157][177]
- Memory Synchronization: Synchronization allows information and memories to pass between Victor and Roxanne. Roxanne could access memories buried deep within Victor while Victor could directly understand and utilize functions belonging to her.[175]
- Shared Power Access: Victor can directly use powers belonging to his synchronized World Trees rather than merely receiving passive benefits from them.[175]
- Nature Manipulation: Through Roxanne, Victor gained the ability to manipulate nature and non-sentient forms of life. Roxanne specifically explained that this included plants, rocks, the earth, and similar natural matter.[175]
- Chlorokinesis: Victor can manipulate plants and vegetation through his connection to his World Trees.[175]
- Geokinesis: Victor can manipulate earth, rocks, soil, and related natural materials through World Tree authority.[175]
- Negative Energy Manipulation: As Victor's Negative World Tree, Roxanne generates and supplies him with Negative Energy. Victor can access this Energy directly through their synchronization and soul connection.[175][176] This ability predates and should not be confused with Victor's later acquisition of the actual Divine Concept of <Negativity>, which gives him vastly greater conceptual authority over the negative side of existence.
- Negativity Absorption: Roxanne can feed upon negative emotions and corrupted beings such as Demons, and Victor receives access to this aspect of her power through synchronization.[175]
- Negative Sense: Victor can use Roxanne's perception to sense negative intentions and thoughts. This supplements the emotional perception he already possesses through other abilities such as [[Aphrodite]]'s Blessings.[175]
- Negative Emotional Energy Interaction: Victor can interact with and draw nourishment from negativity and negative emotions through Roxanne. This is an Energy-based ability and is distinct from his later conceptual ability to directly govern negative emotions through <Negativity>.[175]
- Positive Energy Manipulation: After obtaining Amara Elderblood and synchronizing with her, Victor gained direct access to the Positive Energy generated by a Positive World Tree. He can draw this Energy directly from Amara when required.[176]
- Positivity Absorption: As the positive counterpart to Roxanne's abilities, Amara can feed upon and make use of positivity, an ability Victor can access through their synchronization.
- Positive Sense: Through Amara's positive-side World Tree functions, Victor can perceive positivity and positive intentions in a manner analogous to Roxanne's perception of negativity.
- Positive Emotional Energy Interaction: Victor can interact with positive emotional Energy through Amara. This should not be confused with his later higher conceptual authorities connected to <Positivity> or <Begin>.
- Positive-Negative Balance: Roxanne and Amara constantly produce opposite forms of Energy inside Victor. Positive and Negative Energy naturally oppose one another, and when brought into equilibrium they return toward Balance. Both World Trees continuously nourish Victor while their opposing Energies coexist within his soul.[176]
- Continuous Energy Supply: Roxanne and Amara function as enormous autonomous sources of Energy inside Victor. Together with his draconic physiology, they continually generate and supply him with tremendous amounts of Energy.[176]
- Energy Recycling: As World Trees, their Energy naturally circulates and regenerates rather than functioning like the finite reserves of ordinary supernatural beings.
- [[Senjutsu]] Manipulation: Victor can directly use Roxanne's Senjutsu. Roxanne's Senjutsu appears red and contains an intense killing intent. Because she is directly connected to Victor's soul, Victor can draw upon much larger amounts of her Senjutsu than a conventional practitioner drawing [[Natural Energy]] from the environment.[175] His Senjutsu capabilities were further reinforced after Amara became connected to him.
- Soul Manipulation Enhancement: Roxanne possesses direct control over the souls stored within Victor and can manipulate, consume, move, and otherwise interact with them. Through synchronization Victor can make direct use of this World Tree soul authority in addition to his own pre-existing Soul Manipulation.[175]
- Blood Manipulation Enhancement: Roxanne is capable of controlling the blood stored inside Victor's Inner World. Victor can make use of this ability through synchronization, supplementing his own natural Hemokinesis.[175]
- Energy Conversion and Adaptation: Roxanne's presence allows Victor's internal system to process otherwise incompatible Energy. Before acquiring a Positive World Tree, compatible positive-side Energy absorbed by Victor could be adapted and converted toward the Negative Energy used by Roxanne, although fundamentally positive conceptual powers such as pure Light were exceptions. After Amara became connected to Victor, he possessed direct sources of both Positive and Negative Energy, largely removing the necessity for this former one-sided conversion process.[178][176]
After performing [[Soul Marriage]] with Zaladrac Zeovnur Elderblood, Victor became her Dragon Rider and established an extremely deep connection between their souls. Because of Victor's abnormal nature and compatibility, the bond did considerably more than simply allow communication between Rider and Dragon; Victor gradually began developing genuine draconic characteristics himself.[179]
- Dragon-Rider Soul Bond: Victor and Zaladrac possess a direct soul connection created through their contract.[179]
- Telepathy: Victor and Zaladrac can communicate mentally over their connection.
- Vision Sharing: Information from Zaladrac's senses can be transmitted to Victor, allowing him to perceive through her perspective when necessary.[179]
- Knowledge Transference: Zaladrac can transmit knowledge directly through their bond. This later allowed Victor to receive information concerning the Draconic Language and its scripts.[107]
- Draconic Trait Manifestation: Victor's bond with Zaladrac caused his body to begin developing physical characteristics associated with Dragons despite still being a Vampire Progenitor at the time.
- Scale Manifestation: Victor can manifest draconic scales over parts of his body, using them as extremely durable natural armor.[180]
- Partial Draconization: Victor can partially express draconic features such as scales, altered eyes, claws, and other characteristics before his later complete evolution into a Blood Dragon.[180][181]
- Draconic Eyesight: Victor's eyes developed characteristics comparable to those of a Dragon, further increasing his already extraordinary visual perception.[181]
- Draconic Senses: Victor received further improvements to smell, sight, hearing, and instinct through the draconic characteristics developing in his body.[181]
- Predatory Instinct: Victor developed increasingly animalistic and draconic instincts capable of instinctively recognizing other beings as prey, predators, threats, or related existences.[181]
- Danger Intuition: His instincts can warn him about dangerous beings, attacks, and hostile circumstances before conscious analysis is completed.[181]
- Draconic Organ Reinforcement: Victor's internal organs were transformed and strengthened by the Dragon-Rider bond. They did not become literal copies of Zaladrac's organs; rather, his existing organs evolved toward draconic characteristics.[181]
- Strengthened Heart: Victor's heart became considerably more powerful and acquired characteristics comparable to a Dragon's heart.[181]
- Enhanced Lungs: His lungs were strengthened toward the level required for draconic respiration and the production of Dragon Breath.[181]
- Enhanced Internal Physiology: Other internal structures were similarly altered to accommodate the draconic traits developing throughout his body.[181]
- Enhanced Energy Control: The changes caused by Zaladrac's bond increased Victor's ability to manipulate and circulate enormous quantities of Energy through his body without destroying himself.[181]
- Dragon Breath: Through the draconic characteristics of his lungs and body, Victor can release destructive Energy from his mouth in the manner of a Dragon.
- Demonic Dragon's Breath: Victor demonstrated a violet Dragon Breath possessing tremendous destructive power while fighting Demons.[182]
- Draconic Language: Zaladrac transferred knowledge of the language naturally used by Dragons to Victor through their connection.[107]
- Draconic Scripture: Victor can read, write, and utilize the written form of the Draconic Language.[107]
- Draconic Runes: Draconic writing possesses supernatural properties and can be utilized as an extremely powerful system of Runes.[107]
- Speak of Power: Dragons can combine their voice, Energy, language, and intention to impose an effect on the world through speech. Because Victor possessed draconic characteristics and received the necessary knowledge from Zaladrac, he became capable of utilizing this method.[107]
- [[Draconic Energy]] Storage: Draconic body parts such as horns and wings can function as secondary reservoirs for Energy. Victor later demonstrated this function after his draconic evolution, explaining that his wings and horns were capable of storing tremendous amounts of additional Energy.[183]
Note: Victor's later complete Blood Dragon physiology is covered under his racial powers rather than this tab. The abilities above concern powers and physical alterations that originated from or were first developed through his bond with Zaladrac.
During Victor's transformation into a Vampire, the ritual performed with Violet, Ruby, and Sasha produced an unprecedented anomaly. Instead of developing only one Noble Vampire ability, Victor inherited the bloodline powers ([[Snow Bloodline]], [[Scarlett Bloodline]] and [[Fulger Bloodline]]) of all three women, with the different powers fusing inside him without rejecting one another.[184]
- Cryokinesis: Through Ruby and the [[Scarlett Clan]] bloodline, Victor gained the ability to generate and manipulate ice.[184]
- Extreme Cold Generation: Victor can lower temperatures over enormous areas and freeze targets, structures, Energy manifestations, and increasingly supernatural phenomena as his power develops.
- Ice Construction: Victor can create weapons, buildings, thrones, barriers, and other complex structures out of ice.
- Absolute Zero: After his powers were further refined, Victor developed an extremely advanced state of Cryokinesis referred to as Absolute Zero, which he demonstrated while creating an enormous sealed ice structure during Roxanne's evolution.[185]
- Hydrokinesis: Victor inherited Ruby's ability to manipulate water alongside her Scarlett ice ability. Ruby herself inherited this secondary power from her father rather than from the principal Scarlett ice bloodline.[184]
- Underwater Breathing: Like Ruby, Victor can remain submerged without suffering the ordinary limitations associated with breathing through his control over water.[184]
- Ice-Water Conversion: Victor frequently combines Hydrokinesis and Cryokinesis, freely using available water as material for his ice techniques.
- [[Electrokinesis]]: Through Sasha and the [[Fulger Clan]] bloodline, Victor inherited the ability to generate and manipulate electricity and lightning.[184]
- Electrical Enhancement: Victor can circulate lightning through his body to increase acceleration, reactions, and combat speed.
- Plasmokinesis: Victor eventually developed his lightning to the point that he could directly generate and manipulate pure plasma. He explicitly summoned pure plasma from his hand while fighting during Roxanne's evolution.[186]
- Time Difference: Victor inherited the Fulger bloodline's enhanced temporal perception, allowing him to perceive events as though they were occurring more slowly and examine movement in considerably greater detail. The ability originates from the same Fulger line inherited by Sasha.[187]
- Red Lightning: After spending approximately seven hundred years within Hell's altered time flow and continuously developing his elemental abilities, Victor's Fulger-derived lightning underwent a Demonic mutation and became crimson-red lightning. [[Scathach]] specifically recognized it as a mutation of his Fulger ability.[164]
- [[Zeus]] Enhancement: After consuming Zeus, Victor's Red Lightning was further enhanced by the knowledge, experience, and lightning authority belonging to the former God-King.[178]
- [[Pyrokinesis]]: Through Violet and the [[Snow Clan]] bloodline, Victor gained the ability to generate and manipulate fire.[184]
- Fire Resistance: Victor's Snow bloodline makes ordinary fire unable to kill him, but the underlying resistance is not absolute: he explained that a God with a Greater Divinity of Fire could still damage an ordinary Snow Clan member. He attributed complete fire immunity in the mastered third stage of the Snow Vampire Count form specifically to Agnes; that statement alone does not establish that Victor had mastered the same stage.[172]
- Sunlight Immunity: Because the Snow Clan's affinity removes the ordinary vampiric weakness toward heat and sunlight, Victor inherited the ability to freely walk beneath the Sun despite being a Vampire.[184]
- Emotion Empowerment: The Snow Clan's power is strongly connected to emotion, particularly intense emotions such as anger. The stronger the emotional state, the more violently their power can increase.[188]
- Purifying Fire: Victor can use his flames to burn away impurities and substances such as Demonic Miasma, taking advantage of the purifying properties of sufficiently powerful fire.[185]
- Red World: An enhanced visual perception ability belonging to Vampires that Victor possessed from his early life as a Vampire. It originally transformed his visual perception into a blood-red world that allowed him to analyze supernatural beings and perceive distant targets.
- Violet World: After absorbing [[Adonis Snow]] and his Foresight, Victor's Red World underwent a major mutation. The world instead appeared violet while retaining normal colors, his vision could ignore physical obstacles, and he became capable of seeing mysterious red connections extending between individuals.[189]
Note: Victor's ordinary Hemokinesis and later Biokinesis are not listed here as powers borrowed from his wives. Blood manipulation is fundamentally one of Victor's own Vampire/Progenitor abilities and is already covered under his racial powers. Roxanne's ability to assist with blood manipulation is instead listed under Synchronization Powers.
Because Victor possesses several normally separate Noble Vampire elemental bloodlines inside the same body, he can freely use them together and create phenomena that their original users could not normally reproduce alone.[184]
- Elemental Fusion: Victor can combine Fire, Ice/Water, and Lightning in the same attack or technique. This compatibility was one of the abnormalities observed shortly after his transformation.[184]
- Thermal Manipulation: By simultaneously using Cryokinesis and Pyrokinesis, Victor can rapidly increase or decrease temperatures and create extreme thermal differences.
- Steam Generation: Victor can combine Hydrokinesis and Pyrokinesis to instantly produce massive quantities of steam.
- Electrified Water: Victor can combine Hydrokinesis and Electrokinesis to conduct lightning through large masses of water.
- Plasma Generation: By pushing his lightning and heat to sufficiently extreme levels, Victor can directly produce plasma.[186]
- Atmokinesis: Victor can reproduce several forms of atmospheric manipulation by combining his elemental abilities. Hydrokinesis provides moisture, Cryokinesis governs temperature, Pyrokinesis manipulates heat, and Electrokinesis provides electrical discharge, allowing him to influence cloud formation, rain, temperature and thunderstorms indirectly.
- Tempestakinesis: Through simultaneous use of water, temperature and lightning, Victor can produce and manipulate violent storms and thunderstorms.
- Environmental Elemental Control: Following Roxanne's maturation, Victor's elemental powers experienced a considerable qualitative improvement. His Fire, Ice, Water and Lightning became purer and more powerful even without Victor undergoing a conventional racial evolution himself.[157]
Note: These composite abilities should not be confused with Victor's later direct Weather Manipulation inherited from Zeus. The former are produced through combinations of elemental powers, whereas Zeus possessed genuine supernatural authority over weather.
Victor can consume the Souls and, at higher stages, the entire existence of other beings and acquire their memories, experience, skills, and supernatural powers. Originally, using too much of a consumed being's personality-linked power risked contaminating Victor's own personality, causing him to restrict the amount he accessed. This limitation was eventually eliminated after acquiring [[Ikor-Kar-VI]]'s Predation.[166][119]
- Memory Absorption: By consuming a soul, Victor can acquire the information, memories, experiences, and accumulated knowledge belonging to that individual. This ability has allowed him to rapidly acquire centuries or millennia of experience from beings far older than himself.
- Skill Assimilation: Combat skills, technical experience, supernatural knowledge, and techniques contained in the consumed soul can be incorporated into Victor's own knowledge.
- Ability Assimilation: Supernatural abilities belonging to consumed beings can eventually become available to Victor.
- Foresight: After consuming Adonis Snow, Victor inherited Adonis' supernatural ability to perceive events before they occur. The ability immediately manifested after Adonis's death and altered Victor's eyes.[189]
- Precognition: Victor can receive visions of events shortly before they occur.[189]
- Enhanced Cognitive Processing: Absorbing Adonis greatly accelerated Victor's thought process, allowing him to analyze considerably more information in a much shorter amount of subjective time.[189]
- Violet World Evolution: Adonis's power fused with Victor's pre-existing Red World, changing its color and significantly increasing its capabilities.[189]
- Obstacle-Piercing Vision: Victor's visual perception can ignore walls and other physical obstacles, allowing him to observe distant locations directly.[189]
- Connection-Line Perception: Victor can perceive red lines connecting individuals. The apparent thickness of these lines corresponds to the strength or importance of their connection.[189]
- Enhanced Long-Range Vision: The combination of Adonis's abilities, Victor's continued training, and the physical improvements supplied by Roxanne greatly increased the range and clarity of Victor's sight.
- Famine Manipulation: After consuming the [[Horseman of Famine]], Victor obtained access to his Famine-related power. This ability can induce overwhelming hunger and manipulate the object of a victim's hunger, such as food, water, blood, or other desired sustenance.[190]
- Death Miasma Manipulation: After consuming the [[Horseman of Death]], Victor obtained access to the Horseman's deadly Miasma and associated Death abilities.[191]
- Pestilence Manipulation: After consuming the [[Horseman of Pestilence]], Victor obtained the ability to generate and manipulate diseases, plagues, toxic conditions, and similar phenomena.[191]
- Disease Generation: Victor can reproduce diseases belonging to Pestilence's supernatural arsenal.
- Plague Manipulation: He can produce large-scale pestilential effects rather than being restricted to conventional biological illnesses.
- Horseman Power Assimilation: Victor additionally consumed a portion of War, giving him access to a portion of the Horseman's accumulated abilities and information. Unlike Famine, Death and Pestilence, War was not completely consumed at this stage, making the inheritance less complete.
- Demonic Power Assimilation: Victor consumed numerous powerful Demons during the events of [[Biblical Hell]], including beings such as [[Bael]] and [[Diablo]], adding their memories and supernatural abilities to his enormous collection.
- Holy/Angelic Light Manipulation: By consuming Diablo, whose existence had incorporated powers originating from [[Gabriel]] and Michael, Victor inherited access to portions of the angelic and Holy-Light-related arsenal contained within him.[192] Full use of powers belonging to consumed existences became considerably safer after Victor later obtained Predation.[119]
- Weather Manipulation: After completely consuming Zeus, Victor inherited Zeus's knowledge and supernatural authority over weather phenomena.[178]
- Storm Manipulation: Victor can utilize Zeus's experience with storms, thunderclouds, atmospheric phenomena, and lightning.
- Lightning Enhancement: Zeus's accumulated knowledge and power greatly improved Victor's pre-existing Red Lightning.[178]
- Time Perception and Limited Time Manipulation: After consuming [[Kronos]], Victor inherited the Titan's understanding of the flow of Time. This dramatically increased Victor's temporal perception and enhanced his Foresight.[178]
- Temporal Perception: Victor became capable of understanding and perceiving the flow of Time at a much deeper level.
- Foresight Enhancement: Kronos's knowledge and Time-related abilities combined with the Foresight Victor had previously inherited from Adonis.[178]
Note: This should not be confused with Victor's later independent development of genuine Divine or higher conceptual authority over Time. Consuming Kronos initially granted knowledge, perception, and access to his abilities rather than instantly giving Victor absolute mastery over the entire Concept of Time.
- [[Tartarus (Realm)|Tartarus]] Power Assimilation: Victor consumed approximately half of Tartarus's remaining existence during his transformation into a Vampiric Dragon Primogenitor.[146]
- Primordial Red Flames: Victor explicitly inherited Tartarus's distinctive red flames after consuming his remains.[146]
- Ghostly/Nonphysical Traits: Tartarus possessed an unusual ghost-like existence that allowed conventional physical interaction to become ineffective against him. Through assimilation Victor gained access to traits and abilities contained within Tartarus's existence, which became fully exploitable after acquiring Predation.[146][119]
- Intangibility: As an application of Tartarus's nonphysical traits, Victor can access abilities that allow conventional physical attacks to pass through or fail to properly interact with his body.
- [[Erebus]] Power Assimilation: Victor completely devoured Erebus, acquiring the Primordial God's information, memories, and powers.[193]
- Darkness Manipulation: Erebus's primary authority over primordial darkness became part of Victor's assimilated arsenal.
- [[The Mist|Mist]] Manipulation: Victor inherited Erebus's ability to generate and manipulate supernatural mist.
- Spatiokinesis: Erebus possessed powerful Space Manipulation, which became available to Victor through consumption.
- Gravity Manipulation: Victor inherited Erebus's ability to alter gravitational force, including drastically increasing gravity within an area.
Note: Many of Erebus's abilities later overlap with powers Victor independently possesses through his Divinities and higher Energy systems, but Erebus remains a separate acquisition source for them.
- Void Manipulation: Victor consumed the complete existence of [[Nocturnus]] and consequently acquired access to his powers relating to the Void.[193]
- Void Generation: Victor can reproduce the void-like Energy and phenomena utilized by Nocturnus.
- Void Attacks: Nocturnus's offensive applications of the Void became part of Victor's assimilated arsenal.
- Void Barriers: Victor possesses access to Nocturnus's defensive Void techniques.
- Void Movement: Nocturnus's methods of using the Void for movement and spatial displacement became available through assimilation.[193][119]
- Solar Manipulation: After defeating Ra and taking his Divine power, Victor obtained direct control over Solar Energy and the power associated with the Sun.[13]
- Sun Creation: Victor demonstrated the ability to produce a miniature Sun using the power taken from Ra.[13]
- Solar Energy Manipulation: Victor can generate and control the immense Energy associated with stars and Suns.
- Sun Divinity Assimilation: Ra's Divine connection to the Sun became part of Victor's own enormous collection of Divine powers.
- Star/Sun Mimicry: Victor can reproduce aspects of Ra's stellar and solar existence through the power assimilated from him.
- Adaptation: After consuming Ikor-Kar-VI, whose existence included the powers accumulated from [[Var-Kar-VI]], Victor obtained their supernatural Adaptation ability.[166]
- Reactive Evolution: The ability allows its user to progressively adapt against powers, environments, attacks, or circumstances that previously harmed them.
- Death-Based Adaptation: The Elder God's original version was particularly dangerous in combination with resurrection because death itself could provide information required for the next adaptation.[166]
Note: Victor's later development and evolution of this power should not be restricted solely to the original limitations possessed by Var or Ikor.
- Predation: One of the most important powers Victor obtained from Ikor-Kar-VI. Predation allows Victor to consume beings and properly integrate their powers into himself at a much greater level than his previous soul-consumption ability.[166]
- Power Assimilation: Predation allows the powers of consumed beings to be completely incorporated into Victor.
- Trait Assimilation: Racial and supernatural characteristics can be incorporated in addition to conventional abilities.
- Existence Consumption: Predation can consume more than ordinary physical matter or a conventional soul, allowing Victor to assimilate supernatural existences.
- Full-Power Replication: Before Predation, Victor deliberately restricted the amount of power drawn from consumed beings to prevent their personalities from affecting him. His ordinary state could safely access roughly 25%, his Blood Dragon state roughly 50%, and his God state roughly 75%. Predation removed this restriction and allowed him to reproduce the powers of consumed beings at the maximum level possessed by the original user.[119]
- Soul [[Immortality]]: Victor acquired Ikor-Kar-VI's extraordinary soul-based immortality when he consumed the Elder God.[166]
- Ultimate Resurrection: Even destruction of the physical body is insufficient to permanently kill a user protected by the corresponding soul-based resurrection abilities.
- Soul Preservation: The soul possesses extreme resistance against permanent destruction.
- Multiple-Soul/Composite Soul Traits: Ikor had accumulated and incorporated other powerful souls into his existence. By devouring Ikor, Victor also acquired the supernatural information and powers carried by those souls.[166]
- Probability Manipulation: Among the beings contained within Ikor was an extraordinarily powerful Gorilla possessing Probability Manipulation. When Victor consumed Ikor, the Gorilla's soul and powers were consumed along with him, giving Victor access to its Probability ability.[166]
- Probability Alteration: Victor can influence the probability of events and outcomes through the inherited power.
- Inherited [[Lucifer]] Powers: Lucifer Morningstar's soul had previously been absorbed into Ikor's accumulated existence. By consuming Ikor, Victor also obtained Lucifer's stored powers, knowledge, and supernatural information.[166]
- Kyuubi Kitsune Power Assimilation: After killing and consuming [[Kurama]], Victor acquired Kurama's Kitsune racial traits and supernatural powers through Predation.[115]
- Kitsune Physiology: Victor gained access to supernatural racial traits associated with Kurama's Kyuubi existence.
- Kyuubi Abilities: Kurama's supernatural fox abilities became part of Victor's assimilated arsenal.
- Ten-Tail Enhancement: Because Victor himself was already a God and his Predation could improve what he consumed, the Kyuubi traits did not remain limited to Kurama's original nine-tailed state and developed into a superior ten-tailed version.[115]
- Mass Divine Power Assimilation: Victor has consumed hundreds of Gods as well as numerous Demons, supernatural beings, and other existences. Their accumulated skills, Divinities, knowledge, techniques, and abilities form an enormous background arsenal from which Victor can draw.
- Unknown and Unlisted Abilities: Victor possesses an enormous number of passive and active abilities that have never been individually named or demonstrated. Consumption of hundreds of Gods, Demons, Elder Gods, Primordial beings, and other supernatural entities means that listing every overlapping or unnamed ability is presently impossible. Only powers whose source or function has been identified should be individually listed here rather than inventing abilities based solely on the beings he consumed.
