10 · SKILLS

#### Skills
Learned disciplines, knowledge and non-power competencies.
- Natural Playboy: Through his upbringing by Anna, Victor naturally learned how to treat women kindly and sincerely. As a result, he has a tendency to unconsciously flirt with women without actually intending to do so, a tendency that has led people close to him to repeatedly describe him as a "natural playboy".[253][254]
- [[Martial Arts]] and Weapon Mastery: Victor is an extremely accomplished martial artist whose primary foundation was taught to him by [[Scathach]]. His abnormal learning speed allowed him to rapidly learn and refine several different martial arts and weapon disciplines. Even relatively early in his training, he was capable of becoming experienced with unfamiliar weapons after only a small number of fights.[255] Later in his development, Victor could fluidly transition between several different martial arts in the middle of combat, adapting his stance and method of attack depending on the situation.[83] His overall martial arts and weapon proficiency eventually reached [[Poseidon|the Master]] level, while his proficiency with the Greatsword advanced even further; after returning to the fundamentals of everything Scathach had taught him and perfecting his foundational movements, Victor took his first steps into the Grandmaster realm with the Greatsword.[26]
- Martial Art Creation and Synthesis: Rather than merely copying martial arts, Victor is capable of studying their principles, combining compatible aspects and creating completely new styles and techniques. He demonstrated this when he combined several forms of martial arts into his own Alucard Original Style techniques.[83] This ability eventually culminated in the creation of the [[Seven Arts of the Blood Dragon Primogenitor]], a seven-level martial art formed from everything Victor had learned since his time as a mortal, including martial arts preserved within the memories of the beings he had absorbed.[245] The first levels combine several martial arts into an optimized close-combat system, while its higher stages incorporate increasingly advanced applications of Energy, Soul and bodily control.[84]
- Mental Discipline, Emotional Control and Instinct Suppression: Victor possesses exceptional learned control over his own emotions, predatory urges and racial instincts. Scathach deliberately forced him to confront and master Vampiric Bloodlust during his earliest training, eventually allowing Victor to retain rational control even when his instincts became extraordinarily intense.[213] This became substantially more important after his evolution into a Blood Dragon. Victor describes ordinary Vampire emotions as hundreds of times stronger than Human emotions, while the combined Vampiric and Draconic psychology of [[Blood Dragons]] can intensify emotions and desires to thousands of times the Human equivalent. Despite this, centuries of accumulated experience, martial discipline and psychological development allow Victor to regulate these impulses to a degree vastly beyond newly transformed Blood Dragons.[212]
- Tactician: Victor possesses considerable tactical instincts and is capable of rapidly determining the most efficient method of dealing with a problem both in and out of battle. This became much more pronounced after absorbing Adonis, whose memories and experience broadened Victor's ability to apply tactical thinking to politics, administration and large-scale planning. While temporarily managing the [[Snow Clan]], Victor identified the Clan's internal problems, formulated economic and political countermeasures and predicted how other supernatural factions would respond to his actions.[256][257]
- Schemer: Victor is capable of constructing indirect plans in which his opponents or even neutral third parties unknowingly advance his goals. Rather than directly hunting down the Yōkai responsible for offending Agnes, Victor restricted [[Nightingale]]'s trade with the Yōkai and everyone associated with them, correctly predicting that the resulting economic pressure would force the Witches and other supernatural factions to locate and surrender the responsible party for him.[256][257] He is willing to use intimidation, deception, indirect pressure and patience when they are more effective than direct confrontation.
- Economics and Financial Management: Victor has demonstrated considerable competence in economics, accounting and financial administration. After temporarily assuming control over the Snow Clan, he personally reviewed its financial documents, discovered embezzlement and excessive spending by Clan members, confiscated unnecessary assets, ordered valuable items to be auctioned, reduced wasteful expenses and intended to make the Clan financially self-sustaining before returning control of it.[256] He was also able to weaponize Nightingale's trade network itself as a form of economic pressure against the Yōkai.[257]
- Political Acumen and Statecraft: Victor is highly capable of understanding political authority, factional interests and the consequences of political decisions. While managing the Snow Clan, he understood the extent of the Clan's authority over Nightingale's domestic and international politics and used that authority to impose sanctions without unnecessarily involving the other [[Vampire Counts]].[256] The resulting political and economic pressure forced outside factions to resolve the Snow Clan's Yōkai dispute according to Victor's intentions.[257]
- Leadership and Administration: Victor is an effective leader capable of rapidly assuming control of unfamiliar organizations and restoring order. Following Adonis' death and Agnes' temporary inability to properly manage the Clan, Victor assumed responsibility for the Snow Clan, directed its members and Clan Blank, reorganized its finances and administration, dealt with internal problems and prepared the Clan to operate independently before returning authority to Agnes.[256][258] His ability to inspire loyalty and organize vastly different groups later became increasingly important as his faction expanded into a multi-racial interstellar Empire.
- Military Command and Operational Leadership: Victor possesses experience directing military organizations whose scale extends far beyond individual battlefields. As the Elderblood civilization expanded, its command structure developed beneath Victor into specialized officers, armies and eventually Imperial Legions, while Victor remained the supreme authority responsible for determining strategic objectives and preparing the Empire for large-scale warfare.[19] During preparations for conflict with the Upper Sectors, he coordinated the reorganization of the military into specialized Legions and incorporated allied forces into a larger command structure rather than attempting to personally fight every engagement.
- Delegation and Personnel Management: Victor understands that governing an advanced civilization requires specialists rather than a ruler personally performing every task. He deliberately assigns responsibilities to wives, commanders, scientists, engineers, administrators, [[World Trees]] and other specialists whose expertise exceeds his own in their respective fields. During the expansion of his Sector he rejected making every colony permanently dependent upon his personal intervention, instead favoring autonomous infrastructure and distributing responsibility through the Empire.[81] This philosophy became increasingly important during the accelerated Imperial era, when the civilization, military and allied Pantheons required large independent command structures capable of operating while Victor concentrated upon matters only he could perform.[19]
- Genius-Level Intellect: Victor is naturally highly intelligent and possesses exceptional learning, analytical and problem-solving abilities. He can understand and combine multiple martial disciplines into original systems,[83] quickly identify administrative and economic irregularities in an unfamiliar organization,[256] and understand enough runic theory, engineering and supernatural technology to design experimental devices incorporating principles that experienced Rune users find extremely difficult to comprehend.[45] His intelligence is further supplemented by his extremely large repository of acquired memories and knowledge.
- Vast Acquired Knowledge: Through the memories of the countless beings whose existences he has absorbed, Victor possesses access to an enormous amount of technical and professional knowledge that he never personally studied. While examining Natashia, Victor was able to assess her condition like an experienced doctor despite never having formally practiced medicine; it was explicitly explained that the thousands of memories inside him allowed him to access the knowledge necessary for essentially any profession contained within those memories.[54] This allows Victor to make practical use of knowledge belonging to specialists from numerous cultures, eras and professions.
- Information Retrieval and Knowledge Synthesis: Victor does not merely possess an enormous archive of absorbed memories; he can identify useful information within that archive and combine knowledge originating from otherwise unrelated individuals and disciplines. This allows him to retrieve specialist knowledge when required,[54] reproduce and modify sophisticated [[Magic]] contained within absorbed memories,[193] and synthesize principles from Magic, Runecraft, technology, Souls and Space-Time into new systems rather than being restricted to reproducing what another person already created.[45][148]
- Linguistic Knowledge: Victor possesses knowledge of multiple mundane and supernatural languages. Even before becoming capable of normally using Magic, he had studied magical books enough to remember the pronunciation and function of a Latin spell.[246] He later became capable of fluently speaking the Draconic Language and using it to directly invoke Draconic Runes.[92] His knowledge of supernatural languages continued to expand alongside his study of different forms of Runic Script and the knowledge obtained from other beings.
- Persuasion and Psychological Manipulation: Victor is highly skilled at reading personalities, determining what other people desire or fear and adapting his behavior accordingly. He frequently steers conversations and situations in directions advantageous to himself rather than simply issuing demands. His economic maneuver against the Yōkai was deliberately structured so that unrelated factions would understand his unspoken demand and voluntarily carry it out for him.[257] He is also capable of presenting statements convincingly even when those around him know that he is being misleading, with Haruna being one of the few people who has occasionally accepted his deliberately dubious explanations at face value.[259] This social skill is separate from his supernatural Vampiric Charm and other mind-affecting powers.
- Rune Script Mastery: Victor is an exceptionally accomplished Rune user and Runecrafter. His proficiency has been explicitly ranked as Master in Standard Runic Script, Grandmaster in Draconic Runic Script and Master in Eldritch Runic Script.[77] He can understand the structure and interaction of different Runic Languages and combine multiple Runic Scripts into the same construction. Victor later demonstrated that by mixing three different Runic Languages, he could construct extremely complex effects capable of permanently altering or distorting Reality while maintaining the stability of the surrounding Space-Time.[148]
- Artifact Crafting and Runic Engineering: Victor possesses considerable skill in the creation, modification and design of supernatural equipment. He personally created the special gloves given to Ophis using Souls, Draconic Runes and his control over Creation, allowing the artifact to access and amplify her otherwise dormant Yōkai heritage.[223] Victor also worked alongside [[Hephaestus]] to create extremely high-grade personalized artifacts and weapons, including [[Nero]]'s [[Black Deagles]] and the weapons distributed to the Valkyries.[260] He additionally experiments with combining Draconic Runes and modern technology, developing prototypes such as a concealed weapon capable of changing between long-range and close-combat configurations and a highly complex Runic firearm.[45]
- Forgecraft and Supernatural Material Engineering: Victor understands how to construct and manipulate extremely durable supernatural materials rather than relying entirely upon dedicated blacksmiths. While creating his own forge, he used Divine Metal together with Draconic Runic commands corresponding to restraint, recreation and projection, reconstructing the material according to his intended design.[220] His later artifact work alongside Hephaestus and his independent experiments with Divine materials, Runes and technology further developed this practical understanding of supernatural weapon and artifact construction.[260][45]
- Teaching and Mentoring: Victor is a highly capable teacher who can break down extremely complicated subjects into concepts that other people can understand and apply. He has instructed others in weapon usage,[260] personally taught the principles and different levels of his Seven Arts to members of his family,[84] and later taught advanced Runecrafting to [[Dún Scáith|Dun Scaith]], herself one of the greatest Rune specialists in existence. His explanations were clear enough that Dun Scaith was able to rapidly understand principles and Runic interactions that she previously did not know.[148]
- Master Cook: Victor is an exceptionally skilled cook. Despite being surrounded by individuals with extensive culinary experience and even supernatural beings associated with cooking, Kaguya considered Victor himself to be the best cook among them, with his food consistently receiving extremely positive reactions from his family.[261]
- Assassin Massage Technique: Victor learned an unusual massage technique from Scathach that originated from an assassin. The technique relaxes the target's entire body to an extreme degree and was originally developed as an assassination method before Scathach improved it. Victor became sufficiently proficient with the technique to leave Violet, Ruby and Sasha almost completely dazed from relaxation after using it on them.[262]
- Medical Knowledge and Diagnosis: Through the enormous quantity of professional knowledge contained within the memories of beings he has absorbed, Victor possesses practical medical knowledge despite never formally training as a physician. While examining Natashia, he was able to evaluate her condition from the perspective of an experienced doctor, The memories he carries give him the knowledge of those professions when he needs it.[54]
- Magical Theory and Spellcraft: Victor possesses extensive theoretical and practical knowledge of Magic separate from the raw supernatural ability to manipulate Magical Energy. Even before he could properly cast spells, Victor had independently studied several books on Magic closely enough to remember the structure, purpose and Latin pronunciation of a basic spell.[246] After becoming the Blood Dragon Primogenitor, his understanding developed enough for him to analyze Magic Circles, reproduce magical constructions he had observed, combine different schools of Magic and modify existing spells rather than merely copying them.[82][193]
- Reverse Engineering and Systems Analysis: Victor is exceptionally capable of examining a supernatural or technological construction, determining the principles responsible for its operation and reproducing or modifying those principles for his own purposes. He reproduced Witch Teleportation Magic and [[Clan Alioth]] Magic Circles through observation before combining both systems into a new hybrid construction,[82] and later reproduced and modified highly advanced Magic obtained through the memories within his Soul.[193] He similarly studied the Runic and Space-Time principles used within [[Alexios Alioth]]'s dimensional storage technology and developed his own applications from that understanding.[45]
- Research and Experimental Methodology: Victor frequently approaches unfamiliar supernatural systems through experimentation, observation and prototype development rather than relying solely upon existing techniques. He has experimented with combining modern technology and Draconic Runes, producing prototype weapons and devices while testing the interaction between otherwise separate systems.[45] His later Runic work follows the same methodology; Victor deliberately experiments with the interaction between Standard, Draconic and Eldritch Runic Languages and can determine how their properties can be combined into stable constructions.[148]
- Contract Expertise: Victor is highly knowledgeable in the construction and operation of supernatural contracts. As the Demon King, he became well versed in contract systems traditionally practiced by Demons and Witches and understands how to construct agreements whose conditions, penalties and restrictions are directly bound to a participant's Soul.[92] His contracts later became sufficiently sophisticated that their influence could remain attached to an existence even against extraordinarily destructive outside phenomena.[111] This expertise should be distinguished from the supernatural powers Victor uses to enforce the contracts themselves.
- Interrogation and Torture: Victor possesses practical knowledge of interrogation and torture and has personally used both to extract information from prisoners. During his retaliation against the Inquisition, Victor interrogated Julian, [[Zandriel]] and a captured Werewolf, subjecting Zandriel to severe torture while determining whether the prisoners possessed useful intelligence.[263] Much later, when Tasha questioned whether Victor intended to interrogate Fanir himself, Victor explicitly stated that he possessed the necessary skills but deliberately deferred to Tasha because she had considerably greater experience in covert politics and questioning prisoners.[219]
- Diplomacy and Negotiation: Victor is experienced in negotiating with rulers, Pantheons and foreign supernatural powers. His negotiations with [[Volk Fenrir]] concerning [[Fenrir]] were explicitly structured around equivalent exchange, with Victor refusing to provide an extraordinarily valuable service without receiving something of comparable importance in return.[264][265][266] He later negotiated directly with the [[Indian Pantheon|Hindu Pantheon]] from a position of overwhelming political superiority, defining the terms under which it could enter the [[Elderblood Empire]] rather than allowing the relationship to remain an undefined alliance.[267] Victor's diplomacy is frequently coercive and backed by military or political leverage, but he consistently understands the value of exchange, incentives, status and the interests of the opposing party.
- Imperial Governance and Institutional Design: Victor is capable of establishing political systems considerably larger than the Clan-level administration he handled earlier in his life. After consolidating Earth's major powers, he formally created the Elderblood Empire, replaced the previous planetary political structure and established Imperial identity above racial identity.[268][269] Under this structure, Vampires, [[Werewolves]], Demons, Angels, Witches and other species became Imperial citizens first, while laws and institutions were established to govern matters such as racial discrimination, treason, abuse, experimentation upon citizens and other major crimes without requiring Victor to personally intervene in every individual case.[269]
- Legal and Policy Design: As the supreme authority of the Elderblood Empire, Victor established general legal principles intended to function across numerous species, Pantheons and supernatural cultures rather than preserving the legal traditions of one Race as the universal standard. His Imperial system established common standards for citizenship, criminal conduct, racial persecution and offenses against the state while gradually transforming Victor's personal [[Will Solace|Will]] into institutions capable of enforcing Imperial law independently.[269] This complements his broader Political Acumen and Statecraft rather than relying purely upon supernatural authority.
- Grand Strategy and Civilizational Planning: Victor is capable of planning on the scale of entire civilizations and extremely long periods of development. After becoming Overlord, he recognized that his personal strength could not substitute for the scientists, soldiers, infrastructure, population, education, industry and specialists required by a mature interstellar civilization.[270] His response was to prepare the Empire for accelerated development and eventual contact with civilizations from the Upper Sectors, coordinating long-term technological, military, demographic and territorial expansion rather than focusing exclusively upon his own individual growth.[81][19]
- Logistics and Infrastructure Planning: Victor possesses considerable skill in organizing enormous territories according to practical strategic requirements. After obtaining a complete map of his Sector, he immediately converted that information into infrastructure planning by using World Trees as logistical anchors, establishing teleportation nodes and assigning worlds according to functions such as habitation, resource production, industry, agriculture, research and military defense.[81] He deliberately favored distributed infrastructure and autonomous World Tree systems rather than making every colony permanently dependent upon his personal intervention.
- Strategic Defensive Planning: Victor understands that overwhelming personal strength does not eliminate the need for layered defenses. After learning the capabilities of Upper-Sector civilizations, he began restructuring the Imperial core around redundant defenses rather than relying upon a single barrier or weapon. He considered the vulnerabilities of natural celestial bodies, the dangers created by concentrating too much Imperial infrastructure in one location and the benefits of converting the Galactic environment itself into part of the Empire's defensive architecture.[81][85]
- Risk Assessment and Contingency Planning: Victor is capable of deliberately limiting his own assets when doing so reduces strategic risk. When investigating an unknown Upper-Sector civilization, he did not expose his true body, Soul, World Trees or family connections. Instead, he constructed a restricted scouting clone without a direct metaphysical connection to himself so that an enemy capable of destroying or analyzing the clone could not trace the attack back to Victor's true existence.[127] The clone's eventual destruction by a Solar-System-erasing weapon successfully provided Victor with information regarding the foreign civilization's capabilities without placing his true existence in equivalent danger.[128]
- Strategic Resource Allocation: Victor understands that his own abilities and attention are limited resources even when his raw power is enormous. During the development of his Sector, he rejected the idea of personally sustaining every developing planet simply because he possessed the power to do so, preferring natural World Trees and autonomous systems wherever possible while reserving direct intervention for locations where it provided greater strategic value.[81] This approach allows the Elderblood Empire to expand without making every part of its infrastructure dependent upon Victor continuously maintaining it.
- Multidisciplinary Technical Knowledge: Victor's knowledge is not restricted to a single academic or supernatural field. His absorbed memories provide access to the experience of specialists from numerous professions,[54] while his own studies allow him to combine Magic, Runic Languages, Soul principles, Space-Time theory, artifact construction and technology when designing new systems.[45][148] Rather than possessing only disconnected pieces of information, Victor has repeatedly demonstrated the ability to recognize relationships between separate disciplines and apply them together toward practical problems.

11 · DEFENSES

#### Resistances & Immunities
Documented resistances, adaptations, immunities and defensive negation against supernatural abilities.
- Poison Manipulation and Toxin Manipulation Resistance: Victor possesses extremely high resistance to both mundane and supernatural poisons. During his initial transformation into a Vampire, the Vampiric venom within his body neutralized the Werewolf venom that had already entered his system.[271] His resistance increased enormously alongside his evolution; much later, Victor recovered in roughly five minutes after being poisoned by a substance potent enough to kill a Vampire Count and specifically developed to affect Vampires at the level of a Progenitor.[186]
- Extreme Pain Tolerance and Injury Functionality: Victor has been deliberately trained to remain conscious, observe his surroundings and continue fighting through catastrophic pain and bodily injury. [[Scathach]]'s early training repeatedly pushed him beyond ordinary physical limits so that regeneration would not become useless simply because pain caused him to lose concentration or stop fighting.[198] This conditioning, combined with Victor's later regeneration, Soul resilience and centuries of combat experience, allows him to remain functional through injuries that would incapacitate ordinary supernatural beings.
- Fear Manipulation, Aura Manipulation and Paralysis Inducement Resistance: Victor possesses exceptional resistance to supernatural fear, oppressive presences, killing intent and similar effects capable of forcing involuntary paralysis. Even shortly after becoming a Vampire, he resisted the overwhelming terror caused by Scathach's presence. Although his body initially froze from fear, Victor deliberately injured himself and forcibly regained control of his body despite the enormous disparity between their powers.[272] This resistance subsequently increased alongside the strength of his [[Will Solace|Will]], Soul and overall existence.
- Lightning Manipulation and Electricity Manipulation Immunity: Victor possesses extremely high resistance, eventually amounting to practical immunity, to lightning and electricity. The supernatural lightning associated with the [[Fulger Clan]] normally possesses properties harmful even to Vampires, while the characteristics of the [[Fulger Bloodline]] negate those harmful effects.[273] Following Victor's improvements to the Bloodline, its members became practically immune to lightning itself as well as the physical consequences produced by lightning-based acceleration.[274] Victor possesses the improved Bloodline directly and exists at a substantially greater level than those who inherited these protections from him.
- Fire Manipulation and Heat Manipulation Resistance: Through the characteristics inherited from the [[Snow Clan]], Victor possesses extremely high resistance to Fire and Heat Manipulation. Ordinary flames are incapable of killing members of the [[Snow Bloodline]]; however, this protection is not absolute, as sufficiently powerful Divine Authorities over Fire can overcome the Bloodline's natural resistance.[172] Victor's own resistance became considerably greater as his existence evolved beyond that of an ordinary Snow Vampire.[237]
- Light Manipulation and Solar Energy Resistance: Victor inherited the Snow Bloodline's complete immunity to sunlight, removing one of the conventional vulnerabilities possessed by Vampires from the moment of his transformation.[275] His later evolution also granted increasingly great resistance to supernatural Light and Sacred powers that would ordinarily possess an advantage against Vampires.[237] This should not be interpreted as unconditional immunity to every Divine or Conceptual application of Light regardless of its level.
- Extreme Environmental and Cosmic Hazard Resistance: Victor's developed body can survive environmental conditions that would immediately destroy conventional supernatural organisms. He has come out of a [[Black Hole]] unharmed.[123] His later Dragon body can operate freely in interplanetary and intergalactic space while simultaneously enduring the Energy, pressure and gravitational consequences produced by his own astronomical-scale existence.[28]
- Fate Manipulation, Fate-Based Precognition, Clairvoyance, Divination and Tracking Resistance: Victor is extremely difficult to perceive through supernatural abilities that obtain information by reading Fate or Destiny. The Witch Queen used Fate/Destiny, one of the Witches' greatest location and information-gathering spells, which operates by reading the Fate of its target. Despite being capable of obtaining information about an individual and determining their location, the spell completely failed to properly perceive Victor, making him appear almost like a ghost that did not exist.[276] The same interference spread to people closely tied to him, including several wives and major relatives, who became harder to trace by the same method.[276] This directly grants resistance to Fate-based Precognition, Clairvoyance, Divination and Tracking rather than necessarily establishing that every unrelated method of future sight is ineffective against him.
- Miasma Manipulation and Negative Energy Resistance: Victor can withstand environments filled with extremely dangerous concentrations of Miasma and negative supernatural Energy. His connection with Roxanne, an existence capable of consuming Negativity and using it to nourish and sustain him, allows Victor to remain functional in environments whose Miasma would ordinarily be highly toxic or lethal.[186][277] His compatibility with Negativity later increased dramatically after Negativity became one of his own fundamental Authorities.
- Disease Manipulation and Pestilence Resistance: Victor was capable of directly interacting with and wielding the semi-sentient weapons associated with the Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse. These weapons possessed supernatural properties corresponding to their owners and could automatically harm unauthorized beings attempting to wield them. Victor nevertheless handled them directly, including the weapon carrying Pestilence's supernatural Disease.[190]
- Death Energy and Death-Miasma Resistance: Victor could likewise handle the weapon associated with Death despite its Death-related Miasma and supernatural properties automatically threatening unauthorized wielders.[190] His later Divine, Dragon and [[Chaos]]-related evolutions substantially increased his ability to withstand Death-associated supernatural phenomena.
- Hell-Fire Manipulation Resistance: Victor directly handled the weapon associated with War, whose supernatural properties included Hell-Fire capable of harming unauthorized wielders.[190] This provides Victor with resistance to infernal and supernatural Fire beyond the elemental Fire resistance inherited from the Snow Bloodline.
- Time Manipulation Resistance and Time Stop Immunity: Victor possesses exceptionally powerful resistance to temporal interference. During his confrontation with [[Kronos]], the pure Negativity Energy surrounding Victor prevented Kronos' Time Manipulation from properly affecting him, allowing Victor to continue moving despite his Time having been targeted by temporal control. It was indicated that an enormously superior temporal existence would be required to overcome this protection.[178] The Judges of the Abyss and the Universal Tree later failed to stop him the same way.[59] His resistance subsequently evolved much further. Victor later remained capable of acting within territory affected by Administrator-level temporal Authority where beings without the necessary existential level should have been unable to function normally.[3] Conventional and even extremely advanced Time Stop and temporal restraint are therefore ineffective against his current existence unless backed by an Authority capable of overcoming his own.
- Curse Manipulation Resistance: Victor possesses tremendous resistance to supernatural curses because of the quality of his body, Bloodline and Soul. Victor explained that although Witches can use a person's blood as a medium to inflict curses, most such curses are ineffective against beings such as himself because of their exceptionally robust Souls and superior bodies.[278]
- Death Manipulation and Death-Curse Resistance: Victor's Curse resistance extends to supernatural effects designed to directly cause death. [[Persephone]], whose powers included a curse capable of directly killing its target, realized that her Death Curse would not work against Victor.[279] His later Divine, Soul and Chaos-related evolutions considerably strengthened this protection.
- Mind Manipulation and Mental Attack Immunity: [[Sanguis Noctis Regis]] grants Victor exceptional protection against attacks directed at the mind. [[Vlad III Tepes|Vlad Tepes]] explained that the Blood of the Night King provides immunity to mind-related damage,[153] while Victor's later evolution caused conventional mind-control techniques to become effectively useless against him.[280]
- Memory Manipulation Resistance: Victor possesses direct resistance to supernatural abilities that implant, alter or overwrite memories. When Roberta's memory-manipulation ability affected the people around her, the same power failed to influence Victor normally because of the exceptional strength of his Soul and Will.[281] His later Progenitor, Dragon, Divine and Eldritch evolutions only increased the spiritual and mental foundations responsible for this resistance.
- Illusion Manipulation Resistance: Victor possesses extremely high resistance to supernatural illusions capable of deceiving his perception or manipulating the senses. [[Loki]], despite specializing in supernatural deception, discovered that ordinary illusions and comparable mind-affecting abilities were effectively useless against Victor after the continued evolution of his Progenitor Blood.[280]
- Compulsion Manipulation, Emotion Manipulation and Subconscious Manipulation Resistance: Victor can resist supernatural effects that compel behavior, influence emotions or alter subconscious responses. Anna's increasingly powerful Authority could influence Persephone and even affect existences such as Amara and Roxanne, while Victor remained among the few individuals capable of resisting its influence.[92]
- Truth Manipulation and Truth Compulsion Resistance: Anna's Authority could compel those affected by it to speak and behave with unusual honesty, yet Victor was capable of resisting its effects.[92] This grants him resistance to supernatural Truth Compulsion as a specific application of his broader resistance to mental and subconscious interference.
- Madness Manipulation and Cognitohazard Resistance: Victor can safely perceive, communicate with and interact with Eldritch existences and information that are psychologically destructive to ordinary native beings. Eldritch language, symbols and deeper information can induce madness or severe mental collapse in incompatible observers, while Victor himself possesses the necessary Eldritch nature to comprehend and use such phenomena without suffering the same consequences.[141][140][70] This resistance applies particularly strongly to cognitohazards originating from Eldritch beings, languages and Runic information rather than establishing unconditional immunity to every imaginable information-based effect.
- [[Eldritch Energy]] Resistance: Victor naturally produces, contains and manipulates Eldritch Energy rather than suffering the uncontrolled damage or corruption that such foreign Energy can cause to ordinary native existences.[140][70] His body, Soul and deeper existence are themselves compatible with the foreign cosmological principles from which this Energy originates.
- Eldritch Corruption Resistance: Victor possesses natural resistance to the corruption produced by Eldritch Chaos and foreign cosmological influence. His own deeper existence belongs to the same general class of foreign Chaos responsible for many such distortions, meaning phenomena that catastrophically corrupt ordinary native Souls, bodies or Reality do not automatically affect him in the same manner.[138][70] This should not be interpreted as immunity to every superior Eldritch Being regardless of existential difference.
- Sacred Energy and Holy Manipulation Resistance: Victor possesses abnormal resistance to Sacred and Holy powers that would ordinarily exploit the racial weaknesses of Vampires and other dark-aligned supernatural beings. Following the continued evolution of his Bloodline and existence, ordinary applications of Sacred and [[Holy Energy]] ceased functioning as meaningful Vampire weaknesses against him.[237]
- Faith Manipulation and Faith Energy Resistance: Victor developed resistance to Faith-based supernatural attacks long before acquiring Divine status. Faith Energy used by Church combatants could harm Victor during his earlier development,[282] but his resistance increased drastically alongside his Bloodline, Dragon physiology, Divinity and overall existential evolution.
- [[Divine Energy]] Manipulation Resistance: Victor demonstrated resistance to attacks empowered by Divine Energy even before becoming a Divine Being himself.[256] His later evolution into a Dragon God, God Emperor and Chaos-related existence substantially increased the amount and quality of Divine power necessary to meaningfully affect him.
- Nature Energy Manipulation Resistance: Victor possesses resistance to supernatural attacks utilizing the Energy of Nature.[283] This resistance subsequently increased through his relationship with [[World Trees]], his evolving Divine nature and his growing interaction with fundamental aspects of Life and Creation.
- Gravity Manipulation Resistance: Victor can withstand and overcome extreme supernatural gravitational forces. During his battle against [[Erebus]], he was subjected to a gravitational field exceeding one thousand times Earth's gravity. Despite initially being restrained and damaged by the enormous pressure, Victor successfully broke free and continued fighting.[214] This represents powerful resistance rather than complete immunity.
- [[Divine Sense]], Extrasensory Perception and Information Analysis Resistance: Victor possesses means of preventing extremely powerful supernatural senses from fully examining his existence. When [[Aphrodite]] attempted to inspect Victor using her Divine Sense, Roxanne reacted from within him and prevented Aphrodite from looking deeply into Victor's internal existence, limiting the information she could obtain.[284] This early feat relied upon Roxanne, while Victor's later concealment abilities, Soul and existential evolution provide additional protection against supernatural observation.
- System Observation and Administrative Intrusion Resistance: Victor's mature Eldritch Soul possesses defensive properties powerful enough to block the System itself from penetrating his internal existence. After Moira's birth, the System attempted to observe her despite her residing within Victor's Soul, but its administrative authority could not penetrate the Soul of the Cosmic Horror Victor had become and it obtained nothing from the attempt.[28] Separately, the System judged that isolating him through its administrative authority would not cut off his influence, because he had already been selected as Negativity's successor and that influence runs through the same framework the System uses.[8] This is resistance to observation and to administrative isolation. It is not immunity to every higher authority.
- Life Detection and Life-Based Tracking Resistance: Victor can hide living beings from entities possessing Life-related Divinities capable of detecting Life itself.[285] This grants resistance to supernatural Tracking and Extrasensory Perception when those abilities locate targets through their status as living beings.
- Reality Manipulation and Reality Warping Resistance: Victor possesses powerful resistance to direct attempts to overwrite Reality around him. When Anna used Terror, an ability capable of attempting to make Victor's death become Reality, the effect failed because Victor's power and resistance exceeded the Authority being applied, producing only an image of his intended death instead.[92] Victor later explicitly described maintaining protections against enemies interfering with Reality itself.[286]
- Conceptually Anchored Reality Resistance: Victor can also construct cosmic Realities whose resistance to external alteration comes from the higher Concepts incorporated into their foundation. Norabell could effortlessly overwrite the ownership of an ordinary dimension created by Victor but failed to seize the miniature galaxy he had anchored through <Negativity>, <Begin> and Eldritch power because of its far greater existential weight.[6]
- Law Manipulation Resistance: Victor maintains explicit protections against supernatural beings capable of distorting the fundamental Laws governing Creation. When explaining his safeguards, Victor included protection from entities capable of interfering with Reality and distorting the Laws of Creation.[286] This resistance became increasingly significant as his later existence grew progressively less dependent upon the ordinary laws governing beings native to the Cosmos.
- Luck Manipulation and Probability Manipulation Resistance: Victor explicitly maintains protection against supernatural bad luck and related interference with events.[286] These defenses grant resistance to Luck Manipulation and to Probability Manipulation that operates by supernaturally forcing unfavorable circumstances or outcomes. This does not establish unconditional immunity against every conceivable form of Probability Manipulation regardless of Authority.
- Soul Manipulation Resistance: Victor possesses an extraordinarily powerful and durable Soul whose resistance increased throughout every evolution of his existence. Even before his later Chaos-related development, the strength of his Soul was sufficient to make supernatural curses and indirect interference extremely difficult.[278]
- Soul Destruction, Soul Corruption and Soul Invasion Resistance / Soul Inviolability: Following Victor's evolution into an existence associated with foreign Chaos, this protection reached an entirely different level. Azathoth described both her own Soul and Victor's Soul as inviolable because of their nature as foreign Chaos, placing them outside the normal manner in which Souls native to the Cosmos can be interfered with.[138] Conventional methods of invading, altering, corrupting or destroying a Soul are consequently extraordinarily unreliable against his current existence.
- Layered Existential Survival and Existential Destruction Resistance: Victor's continued existence is no longer dependent upon the survival of a conventional physical body alone. His body, Soul, adaptive mechanisms, internal existence and deeper Eldritch nature provide multiple overlapping layers through which he can survive forms of destruction that would constitute permanent death for ordinary beings.[121][8] Late-stage explanations of Victor's existence establish that even catastrophic damage to portions of his native structure does not necessarily erase the deeper Eldritch existence beneath them.[8] This should be treated as powerful resistance and layered survival rather than unconditional immunity to every conceivable form of existence erasure.
- Conceptual Manipulation and Authority Resistance: Victor possesses increasingly powerful resistance to supernatural Authorities and attacks that operate through fundamental Concepts rather than ordinary physical force. This resistance became particularly pronounced following his association with foreign Chaos, as Victor's later existence does not interact with the Rules of the Cosmos in exactly the same manner as native beings.[138] He can consequently continue acting under extremely high-order Authorities that would suppress beings of insufficient existential rank, including territory primarily accessible and operable by Administrators.[3] This is dependent upon conceptual hierarchy and existential level rather than representing unconditional immunity to every conceivable Concept.
- Rule Manipulation and Cosmological Law Resistance: Victor's Chaos-related nature allows aspects of his existence to operate outside restrictions that normally govern entities originating entirely within the native Cosmos. His inviolable Soul and ability to continue operating within Administrator-level territory demonstrate that ordinary cosmological Rules cannot necessarily impose themselves upon him in the same manner as they do upon native beings.[3][138] Effects whose operation depends upon their target automatically obeying those Rules therefore possess reduced effectiveness against him.
- Reality Distortion Resistance: Victor can remain functional within environments whose Reality is being distorted by Eldritch powers and can withstand foreign principles that would destabilize ordinary native existences. His own Eldritch nature allows him to interact with Reality distortions caused by other Chaos-related beings without automatically suffering the catastrophic consequences experienced by incompatible observers.[140][70] This complements, rather than replaces, his broader resistance to direct Reality Manipulation.
- Corruption Manipulation Resistance and Negation: Victor can generate specialized Anti-Corruption barriers capable of preventing corruption from affecting protected targets so long as the opposing effect does not exceed the combined defensive power behind the barrier.[110] This provides an additional active layer of protection against Corruption Manipulation beyond his personal Soul, Blood Dragon physiology and Chaos-related defenses.
- Mind Control, Charm Manipulation and Supernatural Control Negation: Victor's defensive barrier system includes Anti-Manipulation protection capable of blocking forms of supernatural control ranging from mental domination to charm-based influence comparable to Aphrodite's powers.[110] This functions in addition to Victor's own intrinsic immunity and resistance to mental manipulation.
- Spatial Manipulation, Dimensional Manipulation, Portal Creation and Teleportation Negation: Victor can create Anti-Invasion barriers that prevent interference or passage into a protected region by completely sealing potential breaches in Space.[110] This provides resistance to Spatial and Dimensional abilities when they are used to invade, teleport into, open portals toward or otherwise bypass the protected space. It does not represent universal immunity to every offensive application of Space Manipulation.
- Clairvoyance, Remote Viewing and Extrasensory Observation Negation: Victor can create Anti-Observation barriers that prevent entities outside a protected region from observing anything beyond the barrier.[110] This grants active protection against supernatural surveillance, remote viewing and comparable sensory abilities in addition to Victor's personal resistance to Divine Sense and supernatural analysis.
- Reality Manipulation Negation and Reality Anchoring: Victor's defensive system includes Anti-Reality protection through which his Authority prevents external beings from freely altering the Reality under his protection, effectively establishing Victor as the dominant Authority within that protected region.[110] This stacks with his intrinsic resistance to Reality Manipulation.[92][286]
- Soul Manipulation Negation: Victor can generate Anti-Soul barriers specifically intended to prevent hostile supernatural abilities from interacting with protected Souls.[110] This provides an additional defensive layer beyond Victor's own powerful Soul and his later Soul Inviolability.[138]
- Reactive Evolution and Adaptive Resistance: After acquiring the Adaptation possessed by beings such as Ikor, Victor gained the ability to alter his body and existence in response to phenomena capable of genuinely threatening or killing him.[166] An initially effective attack can consequently become progressively less effective as Victor develops resistance to its properties.
- Adaptive Resurrection and Resistance to Repeated Killing Methods: Victor's Adaptation interacts with his regenerative and resurrection abilities so that a phenomenon capable of successfully killing him can cause his restored existence to return with increased resistance against the same cause of death.[166] Continued adaptation can eventually progress toward effective immunity, making repeated use of the same method increasingly unreliable as a means of permanently defeating him.
- Conceptual Attack Adaptation and Conceptual Attack Immunity: Victor's Adaptation eventually developed to the point that attacks operating directly through Concepts could likewise be ignored or adapted against.[68] Conceptual effects capable of initially threatening him can consequently provoke further adaptation, while attacks whose Conceptual Authority is already below the level capable of meaningfully influencing his existence may fail outright.
- <END> Resistance: He withstands <END> through <Begin>, the principle that counters it, and through standing one step from becoming the living Concept of Negativity.[69]
- Attack Dissolution / Contact Negation: Demonstrated by the combat projection, not by a separate defensive spell. Attacks that reached it lost their form instead of being blocked. A dimensional weapon lost its shape. A chain meant to bind the Soul fell apart on contact. Energy scattered across [[Junketsu]]. Beams that could destroy stars, a domain prison, and a Throne's focused blow left one result: a crack in the gauntlet, small enough that Victor had to look for it.[22]

12Summary
Blessings are external supernatural boons granted to Victor Elderblood by Gods, spirits, World Trees and other higher Beings. Unlike Victor's inherent racial abilities or personal Divinities, a normal Blessing represents a form of borrowed Authority: the source gives the recipient access to some portion, property or manifestation of its own supernatural power, changing the recipient and allowing them to reproduce effects that would otherwise belong to the grantor.[1]
[[Aphrodite]] Elderblood used her own Blessing of Beauty to explain the principle. When [[Adonis Snow]] was Blessed by Aphrodite, he could borrow and exercise part of her Authority over Beauty, but he could not independently develop that borrowed Concept as though Beauty were naturally his own Divinity. Ordinary Blessings also remain dependent upon the source; the God who granted one can normally remove it, which is why Aphrodite warned Victor never to make borrowed power the foundation of his combat system.[1]
Victor nevertheless became an extraordinary exception in terms of the number of Blessings attached to him. The Owner of Limbo publicly revealed numerous major sources during the [[Supernatural Gathering]], including Aphrodite, Albedo Moriarty, Nyx, [[Gaia]], the Lightning Spirits, the Ancestral Spirits of Animals, [[Qliphoth]] and an incomprehensible Being strongly indicated to be [[The Universal Tree]].[2] His collection expanded drastically afterward. By Chapter 782, [[Vlad III Tepes|Vlad Tepes]] stated that Victor had been Blessed by an incredibly large number of Goddesses and that virtually every Goddess within his territory had granted him a Blessing, leaving Victor with peculiar abilities whose complete scope even Vlad did not know.[3] Chapter 843 later confirms that the Goddesses residing beneath Victor's faction continued to support him by Blessing him with their Divinities.[4]
CATALOGUE LIMIT
Scope of this page — The Blessings individually documented below do not represent Victor's complete collection. Canon directly establishes that he possesses numerous additional Blessings from Goddesses within his territory, but their individual identities and exact powers have never been fully catalogued. No speculative Blessings are listed simply because a particular Goddess belonged to Victor's faction.[3][4]

#### Nature of Blessings

##### Borrowed Authority
A Divine Blessing does not ordinarily transfer ownership of the grantor's Concept. It establishes a connection through which the recipient can exercise a portion of the source's Authority.[1]

This distinction later became particularly important for Victor because he eventually developed genuine Divinities corresponding to several powers he had previously borrowed. His later Divinities of Beauty, War, [[Rex Invictus|Home]] and Family are therefore his own conceptual Authorities, not merely evolved versions of the older Blessings supplied by other Gods.

##### Revocability
A normal Blessing can be withdrawn by the Being that granted it. [[Aphrodite]] specifically warned Victor about warriors who became excessively dependent upon borrowed Divine power only to become helpless when their patron removed it.[1]
Victor accepted the usefulness of Blessings but deliberately treated them as secondary tools. His principal development remained focused upon abilities naturally belonging to his Soul, Bloodline, Race and eventually his own Divinities.[1][5]

##### Minor and Complete Blessings
Not every Blessing transfers the same amount of Authority. After learning how Blessings worked, Victor realized that several of the mysterious Beings who had Blessed him before the [[Supernatural Gathering]] had only supplied comparatively small amounts of power. [[Aphrodite]]'s Beauty Blessing was considerably more substantial, while later examples such as Nike and [[Tyche]] are explicitly called Complete Blessings.[1][6][7]

##### Compatibility and Redundancy
Blessings can overlap with abilities Victor later obtains independently. Such overlap does not mean the external Blessing transformed into Victor's own ability.
The clearest example is [[Magic]]. Albedo originally supplied Victor with borrowed Mana, allowing him to perform Magic despite lacking a conventional Witch's Magic Core.[10] Victor's later racial evolution eventually provided independent methods of interacting with Magic, making the Blessing unnecessary as the foundation for spellcasting.
The same principle applies to Beauty, War, [[Rex Invictus|Home]] and Family. Victor ultimately developed genuine personal Divinities corresponding to these Concepts, while the original Blessings remained powers derived from other Gods.

#### Scale of Victor's Blessings

##### Early Blessings
Before the [[Supernatural Gathering]], Victor accumulated several Blessings without fully understanding that they were attached to him. The Owner of Limbo publicly exposed the most important known sources during Chapter 511.[2]
These included:
- [[Aphrodite]] Elderblood
- [[Albedo Moriarty Elderblood]]
- Nyx Elderblood
- [[Gaia]] Elderblood
- Lightning Spirits
- Ancestral Spirits of Animals
- [[Qliphoth]]
- [[The Universal Tree]] (strongly indicated through Jeanne's reaction)

##### Expansion Through Victor's Goddess Faction
Victor's collection expanded dramatically as increasingly large numbers of Goddesses joined his territory and faction.
By Chapter 782, [[Vlad III Tepes|Vlad Tepes]] explained that Victor possessed Blessings from an incredibly large number of Goddesses and stated that virtually every Goddess within Victor's territory had given him a Blessing. According to Vlad, this accumulation gave Victor numerous strange or specialized abilities whose complete scope was difficult to determine.[3]
Chapter 843 later confirms that this system remained active after Victor's faction continued expanding. Goddesses under his protection contributed to his growing strength by Blessing him with their Divinities.[4]
This establishes that Victor's true Blessing collection is much larger than the individually documented powers below.

##### Later Divine Era
Once Victor became a genuine God, the importance of ordinary Blessings changed. His own Divinities, Dragon physiology, Progenitor powers and later Eldritch abilities surpassed many of the external powers that had once been exceptionally useful.
Certain Blessings nevertheless retained enormous value because of specialized conceptual effects that Victor did not naturally possess, particularly Nike's Victory-related Causality manipulation and [[Tyche]]'s Luck.

#### Known Blessings

##### Aphrodite's Blessings
SOURCEAphrodite Elderblood
PRIMARY DOMAINSBeauty, Sexuality, Love, Perpetuation of Life, Pleasure, Happiness/Joy and War
STATUSConfirmed; several effects were later surpassed or duplicated by Victor's own Divinities
Victor's relationship with [[Aphrodite]]'s Divine power developed in two principal stages: the Beauty Blessing he inherited from [[Adonis Snow]] and the additional Blessings Aphrodite personally granted following their [[Soul Marriage]].

###### Beauty Blessing
[[Aphrodite]] originally placed her Blessing of Beauty upon [[Adonis Snow]]. When Victor consumed Adonis's Soul, he inherited Adonis's memories, experiences, supernatural abilities, [[Persephone]]'s Curse and Aphrodite's Blessing.[11]
By the [[Supernatural Gathering]], Victor possessed Aphrodite's complete Beauty Blessing.[1]
- Supernatural Beauty: Aphrodite's Blessing elevated Victor's already exceptional appearance toward the supernatural ideal represented by the Goddess of Beauty herself.[12][2]
- Attraction Inducement: Observers could experience involuntary attraction toward Victor regardless of their ordinary preferences. Even heterosexual men could momentarily become confused by the intensity of the supernatural influence surrounding his appearance.[12]
- Entrancement: Victor's appearance could capture observers' attention strongly enough that they experienced difficulty looking away.[12]
- Enhanced Charisma: The Blessing greatly amplified Victor's natural presence and Vampiric charm.
- Divine Beauty Presence: During the Supernatural Gathering, the Divine quality of Victor's appearance was strong enough for [[Zeus]] to briefly question whether Victor possessed an Authority associated with Beauty.[2]
- Beauty Regulation: Victor can consciously reduce the intensity of Aphrodite's Blessing rather than remaining permanently affected by its maximum expression. In Chapter 784, he deliberately attenuated his Beauty to approximately the standards of an ordinary Noble Vampire so that his presence would stop attracting excessive attention.[13]
- Attraction Suppression: By reducing the Blessing, Victor can suppress the involuntary attention normally generated by his Divine-level appearance.[13]
Victor eventually awakened and fully mastered his own Divinity of Beauty. His later personal Concept should therefore be distinguished from Aphrodite's external Blessing.

###### Soul Marriage Blessings
Following Victor and [[Aphrodite]]'s [[Soul Marriage]], Aphrodite willingly gave Victor additional Blessings corresponding to Sexuality, Love, Perpetuation of Life, Pleasure, Joy and War.[5]
- Enhanced Sexuality: Aphrodite described the Sexuality Blessing as making Victor an exceptionally capable sexual partner and strengthening the sexual aspect of his existence.[5]
- Pleasure Manipulation: Victor can more easily generate and influence different forms of pleasure through Aphrodite's Authority.[5]
- Gentle Pleasure Inducement: The Blessing can create ordinary pleasurable sensations.
- Lustful Pleasure Inducement: Aphrodite explicitly associates the Blessing with sexual and lustful forms of pleasure.
- Sadistic Pleasure Inducement: Pleasure can also be manipulated through violent or sadistic situations.[5]
- Pain-to-Pleasure Conversion: Aphrodite explained that during torture the Authority could alter the victim's experience so that sensations normally interpreted as pain instead produced pleasure.[5]
- Perpetuation of Life: Victor received limited access to Aphrodite's Life-related Authority.[5]
- Life Perception: Victor can sense Life more clearly through the Blessing.
- Limited Life Manipulation: Aphrodite explained that sufficient practice could allow Victor to manipulate Life to a limited degree.[5]
- Anti-Hell Affinity: Aphrodite noted that Life-related Authority was particularly effective against Beings associated with Hell because of the opposing nature of those forces.[5]
- Happiness / Joy Perception: The Blessing allows Victor to more easily recognize what gives another Being happiness or satisfaction.[5]
- Empathy: Victor can more readily perceive and understand emotional states through Aphrodite's Happiness-related Authority.[5]
- War Intuition: Aphrodite's minor War Authority provides Victor with instinctive conceptual understanding of warfare.[5]
- War Initiation Knowledge: Instinctive insight into conditions capable of beginning a War.
- War Prolongation Knowledge: Instinctive insight into ways a War can be sustained or prolonged.
- War Termination Knowledge: Instinctive insight into methods through which a War may be concluded.
- This does not automatically provide all practical military, political or strategic information necessary to successfully carry out those outcomes.[5]
- Love Authority: Aphrodite explicitly granted Victor a Blessing associated with Love.[5] No separate detailed application was explained at the time, so the Blessing should not be expanded into unrestricted Love Manipulation without additional evidence.
LATER OVERLAPLater overlap: Victor eventually developed genuine Divinities of Beauty and War, while BEGIN and other later powers gave him vastly greater authority over Life-related phenomena. These later Concepts belong to Victor himself rather than Aphrodite.

##### Albedo Moriarty's Blessing
SOURCEAlbedo Moriarty Elderblood
PRIMARY FUNCTIONBorrowed Mana / [[Magic]]
STATUSConfirmed; later functionally redundant
Albedo Moriarty secretly Blessed Victor before the [[Supernatural Gathering]]. The Owner of Limbo publicly identified Victor as both Blessed and favored by the [[Chaos]] Witch, forcing Victor to investigate the strange magical ability he had begun displaying.[2]
[[Aphrodite]] later judged Albedo considerably less dangerous than ancient Primordial Goddesses such as [[Gaia]] and Nyx. She believed Albedo's primary motivation was likely curiosity toward Victor's abnormal existence and therefore allowed the Blessing to remain.[5]
- Mana Access: Albedo's Blessing supplied Victor with Mana despite his lack of a conventional Witch's Magic Core.[10]
- Magic: The borrowed Mana allowed Victor to perform Magic despite not naturally possessing the biological structure ordinarily used by Witches.[14][10]
- Spell Casting: Victor successfully learned simple spells including <Lumos>, <Silence> and <Clean>.[14][10]
- Mana Capacity Growth: Victor's initially tiny Mana reserve slowly increased as he repeatedly exhausted it through practice.[5]
- Intuitive Magical Aptitude: Because the Mana directly belonged to Albedo, an extremely experienced former Witch, Victor found working with it more intuitive than someone learning Magic entirely from nothing.
- Support Magic: Because the amount of borrowed Mana was initially tiny compared with Victor's enormous physical and elemental abilities, he deliberately prioritized convenient and supportive spells instead of offensive Magic.[5]
The Mana Victor used through this Blessing was explicitly described as Albedo's power rather than Victor's own.[10]
After Victor's later racial evolution supplied him with independent methods of manipulating Magic, the original practical necessity of Albedo's Blessing dramatically decreased.

##### Blessing of the Lightning Spirits
SOURCELightning Spirits
CONFIRMED EFFECTUnknown
STATUSConfirmed
The Owner of Limbo revealed during the [[Supernatural Gathering]] that Victor was both Blessed and loved by the Lightning Spirits.[2]
The precise circumstances under which the Spirits chose Victor and the actual abilities granted by their Blessing have never been explained.
Victor already possessed extremely powerful Lightning manipulation through the [[Fulger Bloodline]] and his connection with [[Sasha Elderblood Fulger]], meaning his ordinary [[Electrokinesis]] cannot safely be attributed to the Lightning Spirits without explicit evidence.
No additional independent Lightning power should therefore be assigned to this Blessing until its effects are directly established.

##### Blessing of the Ancestral Spirits of Animals
SOURCEAncestral Spirits of Animals
CONFIRMED EFFECTUnspecified
POSSIBLE ASSOCIATIONAnimal Communication
STATUSConfirmed
Victor was also revealed to possess the Blessing of the Ancestral Spirits of Animals.[2]
The actual power bestowed by those spirits has never been directly explained.
- Animal Communication / Zoolingualism (Possible association): Victor demonstrates an unusual ability to naturally understand and communicate with animals and supernatural beasts.
This ability has traditionally been associated with the Ancestral Animal Spirits' Blessing, but the novel has not explicitly stated that every example of Victor's animal communication originates solely from it. Victor later develops several independent Nature, Progenitor and Dragon abilities that can also influence or communicate with living creatures.
The full scope of the Ancestral Spirits' favor therefore remains unknown.

##### Qliphoth's Blessing
SOURCEQliphoth
CONFIRMED EFFECTUnknown
STATUSConfirmed
The Owner of Limbo publicly identified Victor as both Blessed and loved by [[Qliphoth]], the Negative World Tree.[2]
No unique power has been unambiguously identified as the direct effect of this Blessing.
Victor later develops enormously greater relationships with [[World Trees]] through [[Roxanne Elderblood]], gains access to Natural Negative Energy, becomes a God possessing Negativity and establishes connections with numerous World Trees. These later powers should not be retroactively credited to Qliphoth's original unexplained Blessing.

##### The Universal Tree's Blessing
SOURCEThe Universal Tree
PRIMARY EFFECTSoul restoration and repair
STATUSConfirmed; continuing independent effects unknown
Victor encountered [[The Universal Tree]] while restoring the lost memories and identity of [[Jeanne Elderblood]]. Victor reminded Jeanne of her forgotten past and reunited her with the ancient Being she regarded as her brother. In gratitude, the Universal Tree directly intervened upon Victor's damaged Soul.[9]
- Soul Restoration: The Universal Tree repaired damage Victor had accumulated through repeated dangerous use of Soul-related abilities.[9]
- Soul Stabilization: Victor's Soul was returned to a healthier and more stable condition after repeatedly being strained by powers he had not completely mastered.[9]
- Soul Empowerment: The restoration did more than simply close existing damage; Victor emerged with a healthier spiritual foundation, although the precise permanent increase was never numerically defined.[9]
The Owner of Limbo later publicly identified Victor as Blessed by an entity whose true identity could not be casually spoken. Jeanne's reaction strongly establishes that the Being being referenced was her brother, the Universal Tree.[2]
The event should primarily be treated as a high-level Soul restoration and strengthening intervention. It did not grant Victor unrestricted use of the Universal Tree's complete Life, Reincarnation or World Tree Authorities.

##### Nike's Complete Blessing
SOURCENike
TYPEComplete Blessing
PRIMARY AUTHORITYVictory
STATUSConfirmed
After Nike and several displaced Greek Goddesses entered Victor's protection, [[Aphrodite]] maneuvered circumstances so that the Goddess of Victory would Bless him. Nike agreed because Victor had become the principal pillar protecting their new faction; if he fell, the Goddesses depending upon his protection would also be placed in danger.[6]
Nike explicitly called what she gave Victor her Complete Blessing.[6]
- Confidence Enhancement: Victor immediately noticed his already immense confidence becoming stronger after receiving the Blessing.[6]
- Courage Enhancement: Nike's Blessing reinforces Victor's inherent Courage.[6]
- Determination Enhancement: Victor's Determination is strengthened by Nike's Divine influence.[6]
- Willpower Enhancement: By strengthening Courage, Confidence and Determination simultaneously, Nike indirectly reinforces Victor's already extraordinary Willpower.
- Limited Causality Manipulation: Under certain circumstances, Nike's Blessing can alter the development of an otherwise inevitable defeat and transform it into a more favorable result. [[Sasha Elderblood Fulger]] identified this as Causality Manipulation, and Nike confirmed that the interpretation was correct on a limited scale.[6]
- Defeat Mitigation: The Blessing can prevent an unfavorable situation from necessarily reaching its worst possible outcome.
- Escape Inducement: Nike specifically used successful escape as an example of a favorable result that can replace an otherwise inevitable defeat.[6]
- Victory Inducement (Conditional): Under sufficiently favorable circumstances, the Blessing can cause an outcome to develop into a Victory instead of a loss.[6]
The Blessing does not transfer Nike's entire personal Divinity of Victory. Nike explicitly explained that her own full Divine Authority cannot simply be handed to Victor through a Blessing.[6]
Nike's powers are also not conceptually absolute. Extremely powerful or higher-order Concepts may interfere with Victory rather than automatically being overridden by it.
IMPORTANTImportant distinction: Nike's Complete Blessing does not make Victor incapable of losing. It gives him a limited conceptual mechanism capable of turning some otherwise disastrous outcomes into more favorable ones.

##### Ares' Blessing
SOURCEAres
PRIMARY AUTHORITYWar-related perception
STATUSConfirmed
Victor is later explicitly recognized as Blessed by [[Ares]], the Greek God of War.[15] The original bestowal and the full scope of the Blessing have not been extensively shown.
- War Detection: Victor can sense the approach of War or major armed conflict from a considerable distance through Ares' Blessing.[15]
- Enhanced War Sense: The Blessing gives Victor additional instinctive sensitivity toward environments or events developing into War.
The Blessing should not be interpreted as granting Victor the entirety of Ares' War Divinity.
It is also distinct from [[Aphrodite]]'s earlier minor War Blessing. Aphrodite's Blessing provides conceptual intuition regarding the beginning, continuation and ending of War, whereas the directly demonstrated effect of Ares' Blessing is heightened perception of War's approach.[5][15]
Victor later possesses his own fully mastered Divinity of War.

##### Tyche's Complete Blessing
SOURCETyche
TYPEComplete Blessing
PRIMARY AUTHORITYLuck
STATUSConfirmed
Victor placed exceptional strategic value upon [[Tyche]], the Goddess of Luck. He did not possess her Blessing immediately after the Greek Goddesses entered his faction; during Nike's Blessing in Chapter 630, [[Aphrodite]] was still privately considering convincing Tyche to Bless Victor in the future.[6]
Victor subsequently invested heavily in Tyche's development. By Chapter 1007, he explicitly praised his earlier decision to invest in the Goddess of Luck and obtain her Blessing, believing that the resulting Luck had contributed to several extraordinarily valuable opportunities.[16]
Chapter 1125 later confirms that Victor's continued support eventually resulted in Tyche becoming completely loyal to him and granting him her Complete Blessing.[7]
- Supernatural Luck: Tyche's Blessing surrounds Victor with abnormal Luck capable of making circumstances develop unusually favorably.[16]
- Probability Manipulation: Victor determined that Luck functions primarily through manipulation of probabilities, increasing the chance that useful or favorable possibilities will occur.[16]
- Limited Reality Distortion: Victor also describes Luck as producing a degree of small-scale Reality Distortion, subtly changing circumstances so favorable possibilities align around him.[16]
- Opportunity Inducement: Valuable encounters and opportunities can occur with abnormal frequency around Victor because of Tyche's influence.[16]
- Favorable Circumstance Generation: Possibilities that already exist can become disproportionately likely to develop in Victor's favor.
- Passive Probability Favoring: Luck frequently functions without Victor consciously choosing an outcome, influencing events around him automatically.
Victor believed several of his most important opportunities to observe powerful entities and broaden his understanding of Creation may have occurred partially because of Tyche's Blessing.[16] However, even Victor admitted that distinguishing supernatural Luck from naturally occurring coincidence was extremely difficult.
LIMITLuck is not unrestricted probability control. Victor cannot simply consciously choose any impossible result and force Reality to produce it. The Blessing operates through Tyche's Concept and the possibilities available to the situation.

##### Hestia's Blessings
Victor benefits from two distinct forms of Divine favor associated with [[Hestia]] Elderblood: the famous family-wide Blessing established in Chapter 585 and a later personal Blessing directly associated with Victor.

###### Blessing of Home and Family
SOURCEHestia Elderblood
RECIPIENTVictor's family as a collective
PRIMARY AUTHORITIESHome and Family
STATUSActive
Shortly after [[Aphrodite]]'s [[Soul Marriage]] with Victor, she approached [[Hestia]] and requested protection for her new family. After witnessing Aphrodite's genuine emotional development and hearing about her relationship with Victor, Hestia agreed. Rather than grant a conventional Blessing to a single person, however, she placed her Authority over Victor's entire family.[8]
At the time, Aphrodite asked whether Victor required a separate personal Blessing. Hestia explicitly answered that doing so was unnecessary because the much broader Blessing already included him.[8]
- Family Blessing: Hestia's Authority is attached to Victor's recognized main family rather than being individually applied to every member.[8]
- Automatic Blessing Bestowal: Individuals who genuinely become members of Victor's family after the original bestowal can automatically fall beneath its protection.[8]
- Supernatural Comfort: Family members can experience the supernatural peace and comfort associated with [[Rex Invictus|Home]] even while physically distant from their ordinary residence.[8]
- Peace Inducement: Hestia's Authority promotes a supernatural feeling of peace and stability within the united family.[8]
- Emotional Security: The Home aspect of the Blessing reinforces feelings of belonging, safety and comfort.
- Negative Effect Resistance: The Blessing protects family members against hostile supernatural influences and can reduce or eliminate malicious effects under the proper conditions.[8]
- Family Protection: Hestia's power functions as a defensive Divine Authority surrounding Victor's family.
- Unity-Based Empowerment: The effectiveness of the Blessing increases with the genuine closeness and unity of the family.[8]
- Family-Based Scaling: A fragmented family weakens the conditions favoring Hestia's Authority, whereas strong bonds increase its effectiveness.[8]
The Blessing is therefore better understood as a living Divine protection attached to Victor's family structure than a personal passive ability belonging exclusively to Victor.

The Chapter 585 family Blessing should not be confused with Victor's later personal relationship with [[Hestia]]'s Divine power.
By Chapter 858, Victor is separately identified as possessing an extra Blessing from Hestia beyond the Blessing surrounding his family.[17]

#### Collective and Unnamed Blessings

##### Blessings of Victor's Goddesses
One of the largest gaps in simple lists of Victor's Blessings is that the individually named sources represent only a fraction of the actual total.
By Chapter 782, [[Vlad III Tepes|Vlad Tepes]] explicitly described Victor as possessing Blessings from an incredibly large number of Goddesses and stated that virtually every Goddess inside Victor's territory had Blessed him.[3]
According to Vlad, this massive collection of external Divine favor resulted in Victor possessing numerous peculiar abilities whose complete range was difficult to know.[3]
Chapter 843 further establishes that this arrangement remained active after Victor's faction grew. Goddesses who lived within his territory and benefited from his protection continued contributing to his faction by Blessing him with their Divinities.[4]
CATALOGUE NOTEUnknown does not mean nonexistent. Canon directly confirms that Victor possesses many more Goddess Blessings than the ones individually named on this page. What remains unknown is the individual identity and exact power of those Blessings. No speculative entries should be created simply because a particular Goddess lived within Victor's territory.

##### Peculiar Abilities
Vlad directly connected Victor's enormous number of Goddess Blessings with his possession of numerous unusual or peculiar abilities.[3]
However, an unexplained Victor ability should not automatically be classified as the result of an unnamed Blessing. By this period Victor simultaneously possessed:
- multiple Vampire Bloodline abilities;
- Progenitor powers;
- Demon-related abilities;
- World Tree powers;
- [[Magic]];
- Runes;
- Dragon abilities;
- multiple Souls and supernatural transformations;
- and numerous other independent systems.
Only abilities explicitly identified as the product of a Blessing should therefore be placed in this section.
↑ Return to Blessing Codex
