#### Known Blessing Interactions

##### Blessing Suppression
Victor can consciously regulate at least some Blessings rather than being permanently forced to experience their maximum effect. [[Aphrodite]]'s Beauty Blessing provides the clearest example, with Victor deliberately lowering its influence in Chapter 784.[13]
This establishes:
- Blessing Suppression: Victor can suppress at least some externally granted effects.
- Blessing Output Regulation: He can reduce the intensity of a Blessing without necessarily removing the Blessing itself.
- Passive Effect Control: Supernatural effects that would ordinarily remain passively active can be restrained through deliberate control.
The feat is directly confirmed for Aphrodite's Beauty Blessing. It should not automatically be assumed that Victor can suppress or modify every Blessing he possesses in exactly the same manner.

##### Blessing Removal
A Blessing can be removed when the connection is identified and appropriate Divine power is available. [[Aphrodite]] removed the original Blessings of [[Gaia]] and Nyx with Victor's permission.[5]
This demonstrates that Blessings are not necessarily permanent additions to a recipient's existence.

##### Multiple Blessing Stacking
Victor can simultaneously possess Blessings from enormous numbers of unrelated Divine sources. By Chapter 782, virtually every Goddess within his territory had reportedly Blessed him.[3]
The novel does not establish a conventional numerical limit on how many Blessings one individual can possess. Victor's abnormal Soul and increasingly powerful physiology appear capable of supporting far more external Authorities than would normally be expected.
↑ Return to Blessing Codex

#### Notes
- A Blessing represents borrowed supernatural Authority and should not automatically be treated as equivalent to Victor personally owning the grantor's complete Divinity.[1]
- Ordinary Blessings can normally be withdrawn by their source. Victor was aware of this weakness and deliberately refused to build his principal combat style around borrowed powers.[1][5]
- Victor's Blessing collection is significantly larger than the individually identified entries on this page. By Chapter 782, virtually every Goddess within his territory had reportedly Blessed him.[3]
- Chapter 843 further confirms that Goddesses continued supplying Victor with their Divinities through Blessings while participating in his faction.[4]
- The exact individual powers of these unnamed Blessings remain unknown and should not be fabricated.
- [[Aphrodite]]'s Beauty Blessing can be voluntarily suppressed. Victor demonstrated this in Chapter 784 by reducing his Beauty to approximately ordinary Noble Vampire standards.[13]
- Aphrodite's War Blessing and [[Ares]]' Blessing are separate. Aphrodite's supplies conceptual intuition regarding the development of War, while Ares' known effect centers upon sensing approaching War.[5][15]
- Nike's Complete Blessing does not give Victor Nike's entire Divinity of Victory. Its demonstrated Causality Manipulation functions on a limited scale.[6]
- [[Tyche]]'s Blessing and Nike's Blessing should not be merged. Nike alters unfavorable outcomes toward Victory, while Tyche manipulates Luck and probability.[6][16]
- Aphrodite was still considering obtaining Tyche's Blessing for Victor during Chapter 630, establishing that he did not possess it from the beginning of the Greek Goddesses' stay within his faction.[6]
- [[Hestia]]'s Chapter 585 Blessing belongs to Victor's family as a whole. It should not be described as an ordinary personal Blessing given only to Victor.[8]
- Victor later possesses a separate personal Blessing from Hestia, confirmed by Chapter 858.[17]
- The exact powers unique to Hestia's later personal Blessing remain unknown.
- Victor's original Blessings from [[Gaia]] and Nyx were deliberately removed after Aphrodite warned him about their potential influence.[5]
- Gaia and Nyx later develop different relationships with Victor, but this does not automatically establish that the exact Blessings removed in Chapter 550 returned.
- Albedo's borrowed Mana eventually became unnecessary because Victor developed independent access to [[Magic]].
- Victor's later Divinities of Beauty, War, [[Rex Invictus|Home]] and Family are personal Concepts belonging to Victor and should be documented primarily on Victor Elderblood/Divine concept, even though earlier Blessings provided similar effects.
- [[The Universal Tree]]'s confirmed intervention primarily repaired, restored and stabilized Victor's Soul. It did not explicitly grant unrestricted Universal Tree Authority over Life or Reincarnation.[9]
- Animal Communication has traditionally been associated with the Ancestral Spirits of Animals, but the novel has not directly isolated all of Victor's Zoolingualism as a product of that Blessing.
- Victor can regulate at least some externally supplied powers rather than being forced to maintain them at maximum output, as demonstrated with Aphrodite's Beauty Blessing.[13]

The Lykos branch continues beyond the named grandchildren above. Johnny is already the father of young children by the late Imperial era, and Maya possesses additional descendants whose exact identities or generation are not fully isolated in the current text.[2] Those later generations are not promoted into the step-grandchild table. Rena is likewise described as originating from the Lykos lineage and is likely a descendant of Maya, but her exact generational position is not established strongly enough to place her in a numbered step-grandchild row.[60]
Nyx's descendant line extends beyond Morpheus, and Hypnos is stated to possess an enormous number of children. Only the descendant whose individual parentage is directly isolated in the novel is numbered here; the registry does not import additional names solely from external mythology.

The Elderblood second generation has begun producing its own supernatural descendants and creations. These Beings are not automatically Victor's biological grandchildren and are not added to his direct-child count. They are indexed here when the novel explicitly places their creation beneath Victor's daughters and the relationship is relevant to the expanding Elderblood / Great [[Chaos]] hierarchy.

Great Old One; progenitor of the Fire Vampires
The first creation of Victor's daughters; formed through their combined influences together with Eldritch/Leviathan material and one of Victor's scales. Cthugha is a later-generation Elderblood creation, not another direct son of Victor.
Chapter 1188[61]
Cthugha marks the point at which Victor's daughters cease being merely the second generation of an expanding supernatural dynasty and begin creating a generation beneath themselves. Their experiment combined the influence of two [[Outer Gods]], hybrid Eldritch-Leviathan organisms, the individual contributions of several sisters and the Draconic power retained within one of Victor's scales. The resulting Being possessed genuine Divinity, so Victor classified him as a Great Old One rather than a lesser Servant of the Outer Gods.[61]
Within the Great Chaos hierarchy, Victor and [[Azathoth Elderblood]] stand at the summit as Creators; true Outer Gods/Eldritch Gods occupy the level beneath them; Divine Beings created by Victor or his daughters are classified as Great Old Ones; and lesser non-Divine creations are Servants of the Outer Gods. Cthugha therefore belongs beneath the daughters who created him without becoming one of Victor's direct children. Victor nevertheless personally welcomed him into the Great Chaos and assigned him a role after calling him the daughters' first creation.[61]

#### Family & Indexing Notes

##### Indexing Rules
Current Registry RulesThe page follows the corrected/current chapter text rather than preserving superseded names as separate children.
- Numbering is strictly organizational and does not establish birth order, seniority or comparative age.
- The named-daughter registry contains only daughters possessing a current canonical personal name.
- Generic labels such as "[[Mizuki's Daughter]]" remain outside the named registry until the novel supplies a name.
- Once a previously unnamed child is securely identified, the placeholder is removed rather than retained as an additional child.
- [[Nero Elderblood]], [[Ophis Tepes Elderblood]] and [[Eve Elderblood]] remain in the daughter registry because Victor explicitly established father-daughter relationships with them even though they were not originally his biological children.
- [[Metis]] Elderblood remains indexed because Victor reconstructed and accepted her as a daughter before their relationship later changed.
- [[Akasha Elderblood]] and [[Melida Charlotte Elderblood]] are included because the story explicitly recognizes them as daughters. Victor creating an unrelated race, servant, artifact or lifeform does not automatically create a child relationship.
- [[Abhoth]] is included among Victor's sons because his existence was jointly produced from Victor and Azathoth's power and is treated as part of their direct Eldritch lineage.[45]
- A Being created by Victor's children is not automatically promoted into Victor's direct-child registry. [[Cthugha]] is therefore indexed as a Created Descendant / Great Old One because he is explicitly the first creation of Victor's daughters.[61]
- Current chapter names and parentage are used directly. Superseded draft names are not counted as additional people.

##### Reproduction and the One-Child Policy
The Elderblood family's usual one-child pattern is deliberate rather than biological. Victor and his wives are physically capable of producing twins or triplets. Multiple True Dragon children would place a substantially greater burden upon the mother, but the family is not prevented from doing so by infertility or physical weakness. They generally chose one child each because the rapid expansion of the True Dragon population had already attracted attention from the Primordial Beings.[62]
At that point, only approximately forty to fifty [[True Dragons]] existed throughout the entire Sector despite the size of Victor's family.[62] Victor could theoretically expand the Race much more aggressively, but his Blood and True Dragon lineage had become symbols of the Imperial Family itself rather than powers he intended to distribute without restriction. The one-child policy should therefore be understood as a deliberate family and cosmic-balance decision rather than an absolute law of Victor's reproduction.

##### Ariella and Helvarya's Conceptual Gestation
The pregnancies of [[Ariel Elderblood]] and [[Hela Elderblood]] were initially interpreted as twin pregnancies because two Soul-like presences could be detected within each mother. As gestation progressed, the two presences merged and the power of the remaining daughter increased. The additional presence was ultimately revealed to be a fundamental Concept preparing a compatible host rather than another living child.[40]

The additional presence within Hela was END itself preparing Helvarya as its host.[40] Neither pregnancy therefore produced an unidentified missing twin. Ariella is Ariel's daughter from that pregnancy, while Helvarya is Hela's daughter from hers.

##### Shared Traits of the Imperial Daughters
The Elderblood Second GenerationTraits broadly shared by Victor's biological daughters, with individual strength and expression varying between them.
- True Dragon heritage: Victor's biological daughters belong to the extraordinarily rare True Dragon population and inherit a Draconic foundation from their father.[62]
- Violet Dragon Eyes: Victor's daughters inherit a perceptual ability connected to his Eyes. Some possess an extraordinarily strong version from birth while others begin with weaker forms, but all can develop the ability further through training.[2]
- Truth Perception: Their Eyes can perceive aspects of Reality ordinarily hidden from conventional senses. Advanced daughters such as [[Norabell Elderblood]] can perceive increasingly fundamental structures and what Victor describes as the "source code of Reality".[3]
- Maternal inheritance: Each daughter's individual nature is heavily shaped by her mother. Examples include Fulger Lightning, Space-Time Authority, Heavenly Virtues, Destruction, Darkness, Luck and other unique lineages or Concepts.
- Eldritch heritage: Victor's increasingly Eldritch nature can be transmitted into his descendants. By the later Imperial era, his daughters are repeatedly described as possessing Eldritch characteristics to varying degrees.[3][4]
- Primordial potential: Many of Victor's biological daughters possess extraordinary potential to develop toward Primordial-class states, although the exact route, Concept and degree of development differ between individuals.[38]
- Exceptional innate power: The principal danger of the younger generation is often not lack of strength but insufficient control. Even newborn daughters can possess enough passive power to catastrophically affect their surroundings, which is why self-control and [[Scathach]]'s training are treated as mandatory rather than optional.[1][38]
- Family loyalty: The daughters are raised under strict rules preventing ordinary sibling jealousy or competition from becoming genuine hatred. Duels and rivalry are permitted when mutually accepted, but the family is expected to protect itself above internal disputes.[1]

##### Stheno and Euryale
[[Stheno Elderblood]] and [[Euryale Elderblood]] strongly resemble one another and are described as appearing almost like twins, but they are not biological twins. [[Stheno]] is the daughter of Victor and [[Roberta Elderblood]], while [[Euryale]] is the daughter of Victor and [[Medusa]] Elderblood.[37] Their unusual resemblance is connected to the extraordinarily close supernatural history between Roberta and Medusa rather than a shared pregnancy.

#### Volume 1: The Awakening
Chapters 1–31

##### Awakening, Violet Snow and the Rules of Vampirism
Chapters 1–7
Victor's entrance into the supernatural world began when he awakened in his bedroom with fragmented memories and immediately discovered that the body he had lived with for his entire life had fundamentally changed. The chronic weakness caused by his rare RH-null blood and anemia was gone. His formerly frail body had become healthy, muscular and considerably stronger, to the point that an ordinary movement was enough for him to damage his bed without intending to. Looking in the mirror, he saw himself taller (from his previous 175 cm to approximately 180 cm), with a well-defined muscular body including six-pack abs and muscular arms, incredibly pale skin as if missing most of the blood in his body (like a dead creature from anemia but at another level), a more defined face, and black hair and blue eyes that had gained more shine. His senses had undergone an equally extreme transformation. Victor could hear activity throughout and beyond his house, distinguish distant smells and enter a peculiar state of perception in which his surroundings became a red world stripped of ordinary visual obstructions and living beings could be located through the blood moving inside them. When he perceived his mother through a wall, however, the sight of her blood immediately provoked an unfamiliar predatory hunger. Victor suppressed the impulse and began suspecting that he had somehow become a vampire. Sunlight failed to burn him when he deliberately exposed himself to it, contradicting one of the weaknesses he expected a vampire to possess and leaving him uncertain about the exact nature of his transformation. Garlic caused nausea and rejection, while a cross had no effect.[1]
Nightfall made the situation considerably worse. Victor's physical abilities and senses intensified while his thirst for blood became increasingly difficult to control. Fearing that remaining near [[Leon Walker]] and Anna Walker might cause him to attack his own family, Victor left the house and followed the scent of blood through the city. His transformed body allowed him to move across rooftops and through the urban environment with an ease impossible for his former Human self. He eventually reached an alley where three criminals were threatening a young woman. Victor's instincts took over almost immediately and he killed the men with overwhelming physical force (piercing one through the chest and removing the heart, decapitating another, and cutting the third in half with his arm), yet their exposed blood produced almost no attraction in him and tasted repulsive when he attempted to drink it.[2]
The woman was Violet Snow. Unlike the criminals, Violet appeared completely different through Victor's supernatural perception; rather than being drawn toward the ordinary circulation of blood within her body, his attention was overwhelmingly concentrated upon her neck. Violet was a beautiful pale woman with long white hair tied in a ponytail that reached the floor, vibrant violet eyes, a nice figure, modest breasts, and an ass big enough that it could not be hidden by the black goth-style dress she wore. She was tall, just a little under Victor's new height. Violet displayed no fear toward him and voluntarily offered her blood. The moment Victor drank from her, his thirst was finally satisfied and the experience produced an intense connection between them. Violet also drank from Victor, and the exchange caused memories to pass between them. Through Violet's perspective, Victor reconstructed part of what had happened before he awakened: he had suffered a mortal injury, Violet had placed him inside a ritual circle, fed him her blood and completed the transformation that prevented his death. After becoming a vampire, the newly transformed Victor had immediately attacked and bitten Violet before eventually losing consciousness.[2]
Although Victor understood that following an unknown supernatural woman should have alarmed him, his instincts regarded Violet as familiar and trustworthy. He consequently accompanied her to the Snow residence, where he encountered the first supernatural law that could directly restrain him. Victor physically could not cross the threshold until Natalia invited him inside, teaching him that vampires were subject to supernatural Rules rather than merely conventional biological weaknesses. Natalia was a blonde maid with her hair tied in a ponytail, blue eyes, a modest body, and approximately 170 cm tall, between 21 and 30 years old, and not a vampire.[3]
Violet then began explaining what Victor had become. Humans transformed through vampire blood were ordinarily categorized as Plebeian Vampires, while Noble Vampires were born naturally and inherited the abilities of their ancestral Clans. The distinction should have made Victor relatively simple to classify, yet almost everything about him contradicted it. He had been transformed from a Human and therefore should have become a Plebeian, but he had inherited Violet's [[Snow Clan]] characteristics, including her affinity with fire and the Clan's immunity to sunlight. At the same time, his red world of blood perception was an individual ability that had apparently manifested from Victor himself, resembling the personal characteristics expected of a Plebeian Vampire. Violet therefore recognized almost immediately that Victor was neither behaving nor developing like an ordinary transformed vampire. Only virgins could be successfully transformed, and the ancient ritual linked the new vampire to the Noble as husband or slave. Violet had chosen Victor as her husband.[3][4]
The transformation also explained Victor's rapidly changing psychology. Violet told him that vampirism did not replace a person's emotions but amplified them. Love, anger, hatred, pleasure, jealousy, possessiveness and bloodlust all became more intense, with newly transformed vampires being especially vulnerable while they adjusted. Victor began recognizing that several thoughts he had previously suppressed now surfaced much more easily, while his attachment toward Violet developed with an intensity that would have seemed abnormal to his former Human self.[4]
Victor's first direct exposure to wider supernatural politics occurred when the vampires Lucy and Karen visited Violet. Lucy was a tall man of 190 cm with short black hair slicked back, wearing a white suit and glasses. Karen had short black hair in a distinctive cut and wore a normal work suit, standing around 170 cm. Lucy attempted to obtain permission to bring additional vampires into Snow territory because The Inquisition was searching for him, but Violet refused to allow outsiders to freely enter land she considered hers. Lucy's condescension toward Victor as a recently transformed Plebeian also gave Victor one of his first opportunities to display the pride and contempt that had become easier for him to express after his transformation. Rather than accepting Lucy's seniority, Victor deliberately provoked him and treated the older vampire as beneath his concern.[4][5]
Through the confrontation Victor learned considerably more about the hidden ecosystem surrounding vampires. Lucy acted as a supplier of Humans to Noble Vampires who still wished to consume Human blood despite having spouses capable of satisfying their thirst. The arrangement existed because ordinary Human blood could not properly satisfy the bloodlust of many Noble Vampires, while unrestricted predation would create enormous numbers of disappearances and eventually expose supernatural society. Witches had therefore helped develop the marriage ritual used by vampire society, while individuals such as Lucy operated illicit or morally questionable alternatives for those who continued hunting Humans. Victor also learned that Witches were still active members of the supernatural world and commonly sold magical services to whoever could afford them.[5]
Rather than regarding the Inquisition's pursuit of Lucy as his own problem, Victor immediately saw strategic value in the situation. Lucy had attracted a Church hunting force into the city, meaning Victor could potentially observe the capabilities of supernatural hunters without making himself their primary target. It was one of the first examples of Victor instinctively approaching danger with curiosity rather than simply attempting to avoid it.[5]
On February 2, Victor returned to his parents' home with Violet and confronted a more mundane problem: explaining why the sickly son Leon and Anna had known for twenty-one years had apparently transformed overnight into a healthy and muscular young man. His body had already grown several centimetres and Violet explained that vampire transformation pushed the body toward its physical prime, with the process continuing for a period after conversion depending upon the individual's potential. Anna (a 40-year-old lawyer with long black hair, blue eyes, and a curvy body) immediately recognized that Victor was still her son but questioned him intensely about the sudden change, even testing his memories before accepting his increasingly absurd attempt to attribute the transformation to late "puberty." Leon (a 50-year-old retired bricklayer, 183 cm tall, with brown hair, black eyes, a beer belly, and muscular arms) was more immediately enthusiastic about the beautiful women with his son.[6]
The situation became even more chaotic once Violet entered the conversation. Victor and Violet constructed a cover story claiming that they had maintained an online relationship for several years before finally meeting and marrying. Victor then casually introduced Violet as his wife, leaving Leon and Anna shocked before their surprise rapidly transformed into enthusiasm that their previously isolated son had somehow found a beautiful partner. Violet, who was unused to the type of uncomplicated familial acceptance offered by Victor's parents, gradually found herself drawn into the Walker household rather than treated as an outsider.[6][7]
Victor never intended the deception to remain permanent. Privately, he understood that hiding the supernatural world from his parents for eternity would be impossible, especially now that he himself could potentially live indefinitely. The thought of continuing through an immortal existence while Leon and Anna eventually died was unacceptable to him, and he already considered the possibility of someday bringing his parents into the supernatural world rather than abandoning them to Human mortality.[7]
His transformation also forced Victor to reconsider his ordinary Human future. He resigned from his job and began planning how to obtain money without remaining bound to conventional employment, considering using his supernatural abilities against criminals while protecting his real identity. The idea eventually developed into an alternate identity with forged documents, an anonymous bank account and concealing clothing. Even before those preparations were completed, Victor had therefore begun constructing a life in which Victor Walker could remain connected to his Human family while another identity operated within the supernatural underworld.[7]

##### Old Grudges, James Smith and Kaguya Blank
Chapters 8–12
Victor's attempt to resume college life immediately confronted him with one of the deepest grudges from his Human past. [[Luan Davis]], formerly the captain of Victor's high-school basketball team, had repeatedly humiliated him because of the medical condition that prevented Victor from participating normally in sports. Victor's RH-null blood and chronic anemia had made even moderate physical activity dangerous; overexertion could hospitalize him for days, forcing him to exercise only under careful supervision despite desperately wanting to participate in athletics. Luan had exploited that weakness and eventually insulted Victor as a burden upon his mother. Victor had refused to allow Leon or Anna to solve the problem for him because his pride demanded that he confront his own grievances, but his Human body had never given him the ability to retaliate.[8]
The transformed Victor no longer possessed that limitation. When he looked at Luan through his supernatural vision, however, he noticed something even stranger: Luan carried the mark of another vampire. The discovery helped explain how a man who had previously suffered serious muscular problems had recovered so completely and why Luan had apparently enjoyed unusual protection. Victor soon realized that Luan was connected to [[Corneliu Funar]], a Noble Vampire hiding behind the mundane position of a university basketball coach.[8]
Victor challenged Luan through basketball and agreed that neither would openly use supernatural powers. Even under that restriction, Victor's new physical condition completely overturned their former relationship. He could run, jump and endure impacts at levels his sick Human body could never have approached, while Luan's attempt to overpower him physically only demonstrated that Victor's transformed body was considerably more durable than expected. Victor deliberately humiliated Luan throughout the game, treating the confrontation less as a sporting competition than as repayment for years of resentment.[9]
The match was observed by Ruby Scarlett. Victor did not know who she was, but something inside him instinctively reacted to her presence and caused him to look toward the spectators. Ruby immediately concealed herself, disturbed that the newborn vampire had nearly detected her despite having no conscious knowledge that she was nearby. Corneliu was also present and regarded Victor as an irritating newcomer interfering with both his servant and his long-standing obsession with Ruby.[8][9]
Victor left the university dissatisfied because humiliating Luan had not completely extinguished his grudge. More importantly, he had recognized that Luan was merely subordinate to someone else. Victor deliberately remained in an isolated area after leaving campus and waited to see whether Corneliu would confront him, only for the Noble Vampire to refuse the opportunity. Victor's contempt consequently shifted from Luan toward the unseen master who empowered others while remaining behind them.[10]
Returning home also revealed how much Violet had already altered the environment around the Walker residence. A large hidden underground area had been constructed beneath the property with the help of the Witch June, providing space for servants and supernatural activity without exposing Victor's parents to everything occurring around them. Victor used the opportunity to formalize the alternate identity he had planned earlier. June arranged forged identification, financial documentation and other records under the deliberately generic name James Smith, giving Victor a legal-looking identity disconnected from Victor Walker whenever he needed to operate anonymously.[10]
Victor's relationship with Violet meanwhile continued deepening through blood. Their mutual thirst made feeding an intensely personal experience, but the scene also demonstrated how quickly Victor's emotional instincts were changing. When he sensed unknown presences near the house, his immediate reaction was hostility toward people observing what he regarded as his private territory. Violet identified the nearby individuals as members of the Inquisition and explained that the Church possessed equipment capable of locating ordinary vampires. Wealthy Noble families could commission magical countermeasures from Witches, creating another example of how money, magic and supernatural politics were intertwined.[11]
Kaguya increasingly became involved in Victor's daily life during this period. Her speed, shadow abilities and extensive training allowed her to change Victor's clothing and prepare him with almost absurd efficiency, prompting Victor to praise her and affectionately pat her head. What Victor considered a minor expression of gratitude had considerably greater importance to Kaguya. She had spent most of her life being trained to perform perfectly because service was expected of her, meaning sincere praise for simply doing her work was something she rarely received. Kaguya was short at approximately 160 cm, with short black hair and black eyes, maintaining a poker face.[11][12]
Kaguya was approximately two centuries old and belonged to Clan Blank, a lineage historically subordinate to Clan Snow. Her ancestry combined Snow blood with the abilities of an old Japanese Noble Vampire bloodline associated with shadows, allowing members such as Kaguya to inherit both supernatural shadow techniques and resistance derived from their connection to the Snow family. Although Kaguya genuinely enjoyed working as a maid, she resented the idea that birth alone should determine whom she was forced to serve. Her personal ideal was therefore not merely to become a perfect servant, but to become a "perfect maid" who could freely choose a master worthy of her loyalty. Victor's treatment of her began shifting that loyalty away from simple inherited obligation toward genuine personal attachment.[12]
A much more dangerous problem was simultaneously developing among Violet's childhood friends. When Kaguya questioned Violet about Sasha Fulger and Ruby, Violet's possessiveness surfaced violently. Violet understood that both girls had been present during Victor's transformation and feared what completing the abnormal ritual might mean. She did not want to share Victor, yet the magical bond could not simply be ignored. Kaguya and Natalia recognized that the transformation had gone seriously outside the ritual's intended parameters and that keeping Victor permanently separated from Ruby and Sasha could eventually have consequences for all four of them.[11]
Rather than allow Violet's jealousy to determine the outcome, Kaguya decided to investigate the other two women herself. Her choice effectively moved her beyond the role of Violet's attendant and made her one of the first people actively attempting to keep Victor's unusual new family from collapsing before it had even fully formed.[11][12]

##### Ruby Scarlett and the Inquisition Patrol
Chapters 13–15
Kaguya first visited Ruby Scarlett and her maid Luna. Unlike Violet's explosive possessiveness or Sasha's instability, Ruby approached the situation analytically, but she was suffering from the same underlying problem. Since Victor's transformation, her thirst had increasingly focused upon him and ordinary blood no longer properly satisfied her. Ruby understood that the marriage ritual had somehow connected her to a man she had not yet formally met, and she had no intention of allowing the bond—or Victor—to disappear merely because Violet wanted him for herself. Ruby was a beautiful woman with long red hair and a body that would be the envy of any model, possessing the biggest breasts Kaguya had ever seen. Luna was a Russian woman with shoulder-length white hair, pale skin, pink eyes, a height of 180 cm, and huge breasts; she wore a maid's uniform and liked to tease Ruby.[13]
The conversation revealed that Sasha's circumstances were considerably worse. Julia, the maid who had raised Sasha and effectively acted as her mother, had been murdered, leaving Sasha emotionally unstable at the same moment the abnormal ritual began forcing her toward Victor. Luna, recognizing that events were becoming too dangerous for the younger women to manage alone, considered contacting Ruby's mother for assistance.[13]
While Kaguya investigated Victor's wives, the Inquisition moved closer to Victor himself. Thomas and Jimmy, two relatively inexperienced hunters, were patrolling the area with equipment intended to detect vampires. Their search brought them directly into contact with Victor and Violet. Thomas had black hair and brown eyes; Jimmy had light brown hair, black eyes, and a bowl-shaped haircut. Both wore combat-designed black priest's robes with white crucifixes.[13]
Thomas responded aggressively, while Jimmy quickly recognized that the situation was far more dangerous than expected. The hunters carried objects blessed by the Church and could invoke Divine power through their faith. Holy water, prayers, sacred weapons and defensive barriers were capable of harming vampires even when the Human wielding them was physically inferior. Jimmy's invocation of the Archangel Michael produced a powerful golden attack, demonstrating to Victor that Humans possessing the correct supernatural tools could threaten vampires who relied carelessly upon racial superiority.[14]
Violet became enraged when the hunters injured Victor and nearly allowed her anger to dictate the battle. Victor stopped her, pointing out that losing control merely because an enemy had harmed someone important was dangerous. The irony was not lost on him: his own emotions were similarly unstable, and he increasingly realized that the restraint he had practiced throughout his Human life was beginning to erode beneath the amplified psychology of a vampire.[14]
Jimmy chose survival over pride and cooperated once it became obvious that Victor and Violet could kill the pair. He explained that the hunters were not originally searching for Victor; their operation concerned Lucy, who had stolen an important sacred object from the Church. Jimmy also revealed that considerably more dangerous hunters were participating, including [[Carlos Reiss]] and Mizuki. Violet recognized Mizuki in particular as an exceptional threat. She had earned a reputation hunting Japanese Noble Vampire families and possessed enough ability to fight vampires centuries older than either Thomas or Jimmy could realistically confront.[15]
Victor consequently prevented Violet from simply executing the two men. Killing them would provide little information and might provoke an organization whose strength Victor had only begun to understand. Instead, he extracted what he could and kept the encounter from escalating further, displaying an unusual mixture of predatory violence and practical restraint that would repeatedly characterize his later decisions.[15]
The chapter then shifted toward Sasha, where Kaguya found the blonde vampire increasingly consumed by grief, anger and bloodlust. The death of Julia had removed the person Sasha considered her true maternal figure, while the worsening bond with Victor was simultaneously placing supernatural pressure upon her body and mind. Kaguya realized that Sasha was approaching a point where she might attempt something suicidal if left alone.[15]

##### Sasha Fulger, Julia's Death and the Broken Ritual
Chapters 16–19
The events surrounding Sasha began on January 31, immediately after Victor's transformation. Sasha had participated in Violet's ritual without expecting to become personally bound to the Human Violet intended to marry. After the ritual failed to proceed normally, however, Sasha discovered that she had somehow been marked as Victor's wife and that her bloodlust increasingly demanded his blood. She knew enough about vampire marriage rituals to understand the danger: prolonged separation from the spouse capable of satisfying that thirst could eventually cause severe physical and psychological consequences. Sasha had sapphire blue eyes that could change to blood red, blonde hair, and a height matching Victor's.[16]
Returning to her residence transformed the situation from confusing to catastrophic. Sasha found the servants slaughtered and Julia decapitated. The attackers were [[Carlos Reiss]] and Maria, members of the Inquisition who had exploited Clan Fulger's recent political decline. With the Fulger family having lost its former status as a Count Clan, Sasha appeared considerably more vulnerable than she would have been while protected by one of [[Nightingale]]'s great Pillars.[16]
Maria used blessed threads to restrain Sasha while Carlos attempted to capture her, but they badly underestimated the heir they had targeted. Sasha forced her lightning beyond the limits she normally used, escaped the ambush and seized Maria. Her retaliation was deliberately cruel: rather than simply killing the hunter, Sasha transformed Maria into a vampire servant, forcing a woman devoted to hunting vampires to become one herself. Maria's continued existence consequently became both punishment and a source of information regarding the Inquisition's operation.[16]
Kaguya later interrogated Maria and confirmed that the attack had specifically taken advantage of Clan Fulger's weakened political position. She also recognized that Sasha's grief over Julia had combined with her bloodlust and humiliation into a desire for immediate revenge. Kaguya did not believe Sasha was thinking rationally enough to survive such an attempt. Rather than allowing her to leave, she incapacitated Sasha and transported her to Victor, trusting vampire regeneration to repair the injury before Sasha could resume her suicidal pursuit of the hunters.[16][17]
Victor had meanwhile decided to keep Thomas and Jimmy alive. He considered them potential bargaining pieces or sources of information and explicitly ordered that they not be unnecessarily mistreated while in his custody. The decision contrasted with the increasingly violent instincts he displayed in combat; Victor was perfectly willing to kill enemies, but he did not see value in cruelty that produced no benefit.[17]
The moment Kaguya brought Sasha near him, Victor's body reacted before he understood why. Her blood produced the same overwhelming attraction he had experienced with Violet, and Kaguya was finally forced to explain the truth directly: Sasha was also his wife. Worse for Violet's desire to monopolize him, Ruby was bound to Victor in exactly the same manner.[17]
Victor and Sasha initially attempted to restrain themselves, but their mutual bloodlust rapidly overwhelmed that effort. Once they exchanged blood, the magical relationship between them became unmistakable. Their emotions and fragments of thought could pass through the connection, while the unfamiliarity that should have existed between two people meeting properly for the first time was replaced by an almost instinctive intimacy.[18]
Victor's body heated, his throat dried, and he felt the urge to feast on her. Sasha's face went red, her breathing erratic, her eyes turning blood red. She pushed him against the wall trying to bite him; he threw her to the ground, held her arms while she wrapped her legs around his waist. He bit her neck; she bit his collarbone. Both moaned as they drank. Her blood tasted wild and addictive. She was his height and smelled good. He held her waist and sniffed her neck while she clung to him.[18]
Sasha's blood also allowed Victor to witness another portion of the transformation ritual from her perspective. After awakening inside the ritual circle, Victor had not stopped after biting Violet. He had turned toward Ruby, attacked her despite her attempt to resist him and exchanged blood with her. When Violet attempted to separate them, Victor's newborn instincts continued seeking the remaining blood connected to the ritual. Sasha became the third woman caught in the abnormal sequence. What should have been Violet's individual marriage ritual had consequently bound all three women to the same transformed vampire.[18]
The memory confirmed that the anomaly had originated with Victor rather than with a deliberate plan by Violet, Ruby or Sasha. It also provided another early indication that Victor's blood was affecting the women around him. Kaguya and the others had already noticed that Violet seemed to be becoming stronger after repeatedly drinking Victor's blood, suggesting that the relationship was not merely allowing Victor to inherit qualities from his wives; something about him was also changing them.[18]
Once the immediate bloodlust subsided, Sasha finally spoke to Victor about Julia and her childhood. The Fulger family's lightning was extraordinarily destructive, and Sasha's upbringing had involved severe training intended to force her body and abilities toward the standards expected of the Clan's heir. Julia had been the person who remained with her through that upbringing, cared for her after training and experiments, educated her and gave Sasha the affection she never felt she received from her biological parents. Her murder therefore represented the loss of the person Sasha considered her real mother rather than merely the death of a servant.[19]
Sasha eventually broke down while recounting the loss. Victor did not attempt to tell her that revenge was unnecessary or that she should simply forget Julia. Instead, he allowed Sasha to grieve and made clear that he and Violet would help when the time came, while refusing to let Sasha throw her life away through an impulsive attack. Victor had known her for only a short period in conventional terms, but the blood connection allowed him to feel the depth of her emotions directly and made her suffering personally unbearable to him.[19]
Victor consequently decided that Sasha would remain close to him. He arranged for a nearby building to be purchased for additional accommodations and ordered that the servants immediately surrounding Sasha be female vampires, removing situations that might unnecessarily aggravate Violet's jealousy. More importantly, he made clear that he would not reject Sasha merely because accepting her complicated his relationship with Violet. Victor's pride mattered less to him than the safety and emotional well-being of a woman he now regarded unequivocally as his wife.[19]

##### Human Ties, Two Wives and the Lykos Secret
Chapters 20–25
After the crisis surrounding Sasha temporarily stabilized, Victor had time to consider how absurd his new life had become. Instead of being horrified by the discovery that the ritual had given him three wives, he found himself genuinely happy about it. The speed of that attachment made him suspicious of the ritual itself, and Victor increasingly suspected that his abnormal RH-null blood had somehow altered magic that should have connected him only to Violet. He therefore decided that eventually understanding the ritual would require information from older supernatural beings rather than simply relying upon what he and his young wives currently knew.[20]
His attention then returned briefly to the Human life he had known before becoming a vampire. While retrieving his cat Zack from the veterinarian, Victor encountered his childhood friend [[Andrew Walter]]. Andrew was immediately stunned by Victor's dramatic increase in height, muscle and confidence, even suspecting that his formerly sick friend had begun abusing steroids. Victor responded by casually revealing that he was now married, beginning a series of increasingly unbelievable conversations with the friends who had known him before his transformation.[20]
At the veterinary clinic Victor reunited with Leona Lykos and [[Edward Jonathan Elizabeth Lykos|Edward Lykos]]. Edward had previously helped train Victor in basic self-defense, carefully adapting exercises to the severe physical restrictions imposed by Victor's illness. Leona, Edward and Andrew therefore understood better than most Humans how impossible Victor's current physique should have been. They had also known about Luan's bullying and had wanted to intervene years earlier, but Victor had stubbornly refused because he considered that grudge his own problem.[21]
The reunion became increasingly comedic once Andrew revealed Victor's marriage. When Victor described the extreme jealousy and possessiveness displayed by the women around him, his friends explained the concept of a "yandere" and treated those traits as warning signs. Victor instead admitted that he actively liked possessive women. Their concern only increased when he revealed that he had more than one wife, while Victor reasoned that ordinary Human marriage law held little meaning for supernatural beings who followed entirely different rules.[21][22]
Returning home forced Victor to deal with the conflict his friends had just predicted. Violet immediately detected the presence of another woman around him and became suspicious before Victor reassured her. The real confrontation began when Sasha appeared. Violet's possessiveness made her unwilling to casually accept another woman occupying the same position she did, while Sasha was initially hesitant to challenge the friend she had known since childhood.[23]
Victor refused to resolve the conflict by choosing one woman and discarding the other. He openly told Violet that Sasha was his wife and that he wanted Sasha beside him, while simultaneously asking Sasha to acknowledge what she wanted rather than retreat because she feared Violet's reaction. Encouraged by Kaguya to stop avoiding the issue, Sasha finally asserted that Victor was her husband as well. The confrontation consequently ended not in a battle but with both women clinging possessively to Victor and glaring at one another, establishing the unstable but genuine beginning of their shared household.[23]
Victor's James Smith identity then received its physical counterpart. He summoned June and commissioned clothing and a mask suitable for concealing himself during supernatural activity, including preparations that could accommodate Violet when she accompanied him. June's greed remained central to her behavior, but her competence and neutrality made her increasingly useful to Victor's household. Natalia also used June's connections to investigate what Lucy had stolen from the Church and the larger reason the Inquisition had entered the city.[24]
The developing blood bond between Victor, Violet and Sasha was becoming more sophisticated at the same time. They could increasingly perceive one another's emotional states and occasionally catch surface thoughts, producing both greater intimacy and greater difficulty concealing embarrassing reactions from one another. What had begun as a ritual intended primarily to regulate bloodlust was clearly functioning far beyond its ordinary parameters in Victor's case.[24]
Victor subsequently returned to university and spoke with his economics professor, Adam Lykos, the father of Leona and Edward. Victor's instincts immediately identified Adam as dangerous despite the man's outwardly ordinary role. Adam, who had known Victor long before his transformation, recognized an equally important change in his former student and confronted him about the artificial personality Victor presented to society. He questioned why Victor continued hiding behind a "mask" rather than simply admitting what he wanted and who he actually was.[25]
After Victor left, the reason for the Lykos family's unusual physicality was revealed. Adam, Edward and Leona belonged to a Werewolf family. More importantly, Victor himself had previously carried wolf venom that could potentially have caused him to awaken as a Werewolf during a full moon. His vampire transformation had neutralized that possibility, meaning two different supernatural lineages had already attempted to claim Victor before he consciously entered the supernatural world.[25]
Adam ordered Leona not to involve herself in vampire affairs merely because Victor was her friend. She could continue her personal relationship with him, but the conflict surrounding Noble Vampires, the Inquisition and the hidden supernatural factions was no longer something an inexperienced Werewolf should enter casually. Victor left the conversation without knowing every detail Adam had discussed, but the professor's question about the mask remained with him and would become decisive only hours later.[25]

##### The Mask Falls and Victor's First Transformation
Chapters 26–27
Later that night, Victor used the university swimming pool to test another traditional vampire weakness and confirmed that running water had no harmful effect on him. By this point he had begun systematically separating fictional vampire weaknesses from the Rules that actually governed his species. Sunlight could not harm him because of the Snow characteristic, running water was harmless and garlic was irrelevant compared with genuine supernatural dangers such as blessed weapons and the Rule preventing uninvited entry into another person's residence.[26]
Corneliu finally chose that moment to confront him. The older Noble Vampire (blond-haired and blue-eyed) attacked Victor directly, teleporting to smash him into the surroundings and threatening both him and the people close to him if he continued interfering with what Corneliu considered his property. Victor was repeatedly injured and forced to rely upon his regeneration, yet the experience produced a reaction Corneliu did not anticipate. Rather than simply becoming afraid of the older vampire, Victor became increasingly disgusted with what he saw as Corneliu's arrogance and dependence upon age and status.[26]
Adam's earlier question returned to Victor while he was being beaten. Throughout his Human life, Victor had consciously moderated himself so that his pride, anger, competitiveness and more violent impulses would remain acceptable within ordinary society. His sick body had reinforced that restraint because acting on those impulses could have placed him in physical danger he had no ability to overcome. Vampirism had removed the physical limitation without removing the habits Victor had built around it.[26]
Victor finally decided to stop suppressing himself. The moment he abandoned that psychological restraint, an enormous pillar of fire erupted from his body and his appearance transformed. Flames enveloped him, his ears sharpened, his sclera became black, his irises turned blood-red, his pupils became increasingly reptilian and his teeth developed into a more monstrous arrangement. The transformation was not something Corneliu expected from a newborn Plebeian Vampire. He recognized characteristics associated with the transformed states of far older Count-class vampires and immediately understood that his assumptions about Victor had been fundamentally wrong.[26][27]
The change was psychological as well as physical. Victor found violence exhilarating and began treating Corneliu less as a dangerous Noble Vampire than as an object upon which he could finally express the instincts he had spent years suppressing. He destroyed Corneliu's throat and was prepared to continue when another sensation abruptly became more important than his anger.[27]
Victor smelled blood that his instincts identified as belonging to Ruby. Through his supernatural perception and their abnormal bond, he became aware that Ruby and Luna were surrounded and injured by Inquisition hunters elsewhere in the city. Ruby had been defending herself while arguing that the Church was attempting to kill her merely because she was a vampire despite her not hunting Humans for food. Mizuki nevertheless intended to eliminate her.[27]
Victor immediately abandoned Corneliu. Whatever satisfaction he might gain from finishing their fight was irrelevant compared with the possibility that one of his wives could die. Without hesitation, he launched himself toward Ruby's position while still in his transformed state, establishing a priority that would remain central to his behavior throughout his life: personal battles, pride and revenge could all be discarded the moment his family required him.[27]

##### The Inquisition Battle, Scathach's Retaliation and the Third Wife
Chapters 28–31
Victor reached the battlefield to find Ruby and the injured Luna surrounded by Mizuki, Carlos and other Inquisition hunters. Ruby immediately recognized the fire-covered vampire approaching them as Victor despite having never properly spoken with him. Seeing his third wife bleeding pushed Victor's already unstable transformation toward even greater aggression, and the killing intent released by the newborn was enough to momentarily terrify several of the Humans around him.[28]
His raw strength, however, could not compensate for his complete lack of serious combat experience. Ruby understood the problem almost immediately. Victor possessed extraordinary power but had spent only days as a vampire and had never been trained to fight veteran supernatural opponents. Mizuki exploited precisely that weakness.[28]
The Inquisition's strength also came from more than Human physical ability. Mizuki and the hunters invoked Divine beings and sacred techniques to reinforce themselves. Divine blessings associated with Susanoo strengthened the hunters with water-based armor resembling Sengoku-era samurai, while Mizuki could manifest sacred weapons (transforming her fan into a two-meter Odachi) and draw upon other supernatural patrons such as [[Tsukuyomi]], Bishamonten, and eventually the legendary exorcist [[Abe-no-Seimei]], gaining the assistance and knowledge necessary to deal with a vampire whose physical abilities greatly exceeded her own. She used [[Onmyoujutsu]] talismans and blue energy enhancements.[28]
Mizuki landed a severe blessed attack upon Victor, cutting through the defenses of his transformed state and weakening the flames surrounding him. When she attempted to exploit the opening and decapitate him, Kaguya intervened from the shadows. Kaguya had remained hidden within Victor's shadow precisely because neither Violet nor his servants were willing to allow an inexperienced newborn to wander completely unprotected. Her intervention prevented the battle from ending immediately, while Ruby used her ice to help seal Victor's injuries.[28]
Mizuki nevertheless understood that Victor was still vulnerable. He could regenerate, possess multiple unusual powers and display a transformation beyond his age, but he did not yet know how to use those advantages efficiently against a trained opponent. The confrontation became Victor's first direct demonstration that extraordinary potential and overwhelming raw power were not substitutes for actual combat skill.[28]
The battle expanded when Violet, Sasha and Maria arrived. Violet almost lost control upon seeing Victor severely wounded in Ruby's arms, forcing Ruby to redirect her attention toward the immediate objective of getting Victor away alive. Sasha attacked Mizuki with her lightning while the remaining hunters attempted to prevent the vampires from escaping.[29]
Abe-no-Seimei's manifested spirit also became an active participant and quickly displayed considerably greater awareness than the Humans invoking him. While Mizuki wanted to continue pursuing the vampires, Seimei sensed that something far more dangerous was observing the confrontation. The unseen presence was particularly concerned with the red-haired Ruby, making further aggression potentially catastrophic for the Inquisition.[29]
Victor's wives therefore coordinated a retreat instead of allowing anger to turn the battle into a prolonged slaughter. Kaguya concealed herself within Victor's shadow, while Ruby and Violet combined their opposing ice and fire to create an enormous cloud of steam that obscured the battlefield. Sasha carried the incapacitated Victor and Violet away, while Ruby withdrew with Maria. The hunters failed to stop their escape.[29]
The observer Seimei had detected was [[Scathach Elderblood Scarlett|Scathach Scarlett]], Ruby's mother. Her presence also influenced the masked supernatural authorities monitoring the battle. Victor had openly displayed supernatural abilities in the Human World, something that could normally have justified intervention, but the officials understood that taking action while Scathach Scarlett was watching her daughter's husband would potentially create a conflict far more dangerous than Victor's original violation.[29]
[[Scathach]] was less interested in Victor's breach of secrecy than in the fact that the Inquisition had harmed Ruby. Two days later, on February 5, she personally appeared at the Vatican headquarters of the organization responsible. The Church's original operation was finally clarified there: Lucy had stolen a sacred relic identified as a finger of Saint Mary, and the Inquisition force had been dispatched to retrieve the artifact and deal with the vampire responsible. Ruby and the others had become involved because of the hunters' broader hostility toward vampires rather than because Ruby had stolen the relic herself.[30]
The Vatican responded to Scathach's arrival as a catastrophic emergency. She was more than two thousand years old, had already retaliated against the Church in the past and possessed enough power that ordinary Inquisition forces could not realistically compel her to leave. Alexander, addressed as the highest authority present, attempted to contain the situation diplomatically and offered to punish those responsible for harming Ruby.[30]
Scathach rejected the idea that an apology was sufficient. Eighteen years earlier she had already issued a warning concerning her daughter: anyone who harmed Ruby would personally face Scathach's retaliation. Her arrival consequently transformed the Vatican into a battlefield. The destruction was so severe that Human news later reported a fabricated terrorist incident involving unusual explosives, while more than seventy percent of the Vatican's structures were described as having been damaged by the time Victor recovered.[30][31]
Victor with his three wives
Four days after Scathach's attack, on February 9, Victor finally awakened in the underground residence beneath his home. Ruby was sleeping beside him. Victor remembered enough of the battle to recognize that Mizuki's specialized techniques had left his body severely weakened and partially paralyzed, but his immediate attention shifted toward the third woman connected to him by the ritual.[31]
Victor and Ruby finally exchanged blood directly. Just as had happened with Violet and Sasha, the act caused memories and emotions to flow between them, giving Victor a far more complete understanding of Ruby's personality than an ordinary first conversation could have provided. Ruby's calm and analytical demeanor did not make her less possessive than her childhood friends; she simply expressed that possessiveness differently. Victor, rather than being frightened by it, accepted her as naturally as he had accepted Violet and Sasha.[31]
Ruby was sleeping naked beside him. When she woke she crawled toward him, climbed onto his lap and sat on his crotch. Her long red hair and curvaceous body were on full display; her breasts, the biggest he had seen, pressed against his chest like two soft white rabbits. She bit his neck while he bit her collarbone. She moaned, wrapped her legs around his waist, and something wet soaked his shorts. They kissed with tongues for minutes. She licked her lips sensually afterward.[31]
Ruby's memories also completed the missing portion of Victor's transformation. After attacking Violet, Ruby and Sasha inside the ritual circle, the newborn Victor had declared that all of their blood belonged to him. He then unconsciously created a dome of blood around himself and Sasha powerful enough to protect them when Violet reacted with fire. Only afterward did Victor finally lose consciousness. The event provided another example of abilities appearing instinctively within him despite his complete lack of training.[31]
The women still could not fully explain why a ritual meant to bind one Noble Vampire and one Human had instead connected Victor to all three participants. Their strongest suspicion remained Victor's original RH-null blood. Within supernatural society that blood possessed a far more significant name: Golden Blood. Its scent could attract vampires from kilometres away, and Humans born with it rarely survived long enough to reach adulthood because supernatural predators eventually discovered them.[31]
The revelation completely recontextualized Victor's supposedly ordinary Human childhood. Violet had known about his Golden Blood for approximately sixteen years and had secretly protected him throughout that period. She hired Witches to conceal his scent, eliminated vampires who attempted to approach him and eventually claimed the surrounding territory so that other supernatural beings could not easily reach the Human she had already decided would become hers. Victor's survival into adulthood had therefore not been simple luck; much of the supernatural danger surrounding him had been removed before he ever became aware that such creatures existed.[31]
The same discussion connected another previously unexplained element of Victor's past to the supernatural world. Violet referred to a Werewolf that had attempted to mark Victor while she was unable to prevent it, corresponding with Adam's earlier revelation that wolf venom had existed inside Victor before his vampire transformation neutralized it. Victor had therefore attracted the attention of more than one supernatural species even while believing himself to be nothing more than an unusually sick Human.[25][31]
By the end of the conversation, Victor had finally met and exchanged blood with all three women created by the abnormal ritual. What should have been an impossible domestic situation instead left him openly delighted with his circumstances. Violet, Sasha and Ruby were dangerous, possessive Noble Vampires, yet Victor considered himself extraordinarily fortunate and internally summarized his situation with the realization that his three wives were beautiful vampires.[31]
The conclusion of the Volume immediately reminded him that the supernatural world extended far beyond the young women surrounding him. When Victor left the room with Ruby, he encountered an unfamiliar red-haired woman. The instant their eyes met, his instincts reacted more violently than they had toward any previous opponent. Victor's body recognized the woman as an overwhelming predator before he consciously knew who she was, temporarily freezing him beneath the pressure of her presence.[31]
The woman merely smiled and addressed him as her "son-in-law." Victor had survived his transformation, learned the existence of the supernatural world, acquired three vampire wives, awakened powers abnormal even by Noble Vampire standards and fought the Inquisition within the span of little more than a week. His first encounter with Scathach Scarlett, however, made clear that everything he had experienced so far represented only the beginning of the world he had entered, closing The [[Awakening]] and leading directly into his introduction to [[Nightingale]] and the true upper levels of vampire society.[31]
