Kaguya also raised another problem created by Victor's new position. A Count required capable subordinates. Victor himself could become overwhelmingly powerful, but that strength meant little if his family and territory remained undefended whenever he left. The observation planted the foundation for the elite group Victor would begin building throughout the remainder of the Volume.[137]

##### Homecoming and the Human Life Victor Refused to Abandon
Chapters 138–145
While Victor prepared to return home, Fred was already being pulled into the supernatural world from another direction. In [[New York]], Mizuki pursued him after Fred acquired the sacred spear connected to the Church. His attempts to escape through ordinary athleticism and parkour nevertheless impressed the spirit of [[Abe-no-Seimei]], establishing that Victor was not the only member of his original Human friend group beginning to attract supernatural attention.[138]
Victor returned to the enormous underground residence beneath his parents' house through a portal and immediately regarded the place as home despite how dramatically June had expanded it during his absence. [[Nightingale]] had become important to Victor, but Earth still contained the parents, friends and memories belonging to the twenty-one years he had lived before becoming a vampire.[139]
Rather than hide underground, Victor took Violet, Ruby and Sasha upstairs and confronted the explanation he had postponed for months. Leon initially had difficulty even recognizing the much taller and more mature man who appeared before him as his son. Victor ultimately proved his identity through private family memories before revealing that the physical changes were not ordinary development: he had become a vampire.[140]
Leon and Anna reacted with considerably more acceptance than Victor had feared. The explanation was absurd from an ordinary Human perspective, but the person standing before them was still their son. Leon approached portions of the revelation with humor while Anna concentrated on Victor's wellbeing. Their response reaffirmed why Victor refused to manipulate them with Charm: their acceptance mattered precisely because it was freely given.[140]
Victor then explained the existence of Nightingale and supernatural society in broader terms. He deliberately avoided revealing every sensitive ability or political secret because ordinary Humans possessing unnecessary information could become targets, but his parents finally understood that their son's new life extended far beyond a strange marriage and sudden recovery from illness.[141]
When Leon heard the name Alucard, he immediately recognized that it was Dracula written backwards. Victor admitted that the provocation was intentional. Leon found the audacity amusing but also warned his son that deliberately antagonizing people more powerful than himself would eventually create consequences Victor could not solve purely through confidence.[141]
Victor accidentally demonstrated that danger when part of his increasingly oppressive aura escaped during conversation and frightened his parents. His wives immediately corrected him, and Victor responded in a way he would almost never behave toward ordinary outsiders: he bowed and sincerely apologized to Leon and Anna. Victor's pride did not extend above the people who had spent his childhood caring for a chronically ill son without ever abandoning him.[142]
He then properly introduced Violet, Sasha and Ruby to his parents within the context of the truth, no longer pretending that the three women were part of an ordinary Human relationship. What had once been an improvised lie about Violet being an online girlfriend had become an enormous supernatural family involving three Noble Vampire wives, a legendary master and political responsibilities in another world.[142]
Victor resumed training almost immediately. June had constructed a specially reinforced training room beneath the residence, allowing him to test his powers without casually destroying his parents' property. Victor began systematically examining each inherited ability rather than relying solely upon what happened naturally during battle.[143]
Snow fire was comparatively intuitive for Victor, but he recognized that fire amplified aggressive emotions and therefore required emotional control as much as technical control. He disliked the idea of taking decades or centuries to master abilities simply because that was normal for vampires; to Victor, accepted growth rates were limitations to surpass rather than rules he was obligated to obey.[143]
Victor also recognized a weakness in training alone. [[Scathach]]'s months of instruction had taught him that real opponents exposed flaws solitary practice could not. When Kaguya suggested figures such as Hilda for specialized fire instruction, Victor became increasingly willing to learn from people who understood the individual abilities he had inherited instead of assuming his unusual talent meant he needed no teachers.[143]
June meanwhile returned with information connected to Clan Horseman. Instead of the straightforward report the family expected, the investigation produced a strange recording containing references to [[Nero Elderblood|Number Zero]], an apparently "perfect" subject and the conclusion that some result had nevertheless failed. The fragment immediately attracted Ruby's attention because it suggested experimentation occurring behind the political dispute involving Horseman.[144]
Ruby separated the useful terms from the incomplete recording and decided to pursue the information through contacts capable of reaching places June could not. She departed with Natalia while Victor returned to power training, including exercises requiring him to create increasingly precise ice structures instead of merely producing large quantities of frozen matter in combat.[144]
Victor later crossed paths with Edward and Leona again and finally confirmed through his supernatural perception that the Lykos family were [[Werewolves]]. The revelation changed little emotionally. Victor had known Edward and Leona before becoming a vampire and saw no reason an ancient racial feud should retroactively invalidate their friendship.[145]
By this point Victor's Human and supernatural lives were no longer separable. His parents knew the truth, his childhood friends were revealing supernatural identities or developing powers of their own, and problems originating from Nightingale, the Church and Werewolf society were converging on the same people Victor had known as an ordinary Human.[145]

##### The Lost Club, Old Friends and Sasha's Unfinished Revenge
Chapters 146–154
Ruby and Natalia travelled to [[The Lost Club]], a supposedly neutral supernatural establishment where information, mercenary contracts and services circulated among different races. Ruby sought Esther, commonly addressed as Madam, whose information network reached far beyond the resources available to ordinary Noble families.[146]
The visit quickly brought Ruby into conflict with [[Johnny Lykos]]. Johnny's hostility toward vampires and disrespect toward Ruby escalated into a physical confrontation, only for Ruby to freeze and humiliate the Alpha Werewolf despite the establishment's nominal neutrality. When others implied Victor might react badly if he learned how Johnny treated her, Ruby made clear that she did not require her husband to solve every problem for her; she was entirely capable of retaliating personally.[147]
Ruby also had an older grievance with Madam. She had never forgotten earlier dealings in which Esther had manipulated negotiations and extracted far more payment than Ruby considered reasonable. Rather than simply complaining about the past, Ruby arrived carrying information valuable enough to renegotiate their relationship from a much stronger position.[148]
The strange recording June had recovered became the centerpiece of that negotiation. Ruby proposed a much larger partnership built around destabilizing systems she considered corrupt and profiting from the resulting reconstruction. Her reasoning reflected a more ambitious side of Ruby that Victor's earlier chronology had not yet emphasized: if an existing supernatural structure was rotten beyond useful repair, Ruby was willing to contemplate destroying it and building something more favorable to her family in its place.[149]
Madam warned that Ruby's proposal could affect several major supernatural factions rather than merely one Clan. Ruby did not regard that scale as a reason to abandon the idea. Her ambitions increasingly matched the disruptive family she had married into, even if her methods remained more calculated than Victor's preference for direct confrontation.[149]
At the same time, Sasha returned with Maria to the abandoned Fulger residence associated with Julia's murder. The location forced both women to confront their shared past. Maria had participated in the attack, while Sasha had transformed Maria into a Ghoul as an act of revenge.[150]
Sasha had spent the previous six months researching what Maria had become and understood that her transformation was unstable. Maria had blonde hair tied in a ponytail, sapphire blue eyes, and stood around 180 cm in a modern maid's outfit.[151]  Maria's Ghoul nature produced intense hunger for Human flesh, while portions of her previous identity were gradually becoming more distant. Sasha also noticed the contradictory influence Victor exerted upon her: Maria could experience predatory hunger around him while simultaneously feeling an instinctive urge to submit and serve.[150]
Sasha explained that the most complete form of revenge was not necessarily killing someone's body. Destroying the identity, beliefs and sense of self upon which that person had built their life could be considerably more devastating. Maria, once an Inquisition hunter devoted to killing vampires, had been forcibly turned into one and made to live beside the people she once hunted.[150]
Victor meanwhile reunited with Mizuki under circumstances radically different from their first battle. Mizuki had almost killed him when he was an inexperienced newborn. She was now confronting a trained Vampire Count whose development over approximately six months contradicted nearly everything she understood about vampire growth.[152][153]
Victor did not treat Mizuki as a hated enemy. Their original fight had given him one of his first important lessons about the difference between raw power and actual combat experience. Rather than seeking revenge, he became interested in the systems she used to threaten creatures physically superior to ordinary Humans.[153]
Through Mizuki and [[Abe-no-Seimei]], Victor learned more about Faith. [[Hunters of Artemis|Hunters]] and other religious practitioners could channel power associated with Divine beings through belief, prayer and sacred techniques. Victor had already experienced the practical effects of Faith through blessed weapons, but the explanation helped separate the power system itself from the Church institutions that employed it.[154]
Fred became fascinated with the possibility of obtaining supernatural power himself. Joining the conventional Church structure became much less attractive once its restrictions were explained, especially because several conflicted dramatically with Fred's personal ambitions.[154]
Abe-no-Seimei provided an alternative by offering Fred a path toward becoming an Onmyō practitioner. Victor strongly encouraged him. Part of the motivation was simple concern that his increasingly supernatural life could place ordinary friends in danger, but another part was characteristically Victor: if Fred became stronger, Victor might someday have another interesting person to train or fight against.[155]

##### The Fulger Mansion Ambush and Victor's Blood Control
Chapters 155–165
Sasha's return to the old Fulger mansion was not merely sentimental. She intended to recover a family heirloom hidden within the property, later revealed to be a golden dagger associated with her ancestor Carmila Fulger and crafted through Dwarven workmanship. Before Sasha could leave, however, the mansion became the site of an organized ambush involving hunters, mercenaries and religious combatants.[156]
The attackers intended to capture Sasha rather than simply kill her. [[Zandriel]] and the other participants believed Clan Fulger's previous loss of its Count title had made its heiress a safer target than she would once have been. The operation therefore rested on an outdated political assumption: they did not fully account for Sasha now being the wife of the newly created Fifth Count.[156]
Maria fought beside Sasha while Kaguya intervened as Victor's representative and protector. [[Father Julian]] demonstrated that experienced Faith users did not always require elaborate spoken prayers, explaining that Faith ultimately came from conviction in the heart rather than the visible ritual surrounding it.[157]
The confrontation became critical when Kaguya was grievously wounded while protecting Sasha. Victor arrived soon afterward, and Sasha immediately recognized something terrifying about him: through their bond she could barely feel the emotions she normally associated with her husband. Victor had become almost completely cold.[158]
Rather than explode into uncontrolled rage, Victor began dismantling the attackers with a detached brutality that frightened even people familiar with his violence. He examined Zandriel and discovered that the man possessed abnormal hybrid characteristics—vampiric traits combined with a Human heart—providing another connection to the experiments already appearing elsewhere in the Church's activities.[158]
Father Julian revealed that General James was behind the operation. Sasha's blood was valuable to the project, and the attackers had been ordered to obtain the Fulger heiress either alive or in a condition from which useful material could still be taken. The same organization had also arranged for conventional Human authorities to enter the area, expecting their presence to complicate Victor's retaliation.[159]
Before acting, Victor contacted [[Scathach]] and told her only the essential facts: one of his wives had been trapped and one of his maids had nearly died protecting her. Scathach's answer reinforced the worldview she had spent six months teaching him. Victor was a vampire and the head of his own Clan; people who deliberately attacked what belonged to him should not expect him to tolerate it merely because political consequences existed. She instructed him to find everyone responsible and destroy them.[160]
Victor followed that advice. During the massacre he began experimenting with Blood in a way he had not previously understood. By extracting and manipulating the blood of defeated enemies, Victor discovered he could refine the precision of his own Blood control. What began as slaughter therefore became another training experience, with every corpse giving Victor additional opportunities to feel how blood responded to his will.[161]
The incident also affected [[Abe-no-Seimei]]'s understanding of the Inquisition. Seeing hybridized agents such as Zandriel forced him to question whether the organization operating under religious authority still represented the principles its members claimed to defend.[161]
When Human authorities entered the area, Victor refused to allow them to shield the people responsible for the ambush. The resulting supernatural confrontation created an enormous secrecy problem, forcing Ruby, Sasha, Violet and Natalia to divide responsibilities between cleanup, memory manipulation, electronic evidence and controlling the public explanation.[162]
Sasha used Charm on the Human commander and learned that General James had also influenced the conventional operation. Natalia dealt with surviving recording systems and witnesses, while Ruby and Violet focused on ensuring the narrative did not expose the existence of vampires.[162]
Ruby was more worried about Victor's parents eventually learning the scale of what he had done than about the political consequences of a Count killing enemies. Sasha, meanwhile, blamed herself for Kaguya's injury because the ambush had occurred during her attempt to retrieve the Fulger heirloom. Violet rejected the idea that a mistake meant Sasha should remain trapped in guilt; she needed to learn from it, apologize to Kaguya and become better prepared next time.[162]
The group also discovered that Maria had been left strangely unharmed by some of the attackers, strengthening suspicion that she remained relevant to Carlos and the Hybrid Project. Zandriel's unusual body was preserved rather than destroyed so that Ruby could investigate it.[163]
Victor later confronted [[Father Bruno]], another artificially modified combatant. Bruno's body possessed advantages beyond an ordinary Human, but the hybrid construction was biologically unstable. Victor dismissed such creations as incomplete attempts to force incompatible systems into one body rather than genuine evolution.[164]
During the battle Victor used a transformation patterned around the [[Snow Clan]]'s Vampire Count state, surrounding himself with overwhelming fire and manifesting features distinct from his more unstable Blood-based transformation. The difference demonstrated that Victor was gradually learning to access the Count-level characteristics inherited from individual wives rather than relying upon one uncontrolled monstrous state.[164]
The Snow Count state, as it came out of him, was specific. His height increased a little. His ears sharpened. His teeth grew sharper. His hair began to float. Large bat wings made of fire appeared behind him, and a pillar of fire erupted from his body. He landed and the ground caught. A pillar of flame burned Father Bruno's five subordinates. Victor took Bruno by the neck and was about to erase him. Violet caught his arm. She told him they still needed the man for what had been done to Kaguya, and not to let the fire take his emotions. Ruby hugged him until he came down. He turned the ice he had laid into hail. Bruno was not a vampire. Vampire blood had been used to raise a Human body. He had regeneration and the strength to kill a five-hundred-year-old adult vampire, and with his subordinates he could trouble vampires around eight hundred. Victor could not see the rest of a vampire's traits in him.[164]
Violet ultimately stopped Victor from killing Bruno because the family still needed information. Victor severed the man's ability to continue fighting and left him available for interrogation rather than allowing anger to destroy another source of intelligence.[164]
Approximately one week later, Kaguya finally awakened. Victor initially joked that she had been unconscious for centuries before immediately turning serious. He did not condemn Kaguya for protecting Sasha, but he was furious that she had treated her own death as an acceptable price so quickly.[165]
Victor explained that losing important people was one of the few things he genuinely feared. Kaguya was not a disposable tool whose purpose ended if sacrificing herself benefited his wife. She was his chosen maid and part of his family. The conversation strengthened a relationship that had already progressed far beyond Kaguya's original hereditary service to Violet.[165]

##### Clan Scarlett, Spearmanship and the Rules of Vampire Creation
Chapters 166–174
[[Scathach]] soon arrived in the Human World accompanied by Siena, Lacus and Pepper, moving much of Clan Scarlett into Victor's already crowded underground residence. Her stated reasons were casual, but the ease with which Scathach inserted herself into Victor's home demonstrated how comfortable she had become around him and his Human family.[166]
Victor showed the Scarlett family through the underground complex and quickly turned their stay into another opportunity for training. Rather than viewing Scathach's daughters solely as sisters-in-law, he treated them as experienced Noble Vampires whose different specialties could expose weaknesses in his own combat style.[167]
Anna's direct interaction with Scathach created an unusual family dynamic. The Human woman who had raised Victor treated the legendary Countess with a degree of normality few supernatural beings could manage. Anna also began noticing that Scathach's behavior around Victor did not resemble that of an emotionally detached mother-in-law.[168]
Scathach resumed training Siena particularly harshly after determining that her daughter had become too comfortable and had allowed portions of her combat ability to stagnate. Victor supported the severity because he understood the underlying principle from experience: Scathach's brutality during training was intended to prevent a far more permanent death when a real enemy eventually attacked.[169]
Victor then fought Ruby, Siena, Lacus and Pepper as a coordinated group. The exercise forced him to confront abilities that became considerably more dangerous when used in cooperation. After hours of combat, Victor identified specific shortcomings in himself rather than simply judging the session according to victory or defeat.[169][170]
He recognized that his attention was still better suited to fighting individual opponents than managing coordinated groups, that Siena could create and control ice more efficiently in certain situations, and that Lacus remained faster than Victor's unenhanced physical movement when he was not using Fulger lightning. The self-analysis demonstrated a major difference between Victor before and after Scathach's training: he had begun actively searching for the weaknesses exposed by combat instead of treating superior raw power as sufficient.[170]
Victor also concluded that the spear offered advantages for controlling several opponents simultaneously. He asked Scathach to teach him directly, and she immediately began introducing him to Sojutsu. The choice expanded Victor's growing ambition to become capable with many weapon types rather than restricting himself to the greatsword he had initially preferred.[171]
After another period of training, Victor asked Scathach a question directly connected to his new responsibility as a Clan founder: how did a Noble Vampire create another vampire?[172]
Scathach explained that modern vampire transformation was deliberately regulated. Under ordinary circumstances, the process required blood from a Noble Clan leader, ingredients designed to prevent the Human body from rejecting vampiric venom, the participation of a Witch and a virgin Human candidate. Different magical circles produced related rituals for marriage, subordination and transformation.[172]
The regulation existed because uncontrolled vampire creation had once been extremely dangerous. Simply biting and attempting to transform a Human carried an enormous failure rate, with most victims dying because their bodies rejected the venom. The deaths and uncontrolled predation produced through early vampire practices had contributed to violent conflict with Humanity.[172]
Victor was a major exception because of [[Sanguis Noctis Regis]]. Scathach explained that Victor could transform a virgin Human directly through his bite with a success rate effectively reaching one hundred percent, without requiring the complete Witch-assisted procedure used by ordinary Noble Vampires.[172]
The revelation gave Victor the means to turn Clan Alucard from a political title into a genuine bloodline. Until this point, Victor had been the only actual Alucard. He now knew he could personally create new vampires capable of becoming his descendants or direct subordinates.[172]
Victor also reiterated the conclusion produced by Kaguya's near death: anyone who deliberately targeted his wives or people under his protection would be hunted rather than merely repelled. His conversation with Scathach included the information gathered about General James and the strange individuals connected to the experiments, giving Victor another enemy he intended to eventually identify personally.[173]
Scathach and Kaguya also displayed growing jealousy toward one another's closeness with Victor, while Victor continued treating the Countess with physical and emotional familiarity nearly unimaginable to outsiders. Their relationship remained formally master and disciple, but no one close to them could reasonably describe it as emotionally ordinary.[173]
Elsewhere, Natashia's obsession with Victor continued developing alongside her restored maternal feelings toward Sasha. The original personality was no longer content to simply exist after being suppressed for years; Victor's constant encouragement toward greed, ambition and pursuing one's desires was steadily pushing her toward reclaiming everything she believed she had lost.[174]

##### Bruna, Eve and the First Blood of Clan Alucard
Chapters 175–186
Natashia acted upon that ambition by approaching Vlad and asking whether she required the King's permission to challenge Clan Horseman for its Count title. Vlad explained that no such permission was necessary. Beneath [[Nightingale]]'s laws remained a much older principle recognized throughout supernatural society: power ultimately determined whether someone could enforce a claim. If Natashia possessed the strength and accepted the consequences, she could challenge Niklaus herself.[175]
In the Human World, Victor encountered a completely different problem. While travelling with Kaguya, he discovered a group of [[Werewolves]] receiving captured nuns through a corrupt arrangement. One of the women was Bruna, who had been reduced to something traded between people far stronger than herself.[175]
Victor immobilized the Werewolves through ice and demonstrated that his Charm could influence them despite the resistance supernatural races were generally expected to possess against ordinary vampiric compulsion. He then freed Bruna, but deliberately refused to simply kill everyone responsible on her behalf.[176]
Instead, Victor placed the weapon in Bruna's hands and gave the victim the decision. She could leave the people who had abused and sold her alive, or she could personally avenge herself. When Bruna hesitated because of the morality and faith she had been taught, Victor rejected the idea that her abusers were entitled to forgiveness simply because violence against them would be considered sinful.[176]
Bruna chose revenge and executed the people responsible. Victor told her that refusing to remain a victim did not make her evil and offered a new path rather than demanding she return to the institution that had already failed her. Bruna accepted him and was transformed into a vampire.[177]
She was naked when he bit her. He had no ritual circle. His teeth changed, he drank a little, and something left his fangs into her body. Her sapphire-blue eyes turned blood red. She bit his neck and drank. The narration's measurement of that body is exact. Before the turn she was 170 cm with C-cup breasts. After it she was 183 cm, her body curvy, and her breasts an I-cup, bigger than [[Scathach]]'s and Ruby's. Long black hair reached her ass. Her skin was pale. The uniform later put on her was a maid outfit with slight oriental features, and it was tight. When she stood in the house, the stated height was again 183 cm, long black hair, blood-red eyes, and Ruby's reaction to those breasts was that they were bigger than hers and her mother's.[177][178] He told the nun she was not guilty. The men she had killed were the culprits. If the world blamed her and supported that blame, the world was wrong, and if the world was wrong she only needed to burn it. Everything was permitted.[177]
The transformation also redirected Bruna's enormous capacity for religious devotion. The God and institution around which her previous identity had been built had failed to answer her suffering, while Victor had appeared, freed her and allowed her to personally reclaim control of her life. Bruna consequently began developing an almost religious devotion toward Victor himself.[177]
Victor did not allow his newly created vampire to remain untested. He, Kaguya and Bruna travelled to the Werewolf settlement from which the abductors had originated. Victor taught Bruna to use basic vampiric senses and quickly noticed that a vampire created through his blood displayed unusual aptitude for someone who had only just transformed.[179]
Victor then ordered Bruna to fight. The purpose was not simply vengeance but to establish whether she possessed the will to survive the world she had chosen to enter. Kaguya corrected the inexperienced vampire during combat while Victor watched how his first direct transformation adapted to her new body.[180]
When stronger Werewolves entered the conflict, Victor ordered Kaguya to show him a "bloody spectacle." Kaguya expanded her darkness across the battlefield and used the assassination techniques of Clan Blank on a far greater scale than Bruna had previously witnessed, turning the area into a demonstration of why Victor considered Kaguya the standard his newer maids would eventually need to approach.[181]
Victor personally fought the settlement's elder, who possessed a rune-covered weapon capable of producing supernatural elemental effects. Victor's initial enthusiasm faded once the Werewolf admitted the group's involvement in abducting women. The confrontation stopped being an entertaining duel and became an execution.[182]
After killing the elder, Victor claimed the unusual weapon instead of destroying it. His habit of collecting interesting supernatural objects, techniques and enemy technology was becoming another aspect of Clan Alucard's growth; enemies were increasingly valuable not only as opponents but as sources of knowledge and equipment.[182]
Another Human victim encountered during the same period would become considerably more important. Victor found an eighteen-year-old woman whose parents had confined, starved and abused her so severely that they referred to her only as a dog. Through his supernatural perception Victor also saw an unusual feminine silhouette or presence associated with her, suggesting something existed around the apparently powerless Human that he did not yet understand.[183]
Because Victor had recently learned the requirements for transformation, he verified that the young woman met the condition necessary for his blood to convert her safely. He initially approached the situation partly from curiosity, but her request was painfully simple: she wanted to leave the hell in which she had been living.[183]
Victor killed the parents responsible for her condition and offered her a choice. She could be rescued and live elsewhere, or she could follow him into a completely different supernatural life. The woman unexpectedly asked whether she could greedily choose both freedom and transformation.[184]
Victor strongly approved. To him, greed was one of the natural qualities of a vampire: if someone possessed the ability and willingness to take both choices rather than surrender one unnecessarily, there was no reason to accept less.[184]
He renamed her Eve Alucard, declared that she would become his personal maid and bit her. The Blood of the Night King completed the transformation without the elaborate ritual required by ordinary Noble Vampires.[184]
Eve's body rapidly recovered from years of malnutrition and developed into a healthy vampire form. Her transformation also reinforced something Victor and Kaguya had already suspected: Victor's blood caused abnormal physical development in people repeatedly exposed to it. Kaguya herself had grown several centimetres after drinking his blood, while Eve changed dramatically almost immediately after conversion.[184]
Before the bite Eve was 150 cm, with long black hair that reached the floor and a malnourished body. After she drank, she was 168 cm. The hair took a healthier tone, and she finally looked like the eighteen-year-old she was. Her eyes turned blood red and she bit his neck the way Bruna had. He named her in the same breath: as of that day she was his personal maid, the first member of his Clan, Eve Alucard. The feminine silhouette that had been floating beside her disappeared when she turned. He looked for it in her body and found nothing, and he thought it had merged with her. Kaguya's change was measured in the same accounting. Before she drank his blood she was 160 cm. After she woke from the coma she had grown 5 cm.[184]
Most importantly, Eve adopted the Alucard name. Bruna served Victor, but Eve became the first actual member of Victor's newly founded Clan besides Victor himself. The Count title Vlad had created was therefore beginning to acquire a genuine bloodline beneath it.[184]
Victor returned home after a single night's excursion carrying two new female vampires and a supernatural weapon, producing the increasingly familiar reaction of his wives and family wondering how he repeatedly accumulated people and problems whenever left unsupervised.[178]
Victor explained the kind of organization he wanted. He had little interest in surrounding himself with hundreds of mediocre servants. He preferred a comparatively small [[Maid Squad]] consisting of highly capable and personally trusted individuals. Kaguya represented the current standard, while Bruna and Eve would be trained toward that level rather than treated as ornamental servants.[178]
The family then returned to the experimental prisoner identified as B-002, whose actual name was Bruno. Ruby's investigation established that Bruno was an artificial Human–Vampire hybrid whose incompatible biology was slowly destroying him. Despite possessing vampiric characteristics, he retained a Human heart and could wield significant Faith, producing a combination the Church was clearly attempting to refine.[185]
Records associated Bruno with General James and other experimental designations including S-000 and A-000. [[Carlos Reiss]] had also been promoted and was searching for Maria, giving Victor another direct path toward both Julia's surviving killer and the organization responsible for the hybrid program.[185]

##### The Lykos Family, Maria's Choice and Carlos Reiss
Chapters 187–191
Victor's connections with Werewolf society expanded when he visited Adam Lykos. Despite Adam's status within the Lykos family and Victor's position as a Vampire Count, their conversation retained elements of the professor-student relationship that had existed before Victor's transformation. Adam was one of the people who remembered Victor as a medically fragile Human rather than a supernatural anomaly.[186][187]
Victor openly admitted responsibility for the violence connected to the Werewolf settlement. His reasoning remained consistent: anyone who knowingly raised a weapon against him or his people had already accepted the possibility of retaliation. Adam did not necessarily agree with every aspect of Victor's behavior, but their previous relationship allowed disagreement without immediately turning the meeting into another racial conflict.[187]
Anderson also appeared during Victor's interactions with the Lykos family. The son of the [[Lycaon|Werewolf King]] had already become interested in Alucard and wanted a direct battle against the vampire whose growth was attracting attention across multiple factions. Victor naturally accepted the idea of a future fight.[187]
Meanwhile, Maria deliberately entered a trap arranged around Carlos. Victor and Sasha observed from a distance because they already understood that the meeting was suspicious. Victor's perception had blind spots against certain concealment techniques, preventing him from assuming that seeing no enemies meant the area was genuinely safe.[151]
Before the confrontation progressed, Victor and Sasha discussed Maria more honestly than before. During Victor's six months in [[Nightingale]], Sasha had become accustomed to Maria's quiet presence. Hatred remained because Maria had participated in Julia's death, but Maria had also spent months serving Sasha and had become woven into her daily life.[188]
Victor admitted that he had previously approached Sasha's revenge too aggressively. Attacking her parents and deciding how people responsible for her suffering should be punished had come from love, but that did not mean every decision belonged to him. Victor did not want to become a tyrant toward his own family simply because he possessed enough power to impose his preferred solution.[188]
Maria's fate therefore belonged to Sasha. Victor could protect his wife and destroy people trying to harm her, but whether Sasha wanted Maria dead, forgiven, punished or retained as a servant was ultimately Sasha's decision.[188]
The conclusion redirected their attention toward Carlos, the surviving person most directly associated with Julia's death and Maria's former life. Victor allowed the confrontation to proceed while remaining ready to intervene if Sasha's choice or safety was threatened.[188]

##### General James, the Hybrid Laboratory and Victor's Expanding Arsenal
Chapters 192–205
Victor personally confronted Carlos once the trap unfolded. Using Fulger lightning, he accelerated to speeds Carlos could barely perceive and repeatedly struck him through the air. Victor even experimented with pushing toward approximately Mach-level velocities, discovering that extreme acceleration could strain his body despite his regeneration.[189]
The confrontation was never truly designed around Carlos alone. General James was observing remotely and regarded Victor as an ideal test subject for the Hybrid Project. Artificial combatants were deployed specifically to force the Fifth Count into revealing more of his abilities.[190]
James' observers found Victor's psychology at least as dangerous as his supernatural powers. He did not behave like an ordinary young Noble who could be predicted through pride, fear or conventional political incentives. Victor actively enjoyed pressure, learned during combat and often became more dangerous after understanding what an opponent was trying to accomplish.[190]
Three experimental fighters attacked Victor together. Instead of committing to one inherited ability, Victor constantly shifted between lightning, fire, ice, Blood and physical combat, demonstrating the major advantage created by his abnormal transformation ritual. Most Noble Vampires spent centuries refining one Clan characteristic; Victor could alter the entire nature of an exchange by changing which wife's power he emphasized.[191]
The experiments ultimately fused into a larger irrational creature when their individual bodies failed to overcome him. Victor's reaction changed from excitement to disgust. He had wanted opponents capable of giving him meaningful combat, not a manufactured mass that sacrificed reason and individuality merely to increase destructive power.[192]
Victor destroyed the creation while making clear to the hidden observers that he understood he was being tested. General James consequently gained information about Alucard, but Victor simultaneously gained confirmation that the Hybrid Project was larger and more deliberate than the isolated subjects previously captured by his family.[192]
Violet and Ruby searched the supporting installation while Victor handled the combatants. Violet's instinct was to erase the entire facility with fire, but Ruby stopped her once it became clear the laboratories contained valuable research. Destroying an enemy's work immediately would satisfy anger; stealing it first would strengthen Clan Alucard.[193]
Victor later sat above the burning area on an ice throne and demonstrated considerably finer elemental control than he possessed before [[Scathach]]'s training. Rather than allowing the expanding fire to spread uncontrollably, he manipulated a massive quantity of water and rainfall to suppress the blaze when necessary.[194]
The underground laboratories contained failed hybrid subjects maintained artificially inside experimental equipment. The sight reinforced Victor and Ruby's opinion that the project was producing unstable "mongrels" by forcibly combining supernatural systems whose bodies were not naturally compatible.[194][195]
Victor gave Ruby the practical decision: burn everything or take everything. Ruby chose the second option. June and the maids were brought in to deal with magical protections while Clan Alucard systematically removed experimental equipment, records, specimens and technology from the facility.[195]
Only after everything potentially useful had been taken did Victor allow the remainder to be destroyed. The event marked a development in Clan Alucard's behavior: enemies were no longer simply obstacles to exterminate. Their accumulated technology, knowledge and resources could be absorbed into Victor's growing organization.[195]
While those events unfolded in the Human World, Natashia's preparations against Clan Horseman continued in [[Nightingale]], moving the Fulger political conflict toward another formal challenge.[196]
Victor, Sasha and Kaguya meanwhile entered a deeper hidden section of the experimental complex. The passage used supernatural runes and concealment that interfered with Victor's blood perception, demonstrating that the facility had been designed with supernatural intruders in mind rather than relying solely upon mundane security.[197]
The exploration provided Victor another opportunity to analyze his growth. Drinking Natashia's blood had improved the fine control of his lightning, and Victor combined that control with movement principles learned from Scathach and Lacus. He could accelerate with far greater precision than before, using lightning not only as a raw speed multiplier but as part of carefully controlled footwork.[198]
Sasha herself had also become faster after repeatedly drinking Victor's blood, adding to evidence that the exchange strengthened both sides of Victor's relationships rather than only allowing him to appropriate the abilities of others.[198]
The trio encountered a Nurikabe, giving Victor one of his first direct exposures to a Youkai operating under supernatural principles different from vampires, [[Werewolves]] and Church hunters. Kaguya explained that such beings were not automatically hostile and that their characteristics included powerful resistance to conventional elemental attacks.[198][199]
Victor's immediate desire was naturally to test himself against the unfamiliar creature, while Sasha and Kaguya provided the practical restraint necessary to prevent every new supernatural discovery from becoming a battle. The encounter broadened Victor's understanding of how many systems existed beyond the races with which he had already become familiar.[199]
Elsewhere, Ruby continued overseeing the removal of the laboratory. Eve's introduction of herself under the Alucard surname reinforced to outsiders that Victor's new Clan was no longer merely a title occupied by one individual.[200]
Transporting the enormous quantity of stolen equipment eventually required Natalia's dimensional abilities. Victor and Sasha still found time to turn portions of the operation into personal competition before regrouping with the others.[201]
When Natalia opened the necessary portal, Victor entered before the situation had been completely organized. His peculiar luck immediately complicated matters again: instead of quietly returning to the expected location, he emerged directly inside the Lost Club, placing the Fifth Count in the middle of another supernatural gathering without warning.[202]

##### Roberta, Maria's Rebirth and the Expanding Alucard Household
Chapters 206–217
Victor's sudden appearance at the Lost Club produced immediate tension among its patrons. His reputation had changed dramatically since the earlier days when Ruby could visit the establishment without everyone associating her with an internationally notorious new Count. Victor was now known as Alucard, [[Scathach]]'s disciple and the source of several supernatural incidents.[203]
The encounter with Johnny became less hostile once Victor discovered that the Alpha was Adam Lykos' eldest son. Victor's respect for Adam extended enough protection to his family that Johnny ceased being merely an irritating Werewolf and instead became part of a household Victor already valued.[204]
A much stranger figure attracted Victor's attention: Roberta. Something about the memories and behavior surrounding her did not fit together correctly. Victor eventually discovered that Roberta possessed a power capable of implanting or manipulating memories, and the side effects had already caused serious harm to people around her.[205]
The ability did not affect Victor normally because of his unusually powerful Soul and will. Instead of concluding that Roberta needed to die, Victor became interested in what such a person could eventually become. Memory manipulation represented an extraordinarily dangerous ability, but also one with obvious uses to a Clan operating in both Human and supernatural society.[205]
Victor therefore had Kaguya obtain an advanced magical contract. Roberta was given broad freedom with one absolute restriction: she could not harm or manipulate individuals Victor designated as protected. Rather than demanding complete obedience, Victor constructed boundaries around what he actually cared about and allowed Roberta to remain herself everywhere else.[206]
Bringing another dangerous woman home naturally caused friction with Victor's wives and maids, particularly because Roberta's personality did not immediately mesh with figures such as Bruna or Sasha. For Victor, however, unusual personalities were not a reason for rejection so long as the person understood the boundaries surrounding his family.[206]
The household then returned to Carlos and Maria. Maria began carrying out the revenge Sasha had finally chosen to permit, physically consuming Carlos while keeping him alive through regeneration. Sasha initially forced herself to watch because she believed witnessing the result was her responsibility.[207]
Victor recognized that Sasha was not enjoying what she had demanded. He stopped her and told her that kindness was not a weakness she needed to destroy simply because the supernatural world was cruel. Sasha did not need to force herself to become emotionally identical to Victor in order to survive.[207]
When Natashia argued that Sasha would eventually have to dirty her own hands, Victor disagreed. His answer revealed the protective extreme into which his worldview had developed: if the world contained filth his wives did not wish to confront, Victor would handle it himself. He wanted them capable of defending themselves, but did not believe strength required deliberately destroying the qualities he loved in them.[207]
Victor then turned toward Maria. Her Ghoul condition made her unstable, hungry and emotionally unreliable. Victor told Maria to remember her fear of him whenever hunger or disloyalty threatened Sasha, but he simultaneously acknowledged her as his maid.[207]
Victor bit Maria and introduced his own vampiric essence into her. Maria instinctively drank directly from Victor in return, and the incompatible fragments inside her merged into something more complete. Her scars disappeared, her physical condition stabilized and her eyes became permanently red like those of Victor's other direct creations.[207]
Maria was no longer the defective Ghoul created through Sasha's uncontrolled revenge transformation. Victor had reconstructed her into a full-fledged Noble Vampire connected directly to himself while preserving her place beside Sasha.[207][208]
What Maria did to Carlos before that bite was not left abstract. She tore a chunk of meat out of his neck, bit another piece, thrust a hand into his stomach, pulled the liver out and swallowed it whole. Victor stopped Sasha from forcing herself to watch. His words were that she did not have to deal with the filth of the world, because he was there for that. None of his wives had to deal with the rot. They needed to be as they were: beautiful, bloodthirsty, and immaculate. He would take care of the rest, and the smile on his face distorted until it barely looked like a face. He bit Maria's neck. Something already inside her merged with what he put in, and the narration compares the merge to yin and yang. It was still incomplete until she bit his neck and drank from the source. The crater-like scars disappeared. Her skin became healthier and paler. Her blonde hair loosened, grew a little, and took a more vivid color. Her eyes, like Eve's and Bruna's, became permanently blood-red.[207]
Victor then used Carlos for experimentation of his own. Through Blood and the altered supernatural material inside Carlos, Victor separated the vampiric components from the Human body and searched the man's memories. The process confirmed Victor's judgment that the artificial hybrids were not truly balanced combinations; their incompatible systems had simply been forced together.[208][209]
Most importantly, Victor finally obtained the appearance of General James. He still did not know precisely where the man was, but James was no longer an abstract name behind reports and laboratories. Victor now possessed a face he could recognize when the inevitable confrontation occurred.[208]
Victor kept Carlos alive rather than granting him death because Ruby could use him as an experimental specimen. The decision reflected the same change already seen in the stolen laboratory: Clan Alucard had begun turning defeated enemies into resources instead of automatically destroying them.[209]
Violet, meanwhile, was in a rare good mood with peacetime finally arriving. She bought pretty hot lingerie and planned a week of deepening her relationship with Victor: liquids flying everywhere, the goose being petted, and her cave explored. Fate interrupted when she spotted a red-haired woman in the hall.[209]
In another scene, a maid with a seductive body and an older woman whose body rivaled the maids' appeared. Natashia had long golden hair. Roberta wore a tight maid uniform. Bruna, Eve and Roberta were subjectively beautiful.[210]
Scathach also noticed another disturbing aspect of Victor's development. Mature vampires were expected to require extremely long periods before their basic existence naturally increased in power, yet Victor appeared to be strengthening continuously in ways unrelated to simple technique. The rate at which his body and Blood evolved remained abnormal even after accounting for [[Sanguis Noctis Regis]].[211]
Victor finally turned his attention back toward promises made to his wives. He intended to give each woman periods of time belonging specifically to her rather than treating the marriage as a permanent group relationship. Violet had already received the [[Paris]] date, so Victor chose Ruby for the next extended outing.[212]
Victor refused to postpone the trip even when Natashia's coming Count challenge promised exactly the kind of battle he normally loved watching. Ruby's time took priority over entertainment. Before leaving, however, Victor deliberately motivated Natashia by telling her to defeat Niklaus decisively and make Sasha proud. When Natashia pushed the conversation toward what she might receive afterward, Victor told her that if she reached that point, they would talk.[212]
Natashia interpreted the ambiguous promise with enormous enthusiasm. The other women immediately understood that Victor had intentionally given the obsessive Fulger another source of motivation rather than making an explicit romantic commitment.[213]
Victor also clarified practical authority within the growing household before departing. Kaguya, because of her experience, contract and direct position beside Victor, was effectively the senior operational maid. Eve carried the Alucard surname and potentially possessed greater formal Clan significance in the future, but she remained far too inexperienced to command merely because she was Victor's first bloodline member.[213]
Victor and Ruby then left together, deliberately taking a slower journey rather than travelling by the fastest supernatural means available. For Victor, the travel itself was part of spending time with his wife rather than an inconvenience delaying the destination.[213]

##### Ruby's Date and the North Pole Castle
Chapters 218–223
Victor's absence affected the maids he had personally created more strongly than he initially realized. Bruna and Eve had built much of their new identities around Victor after being rescued and transformed by him, making even a temporary unexplained separation emotionally difficult for them. Kaguya increasingly understood that Victor functioned not merely as their employer but as the emotional foundation around which his direct creations organized their new lives.[214]
While Victor remained away, Anderson arrived near the Walker residence looking for the battle Victor had previously promised. His heritage attracted the attention of [[Scathach]] and Natashia because Anderson was not an ordinary Alpha Werewolf; his maternal lineage contained Divine characteristics that would later become important during his fight with Victor.[215]
The household simultaneously prepared to return to [[Nightingale]] for Natashia's challenge. Violet's casual reference to the Human residence as their home illustrated how completely Victor had merged people who originally came from entirely different worlds. Nightingale remained the ancestral homeland of the vampire wives, but Earth had become their family home as well.[216]
Victor and Ruby eventually reached the North Pole. Ruby initially questioned Victor's idea of romance when the date involved an extreme frozen wilderness, but Victor's behavior quickly broke through her usual composure. Even encounters with local animals became a source of comedy when Victor predictably considered taking interesting creatures home and Ruby had to remind him that a date did not require adopting everything they encountered.[217][218]
Victor's actual gift to Ruby was considerably more meaningful. Using Scarlett ice, he constructed an enormous ice castle in the polar environment. The feat required a completely different level of control from simply freezing opponents or creating battlefield structures. Victor had to shape countless fine details while maintaining a stable enormous construction, demonstrating how far his ice manipulation had progressed.[218]
The castle belonged specifically to Ruby. When destruction or impermanence of the structure was mentioned, Ruby immediately rejected the idea because the value was not merely the material object but the fact that Victor had created it personally for her.[219]
Their relationship also became physically intimate for the first time during the private stay. What had begun with an abnormal magical ritual that connected two strangers had, over the months since Victor's transformation, become a consciously chosen marriage built through shared blood, trust, combat, family and affection.[219]
Victor's feelings toward Ruby therefore could no longer be explained merely through the supernatural compulsion of their original bond. The woman he had once instinctively sensed without even knowing her identity had become someone he loved for her own personality, ambitions and peculiarities.[219]

##### The Fulger–Horseman Rematch and Vlad's Time Trap
Chapters 224–234
Approximately three days later, Natashia's challenge against [[Niklaus Horseman]] began in [[Nightingale]]. The confrontation was considerably more serious than the earlier Clan game. Natashia intended to reclaim the Vampire Count title lost by Clan Fulger, while Niklaus entered possessing abilities he had never fully exposed during his family's previous appearances.[220]
The match became a major public spectacle attended by Nightingale's powerful families and the Royal Household. Sasha openly supported her mother, reflecting the enormous change produced since Natashia's original personality resurfaced. The woman Sasha had once regarded almost entirely through fear and resentment was now someone actively attempting to become a parent worthy of her daughter.[221]
Natashia entered using a Western sword rather than the daggers commonly associated with the Fulger fighting style. Sasha initially questioned the choice, but the battle reinforced that hereditary Clan powers did not require every user to fight identically. Natashia's accumulated experience extended beyond simply reproducing the techniques expected from her bloodline.[222]
The rules permitted a lethal conclusion, and the arena required extensive reinforcement to withstand attacks produced by two ancient vampires fighting seriously.[223]
Natashia gradually released the true speed and destructive output of Fulger lightning. Her objective had become larger than reclaiming political prestige. Victor's challenge to improve herself, Sasha's opinion of her and Natashia's own desire to stop living passively had all become personal reasons to win.[224]
The output of that lightning was not a gesture. Her eyes glowed gold. Lightning armor covered her. The sword hummed gold. One downward arc minced Niklaus. Black liquid rebuilt his entire body. A concentrated beam from her palm erased his body and everything in front of her. He stabbed the blade into the ground and black water surged out as tentacles, trying to cover her and pierce her. She brought the sword down vertically. A gigantic pillar of golden energy erupted from the blade.[224]
Niklaus eventually exposed a monstrous transformation involving dark characteristics he had previously concealed. Even ancient observers such as [[Scathach]] and Agnes became more cautious as the Horseman Count demonstrated that his public strength had never represented everything he possessed.[224][225]
Niklaus pierced Natashia's heart and appeared close to killing her. Victor and Ruby returned from their date during the climax of the fight, with Ophis immediately announcing Victor's arrival by calling out to her "Father."[225]
The form that had her was no longer the man in the helmet. Long black bat wings, a spiked tail, an all-black body, dark-gray skin, blood-red eyes and claws. He held her by the neck and drove a claw through her heart. She was in golden armor. When the armor broke, a white bra was what the chapter records on her. She cut his arm off with the golden lightning sword and the blade stopped on his skin. He punched her, cracked her skull, and she dropped unconscious still holding the sword. Regeneration brought her back with lifeless eyes. He pulled the heart out, threw her down hard enough to break every bone in her back and leave a spiderweb crater, burst the heart and drank it. Black miasma left him. He cut her into hands, legs, chest and head. The last blow at her head did not land. Lightning struck. Victor bit Niklaus's sword and destroyed it with his teeth. He pointed his palm, said "Burn," and a gigantic beam of fire blew Niklaus away. Victor held Natashia's head and screamed her name, Annasthashia Fulger.[225]
The pressure of near death forced Natashia and Annasthashia to confront one another inside their shared mind. Rather than continuing to behave as two personalities attempting to replace each other, they began recognizing that both represented parts of the same existence and that cooperation could make them stronger than either was alone.[226]
Victor intervened when Natashia's life became genuinely threatened. His blood rapidly strengthened her regeneration and helped her recover from the debilitating condition inflicted by Niklaus, allowing the confrontation to continue instead of ending with Sasha losing her mother.[226]
Niklaus protested Victor's interference, but Natashia resumed the battle with renewed strength. The display also attracted outside interest toward Victor's blood because the speed and magnitude with which it affected other vampires could no longer be dismissed as merely a peculiarity of his three wives.[227]
The battle ended in a way almost nobody expected: Niklaus surrendered. He still appeared to possess unrevealed abilities, yet voluntarily gave up the title rather than continuing to a lethal conclusion.[228]
Victor was furious. Niklaus had nearly killed Natashia and exposed hidden power only to withdraw before the confrontation reached the conclusion Victor believed the Count had willingly accepted. To Victor, the surrender made the entire fight feel manipulated rather than honestly decided.[228]
Natashia nevertheless regained the Count position for Clan Fulger. Scathach and Agnes remained deeply suspicious because both had sensed that Niklaus deliberately withheld part of his real capability.[229]
The celebrations and reunion then exposed something far stranger. Scathach noticed changes in Victor's appearance, particularly the considerable growth of his hair. Ruby revealed that the separation between the pair and the people inside Nightingale had lasted approximately one year and six months from their perspective.[229]
Nightingale had not merely been inaccessible. Vlad had used the abilities of [[Clan Alioth]] and the realm itself to alter the relationship between time inside and outside Nightingale. Victor and Ruby had consequently lived through vastly more time than most of the family they had been unable to reach.[229]
Scathach immediately understood what Vlad had done because he had once used a similar strategy against her. Approximately one thousand years earlier, Vlad had removed Scathach from events by trapping her away from Nightingale for twenty years because her uncontrollable personality would have interfered with his plans. Scathach had remained furious over the manipulation for centuries afterward.[230]
She confronted Vlad and warned him that repeating that strategy against Victor was significantly more dangerous than he seemed to understand. Victor was intensely spiteful toward people who manipulated his family, remembered grudges and possessed no instinctive loyalty toward the King strong enough to make him simply accept the intrusion.[230]
Whatever political purpose Vlad had achieved through closing Nightingale, he had also forcibly taken most of Victor's family away from him for roughly eighteen months of Victor's experienced life. Scathach made clear that her disciple would not forget that fact.[230]

##### Reunion, the Witch Queen's Interest and Anderson's Challenge
Chapters 235–244
Victor finally settled back among the family from whom he had been separated. Through the connections surrounding him he could feel the presence of his maids and wives again, while the household immediately noticed behavioral differences created during the lost year.[231]
Ruby had been the one original wife who remained physically beside Victor throughout the separation and had therefore become one of his most important stabilizing influences during that period. Eve had also grown substantially closer to Ruby over the lost year, creating relationships within Clan Alucard that had developed independently while [[Nightingale]] remained inaccessible.[231]
Victor's new political role also began receiving more practical interpretation. Eleonor joked that Victor's responsibility for exploring and discovering new lands effectively made him her territorial neighbor because her Count responsibilities existed along Nightingale's dangerous frontiers.[232]
Ophis' attachment had survived Victor's disappearance unchanged. She comfortably sat on him and drank from his wrist, while Victor openly referred to the princess as his daughter and made clear that he intended to preserve her happiness regardless of whether the Royal Family found their relationship politically convenient.[232]
Elsewhere, Niklaus and Theo discussed the failure of their plans and Victor's increasingly dangerous position. Niklaus no longer treated Alucard as merely an unusually promising newborn. Victor had accumulated recognition from Vlad, [[Scathach]], Natashia and other major supernatural powers while continuing to grow at an abnormal rate.[233]
The conspiracy surrounding Experiment [[Nero Elderblood|Number Zero]] also remained active, with possible applications extending beyond the original Hybrid Project toward weapons capable of affecting entire supernatural populations.[233]
The Witch Queen likewise became increasingly interested in Victor. Reports from her daughter emphasized that Victor routinely violated expected supernatural customs yet somehow accumulated loyalty rather than universal rejection. His personality, political position and responsibility for exploration made Clan Alucard potentially valuable to a Witch society heavily dependent upon access to rare resources.[234]
Attempts to investigate Victor through Fate produced an even stranger result. Powerful divination failed to locate him normally, and people closely associated with Victor—including several of his wives and major relatives—were becoming increasingly difficult to track through the same methods. Whatever surrounded Victor appeared to interfere with supernatural Fate observation beyond what his age should permit.[234]
Anderson eventually arrived personally at Scathach's estate to collect the fight Victor had promised him, announcing his presence with the demand that Alucard come out and face him.[235]
Victor accepted immediately. Rather than treating the encounter as a private spar, he deliberately allowed his wives, maids and family to observe because part of the objective was to show them how he had changed during the lost year.[236]
Four maids emerged directly from Victor's shadow during the preparations: Kaguya, Roberta, Bruna and Eve. Roberta had therefore become part of Victor's [[Maid Squad]] during the period away from Nightingale, another development that had occurred outside the family's view.[236]
Kaguya deployed her darkness across the surrounding territory as a defensive domain while the other maids secured the area. Victor himself created an enormous ice arena whose quality immediately attracted Scathach's attention. The fine control required to produce the structure was far beyond the rough battlefield ice Victor possessed before the lost year.[236]
He told his maids it was time, and his shadow grew until red eyes and hands covered in darkness came out of it. Kaguya's eyes went blood-red. She disappeared and stood in the sky in a French maid dress, with a shadow realm of pure darkness already laid over the ground. Victor snapped his fingers and the arena floor formed under that darkness. He jumped in and asked Anderson whether they fought with weapons or without. Anderson said whatever. Victor made two ice gloves and took a martial stance. A dark red aura covered him. A coin was dropped. When it rang, both auras exploded, they vanished, and they collided in the middle. The opening exchanges were that fast: defend and attack, dodge and attack, then both jumped back and collided again. The magic circles on his gloves were already glowing.[236]
Victor initially fought Anderson barehanded using a foundation that combined Scathach's instruction with martial knowledge he had acquired elsewhere during the previous year. Ruby explained that Victor had spent substantial time around Mizuki after the latter's relationship with the Inquisition changed, allowing him to absorb even more techniques rather than limiting himself to purely vampiric martial arts.[236]
As the battle escalated, Victor created different weapons and repeatedly changed his fighting style. His objective had expanded beyond becoming competent with one greatsword or spear. Victor wanted enough familiarity with many weapons that he could always select the correct tool for the opponent and situation before him.[237][238]
Scathach recognized the ambition immediately. Victor was attempting to build the foundation of someone capable of fighting effectively with virtually anything rather than becoming a specialist restricted to one martial discipline.[238]
Victor's improved focus was not perfect. During one exchange he became so absorbed in Anderson that he sent the Werewolf dangerously close to spectators, forcing Scathach to correct him. Victor immediately acknowledged the mistake instead of allowing pride to excuse it, another indication that his master still occupied a unique position in his development.[238]
Anderson eventually revealed power derived from his unusual heritage and invoked an attack associated with a beast devouring the heavens. Natashia considered intervening because of the danger, but Scathach understood Victor well enough to stop her. Taking the opponent away from Victor when he had consciously chosen to confront the attack would anger him more than allowing him to face the danger himself.[239]
Victor could have attempted to avoid the technique but instead confronted it directly, using the attack as another measurement of his improved body and defenses. His resistance shocked observers who expected the Divine-infused Werewolf technique to overwhelm an ordinary vampire.[239]
More surprising was Victor's decision to end the fight voluntarily. The younger Victor would likely have continued until one combatant could no longer stand. The Victor who had lived through another eighteen months understood that exhausting every possibility immediately could waste future opportunities.[239][240]
Victor explained that the current battlefield could not safely contain the level of combat he and Anderson might eventually reach. He had already accomplished the objectives that mattered: testing his development, showing Scathach what he had learned and demonstrating enough strength to motivate the people around him.[240]
Anderson remained dissatisfied but accepted that the rivalry could continue later. Victor had therefore developed something he possessed very little of at the beginning of the story: patience. Delaying gratification could produce a considerably better battle in the future.[240]
The chapter ended by returning to a more dangerous unresolved enemy. Demon scouts connected to [[Belial]] had been captured around Victor's territory, and Victor directly engaged the Demon Duke through one of his subordinates, reconnecting the present storyline to events that had occurred during the lost year.[240]

##### The Lost Year, Aphrodite and War with Belial
Chapters 245–249
The narrative then returned in a flashback to the period after [[Nightingale]] had been sealed, explaining what Victor and Ruby had experienced during the year and a half missing from the perspective of their family. The flashback began approximately two months after the closure, although Victor and Ruby had recognized the problem much earlier.[241]
For the first several days after their North Pole date, Victor and Ruby assumed access to Nightingale would be restored quickly. Natalia became unreachable, magical communications failed and the usual paths into the vampire realm stopped functioning. By the third day, it was obvious the separation was deliberate rather than a temporary magical malfunction.[241]
Victor's frustration rapidly became anger because Violet, Sasha, [[Scathach]] and much of the rest of his family remained inside. Esther was contacted for alternatives, but reliable information about a realm intentionally sealed by the Vampire King was extremely difficult to obtain.[241]
Several possibilities were discussed, including approaching exceptionally powerful Witches or supernatural beings associated with time and space. One accessible option was [[Aphrodite]], the Greek Goddess of Love and Beauty.[241]
Ruby strongly objected because Aphrodite's Divine authority influenced attraction, love and desire. To Ruby, sending her husband into the presence of a Goddess whose existence itself could manipulate the emotions she considered most important was fundamentally different from meeting an ordinary attractive woman.[241]
Kaguya challenged Ruby's impulse to withhold the option from Victor. Victor resolved the disagreement by distinguishing protection from control. Ruby was allowed to be jealous and afraid, but important information should still be shared within a marriage; Victor could then choose what risk he was willing to accept.[241]
Victor eventually decided to meet Aphrodite because obtaining access to his family mattered more than his discomfort around the Goddess. He asked Ruby to remain safe because she was the only one of his original wives still physically beside him. Losing or endangering Ruby while already separated from Violet and Sasha was a possibility Victor refused to tolerate.[242]
Kaguya remained responsible for protecting Victor's parents and household while he pursued the lead.[242]
Victor encountered Aphrodite while she was dealing with [[Belial]], a Demon Duke persistently attempting to obtain her attention. Aphrodite's Divine beauty immediately affected Victor's perception. He began seeing qualities reminding him of the women he loved and had to consciously separate the Goddess standing before him from Violet, Ruby, Sasha and the other people stored within his emotional associations.[243]
What he walked into was a woman in a Greek dress, long pink hair to the floor, pink eyes, perfectly shaped full breasts, a little slender waist, and a very modest and pert ass. Belial, standing there as one of the seventy-two Dukes of Hell, was tall, with short black hair and blood-red eyes. Belial called Scathach a bitch and said he wanted to meet her because Victor was her disciple. Victor's face turned into pure darkness, his eyes blood-red, the room covered in dark energy. He made a blood dagger covered in lightning and cut the body hundreds of thousands of times, then held the head and discharged. The head exploded.[243]
Belial then insulted Scathach. Whatever caution Victor possessed regarding Aphrodite disappeared immediately. Victor attacked the body Belial was using, combining lightning and Blood without caring that the target represented a powerful Duke of Hell.[243]
Victor's reasoning was extremely simple: Belial's political rank did not grant permission to insult someone Victor loved. The attack caught Aphrodite's attention because most beings who understood Belial's position would have calculated the consequences before acting.[243]
Victor asked Aphrodite for information concerning Nightingale rather than pursuing the conflict further. Aphrodite contacted [[Kairos]], a Divine authority associated with time, to determine what had happened to the vampire realm.[243]
Aphrodite later attempted to demonstrate that she was not Victor's enemy by allowing more of her natural Divine influence to become perceptible. Victor's reaction revealed how seriously he treated mental interference. When desire began affecting his mind, Victor drove ice directly through his own head to interrupt the influence and relied upon regeneration to survive the self-inflicted injury.[244]
The extreme response made clear that Victor preferred physical damage to allowing an outside power to alter emotions he considered his own. Aphrodite recognized that continuing to exert the effect would transform his caution into genuine hostility.[244]
Kairos confirmed the essential truth: Vlad had closed Nightingale and altered its temporal relationship with the outside world. Victor finally knew that his inability to return was not an accident.[244]
Aphrodite also possessed a personal connection Victor did not fully appreciate during the meeting. Anna was described as Aphrodite's only Human friend, meaning helping Victor allowed the Goddess to consider a debt connected to his mother repaid.[244]
Before departing, Victor manipulated the continuing problem between Aphrodite and Belial. He deliberately encouraged the Demon to believe Aphrodite might actually possess hidden interest in him, pushing Belial to continue a pursuit the Goddess already found irritating. Aphrodite eventually retaliated against Belial with a curse that rendered the Demon Duke impotent.[244]
Belial blamed Victor for the humiliation.[245]
The final chapter returned to the present confrontation following Victor's fight with Anderson. Through a possessed subordinate, Belial accused Victor not only of causing Aphrodite's curse but of repeatedly interfering with the Demon's interests during the lost year.[245]
Those accusations revealed how Victor had spent much of the forced separation. He had not remained at home waiting for Nightingale to reopen. Victor and his maids conducted increasingly frequent nightly excursions against criminals, hostile supernatural beings and people Victor considered deserving of punishment. Rapists, murderers, predatory vampires and other targets became both outlets for his anger and practical experience for the growing [[Maid Squad]].[245]
Without most of his family physically around him, Victor became noticeably crueler. Ruby remained his strongest emotional anchor during the period, but even she recognized that the separation encouraged portions of Victor's personality that his wider family normally moderated.[245]
Roberta became incorporated into Victor's Maid Squad during this period, explaining her presence beside Kaguya, Bruna and Eve during the later Anderson fight.[245]
Approximately six months into the separation, Victor had also interfered with demonic activity connected to Belial, protected a young girl involved in the incident and later hunted down and killed Belial's heir. The Demon Duke therefore possessed a grievance against Victor extending far beyond Aphrodite's curse.[245]
Belial effectively declared that conflict between them had become unavoidable. Victor responded by destroying the possessed subordinate rather than attempting reconciliation.[245]
He then transformed the Demon remains and another highly destructive material in his possession into a compressed black sphere powerful enough to devastate an enormous area. Victor ordered a small portal opened directly above Belial's castle and prepared to send the weapon through it.[245]
Victor did not announce the attack under his own name.
Instead, immediately before throwing the destructive sphere through the portal, Victor loudly declared:
“I, [[Beelzebub]], declare war on Belial!”
He fabricated a motive claiming Belial had devoured Beelzebub's wife, deliberately attempting to make the attack appear to originate from another major Demon and potentially provoke hostility between two powers of Hell.[245]
The weapon crossed the portal and detonated over Belial's territory while Victor laughed at the result. What had begun as a personal dispute was therefore deliberately transformed into a false-flag attack capable of generating conflict inside Hell itself.[245]
The ending demonstrated the fundamental development Victor underwent across A New Pillar. At the beginning of the Volume he had only just received the political title of Count and was still learning what possessing a Clan actually meant. By its conclusion, he had exterminated hostile Noble Clans, begun mastering Blood independently of his wives' inherited powers, learned how vampire creation functioned, personally created Bruna and Eve, established Eve as the first member of Clan Alucard, expanded an elite Maid Squad, absorbed enemy technology and experimental research, identified General James, rebuilt Maria from an unstable Ghoul into a Noble Vampire, influenced Natashia's restoration of Clan Fulger, deepened his mastery of multiple weapons, lived through approximately eighteen months of additional growth outside Nightingale, interacted directly with Gods and Demon Dukes and deliberately attempted to manipulate Hell's internal politics through deception.
