Victor was no longer merely an abnormal newborn reacting to supernatural events created by older powers. Clan Alucard had begun acquiring its own people, knowledge, enemies and ambitions, while Victor himself had become increasingly willing to create the very chaos that the supernatural world had once inflicted upon him.[245]

#### Volume 4: Discoveries, Changes, And War
Chapters 250–500

##### Hell's Response and Victor's Limits
Chapters 250–258
The consequences of Victor's activities during the eighteen months he spent separated from most of his family continued following him after his return to [[Nightingale]]. In Hell, [[Belial]] remained enraged by Victor's interference, particularly the death of one of his sons and the humiliation surrounding [[Aphrodite]]. The Demon Duke wanted retaliation directed not merely against Victor but against someone Victor actually valued, understanding that attacking his family would cause far greater pain than attempting to kill the Vampire directly.[246]
The rage had a room. Belial's castle, a gigantic duke on a throne, and a small demon butler with long wings, two horns and a butler's suit asking what had happened. Belial's answer was to prepare a body for him in the human world and call the generals. The son was dead, the humiliation was Aphrodite, and the payment he wanted was not Victor. It was the people Victor valued. A voice came out of the sky and stole the moment. I, [[Beelzebub]], declare war on Belial. You son of a bitch, you will pay for eating my wife. Belial heard his own name in it and then he heard the name that was actually behind the voice. Alucard. You will pay for this, Alucard. The fist that followed destroyed his own city. A mushroom cloud, a pillar of fire, subordinate demons running. Far off, an imp with blue skin and golden lizard eyes and the other small demons watched a duke survive his own temper and started talking about the treasures. The gate was already unstable. [[Diablo]], who wanted the war on humans and had broken the old key with Lilith, had forbidden allies to fight each other unless the fight was personal, and the gaps in the gate were already letting the low ranks through. Victor was not in Hell. He was with his wives, laughing, and he told them the prank. The cheating charge had been his. Natashia's mood lifted, and they went to eat.[246]
The situation also expanded Victor's understanding of Hell itself. The strongest Demons could not simply move their true bodies into the Human World whenever they wished. The barriers separating Hell, Earth and other supernatural realms restricted movement, while powerful Demons often needed possession, avatars, artifacts or openings between dimensions to act outside their home realm. The ancient key once associated with [[Lucifer]] had been broken, with its pieces becoming important to the ability of major Demonic powers to establish passages between worlds.[246][247]
Victor's attempt to disguise one of his previous attacks as the work of Beelzebub had not fooled every ancient Demon. Diablo, whose age and authority placed him among Hell's oldest powers, realized that the voice and behavior involved did not properly match Beelzebub. Rather than immediately allowing Victor's deception to create unrestricted conflict among Hell's major factions, Diablo ordered the matter investigated.[247] Back in Nightingale, Victor recounted portions of the lost year to [[Scathach]], Violet, Sasha and Natashia. Ruby had been the wife physically beside him throughout the entire separation and had therefore witnessed a version of Victor that the others had not: a man growing increasingly violent and ruthless while being denied access to most of his family for what he personally experienced as approximately a year and a half.[247]
Victor also recognized a problem that technique alone could not immediately solve. The additional year had drastically improved his martial arts, elemental control, Blood manipulation and practical combat experience, but his underlying vampiric body remained extremely young. Vampires naturally increased the limits of their physical and supernatural power as they aged, meaning Victor had begun approaching a bottleneck where his skill was developing much faster than the raw power his age currently allowed him to produce.[247][248]
Victor briefly considered whether the time manipulation associated with [[Clan Alioth]] could circumvent that problem by allowing him to experience far more years than passed normally, but immediately disliked the idea of becoming dependent upon Vlad or another Clan merely to grow. Scathach's answer was much simpler: Victor still possessed countless things he could refine before biological age truly became the only obstacle, so there was no reason to waste time complaining about a limit he could not yet change.[248]
Ruby likewise resumed serious training. Although she had begun accessing the transformed state associated with powerful members of Clan Scarlett, possessing more power without sufficient control would only create another unstable weapon. Scathach consequently continued extending her training beyond Victor himself to the people closest to him.[248] Victor then returned to several unresolved matters from before Nightingale had been sealed. His attention returned to Eleonor Adrasteia, the enormous gorilla he had befriended in the wilderness, and the mysterious blood-consuming tree the creature protected.[249][250]
Violet came down the stairs with Scathach and Ruby and found Lilith and Elizabeth already angry about their sister. Ophis was mumbling that she was hungry and that she wanted blood. Elizabeth had been there when the girl drank from Victor. She had thought one drop would only mark him. She had not expected the addiction. Lilith's mouth opened on the other half of it. Had Ophis marked him, and why had nobody been told. Violet told them to hold on. The silence that followed was the kind that happens when a secret is trying not to be a secret. She demanded the explanation. Lilith, as the eldest, said they could not tell it even if they wanted to, and she pointed at her throat. Scathach named it. A contract. She had not thought Vlad would put that on his own daughters, and she looked at Ophis, who looked back with an innocent face and then realized she could follow Victor. The child's eyes went blood red. Elizabeth appeared behind her, caught the gothic dress the way a mother catches a kitten, and told her not to do it and not to lie. Ophis felt wronged. Elizabeth said she had been with her long enough to know the quirks, and that the girl had become troublesome since she found him. Ruby asked if the mark could at least be described. The contract was absolute. Lilith said it was not harmful to the man. In a way it was a blessing, and she was a little jealous of it. Pressed on what blessing meant, she could not say. She would only add that it was not a bad thing, and that in time it might help Ophis become an ordinary girl. The three of them clicked their tongues at a secret they were not allowed to have.[249]
The subject changed because Kaguya was gone. Pepper tried to push the telling onto Lacus. Siena said it herself. Victor had kidnapped Eleonor. He had been in the house acting like a hooligan, and Siena was surprised the rest of them had not heard the argument. Scathach started to say that was not an attitude worthy of her disciple and got cut off. He had taken after her mother's quirks. Pepper mimicked him. You come with me to a place. Ophis said father, because the aura on Pepper was a smaller version of his. Pepper said he had been a lot like her mom when her mom wanted something. Scathach smiled and said she had taught him right. If he wanted a thing, he should get it. Siena asked why that lesson had not been given to them. Scathach said she had not needed to. They already had the attitude. Pepper swore she was not a hooligan. Siena reminded her of a manga shop in Japan, a limited edition called One Bikini, a seller who would not sell, charm used, and the book walked out unpaid even after an offer of ten times the price. Pepper pointed at Lacus and the gaming event called E9, where every exclusive had been taken by hypnotizing the employees. Lacus reminded her of the promise to keep that secret. Pepper's answer was that if she was going down she was taking everyone with her. Violet clarified the insult aimed at Siena. She had been a bitch from the start. Ruby said Siena treated anyone who was not a vampire like cattle. Lilith's conclusion was that vampires were equal in one respect. They were all authoritarian. Pepper sat on the couch and pouted that she at least paid. Sometimes. Ophis repeated the word bitch. Elizabeth's eyes went blood red. She did not want the child growing up like Violet. Violet told her to say it to her face and settle it outside, and the air around her warmed. The argument was still rising when the page left it.[249]
He went through the kitchen, put Eve on his back, and told her to hold on tighter or she would fall. Lightning streaked where he had been. Maria screamed that Eve had been kidnapped and that she had wanted to go too. Bruna, cleaning a window, envied it in a mutter. Luna wondered if jealousy was the correct response. Natalia said his maids had a few loose screws. Maria told them they would not understand. For the maids he was the beginning of everything, and serving him was the pleasure. Bruna agreed, arms crossed, face a little red at thoughts a maid was not supposed to have in a kitchen. Then she noticed Roberta at the table with red tea and asked why the woman was doing nothing. Roberta, gentle, offered to help. Maria and Bruna remembered broken plates, glasses, silverware, and a kitchen on fire, and they refused at once. In the French maid uniform she still looked, to the two of them, like a failure of a maid.[250]
Outside, he held Eleonor tighter while her eyes rolled from the speed. He put more strength into the legs and more lightning through the body. The ground took a spiderweb crater and he went up to a real altitude. His eyes went blood red. Black clouds formed with no rain, charged, a pathway stretching for thousands of kilometers. His body turned pure gold, and the two women with him turned with it, and they disappeared into the clouds. Sasha and Natashia stopped following because they could not name what they had just seen. Natashia thought it was closer to traveling through the clouds than to flying. She reached for Scathach's old trick, the one that turned a body part into ice, and for Ruby's version of it, water turned to ice as a defense. Lightning was not supposed to work that way. She covered her hand anyway. The flesh went to pure lightning. She moved it and the hand seemed to disappear. When she stopped, the hand was pure bone. She had done a smaller version of what he had done, and she did not know how, so she could not teach it. They covered themselves in lightning and went after him.[250]
Victor brought Eleonor to examine the area because Clan Adrasteia had more practical experience with Demonic Beasts and Monsters than almost any other vampire lineage. Eleonor's instincts initially caused her to react aggressively toward the gorilla until Victor forced her to calm down and actually examine what stood before her. She then recognized that the creature was a Demonic Beast rather than one of the Monsters her Clan had spent generations exterminating.[251][252]
He hit the ground holding Eleonor like a princess, Eve still on his back. The landing burned the spot and did not wreck the forest. Eleonor's face had gone dark with the effort of not being sick. Eve leaned on a tree in the same state. He set Eleonor against the trunk, told Eve to follow when she could stand, and walked toward the giant tree because the sense of danger there was familiar and the big guy was alive. Sasha and Natashia arrived in the next rumble of lightning and were told they had taken their time. Sasha said it had been seconds. Natashia said it had not been her top speed. He smiled about a previous fight and she was satisfied. Sasha declared that next time she would not lose, because speed was Fulger's pride. He offered a reward of anything they wished if they trained with him. Both of them swallowed and asked him to repeat it. Anything. Natashia agreed first. Sasha's eyes went red, her body trembled, and she said she would train too, and then she asked if she could change her mind while she was already smiling.[251]
Natashia wanted the explanation of a body that had become literal lightning. He covered himself, the skin went completely yellow, he stepped, vanished, and was back where he had been. He called it a walk to a distant tree and back. Sasha had seen nothing. He said it was a variation of Ruby's technique, and he showed them he had water by making a small bubble. The method was to cover the entire body with that water, muscles, heart and bones included, and then use lightning, because his water conducted it. The lightning damaged him on the inside and not the outside, and the power of blood erased the internal damage. He did not think anyone else could do it unless they were in a perfect vampire count form. The ground started to rumble. He smiled. Sasha realized where they were. Former Horseman territory, now Fulger, the forbidden forest. Natashia looked up. The moonlight was gone and a giant gorilla was standing in what it had left, and it roared at the women. Sasha's heart wanted her to leave. Natashia stepped in front of her. He was suddenly in front of the gorilla, asking if the big guy had already forgotten him. The face went from hostile to neutral. It turned away and snorted. He laughed and called it shy. It pointed at the women and complained. He promised they would not get too close. It did not trust that. Then it made a gesture he had not expected a gorilla to know, and pointed at its nose, meaning his scent. Sasha said she had expected everything from her darling except a gorilla handler. Natashia corrected her. It was an extremely dangerous demonic beast. Sasha sighed and called it a big gorilla anyway.[251]
She came out of the shock into rage and demanded to know what he was doing, and she pointed at the gorilla and said she would kill the monster. He asked which monster. The word rearranged itself in her head. He was a demonic beast. Natashia put a hand over her face. He handed Eleonor the stone sword and told her to watch both of them, the gorilla and Eve, and to say what she thought, because she had more experience with demonic beasts and with monsters than anyone else standing there. She realized he knew her family's work. He wanted the difference between the two, said out loud. He went to Eve, told her she had done a good job, and stroked her head. Then he gave her the job anyway. She had just gotten back. She was to use her power and help Sasha. With Eve there, pulling every beast's attention would be easy. He squeezed her head for imitating Kaguya and reminded her who she was. She was not Kaguya. She was Eve Alucard. She said yes. Eleonor was told to stay, calm down, and be ready to talk when he returned. She said, as she had said thousands of times, that she could refuse. He cracked a knuckle and asked if she was going to disobey. The disappointment hit her as he turned away and told the big guy he would be back soon. Natashia laughed, told Sasha she would accompany him, and the two counts disappeared in lightning. Nightingale felt two of them moving at once.[252]
The tree itself was stranger. Victor had previously fed it a drop of his Blood and watched its damaged branches recover and red crystalline leaves grow from it. Natashia and Eleonor both sensed that the tree and its guardian were considerably more dangerous and unusual than their appearances initially suggested.[253][254]
He asked the gorilla how the other one was doing. The roar that came back was angry, and the gestures that followed were the argument of someone explaining that a tree has a gender and that the gender is feminine. He told it he did not know how to talk to trees, and that the girls were already looking at the conversation strangely. The gorilla looked at Sasha and Natashia, put a hand over its mouth, and laughed. His vein bulged. He asked what it was laughing at. It roared louder, still smiling, and turned around. He was annoyed and he was glad. The big guy was healthy. He told Eve to watch Eleonor. That was an order. When Eleonor could move, they were to follow. Sasha and Natashia started to close the distance and he stopped them. The gorilla was territorial. Letting them in at all was an exception made for him. Natashia asked if he was scared. He asked if she was serious. He was not scared. He did not want a fight with a friend, because if that friend did something to Sasha it would not end well. She heard the respect in it and thought of Scathach. Sasha asked if he liked the gorilla. He said it was not that. What he felt was respect for a strong friend who could fight him at any time. A punching-bag relationship. The gorilla's vein bulged, it roared, and it turned around to give him the middle finger. He gave it back and told his buddy to go fuck himself too. It snorted and walked on. The two women were no longer sure what his feelings were.[253]
The mood changed when the giant tree was close. He asked how many people the big guy had killed there. The smell of blood was fresh. The gorilla turned with a predatory smile and did not answer. There was a huge pile of bodies and a mess around the trunk. He told Sasha and Natashia to stay. The branches moved while the gorilla spoke to the tree. He lifted a corpse, saw a broken head and vampire fangs, and tossed it. Vampires had been hunting the big guy. The next head was intact enough, a Caucasian man. He said it would do. A dark pressure fell. The gorilla's fur stood, its eyes went blood red, and it went into a battle stance until a branch touched its shoulder and it calmed down to watch. Victor's face became a deep darkness, the eyes a deep blood red, the teeth sharp. He told the head to tell him its secrets. The blood flowed into his mouth and the head dried to something like a mummy. The fragment he got was a camp, a tall man in flashy armor shouting that by their count's orders the two beasts had to be eliminated, and the rest of them roaring the agreement. Then the gorilla in black armor, slaughtering them, and the memory ended as it walked toward the vampire Victor had just consumed. He came back smiling and laughing and told the big guy he had done a great job. The gorilla tried to look innocent and failed. He said they should clean the place. A palm went up, the eyes glowed, the magic circles on the glove lit, and the blood rose and gathered into a sphere. He saw the small cuts on the tree. He sent the sphere to it and told it to take the blood. The branches wrapped the sphere and drank.[253]
They watched the tree drink. Damaged roots recovered. Red leaves grew on an ancient giant that had been dry. The gorilla made a pleased sound. Natashia swallowed. The danger she felt was not Scathach's aura. It was the instinct that answered a hunter's weapons, and she could feel the gorilla's strength tick upward as the blood went in. Victor felt the same increase and smiled, and when Sasha asked if he knew what he was doing he said of course, and then he said he did not. She nearly fell. He had just fed blood to the thing because it was interesting. A branch came toward him. Blood gathered at the tip and became a fruit fast enough to watch. Natashia thought it looked like an apple. He grabbed it, said he had missed eating this, and bit. Delicious. The taste was not his wives' blood, and he still liked it. The gorilla clapped, looked up, and went sad. The leaves dried again. He understood that making the fruit had cost the tree the vitality it had just been given. Sasha did not like his face. That face meant he was about to do something outrageous. He asked the big guy if the tree needed blood. It nodded. He listed kinds. Beast, vampire, werewolf, human. Then he said the blood of a god. Natashia felt the premonition. The gorilla and the tree conferred without words, and the answer he read off the gestures was everyone. He laughed that she was pretty hungry. A god's blood was not available. Monsters and vampires were. The branches shook, possibly from shame. He told the gorilla to take care of the girls. The gorilla did not want to. He offered bananas. The eyes gleamed and it nodded. He said he would be back soon. Sasha asked if he was leaving them. He asked if they wanted to help. Natashia asked what the help was. Capture the beasts around the tree, and capture criminal vampires. A count's authority made the second one fast. She asked if he meant to feed the tree. Yes. Why. Why not. They looked at each other and said they would help. He split it. He and Natashia would take the criminals, the vampires who had committed the most serious crimes. Sasha would lure beasts in so the big guy could finish them. The gorilla pointed at itself. He told it that it was the guardian, and that it would help, or there would be no bananas. A branch tapped it. It sighed and agreed. He laughed that it was being ordered around. It growled. Then Eleonor arrived, complaining that a countess had been kidnapped to the end of the world, and Eve told her she did not care. Eleonor's eyes fixed on him and she called him a monster. She reached for a greatsword that was not there. The gorilla growled at the two of them. He told it to stop being precocious. They were with him. Natashia thought bringing Eleonor had been unwise the moment she saw the seriousness. Eleonor's inside voice had already gone to kill. She stomped, pulled an earth greatsword out of the ground onto her shoulder, and looked at the gorilla with blood-red eyes. He recognized Scathach's training in the smile. He was in front of her on the sound of a slap. She touched the reddened face and did not understand. He told her to calm down.[254]
Victor's reaction was not caution but curiosity. Whatever the tree truly was, his Blood had caused it to react dramatically, and Victor wanted to know what would happen if it were given far more powerful nourishment.[254]

##### Limbo and the Second Progenitor
Chapters 259–269
Victor and Natashia travelled to Limbo to obtain dangerous prisoners for Victor's experiment with the mysterious tree. Limbo was not merely an ordinary prison but a separate extradimensional structure divided into seven levels. The upper levels included comparatively lighter punishment and rehabilitation, while the lowest levels held vampires considered so dangerous or irredeemable that ordinary [[Nightingale]] institutions could not contain them.[255]
The prison itself behaved like an intelligent supernatural entity. Rather than relying entirely upon guards, Limbo judged prisoners, maintained their confinement and adjusted treatment according to the beings it contained. Victor consequently became interested in the prison almost as quickly as he became interested in its inmates.[255] While Victor was dealing with Limbo, another important development occurred among the vampires created directly from his Blood. Eve Alucard demonstrated that she had inherited one of Victor's characteristics when she released black fire. Victor understood that when a Progenitor created a vampire, he could pass one of his characteristics to that descendant. Eve's fire was darker and emotionally distinct from Victor's Snow-derived flames, but it was unmistakably an inherited Alucard power.[256]
Eve's black fire made the Alucard name a bloodline rather than the political title Vlad had handed Victor, the first time a vampire made from him had come back carrying one of his own characteristics.[256] The entrance to Limbo then read him, and the sheet it put up stunned both him and Natashia. It named him Second Progenitor, and under that King of Those Who Dwell in the Night, Loved by the Night, Battle Maniac, Marked by the [[Chaos]] Witch, Loved by Animals, Loved by the Lightning Spirits, One Who Has the Protection of the Goddess [[Aphrodite]] and Loving Father.[257] One further title sat in a language he could not read. He could place the Night and the Progenitor lines on the RH-null Blood that the supernatural world called [[Sanguis Noctis Regis]], Battle Maniac needed no explanation, and Loving Father was Ophis. The Chaos Witch, the animals and the lightning spirits he could not place, though he remembered Sasha speaking of Carmilla Fulger as a spirit that had once belonged to that clan, and he noticed Natashia herself was not carrying the lightning-spirit title. Her eyes had already gone cold on Aphrodite's name. The door pressed a list of traits at him that he hated seeing written down, stupidly honest, sociopathic, stalker, violent, obsessive, friendly, bipolar and kind, and the bipolar one bothered him more than the rest. He thought about destroying the door. A wary eye warned him off, and the door asked him to sign if the sheet was correct.[257]
The important distinction was that Limbo was not simply reading official political titles. The entity analyzed the energies and fundamental characteristics of the being standing before it and attempted to classify what kind of existence it was confronting. Victor being identified as the Second Progenitor therefore described what he had become rather than merely what Vlad had politically declared him to be.[257] Victor distrusted the stranger portions of the analysis enough to demand that Limbo repeat it. The second examination again identified him as the Second Progenitor but also began generating predictions or extrapolations regarding Victor's future relationships, listing Sasha, Natashia and [[Scathach]] alongside women with whom Victor had not yet consummated any relationship.[258] Victor immediately objected. At that point he had only physically completed his relationships with Violet and Ruby; he had not yet done so with Sasha, Natashia or Scathach. The absurdity proved that not every piece of information produced by the gate should be treated as a literal statement of Victor's present circumstances.[258]
Limbo nevertheless continued addressing Victor as the Second Progenitor and ultimately granted him unusual access to dangerous Vampire prisoners. Prisoners from levels five through seven could be released into Victor's custody, with Limbo itself accepting responsibility for the transfer.[258] Victor was entirely honest about why he wanted them. They would become food for his tree.[259] Inside Limbo Victor also encountered far stranger inhabitants and learned of the prison's "administrators", exceptionally dangerous prisoners integrated deeply enough into Limbo that even the guards treated them differently. One mysterious tattooed man confronted Victor with the question of whether he knew the definition of insanity, leaving Victor with yet another unexplained existence to remember for the future.[259]
The man was suddenly in front of him. Long black hair to the ground, a muscular body bare from the waist up, rune-like tattoos covering him in a pattern, torn prisoner's pants, two old black cuffs on the wrists, and a face with no life in it. He asked Count Alucard if he knew the definition of insanity, and he answered himself. Rules. A set of words a stronger being made, which weaker beings were obliged to follow. The way a king controlled his people. Chains on a little of the free will the creator had given. Victor had expected a different definition, and he noticed the man said creator, not god. The stare pulled him in. A medieval square, a warrior making rules. A forest and a mansion in a giant tree, an elf woman with long white hair, blue eyes, big pointed ears and a white staff, beautiful, noble, smiling until her eyes met his and the face went dark with fear. A ship in space, a lean muscular man with an eyepatch, making rules at a futuristic screen while he explored. Then a place outside the universe, hundreds and thousands of galaxies, and a snap of the fingers that made galaxies disappear. Three screens showed how the rulers ended. The medieval empire split after the ruler died. The elf's kingdom stagnated and was invaded by humans in futuristic armor, and the queen was captured. The space ruler's empire worked, because the rules were practical. Family disputes were settled at once. They explored for power. Laziness was not allowed. Death was accepted. In a family confrontation both sides were held accountable. Humility and wisdom came out of that, and the empire still regressed after a hundred thousand years. The man said the advantage had been humility, and wisdom, because humility without the lesson in front of you wasted the journey. In every age and every universe, rulers thought they were invincible. Arrogance. Victor came back breathing hard, the body heavy. Rules were insanity, the man said, and they could be amazing if they were used correctly. Remember, as you fall into the deepest abyss, only order will be your guide. Nothing can be born from chaos, only more chaos. Only when a tiny spark of order exists can sentient beings show their full potential. He smiled a little and was gone when Victor blinked. Natashia was arguing with a little girl who said the prison had a mind of its own, like a stomach, and that if you spoke you were heard. Natashia called her a bitch. The girl said to stop, she was still a virgin, and asked if Natashia was from the domestic sector, the light-crimes area. She did not know how many sectors there were. She was a subordinate of the big boss. Victor opened the letter in his hand. The document gave him full access to criminals with the vampire designation, levels five through seven, the prison taking the responsibility, under the codename Rules, and it was not authorized to tell the first progenitor, [[Vlad Dracula Tepes]]. He read it aloud. The guard went cold. Empty rooms filled with white light, and then the cells filled with pale, dehydrated criminals whose faces had no life left. The letter vanished. A voice in his head said, may order accompany you, child loved by the chaos. The little girl asked if he was an administrator. Natashia said he looked tired and he had not done anything. He put a hand on his brow and asked what the fuck had just happened.[259]
Outside the prison, [[Selena Moriarty]], daughter of the Witch Queen, became more directly involved with Victor's faction. The Witches had already become increasingly interested in the new Count because exploration, new territory and Victor's rapid accumulation of rare resources could fundamentally affect their own economy.[260][261]
A woman in a very revealing black dress, a black witch's hat, and a bone staff walked up to Scathach's gate and stopped there, because she knew the personality that lived inside. Vampires on the road ignored her completely. She had already confirmed, by looking, that Anderson had visited the new count. She thought the werewolf king had sent his son to die as a test, which was silly and simple and suited the wolves. The maid at the gate was Kaguya. She felt the watching, looked up, and asked the witch what she wanted. Selena was surprised to be seen. The magic on her was supposed to hide her, her aura, and her smell. Kaguya's private opinion of the dress was that the two pieces of meat on the front could be seen from kilometers away, and she was in a bad enough mood from Victor's absence to want a target. She smelled death and she saw the staff and she thought necromancy, which usually meant someone shopping for corpses. She asked the name. Selena Moriarty, one of the seven daughters of the witch queen, with a small smile. Kaguya's eyes went blood red for a moment. Violet's information from a year and six months ago had named the first daughter. She told the witch to wait and went into the shadows. Selena recognized Clan Blank and put a small barrier over herself.[260]
Scathach asked who it was without opening her eyes. Violet was asleep on the couch in the lazy way that was not really sleep, and Ruby was in the lab. Kaguya said a witch, a daughter of the witch queen, Selena Moriarty. Scathach sat up. The first daughter. Asked what she wanted, Kaguya said a business proposal with her master. Violet's face went strange. The queen's own daughter, out of the richest of the witch kingdoms, coming to deal with him. Scathach's disdain supplied the reason. Her foolish disciple was the count responsible for exploring Nightingale. By the vampire king's decree the whole planet belonged to vampires even though it was not fully explored. Violet asked if the witch wanted to use him to get land. Maybe. Kaguya put the shape of it in plain words. A future piece of land, legally, a witch base in this world, once he explored it. Violet's thought was short. Ruby came in, said she had noticed the visitor, took off the white coat, tossed the long red hair back, and told them to let the witch in and make her wait for Victor. Violet did not see why they could not decide it themselves. Ruby reminded her. The marriage was not legally materialized. A decision that involved his clan could not be made by the wives. The two people who could were Kaguya and Eve. Kaguya said she had known that, and that she still would not decide without consulting them. Ruby told her not to follow Scathach's opinion too far. It tended to be destructive. Then she told Violet to be cooler with other women and not let jealousy cloud the judgment. Violet trusted him. She did not trust the women he looked at. When she thought of one approaching him, her eyes went pure darkness and the thought was to make the woman disappear before she could attract him. Ruby's eyes went the same way, and she agreed, and she said she had learned to control it. Violet did not enjoy hearing how.[260]
Kaguya brought her in. Selena's spine prickled at Scathach's smile, because she had done nothing except walk through the door, and a second hostility was aimed at the dress. Scathach looked at Ruby, and Ruby understood. The witch looked young and was not. The first daughter of the witch queen could be older than two thousand years. Witches did not grow stronger with age the way vampires did. What age gave them was preparation and magic that stayed hidden, which made the old ones difficult. Ruby asked her mother to take the meeting, because her own instincts were already in the way. Selena let the staff go. It floated. She took the edges of the dress, curtseyed, and named Countess Scathach, [[Ruby Elderblood Scarlett|Lady Ruby]], and [[Violet Elderblood Snow|Lady Violet]]. She was Selena Moriarty, daughter of the witch queen, and she had come for Count Alucard. Scathach said he was not there. He had gone to solve something. Selena asked to wait. The matter was important to the witches. Scathach said she did not really like witches. Dealing with them was the same as dealing with demons. They could not be trusted, and she did not have the patience, so she solved it on the gallows. A lie was a slap. A second lie was a second slap. A third lie was death. Simple. Selena kept the professional smile and thought that her business was with the count, not with the woman smiling at her. The smile died. Black pressure left Scathach and became a gravitational field. Things around her cracked. She was covered in pure darkness. Selena saw her standing over a mountain of bodies and understood that the death on this woman was heavier than her own. A voice called her master, her eyes went neon blue and back to normal, and she told whatever it was to go back inside and wait until she called. Scathach felt something dangerous appear and disappear. She told Selena to stop using magic in the residence, and the shield broke with a crack. The pressure left. The smile came back innocent, and she asked whether Selena's mother had never taught her that magic in someone else's house was disrespect, especially in the house of a vampire count. Selena raised another shield and said she was not foolish enough to stand unprotected in that house. She turned to leave. A fight with Scathach was useless and would be a war, and she would not drag her sisters into it.[261]
Violet smiled a small smile. Someone other than her darling had refused an order from Scathach. Kaguya said most ancient beings would not listen, especially old witches older than her mother. Selena, walking, kept the profession on her face and thought she was not that old. Kaguya told her to wait, gave her own name, Kaguya Blank, chief maid under contract with Count Alucard, and the one responsible for the clan when the master was absent. Selena's eyes widened. She had judged the maid by the uniform. She said the proposal itself could not be accepted or refused by anyone but the count, and that as his representative Kaguya could still be told why she had come. Kaguya asked if it was important enough that she could not answer it. It was. It concerned the future of witches. Scathach started to move. Ruby told her to wait until they knew what the witch wanted, and after that she could do whatever she wanted. Scathach said fine, and that she did not want the woman in the house. Throw her in the woods. Ruby's smile went wry. Kaguya took the witch somewhere more private.[261]
Kaguya and Selena spent considerable time negotiating and evaluating one another, with Kaguya increasingly functioning as more than Victor's personal attendant. Her role now included political negotiation, intelligence and the authority expected from someone directly serving a Progenitor and Count.[262][263]
The private talk ended on a simple wall. Selena asked if Kaguya had questions. Kaguya had none. Selena asked if she could wait for him there. Kaguya did not have the authority to decide it, and the mansion was not her master's. Selena said she would come back tomorrow, set a twenty-four-hour alarm, and left. Kaguya watched her go and did not walk her out. Roberta did. Long blonde hair, a gentle smile, an apology for the surprise, and an offer to accompany her to the exit. Selena followed without talking. For a moment the maid's eyes were a snake's and the hair moved. Out past the mansion, into the city, with Kaguya still watching from far off. Maria came out of a shadow and said she did not like the witch. Roberta said the woman reminded her of gods, and that she was hiding something. Their opinions mattered, because the master took them, and the decision was still his. Bruna came out of a shadow with a small smile and told Roberta that Selena had been testing her again. The talk turned to a suitcase and a broken weapon, an axe or a hammer taken when a werewolf pack was destroyed. Kaguya said the power of a Greek god was useful in an emergency. Roberta asked who, with a heavy hatred, and Kaguya answered [[Hephaestus]]. A god's power was answered with a god's power, and she was thinking of the defense they would need against Aphrodite. Roberta's hatred flared and then had to be put down. Anderson, Kaguya said, was a demigod. The explanation of what that meant for the counterattack was still being given when the page stopped.[263]
Victor's relationship with Natashia also continued intensifying during this period. The attraction that had begun when her original personality resurfaced had become openly mutual, even though Victor had still not formalized or consummated that relationship.[264][265] Natashia walked beside him with a beaming smile, happy because the guard at the entrance had fawned. He thought it was cute that an older woman could be that cute, and then he thought of Scathach doing the same thing, and he decided it was normal for them. Strong and wild, and surprisingly cute if you actually knew them. His eyes had gone to something like a black hole and she did not notice, because she was in her own world. The year away had settled a decision he had not shown Ruby. Loss had taught him what mattered. The obsessive streak was up at Violet's level, and it was pointed at Scathach, Natashia, Violet, Sasha and Ruby. Power had not grown with the techniques. The bottleneck irritated him. He suspected a limit that arrived every five hundred years, and he had no proof. He needed to be stronger for the amusement of it, for the things worth fighting, and especially for Scathach. When she found out her own feelings he was going to be in a war he refused to lose by submitting.[264]
The guard had to call Count Alucard twice. She was about a hundred and fifty centimeters, in a police uniform that looked like a cosplay that had gone wrong, with a cute face he immediately decided belonged to a child. He said yes to his own thought. She coughed blood as if she had been shot, wiped it, and told him in an eloquent voice that she was a full-grown vampire. She hit a chest that was not really there and announced that she was seventeen hundred years old. He felt nothing from her except pale skin, tiny fangs, and eyes that could go red, and he asked if she was the only guard. She narrowed her eyes and said she was the director, the boss, the caretaker, and the owner. He called her a freelancer who did everything. Natashia, sparkling hard enough that the guard yelled about her eyes because she had not seen sunlight in more than a thousand years, corrected him. The woman did not take care of the place. Limbo was a large automatic entity in direct service to King Vlad. Whatever he deemed guilty was locked there and punished, forever. The guards did nothing because Limbo did it, which was why the prison was called perfect and why no one was supposed to escape. Natashia sneered at the word impenetrable. He thanked her. The guard said the corridor had gotten colder. He looked at empty cells, a long corridor, no roof, darkness overhead, and asked what kind of being was large enough to be the prison. Natashia did not know. The place was older than she was. The people most likely to know were Alexios or the king's eldest son, and her next thought was whether she should kidnap them. The guard's predecessor had told her to work there and collect a large reward. The reward had been money. She pouted that clanless noble vampires did not have a count's easy income, and that she did not want to be hunted in the human world by that annoying organization. She wanted a quiet life. Natashia laughed and said that was ordinary. Most clanless nobles wanted a normal life full of entertainment. The vampires who caused trouble came from clans. He compared the clanless to ordinary people and the clan vampires to politicians, and he realized the picture he had of the race was distorted. The guard asked why they had come. To catch criminals. Why. He smiled innocently and said he needed to feed his pet. Natashia showed her a photo of the gorilla that she had sneaked while he was talking to it. The guard had never seen a giant gorilla. He felt the smile on Natashia for what it was, obsessive under the gentle face, and he laughed and let the warning go. She had a collection on the phone, locked behind a long password and sitting on a cloud owned by a company her sister had bought. The pictures of him were sorted by the mood he had been in.[264]
At the gate the guard looked at the phone, called [[Diablo|Big Guy]] a demonic beast, and got an argument. He defended the gorilla's intelligence and, in his own head, settled on demonic gorilla. He asked if he was allowed to take criminals out to feed it. She said she did not know, told him to ask the gate, whistled, and walked off picking her nose. The vein in his head stood up. He caught her head and used the squeezing massage Scathach had taught him. She screamed that her head was broken. He told her to act like a professional, since she was an adult vampire. Natashia clapped, called it the hooligan attitude of Scathach's disciple, and looked at him like she had decided the rest of her life. He offered her the same treatment. She agreed at once. He promised a full-body massage later, close to her ear. Her eyes went red, her face flushed, and the composure left her. He told her to stand like a professional. She did, eyes bright, and he had not needed a power to get the obedience. He was still confused by the guard when the scene cut.[265]

##### Roxanne Alucard and the World Tree
Chapters 270–275
Victor brought the dangerous prisoners obtained from Limbo to the mysterious tree and allowed its branches to pierce their bodies. The tree drained them completely, reducing the vampires to desiccated corpses, but the result initially disappointed Victor because consuming ordinary powerful vampires produced far less visible change than he expected.[266] Before he walked them out, the little girl told him the command he had used belonged only to the administrator who dictated the rules of the place, the big boss, and she asked who besides the prisoners knew what punishment they deserved. The ones he was taking looked like mummies and were still alive, weak and hungry. Natashia frowned and said that if her husband had not come they would still be trapped without a conscience, and that they should be grateful to be useful for something larger than sitting in a cell like a vegetable. The letter was signed [[Code, Imperial]], the Second Administrator. The gate opened. The prisoners screamed when they understood the two people taking them were counts. Elsewhere, Vlad read the notice of prisoners from levels five through seven and ordered that Victor's movements be looked at from a distance. He did not call it a rebellion.[266]
The tree then requested Victor's Blood. Victor allowed a single drop to touch one of its branches. The reaction was immediate. A massive pillar of red energy rose into the sky, drawing the attention of both [[Scathach]] and Vlad from great distances. The damaged tree blossomed with red crystalline leaves formed from Blood, while Vlad reacted with genuine surprise upon realizing that Victor had apparently been accepted by the tree—something Vlad had deliberately kept secret from [[Nightingale]].[266] Victor's experiment continued until the tree produced a strange blood-red fruit. He ate it and was overwhelmed by the Blood, memories and accumulated experiences contained within it.[267] Victor's consciousness entered his internal Blood world and was flooded by memories belonging to numerous beings consumed by the tree. Some of those memories belonged to vampires who had lived for more than a thousand years. Victor's mind instinctively sealed much of the information because attempting to process centuries upon centuries of foreign experience simultaneously would have overwhelmed even him.[268]
The experience also advanced Victor's understanding of Progenitor Blood. Blood was not merely food, a weapon or a hereditary carrier. For the King of the Night it could function almost like a supernatural bargaining chip, allowing the Progenitor to interact with body, Soul, memories and the fundamental existence of beings whose Blood he absorbed.[268] What he had swallowed was not an ordinary fruit. It held the essence of the beings the tree had killed, and the moment it hit him his mind was dragged into a sea of blood and buried under memories that did not belong to him. Some of those lives had lasted more than a thousand years, so his mind sealed most of them rather than try to live every century at once. When he came back, the guardian he called [[Diablo|Big Guy]] was whole again, sitting cross-legged and eating bananas, and the gorilla told him that he had become a vampire too, because his life was tied to the tree that Victor's blood had just changed.[268]
When Victor awakened, the tree had changed completely. A female Dryad now stood where the damaged tree had once been. She had evolved through Victor's Blood and possessed vampiric characteristics, making her another abnormal hybrid created through Alucard rather than through artificial experimentation.[268] The enormous gorilla was revealed to be the tree's guardian. Because his existence was connected to hers, the Dryad's evolution affected him as well, allowing the creature to mature further and communicate far more clearly than before.[268] Victor named the Dryad Roxanne Alucard. She became immediately attached to him and was accepted into his household rather than treated simply as a rare supernatural resource.[269] The name was not a private thought. He told her that from that day onward she would be known as Roxanne Alucard, his sixth maid, and she took the place beside the women who already served him rather than remaining a specimen in the forest.[269]
Roxanne preferred remaining close to forests and open nature rather than living permanently inside a mansion, so Victor arranged for June to construct a residence suited specifically to her preferences.[270] Scathach then explained just how absurd Victor's discovery actually was. Roxanne was a young World Tree.[270] Scathach recognized the same fundamental nature she had once felt from [[Yggdrasil]], the World Tree associated with the [[Norse Pantheon]]. A mature World Tree was not simply a powerful magical plant. Given enough time and a world without another competing World Tree, Roxanne could effectively create the conditions for a planet to support life. A hostile lifeless world could eventually be terraformed through her existence.[270] That capability made Roxanne valuable on a level Victor had not understood when he casually accepted her as a maid. Gods and [[God-Kings]] could regard ownership of a World Tree as worth conflict between entire Pantheons.[270]
Scathach consequently warned Victor that accepting Roxanne into his household had effectively placed an enormous target upon Clan Alucard. Victor's response was characteristic: now that Roxanne was his, anyone attempting to take her would simply become his enemy.[270] He left Roxanne outside and told June to build to her taste, and he walked into a grip that cracked bone. Scathach pulled him to the sofa. The eyes were blood red and the hair was up off her shoulders like a jellyfish. Violet, Sasha and Ruby were already recounting what he had done at the tree. She said one word. Explain. Ruby asked how the fuck he visited his friends and came back with a woman and a gorilla. Scathach's answer was the scale of it. Given enough time, and a place where another world tree was not already planted, that woman could create a planet. That was why the target on his back was now huge. Gods and strong beings wanted a world tree. His blood had put the red leaves on her and the rebirth that followed had made her a maid. Ruby put books on Yggdrasil in front of him. He actually read them. The girls, motivated by the sight of him reading, sat down and read too. Scathach suspected Vlad had known what the tree was and had kept it quiet. He did not yet give them the full list of titles the prison had hung on him.[270]
Rather than rely upon fantasy stories and incomplete assumptions, Victor began studying actual books concerning Yggdrasil and [[World Trees]]. The sight surprised Ruby because Victor rarely chose academic reading voluntarily unless the subject directly interested him.[270][271] Victor also revealed that his ability to read memories through Blood had developed during the eighteen months he spent with Ruby outside Nightingale. He did not yet possess perfect control over which memories were acquired, explaining why Roxanne's fruit had nearly incapacitated him.[271] He told them the method while the book was still open. When he fed on someone, he could see their memories. He had learned it in the year with Ruby. Scathach corrected the gentleness out of it. Biting was not enough to take a whole life. He had to kill. After the kill, a process called the absorption of an existence took place, and through it he took a fragment of the soul. The shard carried all the memories of the one who had died. She screamed that a Night King did not have that ability, and then that he was a vampire. He said he had used it on a corpse and had seen the last memories. She decided it made sense for him specifically. The wives' conclusion was the one they already lived with. He was not standard. He went back to the book.[271]
The discovery of Roxanne dramatically altered Victor's future prospects. As the Count responsible for exploring and discovering new lands, he had accidentally acquired an existence theoretically capable of turning otherwise hostile worlds into habitable territories.[271]

##### Aphrodite, the Hammer of Hephaestus and Eleonor's Deal
Chapters 276–280
Victor temporarily returned his attention to Violet and his family after the World Tree revelation. The quiet time contrasted sharply with the scale of what Victor had just brought into their household and gave him another opportunity to reassure Violet that the continued appearance of extraordinary women did not diminish her position beside him.[272]
The quiet was a room with Violet and a question about the memory he had taken the first time he bit her. He did not think it was the same power. He had not finished evolving then, and he had not let the power out. The entry had come through the ritual that already tied them. She told him to give up. He had never been normal. Then she called in the promise from before Ruby's date. Seven days and seven nights. He froze Ruby's books in ice so they would survive the room, and they kept the promise there. The sound carried. Eleonor, Pepper, Lacus, Roberta, Natalia and Maria heard it and did not know where to look. Kaguya and Eve did not flinch. Kaguya put darkness over the room and cut the noise off.[272]
Victor later returned to the Lost Club and encountered [[Aphrodite]] again. Several months had passed since their first meeting during the lost year, but Victor remained wary of the Goddess because her authority over attraction could influence emotions he regarded as belonging solely to himself and his wives.[273] Ruby was simultaneously using her growing information network to investigate Gods, politicians and methods of crossing dimensions without relying exclusively upon [[Clan Alioth]]. She learned that Aphrodite was searching for a Witch who had stolen the original [[Hammer of Hephaestus]].[274]
That information immediately became relevant because Victor had already captured a hammer from a Werewolf possessing similar characteristics. The weapon was not the original Divine artifact but a functional copy. Someone had therefore discovered how to reproduce at least a portion of a Divine artifact's capabilities, something even experienced Witches regarded as extraordinary.[274] Ruby and Victor eventually accumulated multiple copies. Victor brought Eleonor into a concealed armory where the weapons had been hidden through statues that responded only to specific Energy signatures. The storage system allowed dangerous supernatural objects to remain effectively invisible to ordinary observers.[275]
He took her through a wall that opened when it was pushed, down a dark hall, into a warehouse built like a mausoleum. Six statues stood in it. Victor, Ruby, Sasha, Violet, Natashia and [[Scathach]]. They looked like decoration until an energy they recognized touched them. He went to Scathach's statue and pulled a gigantic hammer out of the air. Eleonor caught it, dropped it, and felt the divine energy. He told her it was a copy, called a second one out of the same statue to prove the point, and then he named the number. Sixty-nine copies of the hammer of [[Hephaestus]]. Weaker than the original, still enough to be thrown as missiles and tear a large area apart. She asked what he wanted. He pointed at her and said you.[275]
Victor offered Eleonor sixty-nine copies of the Hammer of Hephaestus. Although substantially weaker than the genuine Divine artifact, each copy still possessed enough destructive output to function as a powerful large-area weapon against the Monsters threatening [[WarFall]].[275] When Eleonor asked what Victor wanted in exchange, Victor deliberately pointed at her and answered: “You.”[275]
Eleonor naturally interpreted the statement romantically and became increasingly flustered while Victor continued exploiting the misunderstanding.[276] His actual request was simpler. Victor wanted Eleonor to hunt with him.[276] During their earlier encounters Victor had seen a portion of Eleonor's normally restrained battle instinct emerge while she fought Demonic Beasts. He suspected that beneath the disciplined Countess and commander existed another person who genuinely loved battle, closer in mentality to Victor and Scathach than Eleonor normally admitted.[276] Victor wanted to see that Eleonor again. The enormous power difference between Victor and Scathach still prevented many of their fights from functioning as equal contests, whereas Eleonor could potentially provide a warrior closer to Victor's current level while exposing him to entirely different abilities.[276] Eleonor eventually accepted: she would accompany Victor on hunts, while WarFall would receive the copied Divine weapons.[276]

##### Adonis' Final Request and the Legacy of Seventeen Centuries
Chapters 281–288
Victor's rise continued destabilizing [[Nightingale]] even when he was not actively trying to change its politics. Vlad learned that the Second Progenitor had become connected to a World Tree, making any attempt to eliminate Victor even more dangerous. Killing Victor could provoke [[Scathach]], his wives, multiple Count Clans and potentially destabilize an immature World Tree whose future value was almost impossible to measure.[277]
The King was simultaneously dealing with severe deterioration within his own family. Ophis' attachment to Victor only emphasized Vlad's failures as a father: the youngest Royal Princess displayed more happiness and emotional openness around Alucard than around the man who had actually fathered her.[277] Hidden factions connected to Niklaus, the Royal Family and other supernatural powers continued watching Victor, increasingly concerned that the new Progenitor might eventually become a political rival to Vlad whether or not Victor currently desired the throne.[278][279] Victor's attention, however, turned toward a considerably more personal crisis. [[Adonis Snow]] was dying.[280]
He did not wait to be announced. Snow guards and Blank assassins went down on the way into the room. Adonis was on the bed, reduced to a pathetic remnant, and a strange golden divine energy was moving through the body and killing him slowly. Victor named it. Divine energy. It was not something a vampire's body could hold, the same class of thing he had seen in fights against werewolves and church hunters. Hilda Snow was there, short white hair covering half her eyes, an older master trained in the same hard school as Scathach. Agnes was there, golden eyes, flame in the blood. Kaguya was there. Oda came out of Agnes's shadow. A traitorous member of Snow was already in the room, armless and legless. Victor's eyes were blood red and the pressure on him was soaked in blood. He told Agnes that lying was never the answer, because she had been hiding the condition from Violet. She's got your blood running through her veins. Did Agnes think her daughter was weak enough to be depressed if she learned about her father. Your daughter is just like you, he said, but at least her brain hasn't gone rotten. The interrogation put a plan on the table. Traitors meant to replace the leaders of Snow and of Fulger, to use Violet as a resource for making new vampires, and to kill or subdue Agnes. They had been waiting for Adonis to die so the weakness would be there to use. Agnes, Hilda and Kaguya took the traitor for the rest of the questioning. He demanded to know how long Adonis had left. Agnes started to answer.[280]
Victor spent time with Agnes and the Snow family while learning more clearly how little time Adonis had left. Adonis' body had always been abnormal and fragile, while curses and supernatural influences accumulated throughout his life had only worsened his condition.[280][281] The number, when Adonis himself gave it, was less than a year, and he did not know the exact day. Victor had woken him with a slap that carried lightning. The cause was a divine curse from [[Persephone]], goddess of the underworld, and the decline had sharpened after Victor was found. Death would not be an ending. It would deliver him to her realm, down around the third or fourth layer of a hell that had seven. Adonis named the cures he could see. Become a god, in the way [[Hades]] was a god, so the lower realms could be walked. Or lie with Lilith, mother of demons. Or the method he had actually called Victor into the room to hear. You, a king of the night, must use your authority as king, and devour me. He asked for privacy. Agnes left.[281]
Adonis eventually asked to speak privately with Victor. His request was something Victor never expected to hear: Adonis wanted Victor to devour him.[282] Adonis knew death was approaching regardless of Victor's actions. His greater fear concerned what would happen afterward. Persephone had marked and cursed him, and Adonis believed that dying normally would allow the Queen of the [[Greek Underworld]] to claim his Soul and continue exerting ownership over him even after death.[282] Victor initially refused. Adonis was Violet's father and Agnes' husband; absorbing a loved family member was fundamentally different from devouring enemies or anonymous supernatural beings.[282] Adonis nevertheless insisted that Victor was the only person he trusted with what remained of his existence. As another Vampire Progenitor, Victor possessed the authority to absorb Blood, Soul, memories and supernatural characteristics deeply enough that Persephone would no longer be able to claim Adonis separately.[282]
Their conversation also demonstrated how radically Progenitor transformation differed from ordinary vampirism. Adonis had not satisfied the normal virginity requirement governing Noble Vampire conversion when Vlad transformed him, yet Vlad's Blood had overridden that restriction.[282] Victor ultimately accepted his father-in-law's request. He asked only that memories directly involving Violet be handled carefully. Victor did not want the paternal memories of Violet's father contaminating the way he personally perceived his wife.[282]
He said it again as a Night King. A progenitor could set the value of a blood and then take it. Set mine higher, he said, and devour me, and you take everything Adonis stands for. Memories, traumas, the powers of the bloodline, and the curse with them. He coughed blood onto his hand. The eyes went blood red, and violet light sat in them. I will die. That fate was decided the moment Persephone cursed me. I would rather be devoured by you than leave my soul in her possession. Take this burden. Take my burden. Protect Violet and the Snow clan. Victor called him a motherfucker. He wanted to heal him, not kill him. What did Adonis think would happen when Violet found out he had killed her father. Merging was worse. How was he supposed to face Violet if a father's gaze came with the man. Even if the merge happened, Adonis would still be dead. He shuddered at the thought of looking at his own wife through that man's eyes. Then he agreed. Forgive me, Violet. He dropped the restrictions on the code he used for it, the crimson flower that feeds on the fallen blood of its enemies. The body went completely dark, as if he were the darkness, blood-red veins showing inside it, two gigantic wings of the same darkness, small lightning dancing on him. The air warmed and the ground around him froze. The chest distorted. A demonic beast's head opened out of it, enlarged, and ate Adonis's entire existence. He sighed that he would not be surprised if he was condemned to hell for it.[282]
The absorption transferred far more than raw power. Adonis had lived for approximately seventeen centuries as a physically weak man forced to survive through information, planning, manipulation, political connections and the intelligence network of Clan Blank. Victor had always approached obstacles principally through personal force. Adonis represented the opposite extreme.[283][284]
The pain hit as the existence settled, and he clamped the power down in levels. The room took damage. The changes tried to revert. He coughed blood twice and braced for the life that was about to arrive. The memories put him in ancient Greece, and Adonis's appearance faded until it was his own, with a warning not to get lost and a reminder that he was the king. What he walked through was a child of a beauty that had drawn [[Aphrodite]]'s jealousy and a curse, a body that had always been weak, Persephone taking him against his will, and Aphrodite later turning that hatred into love. Handsomeness that made people afraid. Violet eyes. A foresight that arrived at random and cost him strength every time it did. Adonis hated the weakness, the beauty, the two goddesses, and the fact of having been born in Greece. He had seen a future anyway: a pale-skinned woman holding a baby, a vampire, Agnes Snow, and a later meeting that ended in her shock and a crazy smile. Victor, alone inside it, said the life had been shit, and he held a king's posture so the centuries would not wash the self out of him.[283]
By absorbing him, Victor inherited those memories, political instincts, social experience, accumulated information, supernatural abilities, curses and emotional remnants.[283] The greatest immediate benefit was therefore not simple strength. Victor had acquired roughly 1,700 years of experience from someone who had survived almost entirely through his mind.[284]
He came out of the memories changed. The black hair reached his waist. The eyes were violet, where the blue had been. The beauty on the face was the kind of male beauty people did not have a casual word for. The foresight had come with the man and had evolved instead of sitting still. The eyes shifted and he saw Agnes running. A red world opened, the ordinary world gone violet, red lines floating in it, connections, and the line from Agnes to him was thick. He could see through walls. Details were clearer. Bite marks showed. Thought moved faster. He was not weaker. The evolution felt strange, and the ritual tie to Agnes was simply there, inherited. She came in, confused by the face and by the connection, and the confusion became fury. Tell me. What did you do to my darling. She pinned him by the collar. Elsewhere in the mansion Kaguya, Hilda and Oda finished the traitors. The bodies were in piles. Kaguya felt the wrongness and started back, and an explosion was heard through the house. Yuki woke to it, saw Agnes on him, and knew him by the suit even with the face changed.[284]

##### Agnes' Grief and the Purge of Clan Snow
Chapters 289–294
Agnes immediately sensed that something had happened and attacked Victor when he returned. Her fury only broke when she drank his Blood and experienced enough of Adonis' final memories to understand that her husband had willingly asked Victor to absorb him rather than allow [[Persephone]] to claim his Soul.[285]
She had him by the collar. Tell me what you did to my darling. The fire around her climbed and burned the clothes off him and did not burn him, because some part of her still saw Adonis in the man she was holding. He told her questions were useless. The ritual connected them, and she knew an easier way. He showed her the neck. Look in my memories. She wanted an explanation in words. He told her to do it. She bit, hard. What she walked through was Adonis explaining the absorption, the soul kept out of the goddess's hands, and the request not to hate Victor too much. He was not to blame. Forgive the selfishness. Adonis had not wanted to fall into that woman's hands. Agnes came out of it with the power fading and the eyes wet, saying his name. She understood the choice he had made, and she felt the sadness through the connection. She asked who he was now. Victor, he said, and at the same time a being who had Adonis's memories. The eyes were violet. He remembered everything, including her past with the man. She clung and asked where her darling was going, and whether he was abandoning her. He did not comfort her with a lie. He was not Adonis. He told Hilda to take her and let her rest. The eyes went cold after that. He ordered Kaguya and Oda to move Clan Blank. The retaliation was not going to stop at the room. All the cities of [[Nightingale]], he said, would be painted with the crimson blood of his enemies.[285]
Understanding did not erase grief. Victor refused to offer false hope that Adonis could simply be restored. His memories and portions of his existence now lived inside Victor, but the continuous individual who had been Agnes' husband and Violet's father was gone.[285] Victor nevertheless accepted Adonis' request that he protect Agnes. He made a clear distinction, however: he would not become Adonis' replacement. Any future relationship Agnes formed with Victor needed to concern Victor himself, not an attempt to recreate the dead husband whose memories now existed inside him.[285] The timing of Adonis' death exposed a conspiracy operating around Clan Snow. External enemies had deliberately waited for the family's patriarch to die and for Agnes to become emotionally vulnerable before moving against the territory.[286] Adonis' memories allowed Victor to understand the Snow administration and Clan Blank's intelligence network almost instantly. When he identified enemies and traitors moving within the territory, Victor asked [[Oda Blank]] for temporary command over Clan Blank.[286]
Oda accepted because Adonis himself had trusted Victor. Victor ordered experienced assassins stationed at every exit, kept Snow forces around Agnes and the non-combatants and sent Kaguya directly onto the front lines.[286] Victor's objective was not a conventional battle. It was an extermination.[286] Through captured memories Victor separated important conspirators from disposable followers and systematically dismantled the people attempting to exploit Clan Snow's moment of weakness. One traitor was left publicly impaled and burning within the central square, turning his death into a warning for everyone considering betrayal from within the territory.[286]
A white-haired man of Clan Snow, one of The Eye, the group that had been watching the three countesses in order to replace them, ran through streets that had just been put under martial law. Alucard had ordered that nobody leave their houses. The man reached the central square and found a pile of corpses with Victor sitting on it, bored, long black hair, blood-red eyes. The city had obeyed because the new count already had the reputation of being ruthless in the way [[Scathach]] was ruthless. The eyes glowed. He said knees. The man dropped as if gravity had been given an order, and he understood that the voice had a new weight. People watching from the houses whispered that a Snow clansman had been killed and that being Snow had not spared him. The man's own shadow broke and moved. Clan Blank was obeying a foreigner who was not their count. What Victor was using was the charm, mutated. On the weak it behaved like a god telling mortals what to do. Oda stepped out of a shadow and reported that every insect on the list was dead. A maid added that the streets were painted with the enemies' blood. Kaguya nodded. She had awakened Blank abilities early, past what Oda had expected from her age. Victor said there was one left. Get up. The man rose like a puppet. A hand covered in red power pulled him through the air, and Victor walked an invisible path to the center of the square. He told the territory that this was what betraying Snow cost. He let the man go. The ground shook. An ice pillar drove up through him to the neck. He screamed. Victor snapped his fingers and the man burned. Regeneration brought him back, and the fire came back with him. The inherited power held the torture for three days. Engrave it, he told them. Do not forget what it means to defy Snow. The smile, the black hair and the red eyes were what the square kept.[286]
Kaguya's performance also surprised Oda. Abilities that Clan Blank members normally awakened after centuries had already begun appearing in Kaguya because of her growth around Victor, his Blood and the constant training to which his household had been subjected.[286] Victor did not stop after the immediate enemies were dead. Adonis' memories allowed him to see exactly how inefficient portions of Snow administration had become. Agnes' focus on Adonis' declining condition had allowed paperwork, internal management and other responsibilities to accumulate.[287]
Agnes woke alone and cried for the man who had given himself up so Persephone would not take the soul, and the hatred in the room was for the goddess. Downstairs, Yuki and a younger Snow maid were talking about the execution in the square. Cruel, and effective, and in line with what Agnes herself taught. Traitors were not forgiven. She heard them, left the room, followed two complaining guards, and spied on Adonis's old office. He was at the documents with the long black hair and the violet eyes and a beauty that did not look like it belonged on a person doing paperwork. The mess included embezzled money, a magic pen Violet had bought for a hundred and ninety million dollars, which he called a fraud, and Oda's sake collection at five hundred million a year, kept as decoration. He confiscated the collection and told Kaguya to auction it on the human market. Oda protested and accepted. Violet's allowance was cut. Clan members who had been buying personal things with clan money lost the assets. They complied because they were afraid. He asked Hilda about a Youkai incident. A member of a spider clan had tried to force Agnes into a bed, and she had burned the place. He put sanctions on the Youkai and cut their access to the vampire market, so the witches would have a reason to deliver the clan that had done it. The anger he felt was possession, and it was Adonis's as much as his. He was not going to become the substitute. He meant to leave once Snow could hold itself, with Hilda in the chair until then. Agnes, listening, cried because the way he worked was too much like her husband.[287]
Victor temporarily occupied Adonis' former office and began reorganizing the system. He wanted unnecessary paper records digitized, competent people placed where they could actually work, corrupt or lazy members pressured into contributing and Clan Blank used more efficiently as an information network rather than merely an assassination force.[287][288] During this period Victor experienced the first clear activation of another ability inherited from Adonis: future sight. His ordinary vision suddenly disappeared and was replaced by an image of a man being dragged away by strange beings later identified as Youkai.[288] Victor found the ability irritating. He regarded foresight as the supernatural equivalent of receiving spoilers for a story and understood from Adonis' memories how easily people who attempted to avoid a predicted future could accidentally become the reason it occurred.[288] Even so, he acknowledged its usefulness. Adonis had repeatedly protected Clan Snow by reacting to visions before disasters became unavoidable.[288]
The sight came without being asked. A man dragged by Youkai. He understood the ability turned on at random, the same way it had given Adonis warnings he could use, and the same way it could make a man paranoid enough to walk into the future he was trying to dodge. He decided to hold it instead of letting it hold him, pushed the clan through the rest of the papers, and left a shadow to watch the work. The corridors felt familiar because they were Adonis's memory, and he understood what a progenitor's absorption actually did. It blended. The RH-null blood was the blessing that let the blend happen. His opinion of the Olympians, formed out of those old memories, was poor, with [[Hestia]] as the exception. He sat on an ice throne in the main hall and waited. Kaguya reported twenty billion dollars from the sale of Oda's goods, sold high. Hilda told him Adonis's people were still in grief. He confirmed the reviews and then changed the gate. Supernatural beings entering Nightingale would be interrogated under charm, bound by magical contract. The management of that was handed to affiliated clans. Entries and exits went onto computers. A security witch was to be hired. Corrupt members of Snow were stripped or killed, and Blank was in the punishment. The vision had given him six hours before guests. He did not know whether the lack of recoil was because he was a Night King or because of the divine energy sitting in the stolen life. At the end of the wait the guards admitted the Kitsune clan. The one at the front was Genji, white kimono, fox ears, nine tails.[288]
Victor's political approach also changed. After identifying a Youkai faction connected to an earlier offense against Agnes, he did not immediately invade Japan. Instead he ordered restrictions upon Nightingale trade involving the offending Youkai and associated groups.[289] The result was exactly what Victor expected. Witch society and other commercial powers valued access to Nightingale's economy far more than they valued protecting one troublesome Youkai faction. They pressured the Japanese representatives themselves until Genji, a Nine-Tailed Kitsune associated with supernatural commerce, was forced to come before Victor.[289]
Hilda put the restriction on Nightingale trade that touched the Youkai and anyone tied to them. The witches did the rest. They pressed until the man responsible for Agnes was handed over, and the name on him was the leader of the [[Arachne]] clan. Genji brought him. Nine tails, a smile that was sweating, the eloquence of a man who had come to survive the meeting. The prisoner had spider legs and a hostile stare, and the cuffs on him were not ordinary metal. Victor's face went to pure darkness and the eyes to blood red. He told Genji to give him that man. On that day, he told the Arachne, you made the wrong choice. A worm dared to try to touch my wife. The left side of him distorted. Eyes and teeth grew out of it until a demonic beast's head was there, and he told the thing to become dog food. The man was eaten. Nothing of him was left to bury. Genji was spared, and praised for having complied, and then he was given a message for her. She should be careful whom she chose as an enemy. Nightingale was not their playground. Stick the divine paws elsewhere, or The Crimson Nightmare would repeat, and this time it would be many times worse than the past. They left terrified and they left compliant.[289]
Victor had therefore made multiple supernatural organizations perform his search for him merely by manipulating economic incentives.[289] Adonis' memories had not transformed Victor into Adonis. They had given Victor the political tools of a seventeen-century-old schemer while leaving those tools in the hands of someone far more aggressive.[289][290] Oda subsequently acknowledged Kaguya as the second leader of Clan Blank, formalizing the authority Victor's maid had already begun exercising through the Clan's intelligence and assassination network.[290]
He finished the town, put the leadership in Hilda's hands, and told her to take care of Agnes. She asked if he was going. He shortened the hair and left in lightning, toward Scathach's territory.
