Oda put a badge in Kaguya's hand. As of today, you are being appointed as the second leader of Clan Blank. The reason he gave was Victor's interest in her, and Blank's tie to Snow. She clicked her tongue and said fine, she would take it. He told her they would be here. They were a family. Then he was gone into the dark. Niklaus and James were elsewhere, counting what the attack had cost them. The one who attacked this time was Count Alucard. He had used subordinates, erased influences, met Genji, and done it without standing in the middle of their investments until the investments were already gone. Theo was missing. They could not answer him without help from outside. What they chose to chase instead was an escaped experiment, a hybrid last seen in Greece, and the rise in demon possessions, and a warning that still had to be sent about Anderson gathering people.[290]

##### Violet's Grief, Persephone and the Birth of Junketsu
Chapters 295–310
The most difficult person Victor still needed to face was Violet. Adonis had been her father, and no amount of political necessity could make that loss simple.[291]
The maids at [[Scathach]]'s door, Roxanne among them in a maid dress, stopped when they saw him. The face was the kind of male beauty people did not have a casual reaction to. He told them good work and smiled a little. Violet was on the second floor with Ruby. Sasha was back, on the porch with Scathach and Natashia. Eleonor was with the Scarlett sisters in Siena's office. Roxanne sniffed him and said the tree in him was stronger, and she asked if they were stronger. The gorilla was in the window, surprised, and what it smelled was divine energy and a curse. He confirmed both. Adonis's power, and a curse that was probably a Greek goddess of the underworld. Roxanne could feel the change in the body because of the link through her. He asked if the curse could actually take him. She was not worried in the way a servant worries. He was a progenitor, and she was on the soul. She muttered curses at gods. He patted her head and thanked her for worrying. Roberta's hair floated and the aura on her went bloodthirsty at the mention of [[Olympus]]. He calmed her and said they would pay, and the eyes on him were dangerous when he said it. He sent the maids back to work. Kaguya entered the shadow. He told her that when the problem was finished she would bring the maids to the coliseum, report the three days, and ask them what they wanted. At Violet's door he stopped. The anxiety was the same shape as the day he had killed Sasha's father, with Agnes added to it. He opened the door. Darling, Violet started, and then the new face hit her hard enough that a nosebleed was a real risk. Ruby recognized the serious expression. It was the one he wore when he had blasted [[Belial]]'s son. We need to talk. She saw the eyes. Neon violet, the same as hers, and the same as Adonis, Elizabeth and Lilith. He knelt, touched her face, and said he was sorry. He offered the neck. The blood would reveal everything she needed to know. Come, my wife. She bit, swallowed, and the memory that rose was her father. The tears came. On the porch Scathach smiled and said her stupid disciple had finally returned. Natashia, quiet for once, told them he had handled Snow himself. Traitors cleaned, the administration helped, new rules. Sasha said he had changed again, and that he was more handsome. The description going around the porch was the long black hair, the violet eyes, the beauty that did not look earthly. Scathach put it together through the world tree. He had absorbed a seventeen-hundred-year-old vampire. The soul had grown on Roxanne's blood, and that growth was what protected it. She called it a fool's luck and compared it to Pandora, and she was amazed at her own disciple.[291]
Victor allowed Violet to drink his Blood and experience the memories surrounding Adonis' final request. She understood that Victor had fulfilled her father's choice, but understanding did not prevent grief from turning into rage.[291][292] Violet attacked Victor and released her power while mourning. Victor did not treat her as an enemy or attempt to suppress her immediately. He accepted her anger because, regardless of Adonis' consent, Victor was still the person who had ended her father's independent life.[292]
The scream was one long sound, and a pillar of fire left her body. She shifted into the vampire count form without deciding to. The strikes that followed were flame, and they tore his flesh and broke bone, and he stood in it with his eyes closed and did not treat her as an enemy. Ruby tried to get close and the heat threw her back. Scathach, Sasha, Natashia and the maids arrived on the noise. Sasha could hear flesh tearing. Natashia's resistance to fire was not enough to walk into that. Scathach could have stopped it and said the stopping might kill Violet. Eve had black flame ready on Kaguya's order. He ended it by putting a hand on Violet's head. You're a grown woman. Don't cry so hard, or I'll be sad too. For a moment the man in front of her was Adonis. She saw the broken body and denied it. He hugged her and told her the wounds were nothing next to what she was suffering, and he wiped the tears, and he asked her to forgive him, and the body healed while she cried into his chest. She passed out. He carried her, and then he said it to the room. Adonis is dead. I killed him. Sasha took her to rest. He ordered Kaguya to keep him inside her shadow with the maids, a black rune lit on his face, and she swallowed him and they were gone. Scathach looked at where the rune had been and named it. A curse. The bloodlust came off her.[292]
Afterward, Violet deliberately returned to Clan Snow rather than remain permanently dependent upon Victor. She wanted to support Agnes, understand the responsibilities of the family she would eventually inherit and grow into someone capable of carrying the Snow name when her mother could no longer do so.[292] The curse Adonis carried from [[Persephone]] had transferred to Victor as part of the absorption. When Victor slept, he found himself dragged into a spiritual domain where Persephone expected to encounter Adonis.[293] Instead, the Goddess met the Second Progenitor who had devoured him. Victor quickly discovered that the domain operated through their Souls and that neither could casually kill the other there. Victor's Soul had already become abnormally massive through his Progenitor status, absorbed existences and the memories obtained from Roxanne's fruit, preventing Persephone from simply overwhelming him.[293]
In the shadow the maids stood around the unconscious body and the black rune on the face. Roberta, diamond-shaped pupils, cold, named it. A curse. A rune of the Greek gods, specifically the gods of the underworld. A killing curse. Someone down there wanted the master's soul. Roxanne said that as long as she existed nobody took that soul. He was already hers. It was not a perfect protection if he offered the soul himself. He woke in a dark void with something hugging him and calling him Adonis, saying he would be hers. He told it to shut up and lit the place with fire taken from his wife's power, a sphere like a small sun. He was standing on a mountain of bodies, Sasha's father among them, demonic beasts among them, and he understood they were souls he had killed, and that for a vampire blood was a bargaining chip. A woman with long black hair over her face screamed at the light and fled it. Hateful light. She demanded who he was. He told her he was the one who had fucked her mother, and he ignored the anger that shook the space. He knew the room. A shared soul, a middle ground where she seduced the cursed into giving the soul up while they thought they were dreaming. Strong souls stayed awake and felt weak. He stayed awake because he was many souls, and what she saw when she looked at him was a dark being whose red eyes held thousands of souls still struggling. It frightened her. He changed. The hair went white and the face became Adonis. She said the name, obsessed and angry, and asked what he had done to her Adonis. Wrong question, goddess of the underworld. The correct question was what Adonis had done to keep her hands off his soul. He had offered it. The proof he showed her was a colossal presence, only the eyes really visible, deep blood red, a big smile full of sharp teeth. He named himself. Alucard. The inheritor of the burden, the blessing and the curse. She ended on the floor without a sentence that held together. Neither of them could casually kill the other in that room. The light weakened her. His soul was already too large.[293]
Victor deliberately used Adonis' appearance and memories to make Persephone confront the truth: Adonis had chosen absorption specifically because he preferred ceasing to exist independently over spending eternity under her control.[293][294] Using Adonis' memories, Victor also understood the rivalry between Persephone and [[Aphrodite]] and deliberately exploited it. He revealed that Adonis had ultimately preferred Aphrodite, provoking the Queen of the [[Greek Underworld|Underworld]] while extracting information from her.[294][295]
He slapped her twice while she was still claiming him, and claiming Adonis. Corpses caught her leg when she tried to leave. He was reading her with Adonis's knowledge of her, and he was using the fear on purpose. Hundreds of thousands of souls sat in him, an amalgamation that behaved like a legion, and the domain could not treat him as one cursed man. He appeared behind her. She asked if he would pay for this, and if he was hers. He told her the Greek gods were always the same. Always demanding. Always treating people like cattle. He did not belong to her. Why the hurry. She had just arrived. They should get to know each other. He was going to leave, and she was not the one who would stop him. He wanted the woman called Persephone, not the throne she was sitting on. If he had not hit her, she would not have respected him. Gods thought they were the center of the universe, and talking to that was irritating. Then he gave her the line that hurt. She was right. Adonis could never hate her. The rest of that sentence was for later. She threw a blast of dark power that shook the world. The curse, the same class of thing she had once put on Adonis, did not take. She could not exercise the authority of the room over a soul that size. He felt small effects and hid them. She retreated into herself to gather information, hostile and composed, and the domain was disrupted and not conquered.[294]
He snapped his fingers, made an ice throne, and sat. The talk he wanted was about preference. You're right, Adonis could never hate you. He despised you. He preferred Aphrodite. That was the rivalry, and it was also the obsession. To her, Adonis had been a limited-edition trophy, and losing the possession was the hatred. Victor, she decided in the same conversation, was more special than the trophy, and the desire moved. He told her he was curious. She was the first goddess he had met, and he had not thought goddesses were that beautiful. Let's talk. She agreed once the corpses, the giant and the sun were gone. She removed the sun herself and moved them to a castle. What he got out of the trivial talk was thin and useful. She liked and hated in the way of someone who had almost no one. The names around her were [[Hades]], Aphrodite, [[Demeter]], and the dead. She knew nothing about the Olympus that existed now, and she cursed it. She believed she was the center, and mortals who did not obey were cursed. He dodged her questions. He was close to waking when she said they would meet again. I'll see you later. Yes, we will meet again, Alucard. He woke in the dark with the maids on him. Master. Only eight hours. Any change in the soul. There had been small attacks. The soul defended itself, and Roxanne had not needed to intervene. He asked if they wanted the short version. They wanted the long one. Elsewhere Violet woke out of a nightmare, and Ruby told her there were two simple choices.[295]
Victor's next major breakthrough came through Blood manipulation. After explaining recent events to Scathach, Natashia, Ruby and Sasha, Victor began experimenting with an attack he had developed during the lost year: Blood Sacrifice.[296]
He came out of the shadow into a room with Scathach, Natashia, Ruby and Sasha, and he gave his blood to Ruby and to Sasha while he told Natashia and Scathach what the absorption had been. Natashia was shocked. Scathach looked as if she had been waiting for the story to arrive. He was worried about Violet, and he arranged the reports through Kaguya, and the sensitivity toward Violet was obvious. Natashia asked if absorbing Adonis had made him stronger. He said no, not in any way that mattered, because Adonis had been weak. Ruby and Sasha disagreed with the size of the word. An older vampire, blessed by Aphrodite, had changed the quality of the blood. It was aged, and it was addictive. The trouble that came with the memories had names. Persephone, Aphrodite, Hades, [[Poseidon]], possibly [[Athena]]. Scathach asked about war. He refused a straight fight. It was inefficient, and the memories had given him a better shape. [[Chaos]], the same kind of tactic he had used on Belial, adapted for gods, after he was stronger. She praised the planning, reminded him of a training promise, and reached for his neck. He slipped it and hugged her. The face went red and the breathing went uneven, because the scent on him was not the scent she was used to. She ordered him to stay away from all women, and then she listed the exceptions. Herself, Sasha, Ruby, Natashia, Violet. He refused the part of the order that would break what he had promised Adonis about Snow, about Violet and about Agnes. Luna brought a letter from the king. Scathach was invited as a bodyguard to a meeting of supernatural beings, god-kings, archangels, witches, werewolves, vampires, demons and humans, the kind of meeting that almost never happened. The last one she could place had been about witches. He offered to support her. Bruna announced an anti-material rifle and a gift from Mizuki. The box was large. His eyes were violet when he looked at it, and he shattered the box. Inside was a massive odachi. He went outside, took an iai stance, and the aura of lightning, fire and ice merged into a chaotic blood-red energy with dark power on the right arm and on the blade. He called the technique blood sacrifice and cut the sky. The slash of blood power tore clouds across tens of kilometers. Eleonor and Pepper were among the ones who saw it.[296]
Victor did not simply create a sword by mixing elements together. He first brought fire, ice and lightning into a balanced state and then used Blood as a catalyst binding the normally conflicting forces into one technique.[296] The resulting slash cut through the sky for tens of kilometres. Even Scathach was momentarily surprised by the scale of the attack from such a young vampire.[296] Victor himself was dissatisfied. Raw destructive power was useful, but he wanted something he could repeatedly carry and control rather than merely a spectacular release of Energy.[297] He consequently condensed the concept into an enormous Odachi connected directly to his Blood. Because the weapon remained linked to Victor, it could channel the same elemental characteristics he carried while also functioning as an extension of his Blood manipulation.[297] Kaguya proposed the name [[Junketsu]], meaning Purity, referring to the extraordinarily pure Blood from which the Japanese-style weapon had been formed.[297]
The weapon itself was a red-striped black odachi, far too large to be called an ordinary katana, formed from his blood and from blessed metal of the kind hunters used against beings of the night. Blood that came from him had the property of devouring, so anyone who touched Junketsu without the genetic signature of that blood was consumed by the blade. Kaguya's reason for the name was blunt: Junketsu meant purity, and a Japanese weapon needed a Japanese name. Victor could already throw a cut far enough that he spoke of reaching the moon, and he still said the attack was not strong enough.[297]
Victor accepted. Junketsu became the first signature weapon created directly from the unique combination of powers belonging to Alucard rather than something Victor merely inherited, copied or stole from another supernatural faction.[297] Agnes meanwhile underwent a change of her own. Violet's words finally broke through the paralysis created by Adonis' death. Rather than remain permanently bedridden while others managed Clan Snow for her, Agnes decided to regain the strength she had allowed to stagnate over centuries.[298][299]
Pepper, Lacus and Siena were the ones who said it out loud. Agnes had gone yandere toward him. Even their sister had risen from the coolest woman to the coolest yandere. Lacus said she got scary when the subject was Victor. Siena blamed the year and six months. Ruby heard her own name in it, veins up, and asked if they could stop talking about her as if she were not there. They whistled and left. He smiled and invited the Scarlett sisters to train. Siena fled. Ruby ran for the mansion with her face red and the blame pointed at him. Pepper claimed she had to feed a black cat. Lacus was simply gone. Scathach backed away when he approached. He whispered something that put a blush on her and a wicked smile after it, and she agreed to let him train the others. Luna could watch the clan. Luna grumbled and took it. Eleonor prayed for the girls. Sasha sighed. Natashia laughed and called it love. He said he would protect them. Eleonor asked how, if he did not know the creatures they would face. He smiled and said who told her he did not know. He picked Scathach up like a princess. She told him to put her down, cold, and she did not make him. Natashia picked Eleonor up the same way. Sasha looked tired in the mind, and the thought that crossed her was kidnapping him if he took too long. Luna watched the women get along because of him and because of the wives, and the word she landed on was oyakodon. He went to train with the maids, with Scathach, with Sasha and with Eleonor. Violet was sitting cross-legged in front of a bed where Agnes was crying, and Hilda said it had been like that since he left. Violet understood the feelings and could not accept the disappearance. She spent half an hour telling Hilda the situation. Then she grabbed her mother. Do you want to cry. Do you want to be depressed. Do you want to be alone. Do you want to mourn my father's death. Do it after you get your revenge. Until that day, she needed the countess of Clan Snow. She told Agnes to seal the room and she left, cold, and she told Hilda she would be in her own room waiting for the woman to change. The door closed and she collapsed. She called herself pathetic and a hypocrite. A shadow left that room, became a woman with oriental features and long black hair in the garden, thought of warning Kaguya and Count Alucard, and went toward Scarlett territory. He was already protecting Violet from a distance.[298]
She retrieved the greatest treasure of Clan Snow: the [[Blade of Fafnir]].[299] The red Western sword had been forged from the scales of [[Fafnir]], King of the Fire Dragons, and bathed in the blood of the Dragon King's heart. The Divine-class weapon could channel and amplify the fire of Clan Snow's leader.[299] Clan tradition claimed that whenever the Snow leader drew Fafnir's Blade, great chaos followed. Agnes ignored the superstition and entered seclusion to rebuild her neglected martial abilities.[299]
Agnes sat in the silence Violet had left. The fists closed. The eyes went blood red with hate. She ordered Hilda to find weapons that could permanently kill a god, using every resource Snow had and every resource tied to it. Clans that refused would cease to exist. She cancelled the appointments, shattered the glasses she did not need, and said that from that day she would train in seclusion until the old strength was back and then past it. She called a red western sword. Fafnir's blade, divine class, fire-dragon scales and the dragon's blood, and the fire of the clan ran through it and the strength climbed. She would make her pay. Hilda took the command. In the colosseum the warm-up with Scathach was already explosions. Bruna, Eleonor, Eve, Natashia, Maria, Kaguya and Roxanne watched a woman whose punches were still destructive with the spear held back, and a man who was withstanding them. Roxanne talked to the gorilla in her head about whether she should be training too, and she decided to watch.[299]
Scathach simultaneously noticed that Victor's fighting style was becoming increasingly difficult to categorize. He still used foundations she had taught him, but his style now incorporated multiple elemental bloodlines, Blood manipulation, Onmyō-derived knowledge, different weapons and techniques adapted from numerous opponents.[300] Victor was no longer merely becoming another practitioner of Scathach's martial arts. He was beginning to construct a system belonging specifically to himself.[300]
Scathach told him the style had become weird. She felt like she was fighting multiple people at the same time. A legion. His explanation was his mother. The habits were the same and they did not get in each other's way. She looked at the foundation she had built, at what she had taught, and at the focus that never dropped, and she let herself think a dangerous thought. If he kept training like that, he might become something close to a god of war. Then he was next to her and she had not seen the step. When did you get close. I just walked. He blew in her ear. She shivered, blushed, and pushed him off. Get away from me a little. The girls watching did not understand the woman they were looking at, and the talk turned to how the maids and Scathach were starting to resemble each other around him. Roxanne provoked the connection and the air tightened. They went back to it with the odachi and the spear. What the girls picked apart was height, reaction time, the Fulger speed in the wrists, vampire strength making a blade that size usable, and the way he adapted, including the possibility of ice and of shields. He and Scathach stopped together and told them to get back to training.[300]
Before he left for Eleonor's territory, the time he still had was spent on people rather than on a new technique. Scathach broke her own rule of saving the spear for opponents she considered worthy and fought him with it, then switched to an odachi so he would have to adapt while she watched. He survived the spar without using a spear art of his own. She then put unfamiliar weapons in his hands. A chakram was a mess. Daggers started just as badly and then improved on their own, as if hands that were not his had used them before, though still nowhere near the standard of Clan Fulger. She felt the rhythm of the fight change, as if she were no longer fighting only him, and she took that speed of theft as something close to a one-man legion, possibly fed by the memories the tree had poured into him. He also slipped attacks he had not consciously seen, the unreliable flicker he had taken from Adonis, and she told him not to lean on it. He agreed. He called that kind of foresight gambling, and he did not like depending on luck.[301]
What Adonis had left him was not only politics. The charm that came with those memories made a first impression land harder, especially on women, without being the same thing as forcing a mind. Victor treated it as useful and as trouble. While he rested with Sasha and Natashia he went looking through Adonis for anything about fighting and found almost none, because Adonis had almost never fought. What he did find was a memory of Stella, Vlad's first wife, golden-haired and red-eyed, climbing onto Adonis and telling him not to think too much, to enjoy it, and not to call her queen. Victor's conclusion was that Stella had taken Adonis despite Agnes watching, and that she was the only woman besides Agnes in that life. Sasha saw the look on his face and told him he was planning something bad. Natashia agreed. He denied it.[301]
He then had Kaguya contact Selena before the trip to Eleonor's land. Kaguya also reported that Violet had gone to her mother at Clan Snow. The first jolt of that news was panic, and it eased only when he heard it was a visit and a recounting, not an attack. He still kept Clan Blank on her, because he would not treat her choice to stand on her own as the same thing as safety. What he wanted was to go to her. He did not, because walking into that house would have trampled the decision Violet had made and the resolve Agnes was trying to stand on.[301][302]
Sasha was the one who said she would not go to Eleonor's territory. She was going to her friend. Natashia told her to do what she wanted. Victor put Sasha's head on his chest and told her he loved the way she was. Natashia would not go either. She had the clan and the meeting, and she would not teach her daughter that a countess could drop both whenever she felt like it. Sasha expected Ruby to stay for the same reason, and Natashia expected Scathach to stay. That left him traveling without the wives. Natashia looked at the days he would be gone, at four wives with two of them already far away, and said he needed blood before the bloodlust had room to move. They went to the bath. Scathach went in ahead of them.[302]
In that bath he fed from Scathach and Natashia fed from him. When it was over he carried Scathach out, then held Natashia and asked her, by the name Natashia Fulger, whether she wanted to be his. She had expected the want. She had not expected the question. Her answer was yes, and she said it until the number stopped mattering.[303]
Eleonor was waiting when they came out, and she looked at Natashia as if the bath had been obvious. Victor called the odachi back to his hand and told Natashia, in her ear, to train Sasha. Natashia stopped shaping a larger chest with her power. She put on black pants, white boots marked in red and gold, and a white sweatshirt that left a shoulder bare, turned once, and asked how she looked. He said perfect. The maids and Eleonor asked, out loud, whether it was really mother and daughter. He asked why they were surprised. He then put Scathach on the maids. Maria, Eve, Kaguya and Bruna did not want that teacher. Roberta said training under the strongest vampire was an honor. Scathach's condition was that she would not be responsible if they broke. He told her they were not him, that she was not to throw at them what she threw at him, and that Kaguya's watch on Violet outranked the training. If a report came, the session stopped. He asked if he could count on her not to break the maids. She said always. He kissed her cheek and called her master.[304]
Victor then prepared to fulfil his arrangement with Eleonor while resolving one final matter involving someone from his past.[305]
He dropped Eleonor at Scathach's mansion and waited out the sickness the speed had given her. She swore she would kill him for it one day. He said he looked forward to it. She was to pack and wait. The weapons were coming, and the promise was that she would be with him through the days in her own territory, room included. He called Natalia. A portal opened into the mansion. He picked her up like a sack of potatoes, told her to hush, and said he was taking her as security. She accused him of kidnapping her. He said yes. Eleonor, watching, compared him to her own master and then hated the comparison because it fit her too. He meant to see Esther's witches, to meet Selena, and to send Vlad a warning that looked like a gift. The flight with Natalia ended at an abandoned building in Canada. The odachi floated beside her as a guard. His eyes went violet and found nobody. On top of a water tank, written in red, was a line. Meet me at that memorable spot. He burned it. He offered Natalia the choice of being carried like a sack of flour or holding on. She held his neck, noticed the scent, and he took them both away in lightning.[305]

##### Mizuki, the Wives' Growth and the Road to WarFall
Chapters 311–334
Victor sought out Mizuki, the former Inquisition hunter who had nearly killed him shortly after his transformation. Their circumstances had completely reversed. Mizuki was now operating without the institutional support she once possessed and was suffering from serious supernatural injuries, while Victor had become a Progenitor and Count.[306][307] Victor nevertheless continued regarding Mizuki as one of the people responsible for his growth rather than merely an old enemy. Their original confrontation had taught him the danger of assuming superior attributes could replace combat experience.[306] Mizuki also possessed knowledge Victor still wanted. She was an experienced Onmyō practitioner, swordswoman and Odachi user. Victor had learned from many different traditions during the lost year and saw no reason to discard a teacher simply because their first meeting had involved attempted decapitation.[307][308]
Mizuki found Victor increasingly difficult to handle for an entirely different reason. Adonis' absorption, Victor's maturation and his already abnormal vampiric appearance had made his natural attractiveness considerably stronger even when he was not deliberately using Charm.[308] Victor eventually asked Mizuki to accompany him. When she attempted to defer the choice to [[Abe-no-Seimei]], Victor objected. Respecting a teacher was acceptable; refusing to make personal choices because a dead master disapproved was not.[309] Victor deliberately removed Seimei from the immediate conversation and demanded that Mizuki decide according to her own wishes.[309] Mizuki eventually agreed. The relationship was another example of Victor's increasingly possessive personality expanding beyond his wives. Teachers, maids, daughters and allies admitted into his inner circle quickly became people he regarded as his, and threats against them increasingly received the same disproportionate response once reserved for his original wives.[310] Victor's wives were developing independently during the same period.
Before that work, he stopped with the witches. Brown, a hundred and sixty-five centimetres and unbothered by what he had become, jumped on him. White was white in skin, eyes, hair and clothes, a hundred and seventy centimetres, the same height as Natalia, and she stared. Mizuki, a hundred and seventy-five, looked at [[Junketsu]] and knew she could lift it and did not trust herself to use a blade made for him. He let the odachi stand on its own and named it Junketsu, the blade of a Progenitor. Brown was the only one who looked at it with shining eyes instead of instinctive fear. The other witches had already hidden themselves when they felt Natalia and Mizuki at the wall. He had come for two jobs. One was to turn a memory of Adonis with Vlad's queen into a recording with the names cut out, so an old man's anger would not land on his wives' clans. The other was to force the memories taken from Roxanne's fruit into doors he could open when he meditated, instead of leaving centuries unsorted in his head. White, whose magic read and stole memory, sat on the pentagram in front of him and built those doors. Esther had taken her in under a contract of loyalty to Ruby and to him after the witch realms had tried to own the trick.[311]
Violet, sitting over Snow's papers, found that her allowance had been cut. The banking app showed $1,054,262,100, which was accumulation, not a raise, and the room heated. Hilda took the documents before they burned and showed her the other set. Money had been leaving the clan coffers while Agnes was too unwell to see it, enough to bankrupt a count clan that had lasted millennia. Victor's answer was Frost Bank. He had bought banks in the human world and in the vampire world, and the card Hilda put in Violet's hand was platinum white. Trades still ran through the [[Nightingale]] bank. The card was for what came next, human investments through the contacts a political clan already had. He had also rebuilt how information moved through the house. Violet's own complaint, that the papers should be a private server with no internet, was already in an envelope labeled as ideas he had not had time to start. A smaller letter fell out of it, white, with a V on the front.[312]
Sasha trained under Natashia and began displaying more of the decisive, dangerous temperament characteristic of the Fulger line rather than remaining the emotionally uncertain young woman Victor had first met.[313] Ruby devoted herself to the experimental material stolen from the Inquisition. Her research confirmed that several artificial hybrids had originally been Humans—likely orphans raised inside Church institutions—whose identities had been deliberately erased during experimentation.[314]
Sasha came out of Natashia's training and heard, for the first time, about the grandmother who had gotten along with [[Scathach]] because both of them were maniacs for a fight, and who had wanted a monster born at Scathach's level. Natashia had been called a genius and had still not been that. She had started to wonder whether the distance was the same habit Victor had, keeping the filth of the world off the women he loved. Eleonor arrived with a suitcase and a black greatsword and asked where he was. He had gone to the human world three hours earlier. Sasha looked at Eleonor and said the next one would be her. Eleonor told her not to confuse her with Violet. Natashia told Eleonor, without embarrassment, that she, Scathach and Sasha had just had that time with him, and that she was only saying it because Eleonor was not a stranger to her. She expected Eleonor to end up with him.[315]
Ruby walked in, looked at the two of them once, and understood. She told them to shower. After that they were going to the Snow clan, because Violet needed them and both she and Sasha had already decided that. Natashia was going home. Victor had pulled the obvious traitors out of Fulger and had left the smaller clans alone where he was not sure, because some of them had fed Nightingale for a long time and she had asked him not to hang them. On the surface they still bowed. Behind it, some of them were Niklaus's. She would not smash them. She would use the empire her younger sister had built, now that the clan itself was stable enough to bear it. Eight hours later Violet was face-down on a desk of paper, smoke coming off her head, calling documents the enemy of anything that could think. Hilda opened a window. Violet's fix was the same one her husband had already written down and not had time to build, a private server with no connection to the internet. The envelope of those discarded ideas was in the drawer, and the letter with the V was inside it.[316]
They increasingly shared intelligence, responsibilities and planning, becoming the central leadership structure around Victor rather than merely three women connected to him through the same ritual.[315][316] Victor then travelled with Eleonor toward [[WarFall]]. The route passed through the enormous Gate of [[Tartarus (Realm)|Tartarus]], a fortified passage between mountains marking the practical boundary between Nightingale's developed territory and the monster-infested western wilderness.[317] The existence of the Gate immediately appealed to Victor. Beyond it were thousands of kilometres of unexplored territory populated by creatures powerful enough that Clan Adrasteia had built its entire culture around preventing those beings from reaching civilized lands.[317]
Warfall did not look like Snow or Fulger. The street wore armor. Merchants wore it too, lighter than the clan's, and sold weapons, bombs and supplies to people who killed dozens of monsters a month and fed the bodies to their own smiths. The clan stayed poorer than it could have been because the monopoly, the secrecy and the refusal to sell the method were the point. The castle in the mountain was a fortress, the last wall, not a noble house. Rose had been writing that day's report for the same post for more than sixteen hundred years, burgundy hair to her hips, burgundy eyes, black armor. Dorothy, a hundred and eighty-nine centimetres, short blonde hair and golden eyes, kicked the door in to say Eleonor was back with the Scarlett sisters, Count Alucard, and a human. In the same breath a squad reported a horde led by an Alpha, which was early. Alphas were supposed to show in December. Lightning hit the wall. Rose took the six Valkyries out.[318]
Eleonor was already screaming at him. The city's own guns, projectiles past Mach 3, were shooting at the new count and missing, and he was laughing. She threw him the identification token that told those weapons to stop. A behemoth came out of the ground, desert-colored, a land dragon on all fours, melting spit, and she treated that as ordinary for the season. He dropped off the wall without a crater. Her squad, Rose in front, asked if he meant to fight the horde alone. She said of course. The behemoth's pressure put a thin aura on the lesser monsters and turned their eyes red. He hit the line with his hands. Skulls broke. An ogre's axe stopped on his skin. He told it he was not impressed, put a fist in its belly, took the axe, and cut the ogre in half on the way down. The thing on the behemoth's head was a man, grey skin, blood-red eyes, pointed tails, two wings, scales over the parts that mattered and nothing else. He struck Victor out of the horde and told him this was not his war, then called three more behemoths and a reviving mass and told him to go play house. Victor said the war was his to name. Absolute Zero turned the field into ice statues. The behemoths broke the ice and woke the dead. He covered himself in lightning and took the heads off both flanks faster than Dorothy could follow, including a behemoth. When the leader said an immortal army could not be killed, he caught fire and said that all creation turns to ashes. The blast was a sea of flame with him as the center, worse than the one he had used on Clan [[Amon]], and it left ash for five kilometres and one vampire standing in it. Flesh grew back out of green miasma. The miasma ate his skin. He stepped to Eleonor and cut the arm off before the rot finished the job. She said that was the right cut. If he had kept the infection, he would have died the way the arm did. The army was immortal in the simple sense that killing it was not the end of it.[319]
Scathach simultaneously took greater responsibility for training Victor's maids. Kaguya, Eve, Bruna, Maria and the others had become too important to remain dependent upon Victor's ability to arrive whenever danger appeared. Scathach noticed with some amusement that Victor's maids were gradually becoming miniature reflections of their master: increasingly battle-oriented, possessive and willing to pursue strength regardless of discomfort.[320]
Outside Nightingale, Hell continued moving. [[Bael]] and other Demonic powers investigated [[Belial]]'s conflict and the disturbances surrounding Earth, while Victor's earlier actions remained one element within a much larger pattern of Demonic activity.[321] At the Fulger mansion a lightning strike put Natashia on the ground in a luxurious black dress with red on the choker and on the dress itself. After Victor had accepted her she had started wearing his colors, burgundy, red and black, because she wanted to be closer to the way he existed. She and Victoria were working through a problem she intended to solve herself, as proof to her husband that she could lead the clan and still be the woman she claimed to be. Victoria's first offer was to ask her sister for help. Natashia set that aside as a last resort and told Victoria to name every option that would not damage their reputation, and she would choose after she had heard them all.[322]
While that house was still talking, the seed Victor had handed the witches reached the royal capital. Selena watched Vlad's castle from a hotel and smiled when the top of it blew open. She had spent a day preparing the gift Victor gave her and the next day selling it. The rumor she pushed, through men with a recording and through her own projections, was that the king's son was sleeping with his own mother. In less than two days the story was everywhere vampires gathered, and older vampires treated it as entertainment. Hidden enemies of the king pushed it faster than Selena needed to. Another blast followed inside the castle. The royal guard put the capital under martial law. Selena snapped her fingers, left a corpse in her place, and disappeared through a blue circle.[323]
Vlad did not argue with the corpses. He looked at the dismembered bodies of his first wife and his eldest son with a cold, lifeless gaze, then used blood to drag in the second wife and the third and killed them as well. Alexios could not find the source of the rumor. Vlad said it no longer mattered. He had known the betrayals and had done nothing about them: the first wife with their son, the second with a werewolf, the third with [[Eros]]. The fourth and the fifth, Jeanne and Anna, had stayed faithful and had fallen into a coma because they refused every blood but his, and blood that old rejected everything else. The first wife had lived on Theo's blood, and that dependence had become the affair. Alexios told him the mess was his fault, that he would not warm their beds and would not let them go, and that blood manipulation could have solved the rejection. Vlad's answer was that there had been a time he loved them and that time was gone. The only woman he still looked for was Ophis's mother, long black hair and violet eyes. He ordered the children told, the rumor hunted, and the scandal contained, then said he would take Jeanne and Anna after the cleanup. He hid the second and third wives in an underground labyrinth and went to the two coffins. Jeanne's body was mummy-like. The guilt lasted a moment and then left his eyes.[323][324]
Niklaus called Theo before that end and told him he and his mother would be dead in a few hours. Someone had taken the memory of those nights, turned it into a video, and sold it through Nightingale. Theo knew the shape of it. Adonis had slept with his mother, and his mother had wanted Adonis. Niklaus offered a machine. Theo refused it. Running from Dracula did not save a soul that Vlad could still collect. He drank a black bottle streaked red, with gold bubbles in it, blood and venom of a hybrid, blood of elder gods, hunter faith, and a high soul-cleansing working, and he spat blood. He wanted the throne as a birthright and he wanted his mother out of a neglect he compared to a dragon sitting on treasure. He told Niklaus to get Jessica out before she attached herself to a sponsor and dragged Niklaus's blood with her. Then he broke the phone, held his mother, and told her to moan loud enough for the castle to hear.[324]
Vlad came in cold and asked for last words, as a generosity to his blood son and his first wife. She said meeting him had been the mistake of her life. Theo cursed him to lose everything, to live alone, and to watch every blood tie he had made come apart, then drove a fist into his face. The blast took a piece of the castle. It did not take Vlad. He pulled Theo apart with his hands and killed the woman the same way, without a step, and looked at what was left as if it had only been a sentence.[324]
Jeanne and Anna woke looking at him as an enemy. Anna had long black hair, violet eyes, black horns, a tail, long bat wings, and a body built to sin. She wanted a divorce and the blood dependence ended. Jeanne, the former saint of Orleans, said they had never drunk from anyone else because they were afraid of dying, not because they loved him, and she told him not to use her nickname. If she had known, she would rather have burned. Anna hated him. A black tattoo of Lilith's mark was growing on her, half a contract of eternal slavery in exchange for protection, and she said demons would fill the room if he stepped closer. Jeanne showed an angel's wing, a contract with God that would keep her away from him even if it cost her freedom and her soul. Vlad felt Theo's curse sitting on the corruption already in his blood, elder-god blood and hunter working mixed through it. He told them they were free. He did not fix the addiction. He turned his back, left the door open, and kept the children. They found themselves outside the royal capital with the tattoos gone, because the contracts had not been fulfilled. Jeanne thought of Adam. Anna thought of her daughters.[324]
Elsewhere, the stories of a Saint and a powerful Succubus began intersecting with Victor's future. Former wives and allies of Vlad were no longer content to remain defined solely through their connection to the Vampire King.[325][326]
A few minutes after Vlad turned his back, Anna and Jeanne were walking a forest outside the royal capital, the first open air they had had in thousands of years. Anna's tail cut the plants as it swung. Jeanne's body ached from God's energy, and she prayed. She could not believe he had let them go that easily. Anna said it had not been easy. If they had not threatened to call Lilith and God, he would not have released them. The curse was still on them, and her body was already craving blood. Jeanne asked her to stop swearing. Anna wished the bloodlust had been solved with the rest of it. Jeanne said the look on him had been a man giving up possessions, and then she growled with hate. They were not going to the children yet. Survival first, then a group to lean on, then the curse. Jeanne did not want Adam near that man. Anna's last memory of her daughters was Elizabeth crying when she was little, the daughter made from Vlad's essence and hers, and Jeanne realized she did not know how much time had passed or whether that daughter might already be in Hell. Anna said she was still lucky. If Lilith had been another demon she would have collected on the contract the moment the firstborn was born, and gentle or not, Lilith was still a demon. Of the four counts, only two still fit a haven Vlad would not smash without paying for it. Adrasteia was essential and isolated from politics, and it was days away if they refused to waste energy. That left Scarlett, where the strongest female vampire lived, Vlad's general, a warrior he would not want to lose if she chose to shelter them. Before they moved, young vampire scouts closed in. Jeanne looked once and saw nobody old. Anna's eyes went a dangerous red, her wings spread, and she bolted for the blood. Jeanne told her not to kill them all. Leave two or three alive, so someone could still talk. Screams went through the trees.[325]
Anna came back smiling at the freedom and found Jeanne staring at three dead vampires. Jeanne offered the bad news first. A holographic image showed Theo sleeping with Vlad's first wife, in clothes Jeanne recognized, because Jeanne had been the one who helped that wife catch the man. The night in the video had not been the son. The first wife had kidnapped [[Adonis Snow]] and used him as a toy, and Jeanne had covered the betrayal for a bribe. In that family it had always paid to hold another wife's power, and they had never been as tight as they pretended. If Snow was answering that old night, Jeanne guessed the political climate was worse than it looked and a civil war could come, which put the children in danger, though she did not think the thing behind the scenes would explode immediately.[326]
The good news arrived tied to the shock. Another image showed a man using the powers of the three count clans, a video from the games between the families, taken while the two of them slept. His name was Victor. He had become the fifth pillar, the fifth count, the youngest vampire in history to hold that seat. Jeanne showed him saving Natashia from a transformed man and then gave the clan name. Alucard. Anna heard Dracula spelled backwards and treated it as a slap the king of vampires had accepted. Jeanne said the man might be like Vlad. She would only be sure if she saw him, but she asked which young vampire could face a count, and the information said he had appeared less than two years ago. Only special vampires broke time that fast, and progenitors were that kind of being. Anna's eyes went blood red. She grabbed Jeanne and laughed that two monsters, two kings, two progenitors could not live in the same place, and that if they joined him they could take revenge. Jeanne slapped her, told her to calm down, and told her to set the guess aside. Even the wives had not seen Vlad use his full power. Only the first and the second had, thousands of years ago, and those two were dead. She did not believe a boy was beating a monster more than five thousand years old on a rumor. They nodded, left the dead vampires, and went to Clan Scarlett, because the man was Scathach's disciple and Scathach could tell them more.[326]
A few days later Victor was standing in Clan Adrasteia's training yard, the ground reserved for Eleonor's forces, and every elite in it was a woman. Six of them, almost his own height, were exercising in sports shirts. Six months under Scathach had left him with a warrior's taste. His master was muscular without being a freak of bulk, lean, the muscle used as accent, and he ranked her six-pack among the most perfect he had seen. He still did not look at the squad with lust. By his own instinct only one woman in that yard had the spice that pulled him, and she was a battle maniac. The first thing Eleonor had done on coming home was train. She said standing still had made her rusty, and she had agreed to let him watch. She was alone, white-haired, a greatsword in her hands.[326]
Mizuki came in with Siena, Lacus and Pepper. Siena said that as companions kidnapped by a rude man, they ought to get along, and Pepper told him he had kidnapped her and brought her here. He said yes, patted her head, and told her not to make that face of despair, because it would get worse. She called him a moron, said she hated him, and hugged her sister. She could not even be properly angry. Her sisters had already told her the kidnapping was her mother's idea, and Victor could not have taken Scathach's daughter without his wife's permission. The place had nothing she wanted. No manga, no anime, no television, no internet. Lacus had given up. [[Rex Invictus|Home]] would only get her kicked back out. She asked where his odachi was. He said the last time he had seen her, she had been in the carriage, and that he could be careless because only he could touch her. He raised his hand. Things broke, and in a few seconds the odachi was in his grip. Mizuki started to ask if destroying the house was acceptable. Eleonor screamed at him not to destroy her house. He apologized. She huffed and went back to the sword.[326]
He asked why the strong vampires in that place were women. Siena said the males were lazy, that they left the work to the women, and that the four big clans being run by women had bent the society around them. Mizuki said it was not the human world's feminism. It was the consequence of what male vampires chose. Powerful men existed. Niklaus, Vlad's royal guards, the leaders of the coliseum. Few of them took a post that everyone watched the way a count's seat was watched, and that absence had become the rumor that powerful male vampires did not exist. They existed. They did not want the influential jobs. The royal guard worked twelve hours and then did whatever they liked, and the demand was high enough that the watches could be traded. A group that never stopped lived inside the castle, the king's personal guards, and almost nobody wanted that post, because it cost freedom. Only the fanatics took it. Victor said it back to them. The men would not take the troublesome jobs, so across time the women held the important places and the men played. Siena and Lacus said that was it. His answer was "Bruh."[326]
Pepper and Lacus also increased the seriousness of their training. Remaining merely protected younger sisters was becoming increasingly incompatible with the level of danger surrounding Victor's family.[327]

##### Ophis' Disappearance and Nero
Chapters 335–342
A completely different crisis began when Ophis vanished from [[Nightingale]]. Vlad ordered extensive searches throughout his territory before accepting that his youngest daughter was no longer inside the realm. The disappearance affected the normally detached King far more visibly than most events involving his older children, and Alexios was ordered to devote himself to finding her in the Human World.[328] The truth was considerably less sinister than everyone initially feared. Ophis had disappeared through her own mistake.[329] Several weeks earlier, she had received permission to visit Victor and attempted to use her undeveloped spatial abilities to teleport toward the mark associated with him. Instead of reaching Victor, Ophis accidentally teleported herself completely outside Nightingale and appeared in Tokyo.[329] There she encountered a golden-eyed girl carrying two guns: [[Nero]].[329]
Nero initially had no desire to become responsible for a strange vampire child who had appeared without explanation. Her attitude changed when she learned that Ophis called Victor Alucard her father.[329] Nero looked like a child of about ten to thirteen, dressed entirely in black with a hood up, golden eyes, and a revolver in each hand. Ophis had not walked into that hiding place. A dark mist opened in Nero's temporary shelter and a little girl in a gothic dress stepped out of it. Nero remembered the arrival that way, and she only changed her mind about keeping the child once the name Alucard was attached to the father Ophis kept calling for.[329]
Nero already understood enough about Victor to know that allowing harm to come to one of his children would be extraordinarily dangerous for everyone involved. She therefore agreed to keep Ophis alive until Victor could find her.[329] Because Ophis could not safely move through daytime Tokyo, Nero provided enchanted clothing capable of protecting her from sunlight. The two girls also concealed their identities behind supernatural masks, Nero using an Oni-like mask while Ophis wore a fox mask.[330] Their timing was disastrous. Japan's supernatural factions were already moving around the coming [[Hyakki Yakō]], placing Youkai, Witches, Japanese vampires and Shinto-connected beings in unusually close proximity.[330] Ophis and Nero consequently attracted attention from multiple factions despite attempting to remain hidden.[331]
Ophis also encountered Haruna, a powerful Nine-Tailed Kitsune. The girl's immediate reaction was emotionally significant: because of superficial similarities and Ophis' own memories, she momentarily looked at Haruna and called her Mother.[331] Rumors soon spread that an important Nightingale child was wandering Japan without her normal protectors. Predators, opportunists and supernatural groups began hunting the girls.[332] For seven days, Nero protected Ophis. The first attackers were manageable, but every supernatural corpse left behind increased curiosity regarding the identity of the mysterious armed girl protecting a Vampire princess. Stronger pursuers followed.[332] Ophis attempted to help using her spatial powers, but she lacked the experience to repeatedly manipulate space under pressure. Excessive use caused Blood to leak from her eyes and nose, leaving Nero responsible for most of the fighting.[333] Despite accumulating injuries, Nero continuously placed herself between Ophis and their pursuers.
The girl Victor had barely begun to know was effectively risking her life for the daughter he had chosen as his own.[333]

##### The Crimson Nightmare
Chapters 343–349
About a week after Ophis disappeared, Victor learned that nobody knew where she was, and everything else stopped mattering. He opened his information networks, called the Witches and the other supernatural contacts, and ordered Natalia to have transport ready.[334] Ruby asked one thing before he left. Do not destroy the country if something had happened to Ophis. He did not promise.[334] What he was walking into was already being called the Crimson Nightmare.[335] The name began as [[Nero]]'s massacre. Before he ever reached Tokyo she had gone through the beings trying to capture or kill Ophis, weapons first and then abilities that kept getting more violent, until the ground around the two girls was covered in bodies. The Japanese authorities were not only counting the dead. The killing was inside Tokyo, and violence on that scale would show the hidden world to ordinary Humans.[335]
When he reached Japan and found Ophis and the badly wounded Nero surrounded by enemies, the dynamic of the hunt reversed instantly.[336] The man in front of them when the hunt turned was not the Count who had been negotiating in [[Nightingale]]. Victor's face unravelled until the skin was gone and only darkness, sharp teeth and blood-red eyes remained, a large pure-red bat wing tore out of his back, and an odachi covered in the power of blood dropped out of the sky beside him. He had already cut August, a tall man with long white hair, two scars on his face and a priest's outfit cut for movement, in half before August felt him move. He healed Ophis and Nero with progenitor blood, working through Nero's body the way a surgeon would, pulling the poison out until he spat black and green liquid. What he said over them was not a challenge. Everyone would die. He was hunting and destroying. Everyone responsible, everyone who thought they could profit, and everyone who had targeted his daughter.[335]
Victor was not interested in efficient execution. Many of the surviving attackers were deliberately kept alive long enough to suffer or provide information. Even experienced warriors around Victor recognized that his reaction went beyond ordinary battlefield violence.[336]
He told them to make no mistake, because this was not a fight, it was carnage. He threw the odachi up and used the bodies it caught as weapons, ripped a youkai open down the middle until organs hit the ground, snapped a vampire slave's arm, inverted the knee, tore the lower jaw off, pulled the spine out through the chest and struck the next head with that spine. A horizontal iai draw, lightning in the eyes for a fraction of a second, cut everything in front of him. August's head ended under his foot while Victor told him to scream like a pig being slaughtered, and he informed a Japanese noble that the noble vampires of Japan would go extinct and that the man would be remembered as the vampire who brought disaster on his country, if any survivors remained. A rain of blood fell after the blast he sent at the spectators who had only come to watch. [[Scathach]], watching with the others, said he could have killed them all quickly and had chosen not to, because he wanted the pain and death was only an easy way to get away from him. She then put Kaguya in charge of the capture and told them to bring in everyone they even slightly suspected, and to retreat without shame if they met a god or anything stronger than they were.[336]
Victor openly acknowledged the hypocrisy. He could tolerate supernatural factions fighting, killing and exploiting one another when he possessed no personal involvement, yet the same behavior became unforgivable when directed toward someone he considered family.[337] Victor did not pretend this was universal justice. It was his personal standard: His family came first.[337] The resulting battle brought Victor against a powerful Faith user named Leonardo. Victor tested [[Junketsu]], Fulger lightning, martial arts and his increasingly advanced elemental control against techniques capable of slowing his regeneration.[338] Victor's control over electricity had advanced enough that he could manipulate the surrounding atmospheric charge and condense enormous quantities of lightning into focused attacks rather than relying solely upon lightning coating his body.[338]
Leonardo came out of a breach in the sky. Victor told him faith came from the heart and asked what would be left of it if the heart was taken, then put a hand through the body and pulled the heart out. The body fell and broke into golden light, and Leonardo answered that as long as he breathed his faith was unshakable. A golden sword followed. Two golden wings opened and he came in with two swords. Victor met him in the air, lightning on the body, ice on the fists, spiked gloves, and he turned the thrust up to make a gap. An ice greatsword formed in the opening, caught fire, and took on yellow electricity. The swing should have cut Leonardo in half. A golden shield stopped it with a shock that rang across the street. A clone came in beside Victor while his sense of time stretched, and the golden arcs missed. Leonardo called him a damn monster and asked how he was that fast. Victor took the clone by the head, said he could not be left behind, and crushed it. The clone burst and erased the hand. The hand came back slowly, and Victor was smiling, because the man was stronger than the first exchange and still worth the trouble. The clone pulled the real body clear, broke the ice, and gold put Leonardo back together. Nero, Jeanne and Anna were watching a man of twenty-two do it. Scathach's verdict was that it was still not good enough, and that he would be good enough when he beat her. He landed on a building already glowing gold, and lightning took the rest of the change. Golden bat wings, a sharp tail, animal claws, a head like a lightning beast with the ears pointed, no lips, the teeth showing. He roared for the head. The shield held one blast and then broke under the claws. Leonardo spent an arm to get clear and grew it back. Victor told the priest to pray, because he was going to need the mercy. A lightning blade formed in the golden clouds, compressed down to the length of the odachi, and he warned Leonardo not to blink. Golden armor and larger wings came up. Leonardo blinked. Victor was already in front of him, and the two blades met in an explosion that ended the exchange.[338]
Leonardo ultimately withdrew under orders from General James, revealing that Victor had been fighting a manifested or remote body rather than the man's true physical form.[339]
The connection confirmed that General James remained involved with enemies operating far beyond the laboratory Victor had previously raided.[339] Once Ophis was secure, Victor refused to immediately hand her back to Vlad. Ophis no longer wanted to leave Victor's side after spending days believing nobody would reach her. Victor considered the girl's emotional condition more important than simply obeying the Vampire King's authority.[340] Alexios later confronted Victor during the aftermath and gained a clearer understanding of Victor's developing philosophy of leadership.[341] Victor believed a ruler needed to establish a direction and take responsibility for the people following him, but he rejected the idea that rulership required sacrificing the people he personally loved whenever the state demanded it.[341] If forced to choose between a kingdom and his family, Victor already knew which side he would choose.[341]

##### The Hyakki Yakō and Scathach Against Inari
Chapters 350–365
The prisoners were not stored as a neat interrogation list. Victor walked Maria through a wing that sounded like a slaughterhouse. One man was already under Roberta, tools in his groin and a thorn through his back, because that wing held people who had tried to profit from Ophis, whether they wanted her blood for politics or her body after her face had been passed around. Victor had taken the witches who circulated that face and expected their sisters to come for them. Charm, heavier than it had been before Adonis, pulled confessions apart until he could sort the frightened from the guilty. He told Maria the people behind the restricted door would not become vampire slaves. They would become ghouls, her toys, because the bite that had made her a noble vampire had not deleted what she was. Before the bad bite she had been entirely human. As a ghoul she had been almost entirely ghoul, with a sliver of human left to hold her face, her memories and her wants. His blood had shoved the ghoul sliver down beside that human sliver and filled the rest, so the wires and the ghoul-making were still hers, soul-deep, not a trick she had forgotten. He could have tried to cut the ghoul out of her and refused, because that would have erased her history. He opened the door on the ones he had judged usable, smiled in a way that made the captured demons afraid of him, and told them welcome to his humble abode.[342][343]
The crisis drew Victor deeper into Japanese supernatural society.
The Japan work also became a recruiting trap. A white-haired, corpse-pale man with black eyes, a living ghost in an intangible state, woke inside a screaming imitation of Hell and said "Well, fuck." Victor offered him money and a way out if he helped, or the room if he refused, and then admitted there had never been a second choice. Kaguya wanted to cover her face. Maria, blonde and already used to the joke, told her to get used to it. Victor pulled the ghost up by the hand, which should have been impossible, and the man gave the name he had chosen for himself, [[Yuuya Shinji]]. He recognized Kaguya as the maid who had chased him and told him her master would want a specimen like him. A salaryman the others had made their leader, [[Watanabe Gintoki]], said his group would take the work and warned that his constitution dumped bad luck on everyone around him and never on himself. Victor's answer was a plan and a wider smile. When a woman asked how they would be judged if nobody was watching, Kaguya tapped her heel and darkness poured off Victor until thousands of blood-red eyes covered the room. Hundreds of Clan Blank were already there, answering Kaguya as their second leader and Victor before even [[Scathach]]. He told them Kaguya held the leash, sent Maria to the people still being tortured, and petted her head until the tension left her. She was not an ordinary ghoul anymore. She was a queen of them, and he told Shinji not to run.[344]
The youkai side of the same crisis was a different room from that trap. Oni, kitsune and the people gathering for the [[Hyakki Yakō]] measured a stranger by whether he could fight, not by the titles [[Nightingale]] used.[345][346] Hours after he had lined his own plan up with Scathach's, Victor stood on a building over Shibuya Crossing, humming, and holding [[Nero]]'s hand while she told him to let go. The mask was gone. Her eyes were red, her white hair fell to her waist, and she was wearing an outfit like the one she had been given in Greece. The new body did not obey the strength she remembered. A grip she thought of as normal would pulverize a human. She jumped too high and hit her face on the ground, failed at a glass and a doorknob, and walked through walls. He held her so she would stop breaking the street, and he thought the failure was cute. Ophis was back in the gothic dress on his shoulder, calling him father and hugging his head.[345]
Jeanne and Anna came up onto the roof. One of them said she was bored. The other said she was curious about the event, and was lying. Jeanne was the one who answered honestly. Victor had expected Scathach to interfere the way she did with other girls. Jeanne said Scathach did not trust the two of them yet, which was fair after years without a word and with both of them weakened, and she repeated the permission Scathach had actually given. Out of respect for old acquaintances she would not meddle. They could talk to her disciple. She did not care what they wanted from him. Their usual tricks would be useless, because he was not a normal person, and she trusted his judgment enough to let him deal with it himself. Anna's glare was the bloodlust. Ophis hugged his head tighter and said "Mine." Anna said she was technically Ophis's mother. Ophis said mother was dead, and that her other mothers were father's wives. Anna had to hold the laugh. Vlad had lost the daughter of the woman he had loved most, and she thought it served him. Victor smiled, small, and then asked how anyone was supposed to trust a woman who was hiding her real name. He had taken it off micro-expressions, heartbeat and breathing, and he said he perceived time differently. Jeanne called that scary and asked why he had shown it. He stroked Ophis's head and said he did not know. When Ophis squeezed him because she felt people coming, he told her that unlike before, he was here, and that no one would dare touch her while he was. Nero watched the yōkai keep their distance with cold sweat on them. The man's presence alone was enough to frighten them, and for the first time she was standing on the strong side of that fear. Victor sighed that the past week had been intense, and that the event was finally here.[345]
[[Shuten Douji]] and [[Ibaraki Douji]] came through that crowd already arguing. Shuten was a male oni, thin, tall enough, without much muscle, handsome in a way the rest of his clan was not, and that was why the women liked him. The oni women were tall, muscular, built as warriors, lesser-muscled versions of Ibaraki. The clan ran eight women to two men. The women chose. A man who was offended was supposed to fight and prove he was better, and none of them dared, because Shuten was strong. Shuten laughed that their girls had dried Ibaraki to death. Ibaraki told him to shut his mouth, that female oni were too thirsty, and that he had been twenty. Shuten hoped the next harvest festival left him without a partner. Ibaraki said the same wish last year had been useless and that the number had practically doubled, and that Shuten was praying to the wrong god. [[Buddha]] was not going to accept a curse like that. He brought up Buddha banishing [[Sun Wukong]]. They were still at it when Shuten felt eyes on him, looked at Victor, and could not place the face.[345]
Ibaraki's presence went wild before Shuten got out more than the start of a warning. The mace was in his hand, the smile was big and wild, and his eyes glowed. For a few seconds the pressure was suffocating. A heavier one answered it, the weight of the whole planet. The world darkened. The moon turned red. Victor punched him in the stomach and sent him through buildings, miles of it, and only a few beings even saw the blow. He said that normally he would play, but this was no place for that. Ophis climbed onto his shoulder, raised a hand, and said "Oni, guy." Shuten knew her as the little girl who had been in that place a week ago. The white-haired girl was still holding Victor's other hand. From where Shuten stood, one of the women behind the stranger had blond hair and the other had a demon's wings and horns. The building Ibaraki had hit blew apart, and he came back to Shuten's side with blood on his lips, laughing that the blow had been really strong and that he could feel it. Victor smiled. He knew the type, an honest man who fought because he wanted to be stronger.[346]
Shuten started an apology for the attitude. Victor cut him off and asked whether a name was not polite before an attack. Ibaraki laughed and gave his. Ibaraki Douji, an ogre yōkai, called an oni in this country. Victor said the legends of the oni were famous outside Japan, and Ibaraki was glad people had not forgotten them. He asked the stranger's name and told him not to play, because no normal vampire threw him several miles. Victor laughed, called the omission his own mistake, and said he was Victor Alucard, the fifth vampire count of Nightingale, and that they could call him Alucard. He petted Ophis and introduced her as his daughter, Ophis Tepes. Both oni heard the king's surname. He introduced the girl at his hand as his adopted daughter, Nero Alucard. She said she did not remember being adopted and that he had never told her. He told her to deal with it. He doubted she could run from his wife now, because his wife liked her, and then he looked into her eyes and said she was not what she had been, and that he owed her an unpayable debt, a debt he would pay by protecting her for the rest of his life. The lifeless look scared her worse than the words. He apologized, turned his face aside until the look was gone, and went back to the oni.[346]
He told them the two women behind him were extras and should be ignored. Anna told him to go fuck himself. She was not an extra. She stomped, and the building shook, and then his smile stopped her breath, because the face was past ordinary beauty. He said she was worse than an extra. She was cannon fodder, a body without a name, used in a war so the villain would look worse, demon number one, the first sacrifice. She answered as a former general of Lilith's demons, someone feared through Hell, and said she would kill him. He spread his arms and left the chest open. She took the stance and did not strike. The child was on his shoulder. She asked, politely, whether he could put the little girl down first. He looked at her as if she had committed a crime and said the strongest warriors always had a little girl or a baby on the shoulder. If she could not force him to take Ophis down, she was not worthy, and she was so weak she could not even make him fight seriously. Ibaraki said that made sense. Shuten told him it made no sense and to stop agreeing. Jeanne tapped Anna's shoulder and said they could play later. Victor's face went neutral and the air changed. He looked at a point in the middle of the street. The yōki around Ibaraki went wild. Shuten, serious now, said that crazy woman had brought a huge army this time.[346]
Victor naturally responded well to people willing to prove themselves through combat. His meeting with Haruna became particularly important.[347] Haruna followed a philosophy Victor immediately recognized: she intended to walk the path she personally chose and accept the consequences without wasting her life regretting every decision.[348] The similarity between their mentalities attracted Victor's interest. Before the word became a sword, Anna was still trying to understand the man who had just called her cannon fodder. She asked Jeanne if he had been messing with her. Jeanne said the joke had been there from the start, pointed at Anna, to lighten the room and to keep hold of the conversation. Anna was embarrassed. Nobody played with her. Jeanne told her to socialize more. Anna said the world saw a walking piece of meat, women jealous and men lustful, and that her conversations had never gone far. Vlad was not a talker. In Hell she had been feared, and Lilith had been the person she actually spoke to. Jeanne said Victor's pull was not Vlad's heavy evil. It drew people. The oni standing around him were the proof, and Anna's own tail was swinging without her noticing it.[347]
Cold air gathered off him and an elegant ice throne stood up in seconds. Ophis sat in his lap. Nero sat on the arm and was not bothered by the ice. Jeanne took one side and said he was enjoying the show. He agreed and said he wanted popcorn. Anna took the other side and told them it had started. She was here. A portal larger than the earlier ones opened, and Haruna came through it in a black yukata, a fan in her hand, long black hair, nine black fur tails moving, and small fox ears. Dark power came off her, and her eyes were blood red. Victor said he liked that smile. The portal opposite let out Genji, long white hair and nine tails. Victor marked him against the last time. Not weak prey anymore. An irritating aura, divine energy, Inari's favorite. Jeanne said he looked tired. Shuten confirmed it. Victor stroked Ophis's head and said Genji had been busy. Haruna thought the dragons she had shown him last time had been worth it, because he had come prepared.[347]
Genji started to ask her whether she really meant to fight when it was not the time, saw the ice throne, and his face darkened. Victor nodded and mouthed at him to keep going with the show. Genji said shit. Haruna said the foreigner would not run, that she would have him inside the Hyakki Yagyō, and she pointed the fan at Victor while the dark power rose. Genji said a foreigner did not matter and that the chaos in Japan was not their fight. Victor called that irrational. So what if the world was ending. So what if Japan was in chaos. So what if the gods were hiding in fear. The fight still happened. He laughed and said it was well said. Lightning answered him. The gods were furious, and his smile widened. He told her to decide to go all the way and leave the rest. Her smile widened with the nine tails, and she said finally someone understood. Blood red met eyes black as darkness. The smiles matched, and they laughed in the same breath. The two powers struck each other in the air without either of them having meant to throw them. Yōkai went nauseous under it. Shuten caught Ibaraki's arm and told him not to intrude, because oni inside that mess would not be safe afterward. Ibaraki said he had not been going to. Shuten called the lie. Genji closed his eyes and opened them an oppressive neon green. He told Haruna to live by her choice and not to regret it, and the voice put a shiver through her. Her aura blew out and damaged what stood around her. She pulled the fan, pointed it at him, and said she had never regretted a decision, because from the beginning she had done what she wanted, when she wanted, wherever she wanted, and there was no room for the petty in her hadō. Victor's eyes widened. He knew the sentence.[347][348]
The fan became a katana in a black sheath. Her yōki went calm, a lake's surface circling her, and she set her feet as if a dance were about to start. She gave her name, Otsuki Haruna, and promised that once the katana left the sheath it would not go back until the victory she had promised was in her hand. She said "Mai." Genji cracked his neck. White power climbed into the sky. Red tattoos came up on his face, his body and his arms, and he raised a white-sheathed katana and laughed that yes, they should fight. He named himself a servant of Inari Okami and said that in his goddess's name he would drive his Hyakki Yagyō to victory, and that the parade of a hundred demons ought to stay in the memory of everyone watching. Both of them called the yōkai, and both of them told their armies to dance.[348]
They met at the Shinjuku intersection. Drawing her sword put a feeling of death on the field. Her style was irregular, elegant, and it looked like dancing. His was rigid, old, polite, and high. Behind the gates, thousands of eyes. [[Yotsuba Kuroka]] came out on Haruna's side, long black hair, sapphire blue eyes, a modern yukata, three cat tails and black cat ears. [[Hashimoto Gin]] came out on Genji's side, three tails, a flashy white yukata, white hair, a face that resembled Genji. Three oriental dragons of different colors rose for her. A gigantic white oriental dragon, blue eyes and white scales, larger than those three, rose against them. The three bit into the white one. It called a hurricane, and the weather changed. The rest of the armies spilled into the air, the ground and the buildings. Victor's building and the center where the two of them fought stayed clear of that wreckage.[348]
