Watching her say that sentence had already changed his plan. Kaguya took the new orders in his head. Shinji was not going to [[Kurama]] yet. He was going to the territory of the unknown nine-tailed fox. Maria was to be ready with the ghouls. The maids and the girls were to be warned. The nine-tailed fox and the vampires on that side had to die. Gintoki was to be thrown at [[Gyuki]] to make chaos. Scathach was to be ready, because Inari would move when Genji lost. Then the dragons annoyed him on their own. He told Ophis to hold on, left the throne, built ice under his feet and went up. Nero grabbed his arm when the white dragon roared. He caught the larger dragon by the tail, the three smaller ones tangled in the spin, turned the knot until the wind was a hurricane, and threw all four of them. Ophis had been treating the field like a zoo, cat and dog and snake and fox, eyes bright, and the spin made her sick. Shuten asked what the man had just done to beings that sat at the top of the food chain. Anna, Nero, Jeanne and Ibaraki answered together that yes, he had thrown four dragons. Shuten asked for a drink. Ibaraki handed him the gourd. Victor went back to the throne, satisfied, and told them to continue. The armies were irritated. Haruna and Genji were not interrupted again.[348]
Haruna also refused Victor's help during one of her own confrontations, insisting that the battle belonged to her. Victor respected the decision because it mirrored his own hatred of people interfering whenever he deliberately chose to test himself against danger.[349] Haruna shouted his name across that field and told him not to mess around. It was not his fight. He said he knew, which was why he had not killed the flying snakes and had only sent them flying, and that he did not get involved in other people's fights. She said that was good, and she told Kuroka it was time. Kuroka had been waiting. She laughed, told her side to get up and get ready, because things were going to get serious, and she called the line of defense. Her hair rose as if gravity had let go of it. Haruna's tails fluttered. A dark power covered them and spread like black threads. She jumped toward the moon, and her eyes shone a bluish white. The threads went into her subordinates. The injured healed. The ones hanging between life and death were pulled back, and an extra cloak sat on them to cut the chance of dying. The control had to be exact. When a neck was cut on her side, Haruna felt the pain herself. Genji did not know what she was doing. He said that whatever it was, they could not let it happen, and Gin nodded and started ordering yōkai to attack.[349]
Victor asked if the black energy was like what Anna used. She said demons worked a demonic magic off the negative energy produced in Hell. In terms of energy it was purer, and more evil, which was her way of saying demons were superior, and because that energy was so strong their versatility was low. She also told him, plainly, that he could not go to Hell the way he was. Shuten Douji answered the other half. Yōki was a negative energy yōkai used. It was part of nature, it had always been around, and yōkai used it without having to learn a foreign art. Victor could not feel it. Ibaraki said the noble vampires of Japan could, and then he buried them in advance. Special yōki had appeared as time passed, and the owners of those yōki had formed clans. Haruna was one example. The man beside them was more special than that. Victor asked whether the energy hurt the body when it was used, and then he pointed at the obvious case standing in front of them. A vampire using demonic energy. He said he would go to Hell in the future. Nero asked if he was right in his head. Jeanne said who knows. He set Kaguya to take the noble vampires of Japan alive. What he took from Haruna, past the technique, was that she was a good woman who was afraid of losing the people under her. Her side roared and went to finish it.[349]
Victor observed techniques outside the systems he had already studied, including Hadō, and once again began analyzing an unfamiliar martial tradition rather than dismissing it simply because it originated outside vampire society.[348] The conflict eventually escalated beyond ordinary Youkai politics and brought major Shinto Divine authority into the situation.[350][351]
On the mountain, Scathach, Kaguya, Ruby and Sasha were already reading the change. Scathach said he had really taken an interest in that woman. The laugh was not a happy one. She thought of him throwing out what he had planned because of her, and she felt it the way she felt a thief's hand on something that mattered. Ruby stared at a cup of red tea that had frozen solid and thawed it back to liquid with her water. Sasha said she had warned her, and the smile did not reach her eyes. She asked if they were going on with the offensive, because the sooner that piece ended, the sooner they got back to Victor. Scathach thought, and said she would go with the ghost. The skill was useful. Used right, it could pull that woman out of the divine world. She had understood him the moment he said Inari would appear if that fox lost. Ruby asked if he was going to do it. Kaguya said yes, he definitely would. Ruby said poor bastard. Sasha told them to stop talking in code, and then she understood. He would wait out the tedious fight. When the woman won, he would move, and the massacre would land on that fox. Inari would see the subordinate, and godly arrogance would drag her down to punish the insolent mortal. Scathach's contempt for that arrogance was open. She ordered Victor left to his plan, ordered the ghost sent into the fox's unknown territory because they needed information, and said she was going to see Alexios and Maria. By then, Maria's toys ought to be ready to use.[350]
Ruby still hated the weapon. Using them damaged what vampires looked like, and she had wanted this incident blamed on another group for the plans that came after. Scathach called her daughter and said it would be used only as a last resort. She set a lesser god at the strength of an adult vampire of five hundred years, and she said a ghoul infection could corrupt even a god, thousands of years to climb back out, and that some minor gods might die of it if they had no faith energy and stepped out of a safe place. Sasha put a document in front of her. The main hands on the Ophis incident were Inari, who had ordered Kurama to spread the rumors, and the greedy people around that order. The same paper said the gods' racism against yōkai had hardened. They wanted a human purity more than they wanted yōkai abilities. Scathach's private measure of gods was greedy, petty, opportunistic, depraved and hypocritical, and underneath it she still kept a human master, a woman with long red hair and a spear, which was why she had not thrown humanity away with the rest. She asked Sasha what she thought. Sasha said the gods would not come to save Inari. They would see an intervention as the chance to be done with a race they already called disgusting, bug killers, and they would be disappointed, because Victor was not on an uncontrolled killing spree. Scathach answered with her own teaching. Anyone who picked up a sword had to be ready to be stabbed, and if an enemy raised a sword, man or woman or child, you faced them and you killed them. She laughed that he had mixed that lesson with the dogma he got from his parents. Kaguya said Gintoki was not still on the way. He had already arrived.[350]
Night, in the streets. Watanabe Gintoki was an ordinary salaryman, neither tall nor short, not handsome and not ugly, not fat and not thin. He picked up a ten-yen coin. A yōkai went for him and the dodge happened by itself. Another was taken by the mouth, covered in fire, and left weakened, which was Roberta's work. Eve, red-skinned, big claws, called the ability absolute bullshit, and the other Eve in her agreed. Roberta told her not to get close to him. Eve vanished, came back on a roof, and said she knew. They had already watched what the skill did to an attacker: a three-meter oni slipping on a banana and taking a pole through the skull. Gintoki pocketed the coin, said that by the end of the night he would be rich, and walked to an ancient Japanese mansion to meet Gyuki, a tall muscular oni who ate humans. He was worried and he went anyway, because of the money. At the gate he announced himself as Count Alucard's messenger, and then he called Gyuki the way a man calls a childhood friend. Eve asked why he was talking like that. Roberta told her not to ask. The door opened. Gyuki asked what he wanted. Gintoki checked a picture on his phone, confirmed the face, and delivered the count's message in a serious voice. "Your mother is so fat, that when God said; Let there be light, she had to get out of the way."[350]
Gyuki heard it again from the human's mouth, veins up, and for a moment the stupidity of it froze him. Eve watched with Roberta. The older woman was shaking her head and holding a laugh at how childish the whole insult was. Hours earlier Eve had asked Victor why a human was being sent at all. She thought the plan could fail. He had violet eyes, he was amused, he petted her head, and he said Gintoki's power was special and that the show would be worth watching. Gintoki tried to leave on a "Nigerundayo." Gyuki blocked him, packed him in with yōkai, and ordered him killed for the insult to his mother. Gintoki said he had only carried Alucard's words and was not the master. A small yōkai with a face like an umbrella spun and threw needles. Every needle missed a stationary man by inches and hit the umbrella's own companions. A red yōkai with a big head cursed the lesser ones and breathed fire. Gintoki screamed, stumbled on broken asphalt, and fell backward at a right angle with his body still upright, so the fire missed and the street went quiet. Eve and Roberta gasped from where they were watching. The other Eve understood what Victor had meant. More of them came. Five closed in, and Gintoki fell. A blade aimed at his head missed because of the fall and cut a companion's sharp tail off, and the spinning tail took the heads of the yōkai around it, including the one who had swung. Blood painted his only suit red, and he complained that blood was expensive to clean. Roberta called it beyond bullshit. Eve agreed. Another wave came out of the gate and then hesitated, because they had recognized the abnormality as Alucard's man. Eve was running that piece of the mission. Victor's order was not to interfere unless Gintoki was about to die, and she did not believe that was going to happen. Roberta heard Victor in the way she laughed, and told her they should just watch.[351]
On Haruna's side of the same night, yōkai with severed necks and missing limbs were getting back up through dark power. Haruna was covered in blood, opening new wounds and closing them again. Victor sat on the ice throne, annoyed, violet eyes lit, and he called the whole thing a messy show of force, no strategy and no discipline. Her side was disorganized. The other side was disciplined and could not bend. He wanted the balance between them, and his hand cracked the armrest. Ophis, about five, held his hand. Haruna's blood felt familiar. She was not Ophis's mother, and Ophis still wanted to help the woman who was getting hurt, and she called her mom off that feeling. He smiled, because the child was ordinary and wrong in the same moment. Shuten explained the Hyakki Yagyō to him and to Ibaraki. Victory was the subordinates securing their fights, and then the leader beating the other leader. Haruna had to prove she could command, or the forces she absorbed would betray her. It was not an annihilation. Victor agreed she was a monster. Both oni said they wanted to fight her. He understood the shape of it and did not know how to help without stepping on the pride the custom required. Haruna said this was enough. Her eyes went back to black, and her people retreated through a portal when Yotsuba Kuroka ordered it, "Retreat-nya." Kuroka took an iai stance. Her yōki climbed like a heavenly fire, hand on the katana. Shuten felt it as thorns through the skin. Genji remembered a nine-tailed man taking a mountain apart, his face darkened, and he ordered his own side to retreat. He was late. Haruna said "Mugetsu."[351]
Scathach confronted Inari.[352] Scathach came to that meeting in her usual battle attire, long red hair in the wind, a strange red spear in her right hand with runes carved along the hilt, looking like a maiden going to war. A crimson aura burst off her and the people around her felt a battlefield whose ground was covered in hundreds of thousands of corpses, and then that aura gathered onto the spear. Inari stood as a golden ten-tailed fox beside Genji, in a traditional Japanese dress, long golden hair and a slim body, drew her katana, and covered herself in white energy while she tried to ask the gods for help and got none. Scathach told her it had been a while since she had fought a god, and to have fun. Inari's answer was that the day was finally a chance to get rid of her.[352]
The prospect of fighting a genuine Goddess excited Scathach rather than intimidated her. She released portions of the power that had earned her recognition as the strongest female Vampire and directly clashed with Inari.[352][353]
She told Inari it had been a while since she had fought a god, and to have fun. Inari started to say it would not be fun. Scathach kicked her in the face, and the face distorted. Time caught up, Inari flew through buildings, and Scathach finished the lesson on the way. Losing focus in front of an opponent of her level was a grave mistake. The next punch took Inari on the chin and caved the jaw inward like wet paper, a crunch, and Inari went into the sky. Scathach set herself on the ground with the spear in both hands. Cold air came off her, the aura exploded, the long red hair floated, and she said they would warm up first. Ice ran from her hands over the spear. She flicked it into one hand, stepped with the right foot, and the ground burst into a crater. She spun for the momentum and threw. The spear went with sonic booms. Inari's eyes glowed faintly. Fire covered her body. One hand pointed at the ground and a torrent of flame burst. The other went blue with electrical sparks, pointed at the sky, and lightning came out of rumbling clouds. Scathach clapped her palms and said "Multiply." The runes lit, and the spear split into thousands. Inari cut space with her hand to pass through. The rift froze. Her head hit something solid, and she asked what the fuck that was. The first spear went through her fire. She dodged and took a small cut on the cheek, and the cut began to freeze her. Stronger fire answered, a small sun in the sky that erased what Scathach had put on the field. Scathach, unseen until she was there, asked if mere fire could stop her. Ice covered her until she looked pure blue, and she punched Inari in the face toward the ground. The sun died when the concentration broke. Scathach raised a hand, stopped her own spear in the stratosphere, turned the runes red, spun it, and took it back.[353]
She said she felt a little motivated, and that she wanted to know if the technique still worked against gods. The ice left her body. The runes went mad, and a red aura burst and shrouded spear and body like a cloak. Inari's eyes went gold. The air changed, the elements acted wrong, and space distorted. She landed, took the katana, covered it in a blue power that bent space, sheathed it, set one foot back, leaned forward, closed her eyes, breathed, and left her hand hovering at the handle with the danger sitting on it. Scathach's smile grew and the red aura exploded upward. Victor told anyone who did not want to die to get out of that place. He vanished in lightning while holding Haruna, and the lightning spread over her without harming her. He came back beside Genji's throne, called Ophis and Nero, took Ophis on his back and Nero on the other shoulder, said leave, and vanished. Anna complained that he could have been more specific. Jeanne screamed at her to shut up and leave, and retreated at a vampire's speed. Anna's face darkened, her wings opened, and she flew. Shuten and Ibaraki fled. Scathach raised an ice shelf, kicked off it, and the booms followed. The red aura held the air away from her so the wind resistance died, then condensed around spear and body until she came in as a red comet, a piercing art evolved for the flesh of a god. Inari opened her eyes and drew. Space shook. The spear's tip met the katana. White light burst far enough to light miles. The crash evaporated the ground and left a crater on the scale of a small atomic bomb, and Ibaraki and Shuten were still inside the blast when it took them, both of them yelling. Victor watched the jump in her since she had drunk his blood and measured it the way he measured a level in a game, a boost that arrived because she had been pushed. The blades were still meeting, clang after clang, when the light began to fade.[353]
The scale of their battle demonstrated the enormous gap separating ordinary supernatural beings from ancient [[Vampire Counts]] and Gods. Their attacks affected the environment over enormous distances and forced observers to remain far from the actual exchange.[354][355] The field they were actually standing in was a mirror of the fight, close enough to Shibuya Crossing that cracks in the space showed humans on the crossing, and something unseen kept repairing the cracks as fast as they opened. Victor, long black hair loose while he watched, asked if that was space, and called it another level of bullshit. Jeanne narrowed her eyes and asked if this was Scathach's current level, then answered herself. She was not really fighting yet. Anna said that when vampires fought they usually took the ancestral form, the count transformation, and Scathach had not done it. Victor said that was not what he was talking about. To make a god bleed royal blood, the weapon had to be special. A god slayer. Anna knew the category. She had been close to a woman whose main weapon was one, Lilith, and Lilith was the only being she knew who carried one, which was why a goal of killing gods was not an empty boast. He listened, and he said it again. This spear had been bathed in the divine blood of gods.[354]
Scathach was still the smiling red-haired woman, and the count form was still unused. She had not used the strongest of those techniques either, the strength that sat with Pepper, the ice with Siena, the speed with Lacus, the control she kept toward Victor, or the defense Ruby had improved. A simpler exchange was doing the damage. She attacked, and columns of ice rose behind Inari. Inari attacked, and the space around her distorted. The runed spear met the katana with a sound like glass shattering, and the air around them cracked into crevices. The stalemate lasted minutes and kept intensifying. Scathach parried, made the opening, and put the spear through Inari's chest. Inari coughed a golden liquid onto the floor. Nero said golden blood, and asked if gods could bleed. Jeanne said the same thing. Scathach called them the best punching bags she had. They did not die, they were strong, and even if they died they came back a few hundred years later. Inari said gods had to be respected, and she told the witch not to treat gods like toys. Scathach asked why not, and then she called her weak. Inari said she was a god. Scathach said a weak god. A weak god became her punching bag, and a weak god was only useful as something to improve herself against. The fate of the weak was to lick the boots of the strong, and it did not matter whether the weak thing was a god, a vampire, a human or a yōkai. Knowing that was why weakness disgusted her. She told Inari to rejoice. At least she had done something other than performing arrogance in front of a decaying mirror. Then she asked if Inari was menstruating, because she talked a lot of useless shit, and she said Inari seemed to be the only one who cared. She asked whether it was strange that the gods of this country had not even tried to intervene while her disciple hunted the beings responsible for what had happened to Ophis. Their silence had been permission. They had been saying to go ahead and annihilate the yōkai, because it did them a favor. She told Inari to look around and find a tengu. Tengu were the eyes and ears of the gods, and they were gone. Becoming a god had not made her smarter. Scathach laughed that she was as smart as that childlike body looked. Inari shouted that she was not a child. Scathach ignored her, called Victor, and reminded him that he still had not unlocked her clan's vampire count form. She said she would show him the initial form, her clan's basic transformation.[354]
Her hair went snow white and her ears pointed. Her hands went completely pale under ice gauntlets. From the thighs to the toes her legs became pure ice, and a long ice tail came out behind her. Two gigantic bat wings opened. A crown of ice grew on her head. She gained a few centimeters and stood at his height. The armor left red behind and became a delicate icy white, spiked where the detail asked for it. The spear froze solid. The voice went cold and apathetic. She said this was her clan's basic vampire count form, and she told Inari, let's dance. Victor watched a woman who was not like Violet, Sasha and Ruby, and not like Natashia, who had evolved over time, and he thought she was beautiful. If he found a way to break the racial boundary, he was not going to make her wait long. He also thought that being a god was not anything special after all. Haruna had looked at him and then at the fight, and what she had for it was nothing. Ibaraki asked whether they had really been expected to die that easily. Shuten did not know how to feel about the low expectation, and said he understood the thought anyway. Inari's face had already distorted toward something demonic, red tattoos standing on her body and her face, and a golden pillar went up off her into the sky. Night-things felt it. Vampires, yōkai, demons.[354]
She took a step, and the ground around her became a land of ice, a view toward the North Pole, with a small smile on her face. First move. Her cold voice carried, and she called Ice Age. The flat ice threw up great mountains. Inari flew between them, tails catching fire, and called it mere ice. A gigantic fireball opened in the sky and did not last. Second move. Cold air left Scathach's mouth, and she said, in an orderly tone, let there be life. The mountain nearest Inari shook. A large red eyeball looked out of it, and Inari asked what the fuck it was. The answer was a roar. The mountain sprouted two great wings and a western dragon of more than fifty meters, the height of the Eiffel Tower, flew toward the heavens. It looked at the fireball with disdain, swelled its chest, and breathed a blast of ice that killed it. Victor asked, "Father, can you do that?" and answered himself that he could not. His eyes glowed. Freezing the ground and raising ice mountains he understood. A dragon that was alive, that had a heart, was another level, and he watched it with his whole attention. Anna and Jeanne had their mouths open. They had never seen this side of Scathach. Inari shouted the name [[Scathach Elderblood Scarlett|Scathach Scarlett]] and asked what she was, and how a mere vampire created an ice dragon out of nothing, because making life was a god's territory.[355]
Third move. Inari was already full with the dragon's claws and an ice breath that could freeze her existence on a touch, her own fire no match for it, and she asked if there was more. She spent what she had on controlling space. Scathach spun the ice spear once, struck the ground with the handle, and said "Empress," the way a ruler declares a thing. For a few seconds nothing changed. Then the ground quaked. Ice pillars came up in the hundreds of thousands, deformed, and built. She floated slowly through a great pillar while the rest rose and covered the structure, until a gigantic cocoon of ice stood there. A declaration followed. "I am the Ruler." Icy air burst, hard enough that everyone but Victor shielded their eyes. He looked through it without caring, holding himself back from jumping into the fight, and the smile on him was the one people who knew him already understood. When the blizzard died, a fairy-tale castle of ice was standing, a majestic throne on top of it, and behind her an arsenal of ice weapons, swords, spears, axes and a greatsword, hung as if she were master of every one of them. She shook the long snow-white hair back, crossed her legs, rested her face on her hand, and said that her orders were absolute. She looked at the dragon still fighting Inari and said come. The dragon turned, ignored Inari, flew to the castle, and perched on it as guardian.[355]
Inari's face distorted again. She asked if Scathach was resting while fighting her. Scathach's smile grew, and she said exactly. Golden tattoos brightened. Pressure left the body, and golden light shrouded it, and then a golden fox with ten gigantic tails stood in front of the castle, majestic, fluffy, each tail an element of nature and each tail higher than the mountains, a natural disaster standing up. Haruna's eyes gleamed. She knew the shape of a nine-tailed fox, and she understood that this was something else. Victor sneered and called her a foolish woman. Scathach sneered the same way and said the humanoid form had been the better chance, and that now she was only a big target. A snap of the fingers turned the ice spikes into a gigantic cannon built to defend a fortress. She said fire. The fire tail moved in front of the shots and bounced them, and Inari called it the wrong decision. The cannonballs hit the fur, became spikes of ice, and pierced the tail. Another snap raised a gigantic ballista, a thin thorn of ice held by chains. She said fire. The shot was faster. It pierced the fox's neck and expanded from the inside, and the chain drew taut and pinned her. The castle threw the rest of the arsenal.[355]
Under that roar she changed to a teacher's voice, looking at Inari and talking to Victor. Three movements for creation. That was the name of her personal technique, ice used together with the runes she had learned from her first master. She categorized it as a continental technique. Used at its full capacity, destroying a big country was as easy as breathing, and it was not at full strength while the fox screamed under the spikes. Jeanne said the fact that she considered it possible was what made her amazing, and crazy. Scathach asked if they knew why she considered her clan the strongest. The power was more flexible. In this form she was not as fast as Natashia's lightning, and she did not have the destructive power of Agnes's fire. In this form she could beat both countesses without leaving the throne. Nobody who heard it thought it was a bluff. She could raise an empire with what she had just done. Empress had been the last move, and the ice dragon was not the only creature the technique could make if she spent all of it. Gods watching from above, the ones who had wanted to descend and show off, felt that wish freeze and break. Inari was popular in that heaven. Male gods told her they were sorry and to rest in peace, and they meant a sleep rather than a death, because if she rested they meant to be at her temple afterward. They were rooting for her to fall. Susanoo called for her not to fight too hard, said she had done splendidly, and that he, Susanoo, would be waiting when she was born again. Another god said the one who would wait was him, and the two of them started a fight over seniority while she was still in the air.[355]
Scathach stopped swinging the spear and held it as if she meant to throw it in one direction. She told them to remember what had happened today, for all of life, and the people watching did not know whether she meant Inari, Victor, or the gods themselves. They knew they would not forget it. She threw. Sonic blasts followed the spear, and when it was close to Inari's head it grew and pierced the entire head. The golden fox crumbled into golden light. A spirit rose toward the sky. Inari said she would remember this, Scathach Scarlett. Scathach hoped so. When Inari came back, Scathach would come after her again, and she would make sure Inari did not die so easily. Inari's face darkened at the smile. Faster than a hero who prided himself on his speed, she said that actually she would forget it, and that she would be quiet in her divine realm. Scathach told her not to worry. If she did not show up, Scathach would come after her. Inari's face went darker. Her last word was fuck. The spirit exploded into thousands of golden lights and soared into the heavens. The spear came back to Scathach's hand. She turned around and said the lesson was over.[355]
Scathach nevertheless restrained herself enough to avoid turning the conflict into a continental disaster.[355] By the end of the Japanese incident, Victor had gained new relationships among the Youkai, expanded his understanding of another supernatural civilization and confirmed Nero's willingness to protect Ophis even at the cost of her own life.[356]
Maria was looking at hundreds of ghouls walking, still wearing the faces they had died with. They would rot. They were dead, zombies with more strength and with the infection still in them, and she said it turned out they did not need to use them. Alexios told her she could not say that yet. Enemies were still hiding, the unknown nine-tailed fox among them. She answered, neutral, that she did not see how that fox was a threat to her master, and she was suspicious of him. She knew he was not truly Alucard's ally. He was there because of what had happened to Vlad's daughter. He warned her not to underestimate nine-tailed foxes. They were closer to divine beings than she thought. She asked so what, smiled like a fanatic, and said that divine beings, demons, vampires, werewolves or yōkai, her master would be stronger than all of them together. The confidence shook him a little. He did not think it was a bad thing. It was what a good subordinate looked like, and he could feel that she did not trust him. He said she was not wrong, and he looked at the battlefield. She narrowed her eyes, ignored him, and went back to the ghouls.[356]
He thought the suspicion was correct. He was not Alucard's ally. If Alucard had been an ordinary noble they might have been, but a progenitor changed the shape of it. Alexios was in Nightingale because of his connections to Vlad's counts, and Victor's influence was already moving those counts in a direction where they might support him without being ordered to. Two progenitors, and another country in the same world as Nightingale, struck him as interesting. Competition was how a world kept from going stagnant, and Vlad had stagnated because nothing had been allowed to compete with him. Jeanne and Anna, as he read them, wanted Alucard's blood and were not looking for a war with Vlad. Alucard himself he read as a family man, a herbivorous dragon that turned chaotic the moment something provoked him. Ophis was the proof. Harm the girls and the carnage landed on the yōkai who had done it. Alexios thought that if those treasures were threatened, the man would attack a realm of gods, or Nightingale, and that the girls had volunteered. Nobody had forced them. He suspected Scathach had left her home for the same connection, and that Natashia would come quickly if she heard. The danger was not only a progenitor's growing strength, or a king that the blood had already decided on. It was the allies who moved because they wanted to. He thought Vlad had made the wrong choice in antagonizing him, and had missed an ally, and he set that next to the business of protecting children.[356]
His attention found Victor holding a nine-tailed fox. He had missed her earlier, because Scathach's aura had taken the eye. Haruna had long black hair, nine black tails, and a modern short yukata that did not fully hide a voluptuous body. The face sent him back to [[Otsuki Hana]], Ophis's mother. Few words, a neutral expression, charismatic, strong, nine tails dancing when she walked. In that memory Hana thanked him, and he said it was his pleasure to serve. Another memory, rain in Japan, Vlad grim after Hana's death because the death had been his mistake, swearing revenge. The blood of the Elder Gods would paint that planet crimson red. The goal was no longer conquest. It was destruction. He asked if Alexios was with him, old friend. Alexios said always. Standing in front of the living woman, he understood she was not Hana. She was of Hana's clan.[356]
Victor asked if she intended to go now. She nodded, got out of his arms, and stood in the air. Her subordinates, Genji, rearrange. He touched his chin, said he saw, and handed her a phone that could reach him wherever he was, even in another world. She asked why. He said he wanted to become close to her, and that maybe they could fight each other in the future, and he smiled. She smiled the same way and put the phone away. Ophis called her mother and asked, stuttering, if she would go. Haruna looked at her with black eyes and said yes, but she would come back later. Ophis said she would wait. Victor touched Haruna's head, stroked the ears and the silky hair, and told her not to think too much, that Ophis was still a child. He stopped, backed off, and apologized. She said fine, low. He went back to the hair. The nine tails were swaying, and he decided not to touch them. He told her to put her own affairs first. Ophis would love the visit. Haruna agreed. Ophis pouted that she was not a child. He laughed and called her his little princess, and she smiled and did not argue. He added Nero to it and said she was more of a tomboy. Nero told him to shut up and hid her face behind his back. He told Haruna to call if something happened, even though he knew she would not. She asked how he could say that. He said they were alike. He preferred to solve everything himself, and if not for the attitude of his wives he would have come to that place alone. She repeated the word wives, and she looked at Scathach coming toward them. He said in the future, smiling, eyes dark. She looked into them, smiled so slightly it almost was not there, and repeated future while she looked at Ophis and at him. Black energy covered her. She said she would see him in the future, Alucard, and she was gone. What she took with her was the family's records. Someone had been hiding things, and those people were going to be removed, and the eyes that thought it were cruel. He laughed that she could talk when she wanted to. The cruelty was a commander's, the sort of woman who only spoke like a normal person inside a fight, and the power sitting on her was akin to Ophis and to Hana.[356]
Alexios's thought, watching Jeanne and Anna silent and the two oni shocked that she had left, was that it was always the women. He remembered Natalia's mother. Alucard was going to fight Ibaraki. The air around Victor was refreshing next to Vlad's, and Alexios decided it was safe enough for Natalia, and that he was done. He told them to let everyone know he was heading back to Nightingale. Maria answered, disinterested, that it was okay. He opened a portal and left. She let go of the ghouls and ran toward Ruby and Sasha.[356]
Alexios returned to Vlad without Ophis. His explanation forced Vlad to accept that his daughter was safe but had actively chosen to remain beside Victor.[357] The King also learned something else disturbing about Alucard: Maria, once an unstable Ghoul, was now a living Noble Vampire after Victor reconstructed her existence through his Blood. Even Vlad considered reversing such a defective transformation something that should not ordinarily have been possible.[357] Victor was therefore becoming dangerous to Vlad not merely because of combat strength. The Second Progenitor was beginning to demonstrate authorities over vampiric existence that even the First Progenitor did not fully expect him to possess so early.[357]
Back in the castle he said it outright. Alexios was back, and Ophis was not with him. Alexios said she was safe. Her own teleportation had drawn her to Japan. Vlad listened, and when the report reached a nine-tailed fox with long black hair he understood what the power had been reaching for. Clan Otsuki depended on each other to an extreme. They sought each other without meaning to, and their real power showed when they were together. He set them next to werewolves in the need for a community, except there was no alpha. Together they became stronger, the unique powers opened to a wider range, and it was as if all the foxes became one being. The variant was rare enough to count on two hands. Black fur meant death and darkness, the negative elements, and the fairy tale called that fur a bad omen. He had known Haruna when she was a small fox with one tail. She was Hana's younger sister. Hana, his wife, had spoken of her with a small smile, and the smile had been love.[357]
The rest of the report was the count. Alucard had eliminated more than half of all the supernaturals in Japan and punished everyone responsible, however minor, by turning them into freaks. Vlad asked what kind. Ghouls. His face twitched. A ghoul infection was hard to hold. Uncontained, it became a plague that grew until it could swallow a planet, and it needed a ghoul king to keep it from doing that. He remembered a blond maid from a report and asked if Maria, the former hunter, had fully evolved into a ghoul king. Alexios corrected him. She was a noble vampire now. Vlad gaped at the stupidity of the sentence. A ghoul was dead. Dead did not come back. Not even a sire's power brought someone back from the dead, and this man had turned a dead creature into a noble vampire. He told Alexios to continue. After the battle of the two, a goddess had descended, and Scathach had fought her directly. That did not surprise him. The last meeting had already told him Scathach would be Alucard's ally, and a woman who had threatened the vampire king would threaten gods. Alexios finished on the three moves of creation. Vlad asked, calm, whether Japan had ceased to exist. Alexios was confused. Japan still existed. The whole fight had been in an alternate dimension the yōkai made when they fought. Vlad knew that technique from having seen it. It should have been stronger now, not weaker. He asked what she had looked like when she transformed, and the answer settled it. She had held back. Pushed, the technique could turn a continent into pure ice, or half a planet, and it could bring an ice age back. It was her main power as a countess, the runes, and the monstrous energy of her third vampire count form, the true appearance of the vampire she had been. He thought Alucard was lucky. Few disciples ever made Scathach put that power on display in order to teach, and calling him a disciple had stopped being the right word.[357]
Turning a hybrid into a noble vampire he understood, because he had done it with Anna. Bringing a dead ghoul back he did not. Maria had been a ghoul king and she had still been a walking corpse. He doubted the world tree. The tree he knew was an immature baby and needed thousands of years. For the first time he doubted himself. Could he do that too, or was it particular to a man who had become a progenitor by a road that was not his? He landed on the difference. Victor was not the same kind of being. He had been human, golden blood, RH null, a soul born human with a human core. The human trait that mattered was potential and adaptability. In an ordinary human the seed was small. In a progenitor like Adam it was a great tree. An ordinary human turned noble vampire had let that seed germinate on progenitor blood and had absorbed it without losing himself the way a slave vampire did. That was why he had not died when he took the power of three heiresses. He had Adam's potential, the potential of three count houses, and his own progenitor potential in the same body. A freak. Vlad's face darkened. The dragon was more dangerous than he had thought. He wished, uselessly, that the man had been born a werewolf, so the news could have gone to the werewolf king instead.[357]
He also knew he could not stop the evolution by charm. Ophis, two daughters, the ex-wives, four countesses and the subordinates would turn on him if he moved, and the society he ruled was one where women held the political weight. The countesses were crazy, strong, dominant and selective, and few people wanted women like that. Acting against Victor would turn the kingdom against its king. He chose not to provoke, out of the consequences, and he did not confuse that patience with the idea of defeat. Patience had a limit. He regretted making the man a count, and he regretted the year and six months of locking him on Earth, which had set the relationship at neutral and hostile at the same time. If Victor hated him, Ophis would not have been saved. What Vlad did not understand was that the saving had started because a girl called him father, and that the people who had touched her had already been written into a book of death. Alexios watched the silence and was surprised by it. Vlad was a man who usually had the answer already. This time he did not, and Alexios wanted to know which sentence had taken it.[357]

##### Sasha, Persephone and Scathach's Feelings
Chapters 366–380
The aftermath of Japan allowed Victor to temporarily return his attention toward his wives and family. Mizuki continued developing independently after abandoning the Inquisition, while Eleonor and the people around [[WarFall]] prepared for the increasingly large supernatural conflicts approaching [[Nightingale]].[358]
Four days later Mizuki was in Eleonor's territory, sitting in the old way and maintaining her long odachi. She was twenty-one, long black hair, and the bloodlust still showed when her eyes went red. [[Abe-no-Seimei]] was with her as a spirit, an old man past five hundred, bald in life, the white hair restored now that he was dead. He said the Mizuki of before would have lost her mind at the news that Alucard had gone to Japan, and that she was punishing herself too hard. He was the one who had told her to join the Inquisition after the ten noble vampire families of Japan were gone, because they had claimed they protected humans, and the guilt of that advice was still his. She had changed her mind in the white rooms. The doubts had started during Victor's fight with Bruno. She had found a laboratory run by General James, one of the first places she burned, and the children in it had been broken into puppets. Victor had told her to take them to his orphanage. They had burned more of those places together. She had suspected him at first, because he arrived too conveniently, and later she understood he was disgusted and that he wanted James disrupted. Abe-no-Seimei called the man at the top of that faith not the pope, only a man distorted by his ideals. Mizuki called the goal of killing every supernatural being the sentence of a tyrannical supremacist. [[Ghosts]] came out of human emotion. Vampires and werewolves had worlds of their own. It could not be done. She also knew that a human guest of Alucard and Eleonor was still an enemy to some of the people watching her.[358]
He asked whether meeting that man had been a blessing or a curse. She said both, and she went back to the blade. The first time she had met Alucard he had been an out-of-control vampire in a Snow count form, and he had given her trouble. The next time she had already lost an arm to [[Scathach Elderblood Scarlett|Scathach Scarlett]]. Fate had dragged the relationship to something neutral, and she was confident he punished only the people who were actually guilty in Japan. The news in front of them was that more than half of Japan's supernatural beings were dead, and that Inari had not escaped. Mizuki's talisman, the blessing of that goddess, was down to a small golden energy that was almost gone. Abe-no-Seimei said it would be thousands of years before Inari woke. Mizuki still asked the goddess for a blessing of prosperity and for luck the next day. He told her to stop leaning on gods. They were tools. He wanted her on the enhancement techniques of Ashiya Dōman, onmyou treated as a tool with no moral of its own. She said that was a return to being a teenager, and that it would take too long. He called her immature. Twenty-one was still immature. She called him a bald old man past five hundred. Then he plucked a hair and put fire on it, and the hair refused to burn the way hair burned. Drinking Alucard's blood had put her body at a peak. The cells had stopped aging for the present, the vitality was back, the scars were gone, and the mirror showed no new shape, only a woman who felt stronger. He called the blood a fountain of youth and doubted anyone else would be handed it, because the source was a progenitor. She agreed to the training so she would stop feeling weak next to him. He said the magic was violent and that she would need opponents, and that immortal creatures were already coming into the territory. He intended to be stricter. He took the whole mess as a blessing wearing the face of a curse.[358]
Violet's possessiveness remained extreme despite her increasing maturity. Hearing conversations involving other women around Victor still provoked instinctive jealousy even when she rationally understood that the family's structure had already expanded far beyond what she originally imagined.[359]
In the Snow office Violet sat in a luxurious chair with the paper piled around her, long white hair, blood-red eyes, and the look of a woman running a business she hated. Through the wall Yuki and the maids were watching a Nightingale movie, The Vampire and his mortal servant, the first vampire production that had not used stuntmen, and they were tearing the protagonist apart for being dense, cringing, and for an attitude Yuki heard as "I know everything, kneel before me, mortal." Violet broke a pen, screamed, and sent the papers up. She had not seen Victor in days. Her father's death sat lighter now that she had his memories, and the thirst for her husband's blood and for his body had not gotten lighter with it. Hilda, older than [[Scathach]] and older than the calendar the humans kept for Jesus, told her to rest. Violet put her head on the desk, called it torture, then stood and hit the table. She called Natalia. A portal opened. The piles were assigned in one breath. Economy and money. Connections. Back wages. Lesser clans. A stack with black markings, vampires with tastes she would not keep on her land, pedophiles, and Hilda could burn them and send them to Hell. She also pointed at a retirement plan and told Hilda to find a vampire mate who was not her husband. She wanted that woman off him. Then she told Natalia to put her literally in front of Victor, and she jumped.[359]
He was in the private room kept for him and his wives, out of the clothes, about to wash, and about to hunt. The nine-tailed fox's place was empty. The fox had hidden after Inari slept, and there was another fox still to find. Gintoki had already ended a yōkai clan by accident: Scathach's ice spike had killed [[Gyuki]]. Victor was also refusing sleep, because sleep was where [[Persephone]] waited. The portal opened and Violet came through it like a white rocket, hit his stomach, and he caught her. She sniffed him and said she had missed him. He was glad and worried in the same voice. She had thought about his decision on her father's soul. She still did not like that he had made it alone, and she would take that soul with him ten thousand times before she gave it to someone else. She asked him, when they were alone, to change his eyes from violet to blood red. He did. The second thing she asked for was sex. He took her to the bed, and they stayed in that room through the night. The hunt was still there when it was over.[359]
The fox who had spread Ophis's face was not dead. [[Kurama]] sat in a cave a witch had built, hidden unless he allowed it to be found, long red tails moving, a fox's grin on him, eyes red for a moment when the [[Semiconductor Devices|memory bit]]. He called what Alucard had done a calamity rather than a war. His own story started at seven, when [[Oda Nobunaga]] asked a child if he wanted to change the world. Kurama had used lies through a bloodbath that unified Japan, then betrayed Oda at Honnō-ji with [[Akechi Mitsuhide]] and [[Toyotomi Hideyoshi]] and forced the seppuku. He had then accused Hideyoshi of treason and started the next war. He treated war as a divine punishment and he ate it. Conflict and bloodshed were how he evolved. The pact with Inari had been the chain that kept him in Japan, and he had regretted it the moment foreigners arrived who were not part of the old board. Vampires. The Kuroyami, who worked in darkness and killed for a living. He had answered the new age by spreading the rumors and the pictures of the vampire king's daughter, a little girl whose father was an ancient monster, and he had wanted vampires and the supernaturals of Japan to bleed each other. What arrived was a young count Vlad himself had recognized as an irregularity. The massacre was one-sided. Half of the supernaturals in Japan were gone, a sea of blood in a day, Gyuki lost, the oni who chased humans lost with him, and Inari in what he understood as an eternal coma dealt by the Crimson Nightmare. The coma revoked the pact. He turned into a white bird, the transformation foxes used when they wanted to be something else and to hide their yōki, and he sent a scroll about the nine-tailed woman who was harboring the vampires Alucard was hunting. He called it a thanks and a distraction. Then something in the cave made him shiver, and the bird left.[360]
Victor devoted more uninterrupted time to Sasha. The relationship between the two had remained physically incomplete much longer than Victor's relationships with Violet and Ruby despite Sasha being one of the three original wives.[361] The delay had not reflected a lack of affection. Sasha's early grief over Julia, her complicated parents and her generally less assertive personality had simply caused their relationship to develop differently.[361]
The scroll arrived in the middle of a room that was already too full. Victor was on a couch in a black yukata with simple red details, black hair grown out and messy, the beauty of it stupid enough to be called divine. Violet sat beside him with a hand on her belly, content, the thirst from Japan satisfied for the present, and with the old thought still in her that she would keep him in a luxurious basement if the work ever allowed it. Ruby sat on his lap, possessive, and glared at Violet, who ignored her. Ophis made unhappy noises at Ruby. [[Nero]] tried to calm her by touching only her clothes, never the skin, because of the curse. Sasha's eyes were on Ruby, gleaming, obsessive. Scathach sat cross-legged on another couch, amused and annoyed and hiding both. Roberta, Bruna, Eve, Roxanne, Maria and Kaguya were in the room with them. The open yukata and the chest under it were enough of a problem that Kaguya had to shake herself back to the work. Roberta smiled at that and started a plan. Maria understood it. Eve did not. The other Eve did.[361]
Kaguya said the scroll had appeared hours ago at a base where Roxanne and Bruna were still hitting suspects from the Ophis incident. Roxanne, a dryad, long red hair, sharp teeth, added that they had charmed a human who admitted he had been handed information on Ophis so he could profit from it, and that he had given up because the competitors were thicker than he was. Quitting was why he was alive. Victor put a hand on Sasha's head. The bond settled her, and it also pushed her further into the lesson her mother had taught and that she had started to take seriously. Love was a war. You attacked, and attacked, and attacked, until you won. Peace was never an option. If you were in her mother's position you walked in baby steps until the goal was in reach. She decided to be the one who moved. He was already planning a date in Kyoto. Waiting had made her more beautiful, and he could feel her coming up toward the place where he and Violet already stood.[361]
Bruna and Roxanne confirmed the scroll. Alexios had gone back to Nightingale and would talk to the king. Scathach said a leak was inevitable and that the point was to control what leaked, and she was amused at how far Adonis's experience had already moved Victor. Ruby spoke with contempt about witches who profited off the incident. He told her later. Scathach said Vlad would get the small things and not the vital ones, which was one reason Alexios had been left where he could see them. Maria reported the ghouls inactive and ready. Victor suggested taking a morgue so the corpses would not have to be hunted one by one. Scathach agreed there was stock in that. Sasha said one morgue could feed a great many ghouls and that the problem was moving them. Violet said they were not going to wear Natalia out, and that the answer was a base. Ruby named his castle at the North Pole, ideal and a problem, because the cold and the distance would punish everyone who was not him. Eve said Natalia could make a rune gate the way Alexios did, a door in the human world that threw the cargo to the Pole by itself. Ruby wanted that door in the United States, where his parents and his people already were. Violet decided it. Sasha asked whether Natalia could do it. Violet said she could be pushed. Kaguya pulled them back to the scroll. Victor said he would call Shinji and Gintoki, give them what they wanted, and keep them. Scathach laughed because she had understood him. Kaguya bowed, put Roberta on the assistance, noticed that Roberta was too pleased about it, and decided to watch her.[361]
Victor and Sasha finally spent several private days together in Japan, culminating in the consummation of their marriage.[362][363][364][365] For Sasha, the development represented more than physical intimacy. She had spent much of her life controlled by parents, Clan expectations and the instability created by her lightning. Victor's acceptance of her possessiveness, emotional extremes and vulnerabilities had given her a relationship in which she no longer believed she needed to hide parts of herself to remain loved.[363][364] The connection also strengthened the Blood bond already existing between Victor and the Fulger heiress.[365]
Victor's sleep continued pulling him into Persephone's domain through Adonis' curse. Their repeated conversations gradually became less openly hostile without becoming friendly. Victor observed changes in Persephone's behavior and increasingly treated their meetings as a source of information rather than merely an unavoidable punishment inherited from Adonis.[366][367] Scathach's own feelings meanwhile became impossible to dismiss. She had spent increasingly long periods watching Victor devote himself to Violet, Sasha, Ruby and other women while pretending that the jealousy she felt was merely maternal irritation.[368] Eventually Scathach admitted, at least to herself, that she wanted Victor. Worse for someone as possessive as Scathach, a portion of her wanted Victor only for herself.[368] Victor understood enough of what was happening to recognize the danger. Rather than retreat, he continued teasing, approaching and emotionally provoking the strongest female Vampire in existence.[369] He was knowingly playing with fire.[369]

##### Dracul and Alucard, Nero's Place in the Family
Chapters 381–395
Victor crossed back into Japan on golden lightning, in an elegant black yukata, with Ophis in a black gothic dress and gloves on his shoulder and [[Nero]] in jeans, athletic shoes and a black shirt. Both girls were sick from the jump. Nero told him to warn her the next time he did it, and when he teased her about calling him dad she said she was trying, and that all of it was new. Eve, long black hair, and Kaguya in the maid uniform were with them. He told Nero and Eve they were irreplaceable, and when Ophis pouted and asked what she was, he called her his dear daughter and picked her up. They left a balcony on a shelf of ice. Nero's landing broke a crater into the ground, and she asked whether she had gotten heavier.[370]
Vlad had Alexios open a portal a hundred metres from his daughter and stepped through after changing his own appearance, black hair and eyes becoming blonde and green, a white suit on him. He asked the hostile looks on the street whether they had the balls, and then he found the other progenitor. Victor's violet eyes and the air around him were no longer a Count whose seat had been given from the throne. The Blood had become the existence Limbo had classified as the Second Progenitor, and the abilities that came with that were awake far earlier than Vlad considered normal. Vlad read Adonis's cunning in the man in front of him, and [[Scathach]]'s attitude, and a control of souls that should not have belonged to someone that young.[370][371] Ophis looked at the white suit and called him evil father. She was still calling Victor father, and Victor did not correct her. He told Vlad he had arrived at a good time, that a boy had just been chased off for approaching his daughter, and that another father's support would be welcome. Vlad's eyes went blood red at the idea of someone hitting on Ophis, and he agreed to walk.[370]
The walk became Akihabara at night. A high-school football captain named Hakuma Noku tried the usual line on the little girl in the gothic dress and on the white-haired girl beside her, and Nero told him to fuck off. Victor, wearing a blond, blue-eyed face that looked like a man out of a medieval painting, put a hand on the boy's shoulder and asked what he thought he was doing with his daughter. Vlad, still in the white suit, said he wanted to know the same thing. The two of them looked at Noku the way something looks at prey. Eve and Kaguya watched from far enough back to talk. Kaguya counted. Fifteen boys before this one, sixteen with him. Eve asked whether the man in the white suit was really the king of all vampires and therefore equal to her master, and Kaguya said yes. They sat on a bench after Victor's charm had emptied the square of everyone who was not theirs. Ophis and Nero played. Vlad asked why Victor had gone out of his way for Ophis. A father does not need reasons to protect his children. From the moment she called him dad, he had been ready to burn the world for her. Vlad heard the difference between that and his own mixture of conquest and possession, and he understood that as long as Ophis existed Victor would never be a complete enemy. He asked how it felt to wear the beauty of a man the gods themselves had called the most handsome in the world. Victor said not much had changed, and then that it was quite a gift. Vlad wanted to know why he did not wear a mask. Beauty made people pick fights, and gods were the idiots who did it. Women would try to take him whether he agreed or not, and the list Vlad offered was [[Aphrodite]], [[Freyja|Freya]], [[Persephone]], Frigga, [[Hera]], Sif, and a few hundred thousand more he did not have the day to name. Most of them were Norse or Greek because those pantheons were, in Vlad's word, the most degenerate. Hera and Frigga were not chained by the marriage they represented. Divinity was a dogma, not a lock. Victor said he did not care about the Greek gods. Vlad heard Adonis in the grudge, and Victor added a maid who wanted [[Athena]]'s head and [[Poseidon]]'s on a stake, and that he would grant it. When the war came, Vlad was to call him. The god of war was not the one Victor had to prepare for. It was the god of war who had to prepare for him. Vlad's own trouble in that pantheon was [[Eros]], Aphrodite's son by [[Ares]], and he did not think Aphrodite would sit still if one of her children died, titan or not. Victor's disgust at her was already in the blood. The body knew it could be made to submit, and it rejected her for that. Vlad paid the protection of Ophis with one hint. The key to Aphrodite was her soul, and the titan part of her was not a title. She had been born from the severed sack of Uranus. Victor took the hint faster than Vlad liked, lightning and Adonis both working in the head. He would not apologize for the grandchildren. Vlad would not apologize for the years on Earth. They called it even. Then Victor asked whether Vlad thought he would rule forever, and he said his interest in being king was the same as his interest in Aphrodite. Zero. No king rules forever.[371]
Nero's place in that household changed in the same days. Victor told her to regard him as a father, not only as the powerful man whose daughter she had once protected. She had not been raised by him, the time they had was still short, and he did not care about the technicality. She had risked her life for Ophis, she had no stable home, and she was already someone he intended to protect, so she was drawn into the Alucard name and into the daughters and descendants gathering around him.[370][372] Victor also refused to protect Nero by preventing her from ever experiencing danger. He took her into environments where she could learn practical combat and forced her to begin discovering what her new existence and connection to Alucard actually allowed her to do.[372] Before sending Nero into combat, Victor made the principle explicit: She was an Alucard and his daughter.[372]
His parenting consequently resembled Scathach's teaching philosophy. Victor intended to protect his daughters, but protection meant making them capable of surviving when he was absent rather than constructing permanent helplessness around them.[372][373] Nero's abilities began evolving visibly under that pressure. Strange physical manifestations and transformations appeared as she fought, expanding what Victor understood about the girl's origin and potential.[374][375] Victor and the family also became more directly exposed to Divine beings during this period. Nero's circumstances and Victor's curiosity brought them into situations where the difference between ordinary supernatural powers and Divine authority became increasingly obvious.[376][377]
Victor continued teaching Nero, Bruna and others foundational martial principles rather than allowing supernatural strength to substitute for technique. He demonstrated how a proper strike transferred force through the entire body instead of merely moving an arm with greater muscle power.[378] The lesson reflected how completely Scathach's training philosophy had become part of Victor. He was now passing the same principles onward to the next generation rather than merely using them himself.[378] Nero gradually began understanding why people feared her father. Victor could switch from affectionate parent to overwhelming supernatural threat with almost no transition whenever someone endangered the people he considered his own.[379] His maids likewise continued developing into a genuine elite force. Kaguya remained the most experienced, but Eve, Bruna, Maria, Roberta and Roxanne were no longer passive residents of Victor's household.[380]
Victor also established information networks in Japan rather than treating the Japanese incident as a problem that ended when Ophis was rescued. Local supernatural figures were converted into intelligence assets for Clan Alucard, allowing Victor to know what happened in the region without personally remaining there.[381]

##### Aphrodite, Morgana and a Rejected Coup
Chapters 396–407
Victor's repeated encounters with [[Aphrodite]] forced him to confront one of his strongest personal dislikes: supernatural influence over desire, love and consent. Adonis' memories only intensified that reaction because Victor now possessed centuries of experiences involving Gods and people affected by Divine authority.[382][383] The situation became more complicated when Victor learned how long Aphrodite had been connected to his Human family. The Goddess had maintained a Human identity and friendship with Anna for more than a decade without Victor knowing what she truly was.[384][385] Victor reacted extremely badly to the idea that a Goddess capable of influencing attraction had been near his mother for years. Ruby forced him to evaluate the issue more carefully.[386][387]
If Victor judged every ancient being exclusively according to modern Human morality, the same standard would condemn many people he loved. [[Scathach]] had committed atrocities during thousands of years of warfare. Agnes' early relationship with Adonis had itself begun through abusive behavior. Ancient supernatural cultures had operated according to standards radically different from Victor's Human upbringing.[387] Ruby did not tell Victor that those actions were morally correct. She argued that attempting to retroactively judge immortal beings solely through modern Human social rules would accomplish nothing. Victor should decide what principles he intended to follow now instead of allowing either Human morality or supernatural tradition to dictate his identity completely.[387] Victor accepted the distinction. He was Victor before he was a "proper" Progenitor, Vampire or supernatural ruler.[387]
The Succubus accompanying Jeanne also became increasingly involved with Victor's household. Because she used the name Anna despite it not being her real Demonic name, the duplication with Victor's mother became irritating.[387] After several deliberately ridiculous suggestions, Victor gave the Succubus a new name: Morgana.[387] Morgana accepted it as a temporary name until the day she might choose to reveal her true Demonic name. She explained that the real names of high-ranking Demons were deeply connected to their existences and normally revealed only to someone trusted to an extreme degree, such as a spouse.[387] Morgana and Jeanne then approached Victor with a serious political proposal. They wanted Victor to build a faction around himself, oppose Vlad, overthrow the Vampire King and recover their children from his custody.[388] Victor found the entire proposal tedious. His first objection was not even political. Neither woman had actually asked their adult children whether they wanted to abandon Vlad and follow their mothers.[388]
Victor had no interest in starting a coup merely because two women assumed they knew what was best for children old enough to make their own decisions. He also believed that, regardless of Vlad's failures as a husband or father, the King would not deliberately harm his own children.[388] Victor likewise possessed no urgent desire to become King simply because two Progenitors existed in the same realm. If conflict with Vlad eventually became unavoidable, Victor would handle it according to circumstances at that time rather than build his entire life around preparing a throne he did not currently want.[388]
They made the offer while Violet was in his lap and his hand was in her hair. Two progenitors could not live on the same mountain, Morgana said, and one day Vlad would turn his fangs on him. The pretty version was a faction, a rescued pair of children, and a dead king. He heard a coup, a weakening, and someone else deciding where those children would live. He called the plan tedious in the situation, in the reasons, and in the grand shape of it. Had either of them asked the children whether they wanted the father or the mother. He would guarantee that Vlad would not harm his own. He did not want the throne, and the mind game of two progenitors in one realm did not work on him. What he saw in front of him was anger, hate, and a wish for a massacre dressed up as a rescue, with the children and with him as the excuse. A former saint and a former demon general had come to him tired, weak, and lifeless, and he was disappointed. He snapped his fingers. Mirrors stood up in front of them. Jeanne saw a tired woman. Morgana saw a walking corpse that was still beautiful and already empty. He said he would fix that, picked Violet up, and left. When he came back he had portaled Natalia and Luna in, thrown Jeanne and Morgana over his shoulders like sacks, and taken them through to Eleonor's territory. [[Junketsu]] shook itself off the stand and flew to his hand on the way, which was enough to make Morgana careful. Violet's guess, watching them go, was that he might throw both of them at the monsters.[388]
The encounter nevertheless brought Jeanne and Morgana deeper into Victor's circle and exposed more of their histories.[389][390][391] Morgana in particular confronted memories of her life as a young Succubus in Hell. She had survived repeated mutilation and predation by learning to hunt other Demons, consume them and continuously grow stronger until Lilith eventually recognized and named her.[390]
Long before becoming one of Vlad's women, Morgana had been a survivor and warrior known as [[Morgana Elderblood|The Reaper]].[390]
The memory she had to sit with was not the general. A low, nameless succubus walked into the gate of Lilith's castle and found a forest full of high-level demons waiting. She lost an arm and kept moving, because Hell killed anything that stopped. She hunted the injured, and she bathed in a red river that grew the limbs back, failure after failure, pain that did not end the attempt. On the hundred and first try she used dream magic on a high-level imp while it slept, killed it, and ate it. Strength, speed, and endurance came out of the meal, and the illusions started to stick. She did that thousands of times, until the body was larger, crueller, and harder to call a minor succubus. The tiny wings and the cave she had hidden in were gone. Lilith came to her like a fallen angel, smiled, and gave her a true name. The name paralyzed her and rewrote her. Horns, wings, and a thinner tail stayed. The rest of her became closer to a human shape, and much stronger. Lilith's praise was two words. You did well. The war against [[Diablo]]'s faction came after that, and the title she won in it was The Reaper, the one Hell was afraid of. The part of her that remembered the forest told her not to forget the order of it. Before the general, the warrior, or the mother, she was a survivor. Vlad had held that survivor captive. The man who had just called her a corpse wanted the opposite. He wanted to see what she was when she was not empty.[390]
Recovering that identity became important now that her connection to Vlad no longer controlled her life.[391][392] [[Nero]] also met members of Victor's Human family, with Anna naturally beginning to treat another of Victor's adopted children as though the girl had always belonged there.[393]

##### Anna, Victor's Parents and Breaking Vampire Common Sense
Chapters 408–415
Anna's involvement with [[Nero]] deepened rapidly. She questioned Victor about the girl's history, emotional condition and violent outbursts rather than treating Nero as merely another supernatural being brought home by her son.[394] For Nero, the casual maternal affection was unfamiliar. For Anna, she was simply another child connected to Victor who clearly needed family.[394][395] Victor continued watching the growth of the people around him while confronting his own biological bottleneck. The Scarlett sisters demonstrated improvements of their own, reinforcing that Victor was not the only person becoming dramatically stronger simply because the narrative centered upon him.[396] At the same time, Victor's existence increasingly violated what supernatural society considered common sense. He had reconstructed Maria from an unstable Ghoul, created unusual hybrids through Blood, awakened Progenitor abilities far earlier than expected and passed hereditary powers to new Alucards despite barely understanding the full limits of his lineage.[396]
[[Aphrodite]]'s Human identity also created a practical problem. Anna genuinely valued her friendship with the woman she knew, meaning Victor could not simply order the Goddess to disappear from his mother's life without hurting Anna as well.[397][398] Victor considered two possible solutions. Aphrodite could abandon her existing Human identity and create another, removing the risk surrounding Anna at the cost of erasing the Human life she had built.[399] Or Leon and Anna could stop being vulnerable Humans. Victor proposed transforming his parents into Noble Vampires and bringing them directly into Clan Alucard.[399] From Victor's perspective, the offer solved multiple problems simultaneously: his parents would gain immortality, supernatural durability and direct protection through his Bloodline.[400] From the perspective of traditional vampire society, hesitating over such an offer was almost incomprehensible.
Becoming a Noble Vampire directly under a Progenitor and Vampire Count would be considered an extraordinary privilege by most supernatural beings.[400]
He asked them straight. Are you sure you don't want to be vampires. Leon and Anna looked at each other and refused in the same breath. The privilege of a Noble Vampire made from a Progenitor did not change the answer. They were weighing the life they already had, not the rank [[Nightingale]] would have killed for.[400]
Leon and Anna nevertheless evaluated the choice according to their own lives rather than according to vampire status. The conversation demonstrated again why Victor could not simply treat his parents like ordinary subordinates. They were among the few people whose choices Victor needed to respect even when every possessive instinct in him wanted to guarantee their safety personally.[400][401]

##### Demonic Omens, Pepper and Natashia
Chapters 416–427
The "strange occurrences" did not start as a war briefing. Victor was on a balcony with [[Aphrodite]], poking her about [[Freyja|Freya]]. He wanted the difference between two goddesses of love and which of them was stronger. Aphrodite sat there and claimed the advantage of a Titan and a second-generation goddess, then admitted the problem. Her major divinities were sexuality, love and beauty. She had minor divinities tied to war that did not compare with [[Ares]], and lesser ones of the perpetuation of life, pleasure and joy, none of them built for a battlefield. Freya's major divinities were love, lust, war and magic, with lesser ties to beauty, pleasure and a rumored hand in death, because Freya was said to see and touch souls. She was also a rune master whose knowledge sat under [[Odin]] and almost nobody else. Aphrodite's answer to "who is stronger" was her charm, the kind that could take hold of gods, and she patted her chest to make the point. The dress moved. Victor's estimate, stated as a fact in his own head, was a J-cup, larger than Roberta's I-cups, and he treated them as weapons. He also told her she was pretty when she was not being a bossy bitch. She jumped on him and said they should fuck. He told the goddess of perversion to fuck off.[402]
Screaming from an alley cut that off. A red portal opened and deformed devils came out. They were not killing the people they grabbed. They were throwing them into the portal. Victor's eyes shifted and the city became wires, thousands of them, all running to that mouth. One wire ended at a building still under construction, with no portal yet, only a thread in the air. Priests arrived, killed the lesser devils with faith, watched the portal close by itself, left something on the wall, and walked away. Aphrodite connected it to the murder reports, the madness, and the rise in demon work that hunters and the Inquisition were supposed to be burying so humans would not see it. A portal to Hell sitting in a city street was not that routine. Victor had her hold him. Lightning took his eyes for a moment, a bolt hit them, and they were on the unfinished building. He asked if she saw a portal or any evil in the empty air he was pointing at. Her eyes went bright pink. What she touched was not demonic. It was negative energy, denser and cleaner than youki, built out of despair from humans, vampires, werewolves, witches and small gods, and the emotions in it were of people forced to kill their own familiars and eat flesh. He covered her mouth and pulled her back because the thread was thickening. Four more deformed demons stepped out, laughing that Team 45 had been killed by hunters and that they still had a quota. He was already in black armor behind them, smiling, red eyes up, and he called them worms and asked them to invite him on the night walk.[402]
They knew the biography Hell had circulated. Do not fight Alucard. Run, and report where he is. The list included Inquisition bases destroyed, a city in Hell under one of the seventy-two pillars blown apart, and more than half the supernatural population of Japan dead. They were low-class devils on kidnap duty and they said so the moment he asked, then swore they did not know why the humans were wanted. Aphrodite's head came out from behind his body. One of them asked why she was with him. She said because he was her husband. He hit her on the head and told her to stop. The portal, they said, did not open on Hell. Hell cost too much power. It opened somewhere in the human world they could not name. Humans who stepped through without a mark were turned to paste, so the devils branded them with a bondage seal. Victor told them they could go, tossed a small golden ball through as a "treasure" he had nowhere to put, and smiled like a child after the portal shut. He had not let them go. Lightning took him and Aphrodite above the clouds, then down over the Canadian border, where his eyes found a cavern her divine sense could not see until he told her to look further down. Whatever was hiding that hole could fool a Titan. Inside it, humans were writhing into grotesque shapes.[403]
The other side of that hole noticed. In a medieval office a subordinate reported a factory destroyed, one shielded by magic that could deceive divine senses and resist witches below the queen's level. The recording showed ice appearing as a thin sheet on the cave wall and then covering the entire factory in seconds. The man watching said it was not magic and not a divine authority. It was the ice of one clan. A demon team had already seen Count Alucard in [[New York]], and the dead factory was the one on the Canada–United States border. He moved Alucard to the top of the danger list and pulled the hunt out of New York. The call he placed was answered with "Master, we have a problem."[404]
Victor left Aphrodite with his parents and went downstairs. [[Nero]] was on the couch in front of a zombie series. Her eyes jumped when she saw him and she stayed where she was and said "You're back, Father," because she would not lunge. He told her to stop holding it in, ruffled her hair, and said she was his daughter whether she wanted the word girl or not. Kaguya came out of his shadow. In the lab Ruby was in a white coat, hair in a ponytail, over two hunter bodies he had given her. She was the shortest of his wives, 175 cm. She smelled Aphrodite on him, believed him when he said nothing had happened, and filed away that she had seen a little interest in Eleonor and none in the goddess. He carried her to the couch and told the maids what he had seen. Eve's objection was practical.
