Demons were taking people in daylight, and if they stopped caring whether humans noticed, the cover every old supernatural faction maintained would not hold. Maria said even her old organization had wanted demons and vampires kept off the human record. Roxanne asked what happened if the demons simply did not care. Victor smiled like he had smelled blood and said the timing was too neat, sitting just before the gathering of supernatural beings. Ruby put Kaguya, Eve, Maria and Roberta in two groups over the block, told them nobody close to Victor went out alone, and set Roxanne as the house's protector because she could call her guardian and liked the human world too much to go back to [[Nightingale]]. The card Ruby handed Kaguya was Frost Bank, Victor's, which he had let her manage because he barely spent it.[404]
The same days looked different in Snow territory. Violet had been sitting in the clan leader's chair doing the work Agnes had left, paperwork, human-world contacts, orders, and nightly fire practice with her husband that had actually moved her control. The fights she wanted were with Hilda, Agnes's oldest maid, because Hilda's fire was precise. When Agnes finally came back it was not a quiet return. A fire tornado hit the courtyard and she stepped out of it with her white hair down instead of tied, a cropped outfit that left her stomach bare, a six-pack, black leggings and boots, arms folded under her chest, and the [[Blade of Fafnir]] planted beside her like a cane. The sword was red, western, scaled from the king of the fire dragons. She told Violet the clan had not fallen apart, stroked her cheek, and asked why her daughter would not call her mommy. Violet slapped the hand away. Agnes's estimate of the training was a hundred times her old peak, and she credited the sword. Hilda said that was the danger. [[Fafnir]]'s mind was still in the blade, and the power could become a need. Agnes let her golden eyes go reptilian, then black, and asked what Violet would do if something offered her the strength to kill the being who had killed her darling. Violet said she would kill the thing and take the power. Agnes agreed, said [[Persephone]] mattered more than a dragon's temptation, and walked off claiming she was better than she had ever been. Oda told Hilda to stay away from Violet if anything happened to that husband, and vanished. Hilda said the fruit of madness had not fallen far from the tree.[405]
In Adrasteia land the same news reached a different table. Eleonor, Mizuki, Morgana, Jeanne and Nero were with Victor when he laid out the kidnapping mills. Morgana described demons the way she knew Lilith and [[Diablo]], as people who preferred blackmail and curses to a clean fight. Jeanne said they were coming through gates in their real bodies. Mizuki floated the idea that Lilith and Diablo might actually be working together, because ending humanity and ending angels pointed the same direction. Morgana rejected it on Lilith's pride. Victor did not. He also asked Eleonor about the hammers she had been rebuilding with monster material. Her estimate of one of them as a wide blast was somewhere between ten and fifty kilometres, and he told her to respect the limit. He had already given Siena, Lacus and Pepper an anti-material rifle. When Eleonor finally asked about the child on him, he said Nero was his daughter, and both she and Mizuki looked like their heads hurt.[405]
He repeated it to their faces. Nero said hello in a flat voice that Eleonor called lifeless. Victor introduced Eleonor as the countess of the territory, earth, and the owner of a mare he was still trying to steal. Eleonor told him to leave Chloe alone. He said no. Mizuki and Eleonor wanted to know how a trip to Mizuki's country had ended with a daughter. He told the Ophis story properly. Jeanne thought about her own son. Morgana was annoyed to be treated as the indecent one after she had kept his business private. Victor's view of witches came out in the same breath. They had called, demanded payment, and been hung up on. He left with Nero, told them to keep their eyes on demons, and found Pepper under a tree looking lost. He sat down, put Nero on his lap, and introduced them to each other. Pepper's first question was since when he had a daughter he had not bothered to tell her about.[406]
She stayed under that tree and, once Nero was asleep on his chest, put her head on his shoulder. What came out of her was not a training complaint. She had never been away from [[Scathach]] this long because her mother was the only safe place she had. The memory under that was a red-haired child in the ruins of her clan, calling for parents who had told her to hide, with hunters in the fire and bodies thrown at her. Scathach had arrived late, frozen the ground, and asked how worms had entered Nightingale on Alexios's watch. Pepper's clan had once raised tidal waves that broke countries. The survivors lived in Scathach's territory, and one of them had become Ruby's father. Pepper called herself a former heir of a dead clan. She did not know if the bottleneck was the hunters or the loneliness. Victor took the glove off and said he knew the wall, because he was standing in front of the same kind of limit. One answer was his blood, and he treated that as the dangerous shortcut. The other was control. He put a ball of water on a fingertip, spun it until the pressure was stupid, and shot it through the clouds. He told her water under that kind of pressure cuts diamond, and that her power could just as easily pull the liquid out of a body or stop a breath. Scathach had never given the sisters the whole art. Pepper had been given strength, Siena power, Lacus speed, Ruby defense, in the hope they would teach each other until control appeared. They had specialized instead and learned to fight as a team, which won fights and capped them. He started Pepper on Lacus's footwork, breathing and a small impulse in the foot, and showed it by vanishing and returning in the same spot. She accused him of cheating with lightning. He said Lacus was that fast and had been slowing herself down whenever her sisters were beside her.[407][408]
While he was doing that, Sasha, Natashia and Victoria were in an office with rags on the floor, looking at a bold plan and at a letter from the king. Fulger, Snow and Scarlett were being called to a meeting as bodyguards, which Victoria thought was the wrong shape for an escort. Natashia decided to ask Scathach in person. Sasha asked if she was actually going to see Victor. The hunger showed in Natashia's eyes and her breathing, and she left Victoria in charge because a countess who looked weak would be challenged. She covered herself in lightning, aimed first at Eleonor's land, corrected toward Scathach, and said business first.[408]
She did not get a conversation. The moment she told Scathach she was going to her darling, the spear came for her head. Luna looked up through the new hole in the ceiling at two countesses, one making ice and the other running. What they had actually agreed, before the spear, was that the king was taking his three strongest countesses to the gathering and leaving Alexios on Nightingale, because [[Clan Alioth]] was the first vampire family in that realm and the one that held space and time. Natashia dodged on lightning she could finally use without cooking herself, broke a storm of ice thorns with two lightning daggers, and told Scathach she was his wife too, body and soul. His instinct was increasingly not to reject systems foreign to vampirism, but to understand them well enough that they could no longer control him from the outside.[471] Victor also spent more time with the [[Maid Squad]] following the constant crises and training.[472] Kaguya, Eve, Bruna, Maria, Roberta and Roxanne were no longer emotionally equivalent to ordinary servants. Victor loved them.[472] He did not necessarily define every relationship romantically at that moment, but he openly acknowledged that losing one of his maids would hurt as the loss of family rather than the loss of an employee.[472] The maids themselves were increasingly unable to maintain conventional emotional distance from their master.[473]
Kaguya's attachment had been developing since the earliest days after Victor's transformation, while Eve and Bruna had effectively rebuilt their identities around the person who rescued and transformed them. Maria's existence had been reconstructed by Victor's Blood, Roberta had become dependent upon the freedom and boundaries Victor provided, and Roxanne's connection to Victor was fundamentally tied to her evolution as a World Tree.[473]
Clan Alucard consequently functioned less like a traditional Noble household and more like a family whose formal titles increasingly failed to describe the actual emotional relationships inside it.[473]

##### Leona's Forbidden Love
Chapter 493
Victor finally confronted another relationship he had left unresolved since his Human life: Leona Lykos.[474] Leona had known Victor when both were sickly Human teenagers. Her albinism and abnormally delayed Werewolf awakening had made her physically weak in ways that resembled Victor's lifelong illness, creating an immediate understanding between the two that neither shared with healthy people around them.[474] Victor admitted that he had liked Leona when they were younger. Leona had felt even more strongly toward him.[474] Before Victor's transformation, several things had prevented either from seriously pursuing the relationship. Victor's illness made his future uncertain, Leona's family were secretly [[Werewolves]], Adam and Edward were protective of her, and Leona herself had hoped to awaken Victor as her Beta rather than lose him to another supernatural lineage.[474] Violet reached Victor first. Leona had been furious when she learned a vampire had transformed the boy she had once wanted to bring into her own family.[474]
Time and Victor's rapid accumulation of wives had not completely erased Leona's feelings. Victor, strengthened by Adonis' experience and no longer willing to leave important relationships permanently ambiguous, refused to give her a false answer.[474] He still liked Leona. The feelings were not yet equal to the love he possessed for his established wives, but the possibility existed.[474] Victor consequently proposed something much more patient than the way he normally handled desire. They would take baby steps. Leona would learn who Victor had become, and Victor would learn who Leona had become after awakening as an Alpha Werewolf.[474] Victor promised he would neither run away nor continue suppressing the possibility simply because Vampires and Werewolves were traditionally discouraged from forming such relationships.[474] For Leona, the conversation reopened a possibility she had refused to completely abandon since childhood.[474]
He told her not to rush. He knew how she felt. He had felt the same way since they were teenagers. The shock on her was a why she did not say. The reasons he gave were the illness, Edward and Adam, and then the transformation, and an unwritten law that vampires and wolves did not do this. The motives had moved with the years. He had also needed time to put the new life in order. She said she knew. She had always known. What she was holding in private was the weakness that had come with her albinism, the awakening that had only arrived on a full moon, and the old hope that he would have been her beta. He looked at what they were now. An alpha who still lacked experience. A count and a progenitor. Neither of them was the sick teenager who had needed protecting. Just give it time. Baby steps. Understand who I am now, and I will try to understand who you are now. The Victor you knew has changed, and he is still there. The same for her. Don't rush. I won't run away or hold back. Not anymore. She heard the last two words and understood he had been holding back. She told him she did not need to understand him. She was the person who knew him the most. Vic. He laughed and told her that someone who had been through what he had been through could change a lot in a short time, and that she of all people should understand that. She agreed to watch him, thanked him, huffed, and turned away because the feelings had gotten embarrassing. He told her to follow him. She did. On his side of it the emotions of a vampire sat at a ridiculous intensity, and he had already noticed vampires glancing at her and, for a second, seeing [[Violet Elderblood Snow|Lady Violet]]. His rule for himself was the whole commitment or nothing. She decided the decision was their problem.[474]

##### Agnes, the Inherited Marriage and the Ultimate Yandere
Chapters 494–500
Victor and Leona travelled into Snow territory, where another unresolved relationship demanded attention.[475] Absorbing Adonis had transferred more than memories and abilities. The supernatural marriage bond connecting Adonis and Agnes had partially transferred onto Victor as well.[475] That bond created an unacceptable ambiguity. Agnes loved Adonis and always would, while Victor now carried Adonis' memories, emotions and portions of his Soul. Victor himself also possessed genuine affection toward Agnes, but could no longer cleanly distinguish which portions originated from his own relationship with her and which had been inherited from the man he absorbed.[475] Agnes reached an important conclusion. Severing the old marriage would not dishonour Adonis. Her husband would have wanted her healthy and alive rather than permanently suffering the side effects of maintaining a supernatural marriage connection with a man who no longer existed independently.[475]
The family was simultaneously processing the revelation that [[Scathach]]'s relationship with Victor had finally become physical. Agnes was shocked when the information circulated through the family's communication network, while Natashia and Victoria produced their own increasingly absurd reactions.[476] Natashia's imagination reached especially extreme levels as she discussed the future of Clan Fulger, descendants and the possibility of binding more of her own family around Victor.[477][478] Victoria's own imagination proved little safer. Discussions involving Tatsuya, Fulger Blood and future generations rapidly became another demonstration that the people surrounding Victor possessed almost no concept of ordinary family boundaries by Human standards.[479] Victor then descended into the Snow mansion's underground areas with Leona, only to encounter Violet. Violet immediately detected the scent of a Werewolf around her husband.[480] The resulting confrontation between Violet and Leona was inevitable.
She hit him like something fired. The hug came with a sniff, and then it stopped. That smell. A wet dog. The eyes narrowed. Leona was already there. Yes, I'm here too, leech. Violet's head turned. What are you doing here. Leona asked whether she was forbidden to accompany a childhood friend, and she smiled when she said it. The vein stood up on childhood friend. Lightning left both pairs of eyes and struck in the air between them. Violet held him as if he might leave. He was already touching her. He put a hand on Leona's head, amused, and told her she really was hopeless. The jealousy, the envy and the anger dropped out of her at the touch, and the argument did not become a fight. The ritual with Agnes was still waiting under them.[480]
The argument led Leona to ask a question she genuinely could not understand. Violet was one of the most stereotypically possessive women Leona had ever known. How could a genuine yandere tolerate Victor accumulating so many women?[481] Violet's response was simple: She had been driving women away.[481] The problem was that Victor was worse.[481] Violet explained that Victor continuously kept her happy, spent time with her and eliminated male vampires who attempted to approach her romantically or politically in ways he disliked.[481] More disturbingly, Victor maintained an almost invisible network around the women he loved. Clan members, servants and information contacts quietly monitored threats around them even while Victor outwardly allowed his wives enormous independence.[481] Victor enjoyed watching the women he loved pursue their own ambitions—what he described as allowing them to spread their wings—but freedom did not mean a lack of supervision.[481]
The same behaviour extended even toward Leon and Anna. Victor's political, financial and supernatural influence had grown large enough that much of the protection around his parents could operate without them consciously noticing every layer.[481] Violet tolerated the possessiveness because Victor did not use it to make her miserable. He gave her freedom, affection, attention and security while quietly constructing an enormous protective cage around everyone he considered his.[481] Most importantly for Violet, she possessed a status nobody could take from her: [[Violet Elderblood Snow|First Wife]].[481] Leona gradually realized that Victor had not truly transformed into an entirely different person. The signs had always existed. Human Victor had been fiercely loyal, proud, vengeful, possessive and willing to endure suffering rather than beg people who humiliated him for mercy.[481] His illness and Human society had simply forced restraint upon traits he lacked the power to express fully.[481] Vampirism amplified the Ego already present.
Scathach then trained that amplified personality into an effective warrior, while Anna's upbringing provided the loyalty and family-centered morality preventing Victor from becoming simply another violent monster.[481] To Leona, the apparent contradiction finally made sense. Victor could be a battle maniac, killer and obsessively controlling yandere while simultaneously being genuinely loving toward his family because those traits did not exist separately. The same extreme attachment produced both behaviours.[481] While Leona and Violet argued, Victor and Agnes prepared the ritual required to sever the inherited marriage.[481] Before beginning, Victor briefly confronted the internal shadow representing another portion of his own Progenitor existence. The entity reminded Victor that absorbing Adonis had not merely placed foreign memories inside him. Everything Adonis possessed—memories, feelings, curses and powers—had become incorporated into Victor's new existence.[481]
The shadow warned him that the pieces he had absorbed were already moving toward one existence, and that he needed a self strong enough to still be Victor when they finished merging.[481] He came back to the ritual with Agnes. It was not the marriage ceremony. No pile of materials was required. His Blood was enough. He cut his wrist and let it fall into a circle on the ground, and the smell of it hit Agnes and Violet hard enough that he had to tell them to focus. Agnes spoke in ancient Latin. The circle went blood red. He started the acceptance with the Count's name, and she stopped him. She wanted the human name, not the title. Victor Walker accepted the closing of the ritual that tied him to Agnes Snow.[481] The light climbed, the letters in the circle rearranged, and the supernatural connection broke. Violet, Sasha, Ruby and Natashia felt another presence leave the network around him at the same moment. He felt a thin sadness anyway. The bond ending was one more statement that Adonis was gone, and that the marriage had ended because the man was gone. Agnes said it was done. He said yes. They were not married anymore.[481]
He turned to leave and she caught his hand. They were not finished. A bag of ritual materials was already waiting behind a pillar, because the marriage she had inherited from Adonis was the thing that had just been erased, and what she wanted next was a bond that belonged to her. She pulled him out of the circle, took a horn of some magical creature out of the bag, and told him they had a ritual to do. The words she put on him were simple. “You must marry me now.”[481] He had stood in front of Vampire Kings, Gods, Demon Dukes, giant Monsters and armies without freezing. He froze at that.[481]
Discoveries, Changes, And War therefore ended with Victor's existence transformed on nearly every level. He had been formally identified as the Second Vampire Progenitor, established the first genuine inherited characteristics of Clan Alucard through Eve, bonded with the World Tree Roxanne, absorbed Adonis and inherited seventeen centuries of experience and future sight, politically reorganized Clan Snow, awakened Blood Sacrifice and created [[Junketsu]], expanded his knowledge through Mizuki and the Youkai, rescued Ophis and accepted [[Nero]] as his daughter, deepened his relationships with Sasha and Scathach, formally married Natashia, prepared a supernatural coalition for an approaching Demonic invasion, travelled forty-two thousand kilometres into [[Nightingale]]'s unexplored west, learned the secret behind Clan Adrasteia's Monster bloodlines, trained in Divine power with [[Aphrodite]], acknowledged the emotional importance of his maids and finally reopened the relationship he had left unresolved with Leona since his Human adolescence.
The Volume closed not with the beginning of the Demonic War itself, but with another major change inside Victor's family: the final supernatural remnant of Agnes' marriage to Adonis was severed, and Agnes immediately declared her intention to marry Victor through a new bond created by her own choice.[481]

The meeting opened above the clouds, on a gigantic medieval island that floated with exotic animals and ignored ecosystem, time and space. A large white palace stood on it. The man who owned Limbo's prison had white hair, closed eyes, a neutral smile and a simple black suit, and his face would not stay one age. Look at him and he was a young adult. Look away and back, and he was an old man. Do it again and he was a child. He said the meeting of supernatural beings had begun, and he told the guests to come in and remember that the meeting would be shown to every major faction. [[Shiva]] never got used to him. A man who had existed before Shiva was born. Shiva was tall, dark-skinned, short-haired, golden-eyed, serious, dressed in an attire made of his own power, and he told [[Thor]] that a mere title did not make you the person you wanted to be. Thor was tall and muscular, a large red beard, red hair worn in the old Norse way, brown eyes, full sturdy armor, the hammer resting at his waist. He said one of his Jotun lovers really hated that title. They did not want to wait for the next guest.[502]
[[Zeus]] came, tall, long white hair, a white beard, light blue eyes, Greek robes, and the air of a man who thought the room was his. Thor laughed that he had the courage to show up, and asked if humiliating himself in front of the [[Destroyer]] had not been enough, that he wanted to do it on an international scale. Zeus said Thor had lost too. Thor said he took a defeat as learning, and that there was no shame in losing to one of the strongest beings. He was grateful to be alive. The host said the Shinto pantheon and the Egyptian pantheon had left their decision with Shiva and sent no representative.[502]
The second guest was Michael, strongest seraph, supreme chief of the army of the eternal father, come from the seventh heaven. Six white wings, golden armor, a western sword at the waist, golden hair falling behind him, and a light that veiled the whole face so the holiness was all anyone was allowed to see. [[Gabriel]] came with him, almost the same armor and the same sword, silver hair instead of gold, the presence less intense, the seraph who stood for justice and announced the eternal father's word. The third guest was [[Volk Fenrir]] of Samar, the strongest alpha, blessed by the beast of Ragnarok. He was 220 centimeters, dark-skinned, body and arms ridiculously out of proportion with ordinary men, dressed in the skins of several animals, barefoot, hair a light black shot with blue and worn wild to the waist, a small scar on the left of his chin, bright blue eyes that were hard to hold. His sons Fenir and Anderson came behind him. They had his face and not his size, and they wore normal clothes. Anderson said they had been ignored. [[Fenrir]] told him to shut up and not damage their reputation. Volk's own thought was that they had been summarized because they had no achievements worth the introduction. At Victor's house the broadcast was already on. Ruby, Nero, Renata, Anna with Zack in her lap, Leon, Edward, Leona, Fred, Andrew and Liena watched it, and Ruby was writing it down for the wives who were not in the room. The fourth guest had not been named yet.[502]
The fourth guest was announced out of the hidden Arcane realm: Evie Moriarty, queen of the witches. She was tall, white-skinned, curvy, and her eyes were a complicated golden magic circle, spikes and runes turning in it. She wore a long thin black dress with dark red accents and an opening at the leg, dark golden draconic armor on the arms and the legs, and a crown of something like black twigs set with a light blue gem. In her hands was a long black staff carrying light blue and green energy. The voice came with seduction magic, a light suggestion that made the speaker attractive and pushed everyone to see her in a good light. It reached through the television. Hecate said her mother used that magic without thinking, even in Arcane, and that a strong will could ignore it. Andrew felt it. Renata, watching from the house, said the queen was not like her. She was much inferior. [[Alice Moriarty]] came as the second daughter, ashen as a ghost, black eyes, black hair, black fingernails, an all-black dress cut low on the chest, and a black staff with a neon green gem. Her field was black magic, the kind that sat on the mind: curses, control, suggestion, subjugation. [[Selene]] was named as the first daughter, the one whose work was necromancy.[498]
The entrance changed with the guest. A mythological forest, then Japanese temples. The fifth guest was a woman who had risen by uniting a race and becoming worthy of the gathering: Otsuki Haruna, nine-tailed fox, supreme commander of the strongest Hyakki Yakou, out of the supernaturals of Japan. She wore a short black kimono with golden trim, long black stockings, nine fox tails, deep black eyes, a little red at the eyes, a pretty face, and a simple katana in a black sheath with golden trim. Yotsuba Kuroka came with her, commander of the first youkai battalion, long black hair, two cat tails, cat ears, a kimono like Haruna's done in purple and worn so the shoulders and a great deal of cleavage showed. She wailed that Haruna had disappeared and she had been worried. Haruna told her to calm down and fix her clothes. On Victor's side of the broadcast Fred and Pepper came apart, one for the fox and one for the cat. Pepper said she preferred cats. Someone asked if the chant that followed was Buddhist. The vampires were being saved for last, and the room knew why. Vlad was a friend of the host. The entrance waiting for them was Nightingale's own misty night. The sixth guest had not been given a name yet.[498]
The sixth name the host gave was Vlad Dracul Tepes, straight from Nightingale, leader of his race and more than a leader, their first progenitor, the king of all vampires. He came first as a dark thing, red eyes and sharp teeth, and then as a man who looked to be in his thirties, black hair, a beard that was not very trimmed, black armor, a large black cape, and at his waist a strange western sword with no sheath, only a blade in a bizarre shape. He told the host it was fantastic as always, my friend. Volk's answer was a growl. Vlad, you piece of shit, you've finally come.[503]
Annasthashia Fulger was announced with him, the fastest woman alive, a pillar of Nightingale, leader of Clan Fulger. She arrived in a burst of golden lightning, long golden hair, red eyes, a black dress, a slightly bloodthirsty smile, two golden rings on her fingers. Agnes Snow came in a blazing fire, long white hair, blood-red eyes, the sword of the dragon king [[Fafnir]] held to her chest. The blade sent a tremor through souls, and what people saw behind it was a huge dragon. The host named her clan as the one that had overcome the mortal weakness of vampires, and named her a pillar beside Fulger. Scathach Scarlett came out of a block of ice, long red hair, the spear in her right hand, runes enough to make the weapon feel sinister. The introduction called her the strongest female vampire alive, disciple of the godkiller [[Dún Scáith|Dun Scaith]], general of Nightingale, leader of Clan Scarlett.[503]
Then the room was given Victor Alucard. Second progenitor. Fifth pillar of Nightingale. The man the goddess of beauty had blessed, and the man she loved with all her heart. He stood in the dark first, and the only things visible were the blood-red eyes, the sharp teeth, and the red veins pulsing through his body. When the dark let him go he was in a black suit and white gloves, the long black hair loose and wild in the same way Volk wore his. The list hung on him was not a vampire's list. Aphrodite. Albedo Moriarty, the ground witch. Nyx, mother of night. Spirits of lightning. [[Gaia]] and the ancestral spirits of animals. The world tree [[Qliphoth]]. One of the blessings the host spoke was struck out of the announcement before the room could hear the name. He was also carrying [[Alsyr]], the chain that binds deities. Vlad asked if he really had to make a commotion. Natashia said he would not be Alucard if he did not make a little mess. Scathach told her foolish disciple she had not thought he would be loved by so many people. He said that was more interesting.[503]
Aphrodite Elderblood was particularly concerned by the increasingly strange Divine influences accumulating around Victor. Blessings associated with powerful Beings such as Nyx, Gaia, Albedo Moriarty and others had attached themselves to him for reasons he did not completely understand. Aphrodite explained that a Divine Blessing represented a God granting another individual access to a portion of their authority, but warned Victor never to make borrowed power the foundation of his combat style because the God responsible could normally remove it whenever they wished.[504][505]
Aphrodite called him in a hurry and wanted the talk to be alone. He sent Natalia out and told the goddess that he already was. The maids were his blood and his essence. She did not have the time to argue the philosophy. Kaguya waited outside with the rest. What Aphrodite had brought was older than the meeting. Thousands of years ago [[Hephaestus]] had made a tool. She had told Zeus to go fuck his toys and refused the order to marry the smith, and Hephaestus had kept the grudge and tried to expose the saint she pretended to be. The chains had dropped the god of war and dropped her with him, and for a while both of them had been at the smith's mercy. She had kept the chain. Its name was Alsyr, the chains that weaken deities. In theory, with those chains on him, even a god-king on Zeus's level could be brought down to the strength of an adult vampire. She was lending it because the moment Victor's face showed in that room the attention would turn ugly, and the owner of Limbo's prison would put private information about him on the table. If a god attacked, he was to use her chain. Zeus would feel it inside him and would most likely not pick the fight. She told him not to count on that. Zeus was the most irrational god for a reason. Shiva was a different warning. Not even Alsyr could interfere with him. The divinity of destruction was too strong. Of everyone who would be in the room, the owner of Limbo and Shiva were the ones he must not make into enemies. He said he would not provoke anyone. He was going to look at the strongest beings and judge them himself. She set the chain into him in a golden glow.[506]
At the door the welcome was a refusal. Alucard was invited. The uninvited beings were to stay out. He said they were not other beings. They were his blood, his essence and his power. They were him. His shadows, his eyes and his fangs. Roberta's hate came up hot enough that she said they would all die, Zeus, [[Poseidon]], [[Hades]], everyone. He told her not to lose herself in it, and he called her [[Medusa]]. As long as he was there, and the maids with him, nobody was going to hurt her again. Old grudges could wait. This was not the time.[506]
Behind the outward diplomacy, nearly every representative pursued private interests. Victor reunited with [[Otsuki Elderblood Haruna]], while negotiations concerning trade, monopolies and supernatural resources demonstrated how much of the world's balance depended upon ancient agreements rather than simple military strength. Individuals such as the First Trader possessed enormous influence because controlling access to rare materials could matter as much as possessing an army.[507][508][509]
The gorilla complained that he had been pulled out of a comfortable spot, then admitted the new place was nice, and asked to be treated kindly. Roxanne said she had heard he was only eating bananas and not working, and that she might tell Scathach. He coughed and told her not to be mean. He would do the job. Just do not call that monstrosity. Victor said the irony was thick, coming from a demonic gorilla, and that Scathach was not an eyesore. On the giant screen she was walking like a queen. The gorilla said his tastes would drive a psychologist mad, and that the psychologist would need a psychologist. Victor told him pretending to be the joker would not get him out of it, and cut the link. Mary asked if the gorilla was getting smarter. Eve asked if that was not cheating. He said he learned everything his queen learned, and she learned everything he learned. That was the symbiosis of a guardian and a world tree. Knowledge did not rewrite a personality. Roxanne had always been carefree, and she could be serious when she had to. She was humming. Bruna, hugging Roberta while Roberta came down from the gods, said it was hard to believe. The maids agreed.[510]
In the guest hall Vlad smiled a small smile and told Shiva it had been a while. Shiva said it really had, and that his kingdom was as usual, and he knew the friend was lying and let it pass. Victor's look stopped on Haruna and went gentle. Her ears twitched. The tails moved. Kuroka laughed to herself that Haruna had reacted. The angels gave him nothing. A protective veil sat on them, and the nothing made him uncomfortable. On the witches his eyes stayed on the taller woman with the crown. Evie was looking at him confused, asking herself what her mother wanted with this man and why that mother had blessed him. He put the confusion next to the name. Albedo Moriarty. The chaos witch was tied to the queen, maybe as her mother. Evie set a small magic circle in the air and told Alice to keep an even closer eye on him. Shiva felt like the size of the sea. Zeus looked at him with annoyance and with lust, and he shivered and thanked Aphrodite that the chain was there. The red-haired god kept looking at Natashia. Victor did not like it. She touched his arm and told him not to mind. Those worms had always tried to pester her, and she had always refused. He asked what they would have done if she had not been Fulger and had not been of the vampire faction. She did not answer. She hugged him and called him possessive, and she loved it. He asked if this was the moment. She said she was only a mother-in-law hugging her son-in-law, the broadcast was over, and it would not come back until the meeting was done. Volk, watching, laughed to himself. He had thought that woman was the freak of her race. The new parent was like that too.[510]
Anderson met him with a hard handshake and said Alucard kept getting attention. Victor said it was not his fault. The host had decided to reveal things he should not have. Gaia, Nyx and Albedo had been enlightening, at least. Natashia was surprised at how easily he made friends. Scathach said he had fought Anderson once, and friendship could be made that way. Agnes was gripping Fafnir harder, and the temperature was rising. The damn dragon was excited by so many strong people, and she was having trouble counting it. Natashia said that even as a sword the dragon's will was alive, and a fight with the strong was what a dragon wanted. Scathach lifted her spear, touched the blade, and put cold air into it. Agnes thanked her and thought it was his fault that the three earl houses could stand in one place and call it family. Anderson had gotten stronger. The fight had been enlightening, and he knew he had to improve. Victor offered another fight when this was over. Anderson said he would never refuse. Then he introduced his older brother, same mother. The brother's private measure of Victor was the enemy of their organization. Niklaus's information said the wolves lent to Victor had been killed by him. Out loud he asked if Anderson had vampire friends now, and called him the family's failure, as expected. Victor asked if this was the one with the dick up his ass, and said that being the first child made it mandatory. The brother looked annoyed and was ignored. The introduction to their father would have to wait.[510]
Anderson, second prince of Samar, asked if Victor would visit his land. Victor said he would not refuse it, if it was all right. Anderson had married. Being the second prince, it had been bound to happen. The wife was not Leona. She was one of Leona's aunts, a sister of Adam. Victor asked how many siblings the old man had. Anderson said Adam's mother had been a famous woman, a harem of wolves, and the children had gone past fifty. The white in Anderson's hair was not that line. It had come from his mother's genes. One of his uncles had the same hair. Victor said he would come to Samar, and he asked Anderson not to drag him into a mess, and if possible to keep that woman away from him. From memory she was an Egyptian woman, chocolate-colored skin and cold eyes, and his feeling was that if she saw him she would want him in the harem. Anderson called that insightful. Victor said he was not a woman and did not give a damn about other women's opinions. The issues could come. They were not to involve his family. If it was only him, he did not mind. Anderson said that was what friends were for, and not to get used to it. Treat him well when he arrived. That was enough. A wolf never forgets, and Anderson said he would return the favor.[511]
Haruna's eyes were obsidian. The fox ears were up, and the tails moved in a way that pulled the eye. He told her she had not come to visit Ophis. She said she had been busy. He asked if she would visit. Ophis, or him. She said both. He put a way to contact him into her hand and told her to beware of the demons, and if anything happened to retreat to her people at once. He leaned in to say it. She had come to this meeting so the youkai would be counted as a great faction, and the law she wanted was years in which nobody interfered while they built. Kuroka's tail stood up when he called her Kuroka-nya. She said that was not her name. He said he knew. She called him a jerk. Vlad watched it and kept himself out of the trouble.[511]
On the way back to his own people he felt someone coming and turned, and the senses went up on golden lightning until time itself sat slower. Evie Moriarty's voice was melodious and authoritative, and she was tall enough to rival Eleonor, with a body other women looked at with envy. She said he was hard to reach, even for her, and she asked why he had ignored her calls. He said he had thought it was a scammer. Alice stood paler than he did, and he was the vampire. She said that was normal. The side effects of her magic were normal, and they did not bother her. He called her a master of black magic and said the spell would draw hostility because it was dangerous and hard to answer. Evie told him he still stood trial for his crimes, and that the next time she called, he was not to ignore it. He called that ego and arrogance at its best.[512]
Then he told them a story, as if it were nothing from the past. A rich man came to a village that had nothing, sold foreign goods at a hundred times their price, and got rich for a year, because there was no competition and no better option, so he dictated the rules and people followed them or lost the privilege of his products. A second merchant arrived with the same goods at a price people could pay. The first tried to destroy him and could not. The second was a retired master, weakened, not one of the strongest, but strong enough to break a merchant. A rivalry followed, and the people who bought were the ones who benefited. Evie knew the shape of it. He said he had an alternate ending. The second merchant used that superior strength, crushed the rival, and took the monopoly. She asked if he was that second merchant. He laughed and said she had it wrong. He was the fourth merchant. She was the first. And what had happened to the second, once people learned that a low price worked? They found him, took his place, and practiced the same greed. Alice said she did not understand the moral. He gave it to her. When everyone wants a product and a cheaper one of the same quality exists, they buy the cheaper one. When they do not have that option, you use force, claim the thing, and build your own system. Refuse people something they want badly enough and the enemies are not one or two or three. They are everyone. He told Evie he would see her at his trial. Her magic-circle eyes had already been measuring him, and what she found was strange enough that she meant to change her plans when she got home: thicker defenses, and the filth she already knew about her clients kept close enough to use.[512]
Victor's own behavior continued upsetting those systems. His rapidly changing powers included [[Magic]] despite conventional Vampire biology supposedly being incompatible with ordinary magical cores, further reinforcing the suspicion that the many Blessings and unusual entities connected to him were altering the limits that should have applied to his species.[513][505]
In a palace waiting room Agnes told him what he had done was very dangerous. He said he knew, and he would not make excuses. If you could not fight an enemy, you turned that enemy's allies, and the allies those allies might still become, against him. [[Chaos]] was the only answer. Only in a greater chaos was there room to move. He tried a spell. The word was Murus. It failed, and the room went quiet around a vampire doing something vampire biology was not supposed to allow. Vlad came in and said the preparations were ready.[514]
The Gathering itself occurred beneath the authority of a Being vastly beyond ordinary national rulers. The neutral administrator responsible for the meeting enforced privacy and supernatural restrictions powerful enough that even [[God-Kings]] and Progenitors were expected to obey the agreed rules while inside his territory. Haruna used the system to request centuries of non-interference while the newly unified Youkai rebuilt their civilization. Most representatives accepted the proposal, although ideological opposition from the Angels demonstrated that prejudices between supernatural races remained deeply entrenched.[505][515]
The blessing had been explained earlier, in a presidential suite, not in the hall. Aphrodite's eyes glowed neon pink, and his violet eyes answered in the same color while she showed him what a god's favor actually did: a piece of authority, beauty that pulled like moths to a flame, and a power that was never his to begin with. Albedo's blessing was the one that had put magic in a body that should not have held it. The rest he ranked as minor next to what he already was, and he meant to understand them without standing on them. A god could take back what a god had lent.[505]
The hall itself was a huge room and a round table, the place where the rules of the world were written, and the rules of the room allowed a whisper to stay private. He stood behind Vlad. The three countesses stood behind him. Haruna's tails moved, and her fox ears twitched, and she asked for five hundred years. A rule that no faction would interfere with hers for five hundred years. Shiva said the gods approved. Volk approved. Evie approved. The angel, Miguel, denied it. Vlad offered to sponsor those five hundred years of peace, provided that at the end of them her people became Nightingale's eternal allies. Haruna refused. Victor had told him to make the offer. Then he made his own. Clan Alucard would fully sponsor her faction. Shiva asked if he was not going to ask for anything in return. He said that if he wanted something from someone, he would not earn it with a soul contract. That was not a thing you used on a potential ally.[505]
Victor strongly rejected the idea of forcing potential allies into Soul Contracts merely because betrayal was theoretically possible. Such contracts had value against enemies or untrustworthy parties, but using one at the beginning of a genuine alliance effectively announced that neither party expected trust ever to exist. His intervention prevented Vlad from turning the proposed relationship with Haruna into another arrangement based entirely upon enforced obligation.[515]
He said it again so the table would have it clean. Using that kind of contract at the start of an alliance only proved you expected the betrayal in advance. Haruna accepted the sponsorship. She would be counting on him in the future. Vlad approved the five hundred years. Shiva had watched the king's frustration at a charisma that did not need his permission. The charm did not land the same way on everyone in the room. Thor felt lust. Evie and Alice went briefly confused, until Evie's own spell cleared it. Michael and the angels, built toward purity, saw something beautiful and virtuous and did not feel the lust at all.[515]
Volk asked if anybody wanted a copy. What he was offering was the rulebook of the place, a high-level contract over everyone present, with punishments that sat at the level of the soul, and a fragment of the host's power inside the pages. Haruna said no, she didn't. Beings whose will was thin took it badly. Eve, Bruna and Maria came away with the headache and the disorientation, and Eve's pain ran into the insecurities she already carried. Victor read it. Haruna read it. Neither of them bent.[515]
The representatives then submitted their own demands. Matters included the missing replicas of Greek Divine Artifacts and disputes among factions, but the proceedings abruptly changed when the administrator announced the unexpected arrival of a sixth representative: Hell itself had finally sent someone to the Meeting.[516]
The Greek pantheon put a demand on the table. Some time ago someone had stolen a divine artifact, made copies, and vanished. The artifact had been recovered. The copies had not, and the culprit was unknown. They wanted a rule that if one of the factions present found a stolen divine artifact, it would be returned to its owner. The vote failed. Michael was the support they had. Victor called it hypocrisy at its best. Gods stole from mortals whenever they liked, and the moment mortals stole from them the gods wrote a rule. He denied it.[517]
Then the host named a sixth guest, representing the demons of hell. The introduction was the whole history in one breath: the woman banished from Genesis by the heavenly father, the ancient progenitor of humans and now the progenitor of demons, mother of demons, goddess of demons. Lilith. She had long white hair and skin almost as pale as Alice's, two large horns, a voluptuous body, a long pointed tail that reached the ground, and two large wings that seemed to grow from her hips. She stood two meters tall, in a black dress with the skirt parted so she could move and with the chest left open, and her blood-red eyes went over the room as if none of them were worth the trouble. She asked permission for her companion to speak. The host told her to sit down, and he told the room to keep the hostility small. An act of aggression would not be forgiven. What stood up behind her was more than five meters tall, completely red, a muscular chest, horns, sharp teeth, sharp claws, large demonic wings, and a long sharp tail that looked as if it would go through whatever it touched.[517]
[[Diablo]] entered as the representative of the Demons and immediately revealed that diplomacy had become irrelevant. The Demonic invasion was already underway. Major regions of the Human World—including portions of Russia and China—had been devastated, while Demon armies advanced through Europe, Africa, South America and other continents. Diablo proclaimed the beginning of a conflict comparable to the ancient wars of Genesis, leaving the assembled leaders with no opportunity to prevent the opening move. The Demonic War had already begun before most of them even realized a war existed.[518]
He raised a hand of demonic claws and a red gate opened on a destroyed Beijing, demonic creatures hunting humans in it. China had fallen. The image shifted. Moscow was in the same state. Russia had fallen too. His troops had entered Europe and were heading for Ukraine, Finland and Sweden, and three portals showed giant demons walking, flying and contaminating what they passed. The demons in Argentina, in Brazil and in Africa had already begun to march. He said he did not believe in some bullshit excuse like the destruction of the human race. His goals were beyond their comprehension. The war had begun, a war as devastating as the one that had been fought in the primeval times of the Genesis age. The voice was ominous enough to shake the place and to push a bad feeling into weaker souls. His eyes went completely red when they found Victor. The room took the portals with shock, and with disgust where the hunting reached children. That was the line Victor drew. Vlad's question was the practical one. How had an invasion of that size stayed hidden until a demon decided to brag about it.[519]

##### War Comes to Nightingale
Chapters 521–547
[[Diablo]]'s appearance revealed the scale of his preparations. He had negotiated with servants of [[The Judges of The Abyss]], promising approximately two billion Souls in exchange for the conditions necessary to bring vast numbers of Demons from Hell into the Human World. His invasion therefore functioned simultaneously as military conquest and mass harvesting: every city destroyed produced Souls contributing toward the agreements that allowed the campaign to continue.[520]
He had not come to negotiate a peace. He came to propose a demand, a non-aggression rule. Until the war broke out, the other mythologies, the vampires, the witches, the werewolves and the youkai were not to meddle. This was not their war. It was the war between the demons, the angels, and the beings the heavenly father had made. Earth would fall today. Do not meddle. This was the war of angels, demons and humans. The answer that met him was not from the table. Three [[Abyss Watchers]] stood in identical clothes, their shapes blurred and distorted, as if the world would not let a lower being see what they actually were. They were impartial, and they sat at a level comparable to the man who owned Limbo. Two billion souls. That was the deal he had made with their master. Avoid breaking the balance, or he would end up stuck in Limbo forever. They were gone as suddenly as they had come.[520]
What he opened next was a dark portal the size of himself, and through it the room saw the war already sitting on more than the human cities. Shadows on [[Olympus|Mount Olympus]]. [[Asgard]] under attack. Moscow. The Arcane realm. [[Nightingale]]. Other kingdoms. Resources that should have gone to the witches and the demons were being turned toward Samar. Lilith's body shook. The life left her eyes for a moment and came back, and the face that returned held a sadistic smile and a plain hatred. Michael spread his wings. White power went through the room. His teeth were grinding. Vlad opened a portal of his own, back to Nightingale.[520]
The armies under him included the Keys of Solomon, Demon Dukes, Horsemen and numerous Legions already positioned across multiple continents. Diablo had prepared the offensive long enough that the supernatural governments of Earth were reacting to a plan already in motion rather than confronting an enemy improvising as events unfolded.[520][521]
The portals that opened across Nightingale were the same kind he had used at the table, and the demons came through like a plague. On a roof in the royal capital two of them stood at four meters. Jeanne named the first. Seventy-first key of Solomon, [[Dantalion|Duke Dantalion]]. Morgana said they were underestimating Nightingale. With him here they would not even need to move. The royal guard was enough. Jeanne told her to shut her big mouth. The pressure that landed next to Dantalion was King [[Baal]], the first key. Morgana said even with Baal she could deal with him. Then the monstrous one came, gigantic wings, miasma leaking from the mouth. Ninth key of Solomon, King [[Paimon]]. She could fight Baal. Baal and Paimon together, and she would have difficulties, and Dantalion's immortality was still sitting under both of them. She had already called Dantalion weak.[522]
At Snow, Violet said the capital was under attack. Hilda said the capital was not the problem. The other territories were. Violet said Scarlett was fine. [[Oda Blank]] said they were buying time, or they were also putting resources somewhere else. Alexios's defenses should have made an invasion of this kind impossible. Natalia took a portal to Earth and found thousands of demons, dukes among them, terraforming a Russian city, and a massive dragon-like demon coming at her.[522]
Fulger was the soft one. Sasha put on silver armor over lightning-conductive cloth and built daggers out of lightning. Victoria told her to take care and to back off if she had to. Sasha's order was to kill them all. Tatsuya vanished on an illusion. A massive bolt came down on the city, and that was her entering the fight. The demon duke on that territory was Marques Phoenix, thirty-seventh key, leading a legion. [[Hecate]] watched it through a territorial spell.[522]
Nightingale was attacked almost immediately. Demonic portals opened across territories belonging to the [[Vampire Counts]] while many of Nightingale's strongest rulers were still returning from the Meeting. [[Sasha Elderblood Fulger]] defended Clan Fulger's lands and demonstrated that she had developed far beyond the inexperienced heiress Victor first met, while [[Ruby Elderblood Scarlett]], Siena Elderblood Scarlett, Lacus Elderblood Scarlett and Pepper Elderblood Scarlett fought separate invasions throughout the Scarlett territory.[523][524]
Victoria had already named him. Marques Phoenix, thirty-seventh key, fiery wings, sent to weaken Fulger, and the collateral damage was not something they could politely avoid. Sasha stood on a building in lightning-covered armor, a helmet over radiant red eyes, the red leaking at the edges. Victoria asked her to keep the property damage small. She said she would try. Below her, young vampires, adults and elders were fighting scattered demons with no shape to it. She rallied them. Those without combat experience were to take refuge in Clan Fulger. Those who could fight were to take up weapons, gnash their teeth, use their bloodline, and defend their territory, their home. A ten-foot horned demon hit a street of young vampires. An elder kicked it and broke property doing it. She left the ground, ignored the disdain Phoenix was aiming at her, and went to the lightning-construct daggers the way Natashia had trained her, Fulger martial arts that came from a lightning spirit and had lost the old weakness of the flesh when the bloodline became vampire.[525]
She said she was the lightning, and the lightning was her. The body glowed. The eyes burned red. The daggers became large golden swords. The first form was Lynet, out of Carmila Fulger's secret art. She moved, left golden trails, and in ten seconds she was back where she had started. In that ten seconds thousands of bolts had come down across kilometers. Demons were opened, beheaded, cut apart. Tatsuya, her cousin, complained that she had stolen his kills. He had been cleaning them with illusions and a katana, and he still said it. Phoenix, one of the seventy-two dukes, admitted the arrogance after he saw the street. He demanded a name. She gave it. Sasha Fulger, heir of Clan Fulger. She told the other vampires to back off. He raised the dead out of their own corpses with fire, a new army, bloodthirsty and covered in flame, and he called it a second round. He would not retreat. She and Tatsuya stood back to back, eyes red, lightning on both of them. She told him to take that side. He took it. They went in under thunder.[525]
Scarlett had been warned, and the territory was already empty. The people were in a bunker under [[Scathach]]'s castle. What came for them was King [[Zagan]] and the legion of the sixty-first key. Ruby arrived with Edward, Leona, Pepper, Lacus and Liena, who was human, to stand with Siena. Ruby's order was that they would not kill the demon duke. They would capture him, torture him, and learn what the other side knew. She told the demons welcome to their world, and to be careful, because the weather forecast today was snow.[526]
She was in full armor, black with dark brown and dark red, a light red cape of tough animal hide on the right shoulder to take hits, a helmet matched to the plate, and the rune-carved spear Scathach had given her. The ice was her mother's. The water was his. The armor made the change between them easier, and she could crack the sky for snow and freeze ground and walls. Lacus went first. She said they should set the mood a little, turned to mist with red eyes glowing in it, and laid a dark gray smoke like cloud over the territory until the place was dark. Siena, long red hair, a dark purple dress open at the legs over black stockings, pushed the snowfall higher and seeded the air with tiny invisible ice spikes. Pepper said done, built the water into gloves with spikes she could control, the weapon Victor had taught her so she would not only have ice, and answered herself with umu, umu. Then Ruby, Pepper and Lacus went in close, Lacus with smoke daggers, while Siena kept the field. Siena's line on it was simple. Follow the plan. One of the seventy-two pillars or not, nobody attacked Clan Scarlett and lived to tell it.[526]
The Demon commanders quickly identified the women around Victor as priority targets. Their abilities, unusual Bloodlines and connections to the Second Progenitor made them too dangerous to leave alive, but attempts to isolate or eliminate them only revealed how much the Count families had changed since Victor entered their lives.[527][528]
Phoenix hovered over Fulger and would not explain himself. Their goal, he said, was too big for a small-minded being to understand, this was not a third-rate movie, and he would not expose the plan. He told them to keep playing with the demons and not to increase his work. Tatsuya called him a glorified flaming chicken, told him that if he was going to invade the territory he should at least do it right, and said he wanted the smug look off that ugly mug so the demons in hell would laugh at him for losing to a baby vampire. Victoria and Hecate, watching, asked why he was acting like Victor. Tatsuya put a lightning dragon into the air, Hakai no sora, and the territory lit. Sasha had already pulled more than a thousand demons into one place outside the city in seconds. The count form was on her. The armor hid most of the change. What it could not hide were the bat wings of pure lightning, and the reach of them when she discharged. She called it one punch. One million hits. The clustered demons were erased.[529]
He came back angrier, and the form that answered her was no longer a man pretending at a bird. Fiery wings, horns, a tail, claws, rigid skin, a toxic miasma that slowed a vampire's regeneration, bursts of speed from an old fighter's experience. He put the miasma through Tatsuya's stomach and told them they were too dangerous to be left alive, that they had jumped into the lion's den. Sasha coughed blood, told Tatsuya not to be a tragic hero, and asked if he was going to sit there and let her do everything. Hecate's circle came down over the miasma and held it so the territory would not be infected. Her thought, sent across, was not yet, and then not yet. Sasha's lightning daggers went through Phoenix's head and split him. Tatsuya drew. Rairyū no Zangeki. A gigantic slash of golden light took what was left, and there was no scream in it. Victoria's answer was impossible. Her niece was twenty-three, or twenty-five. How was she using that technique. Sasha's right side was burned and her hands were damaged. Tatsuya's stomach was pierced and burned, and the miasma kept the healing slow. The demons from before were already gone.[530]
The conflict also reinforced a simple idea that had gradually become the emotional foundation of Victor's household: family. The word increasingly mattered more than Clan names or racial divisions. Someone acknowledged as family would be defended with the same intensity regardless of whether they were born Vampire, Human, Demon or something else entirely.[531]
Sasha got to Tatsuya's side and held the bleeding shoulder, and she coughed black blood. The miasma had come in through the contact, and regeneration was not obeying her. Hecate warned them what a phoenix demon actually was. Immortal. He would respawn. Flame took the corpse and he stood up whole, irritated that he had died, and he meant to erase the stain on his honor. The pressure went out. The wings became a small sun and the ground burned. To kill him for good they needed light, or an attack on the soul, or a seal. A progenitor could damage a soul. Vlad could. Victor could. Hecate started the seal and asked them for five minutes. Sasha called him a glorified chicken and mocked the honor. Then a distorted pressure arrived with Vlad, and Phoenix narrowed his eyes at two progenitors in one place, opened a dark portal, and left. He told them not to die to some other demon. The pressure lifted. They collapsed. Hecate called it a feat, a strong duke. Sasha did not want a partial victory.[532]
Natashia reached her daughter. Victor knelt and said good job, and the pride in Sasha came up as a smile. He had already decided what protection meant. He would train Ruby, Sasha and Violet harder, and he would handle the rot of the world himself. Natashia stroked Sasha's head and trusted him with the future of that house. He told Tatsuya he looked like he had been hit by a truck, and otherwise ignored him. Victoria's report was few deaths, massive property damage, miasma in the ground. The butler's report was billions in destroyed business. Victoria fainted. He let Sasha drink and closed the arm. Victoria wanted custom armor out of Clan Adrasteia. Natashia agreed. The next fight would need better than what she had worn. His sight found demons still lurking. He disappeared toward them.[532]
[[The Arcane Realm]] was also breached. Demonic portals appeared within a dimension that should have been protected by the Witch Queen's advanced defenses, immediately raising the possibility of inside information or specialized methods capable of bypassing barriers most outsiders could not even locate. June warned Violet while [[Hilda Snow Elderblood]] and the other defenders recognized that Arcane's invasion could not reasonably be dismissed as ordinary Demonic brute force.[533][534]
On a balcony of the Snow mansion, Hilda and Violet were already dealing with a smaller knife. [[Sitri|Duke Sitri]], rank twelve, and a rank in hell was wealth and influence and power, not just the number. Violet's armor stored fire, raised her speed, and threw a cloak of it. Hilda covered herself in flame and flew. June broke in with the report that portals had opened in the Arcane realm and legions were coming through. Violet let her go. June's space magic took a shattered rock and put her home. The realm was still itself, nature worked into the magic, witches in the air, seasons on a schedule, circles on her house, and a bag that held five hundred square meters of storage. In the office the attack on the new city was an illusion. A training exercise, run with the demon king. There was no breach and no destruction waiting for her.[535]
The real closing of Arcane was quieter than a legion. Yue, called SmileWitch, met June with long hair that a casual spell turned from green to violet-pink, modern clothes, black pants, a white shirt open at the shoulders and the belly, earrings, and a fox's smile. The queen was cooperating with the demons in the war. She had shut the space of the realm. Nobody could leave except the queen and her daughters, neutrality preserved and the leak stopped. The payment had been divine artifacts out of a destroyed pantheon, and Yue would guarantee that Arcane's strength was about to rise because of them. June would not run to her contractors. They did not need her, and she valued her life and their money and nothing past that. Her crystal could not open a way out. Yue had already seen the new count, and she spent the waiting on what kind of woman he liked, battle maniacs who enjoyed a fight, sadistic women, yandere pursuers, older women, until the announcement that the queen was back cut her off.[536]
Fighting continued across Nightingale. Clan Snow weaponized emotion through its flames, Clan Fulger overwhelmed enemies with Lightning, Clan Scarlett froze entire battlefields and Clan Blank moved through Shadows to assassinate priority targets. The war became one of the first occasions on which the traditional Vampire Clans fought at large scale using the advances and training accumulated during Victor's rise.[537][538][539]
Sitri came to Snow dressed for a court, two horns tipped dark blue, two large demonic wings, entirely black eyes with blue pupils, luxurious black clothes and a dark blue tie. He named Violet Snow and her oldest maid, Hilda, the clan's executioner, and he laughed that the short temper had not changed in this generation. He meant to destroy the territory, and when he was done he would have his demons kill the citizens in front of her and use her body as an object. A king had already warned him, on another day, not to fall for a Snow taunt and not to provoke them back. Emotion spoke louder than reason in that clan. They were meaner than demons. He did it anyway. Violet told Antonio to hush. For a rank twelve he was very free. He had tried the same scheme on rank one, Duke Baal, and come back with his ass kicked, his wife kidnapped, and a punishment that kept him inside his own territory. A demonic ally had told her the rest of that humiliation. Baal's wife had castrated him for trying to rape her. She asked why he did not kill himself and let Gremory take the seat. He called her a little monster. She called it a pathetic excuse for a duke. He looked at her body. She said that was a great sin, and that anyone who looked at her that way paid for it. Only her darling had permission. She told him to burn.[540]
The anger did not explode the way it used to. Hilda saw a silent heat that could swallow everything, and she named the shape. The second vampire count form. Two long bat wings, sharper ears, paler skin, pure blood-red eyes with no white left in them, long hair become pure flame, a monstrous body with nothing human left on it, and a heat that burned what stood around her. This was not the power of a younger vampire. Oda answered her with darkness daggers. Hilda took the first count form, sharper ears, two bat wings, taller, covered in fire, and put a barrier up on a beam of it while she told the rest to retreat. Sitri's miasma did not stop what came through it. He had been too angry to see the man. Violet pierced the heart, burned an arm and an eye, ripped the throat, and ended it in a supernova. The explosion took the place he had been standing.[540]
Violet came out of the sky exhausted, still in the armor he had given her. Hilda, back in the maid's uniform, told her good job. Agnes stepped through Natalia's portal and asked where the invaders were. Hilda said [[Violet Elderblood Snow|Lady Violet]] had killed them. Duke Sitri had attacked Snow and been reduced to atoms. Agnes told them to spread it. Her daughter had killed a demon duke. On the other side of the war Diablo sat in black armor with red shades, white eyes, and long black hair like embers. War stood with him, a pointed helmet and long black hair of his own. The resurrection was a dark blue fire with a white flame in it, a sacrilege, paid in souls. Sitri came back with the rank lowered. The order was to destroy the Vatican alone, and to kill every general of the Inquisition. War said the king's wish was his will. The contingency under that was a recall, and the supernatural prisoners were to be fed into demon factories. The invasion of the vampire lands had failed. The vampires were enemies now.[541]
Zagan did not come to Scarlett as a soldier. He was the sixty-first of the seventy-two pillars, king of more than thirty-two legions, and he called himself a merchant. Everything was negotiable, he said, even his daughter's virginity. The sisters' snowflake froze a finger. He turned the ice to water and the water to wine. Ruby's spear met a spike off a golden throne. A thorn came up under her. Gold became the throne, the throne became coins, the coins became fluid. She told him she would make sure he answered. What he answered was the reason for the raid. Diablo had hit Snow, Fulger and Scarlett to buy time. Earth was already going. China, Russia, Africa, Europe. The Chinese pantheon had been erased. He would not fight. He felt something larger arriving and left through a gate. Scathach and Alexios came out of the next one. She said, daughters. The four of them were still standing, and they were spent.[542]
In the Royal Capital, [[Jeanne Elderblood]] and [[Morgana Elderblood]] fought high-ranking Demons. Morgana's history as one of [[Lilith Elderblood]]'s former Generals made her uniquely suited to understanding the hierarchy, personalities and abilities of Hell's elite. Her confrontations with Demon Dukes such as Dantalion demonstrated how completely her allegiance had changed: the Demon who once served Hell now regarded Victor's family as the place to which she truly belonged.[543][544][545]
Over the royal capital Jeanne and Morgana hovered in front of three dukes. Dantalion in his real form, the seventy-first key. Paimon, the ninth. Baal, the first, called the right hand of Diablo. Morgana went up in a pillar of red light and pressure. The long black hair grew to her feet and moved on its own like blades, with a red glow and a strange smell. The milky skin went deep red. The eyes went from red to gold. Spikes came out of the forearms. The hands became claws. Extra skin armored the arms, the legs, the breast and the groin. She was taller, and she was a succubus again in the shape of it, and she said she was not a demon anymore. Paimon called her Anna. She corrected him. Morgana. He asked the former general of Lilith if she did not want to come back and fight for her own kind. If the ex-general would not join, they could take her offspring. She told him no one would touch her daughter, and that he was not welcome. Enough talk. She slashed Baal's face and sent him crashing, and she kicked Paimon at Jeanne.[546]
Jeanne's eyes and hair glowed gold. Golden wings opened. She had a golden sword, and the blessing she was borrowing from God sat badly in a body that was not built for it. Ten minutes, and she would cough blood from the inside. She took Paimon by the neck, crunched it, and said he was hers, by the power of love, the thing he had forgotten. His true form came out under her hand, an effeminate man with black wings and a crown. She threw him into his own spears of darkness. He called the king Bebal's twins, Abalam, one gigantic and blood red, the other gray and full of darkness. Baal came back with legions and ordered the attack. Jeanne proclaimed the Judgment of Israel. Golden fire ate Paimon's circles and his miasma and took the strength out of the demons around her. Morgana warped. The body became a gigantic monster, sharp teeth, thousands of eyes, and she went at Dantalion. Jeanne put a fist through a demon's face. The fight was not over.[546]
Morgana fought Dantalion as the reaper of that roof. She put a lethal dream into the air, a grotesque monster, and she told him she had beaten worse than him when she still served Lilith. His answer was witch-derived curses, black tattoos, a pillar of darkness, demonic claws, and a shadow hand growing out of the body. The immortal army was his and he could not summon it here. She shattered her own dream with dark power, came in on wings with a sword of pure power, and he blocked with the shadow hand and clawed her face. He pierced her through. She died, for a moment, and the dream put her back together. She stabbed him. An extra demonic hand answered, and the wound closed. She took the count transformation the rest of the way, larger, a tail, an extra horn, the dark power jumping, and she broke out of his hold. The curses were still on him. She was still the one pressing.[547]
Dantalion told her Lilith was not their mother anymore. She was their caged dog. She had joined them. One day she had simply started attending the meetings, and the look of her and the attitude had both changed, and she had begun to support Diablo's plan like a fanatic. He swore he did not know why. He laughed at the image of it. Morgana asked what they had done to their mom. The answer was that they only knew the change. She answered with vampire radiation, a power out of her own body, crimson beams from the eyes and an aura that erased, more destructive than the dreams had been when she was still a demon. The legion he pulled out of his soul, a hundred and sixty-nine of them pushed up to the level of a seventy-second rank by cursed letters and miasma, went to vapor. She took the limbs off him, caught what was left, and flew him to a sealed room in Vlad's castle. Jeanne was still in her own fight when Morgana passed her. The questioning was not finished. The army was.[548]
The conflict widened until nearly every major character surrounding Victor became involved. The Demons were not attacking randomly; individuals connected to Nightingale, Arcane and other supernatural territories had all been incorporated into Diablo's plans, while hidden conspirators continued acting beneath the visible war.[549][550][551]
Paimon made the mistake of talking about her son. Jeanne had been holding back, and he had mistaken the hold for a limit. She asked who he thought he was going to harm. A worm, powerful only because she was restraining herself. She was not his servant. He had insulted Adam and desecrated his existence. A bloodthirsty red aura sat on her. She was not in a count form, and she was still out of his reach. She cut the twin in half and put a foot through the eyes. Paimon pissed himself. A gesture at the throat was enough to choke him. She opened a portal onto a void and threw him through it. What waited there called her little sister. He had made a big mistake pissing her off. The existence would be shattered. The soul broke, was recycled, and was sent on to reincarnation under the abyssal judges, and a tree branch took what was left so the oversight would not slip. A gentle green aura had been on her while she did it, and it terrified Morgana more than the red one. The field went quiet. Morgana could not settle what she had just watched, and the change had Victor's hand on it.[552]
Morgana's information finally allowed Victor to understand more clearly what had happened to Lilith. The former Demon Queen had not simply chosen to stand beside Diablo. Her behavior, the history Morgana remembered and the unnatural changes surrounding her strongly indicated that Diablo had taken advantage of Lilith and placed her under control.[553][554][555]
What Morgana could see of Lilith did not match the mother she knew. The ancient army had been spent on Samar, subordinates thrown away as disposable, while the useful work under the invasion was the taking of children, Volk's and Evie's. A mother did not spend her own that way. Morgana turned on Vlad for choosing the kingdom over the family and called him a goddamn sperm donor. She could not get her breath back under it. He had always, in her measure, chosen the realm over being a father or a husband. Evie, for her daughter's kidnapping, said she would triple the price of the talismans the werewolves bought. The tension with Volk went up a step, and nobody in that room had Lilith back.[556]
Victor refused to treat her as an acceptable casualty simply because she was a Demon. Lilith was connected to Morgana and several people now important to him, and the possibility that she was being controlled transformed her from an enemy to be destroyed into someone Victor intended to free.[557]
He said he would probably be expelled from the office of count when he executed the plan. Vlad would accept not intervening in the demon war. He would not. The thing in front of them had been built across factions and across dimensions, and Vlad's magical contract with Diablo exempted only Vlad from what could be done to Lilith and to the demons. There were loopholes in a contract like that, and there was also the simple fact of who had been touched. They had hurt his wife. They had dared to try to kidnap his daughter. He growled both sentences. The evidence that the witches had helped was not concrete, and it was visual, and he was not going to stand still for it. Clan Blank was to watch his daughters at every hour. Adam, Elizabeth and Ophis would stay under his eye for now. Mizuki would fight the demons because the fight itself satisfied her. The word went out to the people who were not in the room, Liena and [[Aphrodite]] among them, and the ones who heard it did not know what to do with the man who had just said it.[557]
The decision demonstrated another major change in Victor. Older rulers preferred maintaining the supernatural Status Quo, protecting their own territories and interfering only when their immediate interests demanded it. Victor increasingly rejected that approach. If the established system allowed enemies to repeatedly endanger his family while hiding behind treaties, traditions and political boundaries, he would simply stop respecting that system.[557][558]
Scathach recognized the transformation immediately. Her disciple was beginning to act as a ruler whose decisions no longer depended upon whether Vlad approved of them. Victor listened to experienced people around him, but final responsibility for his family increasingly rested with Victor himself.[559][560]
That philosophy led directly to the creation of Victor's first independent political faction. The Count families and allies willing to follow him began organizing around Clan Alucard rather than exclusively around Nightingale's Crown.
