Some families, such as Clan Adrasteia and [[Clan Alioth]], could not enter the same formal structure because of obligations and existing loyalties, but Victor deliberately refused to force them into magical contracts. Their relationships would be built upon trust rather than supernatural coercion.[561][562]
Violet said they would create a faction in which Snow, Fulger and Scarlett were completely united. [[Werewolves]], former hunters, an onmyo mage and witches were in the same room for the same reason, mutual support, not a favor owed to the crown. Natashia's contribution to the politics of it was short. Fuck the king. Fulger wanted its independence. Snow was there because of him. Scarlett, the house Scathach had built, was five of them plus Luna. Alioth and Adrasteia were not in the structure. He was sitting with Eleonor in his lap while it was argued, and Violet did not enjoy the picture. Natalia was surprised the alliances had gotten that far. Edward and Leona were the wolves in the room. The proposal was on the table. The king's problem was not solved.[563]
He asked it back to the room so nobody could pretend they had not heard. All but Clan Adrasteia and Clan Alioth agreed to come together and create a new faction. The people responsible for each group said yes. Eleonor said she would keep quiet. He thanked her. Edward, Mizuki, Siena, Pepper, Lacus, Ruby, Natashia, Jeanne, Agnes, Violet, Leona, Sasha, Natalia, Rose and the rest of the ones who had the right to speak had been in that talk. The reason in front of them was Samar as much as Nightingale. The meeting itself was not a story to be carried out of the room. What had been built was a faction whose center was him, and whose membership was not one race.[562]
By the end of the first stage of the war, Victor had therefore gained something considerably more significant than another battlefield victory. He was becoming the center of a coalition whose loyalty ran directly toward him rather than through Vlad or any pre-existing supernatural monarchy.[562]

##### New Bonds in a World at War
Chapters 548–576
After the immediate invasion of [[Nightingale]] was contained, Victor's household briefly rested while assessing what had changed. [[Aphrodite]] Elderblood joined them and became increasingly disturbed when she learned exactly how many powerful Divine Beings had granted Victor Blessings. The Goddess understood more clearly than almost anyone how Gods used blessings to manipulate heroes, champions and favored mortals, and she did not want Victor to become vulnerable to the political games that had destroyed countless people throughout Divine history.[564][565]
Her response was deeply personal. Aphrodite asked Victor to allow her to protect him directly. Their relationship had already progressed far beyond casual attraction, and Victor asked her to become his wife. Aphrodite accepted and performed a genuine [[Soul Marriage]], permanently connecting their Souls in a manner normally available only to Gods and Conceptual Beings. Unlike the ordinary Vampire marriage ritual, this bond could not simply be undone through separation or the removal of a contractual effect; their existences were tied at the Soul level.[487]
She touched his face and told him to let her protect him. He asked her to be his wife. She asked if he would become her darling. He said yes. A dark red aura came off him and a rose-gold glow came off her, and for a minute the two of them were the same light. The bond that set was a soul marriage, the kind gods and concepts used, souls made into soulmates, not something death undid. It kissed the vampire bloodlust down to a minor hunger. Their eyes, while it held, made a heart. She threw herself on him and kissed his mouth.[487]
What she put in his hands after that were her divinities, not a polite blessing. Sexuality. Pleasure, including the kind that hurt if that was the pleasure asked for. The perpetuation of life, enough to feel life and to move it a little, and dangerous if it was turned on something from hell. Happiness, the knowledge of what made a person happy, and the emotions that came with looking. War, the perception of it, an instinct for how a war was made, prolonged and ended, and a basic mastery. She told the wives the same door existed for them, and the price of the door was godhood, or a state that could bear a soul ritual. Until then only [[Scathach]] would marry him by the ordinary rite. The others would wait. The vampire rite had a weakness when the partners were many. If the bond was not nurtured it dragged the bloodlust into madness. They were to take their fill of his blood, and they were not to be greedier about it than the maids.[487]
Aphrodite subsequently granted Victor access to the Blessings associated with her Divinities of Love, Sexuality, the continuation of Life, Pleasure, Joy and even her lesser authority connected to War. She also explained the significance of Soul Marriage to Victor's wives, revealing that those who eventually reached true Godhood or another appropriate Conceptual state could potentially establish the same kind of permanent Soul-level union with Victor.[487]
The marriage produced several consequences throughout the family. Aphrodite had gone from a dangerous outside Goddess hovering around Victor to someone whose interests were now inseparable from his survival. Scathach, meanwhile, became increasingly fascinated by the new fields of power Victor's relationships were exposing to her.[566][567][568]
The arrogance of older Gods remained one of Victor's recurring frustrations. Many Divine Beings had existed for thousands of years with few entities capable of challenging their authority, leading them to treat younger supernatural races as inherently inferior. Victor's rapid development increasingly placed him in direct conflict with that worldview.[569][570][571]
The war then drew him to the Vatican. Victor appeared on the battlefield in specially prepared black armor while Demons fought Angels and Inquisitors around him. His objective was not to become an unquestioning ally of Heaven. Victor considered Angels and Demons opposing forces whose rivalry helped prevent either side from gaining uncontested power, and preserving the Inquisition gave [[Diablo]] another enemy to fight while Victor pursued his own objectives.[572]
The armor was a gift from Eleonor, because she could not come with him yet and she was afraid for him anyway. It was not the expedition plate. Full black, tight rather than bulky, built to protect him and to let the abilities move. The gauntlets carried three sharp thorns and claws on the fingertips. The shoulder was thorned and pointed the same way. A long dark cape reached the ground, and like the capes on Ruby, Violet and Sasha it stored power so the use of it would be faster. The material of the cape was titan skin, taken from a monster found more than thirty thousand kilometers from Adrasteia, toxic and prickly, and few beings would survive touching it. The breastplate was black with dark red designs that were runes, and Scathach had written them. Protection, passive. Concealment and intimidation, active, so he could hide like a chameleon and become one with the place, or amplify the pressure he already had. Minor runes on the gauntlets and the boots were support, self-regeneration and speed. If the armor broke it would eat surrounding material and restore itself. He looked at her as if she had overdone it. She said nothing was overkill when it came to protection, and that her own armor and Ruby's spear carried similar work. If he was going to a mythological war, a lot of protection sometimes was not enough. She would write the heiresses' armor and the maids' as well, and none of it would be as exaggerated as his, because she knew him. Her eyes accused him. He smiled, because he did overreact. She told him to stick to the damn plan. The heiresses and the countesses would spread across the globe, help the people who mattered, finish recovering them into the new city, and then go after the dukes. They would meet when it was done. He did not accept it out loud. He smiled and turned away. She sighed. Asking him to stick to a plan was asking a berserker not to rage. She trusted him not to walk into the enemy's main force. She would have reconsidered that trust if she had seen where he was.[573]
He was walking crimson earth as if the place were already hell, violet eyes soft and the face serious, and in his hand was [[Junketsu]]. The handle was a katana's. The blade was the length of an odachi and not the thickness of one, as if someone had taken an ordinary katana and enlarged the blade until it was ridiculous. An onmyo mage had made it out of anti-monster metal, blessed with hunter magic, built to hunt the things of the night. His blood had changed it. Covered in his power it could kill whatever the blade was put through, and it had a mind, and it would eat anyone arrogant enough to touch it. In his hand it was an extension of the arm. That was why he had practiced both the katana styles and the odachi styles. He climbed a cliff over the Vatican. The city was a tsunami of demons. Humans screamed. Lesser angels screamed. The Inquisition fought beside the angels and did not overcome the horde. The angels were the ones outnumbered. Kaguya called it madness. Bruna called it insanity and begged him to rethink. Roberta, Roxanne and Eve said nothing. They knew the decision. The gorilla in the shadow asked why he did not simply hunt dukes for information on that woman's daughter. The plan had been absolute secrecy. Victor, Jeanne and Morgana were supposed to split up and look for Lilith, and Scathach had put the concealment rune on the armor for that reason. He answered them once. The enemy of my enemy is my friend. The angels and the Inquisition were not holy. General James did not experiment on hybrids without the pope, and the pope did not approve a thing like that without the god who gave him power. Vampires were not saints either. There were vampires who liked chaos and needed to be hunted, and vampires who still practiced slavery. Every faction had a rotten point.[573]
The forces hidden inside [[Kaguya Elderblood Blank]]'s Shadows were released with Victor's arrival. What had been a desperate defensive battle changed almost instantly when Victor and his maids began annihilating Demonic troops at enormous speed.[574]
Victor did not simply kill every participant on the opposing side. He studied betrayals, political arrangements and the goals of the Demon commanders while preserving factions that remained useful to him. Several Demons discovered that they had been manipulated by their own leadership almost as thoroughly as the Humans and Angels they were fighting.[575][576][577][578]
His coalition simultaneously continued expanding. Allies were recruited throughout the supernatural world, the Youkai discovered additional evidence concerning the Demonic invasion and Clan Fulger began mobilizing independently rather than waiting for Nightingale's Crown to coordinate every action.[579][580][581][582]
One of Diablo's greatest political weapons involved hostages. Important heirs and relatives had been captured, allowing Diablo to bind powerful families through agreements preventing them from joining the conflict. Victor deliberately attacked those chains. He entered enemy territory, slaughtered hundreds of thousands of Demons and liberated the prisoners whose captivity had been keeping several factions neutral.[583][584]
The city had been human, on the Black Sea, Sochi, and Diablo had been using it. What Victor left of it was a sea of demon corpses, bodies impaled, the monument a dump, miasma over the blood. He had killed them one by one, like pigs to a slaughter, and the time it took was short, and the dead were thousands, giants among them piled into mountains. He had come for Morgana's daughter. She cried into his chest. He would take her back to where she belonged, and that place was not with Vlad. It was with her mother. He refused to play someone else's game. No more chains. The words he put on the contract were that he, Count Alucard, denied all privileges granted by the title of vampire count. The contract glowed and the signature faded. Aphrodite's teaching on the soul was what let him refuse it. The darkness he used was abyssal, blood-red eyes in it, a wave of shadow that drank blood and corpses and souls and fed Roxanne. Anderson, Leona and Edward were with him, elite wolves, and the maids were in the shadow, and Morgana and Jeanne were there. He told Alexios he would see him another day. If someone tried to force him back, the royal capital could burn. He was not returning to Nightingale, and he was not stopping.[583]
With those hostages safe, the contracts restraining their families became meaningless and another layer of Diablo's strategy collapsed. Victor had not merely won a fight; he had converted an enemy bargaining chip into additional allies.[583]
Victor subsequently confronted [[Agares]], the Second Key of Solomon. Agares possessed an exceptionally troublesome power allowing him to move partially through another plane of existence, making straightforward physical attacks unreliable. Morgana's knowledge allowed Victor to identify the nature of the ability far faster than he could have done alone, although Agares ultimately escaped rather than allowing Victor to obtain everything he wanted from the confrontation.[585]
Agares was the second key, rank two, and the power was the ability to interact with another plane and walk on it. A perfect assassin. He could camouflage his existence until the last moment, come in on demonic claws and black miasma, and be gone again. He called Victor's lightning speed and the soul-destroying troublesome. Victor sheathed Junketsu, the blade bloody, and answered with red slashes and lightning trails, and he would not stand and trade while the demon was not fully on this plane. He baited the appearance. Then he loved the new tool out loud. Dude, he said, I fucking love magic. He told Agares to die, and he cast Lumos. A large black circle. A blinding light. He took Emily and left in streaks of lightning while the demon was blind. Agares asked if he thought he would be allowed to escape, and then understood he had been tricked by a ridiculously large light spell. He did not chase. Emily's safety was tied to plans bigger than his pride, and escalating would cost them. There was no kill.[586]
Demonic infiltrators remained active even as their armies lost momentum. Victor's faction responded through counterintelligence while allies such as the Witches and Youkai became increasingly involved in the larger political struggle.[587][588][589]
Victor then confronted Evie Moriarty, Queen of the Witches, concerning the arrangement linking Arcane to Diablo. Rather than attacking one of the most dangerous Witches alive and turning another entire race against himself, Victor approached the confrontation as a battle of information and positioning.[590]
The conversation became a contest between two rulers accustomed to manipulation. Victor had gathered enough information beforehand that Evie's attempts to control the direction of the discussion repeatedly failed, while his willingness to exploit her emotional weak points prevented her from maintaining the superiority she expected from dealing with a much younger Being.[590][591][592]
By the conclusion of their exchange, Evie was forced to recognize that Victor had effectively outmaneuvered her without requiring physical violence. The Witches did not suddenly become his subjects, but Arcane could no longer treat Clan Alucard as an inexperienced faction easily manipulated from the shadows.[592]
The Youkai simultaneously formalized a new alliance under [[Otsuki Elderblood Haruna]], adding another historically independent supernatural race to the network gathering around Victor.[593]

##### Allies Beyond the Old Borders
Chapters 577–605
The war had destabilized enough of Earth that Victor's allies began searching for supernatural communities that might otherwise be destroyed in the crossfire. Natashia, Sasha and [[Tatsuya Rider]] traveled through England seeking [[Viviane]], the legendary Lady of the Lake. They found a half-Fairy, half-Goddess who had withdrawn from wider supernatural politics while protecting the remnants of the Fairies from exploitation by Gods and Humans.[594]
Viviane possessed a deep historical connection to [[Carmila Fulger Elderblood]], making Natashia's arrival more than an ordinary diplomatic mission. The Fulgers offered protection and a future in which the Fairies could survive without surrendering themselves to the forces that had historically treated them as resources.[594][595]
[[Diablo]] meanwhile reevaluated Victor's place within the war. The Second Progenitor had become more dangerous than most of the ancient factions Diablo originally planned around because Victor did not behave predictably. He rescued hostages, created alliances between traditional enemies, interfered in Arcane and was developing a coalition that did not depend upon any one existing Pantheon. Alucard consequently became one of the principal targets Diablo believed needed to be removed.[596]
Events also shifted to Samar, where [[Tasha Fenrir Elderblood]] was introduced more fully as the Queen of the [[Werewolves]]. Tasha combined intense maternal instincts with the ruthlessness necessary to govern a warrior civilization. The mysterious deterioration of [[Fenrir]], Samar's legendary guardian, made her suspect that the Demonic conspiracy had extended even into a kingdom historically isolated from most Human conflicts.[597]
Within Victor's household, Natashia's increasingly obvious attachment to him produced further jealousy, but Victor continued pushing the powerful women surrounding him toward leadership rather than allowing their emotions to destroy internal unity.[598][599][600]
[[Hestia]] Elderblood also became increasingly involved with Victor's coalition. [[Olympus]]' deterioration had left numerous Greek Goddesses searching for alternatives to [[Zeus]]' authority, and Hestia's nature as the Goddess of Hearth and [[Rex Invictus|Home]] made Victor's unusually family-centered faction increasingly attractive to her.[601][602]
Victor then traveled directly into Haruna's territory. The Youkai had considered strengthening their new alliance through political marriage, but Victor rejected marrying Haruna merely because their factions found it convenient. He had no objection to eventually marrying her, but only if an actual relationship developed between them rather than treating either person as an object exchanged between governments.[603][604]
Haruna's response reflected her own nature. Instead of continuing formal diplomacy, the Nine-Tailed Kitsune wanted to fight Victor. Combat had always revealed more about Victor than polite conversation, and Haruna wanted to experience directly why so many exceptional women regarded him as something completely different from ordinary rulers.[604][605][606]
Before their confrontation, Victor addressed the status of his Battle Maids. [[Kaguya Elderblood Blank]], [[Bruna Elderblood]], [[Roberta Elderblood]], [[Maria Elderblood]] and [[Eve Elderblood]] had repeatedly risked their lives for him and could no longer reasonably be treated as employees whose connection ended at service. Victor offered them permanent places inside his Clan and family.[607][608]
The maids accepted. Victor used his Progenitor Blood to deepen their Vampiric lineages and increase their potential. Kaguya Elderblood Blank in particular gained an extraordinarily close connection to Victor's blood and inherited access to characteristics associated with Clan Snow's Fire while retaining the Shadow powers of Clan Blank. The transformation demonstrated that Victor's blood could strengthen or incorporate existing Bloodlines rather than merely creating ordinary Noble Vampires.[609]
Victor then confronted a much more dangerous issue within himself. The enormous amount of Miasma, Negative Energy, violent instinct and Bloodlust accumulated through his battles had produced what he perceived as a "monster" inside him. Rather than continue suppressing the problem until it emerged uncontrollably, Victor isolated himself with Roxanne Elderblood and deliberately examined it.[610]
Using his purifying flames and Roxanne's connection to his Soul, Victor attempted to understand and control the violent aspect of himself instead of pretending it did not exist. The experience further developed the distinction between Victor and the darker personality later called Alter: the destructive impulses were not an external corruption but parts of Victor's own nature that needed integration and discipline.[610][611]
Victor's enemies were reaching the same conclusion from the opposite perspective. [[Niklaus Horseman]], General James and other conspirators agreed that Alucard's growth had become too dangerous to ignore. His Golden Blood, adaptability and increasingly unpredictable evolution threatened plans that had been developed long before Victor entered the supernatural world.[612]
The people surrounding Victor continued changing as well. Decisions made during the war altered future relationships, strengthened latent abilities and prepared several members of his faction for transformations that would become more obvious later.[613][614][615][616]
Victor and Haruna finally fought. The Nine-Tailed Kitsune drew upon the Moon, Youki and centuries of accumulated technique, filling the battlefield with enormous quantities of Energy and attacks that would annihilate ordinary supernatural warriors.[617][618]
Victor answered primarily through [[Martial Arts]], perception and adaptation rather than simply attempting to overwhelm Haruna with greater reserves. The encounter became less a battle over which faction was superior than a demonstration of the type of person Victor had become.[617][618]
For Haruna, the fight accomplished something political negotiations could not. She had spent years completing the unification of the Youkai and had begun losing the sense of challenge that once drove her. Victor represented an opponent whose rate of improvement meant she could pursue him without knowing exactly where the pursuit would eventually lead.[619]
Their growing attraction was therefore tied as much to competition as romance. Haruna found Victor infuriating and dangerous while simultaneously respecting him as someone capable of giving her new goals rather than demanding she become weaker for his comfort.[620][621][622]

##### Nature, Souls and Greater Powers
Chapters 606–633
Victor remained in Japan while Haruna introduced him to [[Senjutsu]]. Unlike conventional [[Magic]], Senjutsu involved drawing [[Natural Energy]] from the environment and planetary Ley Lines rather than relying entirely upon Energy produced inside the practitioner's body.[623][624]
Ordinary practitioners needed to carefully absorb and balance that Energy, but Victor possessed an enormous advantage through [[Roxanne Elderblood]]. Because a World Tree already existed inside his Soul, the surrounding Energy of Life reacted to Victor with extraordinary affinity and gathered toward him almost automatically. Haruna was shocked by the amount of Natural Energy entering him before Victor had even properly learned the technique.[624]
The Energy did not remain perfectly neutral after entering Victor. His Blood, Miasma, predatory nature and enormous quantity of Negative characteristics contaminated or personalized the Senjutsu, producing an expression of Natural Energy that reflected Victor rather than simply copying the techniques used by the Youkai.[625]
Victor continued treating [[Nero Elderblood]] and [[Ophis Tepes Elderblood]] as his daughters, training and protecting them while encouraging independent development. Their presence also forced other members of his family to confront old resentments and emotional wounds that supernatural power could not automatically erase.[626][627][628]
Several chapters dealt directly with the idea that unresolved resentment poisoned the Soul. Victor's family had accumulated histories involving betrayal, dead relatives, failed marriages and centuries of supernatural conflict. Simply joining Clan Alucard did not instantly remove those experiences, and Victor increasingly encouraged people around him to confront the past rather than allow it to silently determine their future.[628][629][630][631]
Unexpected variables also appeared in the development of [[Leon Walker]] and [[Anna Elderblood]]. Their transformations into Vampires did not produce identical results, and Victor investigated the powers awakening in both while arranging training capable of forcing them to actually master what they had received instead of depending upon their relationship with him for protection.[632][633][634][635][636]
Victor's connection to Roxanne eventually attracted attention from something on a completely different level: The Universal Tree. The Being represented far more than a giant World Tree. It was one of the fundamental cosmic entities involved in sustaining Life and the system through which living forms throughout Creation could exist.[637]
The encounter expanded Victor's understanding of Roxanne considerably. [[World Trees]] were not isolated magical plants but components within a vast structure linking living worlds to principles operating throughout Creation. The fact that one such Tree had become deeply fused with Victor's Soul made his existence increasingly unusual even to beings who normally concerned themselves with entire planets rather than individual people.[637][638]
The Greek Goddesses living near Victor created another political crisis. [[Vlad III Tepes|Vlad Tepes]] remained the formal ruler of [[Nightingale]] and understandably objected to foreign Divine Beings establishing themselves inside territory he considered under the authority of his Kingdom.[639][640]
Victor refused simply to expel people he had already accepted. The resulting negotiations became another confrontation between two Progenitors acting as rulers rather than an argument between King and subordinate. Even Ophis' position complicated the discussion further because both Vlad and Victor possessed personal reasons to care about what happened to her.[641][642][643]
They ultimately reached an accord rather than allowing the disagreement to become a Vampire civil war. Victor's coalition continued expanding into a group containing Goddesses, Youkai, [[Werewolves]], Fairies, Witches and several different Vampire families whose traditional cultures had little reason to cooperate outside the relationships Victor had created.[642][643][644]
An emergency within the [[Greek Underworld]] then exposed the deeper structure governing the dead. [[Persephone Elderblood]] prepared to claim genuine authority over the realm [[Hades]] had once ruled, but possessing the title of Queen was insufficient. The Ruler of a Hell needed to be capable of judging Souls impartially enough for the system itself to accept them.[645][646]
[[The Judges of The Abyss]] were finally revealed more directly. They were not simply mysterious monsters responsible for punishment. Their role involved separating and judging Souls, cooperating with the fundamental system of Life and helping create or recycle the Souls required for reincarnation. Ordinary dead could be processed through Heavens and Hells, while exceptionally powerful supernatural Souls required more direct judgment.[646]
[[Persephone]]'s test deliberately attacked every emotional weakness that could compromise a Ruler's impartiality. She was forced into impossible scenarios involving people connected to her past and family, confronting choices where sentiment and justice could not always coexist.[647][648][649]
During the same period, the existence sharing [[Roberta Elderblood]]'s body finally revealed her complete identity. She was [[Medusa]], the original Queen and Progenitor of the [[Gorgons]]—a Divine Spirit whose surviving Race had become tied to Roberta's existence.[650]
Medusa offered Victor far more than ordinary loyalty. She declared that her Fate and the Fate of her Race would be permanently tied to Victor's own, effectively establishing another Soul-level bond similar in nature to the union [[Aphrodite]] had previously formed with him.[650]
Victor accepted Medusa's Fate but rejected the idea that the Gorgon Race needed to dissolve into Clan Alucard. This distinction became an important principle of his future civilization: allies could belong to Victor's faction without every species abandoning its own identity, government and cultural heritage. Clan Alucard was increasingly reserved for people Victor considered genuine family rather than functioning as a container into which every subordinate Race was absorbed.[650]

##### Bloodlines and a New Ruler
Chapters 634–645
Victor then deliberately began bringing his wives into his personal Vampire lineage. [[Agnes Elderblood Snow]] and [[Violet Elderblood Snow]] underwent the process first. Victor's Progenitor Blood did not erase their [[Snow Bloodline]]; it strengthened their existing characteristics and altered their ancestry so that the women became more directly connected to Victor while retaining the powers that made them individually exceptional.[651]
The transformation demonstrated that Victor's blood could reactivate or magnify dormant hereditary traits. Kaguya had already acquired strengthened Snow Fire alongside the Shadow powers of Clan Blank, making the possible applications of Victor's lineage extremely dangerous should outsiders ever obtain enough of his blood to study it.[651]
[[Sasha Elderblood Fulger]] and Natashia Elderblood Fulger followed. Their Lightning abilities and perception were strengthened while dormant ancestral qualities associated with the Fulger bloodline became more pronounced. The changes encouraged both women to consider whether the abilities belonging to their ancient ancestor [[Carmila Fulger Elderblood]] could eventually be awakened more completely.[652]
[[Ruby Elderblood Scarlett]], [[Jeanne Elderblood]] and [[Morgana Elderblood]] were next. Jeanne's Divine Spirit was too advanced for Victor's Blood to simply overwrite, but her mortal body was improved and some external Divine influences upon her became less restrictive.[653]
Ruby experienced one of the most useful changes. Her separate Bloodlines no longer required the same deliberate balancing they once had, beginning to function as components of a unified existence in a manner more similar to Victor himself.[653][654]
Morgana produced the most remarkable result. She had previously existed as a Demon who received a Noble Vampire body, leaving her technically composed from multiple racial characteristics. Victor's Progenitor Blood caused her Vampire side to completely absorb the Demonic side into its own fundamental structure.[653][655]
Rather than remaining an unstable Demon/Vampire hybrid, Morgana became a genuine Vampire subspecies possessing Demonic traits—a Demonic Vampire. Victor had effectively reproduced in moments the type of evolutionary process that normally required entire species and Bloodlines centuries or millennia to accomplish naturally.[655]
The discovery forced Ruby, [[Scathach]] and Victor to reconsider what his blood actually represented. A Progenitor was not simply a stronger Vampire capable of transforming Humans; Victor's lineage could restructure the Soul Core and allow existing racial information to be assimilated into new Vampire subspecies.[655]
[[Aphrodite]] immediately sensed another Soul-level connection involving Victor and reacted with the possessiveness that had increasingly become one of the defining traits of the Goddess of Love. Her behavior made clear that becoming Victor's wife had not reduced her Divine obsession; it had redirected it entirely toward defending her place within his family.[654]
Victor's relationship with Aphrodite then demonstrated another difference between Mortals and Gods. Physical intimacy between them involved not only their bodies but interaction between their Souls, making the experience enormously more draining to Victor than ordinary Vampire relationships despite his seemingly limitless reserves of Energy.[656][657]
Meanwhile, [[Persephone]] survived the Judges' ordeal and emerged transformed. The woman who had previously been largely a ceremonial Queen gained genuine authority as the recognized Ruler of the [[Greek Underworld]].[658]
Within her own realm, Hell itself supported Persephone in the same manner [[Olympus]] supported a God-King. Her authority elevated her to a level of practical power far beyond her previous position and made even Nyx cautious about treating her as another easily manipulated piece.[658]
Persephone immediately demonstrated that the new title was real. When Nyx attempted to continue manipulating events around her, Persephone expelled the Primordial Goddess from the Greek Underworld and closed the realm against her. Inside her territory, the Ruler's command effectively functioned as Law.[658]
Nyx nevertheless remained one of the most difficult Beings in the Pantheon to truly deceive. Her association with concealment and her enormous age meant that she continuously observed the Greek crisis from perspectives unavailable to most younger Gods.[659]
The consequences of these developments were shown from several perspectives. Victor's faction was no longer simply rescuing displaced races during the Demonic War; it was actively building a society capable of housing them. Groups such as Fairies, Goddesses, Amazons and supernatural refugees required actual territory, homes, laws and infrastructure rather than promises of protection.[660][661]
Construction therefore became another battlefield. Victor's allies began creating permanent settlements and territories for the diverse populations gathering under their protection, preparing for a future in which the faction survived long after the immediate Demonic War ended.[662]

##### The Trap in the Amazon
Chapters 646–661
The conflict reached the hidden territory of the Amazons in Brazil. Victor, [[Eleanor Elderblood Adrasteia]], Leona, [[Nero]] and other allies entered the region to fight the monstrous forces attacking the surviving population. Eleonor demonstrated the versatility of the [[Adrasteia Bloodline]] by reshaping enormous portions of the terrain through Creation, flattening the battlefield so the group could fight more effectively.[663]
The ground they fought on was already hers. Eleonor said creation, and the land flattened, and giant walls came up to spoil the charge. Dark portals opened in the blind spots, behind necks, and white humanoid things came out of them with no eyes and no nose, only a mouth full of teeth. They regenerated, and they were tied to one central being of the same shape. Victor told them not to lose focus. It was an attack. He caught the first one, saved Eleonor and the others, and the creature clicked its tongue and said that was not what it had been told about his speed. Rose called it a trap and sent the Valkyries, Dorothy, Anrietha, Judy and Alexa, to the work they already knew. He told Eleonor to mess them up. A horde was coming behind the portals, behemoths, minions, ogres, wyverns, and invisible predators hitting from nothing. More portals sat on Natalia's escape, and dark shots were aimed at Eleonor. Rose, Leona, Nero and Ophis were in that field with him.[663]
The attackers were considerably stranger than ordinary Demons. Victor's group encountered Behemoths, invisible creatures and monsters connected to forces beyond the familiar supernatural factions involved in the war, indicating that the Demonic War was being exploited by powers whose complete involvement remained unclear.[663]
Victor was struck by an attack carrying an extraordinarily dangerous poison, but his body regenerated fast enough to prevent immediate death. The poisoning and chaotic battle were only part of the real plan. The enemy used large-scale spatial displacement to remove Victor from his allies entirely.[664]
The projectile had not gone cleanly through. He was paler than usual, black veins ran down his face, and he spat black blood. He told them he was fine. The armor had delayed it, the skin had not been completely pierced, and the body had held. Roxanne told him that was not the problem. He had been poisoned, and the body was deteriorating at an alarming rate. He coughed. Eleonor was already working and said so. His body was dying and regenerating at an insane rate at the same time. Roxanne was spending everything she had to keep him intact. The wound was healed. The poison would not leave. She wanted five minutes. The older version of him would have been incapacitated, possibly in a coma for years. He was not to get hit by that poison again. Nero was on the edge of tears and asked her father not to leave her. Ophis was the same, a small daddy. He stroked their heads and told them he would not die anytime soon, that it was nothing, that he was stronger than he looked and that his daughters were strong too. They both nodded. He told the rest of them, the Valkyries, Rose, Leona, Eleonor, Natalia and Anrietha, not to lose focus. They were still on a battlefield. Nero slammed a palm across her face, took the point, and drew two Deagles.[664]
Ophis did not believe the reassurance. Leona told him not to leave before he took her, or she would kill him herself. He laughed that death would not have him anytime soon. It still had a long dance left. She told him not to make fun of death. What if she fell in love with him. He said that was impossible, that she was overreacting, and that as far as he knew death had its own tastes and he was not the type. Leona said he was literally the type of every woman and every species in existence. He told her to stop boosting his ego. Three minutes remained. He said the projectile had been poisoned, that the poison was destroying the body and the regeneration was dealing with it, and that if they had taken the hit they would have died. Eleonor's eyes opened wide. Rose wondered if it was the same thing Vlad's son had used, and asked if he was okay. He said clearly. Natalia still could not open the portals. She had been trying since the beginning. He told her not to stop. Nero, Leona, Ophis and Natalia had to get out. They could fight. They did not have weapons for these beings. The big monsters were immortal, and only Adrasteia weapons dealt with them. The white humanoid was anyone's guess. He told Eleonor to stop spending the technique on the terrain. They had escaped the trap. Getting tired now was useless. Anrietha put a green light from her hand into his body and would not take the brush-off. One of their best fighters could not be incapacitated. He had stood in front of a bullet meant for Lady Eleonor. He said he would do it again without blinking.[664]
A dark claw came out of the ground. A voice clicked its tongue and called them slippery. The white being called it impressive. He had taken a dose that could cripple even the king of his race, and he was standing as if nothing had happened. Dangerous, Alucard. A black being came with it, the same shape, completely black, red eyes, a mouth full of teeth, gold tattoos scattered over the body and the tail. It complained that his senses were irritating. He shouted Alexa, Dorothy and Judy out of the ground they were standing on. White claws followed them up. Eleonor felt various creatures under them and squeezed the earth down on them. He told Rose not to walk away from the girls. After him, she was the only one whose senses could react in time. He told Eleonor to keep the land. The white one got the answer that he was told he was annoying a lot. He had noticed that they had seen something, even from far away. The black one snarled. What he saw next was the group dead, himself kneeling in a barren red land, and a dark power taking over. The eyes went violet, then anger and hatred. A red pillar went up and the air turned oppressive. The hidden mind behind the attack wondered if he had figured the plan out. None of these attackers should have seen the technique before. A golden bolt of lightning fell on him, and he took the Fulger count form. Roxanne told him to go, that she would handle the recoil, and to destroy them. [[Junketsu]] cut two of the beings into thousands of pieces, and pure plasma obliterated what was left. The hidden one could not believe the speed, on par with that woman, or the power, greater than the report. It did not matter. As long as that one lived, they would come back. It had to get away. He caught another white humanoid, black designs, tribal tattoos, and told it that it would disappear. Raw power gathered in the hand. The monster said holding it had been foolish. The technique had been complete from the moment they arrived. He had helped finish the objective. From the beginning the target had been Alucard. All hail our god, our savior. The accursed invaders would die for that god. Black liquid covered him. He killed it with Junketsu anyway, and the black stain on him grew, and his eyes lit violet again.[664]
When Victor recovered his senses, he was no longer in Brazil—or even the Human World. The creatures surrounding him and the overwhelming Negative Energy made the answer obvious: someone had successfully banished him directly into Hell.[664]
Instead of panicking, Victor laughed. The enemy responsible for the plan believed Hell would function as a prison filled with forces capable of exhausting or killing him. Victor saw an enormous hostile dimension filled with enemies, Souls, blood and combat experience waiting to be harvested.[664]
The news was received very differently outside Hell. Violet, Agnes, Natashia and Morgana reacted with murderous rage while Natalia blamed herself for failing to prevent Victor's removal. [[Scathach]]'s response was colder but no less extreme; she intended to recover Victor even if doing so required forcing Vlad to deploy every resource available to [[Nightingale]].[665][666]
Natalia's report hit four of them at once. Natashia's lightning crackled over her and she demanded to know how Victor could be missing. Violet called it a trap for her darling and promised to kill all of them. Morgana's eyes went bright red. She had been supposed to go with him, and she would have pulverized them. Agnes roared at Natalia to explain and not to be silent, the same roar as her daughter. Natalia was shaking and could not get past the summary of what Eleonor and Rose had reported. Sasha told the four of them to make room so the girl could breathe. They stepped back and apologized. Sasha knelt to Ophis, held the gloved hand, and got a sob that daddy was not here. She told her not to think the worst. Her father was strong. Jeanne knelt to Nero and got the start of the same sentence, and then Nero clenched her fists, wiped her face, and said she did not want to go through that again. She was not as strong as her father. She did not want to be that useless. Jeanne started arranging teachers. Ruby, Lacus, Siena and Pepper for the advanced work, herself for the basics, because Victor and Scathach were not there. Kaguya said she should have been with her master. Siena wanted to know why it had happened while her mother was gone. Pepper just said his name. [[Aphrodite]] came in on a pink glow with [[Rhea]] as adviser, grinding her teeth, and promised that heads would roll. The tone was psychotic enough that Rhea stayed carefully neutral.[667]
Lacus did not think the natives of that world had done it alone. Ruby had already narrowed it. Few of his enemies had the manpower and the connections to reach a native and use them. Before the assumptions, she wanted the report, from the beginning, including what Rose and Eleonor had said about Vlad's ex-wives and a poison that could harm a progenitor. Then she calmed the room with two facts. Aphrodite and [[Medusa]] were tied to his soul. If he had died they would have known immediately, and neither Aphrodite nor Roberta was showing that reaction. Medusa had not manifested. Second, her husband would not die of a simple trap, and being alone gave him more room than if the whole group had vanished with him. His last words to Natalia, and the relief on his face when he killed those people while the strange liquid covered him, meant he had foreseen it and passed the orders on purpose. Natalia confirmed the burst of crimson power, the lightning out of the sky, and the Fulger count form. Ruby's guess was Adonis's foresight, used without meaning to, showing him a horrible future, which was why he had dropped his guard and attacked. She asked Natashia what Fulger was known for. Speed. After Natashia, he was the fastest mortal alive, and he was not alone. Roxanne was with him, and her guardian. Exploding now would not bring him back. They could do that when they met the people who had set the trap and nearly killed the group. Violet told her mother to calm down and to trust the man she had chosen to spend eternity with. He had her father's resilience. Agnes's hand came off the sword. Ruby told Natalia to speak, and the recount started again from the beginning, this time in detail.[667]
They listened without interrupting until Sasha and Jeanne heard how close Nero and Ophis had come to dying. Ruby's anger was ice. A poison that used the properties of a hybrid, the hunter's magic, and the poison of monsters. A weapon that had temporarily weakened Vlad Dracul Tepes himself. A skill that could seal the Alioth clan. They knew vampires and their weaknesses very well. Nero shuddered and thought her father had suffered it because of her. Ruby put a cold hand on her shoulder and told her to calm down. She was not the only hybrid. They might have built the weapon out of the experiment done to her. Maybe. It was not her fault. She was the victim. He had protected his daughter, which was what a father did. Ruby only knew two groups that still had hybrids. [[Niklaus Horseman]], who she was sure still kept one, and James, the ex-general of the Inquisition. Natashia remembered that when Nicholas fled Nightingale he had gone into monster territory, and she had sent swift Fulger after him through her sister because she had wanted him gone completely. Jeanne asked if the poison Theo had used on Vlad was Nicholas's work too. Sasha thought Theo had been influenced. Vlad would have found it very hard to ignore a snake in his garden, son or not. He did not act out of kindness where Nightingale was concerned. Keep the enemy close and learn who was behind him. Morgana agreed, with disdain. Anyone who threatened Nightingale was an enemy, even his children. Jeanne said he was a king before he was a father. Morgana snorted.[668]
Agnes said that still did not explain the wives. Jeanne called him a flawed dragon. He liked to keep treasure close, and he was flawed because he let someone covet it and did not really care for it. He hoarded it and left it in his territory, and he only got angry if someone removed it from his sight. Maria called the mentality bullshit. Violet and Agnes agreed. Kaguya could not make sense of a man who allowed a treasure to be touched and forbade it to be taken out of view. Eve could not imagine anyone like that. Roberta said people were different, and some were more broken, and that for him he was right. Bruna said she could not imagine it. Master would never do it. Maria was proud of that. He would kill everyone who approached them with that intent. The room understood the treasure was the wives. Morgana was done predicting a five-thousand-year-old mentality. Aphrodite agreed, because while they had argued she had used the connection. Ruby asked if she could. Aphrodite said yes. A soul fragment of his, sitting in her soul, used to locate the greater soul. It needed precise control. Rhea said that was not a problem for a goddess that old. Violet told her to get to the point. Victor was in hell. Biblical hell. Whatever the liquid had been, it was strong enough to send a living mortal straight to a place that was supposed to take bad souls, gods, or demons. Morgana stopped the room. Hell was extremely toxic to anyone alive. It was a dimension of miasma, and there were places in it even the strongest demons could not enter carelessly. Pepper asked if he would be okay. Kaguya told them to remember Roxanne. A world tree of negativity made hell a second home for her. The other world tree was the question. As she understood it, the seven hells were derived from the negative world tree of the planet. Two world trees harming each other was strictly forbidden, an unspoken rule her brother had made. That did not stop people ordered by a world tree from harming Victor. Ruby retraced it from his side. A bad vision, an attack that ignored consequences, a last enemy who said the target had been him all along, and the obvious extra: the best way to harm him was to kill the people with him. The objective from the start had been to send the whole group to hell and let the place itself do the killing. That vision of their deaths was what had made him move. In the bad future only he would have survived the trap. The sight had let him change it. A powerful ability, and a dangerous one. She looked at Agnes and Violet. The enemy was smart, and they knew enough to plan a death for an abnormal progenitor. In a normal case even he could not survive that hell. They had not known he evolved. Used earlier, the tactic would have killed him with the group. Roxanne was with him now, so they had sent him to a place that was basically his second home. She laughed, cold, at people who had thought they were delivering a death.[668]
Victor, meanwhile, immediately began slaughtering Demons. Hell's own environmental conditions allowed him to operate with enormous freedom while his predatory abilities turned every enemy killed into potential knowledge and resources.[669]
One of his earliest major confrontations involved [[Vine]] Elderblood, the Forty-Fifth Key of Solomon and ruler of thirty-eight Demonic Legions. Victor annihilated the majority of her forces so completely that Vine—normally infamous for her arrogance—begged for her life after mistaking Victor for some terrifying High-Level Demon.[669]
He was sitting on a hill of demon corpses in the middle level of hell, rivers of blood, flesh and bone scattered, when Vine knelt. She was eight feet tall, red-skinned, black sclera and blood-red irises, large horns, wings, long black hair to her buttocks, red armor, a gigantic axe, and cuts on her that were not healing. She had commanded thirty-eight legions. She commanded them no longer. He had already ended the subordinates and the children of that house, and she was what was left, and she begged mercy because she had not known a high-level demon was there. He put a dome of blood around the place so the offer would not be spoiled, and in that dark the only things of him that showed were the eyes and a sharp-toothed smile. He had a proposition. The count transformation on him was sitting at a god-king's weight. She was crying when she knelt. The scene closed before she answered.[669]
Victor spared her because she possessed useful power and recognized the opportunity in front of him. Instead of merely killing everyone in Hell until someone found a way to rescue him, Victor began recruiting the inhabitants of the realm he was supposedly trapped inside.[669][670]
Vine looked at the blood dome and understood what she had been too proud, and too lustful, to see. Blood as the currency of a soul, the power to devour souls, several elements, and a face like that. Alucard. She was a traitor on Lilith's side, not one of the pillars sent on [[Diablo]]'s new conquest, but she knew the list of dangerous individuals, and he sat at the top of it. She had taken him for some variant of incubus because he had no wings, no tail and no horns. He did not look like an evil spirit on the way to becoming a demon. He looked alive, which he should not have been, progenitor or not, in that much miasma. He did not look surprised that she had his name. He told her to serve him forever, body and soul. She had expected the old progenitor's habit, information and nothing else. He raised a hand, a red wave of energy formed over the palm, and he offered power in return. Her whole body shuddered. Demons grew by eating energy, and the keeper of Roxanne, a world tree of negativity, was a full meal of the negative energy that body absorbed. He was using senjutsu energy. Roxanne was focusing the negative aspect of it into that red offering. Vine asked what his objective was. He sneered that it was a silly question. What other goal but to conquer. He would take this hell for himself. He would become its king. She thought it was insanity. The number of demons here passed fifty billion easily, and most of them stood with Diablo. This hell was one of the biggest, alongside the Buddhist hell, because it was tied to the two largest religions of the mortal world. Nobody had completely ruled it, not even [[Lucifer]]. Demons were beings of strife and respected only the strong. He told her that a thing never done was not a thing that could not be done. Common sense and rules did not bind him. There were no words for limitation or impossibility in his way of life. The only thing that stopped him was his will. If he said this hell would be conquered, it would be. She thought of a being who could make a demon cry, who had broken her pride, who had slaughtered her legions without sweating. Maybe. She named herself. Rank forty-five of the seventy-two demonic pillars. King Vine swore submission and undying loyalty to Victor Alucard. He said he had felt the lust for power, the conviction and the determination, and that he would satisfy them. The red energy went into her, fueled her, healed her, and made her more than she had been. A pillar of demonic energy exploded in front of him.[670]
When the blood dome dropped, she was smaller. The demon who had stood at two and a half meters had come down to two, the bulk gone, the muscle compact and defined, the beauty improved along with the rest of the body, the horns and wings and tail reduced. Those changes were the small part. The energy had practically quadrupled. Every pillar watching, from the lowest levels of hell to the highest, felt the jump and wanted to know what he had done. She looked at her hands and called it power. Then she felt the stares she had been too focused on him to notice, black sclera and red irises lifting toward the sky, and she asked the worms how they dared watch her lord. A gigantic axe landed in front of her, the handle the size of a halberd, made entirely of ice. It fit her hand and its weight was right, and the energy in it was ridiculous. Nothing below her master's level was going to damage that weapon. He had made it with his power alone. He came out of the shadow behind her, blood-red eyes and a twisted smile, took her shoulders, and told her to remember. She served him and him alone. She bowed her head to no one else. Pride and lust were reserved for him. She was his and nobody else's. He turned her face to him. She was no longer a demonic pillar. That title was useless. From that day she was his general and his sword. If he said attack, she attacked. If he said retreat, she retreated. He valued obsessive loyalty and despised blind, dumb loyalty. Body and soul did not mean he wanted a mindless tool. True strength was not the power he had given her. It was what she devoted that power to. He told her to prove he had not been wrong.[670]
Hell also became another enormous laboratory. Victor obtained the memories, combat methods and supernatural authorities of defeated Demons, allowing his understanding of the realm and the species inhabiting it to increase with every confrontation.[670]
The question of whether Demons were inherently evil became increasingly irrelevant to him. Victor judged people based upon actions and usefulness rather than assuming their Race automatically determined morality. A Demon who surrendered and served faithfully could live; one who insisted upon attacking him after being offered the choice could die.[671][672]
Morgana walked into Vlad's office without warning, while he was preparing to visit an ancient bloodline of vampire nobles in South Africa. He told her that if she was there, something had happened, and to speak. Victor had been ambushed with Eleonor and her squad. Direct subordinates of the elder gods had meant to kill everyone in a trap, and his intervention was why they had not. The killing intent at those words was controlled rather than released. He asked if anyone had been harmed severely. Nothing had happened to them. Her darling had saved everyone at the expense of himself. He assumed she had been sent to keep him sharp about South Africa. She said that as much as she would love to see his ass harmed, she would not put her daughters and her family at risk for that. He had her tell the rest. The attackers read, to him, as messengers of the elder gods. He thought of the white fire Victor had shown in Nightingale, and of the value of a just man as a point of propaganda, and he did not like how sloppy a plan looked when the destination was hell. Then he looked at her properly. More beautiful than he remembered, and the demonic features more prominent. He asked what had happened to her. She said it was none of his business, and that she was going back, because her husband was somewhere in hell, alone and desperate, and he needed her. He asked if she had been out of hell so long she had forgotten something simple. Time in the hellish dimensions and in heaven passed differently. Biblical hell's dilation changed the deeper you went, because of the concentration of miasma. She shouted for Natalia and ran. His private thought was that the same fact was an opportunity. Hell's time, and hell's miasma, would make the boy stronger.[673]
Alexios came out of a portal with a severe face and reported that they had made a countermeasure to his powers. Vlad already had the report. Alexios thought the plans were going down the drain. Vlad did not. If they could block that power completely, they would already have invaded. They feared the clan too much. The difference between Alexios and his daughter was an ant and an elephant. Asked if he could rescue Victor, Alexios said it was impossible at that moment. Hell was completely closed. Diablo had made sure no one but himself and his demons could enter. Vlad named it. The ruler's authority. South Africa was still happening, with more precautions. He was going to visit a friend who could give answers only that friend had. Alexios asked if he should open a portal to the Limbo prison. Yes. Vlad would return alone. Alexios was to prepare the trip, keep him posted, and keep an eye on Ophis. What had happened in Japan was not going to happen to his daughters. If they left the second progenitor's allied ground, the shadows were to protect them from the shadows. And he was to visit Clan Adrasteia. Vlad wanted more accurate information. He stepped through. Alexios noted, and did not say, that the king's temper was better controlled than it had been, and that a Snow clan lady's visits might be why.[673]
Jeanne exploded at Morgana for forgetting something that basic. Morgana had not been back to hell in years, and she had had more important things in her head than time. Jeanne told her she was impossible. The argument broke on the training in front of them. Nero had incredible physical strength and an abnormal proficiency in a vampire's basic shapeshifting, and a strange energy inside her, very similar to the natural energy world trees used, which strengthened what she already did. Werewolf traits had stayed after the transformation, a residual soul: a sharper smell, an animal sense for danger. Ophis was a tiny monster who learned fast, with a teleportation that had combat in it, a regeneration stronger than a noble vampire child's, and a significant share of Vlad's progenitor blood. The charm in that blood worked on adult men whether she wanted it or not. The touch absorbed memory, and the gloves existed so she would not grow a second personality. A mark on her could teleport her to Victor. He had forbidden the use of it. Jeanne told them she had only been thinking about the training. Then she smacked Morgana and made her listen. This could be an opportunity. The longer he stayed, the closer he came to physical maturity and to the first strength that arrived when a vampire reached five hundred years. Morgana knew that. She also knew hell. It was a horrible place. Jeanne said it was a horrible place for the weak, and that her husband would be feeling like a shark put back in familiar water. Morgana agreed she should calm down, and then screamed that she could not. Even with Roxanne, he was alone in a hostile place.[673]
Warfall, Clan Adrasteia's city, took an invasion it had not seen since it was founded. Hundreds of thousands came in waves. Behemoths, onis, predators, wyverns, minions, and two alphas over them. The defense systems and the warriors were killing more than they lost, and it was still not the sight on the wall that made the knights go quiet. Eight women had gone into a forbidden stretch of the field and were mutilating the charge. Leona, in a hybrid form, wore sharp gauntlets made for close work, threw a behemoth twenty meters tall on strength that should not have been there, gathered white energy in her mouth, and screamed at the worms to die. The beam evaporated behemoths. Violet covered herself in fire, raised a bastard sword, and cut an invisible monster out of the air while she called them sneaky bastards. Sasha, golden-haired, crossed the field in lightning, and the slashes appeared on the bodies after she had already gone past. Ruby spun the spear, slammed the butt into the ground, froze the battlefield, and ordered that everything be destroyed and that no monster come back alive. Siena led with a ridiculous weight of power. Lacus, short, killed with mist, an assassin's weapon. Pepper's face was an innocent angel's, and the fist was not. Eleonor shouted that the big targets were not to approach the city. Centipedes, ogres, and behemoths over twenty meters. Her face went monstrous. She took one by the neck, called them disgusting, and told them they would pay for what they had done to him. Green flame burst out of the hand and left green ash. She ordered the seven of them into the air. They jumped and floated. She clapped, and she called A Thousand Hands of Creation. The earth shook. Thousands of hands of stone and earth and matter rose, caught the monsters, and threw them back smashed. She was fending off hundreds of thousands by herself. Leona called the power ridiculous. Violet agreed, and said it was exhausting. Eleonor's answer was to ask what they were waiting for. The eyes on all of them were blood red. Violet's fire went up like a hurricane and she shouted at the bastards not to run, that she wanted their faces in pain. The Valkyries and Rose, usually the calm ones, were in the same mood. Dorothy reported more of them from the west.[674]
Mizuki came past Rose at a run, oriental, full leather armor, an odachi on her back, and went up over the west wall. Eight talismans glowed in front of her. Storm clouds and a torrential rain existed only in that slice of the field. Lightning electrocuted what it hit. The drops swelled into spheres and flooded the ground. She shouted for Susanoo. Today was the day of the promised war. Take the faith, and in return aid her to kill an army of corruption. She called the Wrath of the Heavens. Eight giants, twenty meters tall, in samurai armor and carrying different weapons, one of them a rifle, came out of the gathered water. One pair of katanas cut through the mass. The rifle fired a beam of water and obliterated a behemoth. A bladed spear took a centipede. She told them to assemble. The odachi was covered in talismans and used as the catalyst, a wizard's wand in [[Abe-no-Seimei]]'s explanation, the transparent old man watching it. She held the magic for over half an hour, and the monsters were not getting back up. A knight called her insane. Dorothy asked if that was an onmyo mage, and said she understood why Alucard liked her. Abe-no-Seimei said Mizuki was special even among onmyo mages. That kind of power was not normal for them. Above it, two alphas, Kal and Ken, sat on a wyvern and watched their weapons die. Ken said the women were dangerous. Kal said their gods' intelligence had named them scions of important clans, and that the human was an anomaly, which was not uncommon in a weaker race and was not an excuse for prejudice. Their gods were powerful. They were not omnipotent. Information mattered. Ken took the lesson.[674]
The policy was tested when Victor encountered additional Demon nobles and armies. His offer remained straightforward: submission or death. Entire Legions began choosing survival once demonstrations of his power made clear that resistance provided no realistic benefit.[675]
[[Shax]] was ten meters tall, a horse's face, an owl's eyes, the hind legs of a horse, the wings of an owl, and the torso of a muscular man with four arms, and he watched a man with long black hair and violet eyes walk toward his capital in full black armor, a smile on his face, a katana in his left hand with a blade too large to be called a katana. The lesser demon who reported it got roared at. The demon king's messenger had already said Pride was coming, and that Pride would take a long time, because he was in the hell of the Egyptian pantheon. The horsemen were not there. The deadly sins were not there. Shax would have bet that Sloth was doing nothing, as usual, and that her power would actually have been useful. The pressure fell on the capital. Fur and hair stood up. He was already at the gate. He held up two fingers and told the demons he had only two things to say. Kneel in submission, or die. They had five seconds. He counted them down. At three, Shax started to order a battle and was cut off by two. By two, more than sixty percent were already kneeling, because Vine's legions were dead and the story had traveled. At zero he drew Junketsu and disappeared on a trail of lightning. From inside the territory it was streaks of lightning and then, three seconds later, he was back and the blade was sheathed. Blood exploded across the ground. Shax was minced meat. More than forty thousand demons and a demonic duke, in three seconds, at a speed being compared to messenger gods. He told the living to arise and follow him. From that moment they were his legion, and they obeyed only him. Sixty thousand demons ran, flew and jumped after him. The incident put him among the fastest beings alive, a competitor to Natashia Fulger, and the ones who saw it started calling him the fastest man alive.[676]
Fifteen days later by the demon world's count, [[Baal]] put the recording in front of Diablo. The king was irritated. The report was a march from territory to territory, ranks forty through forty-four dead except Vepar, rank forty-two, who had sided with Alucard, and a percentage of every force taken. The legion sat around five hundred thousand, with a margin for the way time disagreed with itself. Vine, the former forty-fifth, was engaged with ranks forty-six through sixty and not making the progress Baal wanted, and after the evolution he could not find her at all. Hiding from his senses was a privilege of the king of pillars. Diablo had underestimated the invader and closed hell so the influence could not be chipped at from outside. His elites, ranks one through twenty, were in the mortal world. The sins were scattered. The horsemen's status was not in his hand. He had sent for Pride and was told the return would take too long, so he would send War and Death. Baal asked if that was wise, with the angelic war able to break at any moment, and with Alucard stronger than he had been when he came for the heirs. Diablo said that was why those two. The brothers could handle the snag. Baal begged, with respect, to send all four. The prediction he had was a thirty percent chance of Alucard losing if all four brothers went. Diablo allowed it, and he added rank sixty-one. [[Zagan]] was in hell. He was to help. The quest was to be completed and Alucard killed. Diablo would handle the glorified pigeons himself. The spy had not made it into them. The Inquisition had gotten strict. An informant had [[Gabriel]]'s next mission, and Diablo called it an opportunity he intended to exploit. Lilith watched him with lifeless eyes that were full of hatred, and he felt the look, thought about the will that was still in her, considered her as a piece against Victor, and decided she was not a complete puppet and would not be sent. He went to the lab. [[Asmodeus]] was in there, darkened, working on a guest's gift.[676]
Outside Hell, the history of the Amazons and the destruction brought against them became clearer. Their [[Meya Neyku|Queen Meya Neyku]] and surviving warriors had been forced into increasingly desperate battles as factions connected to the larger conspiracy attempted to eliminate or exploit another isolated supernatural civilization.[677][678][679]
Meya Neyku sat a golden throne in a white dress with gold accents, a hundred and ninety centimeters, emerald eyes, long black hair in braids, and she watched her people laugh and thought her mother would have been proud. The bangs started like a small earthquake. Dishes broke. The servant got out that demons were invading, and the explosion answered before the queen finished the question. The one in front of them was ten meters tall, red-skinned, four-armed, the body tainted with the putrid miasma of the deepest hell. She ordered the Amazons to prepare. High-level demons killed them in carnage, some of it sacrifice and some of it pointless, and the goal was not the annihilation of the city. Only Meya could fight that demon. The blessings of the other goddesses were still on her. Aphrodite's blessing was gone, and with it the flawless beauty and the sense for emotion. The artifacts [[Hephaestus]] had made could still be used by the queen's bloodline. She went out alone, believing the set would be enough. It was not. She ended on the ground, bleeding. He called her foolish. Their lord had foreseen it. The current generation was not used to war. They had grown soft. Then he called her the daughter of a rape, and he grinned. A weak human had been captured by the queen when it was time to conceive, used until a girl was born, and discarded with the male children once he had served. Meya told him not to call her that. She was Queen Meya Neyku. He asked when it would be her turn to do what her mother had done. She roared at him to shut up. He enjoyed the irony. Women who had been saved from being victims had become the aggressors and done the same. She got the sword up on willpower and leapt, and she was beaten again, coughing blood, emerald eyes still glaring. He did not care what her people did, and he did not care that they were hypocrites. Teasing her was entertainment.[680]
A lesser demon tore the armor off her. She warned him that touching it would make him vanish. It did not. The greater demon explained that the artifacts she was proud of were toys Hephaestus had made for mortals, and that unlike a divine artifact the armor lacked durability. Dense miasma had already weakened it without her knowing. Armor, sword and shield were handed over. There was a secret only the first queen had known, and had not wanted passed on. A beam of red energy out of his four red eyes found the bloodline rune. Hephaestus had been clever. Adding soul essence would make the rune recognize him instead of her. The god of forges had not done a half-finished thing. The armor absorbed energy and transformed it according to the user's will. It repaired in a blinding red glow, went completely black, red runes on it, miasma oozing from the edges, and it grew. She survived the intensification because of [[Hestia]]'s blessing of the sacred fire. A giant sword floated. He said perfect. She understood that the set had been the target from the beginning, and she asked how he knew that much about the race, down to the name. He wanted Callisto's armor, a masterpiece made by a god for a mortal, able to change with the energy put into it. He had no interest in her little race. He was glad they did not call themselves human, because they were not. What they did was, to him, splendid. Hell already had a separate place for the men and women who committed those acts. Those demons were usually insignificant. Her bloodline would have made good commanders of that specific hell, and his king would have been pleased. Lesser demons laughed and moved on her. She begged them not to, and she begged to be killed instead. She had only been queen a short time, and she did not deserve to be taken like that. He stopped them with a raised hand and mocked a proud queen for crying. He was a demon, a creature of sin, and even he was not that hypocritical. He asked why she feared the same act her people had treated as culture for hundreds of years. She did not say the thought out loud. It had never been sacred to her. It had been a way to propagate the kind. Lightning flashed, and [[Scathach Elderblood Scarlett|Scathach Scarlett]] was there with Natashia and the Fulger daughter.[680]
Nike stared at corpses of demons and of women and asked how many Amazons had died. Hestia called it a genocide. The last number she had was around fifty thousand, and that had been years ago. Nike did the logistics out loud. Even with the gods' support they could not have ruled two hundred thousand. Food and supply for a community that size would not have held. The refuge was an average city, built for sixty to eighty thousand. The Amazons were a warrior race, superhuman in conditioning, living up to two hundred years and aging slowly while they stayed at their peak. Hestia said a high-level demon had been behind it. Nike pointed at the corpses and said those were low-level. Hestia did not understand the losses, then. Nike, as the goddess of victory, did. A war was not decided by who was stronger. Villagers beat armed soldiers if they knew what they were doing and had a competent leader. The demon leading this had been competent. They left the count and went to help whoever could still be helped. Scathach and the other two could handle the demon.[681]
Nyx had the others behind a veil of night. [[Artemis]], [[Athena]] and [[Hera]] had arrived after Meya's defeat, and Artemis was screaming to be let out so she could kill them. Nyx told her to change the tone or be taught what respect meant. Athena wanted the reason. Nyx had forgotten they did not see the world the way she did. She told them to close their eyes, sent a dark energy into them, and let them open on her sight. White beings with holes for eyes wandered, the souls of the dead Amazons. Dark beings flew toward deep space, demons returning to hell. The atmosphere was an oppressive dark of negative feeling. Hera asked if she saw this all the time. Yes. It was her authority. Nothing could be hidden from the mother of concealment if she wanted to know it. She could not interact with that part of the world. Specific beings could. Her son [[Thanatos]]. The rulers of hell. A mortal species, the progenitors of vampires. She pointed, and they saw hundreds of thousands of magic circles, each of them supported by smaller circles. A variation of Evie Moriarty's strategic magic, leaking a cursed miasma that felt like the lowest levels of hell. Hera said magic was not supposed to be that evil. It was neutral and passive, not raging like miasma. Nyx thought the demon who had invaded had made it. Artemis said a demon should not be able to use magic. Nyx reminded her that the gods had said the same thing when a group of humans started using a special energy and doing feats like the gods. Times changed. Talented people were born. Her eyes gleamed like a starry night. She took the sight back. If they interfered with him directly, he would not mind using that spell and locking the dimension down. She sent them to the ground to help the people who carried their blessings, and she went to see the demon and the vampires herself. Artemis went screaming.[681]
Nyx was hidden when the demon smiled at Scathach and said he had thought she would not recognize him. He had changed quite a bit. Her grip tightened on the spear. She understood the lesson he had been teaching the girl. Even after turning this way, he still deeply hated the act her people committed as a culture. He said those who enjoyed that heinous act, men or women, had to burn in hell forever, and he looked at Meya with disdain. Normally he would have swept the filth off the land. Scathach asked why, then, he had allowed a lesser demon to exploit her. He called it the fun. The sinner had to experience the sin committed on the victim. She smirked and said he spoke like a true demon. He had made a point, when he became this, of taking the command of the hell responsible for sinners who committed those acts.[681]
The demon was [[Merlin]], and he looked at Meya as if her existence were a pile of garbage. Normally he would have swept the filth off the land. He had needed to stick to the plan, and now that Scathach was here with the other goddesses it was impossible to kill the queen. He said Yama must be pleased with her efforts, and then he corrected himself. The former Yama would have been. The current one was a sadistic brat, and still useful. Scathach heard more in the words than he was bothering to hide, and she was annoyed. He had not changed. He had gotten worse. Becoming a demon had been his plan. He was a rare specimen, the only male human in history who could use magic, an art that was supposed to belong to women and to the witch queen. She would have forgotten him if the annoying voice had not come back. He felt the other goddesses and said his body was shaking with agony at their divine power, an annoying weakness, and that the armor meant he would not have to worry about it in the future. Scathach told Agnes don't. Agnes asked if they were letting him go. She was keeping Agnes out of a trap. Nothing with that bastard was simple. He was standing in front of Natashia, a speed he could not react to, as if she were a minor annoyance. He knew the goddesses were there, including one whose existence was his weakness, and he was composed. The old man only looked like that when the plan was intact. He called it an honor to be treated with that much caution by the strongest female vampire. She did not want to remember how annoying he was. He told her not to be like that. He respected Arthur's sword teacher. Only she had made that man grow a pair and fulfill his destiny, which Merlin himself could never have done. She was exhausted. He did not admit faults in public except once, and that once had been to prove he was the real thing. She still did not know what had happened to turn him into a demon out of a completely different mythology.[682]
He asked an old acquaintance for a favor. Kill that filth. Looking at her, and at the history of these people, brought bad memories back. Scathach went solemn. Even as a demon, he still remembered her. She said it was impossible. The queen was still useful. He had known she would say that.
