If he knew anyone who could change a culture's ingrained thinking by force, it was her. She had always been very convincing. She told him to go away, and to remove the magic traps, and she slammed the spear into the ground. Strange runes glowed on it. A magic circle appeared at the impact and was destroyed. She asked how he could use magic as a demon. He laughed, and several red circles rose, each of them different from ordinary human magic. He had coined the term. Demon magic. He could not use his old energy. He could do something similar with the miasma of hell and the demonic energy in his body. She told him not to say he had done it again. He laughed that it was not difficult. Energy was energy. Good or bad depended on the user's will. Every energy had an implicit rule, and without the rules you could not progress. This demonic energy lacked the subtlety he was used to. Beggars could not be choosers. Natashia and Agnes stared at him as if he had grown another head. Scathach was glad the genius had not been killed by the transformation. A new branch of magic, from the old man. She also wondered how he knew about their group, if she and Ruby had been hiding it as well as they thought. He called himself a hardworking genius. A dark portal opened behind him. She did not believe the modesty. He said he would see her in the future, and he warned her that if he saw any of these free Amazons out in the world he would kill them as brutally as possible. She stopped him with his name. How had he found out about them. On behalf of their ancient friendship, he would tell her. He held up four fingers. First, Nyx, primordial goddess of night and mother of concealment. Nothing could be hidden from her unless a being of the same rank or greater protected the group from her interest. Nyx, unheard, snarled at him not to give spoilers and not to put her name in the game. Second, the primordial entities that maintained balance. They were not interested in the matters of ordinary beings unless they had to be. Their only concern was keeping everything in its place.[682]
Inside Hell, Victor's campaign escalated against increasingly important Demon rulers. The old assumption that the Keys of Solomon possessed unquestionable authority within their own territories began collapsing when an outsider could defeat their armies and force surviving troops to kneel.[683][684][685]
The situation produced a simple lesson repeated throughout the volume: no title protected a ruler whose people no longer believed they could enforce it. A King without strength, loyalty or authority was merely someone using a title while waiting for another person to take the throne.[683][684][685]
Outside the realm, Victor's Vampire wives and Divine allies nearly turned their fear and frustration against one another while attempting to determine how he would be recovered. The confrontation demonstrated how unstable a coalition of immensely possessive women could become when the person connecting them was suddenly removed.[686]

##### Warriors in Hell
Chapters 662–672
The scattered battles outside Hell continued, but Victor's greatest confrontation inside the realm began when [[Diablo]]'s Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse were finally brought against him. The encounter was qualitatively different from fighting ordinary Demon Legions. These Beings had served as some of Diablo's greatest weapons and possessed powers specifically created for apocalyptic warfare.[687]
He was on the ice throne when the four of them came, and the demons around the throne were afraid of them because they were Diablo's executioners. Death rode a black horse with green flames, black armor, two scythes that made one giant scythe, and he thought the man on the throne was arrogant and did not say it. War rode a red horse wrapped in hellfire, black armor with red shades, a massive greatsword, and he said they had met again. He was War. That was natural. He had felt the desire to fight without looking. Famine rode a frail horse with blue fire in its eyes, a cloak, a plain slashing spear, and he had expected shaking and hiding, not this. Pestilence rode a pale horse covered in worms, corrupted armor, white flames, disease given a saddle. Victor's pressure went up as a pillar of red power. Gravity multiplied. The air suffocated. Death, Pestilence and Famine came off their horses. War stayed up on will and armed the greatsword with hellfire. Death took the scythes. Pestilence took a whip. Famine took a glaive. [[Junketsu]] was in Victor's hand. He asked who he was supposed to hide from. Them? Why tremble? Come on, horsemen. Let's dance. The fight itself had not started when the chapter closed.[687]
Victor fought Famine, Pestilence and Death while continuously adapting to abilities designed to weaken, corrupt and permanently destroy their targets. Defeating Higher-Order Demons also accelerated the evolution of Victor's Soul and the predatory characteristics inherited from his Progenitor nature.[687][688][689]
War leapt, and Junketsu crossed the greatsword in the air. Both of them came off that clash smiling at a strength that was being used properly. Death came in from the side on a scythe covered in dark miasma and missed the neck. Victor kicked him clear, used the same motion to shove War off, landed, sheathed the odachi, and took an iai stance. Four against one was not enough. Lightning covered him. He was gone and back inside a second, and all four horsemen were cut deep. Pestilence had lost an arm. The armor on War and Death had stopped most of the damage. War said armor made by the best blacksmiths in hell was not breached so easily, and a sonic boom put him in front of Victor with the greatsword already coming down. Junketsu stopped it, and blood climbed the blade. The two of them went up trading blows that sounded like thunder.[690]
Death joined his scythes into one giant scythe and came in with it. War's greatsword took the flames of hell. Victor parried upward, opened the guard, and put a sphere of compressed blood through the armor at the chest. It did not reach the flesh. War touched the hole and said again that this was not armor broken so easily, and the damage closed on the miasma of hell. Time slowed around Victor. A hand covered in the power of blood put a punch through Death's face, and the body made a cobweb crater. A small cut was on Victor's cheek, and the hood still showed only darkness and a smug look. The miasma on the scythe could be lengthened and shortened. He told Death not to get smug, went behind him, and lengthened the odachi through a horizontal cut. He could do that too. The gash was gigantic. Famine's glaive came in at a thunderous speed. Victor knew the spear from [[Scathach]]. Famine asked if he was feeling hungry. The next connection was bloodlust and a hunger like thousands of years without feeding. Hunger, Famine said, was one of the most horrible ways to die, and the glaive took on a dark blue hue. The feeling was psychological. The body was not actually empty. Roxanne was there.[690]
War took him from behind, and Famine and Death joined it. Victor laughed in the middle of it. Pestilence set the arm back on, felt that the weapon carried an anti-soul property, and stopped playing. The whip spun up a dark orange wind, and he called Disease Field. Worms came out of the soil. The air went toxic. He said no being, mortal or god, escaped disease, and a whip-mark landed on the armor. Lightning would not answer when Victor reached for it. The power was still in him. He could not use it. Famine spun the glaive into the ground and told him few beings escaped the brothers, and that he would not have that honor. The hunger dropped into a bottomless pit. The whip took his legs and put him on his knees. Greatsword and giant scythe came in together.[690]
The blades stopped in hands of pure ice. Famine's glaive stopped in his teeth. [[Vine]], watching, asked if the most fearsome weapons in hell could be restrained that easily. Vepar said not even the demon king would touch a horseman's weapon without permission. Each one held a small part of its wielder's soul, they were semi-sentient, and the blade carried the power itself: the hellfire of War, the dark miasma of Death, the hunger of Famine, and the disease of Pestilence. Victor's face went to a bottomless darkness, a smile full of sharp teeth, and blood-red eyes. He had learned the four brothers' fighting techniques. He hauled Death and War in, slammed their heads together, punched the air out of War, and kicked Death away. The whip yanked Pestilence onto an ice gauntlet that caught fire. Famine was the only one without armor. Junketsu went through his heart. Victor spat the glaive out and said that stopping his speed did not stop him. Lightning was one aspect. He did not rely on it completely. What he named after that was progenitor blood.[690]
Helena could not make the sight settle. A progenitor who looked to her like a male [[Aphrodite]] had recognized her as Helena and not as a Gremory, and he was treating the horsemen of the apocalypse like children. One of them was already permanently dead. Victor fought the other three with Famine's glaive, and the teamwork they still had did not put a scratch on his armor. Death's scythe rang off the weapon and Death went back under the strength. He shouted that this way of using the glaive was clearly their brother's, and demanded to know what Victor had done. Victor asked the horsemen what he was, and he answered it. He was a progenitor. The being who decided the worth of souls was standing in front of them. Death asked if Famine's existence had been completely absorbed. Victor said that existence had not been worth much. He had put an average value on the soul, and what came with it was the martial art and the authority. Then he asked if they had ever been hungry. They could not turn that authority off. Death went down first with a hand on his stomach, then War, then Pestilence. Junketsu went through Death's heart while Victor held him, and he asked Death whether he could be afraid of his own death. The body shook.[691]
War came in covered in hellfire. Pestilence followed, and a wall of ice stopped them. War broke through it. Death was already gone, and the glaive was feeding on the scythes left on the ground. Victor told them they had taken too long. His skin went pale as a dead man's, and the long black hair let out dark miasma. Junketsu split into two small scythes and joined again as a larger black scythe, red in the details, the blade covered in miasma. He spun it as if he had always used it. Pestilence said Death too, and roared that he would make Victor pay. Victor was already looking past them. A shadow grew, a horse neighed, and Death's horse came out bigger and more muscular, black as darkness, with green-tinted flaming eyes, tail and hooves. Victor told Despair to play around, and that he would call when he was needed. The horse walked over to Vine, Helena and Vepar. Vepar said the lord had won, alone, against the four horsemen. Helena told them it was early. The fight was not over, and counting a victory before it was finished was how powerful demons lost.[691]
War told him he was rushing. Victor told him to be silent, and that he would kill him. The scythe's handle split in his hands and he fought War with it until the ground was breaking and War was still getting stronger. The armor went more demonic. Steam left the mouth. Long flaming horns, a tail, sharp claws, a demonic greatsword. The pressure and the heat were flaming hell for everyone except Victor. He stepped back, snapped his neck into place, set the larger scythe on his shoulder, and called it a worthy challenger. A blue pillar went up and the air went cold. He took the vampire count form of Clan Scarlett. The weapon went back to a glaive with ice and blood on the blade. On a stage where the strong fought, the weak had no right to interfere. He was in front of Pestilence before the word finished, and Absolute Zero went through the heart and left an ice sculpture covered in blood. He took the blood. Junketsu ate the whip and the authority. Pestilence's disease worked from what a body already knew. It was poisonous and slow, a support that got worse the longer a fight was allowed to last. Roxanne's energy held Victor's body at its best, so it did not take. He turned to War.[691]
War warped in screaming. Victor kicked him off, and the glaive became Junketsu's katana, an oversized blade. Fire and ice tore the ground, and the fight left it for the sky. Hellfire breath came out of War like a dragon's. Ice wings opened behind Victor, and thousands of ice weapons formed in front of them. He told them to go. They hit, and the ice melted down into magma. They met again in the air, and the boom evaporated the battleground and changed the ground under it. War roared, sprouted wings, and went further into the demonic shape. Victor laughed and told him they would fight, bleed, and be cut, and to dance more. The ice wings dissolved into pure water and took the fire for a moment. A slash put War into the ground. He came up out of the magma. Victor pointed, and he called [[Cocytus]].[691]
The final opponent was War. Unlike many enemies Victor had encountered, War did not hide behind political authority, tricks or overwhelming armies while refusing direct confrontation. He genuinely enjoyed battle and possessed the mentality of a warrior.[692]
Inside, Roxanne was already angry about the value put on filthy souls for the sake of techniques and authority, and about the tax that put on his soul. Alter stood with half of his body gone into complete darkness, the mark of acting as a progenitor, and he was smug about it. They had never been normal in the way Vlad was. A progenitor walked his own path, and because of Roxanne they could aim at being the strongest one. Victor had gone into the inherent power over souls and taken the authority, the battle, and the memories, and he had not given the horsemen the highest value he had once given Adonis. There was no second personality waiting in this. Their powers were a minor authority, the remnants of a demigod's divinity. The sparks of his own divinity had grown to the size of a football, a flame-like golden bridle that had not taken a finished form, and they pushed what he already carried. A demon's soul was only the bad part. Balance was what an ascension and a negative divinity required. Alter's limit was plain. Do not do this to a true deity, and do not do it to a demigod whose aspect was positive. Too much of it was a second personality, a damaged soul, death, and someone else's memories living in the head. Vlad had never used the power this far, because he had not had the protection that made it survivable. Roxanne heard Cocytus from outside, and more of her power was pulled into the fight. Alter said he would watch, and that he would step in if he had to.[692]
Outside, Vine, Vepar, Helena and hundreds of thousands of demons watched the water. Cocytus remade that stretch of hell to his will. Jets erupted out of the ground, the sky rained, and there was enough water to flood a city in seconds. Vine had ordered the demons not to abandon one another. Vepar knew the technique. It was [[Sitri]]'s water, the same element that had flooded a capital and fed demons to a pillar. Helena flew on succubus wings with her wet hair pulled back, and her senses put War and Victor under the water rather than hidden. Vine wanted them anywhere but there, so the three of them could set an ambush later. Vepar thought the lord's victory was a matter of time, and he also thought War had not hit his limit. The ground shook like an earthquake. A jet threw both of them back into the air. The fight had made a sea larger than the lake it had started from. They dropped. Victor stood in the water with his hands open to the rain and called it a satisfying fight, the kind that looked for a limit. War grunted and stayed sane inside the shape. The anger and the hatred were part of him, taken out of hell's hottest places along with the flames. He understood that his brothers' deaths were the rule of the place. Hell favored the strong. The mistake had been not opening with everything.[692]
He listened to rain that should not have existed in the midlands, a sea made by one person, against the memory of the small lake Sitri had made out of a city. What he saw when he opened his eyes was Victor back in his base form. The long black hair moved in the wind, the eyes were blood red, the armor was destroyed down to the bottom of it, and the muscular body showed through ripped cloth. War asked what the path was. He could smell war on him, in the demons already kneeling and in the trail of what had been destroyed. Victor said conquest. He would go down to the deepest hell, take the throne, and every demon would kneel or be erased. War called that a tyrant's road, and the correct one for ruling demons. They respected strength. [[Lucifer]] had been respected and feared. Diablo was feared as evil. This one would be respected the way Lucifer had been and feared the way Diablo was, and the charisma would turn the fear into admiration. Asked if he meant to fight all the billions of demons in hell, Victor said that if they stood in the way, so be it. He dropped his weight and took Junketsu's hilt in both hands. War held the greatsword behind him, chest open, ready for any angle. The rain stopped. The deep lake remained. Female demons in the crowd felt the heat of the power they were watching. A drop fell. The two of them vanished and met over the middle of the lake, and the blades crossed.[692]
Victor was ahead in reaction and in the body, and the attacks reached the soul. War was not far behind him. He was an ancient demon, the strongest of the horsemen, and the true form carried more power than the gap suggested. He lost the exchange of reactions, coughed blood from a cut across the chest, and felt the skin freeze and then thaw on his own heat. Fighting something above him made him stronger, faster, and cleaner in the art. He did not care that the opponent was superior. The heartbeat came up. The flames fed the body, the soul and the heart. The other half arrived. A seed of divinity opened, and he lit up like a demon god of war. Victor smiled at an opponent whose blows were getting heavier and more accurate, took a cut across his own chest, and felt his existence being defined while Roxanne's power fed the change. He could tell the soul in front of him was nearing its end and that the real potential was what was waking up. He hit the greatsword, kicked War clear, and shouted his name. Do not avert your eyes. Lightning covered him. Do not blink. Junketsu took ice, and then blood made it sharper, and two wings of blood came off his back. All of the attention. If not, you will die. The explosion took them.[692]
Their fight became one of the rare occasions on which Victor developed sincere respect for an enemy during combat. War continued pushing himself after his brothers fell, awakening even greater power rather than abandoning the confrontation when victory became unlikely.[692][693]
Victor ultimately defeated him, but refused to kill him. War had earned something Victor rarely granted to opponents: respect. Instead of devouring the Horseman's Soul as he had done to other Higher Demons, Victor allowed War's mount to carry its critically wounded master away so that he could recover.[693]
War told him he was the strongest challenge of a long existence, and that the weight of his own recklessness was punishing the body, and that he feared he would fall, and that he refused to fall now. He had not done his best yet. He was in an ascended state, hellfire and the greatsword, and hell was nourishing him as a demon god of war, flames of hell under the recklessness, regeneration holding him up. Victor had all the bloodlines at full draw, lightning, fire, ice, water, blood and soul. He called it splendid. Out of respect for that determination he would answer in kind. When it was over he did not take the soul. He put the body on the hellfire horse and let the horse carry it away. His own mount was Despair. Vine, Vepar and Helena watched. Lesser demons were still coming. Hell kept the birthplace, and the body, and he let that stand.[693]
Hell itself protected War's birthplace after the battle, preventing Victor from simply changing his mind and finishing the defeated warrior. Victor accepted the result rather than treating the realm's intervention as an insult.[693]
There was nevertheless no opportunity for genuine rest. The conquest continued, while Victor's followers outside Hell supported one another and maintained operations throughout the larger war.[694][695]
Diablo did not believe the report until he had sat with it. Pestilence, Death and Famine were dead and absorbed, and the strange weapon had eaten their weapons with them. War had become a demon god, and the clash that beat him had left a crater, clouds of miasma and red lightning still standing in hell. Diablo, Lilith and Lucifer had never been able to claim a mark like that. Hell itself was held up by the negative counterpart of Earth's world tree, a primordial, and by the Judges of the Abyss. He asked [[Baal]] how long it had been since a demon god was born. Baal said it had never happened since Lilith. Since the Age of Genesis, neither Lucifer nor Diablo had made one. War had, by fighting Alucard. Baal had told the horsemen to be wary. He had not expected the strength. People kept thinking they already knew Victor's level, and an irregular who broke common sense did not stay inside that estimate.[696]
Diablo asked where War's body was. Baal said it was in the part of hell where sinners burned in hellfire for eternity, War's old home, and that the place was closed. Nobody could enter, and the demons inside it could not be reached. Diablo's tail twitched, and he said hell was protecting the body. Hell had a will, the way every hell and every heavenly plane did, and the ruler was the true king, the one who judged sinners. Baal asked if his king was not that ruler. Diablo said that since Lucifer left, there had not been one. He and Baal had been doing the work passively through the Key to Hell, an item in the same class as the Helm of [[Hades]], a connection to the ruler rather than the title itself. Even after Lilith was beaten and the keys were gathered, he had not fully become the ruler, because his aims were larger than the throne. He had set Lilith in the role for a time so the Judges of the Abyss would not interfere. She had not passed the trial. She was a cog. The deal with the judges had been billions of souls in exchange for five years, cut down to one year by a favor, and inside that window he could take innocent souls as fuel for his demons against the Balance so long as he did not overdo it and some souls were still allowed to pass on their own.[696]
The rest of the map had already moved. Hades had foreseen no harm to himself, but [[Persephone]] had taken the title of ruler of the Greek hell and was restoring the [[Greek Underworld|Underworld]], so that influence was gone. In the north, Hela had destroyed the [[Bifrost]], and she had done it with one of [[Odin]]'s most feared dragons, the dragon that gnaws at the roots of [[Yggdrasil]]. An elder beast of the end did not need to be standing on a thing to destroy it. The intent was enough. She was [[Loki]]'s daughter, and it was not hard to see the two of them choosing that. With the Bifrost shut, the other roads ran through branches of the world tree and woke the tree's ego. Ratatoskr was greedy and might have been bargained with once. He had stopped walking the paths into other pantheons after the Greeks and the Egyptians used him, and he had stayed wary of outsiders. The Greek pantheon was closed by Hades being unpredictable. The Norse pantheon was closed by Hela. The Shinto pantheon was already fighting its own hell, and [[Amaterasu]] had shown again why she sat as a god-king on the same rank as Ra among sun deities. The Hindu side would resolve while [[Shiva]] was there. In the meantime Yama had put his hell on Diablo's side. Of the allies still standing, Diablo counted the ancient Chinese pantheon and its empty throne, [[Enma]], the Buddhist hell king, and Yama. He wanted the Greeks, the Norse and Egypt, and Egypt had picked a childish fight with his brother and been put down for it. An annoying insect was loose in his hell because a plan had failed.[696]
He could not go back. The angels would see the opening and hit the work he still had with Michael and [[Gabriel]]. Yama was in South Africa making trouble, and the vampire progenitor was going there to meet him. Enma was restructuring his own hell. Diablo told Baal to call every Deadly Sin off the work they were on and bring them back to support him. On Alucard, the count was ugly. Only Wrath, Pride, [[Agares]] or Baal could have fought War as an equal, and once War became a demon god that list fell to Baal and Agares. That put Alucard at Diablo's own level, or above it, because of what a progenitor was. Baal agreed. Diablo said he would not underestimate him again. Sending the dragon would only be sending food. So they would ignore him, for now. The demons still in hell were the weak ones, and the strongest were on Earth with the king. He could deal with the conqueror when the Earth's plan was finished. He had already considered that Victor would strengthen Vine and Vepar, and he still did not think that would be enough. He would not spend a stroke on the people tied to Victor either. Vlad was loose, [[Nightingale]] was full of divine energy, and Scathach's tie to Alucard was one of the reasons. His thought broke off on the elder gods.[696]
Scathach came back through a portal and said they were back. Ruby saw the guests. The woman with her was [[Meya Neyku]], the current queen of the Amazons, and she looked like a deer in headlights under the women already in the room: Violet, Agnes, Leona, Natashia, Siena, Pepper, Lacus, [[Hestia]], Nike, Aphrodite, [[Rhea]], Mizuki, Morgana and Sasha, with Ruby. Agnes asked Violet for news of Victor. There was none. Agnes cursed the people who had dared it, and Leona watched Violet's mother react like her daughter. Leona assumed the Amazons had been simple with that lineup. Natashia said there had been problems. Scathach said the world was bigger than Leona thought, and that [[Merlin]] had been there in all his demonic glory. The room went awkward, because Merlin was supposed to be dead. Siena said so. Scathach said the old man had turned into a demon out of an entirely different pantheon. Pepper could not square it with the mage who had taught Arthur. Scathach was annoyed at the fame. She had trained Arthur, and she had trained that bag of bones sometimes, and he was just a little boy next to that. She also corrected the room on magic. Merlin could use it. He was the only known man who could, aside from Victor. Victor had been blessed by Albedo Moriarty. Merlin had not needed outside help. Lacus and Pepper hid behind Siena when they tried to explain that it was hard to imagine their own mother as someone legendary. Natashia said she sometimes forgot Scathach was the strongest female vampire, except when the ridiculous fights with Victor reminded her. Agnes said she had been more approachable since he arrived. Aphrodite agreed that sex fixed things, and she would know. Scathach's eyes went blood red. Natashia hugged Sasha and smiled like a cat about a woman who had nearly blown up the Amazons and clearly needed to relax.[697]
Meya looked like a scared cat, which Violet thought was a strange face for a queen. Natashia said Scathach had happened. Hestia said the elder Amazon women had been killed in a public execution, and that everyone who went against the word had been beaten into oblivion. Nike said the city had been painted in blood. Aphrodite and Rhea turned on Hestia, because that was not the goddess they knew, and the look on her face was enough. Agnes told it, since Hestia would not. The elder Amazons had used the sons of the Amazons as slave labor from the time they were young. When those sons were old enough, their seed was taken by force, they were used until exhaustion, and then they were discarded. The next generation of sons was given the same fate, and the women called themselves proud Amazons. Meya squealed that she had not known. She had only just become queen. The elders held the prestige, and the tradition ran back to the first Amazon. Her mother had told her that males were put back where they belonged, and she had thought that meant outside the realm, not in that hole. Ruby asked how a queen never wondered where the men were, given that a birth was more likely to be male than not. Scathach said that was why the elders who knew had died, and that she would have killed the mother too if the woman had still been alive. Mizuki wanted to know that every person responsible was dead, and how. Scathach had used four horses, one limb to each, and called it dismemberment. Natashia had taken others with lightning. Agnes had incinerated an elder herself. The disgust in the room did not need the rest of the sentence.[697]
Elsewhere, [[Vlad III Tepes|Vlad Tepes]] confronted Yama, another ruler associated with the Hells of a major Pantheon. Their battle placed two ancient monarchs against one another and demonstrated that the Demonic War had escalated far beyond Diablo's original forces.[698]
The city was burning, and the demons in it were looking at one golden-haired man in an ordinary suit. Yama sat on a golden throne with three generals behind him, and he named Vlad Dracul Tepes, first progenitor, king of vampires, as if he had not expected the visit. Vlad said Yama, king of hell, had changed since the last time he had heard of him. Yama said of course he had. He was not the same Yama. Vlad felt the old signature still sitting in the soul and asked if this was the old king's son. Yama said wrong. He was the grandson. Vlad's tone went dry about the nature of demons. Yama asked if it was not normal, parents killing children and children killing parents for power, and whether Vlad's own children had been planning the same. Vlad said they had failed. If they could not plan his fall without him knowing, they were not worthy of the throne. Yama laughed and called it the arrogance of the strongest vampire, and he got off the throne. The generals reached for him. He asked, casually, whether he had told them to leave their posts, and they froze and watched Vlad harder. Vlad said he had not expected loyalty like that outside Lilith's army. Yama said he understood good subordinates better than his grandfather had. Dark miasma with a violet hue gathered on his head, and a crown formed. Vlad recognized a ruler's bond, and a strong one. The grandson had taken the complete rulership of that hell.[699]
A ruler's soul was harder to touch than a progenitor's. Something in the order of the Judges of the Abyss and the universal tree required that protection. Vlad still could not tell whether walking out alone was arrogance or confidence. Yama said he had wasted a long time pulling the vampire king out of his hole, and that the least he expected was a little fun. Miasma covered him. He put on full ceremonial robes, red with shades of gold. The skin went to red and dark blue, fangs came out, and the crown of miasma caught fire. Vlad answered in his demonic form with everything he had, and he was glad the younger king had not walked in underestimating him. He was also watching the ground. He had been poisoned before. Then he caught a scent he knew and asked if Yama had known he would come for the vampires. Yama called it a hunch that had been correct, and he told the generals to bring them. [[Magic]] circles, a technology Vlad did not recognize, put the captives on the field.[699]
They were not one people wearing one face. They shared an ancient progenitor bloodline and had grown apart. Some had metal fangs of a make he did not know, slightly pointed ears, pink skin, golden eyes, and soft androgynous faces. Some were a little blue in the skin, blood-red in the eyes, sharper in the face. One group had gray skin, cracks along the legs, beast-like limbs that were not humanoid, and claws of the same metal as the teeth. Another had chocolate skin, blood-red eyes, ordinary fangs, and claws like gauntlets grown out of the arm, and on some of them half the arm or the whole arm had gone monstrous. The most human-looking of them stood out as leaders: a woman with chocolate skin, curly hair, blood-red eyes and a shaman's dress, and a tall muscular man in masculine clothes. The man, Bomani, was tired when he spoke to Vlad. They had been captured. Someone in the village had been a spy, and the protection had been found from an entrance they had not known. Vlad asked what the point was, if the whole display existed only so Yama could fight him. His golden hair went dark. The body became pure darkness with shades of red. He stopped disguising the progenitor. His instincts put Yama at a demon king's level, not a weak one. Yama said that was correct. He wanted to know the man his grandfather had respected. His hands went to thick miasma and sharp claws, and he took an open guard. The three generals raised circles of a strange pattern, and a red dome of demonic power closed over the two kings and stretched the space inside it. Vlad recognized the shape. It was the same technology witches used to build an arena, and it was not Victor's work. Defeat me, Yama said, and you get the vampires. Simple. Vlad did not trust simple. This was not a battle maniac in the style of Scathach or Victor. This was a planner. Alexios's message came through: he had not found the vampires, only traces of destruction. The contact itself mattered. Vlad could leave if he had to. They had not used the negation that had shut the Alioth. He made a blood sword and said yes, very simple, a duel that would have pleased the second progenitor and annoyed him at the same time, because it was being fought over a hostage. Fortunately, he said, he was not the second progenitor. The blade and the claws met, and the city rumbled.[699]
He told Yama the hostage tactic would not work. Yama dodged, came back with the claws, and said the incident of the beloved non-daughter already refuted that. Vlad went for the head and told him not to act as if he knew him. They vanished and reappeared faster than the terrain could survive, and neither of them was serious yet. Yama laughed that he knew Vlad better than Vlad thought, backed off, and threw a spear of ominous miasma that caught fire. Vlad turned his head. The spear hit the ground, and the smoke went up like a mushroom.[699]
Vlad eventually revealed the terrifying True Form associated with the First Vampire Progenitor, reminding observers that Victor's rise had not made the ancient ruler of Nightingale weak or irrelevant. Vlad remained one of the oldest and most dangerous individuals participating in the conflict.[700]
The generals holding the dome were already arguing about who put more energy into the shield and who was allowed to give orders, and the third one had to tell them to concentrate while the kings inside hit harder. Vlad's fight did not look orthodox for long. The body became a messy form of black and crimson liquid, and the posture disappeared. Yama called it cowardly for a progenitor. The liquid dissolved, Yama spoke, and the liquid exploded until it occupied the space. Vlad's voice said he was blood, and the blood was him. A progenitor negotiated between life and death and used blood as the chip that bought the soul. That was the essence. Living blood hit Yama with human hands and the heads of monsters, and Yama backed away naming what he was seeing. Souls. Living souls. Hundreds of thousands of them. The blood spread into red clouds, and the sky rained blood. A giant blood-red eye opened in it, full of smaller red eyes, and Vlad asked why the surprise, if Yama claimed to know how he fought. Blood monsters bit an arm. Yama wrapped himself in black miasma against the rain. A blood hand spiked his leg, and he burned it off with the flames of hell and went up. The whole place was the weapon. Vlad said blood was his power and his authority, a means to reach the soul.[701]
The sea swirled, and a body stood up in it. Large wings made of blood, slightly gray skin, eyes with black sclera and irises glowing crimson, slightly pointed ears, and a mouth entirely made of sharp teeth with no hint of lips. The hands were sharp claws. The feet were long blade-like talons. Black spikes with crimson tips protruded from the elbows. Patterns of black tattoos wandered the body as if they were alive. Alexios, watching from outside, had thought he would never see his king's real appearance in his lifetime. Yama dismissed it as a vampire count form and asked if that was supposed to be enough. Vlad and Alexios both said wrong. Vlad raised a hand and thousands of blood spikes formed, and he explained it for the ignorant. The count form was only the most talented vampires recovering an ancient shape from a time before the current gods were alive. What Yama was looking at was the true form. The form of the ancient vampires. The count transformation was not the power boost everyone thought it was. A full count form was one step back toward the original power, the power the strongest monsters of that age had feared enough that they had joined together and crippled the race. One thorn flew with a sonic boom and grazed Yama's cheek. Yama said it was impossible, that a race that old, older than the gods, would never have been allowed to exist. Vlad told him he thought small for a king. There were thousands of worlds. Earth was not that special. Samar and Nightingale were different planets, with their own gods, natives, rules and past. It was not hard to believe vampires had not started on this one. Yama's anger at being compared to human smallness lit his eyes, and he threw a wave of flame upward and burned the blood clouds.[701]
He called Yama's Judgment. Power surged, an immense rift opened in the red space, and four gigantic hands took hold of the crack. Outside the field the generals struggled to hold the circle and shouted that this was supposed to be a test, not this. Merlin arrived in full armor, greeted his disciples, and put his own magic circles under the field. Then he noticed the captured vampires were gone. The lesser demons had been watching the fight. Merlin was not irritated for long. They had not been the important part. The goal had been met when Vlad used the true form. The vampire king was as strong and healthy as ever, and the poison had already been used up in his body. One of the generals admitted he did not read reports. Inside, Vlad drove a river of blood and corpses, and the corpses got up as monsters. A fiery hand came out of the rift and evaporated souls where it hit. Vlad did not know whether that was a ruler's authority. He did not stop. He absorbed an ancient dragon out of what he was holding and sent a dragon's head roaring fire at Yama. Merlin felt his own energy burning too fast for the plan to survive a long fight, thought Yama had overdone it the way Arthur used to, and left the generals with the order to keep the magic stable.[701]
Vlad went on the offensive and was surprised again when a punch evaporated souls. A magic circle turned the dragon fire aside, and Merlin was suddenly there, bowing, pleased to see the king healthy. Vlad said Merlin had become a demon. Merlin called it ironic. He had been called a demon, and then he had become one. He chanted Diabolic Zone, and the space shrouded in demonic magic. A blood spike broke twelve times against the wards. The twelfth broke. The thirteenth held, and then the wards were raised again. Vlad named it a variation of Evie's mana zone. Merlin told him it was not that hard. He turned to Yama and started in on the properties of dragon fire, which the hell king had not known.[701]
Victor's maids continued taking their anger over his imprisonment out on Demonic armies with considerably less restraint than usual.[702]
Haruna looked at the horizon and did not like what she had ordered. Kuroka, unusually quiet, asked if it was really necessary. In front of them a sea of black flames sat against a sea of ordinary flame. Demons floated in the air, alive and thrashing. Stone statues stood where demons had been. Hordes of hungry ghouls ate whatever was still visible and multiplied. Shuten Doji had come as backup and realized he was not needed, and he said he had not thought those girls were that dangerous. Haruna said it was the expected result. They carried Alucard's name. Her own thought was quieter. She hoped Victor was all right, somewhere in hell where nobody could find him.[703]
Kuroka saw it next, and Haruna and Shuten Doji followed her eyes. A giant snake, a basilisk, was crossing the field, and Roberta Alucard stood on its head with her hair moving as if it were alive. The mouth was full of venomous fangs, and the eyes petrified whatever they looked at. Two voices came out of her at once, Roberta and [[Medusa]], sonorous and wrong to listen to, praising the child. Roberta told it to kill everyone who had laid a hand on their husband. The glint in her eyes was not restrained.[703]
Morgana said the result was natural, and she and Mizuki were suddenly beside the youkai watching it. Scathach had trained the maids. Victor had trained them sometimes. Each of them had his blood. With Morgana present, Kaguya no longer had to command. She cut the throat of an elite demon in ancient samurai robes, and the shadows went into the body while it screamed without sound. Her master was nowhere to be found, and she was not beside him. That had never happened. She had never been away from him this long. Her eyes went a vicious red, and she called the demons sneaky creatures and put the whole situation on them. Mizuki said Kaguya was a lot like Violet, however it looked. Morgana asked how anyone would react if someone they loved was taken, and Mizuki's answer was that she would be very angry. Then Morgana noticed Maria. The maid was controlling demon corpses. A ghoul's poison normally woke a demon body into a rage that could not be directed. Maria told her children to fight, kill, die, and come back to life again, to serve her and her beloved master. Morgana called the theory wrong in practice, and she called Maria a special ghoul queen. Nothing tied to Victor was normal. Shuten Doji asked to be reminded not to antagonize them.[703]
Haruna thanked Morgana for lending two men. Morgana said their skills were useful, especially for the lucky human, and that they were Victor's servants, living in Nightingale and paid for hazardous work, not war potential. Haruna said they had been instrumental in finding demons, particularly [[Watanabe Gintoki]], the one they called the Lucky One, who kept coincidentally walking into groups of them. Shuten Doji could not understand a man that lucky and that unlucky at once. Haruna repeated what Alucard had said. Gintoki's power was passive. He was lucky, and everything around him was unlucky, as if he pulled the luck out of the place and kept it. Mizuki named the other irregular. [[Yuuya Shinji]] was a living ghost, and she had never seen a case like it. A three-tailed fox servant then ran up, exhausted, and told Haruna that Amaterasu had come, and that she had come alone. Haruna was not in the habit of putting respect in her voice for gods, god-king or not. Morgana and Mizuki both called that strange.[703]
The war also devastated the [[Shinto Pantheon]]. Amaterasu Elderblood explained that several Gods had been seriously injured and that the systems controlling their Hell and deceased worshippers were beginning to fail because her mother had abandoned important responsibilities. Gods such as [[Tsukuyomi]] had been injured severely enough that recovery could require centuries.[704]
Amaterasu came graceful and angry at her own mother in the same breath. The souls devoted to their gods since ancient times could not pass on, because the current ruler had decided it was not a good idea to keep doing her duties. The gods were busy holding the system up and looking for a successor worthy of the title. The war had hurt the lesser gods. Some had gone into an eternal sleep and would not function again for centuries. Tsukuyomi had fallen to the demons and was one of those cases. Japan could not be protected while that was true, and she did not intend to let Diablo's demons into her territory. Haruna said protecting her own territory was already her job, which was why the demons were being exterminated, and she opened a fan with the word determination written on it in Japanese so that only the fox eyes showed. Amaterasu thanked the youkai and then asked the real question. Once the numbers dropped, they would only come back for another massive wave. She understood they were not in a position to demand help after their history. She had come to hire them.[704]
She opened a fan marked with a golden sun and pointed. A whirlwind of flames put a woman on the field, long black hair, two large raven wings. Haruna named her. [[Yomi-Hime]], commander of the ravens, wife of Tsukuyomi, queen of the tengu. Yomi flinched and corrected it. Ex-wife. Amaterasu said her brother's condition had turned up secrets that upset Lady Yomi, and that the woman was currently single and seeking marriage. She offered her to one of Haruna's generals. Haruna declined. She offered her to the ally instead, a triple alliance, since Yomi was still tied to the gods. Morgana, Jeanne and Haruna all narrowed their eyes. Haruna said she could not speak for that ally, his representative was unavailable, and the alliance would be impossible even if the representative had been standing there. Amaterasu said that in that case she would offer herself. A progenitor of vampires with the greatest potential seen since time immemorial, married to a god queen, would lock the noble vampires, the youkai and the Shinto pantheon together. Three birds with one stone. Yoichi and Genji wanted to be anywhere else. Jeanne held Morgana's hand so she would not attack. Haruna repeated that Clan Alucard was an ally and an equal, not a subordinate, and that the decision belonged to the progenitor or to the wife who handled external dealings. Asked who that was, she said Violet Snow, heiress of the Snow clan. Amaterasu said she would talk to Violet later. Haruna asked why the progenitor interested her. Amaterasu lifted a finger and showed an image of Victor in an arena, a slight smile, and told Haruna to look at it and claim she did not want it. The apology for getting excited came immediately after. Appearance was a large reason. The people's interest was the larger one. She had already decided Haruna herself would marry him, get pregnant, and join the alliance, and she asked, with a god queen's complete lack of tact, whether Haruna liked women or was impotent. Haruna got them back onto the job.[704]
Amaterasu snapped her fingers and eight stacked boxes appeared, advance payment, weapons and supplies made by their best blacksmiths out of deadly materials. Haruna had to interrupt to say the service itself had still not been named. It was protection. The youkai would keep dangerous supernatural entities out of Japan, and Lady Yomi-Hime and her tengu would be lent as scouts. Haruna said they had not taken the job. Amaterasu asked if they were going to refuse, and Haruna's fan cracked. Her grandfather was already examining a katana and saying he had never seen material worked that well. Amaterasu was proud of it. They were not ahead of [[Hephaestus]] or the Norse dwarves, and without those two her pantheon would have been first in crafted items. She tried to leave as if the deal were closed. Haruna said she had not closed it. Her grandfather protested. The fan broke. She said she would accept. Amaterasu told her to settle the details with Lady Yomi, and that another shipment would follow when the deal was done. Asked when the gods would be active again, she said that if all went well they would have a worthy successor for hell in less than a month and could return to protection. She held out a token marked with the kanji for sun.[704]
The Demonic War was therefore no longer merely destroying cities in the Human World. The conflict had begun damaging the spiritual systems responsible for Souls and afterlives across multiple Pantheons.[704]

##### The Throne of Hell
Chapters 673–680
War's defeat effectively removed the final major obstacle preventing Victor from advancing toward the deepest territories of [[Biblical Hell]]. Demon society descended into uncertainty as reports spread concerning the outsider now nicknamed Alucard the Conqueror. Riding Despair and followed by the Demon Legions that had already surrendered, Victor continued moving downward through the realm.[705]
The circumstances favored him enormously. [[Diablo]] and most of Hell's strongest military elites remained trapped by their own invasion strategy in the Human World. Bringing such high-ranking Demons to Earth had required sacrifices and enormous preparation; if Diablo abandoned the campaign and returned to Hell prematurely, much of the plan he had spent years constructing would collapse.[705]
Victor therefore marched through a kingdom whose King could not return home to stop him. Cities, Demon nobles and Legions were offered the same terms used throughout his campaign. Those who surrendered joined the rapidly growing army behind him. Those who resisted became resources.[705]
Even the supposedly indestructible gate separating Hell's deeper regions could not stop his progression. Victor simply cut through an obstacle the Demons regarded as an immutable feature of their realm, further destroying their confidence in the rules they believed governed Hell.[705]
The middle floors were in chaos after the horsemen, and the demons who understood the war had already given him the name. Alucard the Conqueror rode Despair downward, and the horde behind him swelled past hundreds of thousands with every city that chose the obvious result. Pillar demons knelt without a fight. High demons who had been someone else's subordinates and petty demons who had been citizens fell in behind a man whose long black hair was buried in miasma, whose skin was pale as a corpse, whose eyes were an intense blood red, and whose greatsword was covered in pure miasma. Helena and Vepar flew. [[Vine]] ran. The three of them sat at the highest rank under him, put by his power at the level of the top ten pillars, and nobody in the column questioned the order. Informed demons such as [[Zagan]] already knew whose hell it was. Diablo could not come home without spending a country to do it, and if he did it before the human plane was taken, the invasion collapsed around him.[705]
The gate to the lower levels showed in the distance, closed, which the memories Victor had eaten said was not supposed to happen. Vine said the rank-ten pillars must have shut it as a precaution. Vepar asked how they crossed a closed gate. Victor started to say they could demand it, and then he called that useless. The three women flinched at the tone. He raised the greatsword. Black, immaculate miasma exploded off him into the sky, and the demons behind him went from shock into envy. The miasma gathered on the blade until the weapon was pure darkness, and Roxanne's energy surged through it until the stroke was the most destructive thing that hell had on hand. He said a mere gate would not stop him, and he cut vertically. Two seconds of silence, darkness, blindness and deafness, and then the lower gate of hell, an artifact [[Lucifer]] had made to separate the highest demons, split in half. Vine's answer to the wind of miasma in her face was holy fuck. Helena said she knew she should be used to it, because he had done something like it against War, and that it would still take time. Vepar's thought was drier. He had already broken the idea that hell was invulnerable, in that same fight, and now he had broken a gate that hell's own energy was supposed to sustain.[705]
He did not stop riding. Anyone who was not confident they could bear the miasma of the lower levels was told to wait outside. The lesser demons shook, retreated, and stayed in awe of a feat that broke the sense of the place. Vine was to leave someone watching them, and if enough came in, a smaller city could be raised for them. She set an elite on it. Past the gate the city was gigantic, bright and clean, and the miasma sat on the body like a higher gravity, toxic and heavy. The lower levels held most of the land. Hell was a pyramid. The upper floors had less miasma and less ground. The lower floors had more of both, and past the city there was unused country he had not expected even with the memories of the demons he had eaten. At the city gate, hundreds of high demons waited in full armor. A tall, muscular man with a gigantic red and gold axe boomed at him to stop the foolish conquest and go back to where he had entered. Victor's smile unsettled Vine, Vepar and Helena. He rode in until he could see the man's secrets, and he said he could feel the fear. The pressure hit like gravity and the demon went down. Before a demand was made of him, Victor wanted to be looked at by someone who was not about to soil himself. Open the gates and submit, or he would open them, and the man would not be alive to tell it. The vision that answered was a sea of blood and corpses. The scream was enough. He ordered the gates open over his own side's protest, and someone called him Lord [[Amon]]. Vepar asked if he was a descendant. Helena said apparently so. He had Amon's characteristics. Vepar had seen the original once, visiting this city with his father.[705]
Victor's order to the horde was not a sack. Do not destroy anything. Do not kill anything unless it attacks first. If any of them stirred strife because they had marched in as his demons, he would know. They shuddered. Demons followed tyrants. Lucifer had been one. Diablo had been one. This was the same shape of obedience. They were to spread through the city and make a defensive area, and the old pillars were in charge of seeing that not a single soul left. He called Vine, Helena and Vepar with him, looked at the gigantic castle, and said it was time to take the throne of hell. Despair's hooves left fire. In Diablo's absence a new king was already being born, and the old one was going to regret the leaving, even though he had not had a choice about the timing.[705]
Victor eventually reached the Demon King's castle and throne room. The guardians responsible for recognizing legitimate authority sensed something within him that Diablo had lost: the characteristics necessary for Hell itself to acknowledge a ruler.[706]
He came through a gigantic door of hellish metal with long black hair covered in fluttering miasma, Vine, Helena and Vepar behind him, a greatsword in his grip, and green flames lit the throne room because he had entered it. Two keepers stood in front of the gigantic throne, identical, [[Zahal]] gray-skinned and Albu red-skinned. They had existed before Lucifer fell. Their work was to keep hell from destruction and from an inept king, and an inept king meant any king who threatened hell's existence. Their eyes opened red. The pressure dropped the three women back. It did not stop him. Each step made it worse, until his own red power came out and the smile widened and the keepers knelt. Hail the king of hell, master of life and death, the true king. The throne shrank as he approached and turned black and red. He let [[Junketsu]] go and it floated beside the seat. He sat. The castle changed color and design around him, and the knowledge of what a king of hell and a ruler owed came in with the seat. Albu said the throne had accepted him, as expected. Zahal said of course it had. He was the true king. That was proof enough. Diablo was no longer needed. The keys of hell had to go back to their rightful owner.[706]
His eyes opened crimson and he said the authority was incomplete. Albu said it would be complete when the keys were taken back from the former king. The soul flow was wrong because Diablo had refused the ruler's role, and with Lilith neither of them could influence the system while the ruler was outside hell. He put the abyss judges and the universal tree above that mess, primordial things that kept reality, souls and judgment, and rulers and god-kings were subordinates of that order. Zahal added that Diablo had dealt with the judges for billions of souls to delay an intervention. The keepers' loyalty had a reason. Their mother's energy was in his veins. He drew a branch out of Roxanne's power and the demons reacted to the negativity and the life in it. Only a true king could do that. She told him, inside, that the guardians had been made by the earth's world tree, the negative part of it, and that his energy was close enough to her sister's that they thought he was her son, or something like it. He dismissed the branch and they screamed at the loss. He named them elders, guardians and historians, and told them to teach Helena, Vine and Vepar the politics and the former king. They said his wish was their command. Long live the true king of hell.[706]
When Victor approached the throne, the structure changed to accommodate him. Hell accepted the Second Vampire Progenitor as its new sovereign. Diablo sensed the change from Earth and finally understood the magnitude of his mistake. The enemy he deliberately banished into Hell had taken the kingdom upon which Diablo's title and authority depended.[706][707]
[[Baal]] told him the preparations were almost done and that all that remained was the order. Diablo looked at the destroyed city and said the angels were very quiet. He did not like it. They were not falling for the trap. It was as if they were expecting something. He stopped walking. Dark red miasma seeped out of him. The calm cracked. His demonic face distorted into the shape of what they called evil incarnate, and the distorted voice went out over the ruin as a name. Alucard. The presence alone tore the ground apart in pure demonic miasma. Baal jumped back with a cold sweat. Lilith, still the emotionless thing standing in front of him, showed a small smile, and the lifeless eyes took on a sadistic gleam that was easy to miss. Diablo told Baal that from that moment everyone related to Alucard was an enemy, and that if an opportunity came to kill them, they were to be killed. Baal wanted to question it. The mood did not allow the question. He said the wish was his command.[708]
A woman with long immaculate white hair opened light green eyes, stood, and took up a sword with a white blade and golden runes. Six wings opened behind her. She said the time had come. Daniel, one of her subordinates, asked if [[Ariel Elderblood|Lady Ariel]] would fight. She said yes. The demons' miasma had to be purged and the scales brought back into balance, or it would be too late. Beside her was a brother with golden hair, green eyes, six wings, and a star tattooed under the eyes. [[Cassiel]], the virtue of diligence. Two women stood behind him with their eyes covered by white masks that carried the same star. He said it was just as their father had predicted. A new king of hell had emerged. Daniel asked if they knew who. Cassiel said they did not know exactly, but their sister Chastity had spoken a name out of her visions. [[Azrael]]. The angels present went cold and said Azrael would not betray their father. Cassiel reminded them that Azrael, broadly, was only another name for death, and that the sister's visions were not very accurate. The king of hell was not an angel and not a demon. He walked the fine line of balance, the line called life and death. Ariel did not trust how much a brother who should have known nothing seemed to know, and she got another vague answer about diligence. She set the identity aside. What mattered was what had been done to the old king. With biblical hell in a new king's possession, Diablo could no longer call lesser demons, and his strength had taken a real blow. Cassiel called it the opportunity they had been waiting for. A voice entered every angel's head. Sound the trumpets, my children. Judgment day has arrived. Hundreds of angels went up with golden trumpets, and the sound marked the start of the second total war across the planet. The heavens cleared. Five of the highest came out, the virtues, heaven's elite. Cassiel told his sister not to keep Michael waiting.[708]
In Japan, Jeanne asked if Morgana had heard it, and Morgana said it would have been impossible not to. The trumpets meant the angels were done being passive and would attack in full. Morgana wanted to know why. She did not like being in the dark about something that was going to drag in every supernatural creature. Haruna came in with a contact from [[Amaterasu]]. Gods who were not hurt and could still fight would be assigned to the country's defense, and gigantic monsters were heading for the battlefield. Jeanne asked what monsters. Haruna named them. [[Kumbhakarna]], known in that world as the ogres of the Hindu pantheon, and his kind. [[Yamata-no-Orochi]] of the Japanese pantheon. They were supposed to be dead. The problem was necromancy. They had been revived as the undead. Kaguya took an item out of her shadows, and a hologram showed a being covered in miasma reviving a snake with eight heads and eight tails. Morgana snarled the name. [[Asmodeus]]. Bruna did not understand. Was necromancy not a witch art? Haruna said it went further than reanimating a body to fight, or using the dead to divine the future the way witches did. It was an art that used dead souls and kept them from being judged or moving on. What Asmodeus was doing was worse. He was using innocent souls to reanimate the snake, breaking a soul into a thousand pieces and stopping that soul from reaching its end. Eve said that if Diablo had ordered it for these two, it was safe to assume he had done it more widely than the room had seen.[708]
Victor did not stop after claiming the throne. A title without administration was worthless. He began reorganizing the Demons who had submitted, assigning authority according to capability and loyalty rather than blindly preserving Diablo's hierarchy.[709]
Alexios arrived sweating, clothes a mess, kidnapped out of his own house and dropped by Natalia into a room of looks he did not understand. Violet told him to connect to hell now. Agnes growled at him to be fast, to use his magic or whatever it was, and to connect. Leona told them to explain before they threw him at it. Ruby put it in a few words. They thought Victor had become the new king of hell, and that the authority of that position might let Alexios interfere in the dimension. They wanted a hole. His mouth worked like a goldfish. Natalia nodded that the theory was serious. He sighed that the man never ceased to amaze, closed his eyes, and asked for silence.[709]
He turned away. His eyes glistened, the galaxy in them changing with a strange zoom, like the universe itself moving in the reflection. A small portal opened on an apocalyptic hell: destruction, black miasma, red lightning. [[Aphrodite]] asked what that was. Sasha asked if it was hell. Jeanne said it was, and that it was not the hell she knew. Morgana had described a lifeless rocky desert and the sub-dimensions where sinners were kept. A place this damaged, with black miasma and red lightning, would have been mentioned if it had always been there. Someone had made it recently. Violet asked how they could know the damage. [[Scathach]] said there was one person in hell with the destructive potential to do it, and the temperament to actually do it. Natashia said she had tried to feel the lightning the way she felt her own lineage, and the familiarity was not there. Alexios said he was being pulled. The portal jumped and became a long throne room. Aphrodite knew the place. It was where the king of hell stayed. The image went to the throne. Ashen skin, as if he were dead. Black hair flowing like darkness itself. His head rested on his hand. Black plate armor, a cloak of pure black miasma behind him, and a large greatsword floating at his side that put a chill through the people watching.[709]
Violet and Leona both called his name. Ruby said the theory was correct. Sasha laughed that of course it was, because it was Victor. Leona said the man would not miss a chance to cause chaos. Scathach's thought was quieter. He had changed, and not only in the face. He seemed much stronger, and older. He opened his eyes on the familiar violet irises, shocked, and put out a hand that glowed red, grabbed the space, and pulled. Alexios could not believe it. His magic had been taken in a hand, and the power in that hand was heavy. Victor asked, carefully, if they were really there. The melancholy in the look was not hidden. Violet tried to jump the portal and a large hand stopped her. He told her to stop. He wanted the hug. She could not come to hell. The only ones who could were demons, or someone very resistant to miasma, and Morgana might qualify as an ancient demon, though she had changed enough that he would not swear to it. Sasha screamed at him to come to them. Natashia said they missed him. He said he could not. His existence, as it was now, was not something the Alioth clan's magic could handle. Pulling him out of the deepest place in hell to [[Nightingale]] would take more energy than the spell had. He was the king. Hell itself protected him, and pulling a king of hell out of the hell he ruled would exhaust Alexios to death. Sasha and Violet said they had not understood a word. Agnes roared why, and Violet roared it with her. He told them to calm down and breathe. He was not going to disappear. The eyes went blood red for a few seconds, and the emotions in the room settled. Sasha asked what the feeling was. He called it a trick learned across a long stay. As a progenitor he could influence, a little, the people who shared his bloodline. Scathach caught the words. How many years. He said he did not particularly know, but that for reference he would soon reach his maturity. Ruby asked if he was okay. He smiled at her and said that keeping the mind busy was the answer. She bit her lip against the tears. He told them not to think too hard about his condition. He was fine, and he was glad it had been him and not them. At the time, this had been the best result available. Natalia called him a selfless idiot with tears on her face. He laughed that he was like this only for them, and that in hell he was pretty feared. They called him Alucard, the Tyrant King. A flashy title. Jeanne said that being called a tyrant by demons was respect. They only respected strength. He called them a bunch of masochists. Alexios, sweating, said he was running out of time. Victor's voice changed into an order. Jeanne was to touch Alexios, focus on her natural energy, and replenish his reserves. She had never tried to give her energy to anyone. He told her it was all right. The energy she used was powerful enough, in theory, to explode someone if it was transferred wrong, and it was also natural energy. She only had to focus.[709]
Several women became central members of his new infernal government, while the enormous armies around Victor increasingly behaved less like terrified prisoners and more like fanatical followers who believed service to the new King would provide greater rewards than loyalty to the old one.[709][710]
He did not know how long it had been since the castle and the title. To him the taking of the throne still felt like yesterday, and he knew that was a lie. The history of hell, the inner politics of the higher demons, and the account of how demons had come to exist were easy. He already carried the memories of pillar demons who had been alive for a very long time. Politics was easier than the history. Demons respected strength, he was the strongest, and he used that to reform the society. It became a merit system. Lineage, ancient clan and old influence stopped mattering. Talent and usefulness rose, and the reward usually came straight from the king as power. He had turned the race into warriors who served him directly, and he had refused to let that be the whole of the kingdom. A society of only warriors would exploit everyone else and then stop progressing. There was room for logistics, for demons who studied their own history, and for research into the meager technology they had. The nature still showed. Stronger demons abused weaker ones. Influence was spent on the people who did not have it. He built an arena and made the answer a duel. One against one, no clout, just the two of them. It worked, because the loser usually forfeited the government post to the winner, and being close to the new king was a pride they did not want to lose. The arena also became the meeting place of demons who simply liked to fight. Acceptable requests were paid out as prizes. Small work grew up around it. Little demons with wings, fast and not worth a warrior's attention, knew every corner of hell from years of running from predators, and they became the delivery of the realm, a company selling and carrying goods, and they got rich. They were also the most fanatical. They said the chance would not have existed if he had not taken the throne.[710]
The fields that punished sinners were changed in the same pass. Endless torture was replaced, for the lowest level of sinner, with a stick and a carrot. A day of rest, the basic luxuries of an ordinary human life, and then the punishment again. It worked better than eternity. After thousands of years a soul got used to pain and went dull. Put a simple pleasure in front of it and it remembered what life had been, repented, and asked to move on to reincarnation. The privilege stopped at sins that were not unforgivable. Those, he did not touch. They could suffer forever and he would not care. The three generals under him were Vine the destroyer, Vepar the proud, and Helena the strategist. He had not chosen the titles. The devils had, out of what the three actually did. Vine, in a rage over a demon who had disrespected him, had gone to the man's territory and sunk the whole place in storms. The demons who had followed the conquest from the beginning were fanatics. They glorified his name as a god of a new world, the messiah out of hell, the antichrist itself, and the thought spread by the day. A former human did not know what to do with antichrist. He settled for the fact that they were in his control, and that the masses had called him worse.[710]
The troublesome woman waiting in the private chambers was Lily Baal, born Lucifer, wife of the former rank-one Baal and daughter of the first king. The name Lily was a tribute to Lilith, Lucifer's former wife and this woman's mother. Long black hair tipped with red, the body of a succubus, blood-red eyes, horns, a thin tail, and two leathery wings, the same shape of feature Helena carried. He addressed her as Lady Baal, neutral and heavy. She rose, bowed, and called him the strongest individual in hell, the king among kings, the one even her father would have been wary of facing. He told her to cut the fawning and say what she wanted. She asked if she could not visit only to see a beauty that surpassed prettier gods, and she said [[Apollo]]'s name as if the comparison were an insult to the man in front of her. He was amused. He sat on the sofa in front of a fireplace of blue flames, crossed his legs, rested his face in his hand, and waited in a bored authority for the actual request.[710]
Victor understood Demonic psychology well enough to exploit it. Demons respected strength, reward, ambition and fear. Instead of demanding that they suddenly behave according to Human morality, Victor created incentives matching what they already understood: competence produced rewards, ambition could be satisfied through service and betrayal produced consequences terrifying enough to make loyalty attractive.[710][711]
His reputation consequently spread through the realm as the King Among Kings. Victor had defeated Demon rulers, consumed powerful enemies and taken the central throne despite not even originally belonging to the Demonic Race.[711]
Lily dealt with the rebellion in her own house before she dealt with it in public. Luka was a male version of her, short spiked black hair with red tips, far more muscular than his mother, and he still called her mother while he questioned what she was doing. She kicked him in the gut, punched the next word out of his mouth, kneed him in the face, and stepped on his leg until it crunched. He screamed. She took him by the throat and told him to stop screaming like a bitch. He was a descendant of Lucifer and Lilith. Even in pain, he would act proud. She had warned him. End the rebellious thoughts and accept the change, or death would be kinder than what was coming. He asked how she could accept it. How she could accept that halfbreed. He was not even a demon. Her eyes narrowed. She slammed him into the ground hard enough to crater it and break the body, stepped on his face until it deformed, and then hauled him up again. The wounds closed just enough that he would not die. She asked what the man had done. Irreversible damage. He had destroyed the door of hell that was supposed to be unbreakable, a feat her mother and her father had not managed. So what if he was not a demon. He had the strength to put all of hell under his heel the way she was putting her son under hers. She asked what she had taught him. Power is everything. She had married Baal for political power. She had bowed to Diablo and supported her husband for power. She was supporting the new king for power and for survival, because his father was not in hell to protect him, and neither was Diablo.[711]
Diablo had beaten her mother, which even she could not claim, and as an ancient demon and the incarnation of evil he had had the power to be king. That had changed because he left hell unguarded. Alucard could have destroyed everyone in it. He had chosen to rule, and the effect was visible. She made Luka say the name the masses used. Antichrist. Messiah of hell. She kicked him until he said it clearly, and then she made him say why. The demons had fallen for the charisma the way they had fallen for Lucifer. Hell had been pure chaos and was gaining order, which Diablo in all his years had not done. A merit society gave every demon a road to power, and the ones who received the king's power directly would be loyal because their destiny had changed in his hand. That was an endless cycle of fanatical soldiers. Luka asked if the monster had planned it from the start. She said he was finally using his intelligence. Lesser demons supported this king. They had feared Diablo. They had not supported him as a life's goal. Ancient demons were strong, and in front of billions of fanatics they were nothing. She could fight hordes until she got tired, and then she would die. He was empowering the lesser demons, the old ones and the ones still to be born. A rebellion was not a fight against one man who had conquered hell essentially alone and walked away from a demon god. It was a fight against all of hell, and against the elders he called the elders of hell, Zahal and Albu. Luka could not believe they had knelt. They had been loyal to Diablo. She corrected him. The elder demons were loyal to hell itself. They had not cared about Diablo or about her father. They had knelt to Alucard, and Lucifer himself had never had that loyalty. She told her son to stop resisting the inevitable. She would be an influential figure in the society that was being remade in the new king's image. Her pride would not accept being left as just another demon, and his recklessness was putting that at risk. Black and white power came off her with the beat of her wings. He would help her fix the mess. He knew better than to resist. Her Dark Light was a demonic power with traces of the holy light from Lilith and Lucifer's union, deadly to demons, and it had not passed to him. He was more Baal than Lucifer. It would hurt. He would not die.[711]
The square in front of the castle looked up at a black and red throne and went quiet with awe. Victor sat with his head in his hand and his face covered in a strange darkness, violet eyes, full plate, long black hair flowing under black miasma that moved as if it had a life of its own. A greatsword covered in black miasma rested beside him. Three women of different heights and different armor stood behind the throne, and twelve women, commanders of hell and the direct subordinates of those three, stood with them. The twin elders knelt. Albu apologized for the delay. His brother had spent too long adoring their new residence. Victor said delay would not be tolerated. When he called, they were to forget whatever they were doing and come. They swore the mistake would not happen again.[711]
He publicly demonstrated what his rule meant. Traitors were displayed suffering beneath his authority, while individuals whose loyalty and capability benefited the kingdom were elevated. Victor did not ask Demons to believe vague promises that the new regime would reward them; he showed them directly.[712]
Helena turned the crowd and called it judgment day. Hundreds of shackled demons of every size stood where she pointed, open wounds, blood on the ground, and Lily Baal walked them in with a neutral, confident step. Someone in the mass recognized the beaten body with the missing arm. Luka Baal. Lily's son. The whispers asked if she was that loyal, even with her own son, because everyone knew how protective she was. The act raised her reputation rather than ruining it. Victor smiled with sharp teeth, and they read the smile as pleasure. Helena named her in full. Lily Baal, born Lucifer. Direct lineage of the first demon king, a noble woman who in the past would have been exalted wherever she walked. That reality was the past. Even Lucifer's daughter, even one of the oldest bloodlines, did not matter to his majesty. Only actions mattered. Only merits mattered. Knowing that, she had made the move. She had tracked and captured everyone planning a coup. The prisoners in front of them were the beings who had meant to overthrow the current king. A lesser demon growled death to traitors, and the chant took the square. How dare they. Arrogant worms. Death to traitors. Die. Lily's small smile shook once under the noise. Vine slammed the handle of an ice axe completely covered in metal into the ground and called for silence. They were in the presence of the king. They would respect themselves and not act like barbarians. They were not unreasonable creatures. They would carry the pride of the race and the pride of the king. Heads went down. The king's face was not smiling anymore. Helena thanked her and went on. Capturing the traitors and bringing them to justice was, under the law, the right to ask the king for a reward, and because the deed served the whole society and the government, the reward on offer was the highest order a demon could be given.[713]
The square understood the ranks because most of them were living inside them.
