A highest-order demon could request anything inside the king's capabilities that did not harm him, for themselves or for the society. Gold was a boost of power, or the equivalent. Bronze was a limited favor, or cash. Most of the demons who had come through the war had received gold or bronze. This rank was rare, and the ambition in the crowd lit up when it was named. Helena said the king had a word before the trial. He asked Lily what she desired, and he raised a hand in red power as if offering power, then let it go, and he offered a political position, or a demonic artifact. With his authority she could have anything in hell. Her eyes were serious. She wanted her son to become her slave. The crowd thought it was a waste, and that she was only saving him from death. What she was actually protecting was Lucifer's bloodline. Victor laughed, long, and called it quite a kind gesture for a demon, choosing protection over something that benefited her. He could still call Luka a useless insignificant life. Lily's answer, in the open, was that he was still her son, and that she would protect him even if she had to make him a mindless slave. He heard the twisted loyalty for what it was and said he understood. Then he reminded the square that the man had still conspired and tried to bring him down. A wave of the right arm took the handcuffs off, and Luka floated toward the throne. Helena shook her head, and Lily saw it. She recommended the king use him as a puppet. The blood was Lucifer, Lilith and Baal. Useless as a person, useful as blood, and strong. Her mother had had an ancient technique for this. Hostile demons, even mindless beasts, taken and turned with mind control into war puppets. Victor asked if it was not better to let him die as his own master. Even traitors deserved to die as masters of themselves. Lily said that privilege was for the worthy. Traitors were not worthy of it. She would rather have her son as a puppet, alive and useful, than dead and useless. He called it splendid. A display of true loyalty, which was what he expected from the people who worked for him. As king he would be cruel not to reward it. From that day Luka Baal would serve ten million years as the slave and puppet of his own mother. And for the loyalty of sacrificing her own blood, Lily could make one more wish. The crowd called the king kind, called her loyal, and started the inevitable rumor that she was in love with him, because they all knew how handsome he was. She looked into the violet eyes and asked for political position. The highest he could give. He said that could be resolved. He would adjust his personnel, and in the future he would call her and hand her a post that fit the reward. He thanked her for being a loyal demon. Then he said he heard she had a show for him. Her eyes went blood red and the smile went cruel. He told Vepar not to let the man die. He still had a great deal of work to do for the kingdom. Vepar bowed and passed it down. He was not to die. His hands were to be tied, so he could not kill himself and could not run.[713]
The response became overwhelming. Legions that had once belonged to Diablo began chanting the name of their conqueror, and Hell formally acknowledged a new ruler. Victor Alucard—Vampire Progenitor, Count of Nightingale and husband to several of its most powerful women—became the King of Demons.[714]
Lily Baal worked on a traitor in front of the legions until the crowd went silent from it. He called the work splendid, worthy of an artist. She had learned the basics from her mother and then gone past her mother, and she said it ran in the female line, and that Lilith shared the fondness. He stood up off the throne, showed his face, and told his citizens they had seen the consequence. Remember it. There would be no mercy. He showed them the traitor's body and a vision of tortured souls, and he said that for those who went against him only true death was waiting. No reincarnation. No afterlife. An empty disappearance. He closed his hand and the souls burst and were gone. Then he pointed at Lily and put power into her. Loyalty was rewarded. Betrayal and insubordination were punished. Choose. With him, or against him. The legions chanted all hail Alucard, the king of demons, and they stomped until the ground rumbled like an earthquake, and their eyes glowed with his image. He felt the conditions of a technique finish themselves in the noise.[714]
The trap designed to remove Victor from the war had therefore produced the worst possible outcome for Diablo. Victor had not merely survived Hell. He had taken it from him.[714]

##### The War's Final Act
Chapters 681–691
Victor returned to the larger conflict with the authority of Hell behind him. The Demonic War entered its final phase as Victor mobilized Legions that had once belonged to [[Diablo]] and entered Earth not merely as another Vampire reinforcement but as the recognized King of the same species conducting the invasion.[715]
From a hill, Vlad, Natashia, [[Scathach]], Kaguya, [[Aphrodite]] and Alexios watched it in armor, heads bare, except Vlad, Alexios, and Aphrodite in divine robes. Vlad asked why Volk was meddling. The report he had was that Victor was king of hell and needed the key of hell off Diablo, and the urge to step in was sitting next to the caution, because the man who had been eating demons was stronger. On the field, angels, demons and werewolves were already in it. [[Baal]] had the third through sixth pillars against two virtues and was fighting Ariel in his true form. Lilith was on a black dragon, helping the demons, and trading with Michael and [[Gabriel]] as they switched. The deadly sins were not on the field yet. [[Thor]] was throwing lightning for the angels. Portals opened for servants of elder gods, for Yama and his generals, and [[Merlin]] stood behind Diablo. The group on the hill was not there to dive in. The plan Victor had left them was the key, not a brawl. Scathach's priority was getting her disciple back. Vlad would wait on the decision of a king of hell. They expected him to refuse both sides and make a third game. Vlad's own guess put him in the lowest hell, with the negative world tree, and with enough time in that place to have trained into something on a god-king's scale. Then a bullet-loud sound, and Michael screamed, and the watching stopped being theory.[715]
The fighting between Heaven and Hell had reached catastrophic levels. The Seven Deadly Sins confronted the Heavenly forces while Angels and other Divine powers were drawn deeper into the conflict.[715][716]
Diablo laughed that it was finally starting. [[Asmodeus]], a shadow with demon wings and a big smile, put the demon king's will into Gabriel as miasma. Sloth, a woman, told Michael he was so busy, so tired, and the sleepiness landed. Envy, a man, said he envied that power and asked how Michael would like to lose some of it for a while, and the darkness went in and the reserves drained. [[Agares]] came from behind Ariel and her sister virtue, daggers through the chests, and told them not to drop their guard when an Agares was on the field. Holy aura hurt him and he ignored it and left through a portal. Diablo said he did not fight alone. He pierced Gabriel and took the heart. He pierced Michael and took that heart too. The ingredients, he said, were complete: the heart that held all the evil of hell, the heart of a fallen angel of the highest order, and the heart of the fairest and holiest angel in existence. Michael had already called [[Azrael]]. The angel of death came in black plate and a hood, three pairs of translucent wings in white and in black, and he told the others to leave and find different opponents. He had not expected to intervene so soon. A golden portal brought hundreds of angels. After the brothers fell he mowed demon elites and pillars in a cold anger, black beams putting him wherever the next one stood. A vampire woman took the hearts. Diablo and the ones with him fled through a portal. The field had no order left.[716]
The death and injury of important Angels caused the Heavenly faction to escalate. Azrael entered the battlefield and began slaughtering high-ranking Demons with enough force to remind everyone that Heaven possessed combatants far beyond the ordinary Angelic armies.[716][717]
A gigantic dark gate opened, and the dark on the other side was full of miasma and hundreds of thousands of red eyes. The fear that came off it made the field shiver. The miasma was heavier than Diablo's. What walked out was a man with long black hair covered in miasma, a condescending smile, sharp teeth, a blood-red gaze, red power under the miasma. He asked Diablo why he was yelling. Was he menstruating, or had someone stolen something from him. Control that famous temper, ex-demon king, or people would think he was an imposter. Diablo snarled that it was demon king, Victor Alucard, worm. The angels ordered a retreat from the terror. The fighting paused because every side was looking at the man who had taken the throne.[717]
Victor's arrival changed the environment again. The enormous quantity of Miasma he released turned portions of the battlefield increasingly hostile to Angels while the Demon Legions now loyal to him attacked Diablo's remaining army. Even the supposedly clear conflict between Heaven and Hell had become distorted because the new King of Hell was fighting against Hell's former King.[717][718]
He came through hell's gate without the sacrifice that gate was supposed to cost. The miasma and the demons that belonged to him now hit Diablo's army, and the angels watched and chose, for the moment, not to interfere. A dragon Diablo had sent at him was tamed instead of killing him. Diablo lost the shape of the battle and retreated rather than stand in it. On the hill the people who knew him were relieved by the soul, which had not changed, and by the strength, which had.[718]
Another extraordinary participant then appeared: the Dragon [[Zaladrac Zeovnur Elderblood]]. Despite her gigantic body, Victor discovered that Zaladrac was still comparatively young by Dragon standards. Her size and potential were already extraordinary enough to make even experienced supernatural beings treat her with caution.[718][719]
Victor defeated and impressed the Dragon enough that Zaladrac chose him as her partner—a relationship she initially expressed through the terminology of Dragon and knight. Victor characteristically corrected the wording: he was not interested in becoming anyone's subordinate knight. If Zaladrac intended to remain with him, he would be her King.[719]
The supernatural bond between them allowed both Beings to benefit from the other's development and connected Victor directly to the physiology and senses of a genuine Dragon. The relationship would eventually become another of Victor's most important racial evolutions.[719]
Victor then turned toward [[Lilith Elderblood]]. He had suspected for some time that Diablo controlled her artificially, and the confrontation finally confirmed it. Rather than fight Lilith simply because Diablo commanded her to attack, Victor coordinated with someone capable of restraining her and attacked the supernatural control itself.[719]
Victor destroyed the mechanism binding Lilith to Diablo and restored the Mother of Demons' free will. Her lifeless obedience disappeared immediately, replaced by centuries of hatred toward the man who had enslaved and humiliated her.[719]
Lilith summoned her anti-Divine weapon Genesis and turned on Diablo. The strategic value was obvious. Victor had simultaneously removed one of Diablo's greatest weapons and created another overwhelmingly powerful enemy standing directly beside him.[719]
Zaladrac was the black dragon. Lilith came at him and he stopped the punch on an arm covered in red power. Vepar, Helena and Lily took hold of her so he could work. He put a hand on Lilith's head. Diablo's magic was the binding. He broke it. She screamed as the power came back, and he told her to return to her former glory, Lilith, mother of all demons. She called the god-slayer Genesis and told the worm to give back what belonged to her. He called it the start of the show, a very angry goddess's revenge on a lowly demon who had swallowed more than he should have.[719]
Diablo's alliances began collapsing almost immediately. Yama had entered an agreement with the King of [[Biblical Hell]], but Diablo no longer possessed that title. The moment this technical reality became undeniable, Yama considered his obligation void and abandoned the battlefield with his Generals rather than die for someone who no longer controlled the kingdom on which their agreement had been based.[720]
Internal betrayal followed. Demons who had already chosen Victor acted against the remaining loyalists, while Baal and other important pieces of Diablo's hierarchy were removed. Victor rewarded loyalty openly, elevating individuals such as [[Lily Elderblood]] rather than pretending their contributions were disposable simply because they had once served his enemy.[720]
Yama watched long enough to know the loss, and he told Diablo the deal was void because Diablo was not, at that moment, the demon king of biblical hell. Stay alive, if he could. Yama left through a portal with his generals. Lily, the succubus, put a hand through Baal, her husband, and drained him, and she said it was nothing personal. He was simply no longer useful. Helena used Victor's blood and turned the body into a blood sphere, and he ate it. He told Lily that killing her husband had completed the last mission, and that as promised she was his fourth general. She knelt with Helena, [[Vine]] and Vepar while the elites of Diablo's side were rendered the same way and consumed. Diablo screamed that he was Diablo, the incarnation of evil, and the worms should remember who they were looking at. Victor pulled his demons out, brought back allies who had fallen, and with the heavenly father raised a barrier so the next fight would not take the earth with it. He had the wives again. Seven hundred years sat on the power. He meant to step in when Diablo hit his limit.[720]
Lilith finally fought Diablo personally. In her True Form, the Mother of Demons wielded Divinities associated with Rottenness, Corruption, Despair and Beginning, the authority connected to her position as the origin of the Demonic Race. For Lilith, the confrontation was not another political battle. It was revenge against the man who had stolen her will.[721]
Her true form was long demonic wings, sharp horns, and a tail covered in miasma that spread until the body itself was dense and corrupt. The concepts on her were rottenness, corruption, despair, and beginning, the progenitor's authority over demons, the right to make them and to force them. She hit him with that and with Genesis, and the damage was enormous, and it was not a finish. He threw the [[Spears|Spear]] of Longinus, covered in miasma. Ariel called it blasphemy that the spear was in a demon's hands. Lilith caught it on the sword and the hand and hurled it back. He dodged. Victor and the heavenly father both said it would not work. When a being ascended to godhood the soul went through a metamorphosis, and the moment Lilith became a goddess she had stepped out of that influence. They fought for more than an hour. His regeneration had stopped and he was the more damaged of the two. She was running on hatred. The barrier would not break, so he tried to leave. She appeared and put the sword through his stomach. He exploded, threw her, and blasted a beam that blew where she had been. Then he swallowed three hearts: his own, miasma-covered; Michael's, holy; Gabriel's, dark with white in it. Dark and holy light came out of him as a pillar. He said it was too late.[721]
Diablo, surrounded by collapsing alliances and enemies on every side, attempted to surpass the limitations of ordinary Demons. By forcing Angelic and Demonic characteristics into one existence, he pushed himself toward the forbidden state associated with a Nephalem.[721][722]
Victor clapped from the throne and congratulated him. The evolution was amazing. He had gone from a lowly demon who did not know his place to an aberration of several races. What a status upgrade. What came out of the shrinking pillar of light and darkness had pale skin, dark tattoos, two horns, six wings that mixed angel and fallen angel, a black tail, dark red armor-like pieces, one hand full of dark demonic miasma and the other full of holy light, an androgynous face that was still fierce, and a pressure that kept climbing. Thor watched from far off and did not like a hell that might line up with heaven and fatten the biblical faction. Adam and Volk watched a troublemaker get worse. Limbo's guardian showed in the clouds, annoyed. The judges of the abyss came as beings of darkness. Victor asked why he was still so weak. He had trained without stopping for seven hundred years. He had expected a good fight, and this was the shit he got. Let me teach you a lesson, Diablo. Don't worry. It's free. You've gotten weaker. Diablo would not accept it. A hybrid. A nephalem. A being that broke the balance. Victor's answer was red lightning, fast enough and controlled enough that the new body regenerated and was still hit, disarmed, and lectured for having no mastery of what it had just become. The judges told Limbo the balance was not actually broken. Their agreement allowed the thing to exist for a while. Victor started a pillar of black and red, and the destruction that should have followed was held down by those same judges.[722]
The transformation was cosmologically dangerous because Angels and Demons represented opposing sides of a balance that was not supposed to combine freely. The Owner of Limbo and other higher Beings monitored the development because a sufficiently complete violation could require direct intervention from the entities responsible for maintaining existence.[722]
Diablo believed the transformation finally gave him the raw Energy necessary to overwhelm Victor. In quantity alone, the power was enormous. Victor's response exposed the fundamental mistake that had defined Diablo's entire ambition.[722][723]
Power was not simply Energy. Victor had accumulated [[Martial Arts]], Scathach's teachings, countless Bloodline abilities, memories consumed from enemies, Roxanne's support, Divine Blessings, Soul manipulation, centuries of practice and the discipline required to control destructive forces without allowing them to control him. Diablo possessed enormous reserves but lacked equivalent mastery over everything he had forced into his body.[723]
When Victor finally released his own accumulated Energy, Diablo experienced genuine fear. The man who had sacrificed nations, manipulated Gods and spent immense periods accumulating strength realized that Victor possessed an overwhelming quantity of power while simultaneously knowing how to use it far more efficiently.[723]
What he released was a pillar of pure power, negative energy at a god-king's level, and it condensed into a humanoid body of darkness and crimson, two wings of pure miasma and darkness, thousands of blood-red eyes on the body. Diablo's first thought was what is that. Ariel said, by the holy father, what the fuck is this. The fear was the pure kind. Numbness, insignificance, desperation. He shook, barely breathed, fell back, went to a knee, and begged to be killed. He felt like a child in front of something he did not have a name for. Victor asked if he was afraid, and called it disappointing. Aren't you a nephalem. A being that broke the balance. Aren't you above everyone. Prove it. Stand up. Get into position. Diablo asked what he was. Victor told him to take the sword. He made an ice sword and put it in the hand and stepped away. Diablo said he couldn't. Take that sword, get into position like the proud demon you claim to be. Diablo said he couldn't, just kill him, he did not care, just get him out of this place. Victor said that in the end even he was only fit to be dog food. He took Diablo by the neck. The body distorted. Half of it became a demonic beast's head, and the head flew in and devoured him. There had not been a fight. Victor was disappointed. He missed a fight that had been worth having.[723]
The confrontation therefore failed to become the glorious final battle Diablo imagined. Victor was disappointed. Diablo had pursued power for so long that he had mistaken possession for mastery.[723][724]
Victor ultimately devoured Diablo, permanently ending the existence of the former Incarnation of Evil and absorbing the knowledge and power accumulated throughout his enormous lifespan.[724]
Power was not the amount of energy. It was techniques, mentality, the quirks of a race, and the artifacts in the hand, weapon or armor. A being could hold a great deal of energy and be weak. A being could hold little and be stronger. Power without control was useless. Diablo rushed him. He did not give the rush time to become a fight. He went in before the man could adapt, and the progenitor's nature destroyed souls, and Diablo had no protection against that. The difference, once the form changed, made the incarnation of evil look like an ant. Victor won and was frustrated. It was not the battle he had wanted. The war was over. He spoke with the heavenly father without a fight between them, and they traded a way to communicate, and there was talk of cooperation later. Scathach wanted to test him. That was the next argument, not Diablo's.[724]
The remaining hostile forces either fled, surrendered or were destroyed. The Demonic War finally ended, but its conclusion had transformed far more than the political balance of Earth.[724]
Victor reunited with Scathach, Natashia, Agnes, Violet and the rest of his family after an absence that had felt incomparably longer to him because of the altered flow of Time in Hell. Scathach immediately wanted to test the strength he had gained, but Victor refused for once. He had spent approximately seven hundred subjective years fighting, conquering and ruling inside Hell. Before pursuing another battle, he intended to stabilize his new kingdom and then give his family the time they had been denied.[725]
He held Scathach and kissed her, and the thought was how he had missed this. As much as he wanted to fight her, now was not the time. He had to go back to hell and put it in order, and he wanted time with her. Seven hundred years was a long time. She told him not to run. He said never. To Natashia he said he had promised himself months with her when he got back, and he would keep it. She told him not to dare run from the promises. He said of course not. Kaguya had been supposed to go with him and had not. Hell was not kind to mortals. Even in his shadow the miasma would have killed her. He had been researching, from the start, a way for beings weak to miasma to enter, because he wanted to show them the city he and his subordinates had built. With the key of hell he could come and go more easily. A king should not apologize, someone told him. He answered that if a king could not recognize his own faults he was not fit to be one. He asked who would go back with him. Yes. She could feel it. That was the proof. She was his until the end of time. Don't take too long. For them it would be a few hours. For him, days or months, depending on the work. He would be back before they knew it. Say hello to the old man. Tell him to retire and get a wife to calm the paranoia. The complaint that followed was that six months of practice had been missed, and that unfortunately he had only touched Roxanne. He told them they took care of each other. They agreed. He called Zaladrac, and he went through the gate with his generals. Scathach, Aphrodite, Kaguya, Natashia, Vlad and Alexios turned back toward [[Nightingale]] to report, and to wait.[725]
Demonic War therefore concluded with nearly every objective of Diablo's plan producing the opposite result. The invasion intended to weaken Earth's supernatural factions drove Victor into alliances with Gods, Youkai, Witches, Fairies and displaced supernatural races. Attempts to isolate his family produced an independent coalition centered directly upon him. The effort to use Lilith transformed her into one of Diablo's greatest enemies. The attempt to remove Victor from Earth by throwing him into Hell gave Victor centuries of combat experience, armies of Demons, new subordinates and ultimately Diablo's own throne.
Victor began Volume 5 as the Second Vampire Progenitor still operating within the political framework created by Vlad and the ancient supernatural factions. By its conclusion he had created an independent faction, married Aphrodite at the Soul level, tied [[Medusa]] and the [[Gorgons]] to his Fate, learned [[Senjutsu]], encountered the Universal Tree and the Judges of the Abyss, transformed the Bloodlines of his family, recruited multiple Demon rulers, defeated the Four Horsemen, gained a Dragon partner, liberated Lilith, conquered Biblical Hell and devoured the Being who had declared himself the Incarnation of Evil.
The supernatural world had once viewed Victor as an abnormal young Vampire whose rapid rise would eventually slow when he encountered the ancient powers standing above him. The Demonic War proved the opposite. Every larger world Victor entered simply became another place from which he returned with greater knowledge, stronger allies and more authority than he possessed before.[482][650][714][724][725]

#### Volume 6: King Among Kings
Chapters 692–888

##### The King Returns
Chapters 692–700
After approximately seven hundred years spent within Hell, Victor Elderblood finally returned to the people who had been waiting for him. Although only a comparatively short period had passed for those outside, Victor himself had experienced centuries of ruling the infernal realm, fighting Demonic Beasts, studying the accumulated knowledge of the former Demon Kings, strengthening his control over Miasma and Negativity, and repeatedly forcing his body and mind beyond what they had previously been capable of enduring. The result was immediately visible. Victor returned with the presence of a genuine monarch, his overwhelming power now accompanied by considerably greater emotional discipline and experience.[726]
The household did not meet that return as a quiet homecoming. Violet paced asking if he was coming. The women already treating him as theirs had gathered in one room: Natashia, Agnes, Ruby, Violet, Sasha, [[Aphrodite]], Kaguya, [[Scathach]], Leona, Eleonor, Jeanne, Morgana, Haruna, Bruna, Eve, Maria, Roberta, Natalia, Mizuki, Rose, Pepper, Siena, Lacus and Victoria. Aphrodite counted the possible future wives at thirty-one and included the Demon Generals, Lilith, and the Dragon. Scathach, told that Pepper, Siena and Lacus meant to chase him, gave the blessing outright. He was already her husband, and Ruby's. The man they were waiting on was no longer only a Count. He was King of Hell and the head of a faction, with more political and military weight than Vlad.[727]
The enormous difference in experienced time also created an unexpectedly personal problem. For Victor's wives, their separation had lasted only a fraction of the time he had personally endured; for Victor, he had spent roughly seven centuries without the women who had become the emotional center of his life. The accumulated longing broke through the restraint he had cultivated as Hell's King. He returned with 700 years of love, affection, and lust bottled up. His body erupted with an extremely potent pheromone scent that attracted everything to him. Roxanne stated she could barely handle him alone for 700 years. He warned the gathered women that he would not hold back and that he had interesting applications for the Goddess's Blessing of Sexuality. Those who did not wish to associate with him were free to leave; the rest sealed themselves in a room with black magic circles isolating it. Roxanne placed beds and informed everyone outside that the women would be unavailable for a year. Natashia, Morgana, Violet, Scathach, Maria, Bruna, and Agnes panted in anticipation. Pepper realized it was too late to leave; Lacus watched expectantly. Victor disappeared with Violet, reappeared naked in bed, filled her completely while bypassing even her womb's barrier, and told her to scream for him. A battle lasting one year began—non-stop sex for 365 days.[728][729]
One year later, the women discussed the results. Aphrodite noted that Jeanne, who appeared outwardly as an unsullied Saint, easily bested Aphrodite, Morgana, Violet, and Natashia in bedroom debauchery. She imitated Jeanne's dirty talk: "I want more! Please fill my uterus! Cum on my tits! Mess me up completely! Grab me by my hair and spank me harder, rougher! More, More!" Jeanne had ridden Victor until her womb was completely filled. Similar intense sessions occurred with Pepper and Haruna. Morgana threw herself on Victor demanding more. The year of continuous sex left everyone thoroughly satisfied and further bonded.[730]
His reunion with [[Anna Elderblood]] revealed that his family had not remained unchanged in his absence. Anna had become a Noble Vampire and was still adjusting to the dramatic strengthening of instincts, emotions and desires produced by her new biology. Victor understood the problem better than almost anyone. His own existence contained Bloodlust, overwhelming possessiveness, Demonic impulses and quantities of Negativity capable of destroying ordinary beings, yet he had learned that instinct did not have to mean obedience. Victor therefore encouraged Anna to stop fearing what she had become while making an equally important distinction: accepting an impulse and allowing that impulse to control one's actions were entirely different things.[731][732]
What stood in front of him was not the woman who had raised a sick son in an ordinary house. Anna walked with a noblewoman's aura, long black hair, red eyes and a curvy body, the new confidence sitting in the step itself. She admitted that even now she wanted to jump on top of him and ride him until lost in lust while drinking his blood to satisfaction. Victor told her he had come back from Hell feeling as if he could explode at any moment, and that the weight had only left him after he finished working through it. He was lighter. He had missed them. The Kingship did not, in his account, force him to ration the time he spent with his wives and daughters, because the subordinates under him were competent enough to hold the chaos while he was with his family.[733][734]
Elsewhere, [[Lilith Elderblood]] awakened and began exploring the Hell that had once been the foundation of her own existence. What she found bore little resemblance to the fragmented territory she remembered. Victor had not simply defeated the old Demon Kings and placed himself upon their throne. Cities had expanded, infrastructure had been restored, military and administrative hierarchies had changed, and Demons who previously existed beneath hereditary rulers were beginning to function inside a civilization increasingly built around merit and service to the new King.[735][736]
Lilith woke into a Hell that had a capital. Abbadon was the Royal Capital, one of three Mega Cities the King had built to split economy, development, and a route for Demons who were not yet strong enough to live in the capital. The other two cities are not named in that chapter. Abbadon had a Technological Development Department under Aline Valefar, daughter of the former sixth-rank Pillar Valefar and an Ice Demon, one of four Commanders reporting to the General Vepar, split between military work and domestic work and already building toward weapons of mass destruction. Hell had a currency, the Knull, set at one Knull to one human dollar. Inside the three cities the rule was unspoken and absolute: cause trouble and every Demon in Hell hunts you. Outside them the Miasma was still hostile. Inside them Victor's control of how much Miasma spread had stabilized the weather enough for schedules, days of the week, and a Conquest Calendar of 377 days a year and 27 hours a day. Time was not even the same from pit to capital. Lilith, coming out of the deepest pits, was looking at something on the order of seven hundred years; Abbadon itself had lived through roughly four to six hundred. [[Vine]] and Vepar were the Generals on her. The castle sat over the place Miasma was born, with a garden and room left for Zaladrac. She looked at Aline as if the woman had used four languages in one sentence, and she still said the new King seemed to be doing a great job. When she saw Victor she had forgotten how ridiculously handsome he was, called him a damned provocateur, and was told to learn the society he had built and then choose her own path. Any act that jeopardized the peace of his cities carried grave consequences.[737]
Victor also reunited with [[Zaladrac Zeovnur Elderblood]], whose perspective as an Ancient Dragon made the changes surrounding him particularly important. Victor explained portions of Hell's development, including the enormous differences in temporal flow that had allowed centuries to pass within the realm while relatively little time elapsed elsewhere. Zaladrac, meanwhile, was finally introduced more directly to the ever-expanding collection of women connected to Victor.[738]
The Dragon he walked in on was a gigantic black body with violet worked through the scales, and eyes the same striking violet as his. Eye contact thinned his pupils to match hers, and the bond pushed her scales toward dark violet. She told him, again, not to call her Girl. She had a name. If he were not her Rider she would have burned him for it. He called the name a tongue twister and said he would not be surprised if she burned people for pronouncing it wrong. She agreed that was a possibility, then agreed not to burn the Demons, because they were already too frightened to approach her and because her actions reflected on him. He stroked her snout. She told him to get off her head, glowed violet, and shrank into a humanoid of 184 centimeters: long black hair shaded violet, dragon wings, pointed ears, violet slit pupils, a toned fair-skinned body. She had never had to dress. He put her in a dark violet dress and helped her into it. The ratio he was already carrying for the two worlds was one year on Earth to five years in Hell.[739]
The meeting quickly demonstrated how strongly Dragon instincts reacted to hierarchy, territory and the scent of Victor upon his family. Zaladrac's immense age and status did not prevent friction when confronted with women who already regarded Victor as exclusively theirs, while those same women had little intention of behaving submissively merely because a primordial Dragon had entered the household. Victor's return thus marked far more than the conclusion of his stay in Hell. The young Vampire who had entered the Demonic realm had returned as its undisputed King, a vastly more experienced martial artist and a ruler whose family was now large enough to resemble the foundations of an entirely new supernatural power.[740]

##### Faith Takes Form
Chapters 701–713
The memories Victor obtained after consuming [[Diablo]] and several of his closest servants finally provided a coherent trail toward enemies who had remained scattered throughout his life. His predatory abilities did not force him to consciously experience every memory belonging to those he consumed; relevant information remained available almost like an enormous internal archive, surfacing when he deliberately searched for it or encountered circumstances connected to it. Through Diablo's history Victor gained substantially more information concerning [[New Dawn]] and the network of conspirators associated with figures such as [[Niklaus Horseman]], General James, Fenir and others who had repeatedly interfered in events surrounding his family.[741]
A very different crisis was simultaneously developing among Humanity. The public revelation and increasing visibility of supernatural events had damaged traditional assumptions about religion, while the weakening of several established faiths left enormous populations searching desperately for something new to believe in. In a world where collective Faith possessed genuine supernatural power, this was considerably more dangerous than an ordinary cultural crisis. Enough uncontrolled belief could eventually produce Divine phenomena—or even new Gods shaped by what Humans expected those Gods to be.[742][743]
Victor consulted individuals more experienced with Divine systems while his faction considered what might happen if Humanity unconsciously created unstable deities from fear, desperation or contradictory religious ideas. At the same time, [[Scathach Elderblood Scarlett]] refused to allow Victor's accelerating growth to become an excuse for her own stagnation. The fact that her disciple had begun exceeding conventional limits only made her more determined to continue advancing, while Victor himself experimented with increasingly dangerous combinations of Draconic power and Demonic Energy, including techniques such as his Demonic Dragon Breath.[744][745]
Information about [[Fenrir]], the legendary Beast associated with Ragnarök and the [[Werewolves]] of Samar, also entered Victor's awareness. Fenrir was not merely another unusually strong monster. His existence carried enough weight that entire political structures had been built around his protection, while his relationship with the Werewolf monarchy would later become central to Victor's dealings with Samar.[746]
Victor meanwhile continued teaching his daughters. [[Nero Elderblood]] possessed exceptional talent and raw power, but Victor repeatedly warned that talent became dangerous when it encouraged arrogance. Stronger opponents had to be observed and understood rather than challenged simply because losing seemed unlikely. His lessons increasingly reflected the experience accumulated during centuries of warfare: Victor had become extraordinarily powerful precisely because he learned continuously rather than treating power as a substitute for understanding.[747]
The transformation of Humanity also changed how the supernatural world viewed Victor. To many Human institutions, his rapidly expanding influence made him appear closer to an enemy of Humanity than a protector, particularly because Victor possessed little sentimental attachment to Human political systems simply because he had once been Human himself. Yet the same actions that frightened governments inspired increasing worship among ordinary people who saw him as a Being capable of doing what their old institutions and Gods could not.[748][749]
Victor eventually learned that this worship had already become a genuine religion. What had begun with [[Bruna Elderblood]] directing her Faith toward the man who rescued her had spread through Victor's maids, allied Vampires, Humans and supernatural races. Under the work of Roxanne, Aline, [[Vine]], Helena, Kaguya and Victor's wives, the [[Blood God Religion]] developed temples, Acolytes, Archbishops and communities across Hell, [[Nightingale]] and portions of Earth. Its members were not trained merely to kneel before Victor. They received education in politics, medicine, warfare, economics, architecture and other disciplines so that the religion could produce useful members of society rather than helpless fanatics.[750][751]
Victor decided that an institution carrying his name would no longer operate while its God pretended it did not exist. He personally appeared before hundreds of followers gathered inside one of the religion's hidden temples, making the object of their worship a tangible presence rather than a distant myth. For followers who had previously known Victor primarily through stories of impossible battles and miracles, seeing him personally became a defining moment in the history of their faith.[751]
The most important administrative decision concerned [[Valeria Alekerth]]. Victor recognized that her devotion remained extraordinarily strong without reducing her to a mindless worshipper incapable of judgment. She was therefore selected as the religion's High Priestess, the mortal authority intended to act closest to Victor while coordinating the organization beneath him.[751][752]
Victor established a direct supernatural contract with Valeria, dramatically changing her body and potential. Her youth was restored, her capacity for growth increased and a direct connection to Victor allowed her to use powers derived from the Being she represented. The contract also strengthened her mind and perception enough that she absorbed Victor's teachings with remarkable speed. The transformation was not merely a reward; Victor was creating an administrator capable of surviving alongside the institution she was expected to lead.[752]
The contract was spoken as a two-way oath. Victor Alucard, King of Hell, named Valeria Alekerth the spokesman of his will. In exchange for undying devotion to him and only him, she would use his Energy to stay forever young and would be able to summon the Hell Demons who served him. The breach was simple: lose the devotion and the contract breaks. He put a finger to her forehead. Dark Energy entered her. Her eyes went crimson, and a blue rune circle appeared in them, the mark of a completed contract with the King of Hell. The body changed with the oath. She rejuvenated, the hair took a golden hue, she grew taller, and the figure became more voluptuous.[752]
Finally, Victor turned toward the physical infrastructure of his religion. He rejected the idea that his faithful should remain scattered throughout hidden basements and improvised temples when he possessed the resources of Hell, multiple Clans and an expanding faction. If something was going to bear his name, Victor wanted it constructed properly. The Blood God Religion consequently began changing from an underground movement into one of the formal pillars of his emerging civilization.[753]

##### Learning the Language of Power
Chapters 714–721
Victor's increasing responsibilities did not stop him from returning to subjects he had never properly mastered. [[Scathach Elderblood Scarlett]] began teaching Victor, Ruby, Siena, Lacus and Pepper about Runes, correcting Victor's assumption that the Demonic inscriptions he had learned in Hell were themselves conventional Runes. Demonic and Divine scripts were languages carrying supernatural authority, but a Rune involved using a language of power, Energy and intention to impose a desired instruction upon Reality. Victor immediately recognized the comparison to programming: the user supplied a command through a symbolic language and Reality executed the instruction if the proper conditions were satisfied.[754]
Runes had enormous versatility but were not omnipotent. They could imitate numerous effects and permanently alter equipment or structures, yet they were generally inferior to the specialized Conceptual or Racial abilities that naturally embodied the phenomenon being reproduced. Their traditional weakness in active combat was equally important: preparing sufficiently complicated instructions normally required concentration and time.[754]
Victor then asked [[Zaladrac Zeovnur Elderblood]] whether Dragons possessed an equivalent language. Her answer introduced him to what Dragons considered the Speak of Power. Ancient Dragons combined Energy, intention and language directly through their voices, forcing Reality to respond to sufficiently authoritative commands. Zaladrac demonstrated the principle by speaking a command equivalent to "Rot" and causing a tree to decay almost instantaneously.[755]
To Victor, the discovery was almost absurdly valuable. What other races approached through slowly constructed Runes, Dragons could potentially reproduce through speech if their understanding and authority were sufficient. His connection with Zaladrac and his own Draconic body allowed Victor to begin learning this system despite not yet possessing a conventional Dragon Soul. Dragon Language and Dragon Runes would later become some of the most important tools in his family because they united inscription, willpower and racial authority within one system.[755]
The following chapters turned toward [[Violet Elderblood Snow]]. Her greatest strength was not merely the Fire inherited from Clan Snow. Violet possessed a terrifying ability to understand Victor emotionally because her obsessive attention had been focused upon him since the earliest period of their relationship. The centuries Victor experienced in Hell had taught him to hide immense portions of himself behind the mentality required of a King, yet Violet could still perceive when the man underneath that role was suppressing something.[756]
Her position as Victor's first wife likewise carried social power far beyond a ceremonial title. Violet had been present before virtually every later relationship, understood the foundations of Victor's family and increasingly acted as the woman capable of organizing wives who possessed radically different cultures, ages and personalities. Victor could overpower almost everyone around him physically, but Violet possessed influence over the household precisely because she understood its emotional structure better than most warriors understood a battlefield.[757][758]
Victor then visited the Fairies living within [[Roxanne Elderblood]]'s territory and spoke with [[Viviane]]. Fairies depended heavily upon [[World Trees]], and the recovery of Roxanne's ecosystem had allowed their population to begin stabilizing again. Victor predictably turned what could have remained a simple welfare check into an opportunity to pull another useful supernatural race more securely into the civilization forming around his family.[759]
The collapsing [[Greek Pantheon]] represented an even larger opportunity. [[Aphrodite]] Elderblood argued that [[Zeus]]' increasingly unstable rule and the Pantheon's internal civil conflict made [[Olympus]] a treasure house waiting to be dismantled. Divine materials, artifacts, resources, talented inhabitants and knowledge accumulated across millennia did not need to disappear merely because the ruling Gods were destroying one another. Victor's faction could simply take what was valuable before someone else did.[760]
[[Otsuki Elderblood Haruna]] meanwhile reached a more personal conclusion regarding Victor. Remaining indefinitely trapped between desire, pride and hesitation would accomplish nothing. The women surrounding Victor were increasingly learning the same lesson his own life embodied: waiting for circumstances to decide everything for them meant surrendering control of their future.[761]

##### A Growing Court and a Journey Ahead
Chapters 722–732
Victor's relationship with Eleonor Adrasteia and [[Rose Adrasteia Elderblood]] led him deeper into the history of Clan Adrasteia. Eleonor explained the First Adrasteia and the traditions through which members of the Clan historically acquired Monster Traits. Victor's own existence made repeating the conventional ritual almost meaningless. His contract with Zaladrac and the accumulation of monstrous physiology inside his body had already carried him far beyond what most Adrasteia transformations were designed to accomplish.[762]
The discussion also touched upon old wishes and promises connecting the women around him, while the household entered an unusually peaceful period. Victor's life had become filled with wars between supernatural civilizations, yet his family could still gather for cinema nights, arguments and ordinary entertainment. These apparently trivial scenes became increasingly meaningful precisely because the scale of everything surrounding them had become so absurd.[763][764]
Victor's relationship with material wealth had likewise changed beyond recognition. Hell, the Vampire Clans and his growing network gave him access to resources that rendered ordinary financial limitations almost irrelevant. Money was not happiness by itself, but Victor considered claims that wealth did not improve life laughably simplistic when wealth could purchase safety, medicine, food, infrastructure, comfort and opportunities for the people he loved. In a lighter moment, Violet stood up emphasizing her assets while declaring that if it was [[Hestia]] she had no problem and he could fill the Virgin Goddess's three holes. She dismissed nobility concerns outright. Sasha called the entire [[Scarlett Clan]] full of masochists, including Ruby in bed. Natashia proudly called herself the most beautiful woman in [[Nightingale]] and stated that being a degenerate is good.[765]
He also interacted more directly with Kali, recognized throughout the Divine world as one of the most dangerous Goddesses alive. Victor was fascinated rather than intimidated by Beings at that level. Every exceptionally powerful individual represented both a future benchmark and another opportunity to understand what existed above his current state.[766][767]
Kali's own name for the throne was the Strongest Goddess, the embodiment of Active Destruction and the counterpart of [[Shiva]]. Her Divinity did not switch off. Speaking could destroy a weaker Being, and a laugh of hers destroyed the temple around her, which then regenerated. She had long blood-red hair floating on Power, a red aura worn like natural armor, and dark red eyes with no irises, a lake of blood full of beings. Victor told her, in the open, that she was the strongest for now, and that she should keep the throne warm because he would take it. She read that with an amused smile and the understanding that nobody could call himself the strongest while she existed. She also knew he understood her Power and had said it anyway.[768]
More personal insecurities surfaced among the women of his family. [[Victoria Fulger Elderblood]] was forced to confront how much of her lifelong obsession with strengthening the Fulger bloodline had developed from a desperate need to earn recognition. The irony was that the family she now possessed no longer required her to prove her worth in order to be loved. Victor and the others wanted Victoria herself rather than merely what she could accomplish for Clan Fulger.[769]
Hestia Elderblood faced a related problem. Her former identity had revolved around the displaced Greek Gods and the Amazons under her protection, yet she had gradually become emotionally integrated into Victor's household without formally acknowledging where she now considered home. Victor openly wanted to draw her fully into that family instead of allowing her to remain permanently at its edge.[770]
The growing number of races and organizations surrounding Victor finally made informal administration insufficient. A meeting among faction leaders produced plans for a new central governmental mansion where representatives of each major race and organization could meet. Noble Vampire representation included figures such as Victoria, Kaguya and Ruby, with alternates necessary because the women also carried responsibilities elsewhere.[771]
The Vampire political landscape changed simultaneously. With Clan Scarlett having effectively abandoned the conventional territorial role it once possessed, Clans Snow and Fulger absorbed much of the remaining Noble population previously connected to Scarlett territory. More importantly, the Snow, Fulger and Scarlett Clans formally announced their alliance with Clan Alucard, while Victor's marriages to Violet, Sasha and Ruby publicly transformed relationships that the supernatural elite had already suspected into official political reality.[771]
Plans surrounding Victor's faction became increasingly ambitious as other monarchs reacted to his rise. His wives learned to expect that every apparently harmless journey involving Victor had a serious chance of becoming an international incident, and consequently prepared forces whenever he mentioned visiting another supernatural civilization.[772]
Before that journey, the faction stopped being a pile of personal loyalties and became a council. A new mansion was set as the seat of government, the place where race representatives and faction leaders would meet, with Alioth teleportation arrays for anyone who lived as far out as Haruna. Snow and Fulger would rule from that same house. Scarlett had effectively given up its old territory, and Snow and Fulger absorbed the Noble Vampires who had lived there. The Council of [[Races (Flamel)|Races]] came out of a vote. Noble Vampires: Victoria, with Kaguya and Ruby as the alternates when she could not sit, chosen because Victoria had already built a financial empire under the name Victoria Rider and because the three of them were the ones who decided logically. Youkai: Kuroka, Haruna being too bound to her own territory. Goddesses: [[Rhea]], after [[Aphrodite]] and Hestia both refused on the grounds that they already had too much work. Fairies: [[Viviane]]. Amazons: [[Meya Neyku]]. Humans: Mizuki, over Liena, because she was the strongest Human and Victor's wife, and because she could watch the Humans living in Snow's new town who were not fully under his control. Demons: Morgana, an ex-demon, because everyone he trusted more was already buried in work. Groups too small for a seat, including [[Medusa]]'s [[Gorgons]] and the same problem Leona's people had, were left without a racial chair. The public announcement that followed was blunter than an alliance communique. Sasha Fulger, Violet Snow and Ruby Scarlett, the heiresses, would marry the Second Progenitor and King of Hell. So would the leaders and the close main-bloodline family. Named on that list: Agnes and Violet of Snow; Victoria and Annasthashia of Fulger; Ruby, Siena, Lacus and Pepper of Scarlett. The high echelon of vampire society was not shocked. They had already known.[773]
Victor's next destination was Samar, the homeworld of the [[Werewolves]]. From his perspective, he intended to visit acquaintances and accompany members of his family. From everyone else's perspective, the Demon King, Vampire Progenitor and head of one of the fastest-growing factions on Earth was about to walk personally into the heart of a historically hostile civilization accompanied by [[Anna Elderblood]], [[Leona Elizabeth Elderblood Lykos]] and [[Natalia Elderblood née Alioth]].[774]

##### A Visitor in the Land of Wolves
Chapters 733–747
Victor traveled to Samar alongside Anderson and his group, encountering a planetary environment substantially different from Earth or [[Nightingale]]. Samar's greater gravity, enormous wilderness and highly physical culture reflected the species dominating the world. Werewolf civilization placed immense emphasis upon strength, hierarchy and the authority of Alphas, making Victor's presence particularly disruptive because his own predatory aura did not naturally recognize the local hierarchy as something to which he should submit.[775][776]
The political consequences arrived almost immediately. [[Volk Fenrir]], King of the [[Werewolves]] and Anderson's father, learned that Victor Alucard had entered his world. Victor did nothing to reassure him. He treated the [[Lycaon|Werewolf King]] with essentially the same irreverence he had historically shown Vlad, ancient Gods and Demon Kings. Being inside another monarch's territory did not cause Victor to pretend that the monarch possessed authority over him personally.[777][778]
Their confrontation became particularly tense when the subject turned toward Leona and Victor's family. Victor made no attempt to portray himself as morally superior to every monster Volk feared. On the contrary, he warned that if someone deliberately threatened those he considered his own, he could become worse than the enemies they imagined him replacing. The vision of what Victor was willing to do when his family was harmed disturbed even the battle-hardened Werewolf King.[779][780]
Victor then encountered Adam Lykos, someone connected to his comparatively ordinary Human past. Their reunion became a physical test rather than a polite conversation. Victor restricted his supernatural abilities and relied upon physical movement, martial technique and observation while fighting Adam, demonstrating how dramatically his skill had changed independent of the increasingly absurd supernatural powers available to him.[781]
He set the rule out loud before they started. No Powers. Physique only. He came out in long wide black pants with red stripes, white wrappings from the hands to just short of the elbow, upper body bare, feet bare. Adam came in full armor with a naginata. The people in the circle were Leona, Anna, Natalia, Kaguya, Bruna, Eve, Roberta and Maria on Victor's side, and on the royal side Volk, Tasha, Fenir, Anderson, [[Thomas Fenrir]], and Maya [[Elizabeth Lykos]]. The chapter records the Charm as strong enough that he pulled attention the way a God of Beauty would. The duel itself is called, not finished, in that chapter.[782]
The fight attracted [[Maya Elizabeth Lykos Elderblood]], ancient Matriarch of Clan Lykos and one of the most dangerous Werewolves on Samar. She stood 187 cm tall with loose snow-white hair to the shoulders, sky-blue eyes, chocolate skin, a warrior-toned body with defined six-pack abs, average balanced breasts under a simple black top with silver wolf designs, tight black pants ripped at the thighs, and black high heels with gold accents—presenting a femme fatale image. Maya's arrival changed the atmosphere immediately. Her [[Will Solace|Will]] and predatory nature were powerful enough to affect surrounding Werewolves merely through proximity, but Victor answered naturally rather than being forced into submission.[783][784][785]
The meeting did not stay a stare. Victor's violet eyes lit and a red aura shot with black covered him, then thickened into pure crimson darkness. His face paled, the hair grew and smoked with Miasma, and the body deformed with it. Maya answered with a wild green aura that went animal: sharper teeth, fur on the arms, hair gone wild, golden energy off the soul, the body's power climbing to a god-level with mid-level combat divinities. The two auras could be seen from far off. Black clouds, red lightning, heat, cold, death and life all moved at once. Volk ended it. One shout of "Enough" pulled them back and sat on both powers. Nobody was described as injured.[786]
Watching Victor fight revealed another problem for Maya. Victor's martial talent allowed him to observe techniques and rapidly understand the principles behind them, adapting information after extraordinarily limited exposure. He was not simply a supernatural creature carrying overwhelming statistics; the centuries spent training in Hell had transformed him into a genuine master whose technical understanding continued increasing every time he encountered someone worth studying.[787][788]
The apparent stability of Samar concealed political fractures within both the Royal Family and the great Werewolf Clans. Those problems became entangled with the arrival of [[Hera]], former Queen of Olympus, whose conflict with [[Zeus]] had progressed to the point where remaining inside the [[Greek Pantheon]] became suicidal.[789]
Victor's wives took an active role in the resulting negotiations. Granting asylum to Hera was not simply an act of charity. A former Queen of Olympus possessed knowledge, political legitimacy and enormous symbolic value, while her successful defection could demonstrate to every other dissatisfied God that Victor's faction represented a genuine alternative to remaining beneath rulers they hated.[790][791]
The bids in the room were blunt. Hera, with difficulty, offered herself to the faction leader. Nyx raised over that and offered the treasure of [[Olympus]]. [[Aphrodite]], [[Hestia]], Violet, Sasha, Morgana, Ruby, Jeanne and [[Scathach]] were in the questioning.[792]
The negotiation also demonstrated how formidable Victor's wives had become collectively. Individually, many were already dangerous. Acting as a coordinated family, they could apply political, emotional and supernatural pressure from multiple directions while Victor barely needed to participate. The household surrounding him was beginning to function as a ruling court rather than a group of powerful women who merely happened to share the same man.[793]

##### Monarchs, Bargains and Hidden Fangs
Chapters 748–767
Victor's status as Demon King became increasingly impossible for Samar to ignore. [[Leona Elizabeth Elderblood Lykos]] openly considered drawing Maya closer to Victor's faction, recognizing that the ancient Matriarch possessed both enormous strength and a mentality unusually compatible with the people surrounding Victor. Maya challenged the idea that Victor could casually ignore the will of an entire nation, only for Victor to explain the principle governing nearly every political decision he made: his sense of honor could restrain him in ordinary conflicts, but when his family was involved, national borders and conventional authority ceased being meaningful obstacles.[794]
The last meaningful separation between Victor and the personality once called Alter also disappeared. Alter had never been an unrelated Soul possessing Victor's body but the embodiment of emotions, impulses and characteristics Victor once compartmentalized. Centuries in Hell and the emotional reconciliation following his return removed the need for such division. What remained was simply Victor—capable of tenderness, tyranny, brutality and affection without pretending those qualities belonged to different people.[795]
Victor's control over Hell likewise became a direct political weapon. He possessed armies of Demons waiting for orders, multiple Generals and the authority of the Demon King of Tyranny, meaning threats against Victor could no longer be evaluated merely by asking how powerful Victor himself was. Any monarch dealing with him was also dealing with an entire infernal civilization.[795][796]
The most important negotiation involved [[Fenrir]]. The ancient Beast of Ragnarök had protected Samar for generations but existed in a condition the Werewolf Royal Family could not easily repair. Victor believed he possessed methods that could help, yet he refused to provide something of such enormous value without receiving something equally significant in return. He invoked the principle of equivalent exchange and provocatively asked Volk for Tasha Fenrir.[797]
Volk's request was the healing. Fenrir was a patient they believed had been hit by a Demonic Curse, debilitated to a near-death state, and Victor already suspected the illness traced to his predecessor using the kingdom's traitors. Victor's price was one sentence: he desired Tasha Fenrir. He called it equivalent exchange, the principle of alchemy and of business. Something that large needed an equal reward. Tasha was watching the whole meeting through cameras hidden in her husband's clothes. Being named as the payment, and watching a man of that level treat her as a counter on a table, put a rage on her face that her own family rarely saw. She was furious at being ignored as a person worth speaking to.[797]
The demand shocked the Werewolf court because Tasha was not merely Volk's wife. She was the Queen of Samar, the administrator responsible for much of the darker and more practical side of Werewolf government, and one of the most capable political figures on the planet. Tasha herself, secretly observing portions of the negotiation, understood Victor's mentality more easily than many others because she had spent her life making similarly ruthless decisions for the sake of her family and country.[797]
The negotiations continued as agreements between monarchs rather than simply a dispute over possession. Victor's interest in Tasha was real, but the broader bargain also involved Fenrir, Samar's security and what each side could actually offer the other. Neither Volk nor Victor could pretend the issue was merely personal once two entire civilizations were affected by their decisions.[798][799]
[[Hestia]] Elderblood simultaneously moved closer to Victor's family, gradually surrendering the emotional distance she had previously maintained. Hell's forces were also displayed more openly, reinforcing that the faction Victor had created was becoming capable of deploying large armies without depending upon [[Nightingale]]'s traditional Vampire forces.[800][801][802]
A particularly revealing conversation occurred between Victor and Anna. Concerned by the increasingly ruthless image her son presented, Anna questioned whether Victor was becoming something monstrous. Victor responded that despite his willingness to commit atrocities against enemies, he did not indiscriminately slaughter innocents. Even when [[Nero]] had nearly been killed during the Youkai conflict, Victor had hunted those he considered responsible rather than exterminating an entire species for existing. His moral line was extreme, personal and often terrifying, but it remained a line rather than simple mindless cruelty.[803]
Victor later visited Tasha privately instead of continuing to speak through Volk and the political machinery around her. He regarded the Queen as an individual whose enormous potential was being wasted by circumstances that forced her to spend most of her existence repairing the mistakes of other people. The conversation deepened their personal relationship while making clear that Victor saw something in Tasha that Samar's existing hierarchy had not fully allowed her to become.[804][805]
The discovery of [[New Dawn]]'s influence inside Samar gave that assessment immediate political consequences. Fenir, the First Prince, had been conspiring with the organization as part of his attempt to obtain power. Volk did not object to competition for the throne in principle; a strong successor challenging weakness was perfectly compatible with Werewolf culture. What he rejected was a prince effectively offering his people as pieces in the plans of an unknown outside organization. Once the evidence became undeniable, Tasha and Volk dismantled Fenir's faction, unintentionally allowing Victor to damage New Dawn's influence on Samar with remarkably little direct effort.[806]
Victor increasingly concluded that Tasha possessed the mentality of a genuine ruler—an Alpha among Alphas—even if the existing structure of Samar had limited how openly she could exercise that nature. His presence consequently changed political calculations throughout the planet. People who had spent decades assuming the Royal Family would continue along predictable lines now had to account for a foreign Demon King whose involvement had already exposed conspirators, emboldened dissatisfied leaders and attracted the attention of the nation's strongest women.[807][808][809][810]
Even a simple walk with Maya inevitably acquired the atmosphere of a date, further alarming members of the Lykos family who understood exactly what tended to happen when powerful women spent sufficient time around Victor.[811][812]
Victor's increasingly dominant presence eventually brought him into direct conflict with Volk himself. To Tasha and Maya, watching Victor overwhelm the [[Lycaon|Werewolf King]] was not merely a spectacle of physical superiority. Werewolf instincts reacted violently to the image of an Alpha capable of dominating another ruler without needing the social structures traditionally supporting authority.[813]
The chapter is not a traded sequence of techniques. Victor filled the room with raw Power until the air itself pressed down, and Volk went quiet. Tasha and Maya watched a foreign King silence the King of Samar without needing the throne, the army, or the customs that normally propped an Alpha up. That was the domination their instincts answered.[814]

##### The Beast and an Ancient Bloodline
Chapters 768–774
Victor finally encountered [[Fenrir]] directly. The Beast of Ragnarök was nothing like an ordinary Werewolf, despite his importance to their civilization. Fenrir's immense body, ancient instincts and connection to forces capable of bringing an End to entire Divine systems placed him in a category that even powerful Gods treated with respect. Victor responded not by approaching him as an animal requiring rescue but as another apex predator whose intelligence and [[Will Solace|Will]] deserved recognition.[815]
The wolf he actually walked up to was debilitated and still beautiful in the way a legendary beast is beautiful: fur of pure white and deep black, celestial blue eyes, the bearing of a king of wolves. Victor floated in, tore his own shirt, flexed, and showed the demonic face on his back. He told Fenrir he was beautiful even weak, apologized for calling him boy, and said he would not wait to be allowed closer. He would come closer, and he would face him as an equal. Tasha had brought him to heal, not to harm. Victor said he did not want a fight against a weakened Fenrir, and then told him to dance anyway. Fenrir roared, leapt, and bit through space. Victor slipped it and punched him in the face inside blood-red energy, and the weakness on the wolf eased instead of deepening. Fenrir answered by coating himself in a green power that felt natural and by roaring hard enough to shake the city, except Victor. Victor's line on the feeling was that this was what confronting the End was like, and that he now understood why [[Odin]] was afraid of him. Maya asked how a Demon King could be loved by the spirits of animals. Victor said that for him, it was possible.[815]
Their first interactions were therefore built upon instinctive testing rather than submission. Fenrir recognized something similarly abnormal within Victor, while Victor found the enormous Wolf fascinating precisely because Fenrir's existence did not fit the ordinary progression of Werewolf strength. What began as an attempt to understand and potentially help him naturally turned into the beginnings of a relationship defined through challenge, respect and the desire to eventually test one another properly.[815][816][817]
The remaining chapters returned attention to Clan Lykos. Leona's maternal family was vastly larger and older than the relatively small group Victor had known during his Human life. The Clan had existed since the earliest periods of Werewolf civilization on Samar and had participated in virtually every major stage of the planet's political history.[818][819]
Particular importance surrounded the name Elizabeth. Maya explained the rare mutation associated with her lineage and the way the trait resurfaced only after multiple generations rather than passing straightforwardly from mother to daughter. [[Leona Elizabeth Elderblood Lykos]] represented the next important inheritor of that legacy, connecting Victor's wife directly to the deeper ancestral power that had made Maya one of Samar's most exceptional [[Werewolves]].[819][820][821]
The mutation itself was put in plain terms. Elizabeth genes let a Werewolf advance the instinctive side faster and lifted the whole set of abilities with it. It was a mutation the Progenitor himself had not had, and it was what had earned the title of strongest Werewolf of her time. Normal Werewolves woke around eighteen to twenty-one. Carriers of this mutation could wake between three and six, which made them stronger and also wrecked their control, so they had to be trained young or the wolf ate the person. Nobody else then living in Clan Lykos carried Elizabeth in the name. Only Leona and Maya's mother did. Leona asked if she had it. The silence she got back was the answer.[819]
Victor therefore left the initial stage of his visit to Samar with considerably more than a diplomatic acquaintance. He had become directly involved with its Royal Family, disrupted [[New Dawn]]'s influence, drawn closer to Tasha and Maya, met Fenrir personally and uncovered another layer of the bloodline carried by Leona. The Werewolf world was no longer a distant faction neighboring [[Nightingale]]; it had become entangled with Victor's family at almost every important level.[821]

##### Underworld Roads and Gathering Gods
Chapters 775–793
While the situation in Samar continued developing, Nyx Elderblood, [[Aphrodite]] Elderblood, [[Scathach Elderblood Scarlett]] and [[Morgana Elderblood]] entered the [[Greek Underworld]]. The realm differed greatly from [[Biblical Hell]]: it was a Divine afterlife system built around Greek authority, with increasingly oppressive conditions closer to [[Tartarus (Realm)|Tartarus]] and a tightly controlled Soul-processing structure at its center.[822]
What they walked into was not a functioning afterlife. Near the River [[Styx]], Nyx's Divine Senses found no Souls and no Underworld creatures. The Souls were gone. Vanished. The four kept a formation anyway, Morgana floating ahead, Nyx and Aphrodite in the middle, and they went toward [[Hecate]]'s domain because they wanted herbs.[822]
The Greek Underworld's Core regulated enormous flows of Souls moving through the realm and could normally be approached only by the highest authorities governing the Underworld. Its existence reinforced an increasingly important lesson for Victor's faction: Hells, Heavens and Pantheons were not merely territories inhabited by Gods. They possessed metaphysical infrastructure responsible for processing Souls and maintaining systems upon which entire populations depended.[822]
Back on Samar, Victor's investigation of the World Tree of Samar similarly expanded his understanding of planetary supernatural structures. [[World Trees]] were not simply giant organisms producing Energy. They supported spiritual ecosystems and dimensional systems, connecting inhabited worlds to the larger mechanisms of Life and Creation.[823][824]
Victor's faction then made what they jokingly treated as an "unexpected visit" into territories whose rulers would have preferred them to remain outside. The distinction between diplomacy and invasion had become increasingly meaningless whenever Victor appeared with enough power that stopping him was not a realistic option.[825]
Several participants changed plans as the scale of Victor's alliance became clearer, while misunderstandings among [[Werewolves]], Vampires and Greek factions threatened to trigger conflicts unrelated to the larger objective.[826][827]
[[Vlad III Tepes|Vlad Tepes]] and [[Volk Fenrir]] eventually discussed Victor directly. Vlad understood better than almost any monarch how dangerous it had become to evaluate Victor according to the status he possessed only a few years earlier. He warned Volk that Victor could no longer be treated as an ambitious young Vampire whose behavior older Kings could simply forbid. Political titles mattered only while everyone involved possessed sufficient power to enforce them.[828][829]
Tasha reached an equally important decision regarding her own future. Remaining passive would simply allow Volk, Victor or the structure of Samar to decide what she became. The Queen began choosing for herself, accelerating changes already produced by Victor's presence.[830]
The Greek conflict moved toward its decisive stage while increasingly dangerous Beings gathered around Victor. The old supernatural order had been built upon the assumption that Progenitors, Gods, Demons and members of different Pantheons could rarely cooperate for long. Victor's relationships were systematically destroying that assumption.[831][832][833][834][835]
Hecate was waiting for them, and she named the group as goddesses, demons, and a god killer. She stood 177 centimeters, black hair to the shoulders, black eyes, a black dress with red and gold, slender. Her title was Goddess of Magic. The magic was not witchcraft. Hers ran on Divine Power, stronger in raw output and poorer in versatility. Witchcraft covered the elements and could reach darkness and light. [[Merlin]]'s line, repeated there, was that Energy was Energy and the wielder decided the rest. Aphrodite did not ask for an alliance. She pointed at a distant garden of gray and black plants. Hecate asked if they were kidding, bringing enough military power to destroy several Gods in order to steal weeds. Aphrodite said she was looking at the group that had done exactly that. Hecate told them to take as much as they wanted and leave. They bagged the plants in dimensional space. She still gave them a painting.[836]
[[Hera]] remained absolutely determined to see [[Zeus]] fall after his betrayals and the destruction of their marriage. Victor's group also encountered Hecate, the eccentric Goddess of Magic. Hecate's Divine [[Magic]] differed from Witchcraft despite superficial similarities: her spells relied far more heavily upon [[Divine Energy]] and could produce greater raw potency in certain applications, while Witch Magic remained considerably more flexible across different systems and Elements.[837][838]
The journey deeper into the Greek conflict brought together Beings who would once have considered cooperation almost impossible, including multiple Progenitor-level entities and ancient rulers. Their combined operation demonstrated how thoroughly Victor's personal relationships had begun overriding the traditional divisions separating species and Pantheons.[839][840][841]

##### A Legend in the Making
Chapters 794–805
The operation changed dramatically when [[Erebus]] revealed himself inside the [[Greek Underworld]]. Nyx immediately recognized her counterpart, forcing the group into a confrontation involving powers operating at the level of [[Primordial Gods]]. Erebus' presence exposed that the collapse of [[Olympus]] was considerably more complicated than a conflict between [[Zeus]] and his immediate family.[842]
Victor entered the escalating conflict as the Demon King of Tyranny. Rather than continue operating through proxy battles and political manipulation, he moved openly against the assembled Greek forces.[843]
The result became one of the greatest displays of Victor's power up to that point. Gods attacked him in numbers that would normally overwhelm nearly any individual combatant, but Victor possessed an ability specifically suited to turning Divine armies against themselves. His attacks could sever Souls, meaning Gods he killed did not simply enter the temporary incapacitated state through which Divine Beings could often eventually recover. Their deaths became genuine, and those same dead Gods were immediately incorporated into the immortal forces controlled by the Demon King.[844]
The psychological effect was nearly as destructive as the attacks themselves. Every God Victor killed strengthened the army fighting beside him, turning conventional numerical superiority into a liability. The spectacle shocked even Beings such as Erebus and [[Tartarus (Realm)|Tartarus]] who had spent enormous periods observing supernatural conflicts.[844]
The fight was fought from a throne of blood. Victor floated above the Greek Underworld and put Soul-severing into every attack he made through Blood, so a God who fell did not get the usual Divine recovery. The dead rose at once as his immortal army. Zeus, [[Poseidon]], [[Athena]], [[Ares]], [[Helios]], [[Apollo]] and the rest of the Pantheon were in that battle, and [[Titans]] died on both sides until mostly elites were left. Maria, Eve, Roberta, Bruna and Kaguya took Blood-covered weapons and were sent after Gods other than Poseidon and Athena. [[Scathach]] entered her Vampire Count form, covered a spear in Blood, and took Helios.
