Morgana fought with the demon claws she had from Marbas, dream, and radiation, and she killed Ares by driving a claw through his heart. [[Medusa]] called a giant snake made of snakes and went after Poseidon and Athena for what they had done to her. [[Persephone]] held Gods down and prepared an army of her own.[844]
Zeus responded by drawing increasingly deeply upon the power of Olympus itself. The [[Master Bolt]], long treated as one of the symbols of his rule, was sacrificed in exchange for greater access to the Pantheon's authority. By damaging his own Divine infrastructure to strengthen himself, Zeus turned the civil conflict into a threat against Olympus as a functioning realm.[844][845]
He broke the Master Bolt in half. The weapon that had been the symbol of his rule was spent so he could drag the territory of Olympus itself into the Underworld, and the lightning that followed was the Pantheon tearing its own house open to keep him standing. Victor answered with the Sea of Blood, Roxanne supporting the split of the field, a demonic side set against the territory Zeus had just restored. The price on Zeus's side was more than ninety percent of his forces. [[Kronos]]'s side lost more than seventy percent, and what remained were injured elites: [[Atlas]] was down to one arm, Ares was weakened, and Athena came to ask for a cease-fire with half her arms corroded and her legs ruined. Victor refused. He told them Olympus would be annihilated, and that this was not a war, it was genocide. Zeus still called the barrier of Mount Olympus unbreakable. [[Dionysus]] wet himself.[845]
The confrontation eventually involved Zeus, Kronos and increasingly ancient powers associated with the [[Greek Pantheon]]. Victor continued adapting as the conflict escalated, while [[Hera]], Persephone and others who had suffered because of Zeus' decisions found themselves participating directly in the collapse of his reign.[845][846]
Victor then confronted forces associated with Tartarus, Erebus and [[Nocturnus]]. Nocturnus in particular embodied an artificial combination of opposing properties and powers connected to the Void, forcing Victor to fight phenomena substantially different from ordinary elemental or Divine attacks.[847][848][849]
Erebus named himself the Darkness of Olympus and poured that darkness out of his body until vision failed and a small black hole formed. Nocturnus, God of the Void, answered an attack with a singularity and fought with a void spear that ignored the Concepts of Speed and Time. The spear opened a hole through Victor's stomach. Victor coughed blood, regenerated in milliseconds, turned his gauntlet into a greatsword wrapped in pure Negative Energy, and cut vertically through the darkness, the black hole, and Nocturnus's face. Nocturnus screamed that his face was gone and cursed Alucard. Tartarus fought as a Primordial whose territory was portals and hands: red flame, a portal opened under Victor so burning hands could seize his legs, and the warning of a Breath still coming. Victor went back to gauntlets to hold that, roared a beam of pure violet destruction, and used Red Lightning to get behind Nocturnus, only for darkness to block the follow-up. He was losing ground. He was also wounding them, reading the dark with an enhanced gaze, and stacking Negative Energy, Soul, the Draconic body and [[Martial Arts]] into the same exchange. Tartarus told him he had held on well for a mortal and that he would still lose. Victor told him he did not know him.[850]
The pressure finally forced a transformation that had been developing throughout Victor's relationship with Zaladrac and his Progenitor nature. His Vampire and Dragon characteristics ceased functioning as two systems inhabiting the same body and fused into a genuinely new racial existence.[851]
What finished the change was eating the Primordial God who stood second in age after [[Gaia]]. Victor appeared in the air with the Draconic and Vampiric traits of his Progenitor form fused into one body. His hair was long and black and made of miasma. The pupils glowed violet shot through with crimson. The wings opened, and for a moment everyone who saw him felt small. He lost the status of Progenitor of Vampires in that moment and took a narrower, higher one. The chapter names him the Primogenitor of Vampyric Dragons: the First, the Beginning, the Only One, the one who stands above every Dragon species and every Vampire species. Zaladrac watched it from [[Nightingale]]. A new race had been born, and the thing born with it was a Progenitor.[851]
The significance was immediately perceived by the cosmic administrators. Victor was no longer simply the Second Progenitor who had acquired a Dragon body. He became the Primogenitor of the Draconic Vampires, the origin point of an entirely new Dragon race combining the fundamental qualities of Dragons and Vampires.[851][852]
His new position was extraordinary even by Progenitor standards. The cosmic observers described him as a Progenitor standing above the existing Dragon and Vampire subspecies—the First and Beginning of a legitimate new lineage. The anomaly surrounding his prior state disappeared when the transformation completed, allowing the Balance of Creation to recognize his existence properly.[852]
Victor rapidly tested what his new existence meant. Enemies who would previously have demanded prolonged battles could be removed, overwhelmed or displaced through powers operating on a fundamentally greater scale. Yet he refused to simply destroy Olympus and walk away. Having won, he intended to decide what happened to the territory, surviving population, Divine resources and metaphysical systems left behind.[852][853]
The [[Regulators of Existence]] consequently gathered to discuss what Victor had done. [[The Universal Tree]], The Owner of Limbo, [[The Judges of The Abyss]] and [[True Death]] considered both Victor's new race and the changes occurring throughout Earth's spiritual infrastructure. Victor intended to merge or reorganize portions of the Greek Underworld alongside [[Biblical Hell]], something the Judges themselves acknowledged aligned with reforms that had already become necessary because several infernal dimensions served little useful purpose in their existing state.[854]
Their discussion also revealed another development already beginning elsewhere: the Convergence associated with the Witches of [[The Arcane Realm]]. Even as one major supernatural system collapsed beneath Victor, another problem was forming through experiments with powers whose consequences the Witches did not completely understand.[854]

##### What Remains After Olympus
Chapters 806–818
Victor initially struggled with something deceptively simple after his transformation: movement. His new Draconic-Vampiric body possessed proportions, weight distribution, instincts and capabilities different enough from his previous form that relying completely upon ingrained habits could create openings. Rather than assuming greater power automatically made him a better fighter, Victor returned to fundamentals and relearned how his own body moved.[855]
Hours later he was still in the Dragonoid form, floating inches off the ground, because everything about the body had changed at once and the old habits no longer fit. He put himself back on the basics. It was the same problem he had had in [[Diablo]]'s time, with one difference: he was already used to fighting in a humanoid shape close to this one, so his combat prowess had not dropped far. He had not mastered the body. That was the work in front of him. Natashia, [[Aphrodite]], [[Scathach]], Morgana and the Maids looked at his body with thirsty and curious eyes. [[Meya Neyku]] bit her lips wanting to touch him. Aphrodite called them thirsty; Jeanne admitted his scent was addictive and that as a Dragon Progenitor he drew her in. Eleonor nearly lost control, her body shifting toward Draconic traits as she thought she needed his child now; Rose slapped her to regain composure.[856]
The victory over [[Olympus]] then allowed him to fulfill promises made long before he possessed the strength to enforce them. Surviving Gods and prisoners were not judged collectively. Victor allowed people harmed by the Pantheon to confront specific individuals responsible for their suffering, including [[Medusa]] and women within his own family. Revenge, justice and practical usefulness were evaluated separately rather than every captured God receiving the same punishment merely because they belonged to Olympus.[857][858][859][860]
The process brought Victor into contact with the deeper machinery of the [[Greek Underworld]] and its Souls, further increasing his knowledge of how Divine afterlives functioned.[861]
One of the most emotional consequences involved [[Adonis Snow]]. Victor's access to Soul-related powers and information preserved in the [[Akashic Records]] allowed him to reconstruct an informational echo of Adonis rather than literally reversing history. The Being who awakened possessed Adonis' memories and personality corresponding to the period preserved before his death, effectively allowing the man to temporarily exist again without pretending his original death had never happened.[862]
The method was not a resurrection. Victor followed the programming the Primordial beings had left and pulled a record that existed only inside the Akashic Records. Adonis woke as an echo of the past, and he woke inside Victor's Soul, operating there alongside tens of thousands of other beings. The man looking back at him was the Count, the Blood Dragon Progenitor. Roxanne and [[Thanatos]] were part of that meeting, and the presences of Agnes, Violet, [[Persephone]] and Aphrodite were confirmed to him from inside that same Soul.[862]
Adonis quickly realized how absurdly much had changed. The young Vampire connected to Violet whom he once knew had become a Blood Dragon Primogenitor, Demon King and one of the most powerful entities active around Earth. More importantly, his family had changed in ways he could never have predicted.[862][863]
Victor allowed Adonis to interact with [[Agnes Elderblood Snow]], [[Violet Elderblood Snow]], Persephone and others whose lives remained marked by him. The encounter gave them something his sudden death had denied: an opportunity to say what could no longer be said to the dead and allow Adonis himself to understand what his family had become without him.[864][865]
Another unexpected discovery involved [[Metis]] Elderblood. [[Zeus]]' first wife had not been completely destroyed. Her Soul had instead been divided, with surviving portions existing through Zeus and [[Athena]]. Victor recovered the fragments and placed them within his Personal Universe where they could begin reconstructing themselves.[866]
Metis' Soul was so badly damaged that ordinary recovery proved impossible. It instinctively absorbed the overwhelming quantities of Victor's Energy saturating his internal world, incorporating that power into the process of rebuilding itself. When Metis finally awakened, her Soul possessed the form of a Dragon and the Essence of a Goddess. Her appearance carried characteristics connected to Victor, and she instinctively addressed him as her father.[867]
Victor's family therefore gained another daughter through circumstances no one could reasonably have predicted. Rather than obsess over the absurdity, Victor accepted the relationship in the same way he consistently responded to children who genuinely became his: whatever history had produced Metis, the girl standing before him was now family.[867]
Upon returning to [[Nightingale]], Victor encountered Zaladrac again and prepared another transformation much closer to his heart. [[Scathach Elderblood Scarlett]], already his wife and one of the greatest martial artists alive, underwent an evolution through the Draconic lineage connected to Victor.[868]
Scathach retained the exceptional traits that had defined her—her affinities, [[Martial Arts]] and centuries of accumulated experience—while gaining the physiology and potential of a genuine Dragon Ancestor. Her evolution marked the beginning of another branch of the Draconic family surrounding Victor and demonstrated that his new race would not remain confined to Victor himself.[868]
The body that came out of it was specific. Two dragon wings of red scales opened and dumped their Power in one gust. Two horns of the same red rose with them. Her crimson eyes did not change color; they narrowed like a reptile's. She grew those last few centimeters to two meters, Victor's height. The red hair went more vivid, and the new height made her look bulkier until one looked again and saw that the figure had simply been redrawn around the height. The name the rebirth carried was Scathach Alucard Scarlett, Ancestor of the Red Dragons, the line known for mastery of Fire and Ice and for taking other people's Martial Arts apart and keeping what worked.[868]

##### Building a World, Opening a Door
Chapters 819–836
[[Scathach]]'s transformation was followed by one of Victor's most ambitious projects. His family possessed territories, mansions and dimensions scattered through several supernatural civilizations, but Victor wanted something entirely their own: a complete home-world capable of serving as sanctuary, capital and foundation for the civilization growing around them.[869]
The project could not be accomplished simply by creating a large sphere of rock. Victor gathered the abilities of [[Gaia]] Elderblood, Nyx Elderblood, [[Natalia Elderblood née Alioth]], [[Jeanne Elderblood]] and others capable of controlling the systems required for a functioning planet. Matter had to be assembled on a planetary scale, continents and oceans formed, atmosphere stabilized and supernatural conditions integrated into a coherent world.[869][870][871]
His own statement of the project was smaller than the labor and larger than a house. He was going to create a new dimension where they would live.[869]
The involvement of [[The Universal Tree]] demonstrated how incomplete ordinary definitions of planetary creation were. A genuinely living supernatural world needed integration with the larger systems governing Life, Souls and planetary development. Simply creating matter did not automatically make an artificial planet equivalent to a naturally developed world connected to Creation's deeper mechanisms.[872]
The Universal Tree also reunited with Jeanne, reinforcing the unusual familial relationship between the cosmic mechanism governing Life and the woman Victor had brought into his household.[872]
Once stabilized, the new planet became a private paradise and future central territory for Victor's family. Victor, Scathach and Zaladrac traveled through the world establishing Runes, Draconic protections and defensive systems intended to make an invasion extraordinarily difficult even if an enemy somehow located the realm.[873][874]
Victor then spent time with [[Violet Elderblood Snow]], [[Ruby Elderblood Scarlett]] and [[Sasha Elderblood Fulger]], the three women whose ritual had started his supernatural life. The contrast was enormous. Their relationship had begun with a young man newly transformed into a Vampire; they now stood together upon a world their family had literally created.[875]
News of Victor's transformation and conquest of [[Olympus]] spread throughout the Divine world. His existence increasingly demonstrated that the word God by itself did not guarantee supremacy. A Being could possess Divinity and still stand below Progenitors, Dragons or other entities whose racial and conceptual foundations vastly exceeded those of ordinary deities.[876][877]
Additional Draconic developments followed as Victor's new race and the Dragons surrounding him changed how the family understood its future.[878]
Meanwhile, [[Albedo Moriarty Elderblood]], [[Evie Moriarty Elderblood]] and the Witches of [[The Arcane Realm]] continued conducting dangerous experiments with dimensional travel. Their work finally produced a portal connecting Arcane to an entirely different inhabited world.[879][880][881]
The connection was not one-sided. Beings on the opposite world eventually interacted with the portal as well, transforming a scientific breakthrough into a potential invasion route. Victor crossed the threshold and encountered a civilization completely separate from Earth's established supernatural societies.[882]
Among its defenders was Alfey, a disciplined warrior carrying Blessings originating from multiple Gods of his world. Individually, those Gods did not necessarily exceed the strongest entities Victor already knew. The real danger was organizational: the Pantheon acted as a unified military and Divine system rather than wasting most of its strength fighting internal wars. A civilization of moderately powerful Gods cooperating efficiently could be more dangerous than several individually superior Gods constantly sabotaging one another.[882]
The man who came through first wore silver and gold armor, carried a large shield and a golden sword shedding divine light, and attacked while shouting in a language they did not know. Victor counted the Blessings on him out loud and did not stop at ten. He reached twenty, light and dark both, and called the set holy. The sword absorbed, the armor repelled, and the man was the intermediary between them. Alfey himself was a paladin of long golden hair, green eyes and a square face, human or close to it. Victor went through the portal on dragon wings with red Energy pouring off him, took control of the portal, and burst that red Energy until the gravity of the place changed and the Gods on the other side, who had been ready for an invasion, were staring at something they had thought themselves above. He pointed at a black-haired man, told him to get stronger, said he would return, and the portal closed behind him.[882]
Victor overwhelmed the immediate threat and returned to Arcane with a warning. Had someone weaker than Victor answered the portal, the Witches might have accidentally opened their home directly to a civilization capable of conquering them.[883]
The situation attracted [[Thoth]] and [[Khons]], Egyptian Gods secretly observing the anomaly. Victor detected their surveillance and made it unmistakably clear that spying on his allies without permission would not be tolerated.[884]
The most dangerous consequence, however, was not military. The two connected worlds experienced Time differently, and manipulation occurring on the foreign side began leaking through the portal into Arcane. What the Witches had created was no longer merely a stable doorway joining two spatial coordinates; incompatible temporal conditions were contaminating one another through the connection.[885]
The Universal Tree and [[The Judges of The Abyss]] were forced to intervene because continued interference could affect systems extending far beyond either laboratory. The incident reinforced how recklessly dangerous dimensional research could become once Space and Time were treated as engineering problems rather than immutable boundaries.[885]
For Victor's wives and allies, the foreign civilization also carried a simpler lesson. Earth, [[Nightingale]] and Samar were not the entire world. Civilizations existed beyond their known territories with different Gods, military doctrines and supernatural systems. Waiting until those civilizations arrived before becoming stronger was no longer acceptable.[886]

##### The Tower That Makes Monsters
Chapters 837–845
Victor responded to the growing difference between his own strength and that of his family through the Tower of Nightmare. He supplied the structure with approximately five hundred million Souls as an initial foundation and transformed it into a massive training environment containing 777 floors. Difficulty increased continuously, with the upper floors containing opponents at High-Level God and eventually Primordial-God standards reconstructed from Beings Victor had previously killed or absorbed.[887]
Time inside the Tower moved differently from outside. Using principles associated with Time that Victor had acquired from [[Kronos]], approximately six months of internal experience could occur while only a few days passed externally. The purpose was therefore not merely to create another dangerous dungeon; it allowed Victor's family to accumulate combat experience at rates otherwise requiring centuries.[887]
The numbers were exact. Five hundred million Souls went in first, a gesture from Roxanne pulling them out of Victor's body toward the Tower, and he treated that number as nothing beside what he was already storing. Seven hundred seventy-seven floors. From the seven hundredth floor upward the opponents were High-Level Gods. The last floors were [[Primordial Gods]] he had absorbed. The time ratio he stole from Kronos was six months inside for three days outside, and the women sent in were not allowed to leave before those six months were done. Violet, Ruby and Sasha were the first three, snapped out of the room and onto screens. The rule he repeated was not to underestimate the opponent, because the Tower would not give them favorable ground. The method was fight, die, take traces of Soul, drink the Blood he had stored in the Tower, and repeat, because a Soul only showed what it could do when it was near its end. Ruby's head hit the ground, something pierced skull and heart together, and she woke back in the room. Victor hated watching it. He sent them anyway.[887]
Its true design was considerably harsher than Victor initially explained. Participants would fight, lose, die and awaken again. The Tower prevented permanent death under the intended circumstances while using extreme near-death states, Victor's blood and traces of Soul Energy to nurture the participants' own Souls. Victor hated watching the women he loved repeatedly suffer and die, even knowing they would return, but refused to disrespect their determination by denying them the method simply because it was painful for him emotionally.[887]
The environments were intentionally unpredictable. A participant specialized in Ice could encounter creatures resistant to Ice, narrow spaces preventing preferred weapons, genuine sunlight or monsters carrying abilities their species normally should not possess. Victor wanted to eliminate the habit of assuming that knowledge of an enemy's race automatically meant knowing what the enemy could do.[887]
Violet, Ruby and Sasha became among the first major participants, repeatedly confronting scenarios designed to punish arrogance, specialization and predictable behavior. Other women eventually entered after seeing the results and refusing to remain behind while Victor's original wives continued improving.[888][889][890][891]
Victor also passed accumulated combat knowledge to members of his family. Memories and techniques taken from enemies such as [[Zeus]] could be examined and adapted rather than merely remaining useless information stored inside Victor's mind. Natashia, for example, gained access to exceptionally refined knowledge concerning Lightning while Victor himself improved techniques that even Zeus had failed to perfect completely because of the cognitive demands involved.[892]
Events outside the Tower returned attention to Werewolf conflicts, which Victor characteristically made more chaotic simply because observing strong predators compete entertained him.[893]
More importantly, Victor began considering what his own true nature had become. Several supernatural species responded to him instinctively in ways that exceeded normal Progenitor authority. A Vampire Progenitor naturally affected Vampires and a Werewolf Alpha affected Wolves, yet Victor increasingly triggered submission, fear or recognition across species whose biological hierarchies should have been unrelated.[894][895]
His existence was becoming increasingly difficult to explain through the simple categories he had accumulated—Vampire, Demon King, Dragon or Progenitor. Each remained true, but none alone described what the combination was producing.[895]

##### An Alpha Among Alphas
Chapters 846–858
Changes surrounding [[Tasha Fenrir Elderblood]] accelerated as her relationship with Victor, Samar and her own identity evolved. Years spent functioning as the competent Queen behind the Werewolf throne had already demonstrated her ability to lead, but Victor continuously pushed her to acknowledge qualities she had spent too long using only for the benefit of other people. She found herself wanting to be his, wanting him to love her that way, wanting him to take her from behind and fuck her so hard that he deposited all his fertile seeds inside her and put a child inside her womb.[896][897][898]
Her development culminated in genuine Divinity. Tasha awakened not merely as a Goddess associated with one particular wolf species, but with an authority extending across the Wolf Race and its subspecies. Her Divine transformation produced a status comparable in broad principle to racial Goddesses such as Lilith, although the exact nature of their positions differed.[899]
When the golden light broke, the woman standing there was two meters tall. A long black wolf tail hung behind her, marked in gold stripes like tattoos. The same stripes ran her body and gathered on the face until the features read as a wolf's. The eyes narrowed, the ears came forward, the body filled out, and the black hair went wild down to her knees. Victor, Maya, [[Scathach]], Volk and [[Metis]] were there to see it. Tasha did not celebrate the change. She used the new influence, silenced Volk with a look, took hold of his body with an invisible force, and began to pull something out of him with her left hand.[899]
The transformation validated Victor's earlier assessment of Tasha as an Alpha among Alphas. The woman whose role had been defined through marriage to Volk now possessed a Divine identity capable of standing independently at the head of an entire racial category.[899][900][901][902]
Victor then resumed his confrontation with [[Fenrir]]. The ancient Wolf possessed a connection to The End allowing him to interfere with Concepts themselves rather than simply overpower conventional attacks. Fenrir could effectively disregard portions of the rules upon which ordinary abilities depended, making him an exceptionally dangerous enemy for Gods whose combat styles relied entirely upon fixed Divine Concepts.[902][903]
The battle became another accelerated learning experience for Victor. Fenrir improved as the fight continued, adjusting his senses and attacks to Victor's speed and movements, but Victor was equally adaptive. Every exchange supplied information he immediately incorporated into his [[Martial Arts]] and countermeasures.[903]
Fenrir's use of END was not a stronger claw. He roared, covered his paws in colorless power, and the roar deleted the Energy and the objects in a straight line until that stretch of space was an abyss. He could put END into the claws, the teeth, and the inside of the attack and throw it, which was not how [[Typhon]] had used the same concept. Victor was reading five seconds ahead. He kicked Fenrir in the face, then used the strike he called one punch, one million hits, driven up to one billion hits inside a burst of pure red plasma-like power. He stopped the fight himself. END had already ruined the battlefield, and training on ground that no longer existed was useless. Death arrived, looked at the deleted stretch, and put it back with a gesture, the way one undoes a stroke. The warning that followed was not male and not female: do not abuse the power, it has a purpose, do not go against it. They went back to training without END. Victor asked for help concerning [[Odin]] before they left.[903]
The relationship between Victor and Tasha meanwhile ceased being plausibly describable as simple political cooperation. Victor made his possessiveness explicit. If people disapproved of his decision to claim a woman who had willingly chosen him, he considered that their problem rather than his. Tasha, with Middle Eastern and European features, bronzed skin, long straight black hair, and voluptuous breasts, jumped up and wrapped her legs around his waist during a passionate, predatory kiss. Pure female pheromones exploded from her body. She attacked him demanding a room immediately. Victor's Draconic pheromones bombarded her, making her entire existence feel that this strong male wanted her.[904]
The chapter between the Fenrir fight and that claim is the one the chronology had skipped. Victor was in the palace bath, still turning the fight over, close to something he could not yet name. Scathach came in jealous of the Queen of Wolves and of the attention being pulled off her. She climbed onto his lap and impaled herself on him, the Junior Dragon invading her completely. She used techniques learned from [[Aphrodite]] and Morgana while water splashed. Victor bit her neck; she had an orgasm so intense her eyes rolled back and all the liquid inside her exploded with force, expelling the water from the bathtub. She came for a long minute. She bit him in return. Both assumed True Forms with horns and wings. Metis, outside, could not retract a pair of wings the draconic instinct had forced out of her, smelled the scent, and left for the ice rather than walk into that room. What the conversation settled, besides her place as the master who had sculpted him at the start, was the shape of the fused race. The dragon side had amplified what the vampire side already was and had erased most vampire weaknesses, because the dragon physiology sat above them. What remained was vulnerability to anti-dragon weapons, which he meant to close. Her advice when he was stuck was the same thing she had learned in her own enlightenment: go back to the basics.[905]
Tasha ultimately entered Victor's family as a genuine romantic partner rather than merely an allied Queen. Afterward she lay on his body, still connected, white liquids leaking from every hole that had been explored—including ones never used with her former husband—and she loved every second. The amount of seed released was ridiculous; his tool pierced her uterus. She purred as more warm white liquids filled her insides. As a Progenitor Wolf Goddess with a toned tanned body and straight black hair, and Victor as Progenitor Dragon, both had the stamina to continue indefinitely. Her Egyptian heritage, Werewolf authority and newly awakened Divinity gave Victor's family another powerful connection between supernatural civilizations that had historically considered one another enemies.[906][907]
The period concluded with multiple surprises emerging among Victor's family and the Tower's participants. The most serious occurred only hours before the next Meeting of Supernatural Beings, when Natashia Elderblood Fulger suddenly collapsed in overwhelming spiritual pain.[908]

##### Old Blood and a Gathering of Powers
Chapters 859–872
Victor immediately examined Natashia and realized her problem was not physical. Deep within the core of her Soul he discovered two additional presences whose existence explained abnormalities that had surrounded the Fulger family for centuries: [[Natasha Elderblood Fulger]] and [[Carmila Fulger Elderblood]].[909]
Carmila, the original Countess connected to Clan Fulger's history, revealed that her remaining Soul had become attached to Natashia while attempting to save her daughter from the lethal consequences of the Fulger bloodline's overwhelming Lightning. The process damaged and fractured Natashia's developing Soul, with one portion eventually becoming the personality known as Natasha.[909]
What Victor saw when he went in was more immediate than the old history. He teleported to her, looked with draconic eyes, and sent a fragment of his own consciousness into the core while Roxanne guarded the body. Two blonde women who resembled Natashia were standing over a third who lay on the floor. The core was damaged in two places. He caught both women by the neck, crimson-violet eyes reading the fragments, and let them go once he was sure they were not there to harm her. Natashia and Natasha were the same person split by facet: Natasha the worst side, Natashia the best. Carmila Fulger, once called the strongest Fulger and the Fulger Knight, had a different reason for the damage sitting in front of them. The Tower and Victor's Blood had pushed Natashia so far that she was about to evolve into a High-Level Spirit, and that evolution would have killed her. Carmila damaged the Soul Core to weaken it and stop the death. Victor healed what he could with World Tree power and Soul power. He was already thinking of the longer fix, turning Natashia into a Spiritual Being so the evolution would not kill her the next time it arrived.[909]
Victor's initial reaction to finding foreign Souls buried inside his wife was predictably violent, but the circumstances forced him to distinguish malicious possession from a desperate attempt by a mother to preserve her child. Rather than destroying either presence, Victor repaired Natashia's damaged spiritual foundation so that her existence no longer depended upon the fragments remaining inside her.[909][910]
Carmila and Natasha could consequently separate into independent existences. For the first time, Carmila, Natashia and Sasha could physically stand together as three generations of Fulger women rather than existing through memories, fragmented Souls and inherited trauma.[910][911]
The separation was mechanical. Victor turned Natashia into a vampire with spirit-like characteristics, the same kind of change Clan Adrasteia used, and the body threw out every spirit that was not hers. Carmila's soul had clung on at the moment of her own death. Natasha, whom he renamed Naty so the two would not be confused, had been born the day Natashia's psyche broke after she saw her mother killed. A Progenitor's power can destroy a soul and edit a soul. It cannot create one. After the expulsion, Natashia's core was no longer damaged. Carmila and Naty were sent to the Nightmare Tower until the problem with Sasha and Victoria was dealt with. The three generations could stand in one room because the extra souls were no longer living inside the daughter.[910]
Victor refused to let Natashia blame herself for circumstances that had begun before she possessed any control over them. The family was finally given the opportunity to confront centuries of misunderstanding without pretending the emotional consequences could be repaired instantly.[912]
Only after resolving the immediate crisis did Victor leave for the [[Supernatural Gathering]]. The significance of his arrival was completely different from previous meetings. Victor no longer entered as the newly risen Second Progenitor whom older factions could patronize. He arrived backed by Vampires, Demons, Dragons, [[Werewolves]], Gods, Witches, Amazons and numerous other groups whose loyalties had converged around him.[913][914]
The atmosphere of the Gathering changed simply because Victor entered it. Even cosmic observers such as The Owner of Limbo recognized the characteristics associated with beings capable of eventually becoming Overlords: overwhelming presence, authority and the ability to cause other rulers to unconsciously reorganize themselves around one's arrival.[915][916]
Victor's unusual existence attracted analysis from individuals familiar with civilizations far beyond Earth's scale. His fusion of Dragon and Vampire biology, enormous reservoir of Negative Energy and status as a Progenitor made him an anomaly even by the standards of experienced interstellar observers.[917]
The discussion eventually turned toward Hell and the species under Victor's rule. When other supernatural leaders attempted to dismiss Demons collectively as monsters, Victor rejected the distinction. Demons were capable of brutality, but so were Humans, Gods, Vampires and virtually every intelligent species represented at the Gathering. Under Victor's laws, Demons capable of obeying society were citizens; individuals who behaved like monsters would be judged for what they did rather than what race they belonged to.[918][919]
Victor formally named his emerging Pantheon Dragon's Nest. The name was registered by the greater System, recognizing the new faction as a genuine Pantheon. Unlike traditional Pantheons constructed primarily around one culture or Divine race, Dragon's Nest openly accepted Dragons, Vampires, Demons, Angels, Werewolves, Youkai, Humans, extraterrestrial species and others so long as they accepted Victor's leadership.[918]
The Gathering nevertheless proved that diplomacy could no longer indefinitely delay the conflict surrounding [[New Dawn]], the [[Egyptian Pantheon]] and the Elder Gods connected to the conspiracy. Victor refused another cycle in which his enemies attacked his family, withdrew behind political protections and were allowed time to prepare the next attempt.[920]
War was declared, but the reaction of Victor's allies made the word almost misleading. Against enemies already surrounded by the [[Heavenly Father]], the Shinto Gods, portions of the Celtic faction, Victor's military, Werewolves, Demons and numerous other forces, what followed increasingly resembled a coordinated purge rather than a balanced war.[921][922]

##### The Hunt Beyond the Old Order
Chapters 873–888
Once the Gathering ended, the promised war began as a hunt. The coalition assembled against Victor's enemies demonstrated how completely his political position had changed. Heaven contributed powerful Angels such as [[Azrael]] and Ariel, the [[Celtic Pantheon]] sent major Gods, the [[Shinto Pantheon]] contributed warriors such as Susanoo and [[Takemikazuchi]], while [[Shiva]] intended to confront Elder Gods personally. Victor's enemies were no longer facing one unusually powerful Vampire faction; they were facing a network connecting multiple major supernatural civilizations.[923]
Victor divided responsibilities according to capability instead of attempting to personally occupy every battlefield. The strategy reflected the administrative lessons he had spent the entire volume learning. A King who needed to perform every task himself had not actually built a functioning kingdom.[924]
His personal attention first fell upon the [[Egyptian Pantheon]] and Ra. Victor's rage was not reduced by Ra's attempt to blame Seth or manipulation for the actions taken against his family. From Victor's perspective, Ra had been the ruler who allowed the plot to threaten his wives and daughters; whether he had been deceived did not erase responsibility.[925][926]
Victor demonstrated just how dangerous his developing Soul abilities had become. Rather than merely killing Ra, he directly attacked the structure of the Primordial God's Soul and extracted the Divine foundation connecting him to the Sun. Victor consumed Ra's Sun Divinity, establishing a connection with the Sun inside his own personal world and gaining direct use of that power.[926]
The method was an edit, not a blast. Victor put Soul Power into Ra's heavy Soul and tore a significant piece out of it while Ra screamed. He then pulled his hand back out of the chest with the heart and a golden Energy still in it, swallowed the heart, and took the Power of the Sun. A mini-sun sat in his palm, and a connection opened to the Sun inside his personal dimension. Ra's body lost its golden glow and froze like a puppet with the strings cut. Victor told him he had been made mortal, that he would not be allowed to die, and that he would beg for death and still not be given it. Ra's mortal heart stopped anyway. He died of fear when Victor's face distorted into something the chapter treats as cosmic horror. Victor threw [[Natural Energy]] back into the corpse, restored the body, and left the man mortal and unable to grow.[926]
He then restored Ra's damaged body while deliberately leaving him fundamentally changed. The ancient Primordial Sun God awakened as a mortal, permanently deprived of the Divine status that had defined him for millennia. Victor considered the punishment more fitting than death: Ra had spent ages judging weaker beings from the position of a God, so Victor forced him to experience complete powerlessness beneath someone he could not resist.[926]
Victor also claimed authority over the Egyptian Divine territory obtained through Ra, intending to catalogue its artifacts and place the dimension to practical use rather than simply destroy it.[926]
The arrival of the Elder Gods escalated the conflict dramatically. Their forces contained enormous numbers of creatures whose biology and supernatural systems differed fundamentally from the Gods of Earth's familiar Pantheons. Battles erupted across several fronts while Victor's highest-level allies protected [[Nightingale]] and other territories from armies capable of overwhelming ordinary supernatural nations.[927][928][929]
[[Ikor-Kar-VI]] emerged as one of the central enemies. Threats against Victor's family triggered the full force of his Draconic rage, affecting the battlefield on a scale that demonstrated how far the once-young Vampire Count had evolved.[930]
Victor's allies fought their own extraordinary battles, including Shiva confronting powerful Elder entities. The war made clear that Victor's greatest achievement was not simply becoming individually strong. He had gathered enough exceptional Beings that multiple God-level conflicts could occur simultaneously without every battlefield depending upon him.[931]
Ikor eventually moved Victor and several combatants toward the [[Edge of the Cosmos]], the constantly expanding frontier where Creation itself had not fully stabilized. Ordinary assumptions regarding Space and Time became increasingly unreliable there because the established Rules governing the older Universe had not completely reached the region.[932]
The battlefield therefore became almost ideal for what Victor had always done best: grow through combat. Without an ordinary sense of elapsed time, Victor fought continuously against multiple Elder Gods. It might have felt like centuries, millennia or vastly longer; measurement had become almost meaningless. What mattered was that every exchange refined his [[Martial Arts]], perception, adaptation and control over his existence.[933]
The Elder Gods realized with horror that prolonged battle was making Victor stronger rather than wearing him down. Even multiple opponents coordinating against him could not stop his techniques from becoming more efficient as the fight continued.[933]
Victor finally struck the metaphysical barrier preventing his ascension. His Soul began awakening into genuine Divinity while the various paths he had accumulated throughout his life—Vampire, Progenitor, Dragon, Demon King, warrior and ruler—started producing Divine Concepts of their own.[934]
Among the most important was Beginning, a Divinity derived from Victor's position as the origin point of his race and conceptually connected to the perpetuation and beginning of existence. Unlike Blood, which Victor already understood at an extraordinary level, Beginning possessed almost no initial mastery because of its vastly greater complexity.[934]
His Divinity of Blood awakened with the opposite condition. Victor already stood at the peak of his understanding of Blood, having spent virtually his entire supernatural existence developing around it. Lesser Divinities also formed around characteristics that had defined Victor personally: Murder, Strength, Beauty, Revenge, Martial Honor, [[Rex Invictus|Home]], Family, Nature and even the uniquely Victor-like Concept of Yandere.[934]
The awakening did not stop at those. War came with them. Destruction awakened at a beginner's grasp. Negativity awakened as the sole representation of that side, carrying fear, despair, anger and loneliness inside it rather than as separate gods. BEGIN came straight out of the Progenitor status, the concept of life and of existence continuing, and his proficiency in it was nil. Blood was the opposite: he already dominated it, and the chapter states that if he declared there would be no other Blood God, that declaration would hold. His existence burst into Blood across the expanse, and the line he put on it was that from Blood he came and to Blood he would return. Yandere had never existed as a Divinity before. It was born from the personality that likes his women a little crazy. The body went through the change covered in golden Power while the energy of the concepts entered the Soul. In dragon form he reached five hundred meters, then shrank into a humanoid dragon so the same Power would sit denser. He came out of it holding both the positive and the negative, which is what the next chapter names the Dragon God of [[Chaos]]. The count given there is fifteen Divinities awakened at the moment of Godhood.[934][935]
His ascension attracted immediate attention from the [[Regulators of Existence]]. Victor should have represented another enormous anomaly, yet the cosmic system did not reject him as expected because both Negativity and Positivity were interacting with his existence in ways that allowed his developing state to remain balanced.[934]
Victor ultimately awakened fifteen Divinities, an absurd number compared to the handful normally awakened by mortals successfully reaching Godhood. Among them were major Concepts capable of influencing numerous lesser Divinities, making his ascension extraordinary even before considering that the new God was already a Blood Dragon Primogenitor and Demon King.[935]
The resulting existence became the Dragon God of Chaos. The title did not mean Victor had simply become another God associated with a conventional Element. His Divinities reflected the chaotic accumulation of everything he had become throughout his life: Blood, Beginning, Negativity, family, combat, predation, Nature and several deeply personal Concepts existed simultaneously within one Divine Being.[935]
Even the beings watching his ascension struggled to understand how someone had awakened so many Divine authorities at once. Ordinary mortals who successfully became Gods might awaken only two or three; Victor emerged carrying fifteen while simultaneously possessing racial status already exceeding most conventional deities.[935]
His ascension also strengthened his Personal Universe enough that beings and planetary systems could be supported inside his Soul on an even greater scale. The increasingly incomprehensible presence associated with Victor's deeper self remained visible within that internal existence, disturbing entities incapable of understanding what they were seeing.[936]
With the Elder Gods defeated, Victor immediately began claiming the territories and resources left behind. He had repeatedly watched supernatural wars create vacuums into which new enemies simply moved. This time, victory would be followed by administration. Worlds, populations and resources previously controlled by hostile powers were incorporated into the civilization he intended to build.[937]
King Among Kings therefore ended with Victor occupying a position almost impossible to compare with the man who had entered Hell at the end of the preceding conflict. He began the volume returning from seven hundred subjective years of isolation as the new Demon King and spent the following period building institutions rather than merely accumulating strength. The [[Blood God Religion]] became organized under a High Priestess; his family learned Runes and Draconic systems; representatives and governmental structures were established; Samar became politically intertwined with his household; Tasha awakened as a Wolf Goddess; [[Olympus]] fell; Victor became the Primogenitor of the Draconic Vampires; a new world was created; the Arcane Realm contacted an extraterrestrial civilization; the Tower of Nightmare provided a way for his faction to accelerate its growth; Dragon's Nest became an officially recognized multiracial Pantheon; and multiple ancient factions united behind Victor against common enemies.
Most importantly, Victor himself crossed two thresholds that redefined everything following them. Olympus transformed him from a Vampire Progenitor carrying Dragon characteristics into the origin of a completely new Draconic race. The war against the Elder Gods then carried that Primogenitor into true Godhood, where fifteen Divinities awakened together and established the Dragon God of Chaos. The supernatural world had spent years asking whether Victor would eventually become powerful enough to stand beside its ancient rulers. By the end of Volume 6, that question had become obsolete. The problem facing everyone else was how far he would continue climbing now that even Godhood had become only another beginning.[726][852][918][935][938]
