#### Volume 7: Dragon God of Chaos
Chapters 889–985

##### A New Age After the War
Chapters 889–897
Following his ascension as the Dragon God of [[Chaos]], Victor experienced a strange vision in which he floated among innumerable galaxies before confronting the incomprehensible creature he had previously perceived within the deepest portions of himself. The being was a mass of violet, red and black: thousands of eyes larger than galaxies, mouths that opened onto black holes, and tentacles whose touch erased galaxies. Its speech shattered space. Rather than treating the cosmic horror as an invader or separate personality, Victor instinctively understood that it was another expression of his own existence—his True Self. He accepted it without hesitation, let his Human shape give way to his Dragon form, and drew the cosmic darkness into himself. The experience slightly advanced his understanding of Negativity and Beginning, by only about one percent, while making the enormous difficulty of mastering such fundamental Divinities increasingly apparent. Concepts tied more directly to Victor's nature, such as Blood and his obsessive characteristics, remained much further developed. On waking he found [[Violet Elderblood Snow]], [[Sasha Elderblood Fulger]] and [[Ruby Elderblood Scarlett]] clinging to him. He concluded that progress in Beginning and Negativity would take millennia if it continued at that pace, and that his earlier idea of Godhood had been naive: a Divine Body is a vessel, the Universe is full of Laws a God must learn, and [[Primordial Entities]] are those who have merged their Concept with Creation. Positivity and Negativity sit under almost every other Divinity, while The End comes from [[True Death]] as the restart of the Universe. Minor concepts such as his own obsessive Divinity and Blood advanced freely because no rival God blocked them, whereas Beauty, Revenge, [[Rex Invictus|Home]] and similar authorities were already occupied by beings such as [[Aphrodite]] Elderblood, [[Nemesis]] and [[Hestia]] Elderblood. Victor rose in only black underwear, floating through the corridors. He had spent more than five months pampering the three of them in the bedroom, one external day stretched by Natalia Alioth's lineage talent, and he was still satisfied enough that ordinary clothes did not matter.[939]
With the immediate war concluded, Victor began consolidating what his ascension had actually given him. A meeting of the Sector's supernatural powers, held days earlier, had been short because of what he now was: he declared that an alliance among the Pantheons would be hastened, and those present accepted. As a God of Beginning and Negativity he was treated as something above an ordinary God-King, a being who could end populations and begin them again, even if he was not a Primordial. He split his faction into three practical blocks: a personal world for his wives and family; the former [[Egyptian Pantheon]] and loyal non-infernal allies, with Hell kept inside his Soul; and bases in [[Nightingale]], Samar and Earth as recruitment grounds and embassies, expandable onto new planets. His original wives had also changed dramatically through the Tower of Nightmare. Violet Elderblood Snow, Sasha Elderblood Fulger and Ruby Elderblood Scarlett rose from the level of minor combat gods to high-level combat-focused gods, and in Vampire Count form could stand beside beings such as [[Thor]] or [[Ares]]. Natalia Alioth's lineage talent had matured past her father Alexios: one day beside Victor could stretch into months for those inside her dilation, though her Soul was still an unfinished God-quality existence without a Concept, so he refused to force a Dragon transformation on her until he was sure it would not break her.[940][941]
One of the first diplomatic consequences of that change came through [[Amaterasu]] Elderblood. She and [[Velnorah Xyphora Elderblood Thaloria II]] met him in the mansion's recreation grounds, near the reinforced Ice Castle he had once made for Ruby and the new [[Pillar of Memory]], a soul-fragment relic only his wives and daughters could fully see. Seeking a deeper relationship between the [[Shinto Pantheon]] and Dragons Nest, Amaterasu directly proposed a marriage alliance with Victor. Victor did not reject the idea, but immediately asked what her Pantheon could provide that he did not already possess. Amaterasu offered the Essence of her parents, the Creation associated with [[Izanagi]] and Izanami, recognizing that Victor's ability to create did not yet make him an ordinary God of Creation. Victor in turn made clear what entering his family meant: once he genuinely accepted someone as his wife, he would not regard their relationship as a temporary political contract. When she accepted, his obsessive authority bound their Souls through a [[Soul Marriage]], so that distance and dimension would not stop him from finding her. He did not swallow the Essence on the spot. He told her to keep it safe for the time being, both as repayment for earlier kindness and because the public ceremony could wait. He pulled her against him, fed her an onigiri by hand, and stroked her long black hair until she blushed and chewed without thinking. Her hair was warm to the touch.[942][943]
The same negotiations brought Velnorah Xyphora Elderblood Thaloria II's history into focus. Velnorah revealed that she had once been the [[Anna Elderblood|Second Empress]] of [[Eldoria]], a technologically extraordinary world ruled by her dynasty. Her mother, [[Thaloria Xyphora]], belonged to the [[Xyrra]], a towering race possessing an exceptional natural affinity for technology, and had transformed Eldoria into a civilization where extreme technological advancement coexisted with a preserved natural environment. Thaloria's rise had eventually carried her civilization far beyond the level of an ordinary planetary power, but Eldoria's expansion also brought it into contact with forces from much greater cosmic regions. Velnorah's records gave Victor his first detailed look at how advanced societies beyond his familiar Sector actually fought, governed and developed.[944]
The footage disturbed Victor more than the technology itself. Gods belonging to higher-level regions had not stagnated like many of Earth's ancient deities; they trained their Divinities and combat skills, creating a standard in which beings comparable to Earth's exceptional Gods could be relatively normal participants in greater civilizations. One of the beings involved in the fall of Velnorah's civilization even possessed powers resembling Night and Darkness, yet Nyx Elderblood had never sensed such a being competing with her for authority over those Concepts. Victor consequently realized that Divine monopolies and conceptual hierarchies were not necessarily shared universally between Sectors. If his Sector eventually ascended, his Gods might enter a region already populated by other beings expressing apparently identical Concepts under a different cosmic jurisdiction.[945]
The discovery reinforced Victor's conviction that his family needed to become stronger before the outside universe arrived at their doorstep. He nevertheless continued treating his daughters as daughters rather than simply future weapons. [[Nero Elderblood]] received a pair of linked Divine firearms whose ammunition and destructive output could be controlled through her own Energy, allowing everything from conventional shots to enormous beams. [[Ophis Tepes Elderblood]] received specially created gloves that allowed her to access the small Youkai component inherited from [[Otsuki Hana]], including powers that had remained largely suppressed beneath her overwhelmingly dominant Vampire bloodline. The gifts were designed to expand what the girls could become rather than merely providing stronger equipment.[945]
Victor's attention then returned to unfinished enemies. [[Agares]], aware that remaining within Victor's reach would eventually lead to his capture, had accepted outside work and attempted to survive through his exceptional interdimensional mobility. He did not stay hidden. He tried to strike Anna Elderblood and [[Maya Elizabeth Lykos Elderblood]] in Samar. Zack caught the approach and broke the concealed form apart. [[Oda Blank]] raised a barrier and a tracking orb, and squads of Shadow Demons and [[Blank Clan]] vampires in Count form followed Agares through his dimensional jumps. Victor specifically ordered that he be taken alive, since such an ability was considerably more useful if it could be studied or placed at his service. Nyx Elderblood, called Agent 000 in that operation, brought the Starry Night down with [[Zaladrac Zeovnur Elderblood]], and the surrounding Space was sealed until the chance of escape was treated as zero. Agares fought after realizing his mysterious contractor would not rescue him, but the forces surrounding him had been assembled specifically to counter his greatest advantage. The hunt embodied one of Victor's most characteristic traits as a Dragon: neither distance nor the passage of time caused him to forget an unresolved enemy.[946][947]
Another loose thread unexpectedly involved [[Vlad III Tepes|Vlad Tepes]]. Victor questioned Vlad after learning that one of the former Horsemen had claimed the identity of Radu Tepes. Vlad finally explained that the original Vlad Tepes had possessed a sickly younger brother named Radu, who had watched the Progenitor consume the original's Soul, and whom Vlad had transformed into a Vampire at that man's request. Radu did not stay loyal. Twisted by what he had seen, he experimented on Vlad's Progenitor blood and, using Jessica Horseman's blood, produced the clone-like Horseman brothers. The revelation connected the Horsemen experiments to Vlad's own blood and demonstrated the risks inherent in allowing Progenitor blood to remain outside its creator's control. Victor realized that his own relationship with Blood had become even more abnormal: blood originating from him could remain perceptible and controllable at extraordinary distances, including across dimensional separation. [[Junketsu]], forged from his blood and merged with his Soul, reinforced that reach in a way other Progenitors did not possess.[948]
Vlad subsequently withdrew into one of his most heavily protected private locations, where remnants connected to his distant past remained preserved, including his relationship with the original Vlad Dracul Tepes. The encounter reminded both men that becoming Progenitors had never completely erased the histories preceding their current identities.[949] Victor, however, was increasingly looking toward the future. Having personally crossed the boundary into True Dragonhood, he no longer saw any reason that his family should remain constrained by their original races if they genuinely wished to evolve alongside him. The question was no longer whether Victor could create additional Dragons, but which members of his family actually wanted to become them.[949]

##### The Family's Next Evolution
Chapters 898–901
Preparations began for what Victor's family jokingly referred to as the "big day". Victor offered several women the opportunity to become genuine Dragons through him, but refused to make the transformation mandatory. [[Otsuki Elderblood Haruna]] became the clearest example of that distinction. Despite understanding how powerful Dragonhood could make her, she refused. Every ancestor she counted had been a nine-tailed fox, her techniques were built on that bloodline, and she would not throw the identity away to become something else. [[Mizuki Elderblood]], in contrast, was far more receptive. She had once refused vampirism because she would not drink blood or lose the arts she had trained, but Dragonhood, as Victor described it, would keep those arts and put a stronger body and a greater mastery of energy under them. The morning itself still carried the previous night. Several of the women were sleeping naked from exhaustion after intimate time with Victor. Kaguya was among them and used her shadows to form a maid dress rather than walk bare. Haruna was covered by dark power that left her in a black kimono with gold details.[950]
That distinction was important to Victor. He believed Dragons were extraordinary beings and wanted many of his wives to share his race, but he had no desire to erase the identities that had made him love them in the first place. Transformation through the Dragon God of [[Chaos]] was therefore intended as an evolution that absorbed and strengthened existing characteristics rather than simply overwriting every woman with a standardized draconic template. The same morning made the scale of that plan practical. In Ruby's laboratory, Velnorah—three meters tall—was already rebuilding the faction's communications with [[Ruby Elderblood Scarlett]] and Aline. Her Technomancy, a forge-like Divinity aimed at technology, could skip the ordinary steps of construction. A communicator that would have been a bracelet was crushed down into an earring. Sector-wide interdimensional contact was the near goal; with Witch technology folded in, she and Aline thought galaxy-wide contact was possible, and pairing her work with [[Hephaestus]] looked like a leap of centuries. She also spelled out why Victor could make new Dragons at all: Beginning, Negativity, and a Progenitor's reach into the Soul let him found sub-races, and a trained Creation would later let him found races that were not branches of his own. Aline was told she would not come out as an ordinary Dragon. She would be a Demonic Dragon, on the same road as Zaladrac. Elsewhere, Victor walked the ruined Warfall ground of Clan Adrasteia, where mountains had been golems under the clan's command, and started planning defenses that used his own world's volcanoes and core Dragonfire, plus small scout golems, robots, and Dragon sub-species. He was also already thinking of [[Nordic Hell]], and of keeping that visit a surprise for Hela.[950][951]
Victor also continued preparing allies outside his immediate household. He visited Eleonor Elderblood Adrasteia and the Valkyries while accompanied by [[Metis]] Elderblood, openly introducing Metis as his daughter rather than allowing her to remain defined by her former relationship to [[Zeus]]. Dorothy, Alexa, Anrietha and Judy were among those present. When Metis was named as the Titan who had been Zeus's wife, she corrected them at once: ex-wife. Victor then distributed personally crafted weapons and Divine Artifacts among the Valkyries, each adapted to its recipient's fighting style. His goal was not to make allies dependent upon him for every battle; he wanted talented warriors to possess tools capable of allowing their own skills to continue growing alongside the escalating threats facing the Sector.[952]
By this point the women surrounding Victor had also begun assuming clearer Imperial roles. Anna, Sasha, Ruby, Violet, Jeanne, Helena and Kaguya were among those increasingly treated as Empresses rather than merely wives of a powerful man, each carrying authority and responsibilities inside the faction. Victor's relationship with his mother [[Anna Elderblood]] demonstrated how completely his mentality had changed across centuries of supernatural existence; mortal taboos that once would have defined his thinking no longer held the same meaning, although Victor remained insistent that Anna's decisions had to remain genuinely her own.[953]
Before the complete consequences of the coming Dragon transformations could be explored, Victor turned toward another major power of the Sector. Accompanied by Ophis, [[Nero]], Metis and Ariel, he departed for the highest regions of Heaven to personally meet the Heavenly Father. It would become the first substantial diplomatic meeting between the Creator of the [[Biblical Pantheon]] and the newly ascended Dragon God of Chaos.[953]

##### A Visit Between Heaven and Hell
Chapters 902–916
The journey through Heaven immediately contrasted with Victor's own increasingly chaotic household. Ophis rapidly became bored by the endless clouds while Ariel attempted to maintain the dignity expected of a Seraphim escorting one of the most dangerous beings in the Sector. Their route eventually brought Victor into contact with the Garden of Eden. He recognized the Tree of Life and the Tree of Knowledge of Good and Evil through his dimensional senses. The fruit called to him, but he refused to take any. The [[Heavenly Father]] watched that restraint and was satisfied. They reached a simple temple in the Seventh Heaven with one ordinary wooden door. Beyond it lay green hills under a blue sky, and the Heavenly Father sat in a white chair under a parasol in what he called the heaven of humility.[954]
At the same time, developments inside the Arcane Realm were becoming increasingly dangerous. The unusual opportunities surrounding the Witches attracted attention from powerful factions, including Yama and [[Merlin]]. Evie distrusted every faction attempting to exploit Arcane and refused Yama access even when he personally came seeking an agreement. Yama offered two contracts. The first would have made demons subordinate to the witches. The second offered the witches thirty percent of profits against seventy for the demons. She refused both. He answered that one day the witches would bow, and he intended to be there to see it. Yet she was also forced to remember Victor's earlier warning that, when circumstances became sufficiently desperate, she might eventually find herself calling upon the very "Devil" she had tried to keep at a distance. To Evie's frustration, Victor's faction increasingly appeared to be one of the few powers strong enough to negotiate with Arcane without needing to steal what it wanted.[954][955]
Victor's meeting with the Heavenly Father became considerably more philosophical than an ordinary treaty negotiation. The Heavenly Father asked whether Victor actually wielded Creation. Victor answered that he held only a fraction, not yet a Divinity, and showed the Creation Essence [[Amaterasu]] had entrusted to him. The older question remained underneath that exchange: what was he? Victor could call himself Human, Vampire, Demon King, Dragon, Elder God, Emperor or countless other titles, but none completely described the being standing before Heaven's Creator. The Heavenly Father warned that defining himself entirely through those categories would make the labels into limitations. Victor came away with a clearer distinction between the Blood Dragon body through which he interacted with the world and the incomprehensible deeper existence he had begun recognizing as his True Self.[956]
Their political discussion also addressed the relationship between Heaven and the territories controlled by Victor. The Heavenly Father wanted a deeper alliance: demons and angels as permanent partners, a marriage to one of the daughters of the Seven Virtues, and a union of their religions that would last as long as Victor remained Demon King. Victor refused the marriage. He had no interest in forcing an alliance through wives merely because traditional Pantheons considered such arrangements convenient. He told the Creator to leave that question for later. What he wanted was a public handshake between the Heavenly Father and the King of Hell, practical cooperation, and stability.[956]
Victor then reversed the roles and invited the Heavenly Father to visit Hell. The realm the Heavenly Father remembered as a violent and primitive infernal territory had changed beyond recognition. Alexandria, called the city of beginnings, was already larger than Tokyo and still growing toward the size of a small country. Alcantara, the economic hub of the middle layers, was a futuristic metropolis generating over ten trillion Knull a year. One Knull equaled about seven human dollars, and the currency was backed by fair contracts rather than the old loopholes. Abaddon, the royal capital, had been rebuilt by Victor's demon wives, Helena especially. Its seven towers were larger and sturdier, and the Demon King's castle was mountain-sized so that Dragon bodies could live in it. Invisible Shadow Demons, a race born from extreme despair and commanded only by Victor, maintained order. When the Heavenly Father released positive energy, thousands of them became visible. A war stadium was sealed in demonic runes so that souls fighting inside it lost almost nothing on revival: the old thirty-percent loss had been cut to about one percent. Spatial rifts moved people between the layers. [[Nero]] wanted to fight in that stadium. Commerce and entertainment rivaled or exceeded what ordinary Human societies could provide, and the change was extreme enough that Heaven's ruler briefly questioned whether Victor intended to rule Heaven as well.[957][958]
The tour did not magically erase the ancient hatred between Angels and Demons. Victor understood that agreements between rulers could not instantly remove grievances accumulated across thousands of years. Angels remembered Demonic atrocities, Demons remembered Heavenly violence, and neither population would accept friendship simply because their leaders declared it. Victor instead favored gradual cooperation built upon mutual benefit, believing that survival against future threats mattered more than perpetually repeating conflicts whose origins many modern participants had never personally experienced.[959]
Even something as simple as sharing infernal food became another demonstration of how much Hell had changed. The Heavenly Father and Ariel encountered a functioning culture rather than the caricature of endless torture and savagery expected from traditional depictions of Demons. Victor's family had not made Hell harmless, but they had turned it into a civilization whose inhabitants possessed homes, entertainment, businesses, loyalties and ambitions beyond indiscriminate evil.[960]
[[Metis]] Elderblood was another subject the Heavenly Father had to reconsider. She had once existed almost entirely in relation to [[Zeus]] and the [[Greek Pantheon]], yet Victor now introduced and treated her simply as his daughter. The family surrounding him likewise accepted her through that relationship. Metis' past had not disappeared, but it was no longer the primary definition of her identity.[961][962]
The most shocking part of the visit involved War. The Horseman had already changed considerably through Victor's influence, but Victor saw the possibility of taking him much further. Demonic and Divine characteristics that should traditionally have been incompatible could coexist when Victor's powers of [[Chaos]], Beginning, Negativity and his understanding of opposing Essences were used as the foundation.[963][964]
Victor reconstructed War into a new kind of Progenitor, an existence born from Darkness yet capable of carrying Positive and Holy characteristics without simply destroying itself through contradiction. He rose from his throne and formed a violet sphere from a sliver of Negativity, a sliver of Positivity and Dragon fire, then drove it into War's heart. The corpse and miasma of the old monster were taken in. Death's darkness, Famine's hunger, Disease's decay, a fragment of Victor's own essence and the Divinity of Beginning were fused in the same fire. What stood up afterward had six wings of dark beams and was the origin of the Bearers of Damnation, harbingers counted among Victor's expanding Chaos Creatures. Victor named him son, [[Demon God]] of bloody war, right hand and his Horseman. War answered him as king, father and creator. The Heavenly Father initially regarded the deliberately contradictory being as an abomination and, seeing those wings, cried out that an angel had just been made. The reaction provoked Victor's anger; Victor had little patience for the idea that the categories established by Creation determined which of his children deserved to exist.[964][965]
The disagreement ultimately reinforced an important difference between them. The Heavenly Father represented an ancient system whose rules he understood intimately. Victor increasingly represented the refusal to accept those rules as immutable. The Heavenly Father had treated the Demon King of Tyranny as a subordinate. Victor called that disrespect. The older being apologized, and Victor accepted. He gave the Heavenly Father a black card loaded with one million Knull, later raised to three million in the exchange, and received Cain's dagger in return. He agreed to consider sharing what he learned from the dagger, but made no promise. Even so, both recognized the value of cooperation. Victor emphasized that if the Sector eventually ascended and encountered hostile powers from higher regions, Dragons Nest could become one of the safest refuges available to Heaven's people.[965][966]
The process also deepened Victor's understanding of his own powers. Metis explained aspects of Chaos and Victor's contradictory Essences to Ophis and Nero while Victor himself recognized that genuine understanding of Creation could directly improve Concepts such as Beginning and Negativity. Progress could not simply be forced by throwing Energy into a Divinity. Some powers advanced because their wielder finally understood what they actually represented.[967]
Victor's family reacted with predictable disbelief when they learned that he had transformed another impossible being into a Progenitor. Yet behavior that would have once been considered a cosmological miracle was already becoming alarmingly normal around Victor. Discussions among his wives also revealed that knowledge concerning possible futures had to be handled with extraordinary care: individuals such as Violet understood that interacting recklessly with Time and potential futures could create consequences far beyond ordinary prophecy.[968]

##### The Dragon Family Changes
Chapters 917–925
Victor finally initiated the large-scale Dragon transformations that had been discussed throughout the preceding chapters. He did not hand out a single template. In Dragon form he laid violet circles of Draconic runes under groups of wives and allies and pushed the Authorities of Beginning and Negativity through them, infusing Dragon Essence while leaving a fraction of each woman's original racial Essence intact so old powers would be enlarged rather than deleted. The women who accepted were remade as [[Blood Dragons]], a fusion of Noble Vampire and True Dragon. The first waves included the Fulger line—[[Sasha Elderblood Fulger]], [[Annasthashia Elderblood Fulger]], Carmila, Victoria and Naty—who came out as beings of living lightning; the Scarlett sisters [[Siena Scarlett Elderblood]], [[Lacus Scarlett Elderblood]] and [[Pepper Scarlett Elderblood]]; [[Maya Elizabeth Lykos Elderblood]], [[Mizuki Elderblood]], Maria, [[Roberta Elderblood]], Bruna, Eve, [[Lily Elderblood]], [[Vine]], Helena Elderblood, Aline and others of the household; and, in a slower and more dangerous circle, High Goddesses such as [[Hestia]] Elderblood, Nyx Elderblood, [[Gaia]], [[Persephone Elderblood]] and [[Amaterasu]] Elderblood. Eleonor's monstrous lineage mutated instead of being overwritten. Haruna was not in those circles. She had already refused. Eggs of different colors closed around many of the women while their bodies were rebuilt from the inside. Even [[Scathach Elderblood Scarlett]], who trusted Victor more completely than almost anyone alive, remained tense until she personally confirmed that her daughters were safe. Before the ritual, his full Dragon shape—compressed to a hundred meters in the available space, five hundred at true size—had already pulled hidden draconic traits out of the watching wives. Violet, Jeanne, Rose, Morgana, Zaladrac, [[Aphrodite]] and [[Scathach]] shivered into an aroused state just from seeing him.[969][970][971]
The results were therefore radically different between families, and more than thirty [[True Dragons]] stood where a handful of rare births would normally have taken cosmic ages. Eleonor Elderblood Adrasteia kept Space, Earth and a corruptive fire that could ruin Souls, and woke with neon-green Draconic eyes, a horn and wings. Eve gained a related mutant fire and could leave a negative copy of herself, an Alter Eve; she also grew a few inches and filled out. Maria's authority settled on corpses, ghouls, Death and Souls. Roberta Elderblood could petrify with a glance and twist memory. Bruna's telekinesis jumped to an absurd level on a body about 197 centimeters tall. [[Kaguya Elderblood Blank]] became a shadow dragon who could lay her weight on shadows and walk on ceilings, her mature shape near 193 centimeters, with darkness for hair and empty black eyes, and the change left traces of Divinity on her. The new body was openly seductive. Traces of an attraction-related divinity clung to her, and even Roberta Elderblood felt her body heat when she looked. Hestia Elderblood's flame stopped being only a power she called: her hair burned on its own, and she could pull that fire back inside her body so less of it leaked away. [[Anna Elderblood]]'s honesty had become a field. Lies did not hold in front of her, and her feel for Draconic runes was already strong enough that speech bent reality whether she meant it to or not. She came out more defined, black hair, blood-red eyes, black-violet horns and wings, still in the long red-and-black dress. The Fulger women did not merely throw lightning; Sasha in particular became something closer to lightning itself. Among the Scarlett sisters, Ruby insisted she had already been complete, Pepper grew into a much taller adult shape while keeping her innocent face and could pass for a milf, Siena sharpened, and Lacus grew to Ruby's height as the childish cast left her features. Velnorah gained a few more inches with everything remaining proportional.[972][973]
The changes also attracted powerful observers. Kali and [[Dún Scáith|Dun Scaith]] sensed Victor's return to [[Nightingale]] and sought him out. Dun Scaith immediately recognized the Draconic Language being used by Victor, Aphrodite and Scathach—one of the rare languages even she could not simply understand through ordinary knowledge because a Dragon's speech did more than communicate; it imposed the speaker's [[Will Solace|Will]] upon Reality.[974]
The encounter revealed an unexpected piece of Scathach's past. Dun Scaith addressed her former disciple by the name Siren, the identity Scathach had used before completing her training and adopting the name by which she was now known. Victor immediately became fascinated by the possibility of discovering embarrassing stories about his wife, while Scathach discovered that becoming one of the strongest Dragons in the Sector did not prevent her old teacher from knowing exactly how to irritate her.[975]
Kali's attention was focused on something more important. Victor's Energy and her own authority over Destruction and Negativity reacted with extraordinary compatibility, while Kali was shocked by how rapidly women such as Aphrodite had advanced through their relationship with Victor. She had required enormous periods of training to reach her current understanding of Destruction; individuals surrounding Victor were beginning to approach comparable conceptual thresholds in dramatically shorter periods.[974][976]
Victor eventually brought Kali and Dun Scaith into his personal territory, where the sheer number of newly created True Dragons immediately changed their understanding of his faction. The "strongest woman" was no longer an easy title to assign when beings such as Scathach, Kali, Dun Scaith and the increasingly evolved members of Victor's household could exist in one place. More importantly, Victor had produced in months and years what natural Dragons ordinarily represented only through extremely rare births across cosmic periods: the beginnings of an entire Dragon civilization centered upon one family.[976][977]

##### A Power Without Ordinary Limits
Chapters 926–932
Among all the newly transformed Dragons, [[Anna Elderblood]] presented one of the most dangerous problems. Her awakening ability did not behave like a straightforward element or Divine authority. Spoken intention, perception and Draconic expression could cause what Anna imagined to become real. Victor tested her with single words. "Weapon" produced kitchen knives and dolls shaped like him. "A weapon of mass destruction" produced missiles, tanks and a golem-like doll of Victor, because that was what her subconscious thought the phrase meant. Ordinary words such as "ball" simply made ordinary objects. When he had her say Terror, miasma rose and an illusion of his corpse appeared: the power had reached for the thing she feared most, and, unable to actually kill him, it drew the picture instead.[978]
The manifestation could not actually overcome Victor, but that was almost beside the point. Anna possessed a power capable of interpreting words through her own psyche and altering Reality to satisfy them despite having relatively little experience controlling it. Victor therefore refused to solve the problem by simply increasing her strength. She was to stay beside him until the ability was leashed. After that, Anna needed control, self-understanding and training from individuals such as [[Scathach]], Zaladrac and [[Dún Scáith|Dun Scaith]], under a binding contract of secrecy, before she could safely use an ability whose output might change depending upon her emotional state.[978]
[[Amara Elderblood]] and [[Roxanne Elderblood]] simultaneously investigated the changing structure of Victor himself. Inside his Soul they found two [[World Trees]], one Positive and one Negative, whose roots were sinking deeper through everything he had accumulated. The same inner world held the cosmic horror he had accepted as his [[Chaos]]. They tested folding [[Gabriel]]'s essence into that structure and found it opened a usable light. Remnants from consumed enemies, [[Diablo]] among them, were already being pulled into the same system rather than left as loose trophies.[979][980]
The restructuring became so profound that Victor's physical body reacted despite its absurd durability. For several minutes he became unconscious and even coughed blood, alarming Anna and [[Persephone Elderblood]]. The cause was not conventional injury: Victor's Soul had undergone an accelerated purification that eliminated the remaining traces of Mortality within it in a single process. A transition that might normally have occurred gradually throughout a God's development happened virtually at once because of the transformations taking place inside Victor's personal existence.[980][981]
[[Persephone]]'s relationship with Victor also finally ceased remaining in an ambiguous space between subordinate Goddess, ally and romantic interest. Both openly acknowledged Victor's desire to possess her and Persephone's own willingness to accept that relationship. Their bond culminated in a [[Soul Marriage]], integrating Persephone into Victor's family in a manner radically different from the marriage she had once endured with [[Hades]]. Victor did not require her to pretend that her past had never happened, but he made equally clear that once she chose him she would be regarded as his. The marriage was not only metaphysical. He set her on his lap, pushed her face into his chest, and her body answered the scent of her Progenitor. She was bare. They kissed, licked and touched until he put her down on a mattress. She felt him hard against her entrance. When he thrust, she took him fully. Her body heated with dragon fire and she grew very wet from the weight of his possessiveness. The room filled with the sound of them. No cup size was given; she was simply described as voluptuous, long black hair, black dragon horns.[981][982]
Training among the Dragonized families soon revealed that Anna's ability was an extreme manifestation of a trait shared more broadly by Dragons. Members of the Fulger and Scarlett families discovered that words spoken through Draconic intent could impose relatively simple concepts upon Reality. Even producing an ordinary object through a word demonstrated how dangerous the language could become when used by creatures whose speech itself carried supernatural authority. Anna's version was simply far more powerful and much less controlled than what the other newly transformed Dragons displayed.[983]
The transformed women consequently began training their bodies, abilities and Draconic Language rather than assuming the transformation alone made them complete warriors. Victor continued watching their development even when he was not physically beside them, maintaining the same habit that had long defined his protection of family: distance rarely meant he had stopped paying attention.[984]

##### Settling Old Debts
Chapters 933–936
Victor's transformation into a far greater being did not make him forget enemies accumulated throughout his earlier life. War began gathering individuals who had once opposed Victor and presenting them for judgment. Victor's decisions demonstrated that his idea of justice was considerably more complicated than simply executing everyone he disliked. [[Kurama]] was among those brought up for what he had done as an enemy. Thomas and Jimmy, human exorcists who had been pushed into betrayal and had since shown loyalty, were rewarded rather than killed. Cornelius, a Noble Vampire heir and a direct enemy, would not take a place in the new order. [[Luan Davis]] was judged as someone only indirectly tied to the old conflict. Lucy and Karen were not treated as enemies at all; they had facilitated rather than fought him. Thomas, Jimmy, Lucy and Karen were given new purposes and transformed into [[Heralds of Chaos]]. War, as bearer of the Dragon God of [[Chaos]]'s will, poured a miasma of pure darkness through the worthy ones and raised them into messengers who would operate under him and Victor.[985][986]
Other prisoners received radically different sentences according to Victor's view of their crimes, intentions and possible usefulness. Kurama was dragged into pure terror for what he had done to one of War's charges. His body was distorted into a floating ball of flesh that exploded and reformed, then taken to the center of the God to suffer forever. Cornelius chose the complete erasure of his Soul rather than accept the alternatives. War treated the erasure as mercy. Luan accepted servitude over death. He was fitted with a choker, numbered 069L, and sent to a desert-like place under wardens, with the chance of reward if he obeyed. Former Egyptian Gods such as [[Upuaut]] and Kuk, having completed the punishments imposed upon them and demonstrated acceptable behavior, were permitted to leave imprisonment as free citizens under the new rules. Lucy, Karen, Thomas and Jimmy accepted power in exchange for servitude to War and became Heralds of Chaos.[985][986]
The process illustrated how Victor intended his growing civilization to handle enemies. Some crimes deserved permanent destruction, some deserved punishment followed by reintegration, and some individuals were more valuable reconstructed into useful members of society than annihilated. His morality remained intensely personal and often brutal, but it was not indiscriminate.[986]
By the end of the purge, Victor noted that virtually every enemy still reachable within his Sector had been killed, captured, converted or otherwise dealt with. Only individuals genuinely beyond his present reach remained unresolved. With old enemies disappearing, Victor experimented more deeply with his evolved physiology and the predatory abilities accumulated through becoming an Elder God and Chaos Dragon. He could wear traits taken from beings he had consumed—Kurama's fox shape, [[Diablo]], the angels [[Gabriel]] and Michael, [[Erebus]], Nocturnos—without changing what he was. His [[Dragon Heart]] and his eyes stayed his own. Lesser biological or supernatural properties could be expressed as required. The Soul and the essence remained a Dragon's. The same stretch of time was not only experiments. In bed with [[Persephone Elderblood]], still joined to her, he pulled at the hard peak of one of her mounds while she squeezed around him. [[Anna Elderblood]] walked in, aroused by the scent and the sight. Her long black-and-red dress vanished, leaving the black garter belt she liked. She climbed into the bed, pushed [[Persephone]]'s place, moved her panties aside, and took him into her own hot, magma-like insides while white liquid leaked from Persephone. Anna's red draconic eyes threatened the other woman until Victor pulled both of them close and told Anna to behave.[987]
One unresolved issue remained much closer to home. Anna's new power had amplified emotions and desires she had never been forced to confront openly while living as an ordinary Human. Victor understood that such a problem could not be solved through intimidation or another supernatural transformation. [[Leon Walker]] needed to become involved, forcing the Walker family to address emotional issues that centuries of supernatural advancement had not erased. Even a light touch to her new horns made her shudder, and more fluid flowed from her.[988]
Before Victor could remain focused exclusively upon domestic matters, his wives gathered around another developing crisis. The situation in the [[Norse Pantheon]] was approaching the conflict foretold as Ragnarök, and the Elderblood family had absolutely no intention of allowing an entire Pantheon to destroy itself without preparing for the consequences—or exploiting the opportunities.[988]

##### The Shadow of Ragnarök
Chapters 937–948
The civilization developing from Victor's former Egyptian territories already demonstrated what made his faction fundamentally different from traditional Pantheons. Dragons, Vampires, [[Werewolves]], Demons, Humans and other supernatural races increasingly lived under the same authority rather than existing inside completely segregated racial societies. Victor had never formally ordered his population to call him by a new title, yet inhabitants increasingly referred to him as the God Emperor, reflecting the almost religious scale his authority had acquired even outside the [[Blood God Religion]].[989][990]
Attention shifted northward toward the children of [[Loki]]—[[Fenrir]] and [[Jormungandr]] among them—and the ancient Dragon [[Nidhogg]]. Victor's forces investigated the Norse situation rather than simply accepting the traditional story of Ragnarök as an inevitable prophecy. Nidhogg represented a particularly dangerous variable because a genuine ancient Dragon could perceive disturbances that ordinary Divine surveillance might overlook, forcing Victor's covert forces to take unusual precautions while observing the Pantheon.[991][992]
Victor's experiences with Fate had made him deeply skeptical of any prophecy claiming that a specific sequence of events simply had to occur. If Destiny could be interfered with, manipulated or outright broken, then Ragnarök needed to be understood through the actions causing it rather than treated as an unquestionable script. The prophecy might describe a likely outcome, but Victor refused to confuse likelihood with inevitability.[993]
At the center of the coming conflict stood hela. [[Odin]]'s treatment of her had given the Goddess of the [[Greek Underworld|Underworld]] immense periods of isolation in which resentment could mature into strategy. Rather than wasting those years in helpless anger, Hela had trained, gathered resources and constructed a plan specifically intended to destroy the father whose actions she blamed for her imprisonment and suffering. By the time Odin understood that Ragnarök was approaching, Hela had already spent millennia preparing for precisely that moment.[994]
Victor's faction secretly observed [[Asgard]] while Odin gathered [[Thor]], [[Freyja|Freya]], Loki, [[Heimdall]] and the other resources still available to him. [[Idun]] became particularly interesting because her Apples strengthened the Gods and aided their preparation for the coming battle. Violet and the other wives jokingly discussed kidnapping useful individuals, but beneath the humor existed a serious Imperial policy: if the Norse Gods intended to annihilate one another, Dragons Nest had no reason to allow valuable people, species, artifacts and resources to vanish with them.[995][996]
Hela's plans reached considerably deeper than Odin knew. Nidhogg, the END Dragon, had spent ages in a dimension of his own making at the roots of [[Yggdrasil]], a prison even End-beings could not simply break. Hela sacrificed her own vitality to call him out and buy his favors. One of those favors was already spent: the [[Bifrost]] had been destroyed. Another was personal. She offered him Ratatoskr, the squirrel who had taunted him through the imprisonment, as a meal. The remaining favor was kept for the war itself. A genuine ancient Dragon cooperating with a Goddess willing to spend her life-force on The End was a threat to more than individual Aesir.[997][998]
Victor immediately recognized the strategic value of what he observed. The region associated with The End possessed extraordinary resilience and could restore itself after destruction that would permanently ruin ordinary environments, making such a place potentially invaluable as a future battlefield or testing ground. Yet its connection to the [[Norse Pantheon]] also revealed how dangerous Hela's plan had become.[998]
The appearance of excessive End-related power attracted attention from beings and systems far beyond ordinary Asgardian politics. Victor realized that Ragnarök might never have referred merely to Odin, Thor and the familiar Norse Gods killing one another. The destruction of an entire Divine dimension and its associated cosmic structures could destabilize the Sector itself, particularly in a Universe whose remaining Heavens, Hells, [[World Trees]] and other fundamental systems were already interconnected in ways most Pantheons barely understood. Victor even considered the possibility that sufficiently extreme circumstances could contribute to the emergence of something on the level of a new Primordial phenomenon.[999]
Victor's family therefore prepared around Ragnarök rather than attempting to stop Hela outright. Once his wives finally forced him to step away from constant work, they established a simplified military hierarchy for emergencies in under an hour. Victor and his Queens sat at the top with total authority. [[Scathach Elderblood Scarlett]] was Supreme Commander of the armies. Generals would be drawn from the wives who chose to fight. Captains led squadrons. Soldiers filled the base. The ranks were for operations, not for deciding who outranked whom at the dinner table; the women still treated one another as sisters. A headquarters was raised on the edge of the mansion without poisoning the world around it, with Helena Elderblood, Eleonor, [[Gaia]], [[Demeter]] and [[Hestia]] Elderblood shaping the ground, and creatures such as the King's Bison set into the new ecosystem. In the command room with Violet, Anna, Eleonor, Rose, [[Aphrodite]], Agnes, Natashia, Carmila and Velnorah, the first objectives were practical: speak to the dwarves despite their contempt for outsiders, and approach Light Elves, Dark Elves, ice giants and fire giants, who were more likely to respect strength. [[Scathach]] would handle the dwarves. Violet would run the operation. They also had to account for the imbalance Victor had created by restoring Hela's vitality and dealing with the END Dragon.[1000]

##### A Moment Before the Storm
Chapters 949–957
Victor's wives effectively ordered their Emperor to take a vacation. His tendency to move from war to research, training, administration and another war without meaningful rest had become ridiculous even by immortal standards. Victor initially continued involving himself in strategic discussions, but his family insisted that becoming the ruler of an expanding civilization did not mean every moment of his existence had to be devoted to improving it.[1001][1002][1003]
The vacation became genuine family time rather than another disguised training session. Victor participated in games and leisure activities with women who were normally Empresses, warriors or Goddesses, temporarily reducing problems that could affect planets to arguments over ordinary competitions. The scenes emphasized something increasingly rare in Victor's life: despite becoming a cosmic Dragon God surrounded by political responsibilities, he still valued simply enjoying the presence of the people for whom he was building everything. Clothes were casual. [[Hestia]] Elderblood wore a red one-piece swimsuit with a flame design on the chest and a light beige jacket. Other girls played soccer in bikinis.[1004]
His absence also proved that the civilization no longer collapsed whenever Victor stopped directly managing it. Violet and the other Empresses continued operations surrounding [[Asgard]], [[Leona Elizabeth Elderblood Lykos]] coordinated populations and territories connected to the former [[Egyptian Pantheon]], and the women responsible for Hell maintained the infernal system without calling Victor to solve every administrative problem.[1005]
That independence was tested when Hell suddenly received an enormous influx of Souls. Lily, [[Persephone]], Aline, Lilith, Helena and the other administrators were confronted with a processing crisis on a scale ordinary mortal governments could never experience. The Lords and administrators of Hell began revising how Souls were classified, judged and distributed, including greater automation of cases that did not require personal attention. Warriors and other useful Souls could be separated according to predetermined standards while exceptional cases remained available for individual judgment.[1005][1006]
The episode demonstrated how far Victor's family's responsibilities had expanded. They were no longer merely warriors conquering territory; they were administering systems controlling death, punishment and reincarnation for populations capable of producing millions of Souls at once.[1006]
After his vacation, Victor walked through his developing civilization with Ruby, Sasha, Hestia, [[Nero]] and Ophis and unexpectedly encountered [[Frederick Winter]], one of the closest friends from his Human life. Frederick had continued developing as an Onmyō practitioner instead of remaining the ordinary Human Victor once needed to hide from supernatural danger, but the difference between their rates of growth had become almost absurd.[1007][1008]
Victor had no intention of allowing that difference to become a death sentence when the Sector eventually faced stronger civilizations. Rather than merely granting Fred another temporary blessing, Victor fundamentally reconstructed his race with a snap, rewriting Soul and species on the spot. Using his powers over Beginning and Negativity, he transformed Frederick into a complete Noble Vampire while preserving the Onmyō abilities he had worked to acquire. The new body resisted the sun, took blood-red eyes and black hair, and carried Onmyō as its main discipline rather than a leftover human trick. Fred remained Mizuki's apprentice. [[Amaterasu]] Elderblood, [[Tsukuyomi]] and Susanoo were then set to test him: their blessings on god-touched chants would come only if he proved he was worth teaching.[1009]

##### The Twilight of the Norse Gods
Chapters 958–965
After thousands of years of preparation, Hela finally began the decisive phase of her revenge against [[Odin]]. The forces answering her call were considerably broader than [[Asgard]] expected. Her authority as a Goddess of the Dead and agreements established throughout history allowed legendary rulers and warriors to return beneath her banner. About thirty thousand Spartans came under Leonidas and hit Odin's soldiers in a spear formation that killed hundreds in one push. The Wallachian royal army came with [[Vlad III Tepes]]. Roughly seven hundred thousand Romans came under Gaius [[Julius Caesar]] [[Octavian (Roman Emperor)|Octavianus]] Augustus. Beasts out of the Abyss walked with them. Ragnarök was therefore not simply a battle between familiar Norse monsters and Gods; Hela had converted centuries of dead history into military resources.[1010]
The war erupted across multiple fronts. [[Fenrir]] and other beings associated with [[Loki]]'s family confronted Norse Gods prepared specifically for the prophecy they believed they understood, while Hela's resurrected armies overwhelmed positions Odin assumed would be defensible. Hela herself fought Odin. She cut off his left arm, broke his spear, and damaged his Soul. The End Dragon she had called destroyed his palace with pure Darkness. Frigga was erased. Fenrir shrank and bit the necks of two gods, erasing them. [[Jormungandr]]'s poison wrecked the ground around [[Thor]]. [[Freyja|Freya]] ordered the Valkyries to retreat rather than stay for Odin's last option. The defenders of Asgard possessed immense power, but Hela possessed something far more dangerous: thousands of years spent studying precisely how the Pantheon would respond.[1010][1011][1012]
Her strategy also depended upon betrayals Odin had failed to predict. Individuals he had treated as possessions or subordinate pieces possessed their own grievances and interests, turning the apparent unity of Asgard into another weapon against him. [[Idun]] turned on him because Tyr had killed her brother and Odin's punishment had not been enough. Leonidas fought Tyr. Vlad impaled [[Vidar]] on a pillar without killing him. By the end Hela had broken Gungnir, collared Odin, and forced him to answer as "Pochi." Frigga was already gone. Hela ordered the remaining gods sorted into lists: essential ones to hold, a blacklist to detain, and a death list to kill. Victor arrived and negotiated for the corpses of Odin's children and of Odin himself. By the decisive stage of the battle, Odin had lost the control upon which his preparations depended and was finally forced to confront the daughter he had imprisoned with none of the certainty that had once defined him.[1012][1013]
Victor's faction deliberately used the chaos rather than rushing to become the visible protagonist of someone else's war. While the Norse Gods and Hela destroyed one another's military strength, Dragons Nest evacuated valuable races, populations and resources. Whatever political entity eventually inherited Asgard would discover that many of the things making the Pantheon valuable had already been quietly moved beyond its reach.[1013]
Hela's victory revealed how meticulously she had planned even apparently unrelated events. Long before Vlad III ceased to exist in the form she had originally known, Hela had approached him with an agreement involving the protection of his descendants. She took a small part of his core existence, half his Soul, in exchange for a Blessing of Lineage that would keep his direct descendants safe. The rest of his Soul had already been absorbed by the Vampire King without the memory of the deal. For others she took entire Souls. She left the [[Heavenly Father]]'s and the Hindu afterlives alone, but she had been taking Greek Souls for millennia without detection. She retained what was necessary to call upon them later while ensuring the relevant memories could not simply be exposed when other beings interacted with those Souls. Similar agreements with the dead across history allowed her to assemble the forces required for Ragnarök without Odin ever understanding the complete scale of her preparations.[1014]
The chapter then revealed that something even stranger had occurred to Victor. His ascension as <CHAOS> had transformed him into a Unique Being. Ordinary individuals could possess alternative counterparts across the innumerable branches of Reality, but Victor no longer found parallel versions of himself occupying those alternatives. Whatever had happened during his transformation had made the Victor of the Main Timeline the only active expression of his existence.[1014]
The System investigated the anomaly and discovered that Creation had contained effectively infinite alternate Timelines, each possessing its own corresponding System and history. Yet after Victor's transformation, those realities had begun disappearing or converging toward the Main Timeline. The Victor who became <CHAOS> existed only once; the alternative Victors that should have occupied other histories were no longer present.[1015][1016]
Pursuing the contradiction exposed something the Universe itself had largely forgotten. The System discovered remnants pointing toward Destiny, a Primordial Regulator whose existence had been erased so thoroughly that even other [[Primordial Entities]] no longer retained ordinary knowledge of him. Destiny had once been tied to the predetermined course of Creation and its relationship with Time. With that regulator gone, the idea that events were cosmologically "written" into an unavoidable future had lost its former foundation. Futures could exist as possibilities without necessarily remaining active realities that had to occur.[1016]
The investigation became dangerous enough for Akashic to intervene directly. Queries about Rank 0, and about the System's own sentience, returned only insufficient authority. Infinity, a Primordial watching over existence, sat above that wall. Akashic ordered the System to stop probing the anomaly, to ignore it, and to act as if the cosmology were ordinary again. The countless alternate Systems were synchronized and merged into the Main-Timeline counterpart, increasing its processing power. The remaining timeline structure collapsed into a single active history, and the erased regulator known as Destiny—the Primordial of destiny and time—was gone from Creation, so the idea of a written future no longer had a keeper. The Records themselves tightened into one sphere instead of an infinite waste of branches. Rather than Creation continuing as infinitely branching realities containing every realized alternative, only the Main Timeline remained as the living historical Reality, while potential futures became possibilities rather than simultaneously existing worlds.[1017]
Ragnarök therefore coincided with a transformation infinitely larger than the death of a Pantheon. While Odin's order collapsed in Asgard, the cosmological structure surrounding Victor ceased functioning as the branching system it had once been. Victor did not yet understand every implication, but the absence of Destiny and his own status as a Unique Being would become essential to understanding why his future could no longer be treated like that of an ordinary inhabitant of Creation.[1015][1016][1017]

##### What Remains After a Pantheon Falls
Chapters 966–973
With [[Odin]] defeated, the surviving Norse world belonged effectively to Hela. Yet victory did not produce the triumphant reconstruction outsiders expected. Victor's people had already removed enormous portions of the useful population, assets and resources during the war, while Hela herself possessed little desire to become another God-Queen ruling the same civilization that had imprisoned her. She watched Victor's household from a distance and felt the absence of the family she did not have. Ice giants, fire giants, and elves entered new arrangements. The dwarves were subdued by Nyx Elderblood's eternal night and made loyal. The end of her revenge left her with freedom and territory but also forced her to decide what she actually wanted once Odin was no longer the center of her existence.[1018]
Hela's answer was characteristically unconventional. Roughly two months after Ragnarök, she summoned representatives of the major supernatural powers and announced that she intended to sell the [[Norse Pantheon]]. What was on offer was the dimension and its lands, exchanged for artifacts and precious materials, and the key to the realm. Treasures she wanted, and the Gods themselves, stayed hers. A defeated [[Thor]] was brought out on all fours with a leash, not as a relic of the old order but as her bodyguard and proof that [[Asgard]] was finished. The hall included [[Shiva]], [[Indra]], the [[Heavenly Father]], the God-King of the [[Celtic Pantheon]], [[Amaterasu]] Elderblood, Haruna, and Victor—announced as Emperor Victor Elderblood—with Empress [[Violet Elderblood Snow]] beside him.[1019]
Victor attended under the increasingly elaborate titles accumulated around his existence while outwardly behaving as though Hela's proposal had surprised him. In reality, his faction had already profited immensely from the events leading to the auction. The supposedly spontaneous sale consequently became another demonstration of how Victor's family preferred manipulating a battlefield before conventional rulers even realized a game was being played.[1019]
Violet Elderblood Snow stood beside Victor not as the young Vampire heiress she had once been but as an increasingly formidable Divine being in her own right. Concepts developing around Order and Obsession reflected two of the traits that had always defined her: the desire to organize everything around her and the overwhelming possessiveness focused upon Victor. That pair sat against his own obsessive Divinity and left a pressure other Gods could feel. She also carried the Nightmare Tower, a Divine artifact loaded with Soul, Death, The End, Beginning, Life, War, destruction, and time. Her evolution demonstrated that Victor's ascension had not left his original wives behind; their own paths were becoming increasingly conceptual and Divine.[1020]
The appearance of technology such as [[Shiro-Hime]] further changed the nature of the negotiations. She was Violet's own ship: a continental craft of runes and science, built to travel in space, kept alive by a yellow star used as its core, and armed with a cannon that could break a planet. Divine Artifacts were no longer limited to swords, spears or enchanted objects. Enormous technological constructs capable of functioning as strategic weapons could now stand beside ancient mythological treasures, forcing Gods accustomed to judging value through traditional artifacts to confront civilizations combining science and Divinity on scales unfamiliar to them.[1020][1021]
The auction became a political contest among the major factions. Gods evaluated whether the territory was worth its price, whether Hela could be trusted, whether another Pantheon acquiring Asgard would become dangerous, and whether attempting to take the realm by force would provoke everyone else present. Even Gods who normally relied upon overwhelming personal authority were increasingly constrained by a political landscape dominated by alliances surrounding Victor.[1022][1023]
Negotiations were deliberately structured so that the gathering could conclude without immediately becoming another Divine war. Shiva took the deal. He signed for the Nordic pantheon and paid with three essences, dreams and madness among them. Hela handed him the key and kept the essences. Victor's side had already taken what it wanted from the war itself and left the other Pantheons to bid on what remained.[1024]
Afterward, the atmosphere among Violet, Haruna, Amaterasu, Hela and the others revealed how extensively the entire situation had been treated as a game played around the expectations of Gods who believed themselves clever. Hela, once defined almost exclusively through vengeance against Odin, was increasingly finding herself socially entangled with Victor's family. The celebration took place amid the rapidly changing civilization built from the former Egyptian territory, which was itself acquiring the identity of [[Elvenorah, the Eternal Utopia]].[1025]

##### Building for the Future
Chapters 974–978
Victor next examined the society being developed under [[Velnorah Xyphora Elderblood Thaloria II]]. Elvenorah had expanded at an extraordinary rate, accommodating millions of inhabitants within a city rebuilt through the cooperation of advanced technology, magic and supernatural labor. Velnorah organized the civilization around a form of Technocracy: essential necessities were provided while education, research, productive specialization and technological contribution were heavily encouraged. Rather than reproducing a political system in which citizens spent most of their lives struggling simply to survive, the state attempted to create the stability necessary for talented people to devote themselves to advancement.[1026]
Automation and artificial intelligence were intended to assume increasingly large portions of ordinary labor, monitoring and security. At the same time, Velnorah did not intend to hand the entire civilization blindly to machines. Important positions remained distributed among trusted people and capable deputies, reducing both corruption and the catastrophic dependence created when a society could function only while one irreplaceable ruler was personally present.[1026]
The city was therefore not simply another conquered territory. It became one of Victor's greatest social experiments: a place where different races, supernatural systems and advanced technology could be reorganized from the beginning according to the principles favored by his family. Its structure differed even from Hell, whose political foundation remained much closer to an absolute monarchy.[1026]
Victor deliberately avoided micromanaging Velnorah. Her experience with [[Eldoria]] gave her knowledge of civilization-building and high technology far beyond his own, and Victor considered one of the greatest advantages of his enormous family to be the number of exceptional specialists he could trust with responsibilities outside his personal expertise. For Velnorah, successfully constructing Elvenorah meant even more. It gave her an opportunity to create something new after the collapse and failures associated with her original civilization rather than spending eternity defined by the world she had lost.[1027][1028]
Victor also reminded Velnorah that possessing a Divine or Draconic body did not make mental exhaustion impossible. Gods could ignore physical fatigue to absurd degrees while still destroying themselves psychologically if they never stopped working. His concern for her reflected the same principle his wives had recently forced upon him during his vacation: immortality made rest easier to neglect, not less necessary. The private talk did not stay only about rest. In her true scale she matched his nearly four-meter height. Her body was soft, chubby and voluptuous, everything larger in proportion, and he compared the softness to [[Aphrodite]]. His own size was proportional to that height. She touched him, stroked the veins, and mounted with her legs spread, but she stopped short of taking him. Draconic heat rose in her, yet she was not emotionally ready. She rested on his chest instead. He kissed her, let his hands roam, and told her he wanted all of her without forcing the act.[1028]
His weapon [[Junketsu]] underwent an equally important change. The sword's consciousness and obsessive attachment to Victor had continued developing until describing her as merely a sentient Divine Artifact became increasingly inaccurate. She first closed over him as full armor, black and violet, face included, with a violet crystal pulsing at the chest. Then she dissolved into a slime-like liquid, ate the demonic armor he had been wearing, and fused at the level of the Soul. A white sphere tied to that possessiveness pushed the evolution. Once merged, she could still become armor, answer what he wanted, and raise layered shields against corruption, manipulation, invasion, observation, reality-tampering and Soul attacks. She rejected substitutes, including the living metal Velnorah could have built for him. Her accumulated properties could automatically react when Victor was threatened, making the weapon less something Victor carried and more a possessive life-form permanently incorporated into him.[1029][1030]

##### A Voice Beyond the Known Cosmos
Chapters 979–985
The final chapters shifted perspective far beyond Victor's immediate territories and revealed the origin of the strange presence that had occasionally touched his existence. [[Azathoth Elderblood]] had not originated as a God, Demon, Dragon or any species produced by Victor's native Creation. She emerged from foreign [[Chaos]] as an Eldritch existence with no natural place inside the Rules governing the Cosmos Victor knew.[1031]
Azathoth initially understood almost nothing about herself or the realities she encountered. She spread portions of her Essence across immense distances, consuming and observing other beings in an attempt to acquire experience, including beings of light whose knowledge taught her that Primordials and a barrier existed. At one point she encountered and consumed an extraordinarily advanced world filled with powerful life, absorbing not merely Energy but knowledge and memories on a scale that accelerated her self-awareness enormously. Her existence expanded until celestial scales ceased meaning what they did to ordinary creatures.[1031]
Such an intruder inevitably attracted the attention of the native cosmic administrators. Beings connected to [[The Universal Tree]], Limbo, Death, Infinity and the other fundamental systems confronted her after she consumed that sphere of life. Yet Azathoth was not simply another native Goddess who could be erased according to the normal Rules of Death; she had originated from outside the system whose authorities were being used against her. Unable to deal with her as they would an ordinary native entity, the cosmic powers sealed her inside a closed dimension.[1031]
Imprisonment did not make Azathoth passive. Before and during her confinement she packed tiny spheres of her Essence together with powers taken from consumed Gods and hid them where they would not be obvious. A God later threw some of those fragments into lower Sectors by using his son's Divinities of Concealment and Penetration. The fragments functioned as eyes, feeding points and slow siphons, corruptive and almost impossible to notice, through which she could continue observing worlds far beyond the place holding her body.[1031]
One such connection eventually exposed an extraordinary region. Azathoth observed Vampires, [[Werewolves]], Witches, Youkai and other beings whose recent development made the otherwise lower region unusually interesting. At the center of the anomaly stood Victor. The more she examined him, the clearer the impossible conclusion became: beneath the Dragon, Vampire and Divine characteristics covering him, Victor was developing into the same fundamental kind of existence as herself—an Eldritch being associated with Chaos rather than something completely contained by the native Cosmos.[1032]
For an entity whose existence had been defined by isolation, that realization became overwhelming. Azathoth had finally discovered a potential companion. She developed a humanoid female form contrasting Victor's masculine appearance, adopted the identity Azathoth and continued observing him with rapidly increasing fascination. The very act of understanding herself caused her existence to mature further.[1032]
Unable to personally reach Victor from her prison, Azathoth used a tiny quantity of Victor's Essence obtained through their distant connection and combined it with her own. The result was not simply a message but a child: [[Yog-Sothoth]] Elderblood. Yog inherited the overwhelming majority of her fundamental characteristics from Victor while simultaneously carrying the foreign Eldritch traits supplied by Azathoth. She was then sent through their connection toward the father she had never met.[1032][1033]
Victor's response was immediate confusion followed by equally immediate acceptance. Whatever absurd cosmic process had produced Yog, she recognized him as her father and possessed enough of his Essence for Victor himself to feel their connection. Her purpose included learning from Victor and eventually becoming capable of helping Azathoth escape confinement, but Victor refused to reduce her existence to that mission. As far as he was concerned, Yog was his daughter before she was anyone's weapon or rescue mechanism.[1033]
Yog's presence nevertheless made her abnormal origin impossible to ignore. She arrived looking like a small child of about a year, with Victor's face and a composure that did not match the body, carrying only the basic knowledge Azathoth had given her: learn, and eventually help her mother out of prison. Merely existing could distort the Reality surrounding her because her powers had not been produced according to the same native Rules as ordinary Concepts. Victor identified qualities associated with Space, Intangibility and Nullity. Nullity, as she expressed it, could erase from matter up through metaphysical concepts and could also reverse an erasure, which put it in a position to answer even Death and Infinity. Their behavior differed from native Divine Concepts bearing similar names. When her excitement warped the space around them and ordinary Draconic authority proved insufficient, Victor used the nightmare side of himself, the Eldritch layer, and the distortion obeyed. He recognized his daughter as an Outer God.[1033][1034]
Introducing Yog to the rest of the Elderblood household produced considerably less philosophical reactions. [[Ophis Tepes Elderblood]] and [[Nero Elderblood]] immediately became jealous of the unfamiliar sister receiving their father's attention and began worrying that unknown daughters might continue appearing whenever Victor explored another corner of existence. Violet, Anna, Leona and the other women were left attempting to understand how Victor had somehow acquired a biological and metaphysical daughter with a woman imprisoned somewhere beyond any civilization they currently knew.[1035]
The more experienced mothers focused upon a different danger. Yog possessed powers potentially capable of interacting with Space, Death, Infinity and other fundamental phenomena in ways native beings might have difficulty resisting. That potential made it easy to imagine treating her as the solution to future cosmic problems. [[Scathach Elderblood Scarlett]], [[Jeanne Elderblood]], Anna and [[Hestia]] Elderblood firmly rejected that approach. Yog was still a child. Her first responsibility was to learn, grow and develop an identity—not to become an instrument for adults simply because she happened to have been born extraordinarily powerful.[1036][1037]
Victor agreed completely. He intended to guide Yog just as he guided his other daughters, allowing her strength to develop alongside judgment and experience rather than rushing her toward battles she had no emotional maturity to understand. The volume closed on a lighter note that still carried his household's usual excess. [[Violet Elderblood Snow]] threw herself at his chest. Anna stopped the younger girls from hearing what followed. Victor, Violet and the women he named vanished into a sealed room. Indecent sounds started at once. The chapter itself declines to describe the rest, joking that the sealed room would require fifteen thousand words of adult detail.[1037]
Dragon God of Chaos therefore ended with Victor's definition of his world expanding in almost every possible direction. He had begun the volume by accepting the incomprehensible creature within himself as his True Self and spent the following months discovering what that acceptance meant. [[Amaterasu]] entered his family, Velnorah revealed the scale of Upper-Sector civilization, several of his wives evolved into [[True Dragons]], War became the origin of a new Chaos lineage, Anna awakened an extraordinarily dangerous form of Reality manipulation, Hell developed into a functioning civilization, old enemies were judged and repurposed, Ragnarök destroyed [[Odin]]'s rule, and the System discovered that Creation's infinite alternate Timelines were collapsing into a single Main Timeline.
At the same time, Victor's faction stopped behaving like a collection of supernatural families and increasingly became a genuine civilization. The former Egyptian territories evolved into a multiracial state, Elvenorah became a technological and social experiment, his wives developed actual chains of command, Hell automated the administration of Souls, Velnorah introduced knowledge originating from civilizations far beyond Earth and Victor began preparing ordinary members of his family and old friends for the day when his Sector could no longer remain isolated.
Yet the most important expansion was conceptual rather than territorial. Victor discovered that even the Universe whose Gods once appeared infinitely vast was only one Creation among possibilities beyond it. Azathoth represented an existence whose origin lay outside the native cosmological structure, and Yog proved that Victor's own developing Eldritch nature could interact, reproduce and form familial bonds with such beings. The man who had once believed becoming a Vampire revealed an enormous hidden world ended Volume 7 learning that even his entire native Cosmos was no longer sufficient to define either what he was becoming or how far the Elderblood family could eventually spread.[939][1031][1032][1037]
