Citizens who died were no longer automatically surrendered to unrelated supernatural systems; their Souls could be evaluated, exceptional individuals preserved for future service and ordinary citizens who had lived acceptably sent through a reincarnation structure increasingly governed by Victor's Empire.[1192] The personal territories of Victor's family expanded alongside the civilization. Victor granted the Greek members of his household an enormous planet on which they could preserve their temples, architecture, traditions and Divine culture without recreating the political failures that had destroyed [[Olympus]].[1193] [[Aphrodite]] reacted enthusiastically to the gift, while the other Greek wives rapidly became jealous enough that Victor expanded the world until there was more than enough territory for everyone. Even [[Gaia]] and Nyx, who initially acted indifferent, claimed regions once the planet was prepared. The project preserved Greek culture while making clear that Olympus as an independent political order was not being restored.
Natalia demonstrated another method of planetary expansion. While examining the distribution of [[World Trees]], she studied approximately 200 Solar Systems and found World Tree-bearing worlds in around eighty of them; the observation established that such worlds were widespread in the sample but did not prove that forty percent of every Solar System in the Sector contained one.[1194] Natalia then selected a newly formed rocky planet and used her Time Authority, supported by Victor's Energy, to accelerate geological processes that would normally have required billions of years. The immature celestial body rapidly developed toward a usable planetary state, demonstrating that the Empire now possessed several separate methods of producing habitable worlds: natural World Trees, worlds sustained directly by Victor, advanced terraforming and accelerated planetary evolution through Natalia.
[[Scathach Elderblood Scarlett]] devoted an entire world to warfare. Her training planet contained fortifications, logistical infrastructure, arenas and approximately one hundred million recruits, allowing the philosophy she once imposed upon a few personal disciples to become the training foundation of an interstellar military civilization.[1195] [[Scathach]]'s competitiveness did not diminish merely because the Empire had become overwhelmingly powerful compared with the old world; if anything, being surrounded by Dragon Goddesses and enemies from higher cosmic territories gave her even greater motivation to continue improving. The Fulger branch was simultaneously drawn deeper into administration. Carmila, Natashia, Natasha, Victoria and Sasha handled different responsibilities while reflecting upon how much Victor had changed as a ruler. The younger Victor had tried to involve himself personally in nearly every problem concerning people he cared about, while the Emperor of a Galactic civilization had finally accepted that meaningful delegation was unavoidable. His wives and trusted subordinates increasingly governed major parts of the Empire independently rather than functioning merely as assistants waiting for his instructions.[1196]
The treatment of [[Eros]] demonstrated that the household's extraordinary emphasis upon family did not mean relatives could act without consequences. Aphrodite Elderblood had repeatedly warned and punished her son for refusing to control impulses inherited from the old Greek order, and his behavior finally crossed an unforgivable boundary when his desires turned toward one of Aphrodite's own daughters.[1197] During their confrontation, Aphrodite's authority had grown enough that a simple command to remain silent was enforced directly by Reality. Looking through him, she concluded that Eros valued the privileges available through her connection to Victor more than rebuilding a genuine relationship with his mother and formally disowned him. His punishment did not stop there. Rather than allowing Victor to become involved, Violet arranged for Eros to be taken away and his Soul recycled: the identity, personality and memories belonging to Eros were erased while the surviving Divine foundation associated with Love was repurposed into a new lesser Goddess intended to serve within the Empire. The episode drew a sharp distinction between Olympus and the Elderblood dynasty—blood, Divine ancestry and historical status could not excuse conduct the family regarded as fundamentally unacceptable, and even Aphrodite's biological son could lose his place within it entirely.[1197]

##### The Hundred-Thousand-Year Empire and Its Superprojects
Chapters 1145–1148
By the later stages of the temporal ritual, Imperial development had moved beyond conventional technological progress. Beginning around the 30th millennium, genetics became one of the Empire's major sciences, and within less than another twenty thousand years the biological baseline of ordinary citizens had changed dramatically. A normal Imperial citizen could casually perform feats that Old World Humans would have regarded as superhuman, while average life expectancy approached approximately 300 years and was projected to reach around 400 years by Imperial Year 100,000.[1198] Victor deliberately wanted these improvements distributed throughout civilization rather than creating an Empire in which a tiny supernatural aristocracy possessed all meaningful power while the general population remained helpless.
From approximately the 70th millennium, the ruling family began transforming the Imperial galaxy itself into a defensive structure. Victor maintained overall Galactic stability while his Dragon Goddesses manipulated asteroids, moons, stars, nebulae, black holes and other astronomical bodies. Creatures originating from Hela's previous wars were distributed throughout strategically important regions and enhanced through Victor and [[Azathoth Elderblood]].[1198] These Eldritch organisms could inhabit or hide within asteroids, stellar environments and even black holes, allowing apparently empty regions of space to contain living weapons waiting for hostile intruders. Victor altered them so they did not require conventional feeding and could remain dormant without devastating surrounding ecosystems, effectively turning the galaxy itself into hostile terrain for enemies unfamiliar with Imperial defenses.
Imperial Year 100,000 became a major cultural milestone. Avatars of Victor and [[Violet Elderblood Snow]] appeared in the capital during a gigantic military parade broadcast throughout the Empire. In [[Nightingale]], [[Vlad III Tepes|Vlad Tepes]] and [[Alexios Alioth]] watched the event and confronted how thoroughly the balance of power had changed.[1198] Vlad had deliberately avoided subjectively experiencing most of the accelerated era, preferring to encounter the transformed civilization later rather than live through another enormous stretch of immortality, whereas Alexios had taken full advantage of Imperial development and completed the step into the ancestral state of his race. The Empire had also corrected several basic weaknesses of Noble Vampire biology in general; Vlad himself had become stronger through those upgrades and could now consume ordinary food rather than remaining biologically restricted to Blood. The military parade made the difference equally clear: members of the Imperial Guard could contend with powers comparable to a first-generation Primordial God such as the old Nyx, and Vlad privately recognized that merely possessing the Guard would once have allowed him to conquer his former world hundreds of times without serious resistance.
Rather than regarding this buildup as excessive, Vlad understood what it implied about the powers waiting beyond the Sector. He also recognized that the spectacle served a political purpose inside the Empire. Victor did not immediately eliminate every ambitious or dissatisfied faction; allowing potential rebels enough freedom to gather made them easier to identify, monitor and eventually exploit or eliminate if they crossed into genuine betrayal. Seeing [[Ophis Tepes Elderblood]] thriving inside Victor's civilization also continued changing Vlad's attitude toward her future. She had long since ceased being the vulnerable daughter he once tried to control and had grown into an extraordinarily powerful Being who clearly wanted Victor. Vlad increasingly accepted their eventual union rather than treating it as something he could prevent.[1198]
Victor's oldest Human relationships remained recognizable despite the enormous amount of subjective Time that had passed. [[Andrew Walter]], [[Frederick Winter]] and [[Edward Jonathan Elizabeth Lykos|Edward Lykos]] continued speaking and arguing much as they had before Victor became Emperor.[1199] They were joined by members of the Lykos family and two of Victor's daughters, Leone Luna Elena Elderblood, daughter of Leona, and [[Mirabelle Elizabeth Elderblood]], daughter of Maya. Leone strongly resembled her mother, with white hair and Victor's violet eyes, while Mirabelle inherited Maya's darker complexion, short white hair and athletic characteristics. The younger generation initially underestimated Victor's old friends because their own standard for strength had become completely distorted by growing up among True Dragon Goddesses and the other monsters surrounding the Imperial Family.
The meeting clarified that the violet eyes inherited by Victor's daughters were not merely cosmetic. Every daughter carried some variation of Victor's ability to perceive deeper truths of Reality. The strength differed at birth—some daughters possessed exceptionally powerful forms immediately while others began at weaker levels—but every one of them could develop the Eyes through training.[1199] Johnny also asked Leona to arrange training for his children beneath [[Scathach]]. Leona warned that receiving attention from Scathach and actually becoming one of her recognized disciples were different matters; she could arrange an introduction, but Scathach personally decided who possessed the talent and [[Will Solace|Will]] necessary for deeper instruction. Johnny nevertheless preferred severe training to raising children incapable of protecting themselves in the future Empire.
Elsewhere, [[Lilith Elderblood]] personally trained [[Liriel Elderblood]] inside the Frost Hell. Born from two Progenitors, Liriel inherited the foundations of both a True Dragon and True Demon. Her body possessed a form of instant physical evolution: after suffering a corporeal attack once, the same attack became completely useless against her when repeated.[1200] The effect remained inferior to Victor's deeper Conceptual adaptation but still gave Liriel extraordinary natural resistance. Her arsenal included highly toxic Hell Miasma, Hellfire fused with Dragonfire, portals leading into different Hells and abilities that became progressively more dangerous as negative effects accumulated upon an enemy. She had also become highly proficient in the Dragon Language and learned to combine the Demonic and Draconic aspects of her existence instead of treating them as unrelated systems. Lilith left formal martial instruction largely to Scathach and concentrated upon genuine combat mentality, teaching Liriel that pride was acceptable only while it never prevented victory and that real enemies would never respect the rules of a training arena.
Liriel wanted eventually to become a Legion Commander and refused to remain behind sisters such as [[Nero]], Ophis, [[Metis]] and Velina, who were already contributing directly to military or scientific development. Her ambition existed within a family whose entire second generation was beginning to seek personal roles rather than merely remaining protected princesses. Victor's public address during the hundred-thousand-year celebration sharpened that determination further. He openly informed his citizens that their civilization still occupied a comparatively small cosmic "bubble" and that the weakening barrier surrounding the Sector would eventually expose them to civilizations and rulers vastly beyond the old world. Victor declared that he had no intention of kneeling before those powers and intended instead to make them kneel before him.[1200]
Victor then made a supernatural promise to his population: even if their bodies were destroyed in the future war, their Souls would remain protected through him. Crimson power accompanied the declaration and established a tangible connection between Emperor and citizen that even Divine observers could perceive. More than ninety-nine percent of the Empire responded with intense Faith and loyalty, while only especially ancient or naturally cautious species remained comparatively reserved.[1200] Victor announced that approximately another 100,000 internal years remained before the original ritual target was reached. His daughters reacted badly to the hypothetical suggestion that Victor himself could die during the coming conflict, with several immediately proposing increasingly extreme methods of preventing anyone from ever threatening their father. Their mothers eventually intervened before the discussion escalated beyond ordinary Elderblood family absurdity.
The speech triggered another enormous surge in development. Industrial output, research, population and magical progress accelerated as Imperial citizens attempted to contribute more aggressively toward the future war.[1201] [[Aphrodite]] and the Goddesses beneath her fertility-related authority encouraged the demographic explosion enthusiastically, with families containing more than one hundred children no longer necessarily regarded as extraordinary in parts of the Empire. Victor estimated that many of the ritual's intended goals could be completed within another approximately 50,000 years if development continued at the same pace. He slightly increased the temporal pressure and discovered that the enormous strain itself was refining his Energy control, while admitting that he had badly underestimated the ritual's original cost; without Jeanne and his other wives supporting him, he could eventually have become little more than an unconscious living power source sustaining the Empire.
[[Jeanne Elderblood]] improved dramatically through the same process. Where she had initially been able to support only a relatively small portion of the ritual, she could now maintain around thirty percent comfortably and approximately forty percent when necessary, believing she was approaching the peak she once possessed through her ancient connection to a Primordial World Tree.[1201] Victor nevertheless recognized that greater efficiency with abilities he already possessed was not the same as another true ascension. Advancement through his Eldritch nature risked attracting the attention of cosmic powers, while progression through <Negativity> remained incomplete so long as <Positivity> existed within another Being. Remaining indefinitely inside a Sector he already dominated would eventually stop providing the conditions required for qualitative growth.
Victor also clarified why he did not rely excessively upon distant future sight. At the level occupied by himself and the other strongest Beings, the future changed too easily to be treated as predetermined. He preferred short-term foresight useful during combat rather than allowing distant possibilities to dictate every decision.[1201] Small dissident movements were treated similarly pragmatically. Victor intentionally tolerated and monitored groups that merely disagreed with Imperial rule because allowing dissatisfaction to gather in visible places made genuine threats easier to identify. Disagreement by itself was not treason, but he intended to know exactly where dangerous factions stood before the Upper-Sector war began. Meanwhile, the younger generation continued developing: [[Melida Charlotte Elderblood]] obtained increasingly successful results with Soul-related and high-order Energies inherited through her reincarnated nature, while Metis and Akasha matured into increasingly capable Imperial figures. Akasha in particular appeared more interested in managing the Shadow Realm and Imperial systems than obtaining a conventional military title, despite already carrying responsibilities comparable to those of a Legion Commander.[1201]

##### Heaven, Kassandra and Victor's Human Bloodline
Chapters 1149–1153
[[Ariel Elderblood]] visited the [[Heavenly Father]] alongside her daughter [[Ariella Victoria Elderblood]]. Ariella inherited Ariel's facial characteristics together with Victor's black hair and violet eyes, but her abilities represented a much deeper union of their existences.[1202] She had been born carrying all Seven Heavenly Virtues—Chastity, Charity, Temperance, Diligence, Patience, Benevolence and Humility—as Divine Concepts, while her True Dragon biology allowed her to possess them without suffering the same behavioral restrictions that could affect conventional Angels. Ariella also inherited traces of Victor's Creator-related Divinity. The Heavenly Father demonstrated his own extraordinary specialization by creating Life with almost no wasted Energy, initially impressing Ariella until he suggested Victor had not surpassed his mastery and immediately triggered the intense paternal loyalty common among Victor's daughters. Ariella later became fascinated by Heaven's ancient administrative system, criticized portions of its construction as outdated and began rewriting them. To the Heavenly Father's surprise, several of her modifications genuinely improved the system, emphasizing the difference between Heaven's immense historical knowledge and the [[Elderblood Empire]]'s culture of relentless innovation.
Ariel's real purpose was strategic. She provided Heaven with Imperial research concerning Angel biology and methods through which Angels could become more Divine, then explained the Empire's provisional threat classifications for the coming Upper-Sector war.[1202] Combatants around CODE V-03, corresponding roughly to Continental-level threats, could function as expendable enemy soldiers rather than elites. Ariel also showed the Heavenly Father information regarding the Solar-System-destroying weapon encountered by Victor's clone, demonstrating that civilizations beyond the Sector could treat destruction on a scale once associated with apocalyptic Divine warfare as ordinary military firepower.
[[Kali Elderblood]] undertook a similar mission inside the Hindu territory alongside [[Kassandra Kashvi Elderblood]]. Kassandra had been born under radically different conditions from most of her sisters. Victor and Kali both possessed profound relationships with Destruction, and their daughter was born as Destruction incarnate, already possessing the aptitude to become the native Universe's future Primordial of Destruction.[1203] Because a newborn with almost no self-control could erase a planet through something as trivial as a cough or sneeze, Victor and Kali sealed most of her power behind a limiter comparable in principle to the restraints Victor had once used upon himself. The limiter did not diminish her ultimate potential; it restricted how much of that potential she could express before gaining the control necessary to wield it safely.
Her True Dragon Bloodline did not remain a passive container around the Concept. Victor's predatory Draconic inheritance actively assimilated Destruction into Kassandra's biology, causing her Draconic powers themselves to carry destructive properties.[1203] Even Reality alterations imposed through the Dragon Language inherited the character of Destruction, allowing her commands to erase what they targeted with extraordinary efficiency. Chapter 1150 also drew a direct distinction between Destruction and <END>. Destruction could erase matter and structures while leaving the deeper record of their existence—including their place in Space-Time and the Akashic cycle—available for Creation to recycle, whereas END represented a more absolute conceptual termination capable of deleting the record itself. Victor was privately relieved that Kassandra had not been born as END. She additionally inherited Victor's Eyes and traces of <Negativity>, giving her several separate paths of future development.
Kassandra's personality remained far less abstract than her powers. She treasured the old limiter gloves Victor had once worn and reacted aggressively when Gods in [[Shiva]]'s court evaluated her as a possible political match. Kali had to suppress the situation before her daughter's hostility reduced the meeting to violence, only to discover that Kassandra was equally suspicious of Kali's long friendship with Shiva. Kassandra warned that she would side with Victor even against her own mother if she ever believed Kali had betrayed him, forcing Kali to drag her into a private dimension and discipline her before negotiations could continue.[1203]
Kali's official purpose was to strengthen Shiva for the future war. She delivered the battle report from Victor's encounter with the Empire of Light and shared the deeper understanding of Destruction that she and Victor believed Shiva needed, focusing upon comprehension rather than simply increasing his reserves.[1204] Kali explained that the Empire was planning under deliberately pessimistic assumptions: enemy cannon fodder could begin around CODE V-03 and exist in the billions, while elite Gods and the strongest combatants were provisionally being treated as potentially CODE V-06, the Galactic category. She emphasized that these values were not verified measurements of every Upper-Sector force; they were contingency estimates based upon the fragmentary intelligence the Empire possessed.
While Kali and Shiva spoke, Kassandra detected a hidden boy whose appearance resembled Victor by roughly half, with the remainder carrying Shiva's characteristics. She brought him into the meeting immediately and demanded an explanation.[1204] Shiva admitted that the boy was connected to Victor's Human ancestry and that he had obtained him through a transaction involving a Primordial power. Kali inferred that access to the [[Akashic Records]] on this scale was likely connected to the Judges of the Abyss, although this remained her deduction rather than a directly confirmed identity for the party to Shiva's deal.
Victor arrived personally in Chapter 1152 and examined the boy's Past, identifying the original person as [[Veylan Valentin Walker]], an ancestor born around the eighteenth century who had lived through the beginning of the Industrial Age, later moved to the United States and died at the age of seventy-six.[1205] Victor immediately realized that Shiva had not resurrected the continuous Veylan who had completed that life. The Primordial transaction had retrieved a younger record from the Akashic structure and manifested that information through Shiva's Divinity, producing an extraordinarily convincing reconstruction that lacked the memories and accumulated history of the original man's later years. Victor therefore regarded the child as effectively a highly realistic counterfeit built from Veylan's recorded information rather than the actual ancestor returned from death.
The encounter nevertheless supplied useful information concerning the [[Walker Bloodline]]. Victor's research with Ruby and Aline had already suggested that the lineage accumulated potential very slowly across generations, each generation carrying slightly greater possibility than the last until the process eventually culminated in Victor's RH-null Golden Blood.[1205] He also concluded that the predatory qualities later amplified by Vampirism and Dragonhood had existed latently in his Human Bloodline long before his supernatural transformation. Victor reasoned that his entry into the supernatural world had effectively become a fixed point: had Violet not transformed him into a Vampire, Leona or another event would likely have drawn him into a different supernatural lineage, while the future Victor existing beyond the normal Universe had already made that decisive transformation exceptionally difficult to remove from history.
Victor treated Shiva's attempt to reproduce his lineage as a major breach of trust. He ordered Kali to replace Shiva as the principal ruler of the [[Indian Pantheon|Hindu Pantheon]] and sentenced Shiva to serve directly upon the most dangerous front lines during the coming war.[1205] Victor then allowed the reconstructed Veylan to complete his return to death rather than preserving an artificial copy indefinitely. As the boy dissolved, the accumulated appearance and awareness of the original old man briefly resurfaced enough for Veylan to understand what was happening and thank his descendant before disappearing.
Chapter 1153 opened after Kali had spent hours punishing Shiva for the incident.[1206] Victor returned to the temporal ritual and immediately ordered greater investment in [[Tyche]], because Shiva's success in hiding the project with Primordial assistance had exposed a genuine weakness in the Empire's intelligence network. Victor accepted that no surveillance system could be perfect against every Authority in existence, but the event demonstrated how strategically valuable Luck could become when ordinary observation failed.
Violet reached essentially the same conclusion from a much more personal direction. If Tyche eventually loved somebody outside the Elderblood household, a Goddess whose probability manipulation was approaching the point of bending Reality itself might begin favoring that person instead.[1206] Violet therefore argued that Victor should at least spend Time with Tyche and determine whether a genuine relationship could develop. Victor had barely interacted with Tyche personally and refused to treat marriage as a purely strategic acquisition, while Jeanne proposed the simpler solution of allowing them to meet naturally. Violet, predictably, immediately began planning much more aggressively.

##### Violet, Tyche and the Family's Intervention
Chapters 1154–1157
[[Tyche]] had changed enormously from the comparatively minor Greek Goddess who once remained at the edges of [[Olympus]]. Surviving [[Zeus]]' reign by avoiding the worst of the Pantheon's politics left her comparatively intact, while the Elderblood era gave her enough Faith, security and Time for her Divinity to approach the personification of Luck itself.[1207] Her evolved perception allowed her to see multiple possible outcomes surrounding what she observed and select the probability she wanted to become real. The resulting flood of possibilities caused severe headaches, leading Velnorah and Aline to create a suppressive artifact; Tyche deliberately chose a blindfold because she preferred its appearance despite Velnorah favoring something less conspicuous.
Violet approached Tyche on the Greek mega-planet and quickly discovered that Tyche already understood the likely purpose of the visit. Tyche respected Victor enormously as Emperor but admitted that she knew very little about Victor as a man because almost all of their previous interactions had been formal.[1207] She had not pursued other romantic possibilities, in part because her Luck repeatedly indicated that becoming attached elsewhere would eventually produce undesirable consequences, yet she had also been too cautious to approach Victor directly while surrounded by a household of intensely possessive Dragon Goddesses. Victor secretly observed part of the conversation while suppressing himself enough not to distort the meeting.
Chapter 1155 clarified why that suppression mattered. Victor had become an existence so information-dense that an ordinary Mortal attempting to perceive him without restraint could explode or die from informational overload; the effect would become even worse if Victor or [[Yog-Sothoth]] exposed an Eldritch Form.[1208] The chapter used an explicitly illustrative numerical analogy to demonstrate qualitative differences in existence: Tyche occupied one example level, True Dragon Goddesses such as Anna or [[Scathach]] another, Victor, Jeanne, Azathoth and Yog a still higher category, with established Primordial Beings and Creator-level existences above that. The narration explicitly stated that the numbers themselves were not literal cosmological rankings.
Violet eventually abandoned subtlety and directly proposed that Tyche join Victor's family. Before revealing deeper information, she produced a supernatural secrecy agreement similar to those used for Albedo, [[Dún Scáith|Dun Scaith]], Hela and Ariel.[1208] Part of the contract was written in Eldritch script and could not safely be interpreted by Tyche at that stage. The hidden word was Elderblood, because Victor had imposed a metaphysical restriction upon the surname itself: merely calling oneself Elderblood did not reproduce the deeper recognition associated with the dynasty, and only those Victor acknowledged could properly bear it.
Their conversation also corrected a misconception regarding True Dragon reproduction. Dragon Goddesses were not biologically limited to one child at a time; multiple children remained possible, but the Energy required to sustain more than one developing True Dragon could temporarily leave even an extremely powerful mother bedridden.[1208] Reproduction also became more difficult as the existential level of both parents increased, making Victor's Progenitor nature and precise control over fertility major reasons the Elderblood family could produce such an enormous second generation.
Violet interpreted these limitations less as warnings than as logistical problems and began expanding her plans far beyond Tyche. Victor eventually pulled her away for a private argument concerning the difference between allowing relationships to develop and treating women as strategic resources to be collected for the dynasty.[1209] Their discussion lasted approximately four subjective months inside a Time-dilated space while less than two hours passed outside. Victor remained capable of maintaining the Imperial ritual and other responsibilities simultaneously, but his position did not change: he was willing to spend Time with Tyche and women with whom genuine affection already existed, yet he refused to establish a systematic acquisition program merely because somebody possessed a useful Bloodline, Divinity or political position.
Victor acknowledged that several women already possessed real emotional histories with him and allowed Violet to create natural opportunities rather than forcing outcomes. The discussion included [[Yuki Snow]] and the Valkyries among the women whose longstanding relationships with Victor could potentially develop further. Hilda should not be treated as a new addition created by this plan: the author's later continuity correction establishes that she had already entered the harem much earlier, in Chapter 1096, and Chapters 1156–1157 were subsequently corrected around that fact.[1209][1210]
Violet nevertheless stretched Victor's permission as far as possible, and the household detected her maneuver almost immediately through what Kaguya jokingly called their supernatural "Yandere Sense". Approximately forty members of the younger generation confronted the Empress at once.[1211] Their objection was not principally that Tyche or the other women were unsuitable; several daughters actually considered Tyche's eventual inclusion obvious given her importance to the Empire. The problem was Violet attempting to make decisions affecting the family without consulting the people who would become those women's sisters and daughters.
The confrontation exposed several different kinds of authority within the Elderblood household. Anna remained the maternal figure almost every daughter obeyed immediately, while Scathach's generations of brutal training produced a different kind of instinctive obedience. Violet attempted to restore control by manifesting the Crown and Authority of Order, but Victor intervened from within his Personal Reality and simply declared the use of Order forbidden for the dispute.[1211] The Authority vanished under his Rules. Victor also prohibited aggression and deliberately refused to settle the argument for Violet, ordering mothers and daughters to resolve the family matter through conversation rather than sovereignty.
The revolt remained comedic rather than genuinely political. The daughters mocked Violet's secrecy, other wives refused to rescue her from the consequences and Valentina jokingly escalated matters by calling for Violet to be deposed in favor of Anna.[1211] Beneath the humor, the episode reinforced a consistent family principle: Violet's status as First Wife and Empress granted enormous Imperial authority, but it did not give her unilateral ownership over Victor's personal relationships or the emotional structure of the family.

##### War, the Foreign Intruder and the Upper-Sector Threat
Chapters 1158–1159
Several more years passed within the accelerated Imperial era until the internal calendar approached approximately Year 170,000. Victor had never forgotten that the entire ritual existed to prepare the Empire for powers beyond his Sector, and after generations of searching he finally obtained one of the clearest direct traces of Upper-Sector interference inside his own territory.[1212] The incident occurred in the Sagittarius Dwarf Elliptical Galaxy, approximately 80,000 light-years from [[Yggdrasil]], on a moon orbiting an Imperial-controlled world.
The central collaborator was [[Nikolai Francis Nichev]], a [[Demigod]] descended distantly from the Celtic God [[Dagda]]. His mother, [[Juliette Dubois]], was an Imperial citizen born on Yggdrasil, while his father, [[Ivankov Nichev]], carried the Dagda lineage.[1212] Nikolai had allowed himself to become [[Phlegethon Wound|the anchor]] of a foreign Divine influence interested in Victor's anomaly and Bloodline. The external power wanted information concerning how Victor's Blood worked, whether it could be cloned and what made the Emperor fundamentally different from other Beings.
War, Victor's most powerful Herald and the Progenitor of a race created specifically to serve the Emperor, confronted Nikolai personally. War's presence alone began eroding Nikolai's sanity and existence, yet the foreign protection attached to him allowed the Demigod to resist far more than a normal target should have been capable of enduring.[1212] Under War's command, Nikolai admitted the objective behind the operation before the alien influence reacted violently. War's accompanying Heralds captured everyone involved and transferred them to the Third Legion.
The compromised installation was not preserved. War moved away from the planet, compressed the entire moon into a small object without disturbing the world beneath it, obliterated the contaminated structure and immediately created an identical replacement in the same orbit.[1212] The event illustrated how dramatically Imperial standards had changed: eliminating and replacing a moon had become routine cleanup for one of Victor's highest servants.
Victor refused to transport the foreign contamination anywhere near his family. He left the ritual temporarily and moved Nikolai into a sacrificial laboratory constructed inside an isolated dimension near the edge of the Sector, a location he could abandon or destroy if containment failed.[1212] Draconic and Eldritch Runes sealed the laboratory away from ordinary Reality while Victor prepared a Runic altar capable of constraining the unknown entity operating through Nikolai.
The fragment eventually revealed that the rulers beyond Victor's Sector were not merely watching him. One superior power intended to kill and absorb him as part of the competition surrounding the greater cosmic throne, while other forces were interested in his Authorities and the anomaly represented by his growth. Victor had expected <Light> to oppose him because Positivity and Negativity were divided portions of the same greater foundation, but the idea that unrelated powers might attempt to seize those Authorities directly made the situation considerably more dangerous.[1212]
When the captive began mentioning figures such as <Darkness>, <Emperor> and <Law>, an existential Soul Contract activated and destroyed both body and Soul before the restricted information could be spoken.[1212] Victor simply refused to let the destruction remain permanent. Combining Negativity, Life, Beginning, Time, Space, Soul manipulation, Eldritch power, Draconic Reality distortion, the prepared Runes and complete dimensional isolation, he reconstructed the shattered existence and prevented it from completing the normal transition into the [[Akashic Records]]. Every time the contract destroyed the captive again, Victor restored it again.
The interrogation ultimately repeated this cycle 623,596,777,174 times. Years passed subjectively inside the sealed dimension while Victor continuously reconstructed the fragment, restored its collapsing mind and extracted everything it genuinely knew.[1212] The captive was not one of the supreme rulers of the Upper Sectors and much of its knowledge consisted of rumors, impressions and information filtered through lower ranks, so Victor deliberately refused to treat every statement as unquestionable fact. Prolonged exposure to Victor's unrestricted Eldritch presence eventually destroyed the foreign God connected through Nikolai, after which Victor erased the contaminated remains and destroyed the interrogation dimension rather than attempting to absorb something whose full nature he still considered unsafe.
Chapter 1159 opened with Victor bringing the recovered intelligence before Violet, Sasha, Ruby, Velnorah, [[Amaterasu]], [[Aphrodite]], Kali, Jeanne, [[Scathach]], Azathoth and other senior members of the family.[1213] He filtered the memories before sharing them because direct exposure to the interrogation and his manifested Eldritch existence could damage those without Azathoth's natural compatibility. [[Akasha Elderblood]] stored the information at extremely high security and initially restricted access to the adult Imperial leadership.
The intelligence identified the foreign faction as the [[Black Eclipse Pantheon]] and placed <Darkness> at its summit. Beneath Darkness stood seven principal Gods called the [[Seven Black Thrones]], followed by Great Gods, lesser Gods and a servant population.[1213] The operative's memories provisionally portrayed Darkness as Galactic in threat, the Seven Thrones as only somewhat below that level, elite forces around Solar-System scale and lower soldiers across Continental-to-Planetary categories. Victor, Amaterasu and Velnorah immediately warned against treating these values as reliable final measurements: the source was a comparatively minor God with incomplete access to the actual ruling class, and its Pantheon had existed for more than two million years.
The known Black Eclipse Divinities nevertheless interested the Elderblood family because several overlapped with powers already present among them. The memories referenced Gods associated with Night, Emptiness, Silence, Shadows, Death, Fear, Darkness and Oblivion, creating the possibility that defeated enemies could provide compatible Divine reinforcement.[1213] At the same time, the Pantheon's lower forces appeared heavily servitor-like, prompting Velnorah to suggest expanding artificial and engineered armies so living Imperial troops would not absorb every casualty in a prolonged war. Amaterasu warned that completely mindless forces could become dangerous if unknown enemies possessed methods capable of seizing or corrupting them, so artificial troops remained only one component of the war machine.
Victor and Azathoth responded to the corruption problem by jointly creating [[Abhoth]], a genuine Eldritch God described by Victor as living corruption.[1213] Everything touched by Abhoth could be corrupted, while Victor determined the nature of that corruption. The intended military application was defensive: fragments connected to Abhoth could be distributed through soldiers and eventually citizens so that an enemy attempting to corrupt, possess or subvert Imperial personnel risked having the hostile influence turned back upon itself while simultaneously alerting Victor. Abhoth did not contain Victor's Essence in exactly the manner Yog did, but remained directly connected to him. Combined with the separate fragments of the Little One, Victor's parallel thought processes and the World Tree network, the system was envisioned as a civilization-scale intrusion detector and counter-corruption mechanism. Victor personally claimed that there was no real countermeasure to the mechanism as he understood it, although the statement remained his assessment rather than a demonstrated absolute against every possible higher existence.[1213]
The meeting also revealed Polaris, one of the Empire's most highly classified superweapons. Construction had begun around Imperial Year 100,000, and the enormous vessel was classified as a Galaxy-[[Destroyer]]-grade Divine Artifact capable of bending Reality, Space and Time through Destruction-related systems while remaining compatible with Eldritch forces.[1213] Its most dangerous function was the ability to channel <END> through [[Fenrir]], [[Typhon]] and Jormungand. END destroyed the firing mechanism along with the attack itself, making a permanently reusable cannon impractical, so Imperial engineers abandoned that goal and instead designed the vessel around large numbers of replaceable firing systems.
Victor assigned [[Hela Elderblood]] to become familiar with Polaris because the vessel was intended primarily for her use, while Velnorah, Aline and Ruby continued developing it. He deliberately brought Pepper into the project because her creativity could generate ideas the more methodical researchers would never consider, then added Scathach to the development group as an additional restraint upon Pepper's enthusiasm.[1213] The combination of Black Eclipse intelligence, Abhoth's creation and Polaris' disclosure marked a change in Imperial preparation: the Empire was no longer planning merely to survive contact with the Upper Sectors, but to build specific systems capable of corrupting invaders, preserving its own personnel and threatening enemies operating on Galactic scales.

##### The Emperor's Daughters and the Next Generation
Chapter 1160
The narrative then shifted toward the enormous second generation produced during the accelerated era. [[Stella Elderblood]], daughter of Victor and Anna, discovered that [[Hinata Elderblood]] and [[Irene Elderblood]] had taken photographs from Anna's private collection showing Victor during his Human childhood and infancy.[1214] Stella's inherited Truth-related ability made conventional deception almost useless around her; even while deliberately suppressing most of the power, she immediately recognized lies. Because the ability functioned passively, Victor's rule prohibiting his daughters from deliberately using overwhelming supernatural abilities against one another did not prevent her from knowing when somebody was attempting to deceive her.
The photographs were especially valuable because Anna had protected the originals against supernatural duplication. Hinata and Irene consequently treated them almost like classified artifacts until [[Yog-Sothoth]] Elderblood proposed the obvious solution of simply asking Anna for copies. Anna willingly provided them, largely because Yog approached the situation honestly instead of participating in another theft attempt.[1214] The episode demonstrated why Victor maintained strict household rules concerning powers. Sisters could compete, argue, spar or duel when both sides agreed, but Conceptual Manipulation, Charm, Reality alteration and similar abilities could not be used to settle ordinary family disagreements.
Yog herself demonstrated why such restrictions were necessary. As the daughter of Victor and Azathoth, she possessed authorities associated with Unreality and Nothingness, allowing her to invalidate phenomena, Concepts and aspects of Reality rather than simply destroying them conventionally.[1214] Her potential made her one of the daughters most likely eventually to interact with or bypass restrictions surrounding Azathoth. Elsewhere, [[Gina Elderblood]], daughter of [[Gaia]], deliberately provoked [[Isabelle Elderblood]], daughter of Jeanne, into training more seriously. Isabelle's existence was directly tied to Energy and provided enormous natural talent, but Gina argued that possessing extraordinary power and actually knowing how to use it efficiently were completely different achievements. Isabelle understood that she was being manipulated but accepted the challenge anyway, demonstrating how competition between sisters prevented some of the younger generation from becoming complacent.
[[Leone Elena Luna Elderblood]], daughter of Victor and Leona, chose an even more extreme objective: she wanted eventually to become at least as dangerous as [[Scathach]].[1214] Leona immediately explained that matching Scathach could never be accomplished through raw Energy alone. Scathach's true threat came from thousands of years of warfare, martial refinement, instinct and her refusal to stop improving even after reaching levels where conventional progress became nearly impossible. Rather than discourage Leone, Leona contacted Scathach directly. Scathach enthusiastically agreed to train her personally for an entire year, causing Leone to realize too late that expressing her ambition had effectively volunteered her for one of the harshest training programs available anywhere in the Empire.

##### Pepper's Secret Research and the Billion-Sun Project
Chapters 1161–1162
[[Priscillia Penny Elderblood]] discovered that [[Pepper Scarlett Elderblood]] was involved in a project completely absent from the Imperial databases normally accessible to the Royal Family.[1215] Victor deliberately granted his daughters access to remarkable quantities of classified information because many would eventually participate directly in government, military affairs or research, so a project that did not appear at all necessarily belonged to a much narrower category of secrets. Polaris was explicitly given as another example: even many wives and daughters did not possess complete knowledge of the vessel because a genuine trump card became less useful the more people understood how it worked.
Priscillia convinced [[Rosemary Lavina Elderblood]] and [[Sylvia Elderblood]] to follow her into Pepper's private territory. Victor detected the intrusion almost immediately but chose to observe rather than interfere. Priscillia used hundreds of sophisticated Draconic Runes to penetrate the security surrounding Pepper's residence, impressing Victor enough that he privately decided the family's internal defenses needed improvement.[1215] The incident also demonstrated how difficult privacy had become inside a household containing Space-Time perception, Reality manipulation and extraordinarily advanced senses. Specially shielded areas were necessary simply to prevent Victor's daughters from perceiving everything around them accidentally.
Pepper's apparent "room" turned out to be an enormous spatially expanded residence measuring approximately 2.8 million square metres, containing forests, rivers, waterfalls and a self-contained ecosystem.[1216] Deeper inside existed an even more heavily isolated dimensional laboratory. Pepper detected the intrusion and attempted to return, only for Victor to intercept her teleportation and deliberately keep her occupied while allowing the daughters to continue exploring.
At the center of the laboratory stood an artificial star surrounded by scientific equipment and thousands of Runes. Pepper's notes casually titled the project "Creating a supernova in the palm of my hand." Phase Three had already succeeded in creating and stabilizing the artificial star, while Phase Four involved continuously feeding it until the final explosion could reach power equivalent to approximately one billion exploding suns.[1216] Pepper had temporarily used the assistance of a Sun Goddess during development and subsequently removed the helper's memory so the classified project remained compartmentalized. Multiple nested dimensions surrounded the experiment so that catastrophic failure would destroy isolated layers before reaching the inhabited world outside.
The discovery completely altered the daughters' understanding of Pepper. Publicly she was associated primarily with Culture, entertainment and preservation of artistic traditions; privately she possessed hundreds of millions of research records and treated stellar-scale engineering as a personal hobby.[1216] Rosemary's Draconic intelligence allowed her to understand unfamiliar technology unusually quickly despite lacking Pepper's obsession with research, yet even she admitted the archive was too enormous to absorb casually. The sisters immediately began wondering what Ruby, Velnorah and Aline were constructing if Pepper considered an artificial star merely one of her private projects.
Another chamber called the Room for Fun Projects contained functioning technologies inspired by fiction, experimental armor, alien machinery, rare materials and hybrid supernatural weapons. Among them were plasma weapons resembling fictional energy blades and devices combining effects such as Basilisk venom with petrification.[1216] Pepper's collection also contained photographs and recordings from Victor's early supernatural life, including moments from [[Nightingale]] and his tournament battles. For daughters raised around Victor as an almost untouchable Emperor, records showing their father as a comparatively young Vampire became some of the most valuable things in the room. Anna eventually discovered the trespass. Entering a mother's protected area could have earned the daughters a year of [[Scathach]]'s re-education, but Pepper used her own authority to reduce the punishment to approximately six additional months of lessons because they had not actually damaged anything.

##### Victor's Old Friends and Velnorah's New Race
Chapters 1163–1164
The mature scale of the Empire became equally visible through Victor's oldest friends. On a newly contacted planet in the Andromeda Galaxy, [[Frederick Winter]] and [[Andrew Walter]] voluntarily descended from an Imperial fleet to fight an aggressive alien species despite orbital support and the imminent arrival of the Spartans.[1217] Fred had become one of the Empire's foremost Onmyō practitioners and remained a disciple of Mizuki, while Andrew served through the reorganized Imperial Inquisition. Their long histories with Victor had also transformed them into religiously significant figures close enough to the Emperor that ordinary believers could regard them almost as living saints.
Their supernatural systems used related foundations through different methods. Fred's Onmyō techniques could invoke compatible powers from Gods belonging to allied Pantheons when proper permission existed, while Andrew's Inquisition techniques drew more directly upon Victor and the Gods formally belonging to the [[Dragons Nest Pantheon]].[1217] Andrew could therefore access powers associated with figures such as [[Amaterasu]] or Kali because they belonged to Victor's Pantheon, whereas independent allied Gods remained outside that direct structure. Both men possessed Planetary-scale personal power but were classified around V-05 in overall threat potential because the complete systems available to them could threaten a Solar System. This did not mean every ordinary attack operated on that scale: Fred accidentally altered continental geography with one discharge, while Andrew used Victor's Divine power to assume a golden Vampiric state and rapidly move across the world eliminating hostile creatures.
When [[The Spartans]] arrived, Fred immediately abandoned his casual attitude and assumed command. Ordinary Spartans already exceeded two metres in height, while exceptional warriors reached three to four metres.[1217] Rather than exterminating the hostile species completely, Fred and Andrew eventually invoked Violet's Authority of Order. Their prayer attracted Violet's personal attention. A projection of the Empress appeared, read their memories and scanned the surrounding Solar System to ensure unrelated Life would not be harmed.[1218] Violet expanded the projection to approximately 1,346 metres and declared that there would be Order. The species became docile, the climate stabilized and even the atmosphere improved. The watching soldiers regarded the event as a Divine miracle; Violet privately considered most of the spectacle unnecessary and believed a much simpler command would have achieved the same result.
Elsewhere, Velnorah and [[Velina Velnorah Elderblood Thaloria III]] studied cloned members of the Yuurakyo, a species Velnorah had once considered close to the ideal warrior race. Exposure to [[True Dragons]], Bloodhunters and Imperial biological engineering completely changed her standards. The Yuurakyo now appeared heavily flawed as combatants, but their adaptability remained valuable.[1218] Velnorah intended to combine that trait with the technomancy of her former civilization to create a population of highly capable technomages. She did not need another supreme warrior race; she wanted scientists born with advanced technical aptitude and enough personal durability to survive dangerous research environments.
The conversation demonstrated how dramatically Imperial standards had changed. Planetary threats were becoming merely above-average among elite personnel, Solar-System-level entities were major assets and Galactic Beings occupied the upper reaches of the commonly used threat system. True Dragons nevertheless remained extraordinarily rare. Only approximately forty to fifty existed throughout the entire Sector despite the size of Victor's family.[1218] Victor could theoretically create far more, but the Primordial powers had already warned him against rapidly multiplying a species composed of such overwhelming Beings.
The same chapter clarified that Victor's wives were not biologically incapable of twins or triplets. Multiple True Dragon children were possible but required enormous quantities of Energy and placed substantially greater strain upon the mother, meaning the household's general pattern of single daughters reflected deliberate restraint rather than biological impossibility.[1218] Victor also refused to distribute his Blood casually outside the dynasty. True Dragonhood and the Elderblood lineage were defining foundations of the Imperial Family, not upgrades intended for every citizen or political ally.
Velnorah was simultaneously becoming concerned that Velina and several sisters were developing excessive arrogance. Remembering that her own arrogance once contributed to the destruction of her kingdom, she considered sending them into difficult Dream Worlds or missions where they would experience genuine weakness again. Before she could act, Velina returned for the traditional family dinner and was immediately ambushed by several sisters, shoved into a sack and carried away, beginning one of the largest Elderblood family gatherings shown during the accelerated era.

##### The Imperial Princesses and the Elderblood Family Tradition
Chapters 1165–1169
Velina's abduction rapidly attracted more members of Victor's enormous second generation until the incident became a family reunion involving more than thirty-five daughters.[1219] Several daughters who had previously appeared mainly through references to their mothers were formally identified, including [[Angelina Elderblood]], [[Svetlana Veronika Elderblood]], [[Alisa Sasha Elderblood]] and [[Erika Vesta Elderblood]]. [[Nero]], Ophis, [[Metis]], Akasha and Melida eventually joined them alongside [[Albedo Moriarty Elderblood]]. Albedo's reaction to Melida Charlotte Elderblood emphasized how naturally talented the reincarnated daughter had become. Melida possessed an instinctive understanding of Primal Energy and powers connected directly to Victor's Soul at a level Albedo still needed extensive study to reproduce.
Albedo then realized her own daughter was missing, only for everyone to point toward the ceiling where [[Nigredo Elderblood]] was sleeping. Nigredo was an Eldritch Primordial Goddess whose Divinity was associated with Darkness, and her manifestation resembled the interior of an Eldritch black hole in which Being and Non-Being collapsed together.[1219] The scale of her nature contrasted completely with her personality. When Albedo ordered her to come down, Nigredo simply refused and returned to sleep; when Anna repeated the command, she obeyed immediately. The scene publicly exposed how little maternal authority Albedo had developed while isolating herself inside laboratories. [[Scathach]] and [[Dún Scáith|Dun Scaith]] later entered the gathering, and the daughters' immediate nervousness showed just how deeply generations of Scathach's training had conditioned them. Victor nevertheless defended the practice: children born capable of distorting Reality could not safely mature without discipline, control and practical experience.
Victor entered in a humanoid body roughly three metres tall, having increased his usual size so his increasingly tall daughters could gather around him more comfortably.[1219] Yuno immediately attached herself to him, Stella became jealous and Victor stopped the disagreement before it escalated. He restated one of the family's central principles: sisters were allowed to compete, argue, spar and duel when both sides agreed, but rivalry could never be allowed to become genuine hatred. Elderblood sisters were expected to protect one another regardless of personal jealousy.
The gathering continued when Velina arrived demanding punishment for the sisters who had kidnapped her. The group included Erika, [[Priscillia Penny Elderblood]], Rosemary, Sylvia, Siren and [[Lucrecia Lena Elderblood]], daughter of Victor and [[Lacus Scarlett Elderblood]].[1220] Victor immediately recognized that Velina had possessed enough power to escape whenever she wanted and had effectively chosen to participate in the game despite her complaints. The wives then decided to prepare the traditional family meal themselves rather than allowing servants to handle everything. Scathach proposed cooking a recently killed Star Animal whose corpse was larger than [[Jupiter]], forcing Anna to expand the surrounding Space until multiple Jupiter-sized objects could fit inside the cooking area simultaneously.
Ruby, Velnorah and Aline immediately treated the corpse as research material as well as food. Its fur appeared partially integrated with Space, while the digestive system contained such enormous Energy density that Ruby compared its stomach to a black hole.[1220] The chapter also revealed the mature scale of the Leviathans. Billions existed on their designated world and normally hunted cooperatively, while the largest could swallow an Earth-sized planet. Scathach nevertheless regarded the Jupiter-sized prey as comparatively young and showed evidence of another Star Animal encountered near the Sector's edge capable of swallowing a star. The chapter's numerical description and comparison for the larger specimen were internally inconsistent, but both indicated that it was enormously greater than the Jupiter-scale creature. Velnorah immediately ordered future encounters with such organisms to prioritize live capture whenever practical.
Cooking the Star Animal required Divine, Demonic and Draconic tools because ordinary equipment was useless against its body. Sasha helped through the Dragon Language, while [[Amaterasu]] Elderblood was effectively recruited as a Solar heat source.[1220] Amaterasu complained that an ancient Sun Goddess had somehow become kitchen equipment but participated willingly because the entire absurd operation remained fundamentally a family activity.
Chapter 1167 opened with Ophis exploiting Victor's weakness toward his daughters by assuming the small childlike form she possessed when they first met, immediately causing several adult sisters to realize they could theoretically attempt the same tactic.[1210] Their conversation eventually turned toward Vlad, who had become increasingly interested in entering the transformed Empire properly after avoiding most of the accelerated era. Ophis remained suspicious of Vlad's current partner and believed the woman's restraint around her came more from fear of Victor and knowledge of what had happened to the previous Queen than from genuine maternal affection. Victor briefly considered using his abilities to help Vlad find someone who truly loved him before rejecting the idea. The memories inherited from [[Adonis Snow]] had demonstrated too clearly how destructive supernatural interference with attraction and affection could become, and Victor refused to manufacture somebody's love merely because he believed the result would improve another person's life.
Another daughter then approached Victor and was formally identified as [[Norabell Elderblood]], daughter of Victor and Natalia, whom Victor affectionately called his "little cosmos".[1210] Norabell inherited Natalia's powers over Space and Time together with one of the strongest versions of Victor's truth-perceiving Dragon Eyes among the daughters. She had been born as a Primordial Goddess of Time and Space, although her Eldritch heritage meant her abilities continued changing as she matured. Norabell believed she was failing to create a simple alternate dimension. Victor examined her attempt and realized she was accidentally trying to perform something substantially more difficult: rather than creating a subordinate pocket dimension that borrowed the surrounding Universe's laws, Norabell was unconsciously trying to establish an independent miniature Reality possessing its own Time-Space foundation.
Victor turned the mistake into a lesson for the daughters around him. In one hand he created an ordinary cube-shaped pocket dimension; in the other he created a miniature galaxy reinforced with <Negativity>, <Beginning> and other higher powers.[1210] Norabell's Eyes immediately detected additional "levels of existence" within the galaxy. Victor explained that ordinary subordinate dimensions borrowed most of their fundamental Rules from the greater Reality and therefore remained comparatively light in an existential sense. A sufficiently perceptive Being who understood those Rules could interfere with them. Victor demonstrated this by allowing Norabell to change the ownership of the ordinary cube and take control away from him.
Norabell attempted the same thing against the conceptual galaxy and failed even after combining Space-Time Authority with the Dragon Language. She described the difference as one of weight: the ordinary dimension felt almost weightless, while the galaxy felt enormously heavy.[1210] Victor identified this as existential weight. Divine Concepts incorporated into the foundation of an existence were not merely additional powers layered over it; they made the thing itself more deeply established within Reality. He used [[Agares]] as a simpler example. Agares had once been extremely dangerous because he occupied a dimensional layer his opponents could not perceive, but that advantage became much less important against Beings capable of directly seeing and interacting with the hidden layer. Norabell's Eyes operated on a vastly more fundamental form of the same principle. With sufficient understanding, she could perceive what Victor described as the "source code of Reality" and potentially manipulate structures whose Rules she comprehended.
Looking deeper into the miniature galaxy revealed apparently living Eldritch cosmic organisms, disturbing most of the daughters while Yog and Nigredo found them beautiful. Chapter 1168 immediately clarified that Victor's creation remained incomplete.[1221] He summoned genuine Eldritch beings, including [[Abhoth]], and compared them with the organisms inside the artificial galaxy. The replicas possessed form, Energy and convincing behavior but lacked the deeper Conceptual foundation anchoring truly independent Life. Victor therefore described the galaxy as an extraordinarily sophisticated imitation of Reality rather than a genuine autonomous Cosmos. Combining his own existence directly with Azathoth might create something far closer to a true Universe, but conducting such an experiment unnecessarily risked attracting attention from external cosmic powers.
Victor expanded the lesson into the nature of Divine Concepts. Two physically identical objects could possess radically different existential weight depending upon what Concepts had been incorporated into their foundations.[1221] Concepts functioned like metaphysical keys or pieces of Reality's deepest operating code. Raw power could sometimes compensate for lacking the appropriate "key", but direct Authority over the relevant Concept made control much more natural. Norabell finally understood her mistake: she had been unconsciously inserting her personal Time and Space Concepts into what should have been a simple subordinate dimension, effectively attempting to construct an entire independent system without supplying every other Conceptual foundation needed to stabilize it. Once she deliberately allowed the surrounding Universe to provide the deeper Rules, she created an ordinary dimension immediately.
The discussion moved toward Mortal theories concerning higher dimensions. Victor regarded numbered dimensional hierarchies primarily as explanatory models rather than literal universal classifications.[1221] Descriptions of higher-dimensional Beings becoming pure Energy, intelligence or consciousness no longer constrained by normal Space-Time resembled Mortal attempts to conceptualize entities such as Primordial Beings, but Victor explicitly rejected simplistic equations such as "Primordial Being = tenth-dimensional Being." This led into an important distinction between Primordial Goddesses and completed Primordial Beings. Norabell could be born as a Primordial Goddess of Space-Time and Kassandra as an embodiment of Destruction without automatically occupying the universal cosmic office responsible for those functions.
A genuine Primordial Being did not merely wield a Concept; it occupied a functional position within the architecture of the Cosmos.[1221] Victor used The Universal Tree as the clearest example. Its importance was not simply enormous power or universal perception through countless [[World Trees]], but its role as a foundation of Life. Truly eliminating such a Being at the Conceptual level could damage or remove the corresponding function from Reality. The same principle applied to Death and Infinity: removing Death itself could break the ordinary mechanism by which living beings and matter reached their end and disrupt the cycles depending upon it, while eliminating Infinity as a fundamental property would force the Cosmos to possess an end.
Victor therefore compared the Universe to an immense machine whose deepest instructions were Divine Concepts, with Primordial Beings acting as essential components inside the structure established by [[Primordial Chaos]]. From this model he introduced the idea of administrative rights. Destroying every individual component of a Universe would be catastrophically inefficient; obtaining sufficiently high Authority over the entire system would instead allow its Rules to be rewritten directly.[1221] Victor already possessed analogous absolute authority inside his Personal Reality, but the larger implication concerned the vacant supreme position associated with complete Primordial Chaos and the Throne over their native Cosmos.
Victor's understanding of <Negativity> also led him to suspect that Negativity and Positivity might not be completely mindless forces. The fact that no previous Being had simply developed complete Negativity caused him to theorize that the divided foundations of [[Chaos]] might retain remnants of the original Primordial Chaos' consciousness and could potentially choose appropriate bearers.[1221] Victor explicitly treated this as a theory rather than confirmed fact. He further explained how radically his own perception differed from that of ordinary people: Victor could examine portions of an individual's Past, Present and enormous numbers of possible Futures almost simultaneously, while his Space-Time and Eldritch powers could interact with information spread across temporal states. The example demonstrated why contact with higher existences could resemble the Mortal concept of interacting with a higher-dimensional Being.
The lesson ended with a clarification of Victor's Bloodline. [[True Dragons]] possessed extraordinary compatibility with Reality, while Victor's Blood carried unusually aggressive predatory and assimilative characteristics.[1221] A daughter born directly through his mature Dragon lineage did not function like an ordinary hybrid whose conflicting racial traits weakened one another. The True Dragon foundation assimilated useful maternal characteristics while preserving Dragonhood, with Victor's Soul Authority, Beginning and Imperial biology further stabilizing the process. Victor therefore stated that a child directly descending from his mature Dragon lineage could not simply be born as an inferior non-Dragon because the dominance of his Blood rejected that form of regression. He became genuinely disappointed when several daughters revealed gaps in their understanding of their own race, motivating them to correct their studies far more effectively than an ordinary punishment.
Chapter 1169 continued as the daughters followed Victor toward dinner. Rosemary Lavina Elderblood explained the Star Animal incident to sisters who had not read Scathach's report, while [[Gina Elderblood]] appeared much more interested in whether the creature tasted good.[1222] Two additional daughters were formally identified. [[Roberta Elderblood]] and [[Medusa]] Elderblood had historically existed as two genuine individuals sharing one body, and their daughters were named [[Stheno Elderblood]] and [[Euryale Elderblood]] after Medusa's deceased sisters. [[Stheno]] inherited long dark hair, Victor's violet Dragon Eyes and much of Roberta's appearance, while [[Euryale]] possessed violet-black hair capable of becoming living snakes and several characteristics associated with Medusa. Their mothers' unusual shared existence caused them to resemble twins, but they were not biological twins.
Stheno and Euryale asked Victor for Dragon scales. Victor transformed his arms into their black-and-purple Draconic state, removed two scales and handed them over, only for both girls immediately to struggle beneath their weight.[1222] Victor explained that the scales came from his main body, whose unrestricted scale exceeded multiple galaxies, and reduced their effective weight with Energy so the daughters could carry them. Medusa and Roberta warned them not to experiment recklessly. Medusa could now manifest independently after becoming a Dragon Goddess but often continued sharing Roberta's body because she had become accustomed to doing so. When Victor casually dismissed the value of his scales, Scathach corrected him: as Progenitor of the True Dragons and bearer of enormous Energy and hundreds of powerful Divine characteristics, a single scale from Victor could theoretically sustain an ordinary civilization for more than 100,000 years.[1222]
[[Tyche]] then joined the gathering. Victor greeted her openly and informed his daughters that they would have many opportunities to speak with her because she would soon become one of their new mothers.[1222] Anna reassured Tyche that the household already accepted her and wondered whether Luck itself had influenced the unusually favorable timing of her relationship with Victor. Tyche admitted that even she could not always determine the full extent of her passive fortune.
When Kaguya asked how such an enormous family was supposed to arrange itself for dinner, Victor rejected conventional royal seating and transformed the gathering into a literal celestial banquet. He moved everyone to the family's personal superplanet and reshaped astronomical phenomena into furniture and decoration.[1222] Tables, couches and chairs were formed from stars, supernovae, nebulae and lifeless worlds, with Victor deliberately avoiding inhabited planets or worlds containing World Trees. The women received clothing reflecting different celestial phenomena: Nyx wore the starry night, Amaterasu the radiance of a yellow star, Violet the light of a supernova, Tyche the light of white stars and Natalia a dress formed from the fabric of the Cosmos itself, with galaxies appearing across it.
Tyche was stunned less by the beauty than by the casual manner in which Victor performed everything. Stars and cosmic structures had effectively become decorative materials in his hands. Victor condensed cosmic mist into stable ground, restored comfortable local gravity and dedicated the banquet not to Imperial hierarchy but to everything beautiful within their world, personally thanking his wives for everything they had done for the family and Empire.[1222] Everyone chose whatever seat they preferred. Nigredo naturally selected a chair formed from a black hole, while other daughters chose stars and nebulae according to personal taste. Kaguya received the honor of serving everyone herself. Even after becoming a Dragon Goddess and one of the Empire's greatest intelligence authorities, she proudly retained the identity she had carried since Victor's earliest days: his perfect maid. The sequence ended by contrasting the absurd cosmic scale of the dynasty with the simplicity of the tradition being preserved. Victor could reshape celestial structures and rule a Galactic civilization, but the family still gathered for the same reason it always had—to eat, argue, laugh and spend Time together.

##### Tyche's Courtship and the Coming Daughter
Chapters 1170–1171
Some Time after the celestial banquet, Victor began spending private Time with [[Tyche]] without the distance created by his position as Emperor. Instead of the overwhelming form and presence displayed during the banquet, he appeared before her resembling his former Vampire self, wearing a black-and-white suit with short black hair and violet eyes, and specifically asked her to stop addressing him constantly as Emperor.[1223] Their conversation returned to the relationship between strength and freedom. Tyche reflected that many events during the age of [[Olympus]] might have unfolded differently if she possessed her current authority, while Victor agreed that supernatural society had always understood, whether people admitted it or not, that the strongest generally possessed the greatest freedom. He also reflected upon how many extraordinary opportunities in his own rise could be described as Luck: encountering [[Scathach]], Roxanne, Zaladrac and numerous other individuals had repeatedly opened paths that raw talent alone could never guarantee. This was another reason he considered Tyche's Authority strategically important rather than merely convenient.
Tyche revealed another consequence of her evolution. Her golden eyes could perceive a person's Happiness and potentially alter it through thought, and accidental activations had disturbed her enough that she preferred keeping them covered by the suppressive blindfold Velnorah created.[1223] Victor realized the Eyes were symptoms of a much deeper transformation: the Concept of Happiness itself was gradually permeating Tyche's existence, resembling the process through which Kali had moved toward union with Destruction. Happiness was considerably less unstable and violent than Destruction, meaning Tyche did not suffer Kali's old problems to the same extent, but her Divine race remained poorly suited to complete Conceptual assimilation. Victor concluded that becoming a True Dragon would resolve much of the incompatibility.
Victor then led Tyche to the residence prepared for her inside the wives' section of his castle. The castle itself had been designed around the possibility of housing enormous Dragons, and the entrance to Tyche's chamber was a gigantic door large enough for a Dragon hundreds of metres long.[1223] Under Earth-like conditions its effective weight was compared with [[Pluto]], approximately 13 sextillion kilograms. Tyche managed to force it open despite having almost no serious physical training, but Victor's reaction was not amazement; by Elderblood standards he immediately decided she needed much more training because a future Dragon Goddess should not struggle against a door designed to remain usable by Dragon children.
The "room" beyond the door was actually a pocket dimension approximately comparable in area to South America, containing peaceful forests, animals, hundreds of Fairy Spirits, waterfalls, a large sea full of Life and a white Temple designed specifically around Tyche's preferences.[1223] To Tyche the scale was absurd, while Victor regarded it as relatively ordinary by the standards of his wives' residences. Several chambers possessed similarly enormous internal dimensions, and Scathach's territory approached the size of a planet. Tyche spent approximately seven hours exploring the new world before realizing she had become so absorbed that she had effectively forgotten Victor was waiting. When she returned with a snow leopard in her arms, she found him still resting patiently inside the Temple, which helped her understand why his wives remained so intensely attached to him: Victor did not simply grant them generic luxury but paid attention to what each individual actually wanted.
Tyche eventually attempted to accelerate their intimacy because she assumed becoming Victor's future wife meant she was expected to move forward immediately. Victor stopped her, explaining that there was no reason to force anything when they possessed effectively unlimited Time. He wanted the relationship to develop naturally instead of through obligation.[1223] Tyche eventually relaxed against him and fell asleep while Victor removed her blindfold and allowed her to rest. He had already distorted Time around them so extensively that they could theoretically spend approximately 10,000 subjective years together while almost no Time passed outside. Another body continued governing the Empire, but Victor deliberately focused his personal attention upon Tyche rather than treating their relationship as something that could be handled by an inattentive clone.
By the material preserved for Chapter 1171, approximately two subjective years had passed in their courtship and the wives were already eagerly waiting for Tyche eventually to conceive.[1224] Motherhood had noticeably changed much of Victor's household, and women such as Violet, Ruby, Agnes, Sasha, Anna, Natasha, Scathach, Jeanne and Kaguya began discussing what kind of daughter Victor and Tyche might produce. Agnes predicted Tyche's hair and Victor's Eyes, while Natasha considered that too ordinary and hoped for another unusual child comparable to Isabelle or Kassandra.
