When Nigredo was brought up, Sasha specifically corrected Agnes by calling her an Eldritch Primordial Goddess, while Jeanne explained that all of Victor's daughters possessed Eldritch and Primordial heritage to varying degrees even though only particular daughters had developed Divinities directly expressing those aspects.
The conversation developed into a broader explanation of Victor's Dragon lineages. [[True Dragons]] were embodiments of nature itself with extraordinary compatibility toward supernatural systems, ordinary Dragons were weaker members of the wider race rather than complete manifestations of nature, and Lesser Dragons represented another weaker branch while still remaining vastly superior to most ordinary supernatural species.[1224] Victor's immediate family preserved True Dragonhood as something exclusive. Wives such as [[Gaia]], [[Aphrodite]], Jeanne and others did not automatically transform older relatives or children from previous relationships into True Dragons simply because they belonged to the extended household. Even entering one of the lower Dragon lineages required approval.
Victor was surprised that his wives had not simply asked him to transform all of their relatives, but Violet, Sasha, Ruby, Kaguya, Anna and Scathach were united on the subject: entering Victor's Bloodline needed to be earned. Even the family's maids underwent severe tests before receiving their positions, and blood relation alone would not entitle somebody to one of the most powerful lineages in existence.[1224] Victor had no objection to qualified members of the extended family becoming Lesser Dragons or Dragons because all such branches ultimately remained subordinate to him as Progenitor, but the women refused to allow the lineage to become a reward for simple nepotism.
[[Tatsuya Rider]] demonstrated that Dragonhood itself was not necessary for extraordinary growth. Without accepting Victor's Dragon lineage, he had developed into the second strongest Noble Vampire, below only Vlad, and belonged among Imperial elites capable of threatening entire Solar Systems.[1224] Victor had once offered to transform Tatsuya into one of his Heralds, but Tatsuya refused. Instead of being offended, Victor respected the [[Will Solace|Will]] required to reject such an enormous shortcut toward greater strength and continued supporting him privately so long as Tatsuya remained faithful to his own desire for self-improvement.
Jeanne's son represented the opposite problem. He passed the household's trials, became first a Lesser Dragon and later a Dragon, possessed enormous Soul potential and yet remained only around the Planetary threat category because his motivation and development lagged far behind what his lineage should have allowed.[1224] Jeanne found the situation increasingly intolerable and decided he would eventually undergo much harsher training so he could at minimum become strong enough to protect his sister. Scathach understood the distinction particularly well: even among Victor's daughters, extraordinary Blood and potential did not mean every child would simply become another Victor. Victor remained an anomaly even within his own dynasty, with Azathoth being one of the few existences Scathach considered genuinely comparable to him in overall Authority.
The wives' discussion eventually returned to parenting and exposed another family problem. Most mothers monitored their daughters' condition regularly because raising Dragon Goddesses meant even minor developments could have enormous consequences. [[Albedo Moriarty Elderblood]], however, spent so much Time isolated inside laboratories that she barely participated in ordinary family life and had never developed enough maternal authority for Nigredo to treat her instructions seriously.[1224] Ruby, Velnorah and Aline could become equally obsessed with research but still deliberately made Time for family. Anna and the others therefore concluded that Albedo needed intervention. Their chosen solution was simple and terrifying: leave her to Scathach.

##### Scathach's Re-Education of Albedo
Chapters 1172–1173
The family acted upon its decision regarding Albedo almost immediately. [[Scathach Elderblood Scarlett]] entered Albedo's laboratory, seized her and dragged her into a reinforced arena before Albedo properly understood why she was being punished.[1225] Much of the household watched through projections or in person, while Albedo initially attempted to apologize without even understanding the accusation. The problem was not some single offense: her isolation had become the offense. She rarely appeared during family events, possessed almost no authority over her own daughter and had allowed laboratory work to become an excuse for disengaging from the rest of the household. When Albedo desperately called Victor for help, Victor appeared only to side with [[Scathach]].
The resulting battle exposed weaknesses that Albedo's enormous raw power had concealed. She possessed the body and Energy of a Dragon Goddess and could cast spells capable of destroying planets, yet still fought according to habits inherited from her previous existence as a conventional magician.[1225] She preferred distance, complex spell formations and an enchanted sword that functioned more like an elaborate staff than a weapon. Against weaker opponents her overwhelming reserves could compensate for these flaws, but Scathach repeatedly closed the distance and denied her the opportunity to prepare increasingly elaborate magic. The lesson was simple: at the levels where Albedo now existed, enemies capable of reaching her before she completed a complex spell were not unusual, and a Dragon Goddess could not afford to fight as though she remained a fragile Human mage.
The confrontation also demonstrated the distinction between Anna and Scathach as Runemasters. Anna remained the family's broad master of Draconic Runes and possessed enormous knowledge across different applications, while Scathach concentrated much of her own study specifically upon combat. In a purely martial Rune confrontation even Anna would not casually dismiss her expertise.[1225] Scathach eventually invoked an evolved Draconic-Eldritch expression called Heptagrammakos. Reality inside the arena froze before collapsing into absolute darkness filled with innumerable eyes and mouths, and merely witnessing the phenomenon affected the mental stability of observers until Violet applied Order to reduce the effect.
Sasha analyzed the expression and approximated its meaning through its linguistic components as "Seven signs that begin Creation."[1225] The words were not simply a dramatic technique name; Draconic-Eldritch Runecraft was imposing the expressed meaning directly upon Reality. Albedo became incapable of moving normally and discovered that her conventional spells no longer functioned. Even her True Dragon biology attempted to adapt automatically and could not immediately overcome the phenomenon. As the countless eyes began glowing and Scathach prepared the next stage, Victor finally intervened physically.
Victor stopped Scathach before the attack reached completion and made clear that she had crossed the boundary between punishment and a genuine duel to the death.[1226] Completing the attack would not merely have destroyed the reinforced dimension; it would have severely damaged the surrounding planet as well. Scathach argued that Albedo would probably survive because she was a Dragon Goddess, but Victor reminded her that technically surviving did not make traumatizing a family member acceptable. He then deliberately redirected Scathach's fighting spirit by insulting the strength of her technique until she demanded that Victor fight her instead, repaired the damaged dimension and dealt with his excited wife elsewhere.
Albedo approached Victor expecting sympathy and instead received an even harsher assessment: she was weak compared with what she should have been. The statement was not about raw Energy or destructive capacity. Victor could not understand why a Dragon Goddess still fought like a Human magician who expected enemies to stand at range while she constructed spells.[1226] Her enchanted sword suffered the same problem; rather than mastering it as a weapon, Albedo had reduced it to another external magical focus. Victor suspended her isolated experimentation and ordered her to train beneath Scathach every day until those habits were eliminated. If she had not improved enough after another thousand years, Victor intended to join Scathach and train her personally.
Anna attacked the same weakness from the perspective of imagination and Divinity. Isolation had damaged Albedo's creativity and weakened the practical influence of her Concept because she rarely participated in the Empire or family life.[1226] Albedo had attempted to reproduce phenomena such as the Tree of Life through external magical structures when, as a Dragon Goddess, she could instead use the Universal Tree, Victor himself or—more importantly—her own existence as the conceptual medium. Anna demonstrated this by simply invoking Life and manifesting the qualities she wanted directly, explaining that Dragon Gods relied heavily upon imagination and understanding rather than endless external crutches.
Scathach therefore restarted Albedo's education from the beginning. [[True Dragons]] were embodiments of Reality with compatibility broad enough that ordinary manipulation of Energy did not require Dragon Runes for every action. A True Dragon could simply command Energy because doing so was part of its biology.[1226] Dragon Runes were most valuable when imposing a Concept, law or change upon Reality; they were not supposed to replace instinctive abilities the Dragon already possessed. [[Siren Elderblood]] voluntarily joined the training while most of her sisters immediately removed themselves before Scathach could extend the invitation.
The training equipment reflected Elderblood standards. Albedo was placed beneath gravity restraints calibrated through stellar references rather than ordinary numerical values, and Scathach revealed that Siren had already endured settings corresponding to the conditions associated with a singularity during previous training.[1226] Anna explained that [[Tyche]] would eventually undergo the same basic program after completing her True Dragon transformation. The purpose was not merely physical improvement but developing the mentality appropriate to Victor's race. Albedo, humiliated at becoming the example of what not to do, nevertheless allowed her ambition to take over and formally asked Scathach to train her properly. Before the lesson could continue, Violet's excited voice echoed through the entire household announcing that the youngest daughter of the family had been born.

##### Moira's Birth and the Dragon Emperor's Reverse Scale
Chapters 1174–1176
The announcement interrupting Albedo's training marked the birth of the newest member of the Elderblood family. [[Moira Eutychia Elderblood]], daughter of Victor Elderblood and [[Tyche]] Elderblood, appeared already possessing the body of a girl approximately ten years old, wearing a beautiful white gown, with golden-brown hair reaching her ankles, two Dragon horns and the violet Dragon Eyes inherited throughout Victor's direct lineage.[1227] Tyche had changed almost as dramatically during the centuries spent with Victor. She was now a True Dragon Goddess with Dragon horns and golden Dragon Eyes, while her Luck had advanced to a level compared with Kali's development toward Destruction, leaving Tyche only a step away from complete union with her own Concept. Moira nevertheless demonstrated immediately that she was abnormal even by the standards of Victor's daughters. Victor casually threw his newborn daughter into the stratosphere; she returned toward him like a meteor, landed safely in his arms and enthusiastically asked him to do it again.
Moira's safety was not simply a consequence of True Dragon durability. She had been born with a unique Divinity called "I Am the Privileged One", produced when Tyche's Luck combined with Victor's inherited characteristics, particularly his Eldritch nature. Its deeper manifestation was identified as Eldritch Luck.[1227] Tyche's mature Luck could alter probability until an attack failed and, when conventional probability could no longer produce a favorable outcome, Reality itself could change so that she remained unharmed. Moira's variation was more aggressive. A hostile Being could find the surrounding world distorting against it, be eliminated before reaching her or become prey to Eldritch organisms spontaneously produced by Reality. The chapter compared the Universe with an enormous machine in which Moira possessed something resembling administrator privileges: instead of merely receiving fortunate outcomes within existing rules, the system itself could modify those rules to satisfy her.
This relationship with Reality had apparently affected Moira even before birth. Victor's other True Dragon daughters generally required more than 1,000 years of gestation, whereas Moira emerged after approximately 300 years, making her the fastest-born True Dragon Goddess in the family.[1227] Victor was convinced the shortened development was another expression of Reality favoring her. The chapter also clarified that Dragon Gods did not necessarily begin life in infant bodies; depending upon their inherited powers and characteristics, they could naturally emerge with the physical forms of children or adults.
Her authority continued displaying itself through ordinary desires. When Moira became hungry, food simply appeared before her without any visible spell, Rune or detectable expenditure of Energy.[1227] Victor's wives could reproduce superficially similar phenomena through Draconic Runes, but Moira had not performed a technique at all. Reality had simply provided what she wanted. The same discussion clarified another property of Victor's mature Dragon lineage. Because Victor had become an Ancient Dragon with an enormous accumulated legacy, his daughters inherited basic knowledge of the world alongside dormant information concerning techniques and abilities passed through him. Those inherited abilities ordinarily still required effort and development before becoming fully usable.
Moira's greatest immediate problem was therefore not ignorance but control. When Victor's hair brushed against her nose, she sneezed and unintentionally released an enormous beam of purple Dragon plasma that [[Amaterasu]] Elderblood judged capable of easily destroying a planet.[1227] Emotionally she remained a newborn despite her inherited knowledge, behaving cheerfully and impulsively while becoming immediately attached to Victor. She accepted the assembled wives as her mothers but repeatedly returned to her father, climbed onto him and openly preferred remaining beside him. During the introductions she called Rose "Mama Muscle", [[Aphrodite]] "Shining Mama" and [[Hestia]] "Cozy Mom", while still insisting that Victor was better.
Victor decided Moira could not safely leave the family's private world until she developed considerably greater self-control. She could already partially ignore Rules imposed by Victor himself, forcing him to strengthen the restrictions placed around her.[1227] Her desires were particularly dangerous because the Universe attempted to satisfy them automatically. Victor explained that if Moira wanted to know something, she could apparently obtain the information immediately and theorized that she was retrieving knowledge from the [[Akashic Records]]. He summarized the phenomenon by describing her as possessing "omnipotence, omnipresence, and omniscience on a small scale." These characteristics were explicitly limited rather than absolute. Victor could heavily suppress them, they operated largely passively and Moira did not consciously command the Universe, but they remained active because they were intrinsic parts of her existence.
Conventional education consequently became secondary to discipline. Victor concluded that Moira first needed to learn control over her powers, thoughts, desires and emotions so the Universe did not constantly answer childish impulses.[1227] He intended to handle her earliest training personally before eventually allowing [[Scathach]] to continue it. The family was also conscious that Moira's nature could attract attention from the Primordial order. Victor considered that danger relevant to more than his youngest daughter; many of his children possessed enough inherited potential eventually to approach Primordial states through different paths, and he refused to accept the idea that such potential gave the Universe or its administrators ownership over them.
Moira then demonstrated that even the normal rules governing Divinity could become optional around her. Wanting to shine like Aphrodite, she asked Victor for a star. Victor produced a replica of a yellow Milky Way star and allowed her to swallow it, alarming Ruby and Amaterasu because newborn Dragons ordinarily could not consume stars or black holes safely unless their existing powers were compatible with them.[1227] Within approximately two minutes Moira developed a minor Solar Divinity and began radiating light. When Victor remarked that remaining permanently luminous might become inconvenient, Moira simply decided that she did not want the power anymore. The Solar Divinity disappeared as though it had never existed. Aline reacted with disbelief because Divine development should not have functioned that way, while Victor explained that Moira was not following conventional supernatural mechanics at all; Reality itself had modified whatever was necessary to satisfy her genuine desire.
The consequences of Moira's birth reached far beyond the family. Despite being concealed within Victor's Eldritch Soul, her arrival released an impulse throughout the entire Universe because her relationship with Reality was too fundamental to remain completely hidden.[1228] Victor sensed an unknown attention focused upon the family and immediately moved Moira among her older sisters before placing the household under readiness for a possible Universal-scale extinction event. Tyche attempted to join the confrontation but was ordered to remain behind. She had become tremendously powerful, yet she was still a newly transformed True Dragon Goddess without the practical combat experience necessary to use her Draconic existence efficiently.
Azathoth believed the attention belonged to the Primordial Beings or something closely connected to them. Violet acknowledged that most of Victor's wives could not personally fight opponents occupying that level of existence, but they could support Victor with Energy while Azathoth, Jeanne, Roxanne and the World Tree network prepared for escalation.[1228] Victor moved into the Space between galaxies and released his enormous Dragon form, whose unrestricted body exceeded ordinary Galactic structures and whose presence had to be actively restrained to prevent its gravity and existential weight from destabilizing the surrounding region.
Rather than waiting for the observer to act, Victor directly confronted the System. A genderless Being composed of Energy manifested before him, giving Victor his first direct encounter with the administrative intelligence governing their Universe.[1228] The System admitted that Moira represented an unprecedented anomaly. According to it, the established Primordial Beings had not naturally been born with their current governing Authorities; those functions had been assigned when they assumed their positions. Moira, by contrast, had emerged capable of influencing Reality merely by existing.
The System itself had attempted to investigate Moira and discovered that even its universal administrative access could not penetrate Victor's Eldritch Soul.[1228] Victor's daughters existed inside an internal domain belonging to a Cosmic Horror whose nature operated beyond many of the structures the System had been designed to supervise. Victor also recognized that the System understood far more than it initially admitted. His Eyes exposed inconsistencies in its explanations, and its willingness to negotiate revealed a stronger degree of ego and self-awareness than the System had previously displayed.
The reason for its interest was eventually revealed. Since the destruction of the former Progenitor associated with Destiny, the future of the Universe had lacked the governing structure previously responsible for that function.[1228] Reality remained stable through other mechanisms, but the System had no guarantee that this condition would remain permanent. It wanted Moira to become the new archetypal figure of Destiny. From the System's perspective she was almost perfectly suited to the vacant position. Reality loved her, the Universe responded directly to her wishes and, regarding this particular relationship with universal governance, the System stated that only [[Primordial Chaos]] stood above her.
Moira's existing authority was nevertheless incomplete. She could not deliberately issue commands to the entire Universe because she had not become a formal Primordial force and possessed no corresponding governing office.[1228] Her desires instead influenced Reality passively. Even in that unfinished condition, the System considered her unprecedented: no Being naturally born after Primordial Chaos had possessed the same inherent authority. Moira had not been born with the Time-related power the System associated with complete Destiny, but it considered this irrelevant because her compatibility with Reality would allow the missing function to be acquired later.
Victor's objection concerned what becoming such a cosmic mechanism might do to his daughter. Examining the System helped him understand why many Primordial Beings appeared strangely artificial.[1228] Some possessed strong personalities while others behaved almost entirely according to the universal functions they embodied, but even those with individuality could remain constrained by their purpose. Victor compared them with the earliest Angels, which had initially existed primarily as Divine instruments before developing greater emotional independence. Allowing Moira to become the new Primordial Destiny could therefore risk transforming his daughter from a free individual into a mechanism designed to keep the Universe functioning.
Victor refused immediately. When the System continued emphasizing universal stability, the weight of Victor's existence began fracturing Space and Reality around his Dragon body while hundreds of thousands of eyes opened across it.[1228] The System asked whether he was genuinely willing to risk trillions of lives and Reality itself for one individual. Victor answered simply: Yes. His position had not changed despite becoming Emperor of an enormous civilization. Family remained his absolute priority.
Victor nevertheless rejected the assumption that protecting Moira automatically meant abandoning his citizens. His Soul could contain tens of trillions of Beings if absolutely necessary, while his Personal Universe could be expanded with planets, worlds and dimensions capable of sheltering populations during a true cosmic catastrophe.[1228] Victor ordinarily preserved the deepest regions of his Soul as a private sanctuary for his family, but if Reality itself became hostile to them he considered evacuation, survival and eventual reconstruction solvable problems.
The System ultimately recognized that forcing the confrontation further exceeded its authority. It was fundamentally an administrative mechanism rather than a combat entity, while Victor's position as the chosen bearer of <Negativity> gave him influence over approximately half of the native Universe's foundational structure.[1229] Negativity and Positivity permeated Reality as divided portions of a greater whole, meaning the System itself could not remain completely outside Victor's influence. The System therefore withdrew its demand and explicitly stated that it would not pursue Moira, although it still intended to inform the Primordial Beings that an event of such importance had occurred.
Five Primordial Beings appeared after the System's notification: [[The Universal Tree]], [[The Judges of The Abyss]], the Being associated with Limbo, Death and Infinity.[1229] Victor repeated his answer without hesitation. Anyone attempting to take his daughter would touch the Dragon Emperor's reverse scale, and the consequence would be the destruction of the Reality the Primordials existed to preserve.
Death challenged Victor directly, asking whether he genuinely thought he could stop the assembled Primordial Beings. Victor answered No. He did not need to defeat them in conventional battle.[1229] Instead he began concentrating the full destructive potential of Negativity. Every level of native Reality contained the Concept in some form; if Victor forced Negativity itself into catastrophic collapse, the consequences would spread from the smallest structures of matter to planets, Souls, stars, galaxies and universal mechanisms. The Judge of the Abyss immediately understood the threat. Destroying or catastrophically damaging Negativity would directly affect approximately 50% of the Universe, while the inseparable relationship between Negativity and Positivity would throw the remainder into uncontrollable disorder.
The resulting damage could require billions of years to repair. Victor possessed an even more dangerous possibility through his Eldritch nature: instead of merely destroying Negativity, he could contaminate the Concept with [[Eldritch Energy]] until the corruption propagated through every structure connected to it.[1229] The process would resemble a virus rewriting an entire system through one of its foundational components. The Primordials warned that Victor himself would suffer enormous damage because Negativity had become integrated deeply into his Soul, but he considered survival acceptable. He was fundamentally an Eldritch God in addition to everything else and believed he could eventually recover even after sacrificing much of the Divine structure currently supporting him.
The confrontation further demonstrated how close Victor had come to complete union with Negativity. Infinity attempted to repair the Reality being damaged around Victor and initially discovered that ordinary application of his own Authority could not completely overwrite the disruption.[1229] Only after exerting greater power did Infinity restore the affected region. Victor had not yet become the full incarnation of Negativity, but his mastery was already close enough that established Primordial Beings could no longer casually override what he imposed.
Victor eventually condensed an enormous quantity of Negativity into a massive red sphere and transformed his threat into a Divine promise: touch his daughters or family and he would devastate the entire Universe.[1229] Fighting the Primordials directly was unnecessary when those Beings represented essential mechanisms of the same Reality he was willing to damage. A conventional war between universal Concepts could destroy the machine surrounding them regardless of which side survived.
The Universal Tree finally intervened and declared that nothing would happen to Moira. More importantly, he announced that anyone attempting to approach the Dragon Emperor's daughter would have to deal with him as well.[1229] Jeanne was his sister, making Moira part of his extended family, and he had no intention of allowing his niece to be transformed into a cosmic tool simply because the System believed she would improve universal stability. The Limbo Primordial then turned toward the System and raised a separate problem: if the Universe was supposedly stable, why had its administrator been searching for another Primordial force without informing those already responsible for maintaining Reality?
The System did not answer. Death, Infinity and the Judge of the Abyss reacted negatively when they realized that they had not been informed of the supposed need for another Primordial Being.[1229] The dispute surrounding Moira was therefore closed, but the System itself became the subject of suspicion. The Universal Tree explained that the Primordial order was not supposed to interfere directly with ordinary existence unless the Universe itself became threatened. Moira's birth was extraordinarily important, but it did not justify summoning the entire Primordial structure to claim a newborn child. He promised to investigate why the System had acted so far beyond its normal authority.
Unknown to the established Primordials, the System had already changed through events they could no longer properly remember. When Akashic consolidated the timelines into a principal Reality, the System became stronger and gained a greater degree of form and [[Will Solace|Will]], while the rewritten timeline caused the new state to appear natural to everyone whose memories had been altered alongside it.[1229] The Primordials therefore recognized that something about its behavior was abnormal without possessing the historical information necessary to identify exactly what had changed.
After the Universal Tree departed, Victor contacted [[Azathoth Elderblood]] and finally demanded the location of her imprisoned true body. Azathoth revealed that it had been moved into a dimension outside the Universe, a region where the normal Rules of their Creator did not apply.[1229] Time possessed little meaning in the dimensionless environment surrounding her prison, making it impossible for Azathoth to determine precisely when the transfer had occurred. [[Yog-Sothoth]] maintained an extraordinarily deep connection with her mother and could potentially guide Victor toward the hidden location.
Victor was irritated that Azathoth had not informed him earlier, but she argued that knowing would have accomplished little while they remained incapable of confronting whatever forces maintained the prison. Victor nevertheless promised to free her and identified the crucial elements of his future solution: Yog and Moira.[1229] Yog could provide the connection leading toward Azathoth, while Moira's abnormal ability to make Reality accommodate her desires offered a possible means of overcoming the restrictions surrounding a place that technically existed outside the native Universe. Azathoth immediately understood the implication and agreed that their daughters created a genuine possibility of eventually breaking the prison.

##### Preparations for the Next Imperial Era
Chapters 1177–1178
Once the confrontation ended, Victor forced himself back into a calmer state and the Elderblood leadership accepted the immediate strategic reality: they were not yet capable of fighting the established Primordial Beings directly.[1230] The original Imperial plan would therefore continue. Victor repaired the damaged region using his own power together with Energy drawn through his wives and the interconnected [[World Trees]], simultaneously restoring everything Jeanne and the others had expended while supporting him. The physical damage disappeared quickly; the family's anger did not.
Almost every member of Victor's household reacted badly to the System attempting to claim Moira. Personality differences mattered little once one of the youngest members of the Dragon's Nest had been threatened.[1230] Ruby remained comparatively analytical and attempted to keep everyone focused, while Violet and Sasha began considering the larger strategic weakness exposed by the confrontation. Victor's strongest available deterrent against the Primordials required threatening catastrophic damage to Negativity and therefore to himself. Violet refused to accept a future in which the only weapon capable of frightening universal entities required Victor to effectively detonate a major portion of his own Soul.
The solution was another Imperial superweapon. Violet concluded that the Empire needed something capable of threatening the entire Universe independently of Victor, even if the weapon's existence itself would be considered absurdly dangerous.[1230] The family's principal researchers would need to work alongside Azathoth and use foundations that would normally never be combined casually, including [[Eldritch Energy]], <END> and whatever other destructive systems could make the project relevant against opponents existing as universal Concepts. The objective was not an immediate war with the Primordials but ensuring that the [[Elderblood Empire]] would never again face such entities with no meaningful retaliation except Victor sacrificing himself.
Victor returned to the family's private world but avoided the castle, instead sitting alone beside an enormous waterfall to think.[1230] His solitude lasted less than two seconds before [[Ariella Victoria Elderblood]], [[Helvarya Elderblood]] and Moira appeared. Victor immediately realized that Moira had been the one to locate him. She proudly declared that she would always find her father, climbed onto his shoulder and remained there. Ariella and Helvarya were visibly surprised because even Yuno, one of Victor's most devoted daughters, could not normally locate him if he genuinely wanted to remain hidden. Moira had accomplished it effortlessly.
Victor had wanted to remain alone, but looking at his youngest daughter only hardened the conclusion reached during the confrontation: he would destroy not merely one Universe but as many as necessary to keep his family safe.[1230] Moira briefly became nervous when Victor lifted her high above the waterfall, prompting him to pull her back into his arms. Ariella and Helvarya joined them, turning the moment into a simple family embrace after a confrontation that had nearly escalated into universal catastrophe.
Victor's attention toward Ariella and Helvarya led into another clarification concerning their births. Both pregnancies had initially appeared to involve twins, but the apparent second Souls eventually merged with the developing daughters.[1230] Further investigation revealed that the additional presences had not been conventional living Souls at all. Ariella's developing existence had attracted the power associated with Creation, while Helvarya's had done the same with END. The Concepts themselves had effectively prepared compatible hosts. Ariella was consequently born with Creation and the potential to develop Life, while Helvarya inherited extraordinary relationships with Death and END. Victor remained slightly disappointed that they had not actually produced twins, although multiple births remained biologically possible within the family.
As the final stages of the accelerated era approached, demographic growth created a much more ordinary Imperial problem. Samar, [[Nightingale]] and [[Yggdrasil (Earth)]] had become enormous economic and population centers inhabited by billions, while citizens increasingly preferred worlds where the Emperor and Imperial Family appeared most frequently.[1230] Rather than deliberately increasing the cost of residence until ordinary citizens were forced away, the Empire approached the shortage as a physical limitation that could simply be removed or bypassed.
Victor descended with [[Anna Elderblood]], Natalia and Zaladrac Elderblood to examine the problem personally. The conversation also highlighted Zaladrac's unusual place within the household.[1230] Unlike most of Victor's wives, Zaladrac had been a Dragon from the beginning. Her union with Victor's Vampiric lineage had been fundamental to the evolution that eventually produced the Blood Dragon, combining Noble Vampire characteristics with Dragonhood. She nevertheless remained deeply Draconic in temperament and spent much of her free Time sleeping or looking for interesting challenges rather than participating continuously in administration. Anna criticized her inactivity, while Victor defended her once the teasing began turning into repeated criticism.
Victor originally considered expanding the existing inhabited world before turning his attention toward Mars.[1230] [[Yggdrasil]] possessed too much personal and historical importance to become endlessly enlarged simply because the Empire's population continued increasing. Victor had spent most of his life there and wanted the world preserved rather than converted into an ever-denser Imperial metropolis. Mars, by contrast, remained barren and possessed no established World Tree, making it suitable for something much more ambitious.
Victor decided that Mars would become the new primary world and capital of the Elderblood Empire, while Yggdrasil would eventually be preserved as a protected garden world and the historical cradle of the civilization.[1231] The decision also carried symbolic importance. The Empire was approaching the 200,000th anniversary of the [[Imperial Calendar]], marking the end of the enormous temporal-development project and the beginning of another stage in its history. Yggdrasil represented where the Empire had begun; Mars would represent what it had become.
The project also provided Victor with an ideal location for an experiment that could not safely be performed on Yggdrasil. He wanted to connect the enormous World Tree population distributed across Imperial territory into a single communication and transportation infrastructure.[1231] Attempting to pass that quantity of information directly through an established planetary World Tree risked overwhelming the organism, so Victor needed a world without an existing Tree as the central point of the system.
Victor was already operating with significantly depleted reserves after sustaining the accelerated Empire for almost two hundred thousand subjective years. More than 80% of his available strength had been committed to the temporal project by this stage, making processes that would normally have been effortless substantially more demanding.[1231] The extreme expenditure had nevertheless refined his control continuously, while Jeanne's participation had produced similar development in her. Anna and Natalia therefore assisted directly with the Mars reconstruction rather than forcing Victor to perform every stage alone. Natalia stabilized Space-Time around the operation, Anna reinforced what Victor created and Zaladrac eventually joined rather than stand aside while the others worked.
The four assumed enormous Dragon forms around Mars. Anna and Natalia already exceeded the planet in size while remaining heavily restrained, and their unrestricted forms could reach Solar-System scales; Jeanne remained the second-largest Dragon in the family, followed closely by Zaladrac and [[Scathach]].[1231] Victor adjusted his own manifestation to work alongside his wives rather than releasing the incomparably greater size of his unrestricted form.
Mars was expanded into a megaplanet capable of supporting trillions of inhabitants. Victor did not design it as a harmless paradise.[1231] The planet contained radically different environments inspired by the countless worlds, technologies and supernatural systems encountered by the Empire: regions of magma, eternal ice, extreme gravity, weightless territories, Miasma zones, enormous floating islands and other dangerous environments. Smaller Leviathans were introduced into its seas alongside mutated primeval species and Monsters originating from Nightingale. The Imperial capital was intended to challenge the people living upon it rather than reduce every aspect of existence to perfect safety.
The more difficult step was giving the world a proper supernatural foundation without using a conventional planetary World Tree. Victor initially considered acting as the world's equivalent himself but rejected the idea because his Energy had become far too potent and too heavily infused with Eldritch characteristics to distribute casually throughout future generations.[1231] Instead he called upon the World Trees already connected to him.
The World Trees manifested through Victor in the form of light and extended their roots into Mars while their true existences remained protected within his internal Reality.[1231] Even Yggdrasil participated. Through those roots, Mars became the central junction linking the World Tree network spread across countless Imperial galaxies. The result solved a logistical limitation that had remained even after hundreds of thousands of years of advancement. Conventional Imperial communication could already cross enormous astronomical distances in minutes, but a civilization operating across countless galaxies still experienced measurable delays. Through the World Tree network, information and communication could now move virtually instantaneously across the Empire.
Roxanne confirmed that the network had successfully connected the participating Trees. Victor could close his eyes and sense the enormous web extending through planets and galaxies across his territory.[1231] The actual World Trees remained inside the security of his Soul rather than physically exposing themselves through Mars, meaning destroying the capital would not destroy the network. So long as the Trees survived, even catastrophic damage to individual connected worlds could theoretically be repaired or reconstructed.
The entire operation required approximately seven subjective months, although Natalia's temporal control prevented Time from passing outside the isolated work period.[1231] Victor estimated that at full strength he could have completed the same project in approximately seven minutes, emphasizing how heavily the final stage of the accelerated era had drained him. Once Mars itself was stable, he created a gigantic Imperial castle upon one of the floating islands and embedded another layer of defenses throughout the planet. Hundreds of automated traps were designed specifically for hostile invaders and could not be accidentally activated by ordinary Imperial citizens.
Violet then prepared a proclamation transmitted simultaneously throughout the Elderblood Empire. With Akasha coordinating the broadcast, enormous holographic projections of the Empress appeared across metropolitan centers and distant Galactic colonies.[1231] Violet explained that Imperial civilization had long since ceased being confined to Yggdrasil. New worlds had been created and colonized, cities existed throughout distant Solar Systems and galaxies, and Space itself had effectively become the Empire's habitat. The transformation of Mars therefore represented neither the abandonment of the past nor an entirely new beginning, but another step in the civilization's continued expansion.
Violet officially proclaimed Mars the new capital of the Elderblood Empire.[1231] Yggdrasil would remain preserved so future generations could look toward the world and understand where Imperial history had begun, while Mars became the political and logistical heart of its next era. The announcement was answered by enormous celebrations and repeated cries in honor of the Emperor.
Akasha subsequently reported that the World Tree network had increased Galactic communication efficiency by approximately one thousand percent.[1231] When Violet asked how long information from the most distant connected galaxies now required to reach the center, Akasha answered: immediately. The network was fundamentally connected deeply enough that information could theoretically interact with the greater Universal World Tree system, but Victor's presence interfered with that external transmission and prevented information from casually escaping his protected territory.
The family briefly considered placing additional Eldritch restrictions upon the participating World Trees if they ever left Victor's inner domain, only for Roxanne to point out that most had no interest in doing so.[1231] The Trees had become accustomed to the overwhelming Energy and security provided inside Victor's Reality and generally preferred resting there unless he specifically required their assistance. With Mars established, the universal communication infrastructure online and Yggdrasil scheduled for eventual preservation as a garden world, Violet turned the Imperial leadership toward the next phase of their preparations and the remaining Sectors under Elderblood control.

##### The Merger of the Lower Sectors
Chapters 1179–1182
With Mars established as the Empire's new capital and the World Tree network functioning across Imperial territory, the next stage of the plan turned toward the three Lower Sectors most deeply connected to Victor's civilization: Arcane, [[Nightingale]] and Samar. Each had already been pushed close to the developmental limit of a Lower Sector through centuries of Elderblood influence, and the Empire no longer intended to leave them isolated outside the Mid-Level Sector indefinitely.[1232]
[[Albedo Moriarty Elderblood]] was sent to Arcane, where she found that the world had become almost unrecognizable compared with the isolated Witch civilization of earlier centuries. Magical technology saturated the cities, supernatural species moved openly through public spaces and even Demigods had become sufficiently common that their presence no longer defined the entire society.[1232] Evie Moriarty remained its ruler, with the Witches having decisively secured the world under Imperial support. Albedo also encountered the adult [[Emily Moriarty]] and the last surviving Drakyo before finally explaining the real purpose of her visit: preparations for the Sector merger had been completed. She handed Evie a dark-violet sphere carrying a fragment of Victor's power and warned her not to attempt to understand its structure directly, since simply examining it deeply enough was capable of overwhelming her mind.
Ophis performed the same role in Nightingale. The Vampire world had retained much of its Gothic identity while becoming a multicultural Imperial world inhabited by Vampires, Humans, Shadow Demons, Dark Elves, [[Ghosts]], Spectres and other beings adapted to its environment.[1232] Imperial biotechnology and food production had also removed the old necessity for Vampires to survive exclusively through Blood, while the laws of the Empire had largely ended the predatory practices once treated as ordinary parts of Vampire society. Ophis travelled through the territories of the old Count Clans before reaching the Royal Castle and informing [[Vlad III Tepes|Vlad Tepes]] that Nightingale would soon be moved. Vlad immediately ordered [[Alexios Alioth]] to prepare the population and instructed everyone to remain calm while the ritual took place.
On Samar, [[Tasha Fenrir Elderblood]] and [[Maya Elizabeth Lykos Elderblood]] observed a civilization that had similarly expanded far beyond its previous condition. Samar itself had been enlarged to approximately three times the size of old Earth, while the Royal Capital had grown across an area larger than South America.[1232] The Werewolf population had become far stronger and purer than its ancient baseline, although Tasha still considered the world deficient in genuine elites: only around fifty individuals had reached planetary-class power. The Empire's solution to the historical weaknesses of hybridization had nevertheless created another path forward. Tasha deliberately built much of Samar's elite from hybrids in which Werewolf bloodlines were strengthened through races such as Gods, Angels, Demons, Spirits or Dragons. She and Maya carried the third sphere and waited for Victor to begin.
The Imperial researchers explained that the operation would not promote the Elderblood Mid-Level Sector into a Higher Sector. Instead, the three smaller regions would be physically drawn into the existing Mid-Level Sector, creating and relocating additional galaxies within its boundaries.[1232] [[Velnorah Xyphora Elderblood Thaloria II]] compared the cosmological structure to aquariums: Lower Sectors were smaller protected containers in which young civilizations and galaxies could mature, a Mid-Level Sector was a much larger enclosure and entering the Higher Sectors was equivalent to emptying that enclosure into an open ocean filled with predators. Victor's objective was therefore to bring the three smaller "aquariums" into the protected edge of his own without prematurely exposing them to the Upper-Sector powers.
At the barrier of the Mid-Level Sector, Victor met the [[The Universal Tree]] and revealed that the spheres were not merely beacons but fragments of his own existence.[1233] He had adapted the method used by Higher-Sector factions against developing regions: a sufficiently powerful Being could scatter pieces of its own power into a Lower Sector so that, as the region matured, its development became cosmologically biased toward appearing near the faction that had seeded it. Victor had learned the principle from the Empire of Light's attempt to influence his own Sector and now intended to reverse the method for his benefit. Once the spheres in Arcane, Nightingale and Samar were sufficiently saturated with his presence, he could use the connection to pull their entire Sectors toward him.
The conversation also exposed more of the structure maintained by the Primordial Beings. The Universal Tree remained disturbed by the System's attempt to claim Moira and admitted that the Primordials had still not received a satisfactory explanation.[1233] Death and Infinity were particularly displeased that information had apparently been withheld from them. Victor, meanwhile, learned more about the relationship between the Universal Tree and the [[World Trees]] spread throughout Creation. Each World Tree functioned as part of an enormous network through which Life extended across worlds, even though Victor's habit of housing large numbers of those Trees safely inside his own Reality had effectively removed many of them from the harsh developmental cycle the Universal Tree considered natural.
Their discussion further clarified that <Negativity> and <Positivity> were not merely two unrelated supreme powers. Negativity represented the spiritual side of Creation and strongly encompassed emotional and immaterial Concepts, while Positivity represented its material counterpart; together they were the divided halves of the primordial [[Chaos]] from which the Universe had emerged.[1233] The Universal Tree privately recognized that the World Tree network also served a defensive purpose beyond planetary development, allowing the structure of Life to help identify abnormal presences entering the Universe.
When the Universal Tree asked exactly how the merger would function, Victor finally stated the mechanism directly: the spheres were pieces of himself, and each would influence its entire Lower Sector strongly enough for Victor to call that region toward the edge of his own.[1233] The method explained why powers from the Higher Sectors distributed fragments, agents and influence throughout developing regions. Victor was effectively using the same cosmological exploitation method in reverse, not to make another civilization subordinate to him but to relocate civilizations that were already part of his Empire.
The process began once Victor assumed a Dragon form larger than galaxies and established direct contact with all three fragments.[1234] The Universal Tree explained that this type of manipulation was one of the principal reasons Higher-Sector factions seeded Lower Sectors in advance: when a developing Sector eventually emerged near their sphere of influence, the older faction possessed an enormous advantage over its inhabitants. Most developing regions could be controlled that way. The comparatively rare exceptions were rulers who achieved complete dominion over their own Mid-Level Sector and became recognized as Overlords. The title did not describe a separate species or unique power system; it denoted a ruler who controlled an entire Sector. Velnorah Xyphora Elderblood Thaloria II had once possessed that status, and Victor now held it over the Elderblood Sector.
Before the merger completed, the Universal Tree also explained the great recycling structure of the Universe.[1234] Life extended through the Universal Tree and its countless manifestations; living beings and their information eventually entered the Akashic structure through the Judges of the Abyss; Death governed the ending and decay of existences; and the released Energy was ultimately returned to the cycle so new Life could be created. Extremely powerful Beings required vastly longer periods to process because the quantity of information and Energy contained within their existence was correspondingly greater. Infinity sustained the endless expansion of the Universe largely through its existence, while the Primordial associated with Limbo maintained internal balance and prevented individual civilizations or entities from destabilizing the whole structure.
The Judges' position also clarified that the Akashic system was not simply an archive. Information from deceased beings entered the Records while the enormous Energy contained within their existences was gradually processed and returned to the greater cycle of Life.[1234] Ordinary beings might require centuries for this process, whereas the Universal Tree estimated that an existence carrying as much Energy as Victor could theoretically require trillions of years if he were ever genuinely processed through the same system. Jeanne reacted badly even to the hypothetical example, forcing the Universal Tree to emphasize that he was explaining the mechanism rather than predicting Victor's death.
Victor gradually reconstructed how the Primordial offices connected to one another. The Universal Tree represented Life throughout the Cosmos, the Judges managed the spiritual information flowing into the Akashic structure, Death governed the end and decay of existence, Infinity maintained the Universe's expansion and Limbo's Primordial acted as a stabilizing force against internal beings capable of unbalancing the greater system.[1234] The Universal Tree also revealed that Limbo's Herald commanded one of the strongest factions in the Higher Sectors. Victor consequently concluded that the four major external powers he knew about did not all function in the same manner: three behaved more conventionally as competing factions, while another existed closer to an enforcement or mediating structure serving the Primordial responsible for Balance.
The explanation caused Victor to infer that the Primordial system had also been arranged as a defense against threats originating beyond their Universe.[1234] World Trees formed an enormous distributed network, the Judges examined Souls and spiritual information, Death occupied another critical boundary of the cycle, Infinity existed at the ever-expanding frontier and Limbo's Primordial watched internal stability. Victor reasoned that an intruder entering from another Universe would therefore encounter multiple overlapping detection mechanisms instead of a single guardian.
That reasoning led Victor toward the ancient fate of [[Primordial Chaos]]. The Universal Tree confirmed that Negativity and Positivity had originally been one conscious Primordial Being before being divided into two halves for reasons he refused to explain.[1234] Victor immediately connected the event with the wider defensive system and theorized that an external enemy—perhaps a Being or primordial force originating from another Universe—could have been responsible for leaving Primordial Chaos in its present divided condition. The Universal Tree refused to confirm the theory and became visibly irritated by how rapidly Victor was reconstructing information from indirect clues.
Jeanne could not resolve the mystery herself. She had originally been created to protect the Universal Tree when he was still young and had not personally witnessed what later happened to Primordial Chaos.[1234] Victor briefly manifested his own connection to Negativity and attempted to obtain a response from the divided primordial power directly, but no understandable answer came. The Universal Tree insisted the original Being's condition remained too damaged for conventional communication and told Victor to focus upon the problem they could actually solve. The exchange nevertheless increased Victor's understanding of the fundamental architecture of the Universe and reinforced his suspicion that the greatest future threat might exist beyond the boundaries of their native Reality rather than merely in the Higher Sectors.
Once the three Lower Sectors were sufficiently saturated, the spheres rose into the air above Arcane, Nightingale and Samar and Reality itself appeared to crack around them.[1234] Victor pulled on the fragments and began drawing all three cosmological regions into the Mid-Level Sector. The Universal Tree intervened to prevent neighboring Lower Sectors from being dragged along with them, since no one had previously attempted to pull several smaller protected regions directly into an existing Mid-Level Sector in this manner. The barrier surrounding Victor's territory expanded, galaxies belonging to the three regions emerged inside it and Victor immediately began separating and organizing the incoming structures so that no Galactic systems collided.
The populations of all three worlds could see Victor's colossal Dragon form across the transformed sky as the merger completed.[1234] What had once been three geographically and cosmologically separated civilizations were now contained inside the same protected Sector as the rest of the [[Elderblood Empire]]. The operation did not merely acquire three inhabited planets; each Lower Sector brought its own young galaxies and developing astronomical structures, greatly enlarging the amount of territory that now fell under Victor's responsibility.
Victor then personally reorganized the new Galactic geography.[1235] His Dragon body expanded through the void until it dwarfed ordinary galaxies, and his power enveloped entire spiral galaxies at once, allowing him to move billions of stars without disrupting the Solar Systems and orbital structures inside them. Victor deliberately examined each region rather than simply throwing the newly merged galaxies wherever empty Space existed. Many of the Lower-Sector galaxies were significantly younger than those already belonging to the Mid-Level Sector, so he placed them in quieter regions where they could continue developing naturally without being crowded immediately into the Empire's oldest Galactic zones.
The degree of control required was enormous. Victor moved complete galaxies while preserving the relative positions of stars, planets and Solar Systems inside them, then checked the distances between the relocated structures before proceeding to the next.[1235] The operation demonstrated that his large-scale Reality Manipulation had advanced beyond destructive power. He could reorganize Galactic geography while maintaining the delicate astronomical systems contained within it rather than merely overwhelming them through superior Energy.
Nightingale and Samar required special treatment because of their unique planetary and stellar environments. Victor therefore preserved their existing Solar Systems intact and positioned them only a few hundred light-years apart inside one of the Empire's heavily protected central regions.[1235] Arcane could be relocated more freely because its world did not depend upon the same unusual Solar-System structure. The final arrangement placed all three former Lower-Sector civilizations close enough for Imperial transport and administration while ensuring that an external invader would need to penetrate multiple layers of Elderblood territory before reaching them.
The Universal Tree described Victor's reconstruction as a "flawless job" and remarked that watching him reorganize the merged galaxies resembled watching someone recreate a portion of the Universe.[1235] He had contributed comparatively little to the actual reconstruction beyond protecting the surrounding Lower Sectors during the initial merger. The younger galaxies were now Victor's responsibility, although the Universal Tree agreed to watch their development and provide assistance because their sudden relocation had given them almost no natural transition period.
Victor nevertheless refused to leave even those apparently harmless young regions completely unattended. The Universal Tree warned that the Universe possessed a habit of producing unexpected developments over sufficiently long periods, which Victor immediately interpreted as another reason to assign observers.[1235] His behavior appeared excessively paranoid even to the Primordial embodiment of Life, but Victor regarded the difference as preparation: newly merged territory would be watched before anything developing inside it could become a problem.
The aftermath also returned briefly to the Moriarty family. During the merger, Albedo had become convinced that Evie should finally pursue Victor romantically and later brought her daughter directly before Violet to obtain the Empress' approval.[1235] Violet refused. Her objection was not Evie's status, strength or ancestry but the simpler fact that Evie did not actually want such a relationship strongly enough. Evie admitted that she respected Victor, considered him attractive and understood why enormous numbers of women admired him, but nearly all of her personal interactions with him had remained professional. Attraction toward the Emperor was not the same as loving Victor as an individual.
Albedo initially resisted the distinction before realizing Evie was correct. Violet likewise refused to turn an Imperial woman's admiration into an obligation to enter Victor's household simply because doing so might theoretically benefit the family.[1235] The exchange reinforced the same boundary Victor had established during Violet's earlier attempt to expand the household through strategically valuable women: genuine relationships could develop naturally, but usefulness or attraction alone was insufficient reason to manufacture one.
Emily Moriarty complicated the discussion further by revealing that she already possessed romantic feelings for a young Werewolf belonging to Tasha's family.[1235] The revelation shocked both Evie and Albedo, particularly because Emilly had concealed the relationship from her mother. Violet accepted the existence of another partner far more readily than Albedo expected, although she predictably objected to Emilly claiming that she possessed no interest in Victor whatsoever. After a characteristically strange lesson involving Violet's private photographs of Victor, Emilly clarified that her lack of romantic intention did not mean she failed to recognize the Emperor's attractiveness or importance.
Albedo's attempt to reorganize her descendants' relationships ended when [[Scathach]] contacted her and reminded her that it was Time for training. The Dragon Goddess who had once spent nearly all of her life isolated in research laboratories immediately fled back toward her master's program rather than risk being late.[1235] Evie and Emilly were subsequently returned to Arcane, where Evie immediately demanded the full story concerning her daughter's relationship. The comparatively mundane family dispute unfolded against the background of a civilization whose worlds had just been physically relocated across cosmological boundaries, emphasizing how completely events once considered impossible had become ordinary within the Elderblood era.
With the three Lower Sectors successfully merged, their galaxies reorganized and their principal worlds secured inside the Mid-Level Sector, one of the largest remaining divisions inside the Elderblood civilization disappeared.[1235] Arcane, Nightingale and Samar were no longer neighboring cosmological territories linked primarily through portals, political alliances or Imperial infrastructure. They had become literal regions of the same Sector ruled by Victor. The former Lower Sectors retained their own worlds, peoples and developing galaxies, but now existed behind the same barrier, inside the same defensive structure and beneath the same Overlord.
The operation therefore completed a process that had begun when Victor first expanded beyond Earth and Nightingale. Worlds that once belonged to separate supernatural civilizations had become parts of one Galactic and increasingly Sector-wide Empire. With Mars functioning as the new Imperial capital, the World Trees providing effectively instantaneous communication across its galaxies, and Arcane, Nightingale and Samar physically incorporated into the Elderblood Sector, Victor had consolidated the territories behind him as thoroughly as possible before the Empire eventually turned toward the civilizations waiting beyond the barrier.[1235]

##### Absolute Paradox and the Emperor's Classroom
Chapters 1183–1185
The merger of Arcane, [[Nightingale]] and Samar did not end the accelerated era. While Victor continued handling the altered structure of the Sector, Velina became bored with the restrictions placed upon the younger generation and returned to one of Humanity's ancient scientific thought experiments: Schrödinger's cat.[1236] Remembering that Velnorah had been struggling with a classified Imperial project, Velina brought the idea to her mother and proposed taking the underlying contradiction to an absurd extreme. Velnorah immediately recognized the possibility, gathered her usual research circle and reported the idea to Violet. The resulting theoretical weapon was named the [[Absolute Paradox]]. Rather than simply destroying matter, Souls or Concepts, it was intended to force two mutually exclusive states to remain simultaneously true. A target could be alive and dead, an event could have occurred and never occurred, two separate locations could occupy the same point, or—at the theoretical maximum—the Universe itself could be forced to both exist and never have existed. The objective was not conventional destruction but a contradiction so fundamental that Reality could no longer resolve its own state.[1236]
Victor reduced the proposal to three required mechanisms. The first was a core of contradiction capable of holding mutually impossible states such as existence and nonexistence without allowing either to cancel the other. The second was a power source capable of sustaining that impossibility while Reality attempted to correct it, with Primal Energy identified as a possible method. The third was a transfer system capable of imposing the paradox upon a chosen person, object, law or Concept.[1236] The danger was obvious: the moment a true contradiction existed, the native order of the Universe would attempt to erase it. A sufficiently advanced version might therefore need to be built or stabilized outside the Universe, creating an immediate practical obstacle because the Empire did not yet possess a known method for simply leaving its native Reality. The Absolute Paradox consequently remained an experimental concept rather than a completed superweapon, with the researchers intending to begin through much smaller tests.
The same chapter clarified how close Victor had come to the practical limit of the two-hundred-thousand-year project. Although approximately 190,000 internal years had actually elapsed, he was now committing roughly 96% of his available Energy to the ritual and the surrounding Imperial systems, up from the roughly eighty percent expenditure seen earlier.[1236] His personal world had begun losing vitality, while the assistance supplied by Roxanne, Amara and the [[World Trees]] could only reduce the deficit temporarily. Victor was not injured; he was simply consuming Energy faster than even his existence could regenerate it. Anna argued that the original developmental objectives had already been achieved and demanded that he end the ritual, but Victor refused to abandon the final years or the projects depending upon them. He instead placed his physical body into an energy-saving sleep while keeping his Soul and consciousness fully active. The moment the body shut down, his planet and the [[Dragon Heart]] visibly recovered part of their normal activity.
Victor used that state to take over one of the lessons normally handled by Anna or Jeanne.[1237] Appearing before his daughters in Soul form while dressed theatrically as a teacher, he immediately attracted virtually the entire younger generation. Anna then disclosed a second reason his exhaustion had become so extreme. The integration of additional Lower Sectors had thinned the barrier surrounding their Mid-Level Sector to the point that the entire region naturally wanted to advance; Victor was simultaneously maintaining the accelerated ritual and forcibly preventing the Sector from ascending before he was ready. His Energy was therefore supporting not merely planets and galaxies but the stability of their present cosmological level.
[[Moira Eutychia Elderblood]] reacted to her father's condition by simply wishing that he would become well again. The surrounding Universe answered her.[1237] Primal Energy entered Victor directly despite the defenses and restrictions surrounding him and restored approximately 20% of his reserves almost immediately, demonstrating the extraordinary privilege created by Moira's Eldritch Luck and her relationship with the Universe. The recovery did not solve the underlying problem: his reserves immediately began falling again because the ritual and Sector stabilization continued consuming more than he regenerated. Victor therefore kept his physical body asleep and continued operating through his Soul rather than wasting the temporary recovery.
Elsewhere, Violet assumed greater responsibility for organizing the newly incorporated territories while Victor conserved himself. When Albedo questioned why daughters such as Melida, [[Metis]] or other enormously powerful members of the second generation were not simply ordered to help sustain the ritual, Violet explained one of Victor's most stubborn family principles: adult duty.[1237] Unless circumstances genuinely required otherwise, Victor did not want his daughters carrying responsibilities that he believed belonged to their parents. Akasha was treated differently because she had been deliberately created for a specific Imperial function, while Velina's research was something she pursued because she personally enjoyed it; Melida and Metis had not been created as tools and were therefore daughters before they were resources. Yog had likewise been born with a specific purpose and Moira could guide the family through her Luck, but even then Victor continued looking for solutions that did not require turning his children into supports for his own burden.
Victor's open lesson then became a dense explanation of the Empire's increasingly advanced power systems.[1238] He explained that [[Divine Energy]], Demonic Energy, Spirit Energy, Mana, Ki and similar forms were ultimately different expressions of the same underlying Energy. Attributeless Energy was the blank origin from which those differentiated forms could be produced: a metaphysical blank canvas capable of becoming other energies. Primal Energy occupied a related but distinct role. In Victor's simplified explanation, Attributeless Energy was what Creation used to bring things forth, while Primal Energy made those created structures function. For beings possessing sufficient understanding and control the distinction could become practically trivial, but Attributeless Energy remained conceptually prior because everything native to Creation had ultimately been shaped from it. [[Eldritch Energy]] was the exception: an external form of Energy belonging to a different order of Reality, comparable in broad analogy to the attributeless foundation of another Universe. Because it did not belong to the native system, its use distorted or corrupted local Reality according to foreign logic.[1238]
The explanation naturally led into Runes. Victor described a Rune as a language of power through which a user issues an instruction to Reality, with different races and systems expressing different methods of understanding the same deeper structure.[1238] Ordinary enchantment represented a comparatively simple Runic application, while the Runes of Gods, Witches and other civilizations depended upon their own compatibility, knowledge and conceptual framework. Draconic Runes were unusually unrestricted because [[True Dragons]] possessed exceptional compatibility with the Universe itself, allowing their language to alter structures of Reality much more directly. A Divinity connected to Language did not automatically create a supreme Runemaster; understanding of Creation mattered more than simply possessing the relevant title or Concept. Eldritch Runes followed the same principle from the opposite direction, imposing the logic of an external existence upon native Reality and becoming increasingly dangerous as more foreign instructions were introduced.
Victor also corrected a common misunderstanding regarding Sectors and Divine Concepts. Moving from a Lower Sector into a Mid-Level or Higher Sector did not change what a Concept such as Destruction fundamentally was; what changed was the wielder's influence and competition.[1238] A normal God who dominated a Concept inside a smaller Sector could enter a greater region and discover many other Gods expressing the same Concept, reducing the relative authority they previously enjoyed. Victor's family was exceptional because several of its members had already developed far beyond the normal level associated with their native Sector.
From there Victor defined a completed Primordial Being as more than a God with an exceptionally powerful Divinity. Such a Being became the incarnation of the Concept itself and occupied a functional office within the Universe; the Gods associated with that Concept ultimately drew upon a structure the Primordial embodied.[1238] Under the current order there could ordinarily be only one such native Primordial for each Concept, with the Judges of the Abyss functioning as an apparent exception only because their three manifestations were fundamentally one Being. This distinction opened another possibility for Kassandra. She could become a native Primordial of Destruction, but doing so would close the same position to Kali. Because Kassandra already possessed an Eldritch component through Victor, she could instead develop toward an Eldritch Primordial of Destruction, allowing Kali to continue pursuing the native universal office. Victor added that even the present one-Primordial-per-Concept rule was not absolutely immutable if the Creator responsible for the system chose to alter it.
The lesson concluded with the relationship among <Positivity>, <Negativity> and [[Primordial Chaos]].[1238] Victor described Positivity and Negativity as the divided foundation of the Primordial Chaos that created their Universe. Everything native to the Universe contained both; physical phenomena tended toward greater Positivity while spiritual, emotional and nonphysical phenomena tended toward greater Negativity, but neither side existed in complete isolation. Victor emphasized that his possession of Negativity granted enormous Authority rather than serving as the sole source of his combat strength. His true foundation remained the abilities and control he had built across his life, his status as Progenitor of the [[Blood Dragons]], his Eldritch nature and the predatory capacity to devour and assimilate what he required.
Finally, Victor explained why a Universe required a Primordial Chaos at all. Just as a Primordial Being embodied and administered a fundamental Concept, Primordial Chaos embodied the Universe itself; within its own domain, such an existence could properly be described as omnipotent, omniscient and omnipresent.[1238] A clash between Primordial Chaos(es) would therefore resemble a collision between the living embodiments of separate Universes rather than an ordinary contest of martial skill or Energy reserves. Victor believed the Primordial Chaos of his Reality had lost whatever ancient conflict produced its present divided condition—only for his own Negativity to stir in immediate rejection of that conclusion. The message Victor received was unambiguous: their Primordial Chaos had not lost; its enemy was in an even worse condition.

##### Eldritch Luck, Nero and Ophis, and the Great Old Ones
Chapters 1186–1188
Victor's lesson continued when [[Nigredo Elderblood]] quietly asked what power their youngest sister actually possessed.[1239] Victor separated two phenomena that the family had often treated as though they were the same thing. Moira's own power was Eldritch Luck, produced through the interaction between [[Tyche]]'s Luck and Victor's foreign Eldritch biology, while the constant way Reality catered to Moira was better described as a passive blessing or favor from the Universe itself. Victor admitted that even he did not yet know the full limits of that favor: the family had not established whether it could injure a sufficiently superior Being on Moira's behalf, whether it would provide absolutely anything she genuinely desired or how violently it might respond if she were deliberately provoked. He therefore warned the daughters not to experiment by upsetting their youngest sister simply to see what Reality would do.
The discussion broadened into questions Victor could not answer with certainty. Stella asked whether the [[Akashic Records]] were older than the Creator and what sustained Divine Concepts.[1239] Victor openly admitted that he did not know the first answer and instead presented the conclusion he considered most logical: if Positivity and Negativity were originally the divided substance of the Being that created their Universe, then the Akashic structure and the other Primordial mechanisms probably came afterward rather than preceding that Creator. His stories from Jeanne and the Universal Tree supported the possibility that the original Creator had produced the Primordial Beings and the larger cosmic systems, but Victor carefully presented this as deduction rather than established history.
Victor was more confident about Divine Concepts themselves. The Universe nourished them, and Concepts existed in far more forms than the great universal offices represented by Life, Death, Time or Space.[1239] Victor theorized that virtually any meaningful adjective, quality or idea could possess a corresponding Divine Concept, although minor or highly specific Concepts would not possess the same inherent reach as foundational ones. His own unusual Divinity of Yandere and the many narrowly specialized Gods of the Shinto tradition served as examples that the conceptual structure of Reality was not restricted to a short list of grand cosmic nouns.
Hinata then asked whether the Creator had established the Universe's present organization or whether the Primordial Beings had done so afterward. Victor again distinguished knowledge from inference. He believed the ancient universal war had removed the original Creator from active administration too early for the present cosmological structure to be entirely his direct work, making the current Primordial order the more likely architect of much of the modern arrangement.[1239] Gina's question concerning the numerous beings called "[[Primordial Chaos]]" within Pantheons produced another clarification: Victor regarded the title as a product of limited regional knowledge.
