Pantheon-level [[Chaos]] figures were not automatically identical to the true Creator-level Primordial Chaos responsible for an entire Universe, and even extremely ancient Higher-Sector civilizations could retain incomplete models of the greater cosmology.
Chapter 1187 shifted away from cosmology and toward [[Nero Elderblood]] and [[Ophis Tepes Elderblood]], who visited Victor while his physical body remained in its Energy-conserving state.[1240] Both checked his condition despite his repeated assurances that he was merely resting rather than injured. Ophis' concern came directly from memories of Victor nearly destroying himself to protect her in the past, while [[Nero]] remained equally suspicious of his tendency to describe dangerous self-sacrifice as something routine. Their conversation also made their current relationship with Victor explicit: both women regarded themselves as adults and as his wives while still openly treating him as the father who had rescued and raised them.
Ophis abruptly announced that she wanted a daughter because she wanted a "mini-me", with Nero quickly revealing similar thoughts of her own.[1240] Victor did not reject the idea but forced both women to consider the responsibilities behind it. The family already contained numerous examples of mothers dealing with children born vastly more powerful than ordinary Gods, and Nero and Ophis had only comparatively recently become [[True Dragons]] by Elderblood standards. Victor advised them to master their own Draconic existences before creating another generation simply because the idea sounded appealing. Both quickly postponed the plan once they considered the practical realities of raising daughters who might inherit their powers.
The discussion also clarified their attitudes toward the coming war. Nero fully intended to participate and did not want pregnancy or incomplete mastery to remove her from the battlefield, while Ophis retained her longstanding lack of enthusiasm for combat.[1240] Ophis was naturally talented and still trained under [[Scathach]] often enough not to become rusty, but she had no desire to become a frontline warrior merely because she possessed the power to do so. Victor accepted that choice rather than treating every daughter or wife as a military resource.
Thinking about Nero entering the war returned Victor to a problem that had followed his Empire's growth from the beginning: even extraordinarily strong wives and daughters could not be everywhere with equal protection. He already possessed Heralds, Bloodhunters, Leviathans, Dragons and Imperial Guard, yet still wanted personal escorts capable of surviving threats aimed specifically at his family.[1240] Victor began considering a new generation of Eldritch Beings and beasts using himself as the starting foundation, taking advantage of the Soul connections created through his marriages. The idea remained in its conceptual stage, but it showed that his answer to Upper-Sector escalation was increasingly to build living forces whose nature itself belonged outside conventional native limitations.
The [[Absolute Paradox]] project meanwhile proved far more difficult than its initial theory suggested. By Chapter 1188, Ruby, Aline, Velnorah and Velina had spent years of ritual Time trying to produce a genuine contradiction, yet every internal approach failed because the Universe automatically corrected mutually incompatible native states.[1241] [[Eldritch Energy]] made foreign distortion easier precisely because it originated from another universal framework, but even that did not constitute the type of true internal logical break the researchers wanted. The problem resembled trying to destroy a living organism's immune system while still working inside one of its organs: dimensional isolation, worlds hidden inside Victor's Soul and other protected spaces remained parts of the same native Universe because Victor himself was still a native component of that Reality.
Velnorah eventually forced Velina to leave the main laboratory and spend Time with the family. Velina obeyed only technically, moving into a private laboratory Dimension her mother had created for her and using the remaining Time before dinner to continue independent simulations.[1241] Countless combinations of contradictory Concepts failed for the same reason—the Universe simply reconciled them. Velina concluded that even creating the weapon "outside" ordinary space would not solve the problem automatically; they needed a condition in which the native system could tolerate contradiction rather than immediately treating it as an error to be repaired.
Her search for that condition was interrupted by a far less controlled experiment outside the family castle. [[Yog-Sothoth]] Elderblood and Nigredo Elderblood appeared beside a newly created river in their grotesque Eldritch Forms, accompanied by lesser Eldritch creatures and Leviathans.[1241] Velina was disturbed less by their appearances than by what they were doing. The chapter clarified that almost all of Victor's daughters possessed latent Eldritch Forms through their father's nature, although only a minority had learned to access them deliberately by this point.
Yog and Nigredo had already created an ecosystem of hybrid Eldritch-Leviathan fish. Yog initially attempted to take sole credit before Nigredo's annoyance forced her to acknowledge their shared work.[1241] Their creatures could move through Space through Yog's contribution and survive inside black holes through Nigredo's influence, while [[Leone Elena Luna Elderblood]] had added extreme adaptability. Valentina, Hinata, Silvia, Rosemary, Stella and other sisters then began proposing additional traits ranging from Dragon Fire and Dragon Lightning to Ice, Solar power and Truth. Velina, abandoning her role as the voice of caution almost immediately, contributed intelligence so the resulting Being would not emerge mindless.
The sisters also used one of Victor's scales as a Draconic foundation. [[Aphrodite]] Elderblood arrived just in Time to watch the experiment reach the point of no return and reacted with the sense that she was witnessing another version of ancient Pandora's creation.[1241] The daughters attempted to flee with their equipment when she confronted them, but Victor revealed that he had been observing from the beginning and would have intervened if their experiment had crossed a genuinely dangerous threshold. Rather than punish creativity, he allowed the developing Life-form to finish emerging.
The result was [[Cthugha]], a Divine Eldritch entity whom Victor classified not as another true Outer God but as a Great Old One.[1241] The distinction allowed Victor to articulate the hierarchy of the Great Chaos more clearly. At the summit stood Victor and Azathoth as the two Creators. Beneath them were true [[Outer Gods]] or Eldritch Gods created by or directly descended from the Creators, including their daughters and [[Abhoth]]; the direct daughters possessed higher internal Pantheon status than Abhoth because of their descent. Beneath the Outer Gods stood Great Old Ones—Divine Beings created by Victor or his daughters—and below them were lesser non-Divine Servants of the Outer Gods. The narration additionally stated that Victor's wives would eventually become Eldritch Goddesses like their daughters, a future development that should not be read as proof that every wife had already reached that state at this exact moment.
Cthugha embodied the type of contradiction Velina's research team had been failing to create deliberately. He possessed a native Star Concept together with foreign Eldritch Space, Draconic characteristics inherited through Victor's scale and recognition by the native Universe as the progenitor of a new race of Fire Vampires.[1241] The combination was inherently contradictory because conventional Noble Vampires outside the Snow lineage treated fire as a major weakness, yet Cthugha's identity united Vampirism and stellar fire as foundational characteristics. Even as a newborn he possessed enough power to destroy a Solar System and was expected to become substantially stronger with age.
More important than his destructive power was the Universe's reaction: there was effectively none. Cthugha existed as a stable living contradiction without triggering the immediate correction response that had destroyed every artificial paradox tested by Velina's group.[1241] Victor immediately pointed this out. Velina examined Cthugha with the deeper Eyes inherited from her father and recognized that the new Great Old One was not the completed Absolute Paradox but represented the first genuine clue toward understanding how mutually incompatible cosmological principles might coexist without being erased by Reality.
Cthugha identified his own desire simply: he wanted to serve the Great Chaos as effectively as possible.[1241] Victor accepted the answer and assigned the first Divine creation of his daughters a role appropriate to the wars ahead, already thinking about future enemies entering Elderblood territory. What had begun as an unsupervised experiment by several Imperial Princesses therefore ended with the expansion of the Eldritch hierarchy, the birth of a new Vampiric progenitor and the first practical lead toward one of the Empire's most dangerous theoretical weapons.

##### Fragments and the Herald
Chapters 1189–1191
The accelerated era did not keep the barrier closed. As it thinned, the [[Black Eclipse Pantheon]] began sending fragments of Divine Concepts into Imperial territory. The fragments looked for hosts and bound themselves to Souls, building the conditions for a foreign God to use the host as a vessel. One attached itself to [[Ryujin Ikaros]], a descendant of the Japanese Dragon line. The fragment carried the character of a Light-related Divinity. The God it came from is unnamed, and nothing ties that fragment to a named Black Eclipse office. Victor cut it out of the Soul himself and repaired the injury the separation left behind.[1242]
More of the spheres kept appearing. The Empire warned the population not to touch unidentified objects that held foreign Divine power, paid those who turned them in, and punished those who hid them. Black Eclipse already knew the fragments were being destroyed before a usable host could be secured. Its leaders could see that the Sector barrier was failing and still unusually hard to force, and they suspected the emerging <[[Chaos]]> was the reason it held. That suspicion made the Sector more valuable to them, not less. They wanted it before the other Upper-Sector powers could take it.[1242][1243]
[[Niklaus Horseman]] was brought before the [[Vharzath|Great Darkness]] and the Gods standing with him. Darkness covered his body. His eyes had black sclera and red pupils. His own aim was still revenge on [[Vlad III Tepes|Vlad Tepes]], and he did not care what happened to his old Sector, but he told them an unrestricted invasion could destroy the Pantheon. The others laughed at him. A civilization that had held hundreds of galaxies for more than two million years did not treat a Middle Sector as a real threat. Darkness shut them up and let Niklaus finish. He did not throw the warning out. The order he gave was to keep laying traps and not to rush.[1243]
Victor could not keep paying the cost of the ritual and the barrier at the same time. Holding the Sector shut was burning Energy and straining his Soul even with the [[World Trees]] and his Dragon power behind it. He set the Empire to war inside about one year rather than let Black Eclipse choose the hour. Production, the legions, the shipyards, supply and research all moved at once.[1243][1244]
He called War, the strongest of his Heralds and the first Chaos Progenitor, and made him the weapon that would go first. From pure purple Dragon Power he manifested an enormous greatsword, then woke it with an Eldritch declaration: a wielder recognized by the Emperor would become War personified. An eye opened on the blade. The sword knew him as Great Chaos and said it would fulfill the purpose of its existence. Victor named it [[Gol-goroth]] and gave it to War as a companion. The sword fused with the Herald's arm for a moment and came back as a greatsword. What War felt was not ordinary Divine war. It was chaotic, Eldritch, and unsafe to loose near allies. He took it over his shoulder, opened his wings, and went through the portal Victor cut in the barrier, ahead of the legions. Violet asked why one Herald was being sent alone. Victor's answer was that War was strong enough, and that he would not actually be alone.[1243]

##### The War Against Black Eclipse
Chapters 1192–1197
War's first strike was the living ship carrying [[Azrakar]], Primordial God of the Void and one of Black Eclipse's Ten Chief Gods. The God's assistant had just reported that the fragments were entering the Sector and dying before they found hosts. Azrakar searched the Solar System with his Void and did not find the intruder. War killed the assistant, destroyed the ship and everyone on it, and fought Azrakar in the open. The God answered with Darkness and space: distances bent, movement failed, and whole regions were compressed. War broke those prisons with [[Gol-goroth]] and kept coming. Star systems were wrecked. Planets were thrown. The shock reached neighboring galaxies. Azrakar spread his Darkness across thousands of star systems and still could not put the Herald down, because War was hitting the weak points in the techniques instead of trying to out-spend the Energy.[1245]
[[Kaelith]], Goddess of the Night, arrived because Azrakar's own people had asked and because the Great Darkness had ordered an answer big enough to protect the Pantheon's name. Azrakar did not want her there until he heard whose order it was. She thought two Chief Gods would be enough, and she mocked Victor for sending War in without help. War refused that reading. Gol-goroth drank the Energy coming off him and opened its eye. Three Eldritch beings came out of his body: Famine, Pestilence and Death. They took the apocalyptic roles of his dead brothers. They are new existences that can fight. The original Demonic Souls are not what walks out of him.[1245]
The three went at Kaelith together. Death cut her face with a sword of Miasma. Famine put a concentrated blade through her abdomen. Pestilence took her limbs. She rebuilt herself out of Darkness. That regeneration lost to the martial gap. It did not make her untouchable. War, still on Azrakar, turned a concentrated Void shot aside instead of meeting its full Energy. The shot was Azrakar's. It collapsed thousands of distant stars after it passed War.[1246]
Azrakar then tried to crush him inside a spatial prison held up by several convergence points. War did not smash the whole region. He found the weak joint, cut one connection with the tip of Gol-goroth, and the prison fell. He hit Azrakar and drove him through planetary bodies. The fight had grown large enough that Equilibrium and a Judge of the Abyss were about to step in. The Great Darkness arrived first. Pure Darkness left his body and took the surrounding Solar Systems and galaxies under his Authority, and their motion stopped. He also gave the Souls of the dead in that battle to Soul. Inside his own dominion those Souls would have returned to him. He gave them up so the Primordial regulators would stay out of a war between Gods. The reason was political. It was not mercy.[1246]
The fight did not stop because the sky had been frozen. Kaelith hid inside her Night, filled the field with copies, and wounded War's arm from a direction he had not treated as real. Azrakar bent the space around that opening. War learned to tell her Darkness from the copies. The three Horsemen came back to him once they saw the two Gods were fighting as a pair. Then [[Nerath]], Goddess of Silence, and [[Vhalor]], God of Shadows, arrived. Azrakar said it aloud: four of the Ten Chief Gods were on the field, and Nerath was the one the [[Seven Black Thrones]] held in the highest esteem. That esteem is not a seat among the Thrones. Nerath's body was a long white shape with no ordinary face, ribs drifting around her, black symbols around the head, and the air around her had no sound. Vhalor was a tall, wrong-proportioned figure of depthless black, faceless, his lower body a moving band of Shadow. Nerath brought a different order. The Great Silence wanted War taken alive. Azrakar accepted it. The Great Silence is not named, and nothing in the scene makes that being into Darkness. War's answer was that he now had more heads to bring Victor.[1246]
The even exchange did not last. Azrakar stopped repeating the attacks War had already broken and started moving the points the strikes came from. Kaelith's copies pulled War off a killing line. Death, Famine and Pestilence kept finding the real body. On the other side, Nerath's silence weakened Pestilence's corruption as it arrived, and her touch cut his power off for a moment. She could also throw away a piece of her own body before a corruption spread through it. Vhalor bound the legs with shadow, struck from the side, and the flesh started to go where the shadows closed. Pestilence could not hold both of them. War called the three back. They came.[1247]
Gol-goroth opened its eye again. That opening is the reveal of the sword's true purpose. It raised an Eldritch domain and isolated the space. Inside it, Eldritch beings had the advantage, and the laws of the universe ceased to apply. The knights' dormant Eldritch aspects woke. War gave his brothers power and, for a short time, his senses. Their forms shifted toward Death: faces gone, armor gone black, wings of dark energy eating the light. That change and that sharing are War's acts. They are not a second power of the blade. The four hit Azrakar together. The Gods' hold on the space was already gone. Azrakar's void did nothing there. Vhalor's shadows did nothing there. Death paralyzed him with miasma. Pestilence weakened him. Famine took his arms and legs. War cut off his head and pierced his heart. Then all four raised their hands and erased him. At that death he is God of the Void Between Galaxies.[1247]
The other great factions were already watching, and they began to move. <Darkness> was displeased. The order to take War alive did not survive Azrakar. The new order was to bring the Horsemen in, all of them, alive or dead. One of the Seven Black Thrones answered, "Yes, Great Darkness," and summoned the remaining Chief Gods. That throne is not named. It is not [[Vaelthar]]'s entrance.[1247]
War did not give the three who were left the time to form a line. Vhalor tried to scatter and was forced back into one body. Gol-goroth broke the shadow structure he raised and opened his shoulder. His realm no longer touched the knights. Kaelith could not keep her illusions rebuilt, and the wounds stopped closing. Nerath could barely stay on her feet. What kept the kills from sticking was not a technique she finished alone. <Darkness> told her that her duty was not yet done, pushed more power into her than she could hold, and the darkness that came out of her when she screamed drove War back. The Horsemen still set the execution. Death could already feel something else coming. Pressure hit the domain. Gol-goroth held the first wave. The second started to break the barrier. War dropped the stroke.[1248]
A gap opened. Vaelthar came through it at the head of the reinforcement. Kaelith, broken, greeted him as "Great Origin, Vaelthar." He is the Throne of Origin, one of the Seven Black Thrones, not a Chief God. What stood with the wounded three was counted as ten. Nine of them were galactic-level threats. He was the one true God at Throne level in that count. The nine are not named, and the count is not a list of which Chief God seats were still empty. His presence alone strained the domain. War judged him stronger, saw no way out and a ring of fresh enemies, and shut the domain down himself. Vaelthar put Kaelith, Nerath and Vhalor back with a beam of pure darkness and told them they had disappointed the Great Darkness. They bowed and accepted whatever punishment followed.[1248][1249]
Justice and [[Elarion]] were not part of that reinforcement. Justice came from the Emperor faction: faceless, suited, sharp-toothed, with a Throne-level presence. Elarion, God of Goodness, followed in golden armor from the Empire of Light. Each said his own patron wanted War. The <Beginning> that flared was Vaelthar's. Victor saw it, and he saw that it was corrupted. It is kin to the Emperor's divinity. It is not a clean copy of that power, and Vaelthar does not spend it as a blow. War refused to be handed to any of them. Victor's answer was "Well said, my herald." He appeared as a giant dragon holding the whole galaxy. Light, Darkness and the Emperor-aligned patron turned toward him. Darkness was overjoyed. He had found Negativity.[1249]
Victor praised War, judged the Gods in front of him a disappointment, and killed the restored Kaelith by striking her Soul. The body was erased. He held the Soul. Only the patrons saw how it was done. Nerath and Vhalor were not given that death. Victor then said the name Vharzath and declared his extinction. The planets were already being hit from every side. Vharzath could sense twenty or more elite fighters, all women, each at a Throne's level or stronger, and the isolation Victor had already laid down stopped any rescue and any recall. Vaelthar ordered the attack anyway. He put Victor at the level of the four faction leaders and put their chance of surviving him under one percent.[1249]
The Gods answered that order on the spot. They buried the position under attacks that could destroy stars. Beams crossed the void, and dimensional spears closed in from every side. Victor did not raise the sword. When the light died he was still standing, and he asked if that was all. One God, unnamed, gathered his divinity, vanished into a spatial distortion, and came back at the Emperor's neck with a sword that could cut barriers spanning dimensions. Victor caught the blade between two fingers. The extra Energy the God tried to force through it did nothing. Victor called the fight a child's, took him by the face, and threw him through the wreckage of planets. He had not drawn the sword, and he had not moved his feet to do it.[1250]
Vaelthar watched that and understood the scale was worse than the one percent. Black energy wrapped his four arms and built structures across the field. At his command the space around Victor was laid with countless restraints, and the other Gods joined their divinities to pin him. Vaelthar put a focused blow into the chest. The shock ran through the surrounding space. The projection did not take one step. Victor caught the wrist, pulled him in, and drove a knee into the stomach. The defense broke. Victor threw him into the Gods rushing up behind and brought several of them down with that one impact. Only then did [[Junketsu]] come out.[1250]
The lesson he gave them was a plain horizontal cut, no refined technique. It sliced what stood in front of it in two: Gods, planets, and stars. Nerath looked at her allies in that state, and at the Throne missing an arm, and understood they could not win. Her judgment was that only the Great Darkness could keep up with him. They were alive because they were being spared. Vaelthar's answer was "Stand firm!" His power flooded their bodies. The wounds closed in seconds, the lost arm with them. Victor let it happen. He was waiting for the ruler. These were not the fight he had come for.[1250]
They attacked again without changing anything. Beams strong enough to destroy solar systems were gathered into one sphere in Victor's hand and crushed. He called them worms standing at the head of the Great Factions and told them to show their power. The pressure of his aura swept them off their abilities. He did not chase.[1250]
Vaelthar came back and ordered the remaining Gods to focus their divinity on Victor while he wrapped the region in his domain. Space darkened. Black constructs closed like a prison, and he held it by burning immense energy so no one could flee. The others fired into the center. The prison hid him, and then it cracked. He walked out. The attacks near him faded, and the structure fell apart. Three Gods tried to stop that walk. One threw a wave of energy into his back. Another tried to pierce him with a dimensional weapon. A third summoned a chain meant to bind his Soul. All three struck, and all three dissolved. He did not dodge. The God who then tried to flee was taken by the throat and crushed into particles. That God is unnamed. He is not given a seat.[1250]
The rest dropped any coordination and spent what they had left. Vaelthar used the noise to come at the projection from behind. One cut from Junketsu broke the front. He met the sword with all four arms. The block failed, and the next blow hit his chest. The armor tore. Violet lines flickered under the skin. The structures behind his shoulders lost their shape. He still called the survivors for a last attack and raised another barrier. One stroke shattered it. A second hit him before he could raise it again. He counterattacked, was seized, and was thrown against space hard enough to open a rift. A foot came down on his chest. The sword stopped at his head. The survivors stayed where they were.[1250]
The only mark on him was a crack in the gauntlet, small enough that he had to look for it. He told them the whole assault had been spent on a projection. The true body was the dragon, still holding the galaxy, and it had hardly moved. Kaelith is not in this fight. She is already dead. Vhalor is not named in it. Nerath is, and only as the one who sees the cut and makes that judgment. The dimensional spears, the dimension-cutting sword, the later dimensional weapon, and the Soul chain are not pinned to a named God.[1250]
Victor then looked at the two envoys, both of them in a cold sweat, and asked Justice whether the famous factions of the upper sectors were children with too much power or simply weak. Justice said this faction was among the weakest and the most isolated. Victor's answer was that soon it would no longer exist, and that he would do Justice the favor. Vharzath still did not come. Victor had appeared for two reasons: to help his herald, and to draw the leader out of his own territory so the army could destroy it while he dealt with that leader. The refusal was the result he could use. They would not have lasted eons if they were fools.[1250]
He ordered the living taken prisoner and the remains of the fallen collected. Elarion was told to inform his own leader that a visit was coming, because that leader had something of Victor's. Elarion frowned, nodded, and answered that he understood. Victor called him a dog. The projection vanished with War and the fallen Gods. The dragon let the galaxy go and drifted between the galaxies. Gol-goroth is still with the Herald who leaves. Nothing in the fight says the sword was broken or taken. Elarion's last thought, watching them go, was that this man would tear the balance of power off its hinges.[1250]

##### The Supergalaxy and the War on Darkness
Chapters 1198–1207
The invasion did not wait on [[Vharzath]]. Fleets moved on the systems that carried Black Eclipse's transit and supply. John scouted the border. Kaleb hit military stations. Conan held what was taken. Kiana and Caelus moved reinforcements between fronts. The first real fight was a transit system ringed by platforms. Imperial ships held outside the main guns, smaller detachments pulled the defenders apart, and the enemy withdrew before the ring closed. The Empire kept the route. A supply station in a neighboring system was the next target. Protocol on that front was blunt: a world that fought was destroyed, and a world that did not was taken so the Empire could learn how to rule a people that had lived under another faction. John, commanding the Spartans, the First Legion, won the field that had no super-elites on it.[1251]
The main front was not his. [[Scathach Elderblood Scarlett]] stood over five meters in armor as supreme commander. Only the First and Second Legions were committed. Those two alone held more than a trillion soldiers: clones, citizens, machines, Noble Vampires, [[Werewolves]] and the rest. The other Legions stayed home against a raid from another faction. Scanners then showed the enemy's principal galaxy as a starless dark. [[Scathach]] read it as a body. That galaxy was Vharzath, the Great Darkness. She turned the fleet around. Only Victor could enter a leader's body and live. She said the same of the planet inside Victor's Soul: an invader there found death, and Vharzath's galaxy was the same kind of place. Jeanne had not recovered a universal scale. Azathoth might have matched him. The rest would not try.[1251]
In the family mind-space she set the principal objective aside and kept the secondary one. [[Violet Elderblood Snow]] was already losing clean lines of possibility. Scathach told her not to read a future with that many variables. [[Anna Elderblood]], high in the Concept of Truth even in the Upper Sector, could feel thousands of new beings who shared that Concept. Ruby measured the enemy galaxies at up to ten thousand times the Milky Way and still not the largest her scanners would find. Size was not the same as strength. A realm stretched that far was a realm that could be cut. Scathach meant to take galaxies on the way back and hunt a Throne. Conquered worlds that had not yet proved loyal went to the Fourth Legion as test ground.[1251]
[[Sasha Elderblood Fulger]] held the Empire with the Imperial Guard. The other factions had not moved. Scathach said they would. [[Persephone Elderblood]] reported the death system already working: the fallen would be reborn as citizens, and clones would return in new bodies. [[Kaguya Elderblood Blank]] had unknown persons inside Imperial territory. Victor had not turned on the Eldritch defense. He wanted to see how the Empire answered a war without it. Velnorah called the intruders scouts. The usual offer, in her experience, was submission or death. The count of power was the other way around from the count of bodies. The Empire had more than forty beings who could threaten a galaxy. Black Eclipse had seven true Thrones at that level, and ten Chief Gods pushed up to it by their leader's blessing. Black Eclipse still outnumbered the Empire about three to one in lower ranks. Scathach's answer was machines for the low ranks and clones for the middle. Leviathans, Dragons and the rest of Victor's living weapons had not been sent.[1251]
Victor, still present in the Upper Sector while his body sat in his office, drew the same conclusion from the other side. His worlds were scattered. Each of the four great factions kept a principal galaxy as body or realm. Vharzath had made his into his own body. <Light>, <Emperor> and <Law> had soaked a galaxy in their power instead. Inside such a domain the ruler was effectively omniscient unless another being of the same level interfered. A scattered territory could not be held that way. He stopped the expansion. Elites, not more foot soldiers, would decide a war of Gods. Without the Imperial family, the beings who could threaten a galaxy could be counted on one hand, and most of those were his own creations or his daughters'. He would not spend wives as infantry. The plan was one supergalaxy: six regions along the arms, an Imperial Core at the center, each region a supermetropolis of trillions, teleportation already instant, resources created rather than mined. He was not making a galaxy from nothing. He was reshaping what he already ruled. Creating was the hard act. Shaping was easier. Destruction was cheap.[1252]
In Velion, the Realm of Light, Aurethys Vaelthion watched. He was a Primordial God of Light and the Chosen of Positivity: a body of light, golden hair of light, seated in a sacred palace. Positivity stood with him as a being of pure Energy. The old Primordial had been split. Positivity inherited knowledge and reason. Negativity inherited instinct. Positivity had stayed the more awake of the two. Aurethys had been taught the use of attributeless Energy by that half. He watched Victor, less than thirty minutes into the Upper Sector, already folding his territory into a supergalaxy, and he recognized the same Energy. Positivity refused to believe it could be learned. Aurethys concluded Victor had learned it alone. They did not move. <Darkness> and <Emperor> would test him. Light would watch, and take notes, before anyone reached for the Throne of Reality.[1252]
Victor did the work in Dragon form, larger than the galaxies he was joining. Attributeless Energy, the medium Creation had been made from, took the scattered regions and set them where the sketch had put them. When it was done he wrapped the whole supergalaxy in his Energy. Enemy sight stopped at the outside of it. Inside it he knew every corner when he chose to look. A feminine projection of pure red Energy appeared and marked the work as a first attempt, precise enough to use and not yet precise enough to keep. The wives recognized her as Negativity. She said the two Chosen standing near each other had woken more of her. She was instinct, not a teacher. She told him to keep trusting what he already followed, then went back into him as red Energy. He hated the riddle. The one hard fact he kept was that the key sat with Positivity.[1253]
The household then rebuilt the administration around the new shape. Violet set the regions and the chain of command. Sasha rechecked which arms held industry and which held raw material. Scathach ran the war from inside the supergalaxy and left the front to John. Ruby and Velnorah retuned the network. Mars, laid through the territory like a web, made that retuning fast.[1253]
John's next operation was the outer territory of Darkness: a near-circle of influence at the center of a galaxy, with the surrounding galaxies only as extensions. He did not hit one sector. He hit many at once, so the defenders could not mass. Hours of fighting broke a concentrated enemy fleet. Border systems, supply centers and command posts fell. Garrisons stayed. The fleets did not stop to celebrate each world. By the end of that phase a strip of occupied space ran deep into the border. Elites on both sides were still held back. Victor had let the count of more than forty super-elites be known on purpose. The display was deterrence. He did not want every Upper-Sector power to turn on the Empire at once and force the war onto his own ground.[1254]
Vharzath answered the loss of [[Azrakar]] by making another. He poured Darkness into a servant and raised a new God of the Void under the same name, galactic in threat and not yet the equal of the one who had died. [[Xytherion]], Throne of the End, entered in black armor with red accents, more a medieval knight than an alien shape, and confirmed the rite. The Chief Gods could be replaced. [[Vaelthar]] could not. He had been built as a candidate Chosen of Negativity, given a portion of Vharzath's power and a Begin that Darkness had stained, and he had not been chosen. Sending him out was the loss Vharzath regretted. He contacted <Emperor>, who appeared as a gigantic skull of pure fire, and offered twenty percent of the spoils if the Emperor faction would pull Victor's attention aside. Kaiser called the price too low to make an enemy of Negativity's Chosen. The later order shows the bargain was taken in a narrower form: the Emperor would hit Imperial forces, and he would not send elites into Victor's galaxy.[1254][1255]
Darkness then spent a weapon. In a conquered system the star darkened, space tore, and a shapeless black mass stepped out. Plates of armor and warped metal slid over moving tissue. Limbs changed number. Slits opened on filaments and irregular teeth. It drank the matter of the system, the fleets, and the soldiers. Their Souls stuck inside it. [[Abhoth]]'s protection held the Souls from being consumed and still could not send them home. That failure pulled Victor's attention at once. The first code was V-05, a threat to several Solar Systems. John raised it to V-06, a galactic threat, and ordered every Imperial ship out. No one was to feed it more biomass.[1256]
Velnorah, [[Hela Elderblood]] and [[Rose Adrasteia Elderblood]] arrived in ships the size of John's. Rose took command of the Spartans. Hela grew a cannon from the bow of her ship, loaded it with END at the measure Velnorah had set, and erased a hole through the creature. Rose became a True Dragon. Six Valkyries, not yet [[True Dragons]], tore the body apart with her. Dragon plasma went into the wound. Rose pulled the soldiers' Souls out, and [[Persephone]] took them. Velnorah boxed what remained in a square dimension. [[Fenrir]] and [[Jormungandr]] helped Hela load the cannon again, and the beam erased the dimension and the weapon together. A region of that galaxy was simply gone. A Emperor force that had been arming in the confusion withdrew. Rose kept samples for Velnorah. John was told to keep the Spartans clear of the erased region until it recovered.[1256]
Smaller powers read the same war as a reason to pick a patron. The [[Varkhess League]], near an Imperial border, took three newly incorporated worlds for their ore and industry while the Empire was busy driving Darkness off. An expedition took the worlds back. Two days later Conan led elites who could erase Solar Systems and finished the League's home system in under thirty minutes. The financier was a God named [[Auralion]], a chief god of the faction the System listed as <Emperor>. The Empire still had no personal name for that leader. His ten chief gods were public because their work was tied to a preached justice. Kaleb treated the word as a costume. The League had known the ten names and nothing else worth keeping.[1257]
Victor had allowed part of the probing on purpose. Ships were hit. Some conquered worlds were allowed to suffer. Worlds Velnorah and Ruby were using for experiments were not. He already knew the shape of it from Earth's history, only larger: the four powers would not let a fifth stand, the smaller powers were all tied to one of the four, and <Law> moved only as the Primordial of Balance allowed. Allies were possible later, after one of the four was gone. He did not want hesitant allies. Violet gave the order he asked for. The Fourth Legion, under Ruby or Velnorah, stayed on technology. The Fifth, the Imperial Guard under [[Nero]] or Ophis, stayed on the family. The Seventh, the executioners, stayed under Victor alone. Every other Legion was free. He wanted Darkness's territories destroyed or taken inside a week. Scathach split them: the First kept its offensive, the Second and the Third each took a galaxy, one on defenses and one on communications. Within days the initiative was the Empire's. Vharzath sent two Thrones out with orders to put their own survival first, and he told the Emperor to keep the bargain: hit the forces, stay out of the galaxy, and only enter it together after enough elites were gone.[1255]
The prisoners were already in the deepest part of Hell, a room made so Lily could work. Vaelthar, called there the Original Throne, and nine Chief Gods had been reduced to pieces of her collection. She told Violet the ten offices were not won. The leader bestowed them. The titles were Azrakar, [[Kaelith]], [[Nerath]], [[Vhalor]], [[Khariel]], [[Morvane]], [[Azelith]], [[Nihrael]], [[Draveth]] and [[Vaelzara]], set over emptiness, night, silence, shadow, soul, fear, darkness, oblivion and inevitability. A predecessor could be replaced by a blessed elite who would need years before the power was actually his. The Thrones were the real elites. Vaelthar looked to her like a failed attempt at a Chosen of Negativity: begun in light and then ruined by Darkness. Victor had both poles because he had grown into them. Vaelthar had been forced.[1258]
Soul and mind protections, of the same family as Victor's own, had wiped the deeper military secrets the moment Lily reached for them. The rest remained, because the room's Runes kept Darkness from seeing in. Done in open space, the protection would have burned the servant's Soul. The prisoners were left as empty shells. Lily had already given Ruby the samples. Violet ordered the bodies destroyed in Dragon fire. She took a sphere of condensed memory, had Natalia raise a time bubble, and built a profile of Darkness the way she would read a character, as a reference and not as a substitute for Victor's warning against over-reading the future. Akasha pushed the usable part to the high command at once. Six Thrones were still free.[1258]
Xytherion was Throne of the End, right hand and deputy, the nearest counterpart to Scathach and Violet. [[Aetherys]] was Throne of Time and set the time-shift in conquered galaxies. [[Oryndal]] was Throne of Space and bridged those galaxies with him. [[Elyndra]] was Throne of Reality. [[Nharzuel]] was Throne of Existence. [[Zhaeroth]] was Throne of [[Chaos]], the one the captives knew least, treated on their side as leader of everything under Darkness. Ruby and Velnorah read the set as an attempt at a private cosmos: Begin already accounted for by Vaelthar's office, and the Thrones covering nearly every function a stable universe needed. Life, Death and Infinity were the gaps Jeanne named. The wives did not agree that a new universe had to obey the old list. Kaguya brought it back to the order they already had. Violet's reading of the memories was a cautious, arrogant commander who would not sit still while the losses continued. Kali and Haruna left to meet the stronger Gods. Scathach stayed, and hated staying.[1258]
The counteroffensive came as a reinforcement fleet: cruisers, battleships, carriers and interceptors crossing intergalactic space. Two Thrones walked ahead of it and did not bother with the ships. Aetherys was a segmented body of crystalline dark armor and golden lines, a head of concentric rings around a golden core, small spheres aging and restoring themselves as he moved. Dust near him stopped, went on, and sometimes returned. Sensors could not agree where he was. Oryndal was black plates around a core, long extensions, and blue-violet rings mapped like galaxies. He did not cross distance. He made the destination adjacent. Kali met them as a high Goddess of Destruction, one step short of a Primordial by the rank Oryndal felt. Haruna refused to show the fox form. That shape was for Victor. She kicked Aetherys in the face before he could move. Kali's presence alone stopped Oryndal. They gave their names so the Thrones would look only at them. Aetherys called Victor a fool and wrapped a Solar System in Time. Both wives dropped the restraint. Haruna drew Ikari, the violet katana Victor had given her, Draconic and Eldritch script on the blade. The name meant wrath and anchor. Drawing it proved she had reached the master level of her art. Kali covered arms, legs and then her whole body in controlled Destruction and went to her strongest form at once.[1259][1260]
Haruna crossed the temporal gap and broke the rings with Ikari. Aetherys tried to make the blow occupy a time in which it never landed. She was already on the next cut and opened the golden core. Oryndal opened passages for his partner and threw Kali out of the space between them. She ate the passages with Destruction and cracked his plates. He tried to move his core into another dimension. She broke a main ring and the transfer failed. Aetherys then split the region into overlapping sequences so that many Harunas seemed to strike from different times. She ignored the copies and cut the structure that bound them. Oryndal's attempt to take her from behind lost the extensions when Kali collapsed the passage. A joint domain, Time and Space together, held the two wives apart for a few moments. Haruna cut a path through it. Kali hit Oryndal. Haruna hit the damaged core. The synchronization died. Kali's fist, packed with Destruction, went through a layered dimensional barrier into Oryndal's core. Ikari broke the last temporal barrier on Aetherys. Kali blocked his retreat by presence alone. Haruna struck him into Oryndal. The Darkness fleets used the wreck to leave. Scathach watched and was satisfied: the Thrones had power and almost no martial foundation, and wives who had both did not need to trade beams with them.[1260]
Three more galactic presences then approached the Legions outside that galaxy. They did not get a look at the field. Scathach was already there, a pillar of red Dragon power heavy enough to pull neighboring galaxies, a rune-marked spear in her hand. She named herself and called the three-to-one fair. They claimed they had come to watch. She did not believe it. [[Laelzorith]] carried Law for his Emperor and fought with a spear. [[Seraphel]] carried Truth and fought with two swords. [[Dravakar]] carried Retribution and fought with a scythe. She felt three Grandmasters and treated it as a prize. Victor sent Kaguya Elderblood Blank with Nyx Elderblood, ordered to step in only if they had to. He would deal with Scathach's anger afterward. Her safety outranked her pride.[1260]

#### Users
Victor Elderblood
...What an enigmatic creature, Infinity commented.While it is something akin to a Cosmic Horror that will drive Everyone who sees it to madness, it is a majestic Dragon that represents Existence and Life." Seeing this duality of Balance in a single Being was simply uncomfortable.We need to do something… his Existence is clearly breaking The Balance. He has become something worse than [[Diablo]]!" [[The Judges of The Abyss]] spoke....Wrong, his Existence does not break The Balance. Take a closer look. When The Judges of The Abyss looked more closely with their Powers at Victor, they saw Existence being Balanced by force. Instead of being someone who shattered The Balance, as was Diablo's aim, Victor was a Being who aided The Balance itself.…This… What is this? What is this chaotic existence?" The Judges of The Abyss were genuinely confused and didn't know how to proceed.This Duality of Order and [[Chaos]] was crazy. At the same time that its Existence caused unborn Chaos, it simultaneously generated Order and Balance in everything around it.He has become a fundamental Pillar of The Balance. The Owner of Limbo spoke.
—[[Regulators of Existence]] discussing Victor Elderblood, Chapter 884
Victor Elderblood's Divine Concepts are the collective conceptual Authorities he holds as a God and Blood Dragon Primogenitor. His native Divine portfolio began with simultaneous awakening of numerous Divinities, then grew through comprehension, Faith and absorption of other Gods.[1][2] The later Imperial portfolio became so extensive that Victor reported possessing most known Divinities.[3] His foreign Eldritch Chaos system is distinct: in this system Victor can act as the metaphysical source of the Concepts developed by compatible Eldritch descendants.[4] In the late Imperial era, he also studied the use of higher Concepts to anchor Reality through existential weight and obtain the conceptual keys needed to construct autonomous cosmic Laws.[5][6] The foreign branch has a Great Old One hierarchy.[7] He extracts a foreign Divine fragment from a Soul and seals it.[8]
These systems overlap, but they should not be treated as interchangeable. An umbrella Concept does not automatically count as every one of its subordinate Divinities separately awakened within Victor.[9] Manipulating a Soul through Negativity does not turn Victor into the native Primordial administrator of Souls.[10][11] Likewise, providing the conceptual source of [[Nero Elderblood]]'s Apocalypse and [[Ophis Tepes Elderblood]]'s Infinity does not transfer ownership of their personal Divinities to Victor.[4] [[Akasha Elderblood]]'s Control / Loss of Control remains her own foreign Domain.[12]
Victor's portfolio eventually became too large for a complete individual catalogue. [[Shiva]] perceived more than one thousand Divine presences inside Victor.[13] Victor later explained that consuming numerous Gods had left him with most of the known Divinities.[3] Only a fraction of these Authorities have been named individually, so unidentified absorbed Concepts must not be converted into a fictional exhaustive list.

#### Conceptual Framework
Main article: Divinity
A Divinity is not simply an elemental ability with a more powerful name. It establishes a Divine Being's connection to a Concept and to the Laws governing that Concept, while practical Authority develops through the wielder's understanding of what the Concept represents, the Laws operating through it and the ways those Laws interact with Creation. Victor is an extreme case because several fundamentally different forms of conceptual power coexist within the same existence.[9]
Category
Source
Relationship to Victor
Native Divinity
Native conceptual structure of Creation
Concepts Victor awakened or subsequently developed as a God, such as War, Blood, Destruction, Family and Yandere.[1]
Greater / Umbrella Concept
High-order conceptual families
Concepts such as Negativity and BEGIN encompass numerous lesser Divinities, Laws and phenomena rather than one narrow function.[14][9]
Faith-Developed Divinity
Faith, worship and Divine identity
Repeatedly being worshipped under a compatible identity can contribute toward the formation or strengthening of an actual Divinity.[15][3]
Absorbed Divinity
Gods consumed by Victor
Victor can preserve Divine Concepts belonging to Gods he permanently consumes instead of allowing those Concepts to return normally to their higher source.[16][17]
System-Recognized Concept
The System
The System can recognize a sufficiently unique metaphysical function and establish an appropriate Concept, as occurred with He Who Creates Monsters.[18]
Eldritch Concept / Domain
Victor's foreign Nightmare/Eldritch existence
Conceptual powers developed outside the ordinary native Divine architecture and therefore not bound to the same source in the same manner.[4][12]
Eldritch Conceptual Source
Victor himself
Victor can function as the metaphysical source sustaining Concepts developed by other Eldritch Gods descended from or transformed through him.[4][19]

##### Concept, Authority and Comprehension
The name of a Concept should not be interpreted as unrestricted omnipotence over everything that can linguistically be associated with that word. Divine Authority depends upon the Concept's actual Laws, the wielder's compatibility with them, comprehension, experience, hierarchy and the amount and quality of power available to enforce those Laws.[9]
Destruction provides one of the clearest examples. Victor was already capable of extraordinarily destructive feats when he awakened the Divinity, but his conceptual understanding of Destruction itself was initially poor. As a result, the Divinity progressed slowly despite Victor being perfectly capable of destroying things physically. To master the Concept, he had to understand Destruction as a Law rather than merely become better at producing explosions or overwhelming opponents with force.[9]
The same distinction applies to broad Concepts. A God specializing in a subordinate Concept can temporarily possess more practical expertise over that particular branch than Victor even when Victor holds a conceptually superior umbrella Authority. [[Kali Elderblood]]'s mastery over Destruction initially far exceeded Victor's understanding of Negativity despite Destruction being powered through the Negative side.[20]

##### The Universal Conceptual Field
Divine Concepts are native metaphysical possibilities sustained by the Universe itself rather than powers that must be invented anew every time a God awakens. Many Concepts exist without any known active wielder, while the number of possible Divine identities is broad enough to include extremely specialized ideas alongside primary principles such as Life, Death, Time, Space and Nature.[21]
Victor considers the conceptual field so broad that virtually any meaningful adjective or defining quality may have the potential to exist as a Divine Concept, using his own Yandere Divinity and the unusually specialized Gods of the [[Shinto Pantheon]] as examples. This is Victor's inference rather than an exhaustive law, while the existence of narrow and previously unused Concepts is directly established.[21]
Every native Divine Concept also contains both Positivity and Negativity because the two forces are the divided foundation of the native Creator. Ordinary existence is described as containing both halves, while spiritual, emotional and non-physical Concepts can lean more strongly toward Negativity and physical or concrete Concepts can lean more strongly toward Positivity; even foundational Divinities such as Death, Destruction, Time and Space still contain both polarities.[22][23]
✦Native conceptual fieldPrimordial [[Chaos]] → Positivity / Negativity → fundamental Primordial functions and Divine Concepts → individual Gods and specialized interpretations. A Concept may exist without a current wielder, while the God determines how that Concept is expressed through personal understanding and Authority.

##### Conceptual Influence Across Sectors
A Divine Concept does not become a different Concept when its wielder moves between Sectors. A God of Destruction remains connected to Destruction, but their relative influence can fall sharply when they enter a larger Sector containing many stronger representatives of the same Concept.[23]
Low- and Middle-Sector Gods can therefore appear overwhelmingly dominant when few competitors share their Concept, while Higher Sectors can contain hundreds of Gods participating in the same conceptual struggle. Victor compares this to a Universe-spanning tug-of-war in which strength, understanding and development determine how much influence each participant actually commands.[23]
Victor and the strongest members of his family are treated as anomalies within this system because their personal development is already high enough that moving upward through ordinary Sectors does not automatically dislodge them from the top of their respective conceptual fields.[23]

##### Divinity, Embodiment and Primordial Office
Mastering a normal Divinity does not automatically make Victor the Primordial Entity of that Concept. A God ordinarily accesses, represents and comprehends a Concept through Divinity, while a genuine Primordial-level existence can progress toward becoming the Concept itself and integrating that function into Creation.[9][24]
Even personifying a Concept is not automatically identical to occupying its complete cosmic office. Conceptual embodiment and universal administration are separate stages: a candidate can possess the correct conceptual nature while still requiring compatibility with the existing cosmological structure and recognition before inheriting the corresponding Primordial function.[6]
This distinction is especially important when discussing Victor. His development increasingly approaches Primordial-level embodiment through Negativity, but his path is not identical to the conventional native route. The ordinary native process involves progressively becoming one with the Concept and with the Universe itself, while Victor explicitly rejects becoming merely another component contained by the native Cosmos.[24]
The relationship can be represented as:
✦Divinity and embodimentConnection → understanding → Law mastery → possible embodiment → cosmic integration and recognition. Complete Divine mastery alone does not grant a Primordial office.
The final transition is not a simple percentage threshold. Native Primordials function as interdependent components of a greater cosmic system, so becoming sufficiently similar to a Concept does not by itself prove that the Universe has accepted the new Being as that Concept's universal administrator.[6]
Victor later discovered a second route unavailable to ordinary native Gods. By combining mastered native Divinities with his foreign Eldritch nature, he could introduce characteristics originating outside the native Cosmos into those Concepts, potentially allowing them to evolve without following the conventional route of completely merging with Creation.[2]

##### Existential Weight and Conceptual Foundations
High-order Divine Concepts can function as structural foundations rather than merely as powers used in combat.
Victor demonstrated the principle while teaching [[Norabell Elderblood]]. He created two structures: an ordinary artificial dimension and a miniature galaxy. The simple dimension borrowed the Laws of the larger Reality containing it and could therefore be altered comparatively easily by someone capable of perceiving those underlying rules. The miniature galaxy was different. Victor incorporated higher Divine Concepts—particularly Negativity and BEGIN—directly into its foundation, dramatically increasing what Norabell perceived as its existential weight.[5]
Existential weight is not simply physical mass, Energy quantity or destructive power. It describes how deeply an existence is metaphysically rooted through conceptual support. The more fundamental Concepts integrated into a structure, the more difficult it becomes for another Being to casually rewrite, seize or invalidate that structure without sufficient Authority, compatible conceptual "keys" or overwhelming power.[5][6]
Victor's lesson can be simplified as:
✦Existential weightA subordinate dimension borrows surrounding Laws. A conceptually anchored creation receives additional foundational support; Victor’s miniature galaxy remained an imitation of a self-sustaining Cosmos.
Victor's miniature galaxy was not yet a complete independent Universe. It possessed matter, cosmic structures, Eldritch components and substantial existential weight, but still lacked the complete collection of fundamental conceptual Rules required for a truly autonomous Reality; reproducing cosmic matter is therefore not the same as reproducing the metaphysical architecture that allows a Cosmos to sustain itself.[6]
This establishes a hierarchy of creation:
Physical construction → matter, Energy, stars, planets or dimensions created inside an existing Reality.
Conceptually anchored construction → a structure reinforced by higher Divine Concepts and possessing much greater existential weight.
Independent cosmic Reality → a structure possessing sufficient fundamental conceptual Rules to operate as a genuinely autonomous Reality rather than borrowing the deeper Laws of another Universe.[5][6]

##### Conceptual Keys and Authority
Possessing enormous Energy does not automatically grant permission to manipulate every layer of Reality. Fundamental Concepts function like keys that grant access to particular portions of cosmic architecture, so a Being can understand a structure while still lacking the Authority necessary to alter it normally.[6]
This helps explain why Primordial-level functions cannot be reproduced simply by accumulating more raw power. The limitation can be one of metaphysical access and Authority rather than Energy supply.
Victor demonstrated this by constructing a miniature galaxy whose foundations included Negativity, BEGIN and Eldritch power, then explaining that it still lacked the complete set of Rules necessary to sustain an independent Universe. Matter creation, conceptual anchoring and the establishment of an autonomous cosmic framework are different achievements.[5][6]
Victor's late development increasingly revolves around obtaining and understanding these keys. Rather than merely learning how to use individual Divine abilities, he is studying how Concepts establish the operating structure of Reality itself—how they anchor existence, how their Authority is recognized, and how multiple fundamental Laws combine to produce a stable Cosmos.[5][6]

#### Development of Victor's Divinity

##### Early Divine Potential
Signs of Victor's future Divinity appeared before genuine Godhood: a minute Divine spark developed during his early Progenitor growth.[25] Later, his Blood Dragon Primogenitor physiology, Vampiric Aspect and interaction with [[Roxanne Elderblood]] produced Pseudo-Divine effects without completing true Divine ascension.[26] He subsequently extracted Ra's Sun Divinity and used its Authority before independently awakening as a God.[27]
Victor publicly adopted the religious identity of God of Blood, War, Fear, Despair, Murder, Strength, Destruction, Vampires, Vengeance, Martial Honor, Family, [[Rex Invictus|Home]], Nature and Beauty before attaining Godhood.[28] These were then titles of worship, not proof that every corresponding Divine Concept had already awakened. Later religious Faith could contribute to the strengthening or awakening of compatible Divinities.[15] Victor subsequently confirmed which Concepts he actually possessed in his enlarged portfolio.[3]
Victor also received borrowed Divine Blessings before his own ascension. [[Aphrodite]]'s [[Soul Marriage]] established a Divine bond.[29][30] She bestowed blessings associated with Love, Sexuality, the continuation of Life, Pleasure, Joy and her lesser War Authority.[31] The original Goddess, rather than Victor's personal Divinity, remained the source of those blessings.

##### Divine Ascension
Victor achieved true Godhood during the battle against the Elder Gods at the [[Edge of the Cosmos]]. His transition was profoundly abnormal because he did not awaken a single narrow Divinity. The enormous collection of experiences, identities, races, Bloodlines and supernatural systems accumulated within him produced a multitude of Concepts simultaneously.[32][1]
The principal high-order Divinities confirmed around his ascension were:
- War[32][1]
- Destruction[32][1]
- Negativity[32][1]
- BEGIN / Beginnings[32][1]
- Blood[32][1]
The narrower Divinities directly named during the same ascension sequence were:
- Murder[1]
- Strength[1]
- Beauty[1]
- Revenge[1]
- Martial Honor[1]
- [[Rex Invictus|Home]][1]
- Family[1]
- Nature[1]
- Yandere[1]
One count of the awakening gives fifteen Divinities. Another gives fourteen, and fourteen are named. The fifteenth is not named.[33][14]
Murder and Assassination are related but separate Divinities. Murder is named during Victor's original ascension.[1] Assassination appears in his later list of fully developed personal Concepts.[2] Victor explicitly names both separately when describing his Divinities to his friends.[3]

##### Post-Ascension Development
Victor's training after becoming the Dragon God of [[Chaos]] demonstrated how dramatically different Conceptual development could be from ordinary Energy growth. His broadest Concepts advanced slowly because even a small percentage represented comprehension of enormous numbers of interconnected Laws, while Concepts intimately connected to his personality and existence advanced far faster.[9]
After approximately two thousand subjective years of accelerated training and experimentation, Victor's principal tracked portfolio contained seventeen Divinities. Fifteen had reached complete mastery, while the vastly broader BEGIN and Negativity remained incomplete.[2]

##### Later Expansion
Victor's portfolio continued expanding through several mechanisms at once: absorption of defeated Gods, increasingly massive quantities of Faith, development of latent Concepts, System-recognized functions and the growth of his Eldritch nature. By the Imperial era, even Gods examining him could no longer catalogue every connection individually; [[Shiva]] detected more than one thousand Divine presences, while Victor stated that the enormous number of Gods he had absorbed had left him with most known Divinities.[13][3]
[[Nigredo Elderblood]] inherited a Concept of Darkness from Victor, confirming Darkness as part of his conceptual inheritance. Nigredo's own version developed into a specialized Eldritch/Primal Darkness associated with a black hole and the convergence of Being and Non-Being, so her personal manifestation is not automatically identical to Victor's own Darkness Authority.[34]
