#### Major Conceptual Authorities
−
GREATER CONCEPT
Representative of the Negative side of native Creation

##### Negativity
Negativity is the spiritual half of native Creation, and one of Victor's two Greater Concepts. He awakened it at his ascension and became the only God who represents it. The collective consciousness of everything Negative in the Universe chose him. He was later chosen again, by the [[Will Solace|Will]] of the Primordial source, as its representative and successor, and he carries the Negative half of Rank 0.[1][35][22]
It is not a moral label and it is not "evil". Positivity and Negativity are the divided halves of the native Creator. Everything that exists, from a grain of dust to a galaxy, is half one and half the other. Spiritual, emotional and non-physical Concepts lean harder toward Negativity, about seventy percent. Physical Concepts lean about seventy percent toward Positivity. Death, Destruction, Time and Space still contain both.[22][23] Negativity embodies everything spiritual. Hatred, Fear, and the other emotional deities are the Concepts in which that Energy is strongest. Positivity embodies everything material. Together they are the being from which the Universe came.[39]
Any Concept related to Negativity is under his influence. That is authority over Concepts, not a second store of fighting power. Take it away and the Blood Dragon, the martial skill and the Eldritch nature remain.[22][23] The representative of the Negative aspect can control all the deities that energize that side.[40] His Negativity, and the thousands of other Divinities it controls, answer together. Most of those thousands are not given names. Where a Concept sits on this side, it is highly possible for him to use it, because it falls directly under Negativity, even when he has never opened it as its own Divinity and never used it in a fight.[41][40]
On the negative side the order of importance is Negativity, then END, then Destruction. On the positive side it is Positivity, then BEGIN, then Creation. Divine Concepts draw their power from the two halves.[40]
✦Negative sideNegativity → END → Destruction. Under them, the emotional and spiritual Divinities. Fear, Hatred, Despair, Anger and Loneliness are the ones named. The rest of the thousands sit with them.
A subordinate Concept can exist twice at once: as a branch of the umbrella, and as its own Divinity. Fear, Despair and Destruction are both.

###### Fear
Fear is one of the emotions inside Negativity. All negative feelings are part of Negative Energy, and Fear is named in that set at the awakening. It is also its own Divinity in his later portfolio, and one of the titles he was already worshipped under before Godhood.[1][28][3]
How it is used. The feeling itself is the weapon. A full release of his negative existence hits as the pure kind of fear: numbness, insignificance, the urge to beg and be killed. That is what met [[Diablo]]. Frederick, calling him the God of Fear, drew a Negativity attack out of that name through Faith. He also groups Fear with Despair, Murder, Strength and Destruction as the set from which extremely dangerous Divine spells come.[3] Because Fear falls under Negativity, the same uses are open through the umbrella and through the separate Divinity: impose the feeling, call it through Faith, and build a spell on it.

###### Hatred
Hatred is named with Fear as a Concept powerfully represented in Negativity. Emotional deities of this kind sit in the spiritual half.[39] He has not opened a separate Hatred Divinity. It is still highly possible for him to use it, because it falls directly under Negativity, and any Concept related to Negativity is under his influence.[22]
How it is used. Hatred is the emotional Law of sustained hostility. The uses that belong to this class, and that he already performs with the feelings named beside it, are to sense it, impose it, feed on it, and turn it back on the being who carries it. [[Roxanne Elderblood]] senses negative feelings and thoughts through her Negative World Tree nature and feeds on Negativity to grow. He has reached those properties through synchronization with her, and the Concept itself already contains the feeling.[42][39]

###### Despair
Despair is named with Fear, Anger and Loneliness at the awakening, and it is later its own Divinity.[1][3] Lilith wields Despair as a Divinity together with Rottenness, Corruption and Beginning. His own Despair sits in the same spell-set as Fear.
How it is used. Despair is the collapse that follows Fear, the point at which a being stops believing it can answer what it is looking at. Imposed, it takes the fight out of the target before the body is broken. As a spell-component it sits with Fear, Murder, Strength and Destruction. As a branch of the umbrella it is available even apart from the separate Divinity.[1][3]

###### Anger
Anger is one of the negative feelings inside the Concept. It is an emotional Law, not a moral stain.[1]
How it is used. It is highly possible for him to use it, because it falls directly under Negativity. The use is the same shape as the other named feelings: the emotion imposed on a being, read off a being, or fed into a spell. He has not been given a separate Anger Divinity. The umbrella already holds it.

###### Loneliness
Loneliness is named in the same set. It is the spiritual condition of being cut off, not a physical element.[1]
How it is used. It is highly possible for him to use it through Negativity. The use is to impose that cut, or to read it, the way the other emotions in the set are imposed and read. No separate Loneliness Divinity is listed. The Concept already contains it.

###### Every negative feeling
Fear, Despair, Anger and Loneliness are the examples. Every negative feeling is part of Negative Energy. Emotional deities as a class are powerfully represented in Negativity, and the thousands of Divinities his Negativity controls are the unnamed remainder of that class.[1][41][39]
How they are used. A feeling that has never been given its own fight is still on this side, and the authority covers it. It is highly possible for him to use any of them, because they fall directly under Negativity. The use does not change with the name: sense the feeling, impose it, feed on it, or put it into a Divine spell. The representative of the Negative aspect controls all the deities that energize that side.[40]

###### The spiritual side
Negativity embodies everything spiritual. Souls, emotions, and the non-physical side of a being are where it is strongest.[1][39]
How it is used. He moves a Soul, reads what a Soul can become, wakes a latent Concept inside it, and repairs a Soul after something foreign is cut out of it. Evie's Soul was pushed forward through this until her Concept of Research woke and she became a Minor Goddess. Research is not a sub-Concept of Negativity. Negativity was the hand on the Soul.[10] On [[Ryujin Ikaros]] he found a fragment of Light-related Divine power wrapped around the Soul, cut it out, repaired the injury, and sealed the fragment. Nurturing a Soul is a straightforward use for the chosen representative.[8] The Judges of the Abyss keep the office that moves Souls through the [[Akashic Records]]. His work is the spiritual Energy those Souls are made of.[11][23]
Positivity and Negativity also take part in the information that gathers into the Akashic Records. He has pulled a past event back through the Negativity connection and shown it to other people. That is retrieval and projection.[35]

###### Destruction
Destruction sits under Negativity on the negative side, after END. Negativity is the Energy that drives it.[40][20] He also holds Destruction as its own Divinity. It awoke as a beginner's grasp and was later mastered with the narrow personal Concepts. The umbrella and the separate Divinity are both his.
How it is used. A God of Destruction draws on this Energy. That is why a complete hold on Negativity is what stops even [[Kali Elderblood]]'s Destruction from harming him through the same mechanism. Until that hold is complete, a specialist who has lived inside the one branch can be finer there than he is. Kali was. The source still belongs to Negativity, so interference with a subordinate Destructive Concept, and resistance to it, both come from the same place.[20] His own use of the Divinity is the dangerous Divine spell, grouped with Fear, Despair, Murder and Strength.[3]

###### END
END is the Concept placed between Negativity and Destruction on the negative side.[40] It deletes the record. Destruction erases the matter and leaves the record for Creation to use again. BEGIN is the answer to END.[43]
How it is used. Hela loads it and fires it. What the beam touches is erased, record included, and the empty region has to be repaired by the Primordials. It is highly possible for him to use it, because it sits on this side of the scale and any Concept related to Negativity is under his influence. He is not the one who has fired it.[22][40]

###### Darkness
Darkness is grouped with Fear, Despair and Destruction as a negative-side Divinity whose ordinary holder sits below the representative of the whole side.[35] He also carries Darkness as inheritance. [[Nigredo Elderblood]] took it from him and made her own specialized form. That form is hers.[34]
How it is used. The confirmed use through Negativity, rather than through a Darkness Divinity of his own, is the one against [[Erebus]]. Erebus fled into Darkness. Negative Energy dragged him back out.[44][35] Sensory deception, a darkness no light crosses, and a body turned into Darkness are Erebus's uses of the Concept. It is highly possible for Victor to use those as well, because Darkness falls on this side. Night and Concealment stay with Nyx Elderblood. They are not Darkness.

###### Kindness and the seventy percent
Kindness is not a negative feeling. It is the example given, beside Fear and Hatred, of a spiritual and non-physical Concept whose mix is about seventy percent Negativity. The same lean covers that whole non-physical class. Physical Concepts lean the other way. The lean is why his influence reaches about half of native existence, including Concepts that are not emotions and are not hostile.[23] A God of Kindness still works from the positive side of the scale. The proportion and the side are not the same fact.[40]

###### Powers and Applications
- Conceptual Negativity Manipulation: Authority over Negativity itself, not only over ordinary Negative Energy.[1][9]
- Negative Energy Manipulation: He generates, gathers, channels and directs the Energy of the Negative side.[35]
- Control of the deities that energize the Negative side: All of them. The thousands his Negativity controls are included. A branch does not have to be its own cultivated Divinity first.[40][41]
- Emotion Manipulation: Every negative feeling.[1]
- Fear Manipulation[1][3]
- Hatred Manipulation. Highly possible, because Hatred falls directly under Negativity.[39]
- Despair Manipulation[1][3]
- Anger Manipulation. Highly possible, because Anger falls directly under Negativity.[1]
- Loneliness Manipulation. Highly possible, because Loneliness falls directly under Negativity.[1]
- Spiritual Manipulation and Soul Manipulation: Influence over the spiritual side and over a Soul, without holding the Judges' office.[10]
- Soul reading and apotheosis: He can see a development a Soul has not reached yet and push it there. Evie woke Research and became a Minor Goddess.[10]
- Fragment work: He finds a foreign Divine fragment on a Soul, cuts it out, repairs the Soul, and seals the fragment powerless. The fragment's Concept does not become his.[8]
- Destruction Manipulation and, at a complete hold, Destruction Resistance: Negativity is the Energy driving Destruction. A finished hold stops even Kali's Destruction from harming him through that mechanism.[20]
- END: The Concept between Negativity and Destruction. It deletes the record. Hela fires it. The authority covers it.[40][43]
- Darkness, through Negative Energy: He pulled [[Erebus]] out of Darkness with it.[44]
- Akashic retrieval: Past events, pulled through the connection and shown to others.[35]
- False Synchronization: Eldritch Essence forced through Negativity, imitating Primordial Synchronization while his understanding is still short of the real thing.[35]
- Living Negativity: He is one step from being the Concept rather than a God who wields it.[45]
- Half of Rank 0: Influence over about half the native Universe, including the System. He does not yet administer all of existence, because he does not hold Positivity.[22]
- Collapse of the Concept and Eldritch infection of the Concept: Both threatened, neither released. Forcing Negativity to fail would damage about half the Universe and throw the other half into disorder, because Reality cannot run on Positivity alone. Flooding the same network with [[Eldritch Energy]] would carry a foreign logic through every structure the Concept touches.[22]
- Weight against a Primordial repair: Infinity had to push harder before the damage around Victor closed.[22]

###### Specialists
Breadth is his advantage. A specialist's advantage is one branch practiced for an age. Kali's Destruction was finer than his Negativity while his hold on the source was still incomplete. As the source fills in, that gap closes, because the branch draws its Energy from him.[9][20]

###### Representative
Positivity and Negativity are not obtained by ordinary practice. Their highest representatives are chosen.[35] He is that representative for the Negative side. A God who holds only Fear, or only Despair, or only Darkness, or only Destruction, holds a branch. He holds the side those branches draw from. True Synchronization would align him with the Primordial source for a time. What he has used is the imitation: Negativity plus his Eldritch Essence. Past the old three-percent mark, he is close to the point where Negativity is what he is.[2][35][45]
+
GREATER CONCEPT
Beginning, continuation and the initiation of Life

##### BEGIN / Beginnings
BEGIN, commonly called Beginnings, is one of Victor's broadest native Concepts. It awakened through his Progenitor existence as the beginning of new racial lineages.[1] The Owner of Limbo describes Victor as a God of Life and the continuation of existence through this Authority.[14] Victor later explains that BEGIN is broader than an ordinary Life or Creation Divinity because it governs initiating processes and legitimate new lineages.[9]
The authorial conceptual hierarchy places BEGIN beneath Positivity and above Creation:
✦Positive hierarchyPositivity → BEGIN → Creation, in the stated authorial hierarchy.[40]
BEGIN should not be reduced to simple Life Manipulation. Its confirmed conceptual family includes Life and continuation.[14] Later research explicitly lists Fertility, Reproduction, Sex and Love within its broader Life-related scope.[2] The System then bound He Who Creates Monsters beneath BEGIN because Victor assumed a new creative and reincarnational responsibility.[18]

###### Confirmed Scope
- Life: Victor is explicitly treated as a God of Life through BEGIN.[14][9] This does not erase the separate cosmic role of The Universal Tree or prove that Victor has replaced every specialized Life-related Primordial function.
- Beginning / Initiation: BEGIN allows Victor to conceptually initiate something rather than merely transform an already-existing object.[9]
- Continuation of Existence: The Owner of Limbo identifies Victor as a God of the Continuation of Existence through this Concept.[14]
- Fertility: Explicitly listed among the Divinities contained within BEGIN's Life-related family.[2]
- Reproduction: Explicitly contained within BEGIN because reproduction permits Life to continue through new generations.[2]
- Sex: Explicitly associated with BEGIN through its reproductive function.[2]
- Love: Explicitly identified among the Life-related Concepts falling beneath BEGIN.[2]
- Progenitors: Victor is described as the God of Progenitors through BEGIN because a Progenitor represents the beginning of a Race or Bloodline.[9]
- Vampires: Victor's Beginning Authority encompasses Vampires through his relationship as a Vampire Progenitor.[14]
- Dragons: BEGIN similarly establishes a Divine relationship with Dragons through Victor's position as the Blood Dragon Primogenitor.[14]
- Creation: Creation occupies a lower conceptual position beneath BEGIN in the stated Positive-side hierarchy.[40]
- He Who Creates Monsters: The System explicitly bound this specialized Concept beneath the Greater Concept BEGIN.[18]

###### Powers and Applications
- Beginning Manipulation: Victor can conceptually cause a new process, existence or lineage to begin when the result falls within his actual Authority and understanding.[9]
- Life Manipulation: BEGIN grants conceptual Authority associated with Life and its continuation.[14][2]
- Soul Restoration and Vitality Reinforcement (Beginning-supported): After his ascension, Victor strengthened and repaired Haruna's damaged Soul, contributing to her capacity for future Divine growth. The event demonstrates a restorative application compatible with his Life/Beginning authority, but not an unrestricted replacement for the native Soul Primordial.[33]
- Divine-Growth Preparation (Composite): Victor's intervention in Haruna's spiritual state helped her cross an earlier limitation and prepare for a later awakening; this does not mean he gave her a fully mastered Divinity immediately.[33]
- Life Creation: When combined with Creation, Progenitor Authority and sufficient Energy, BEGIN provides the higher-order authority necessary for genuinely new living Beings to begin existing.[18]
- Continuation Manipulation: Victor possesses Divine Authority connected to the perpetuation of living existence across generations.[14]
- Fertility Manipulation: Victor possesses conceptual access to fertility as a process responsible for producing new Life.[2]
- Reproduction Manipulation: Victor's Progenitor nature and BEGIN allow him to overcome the extreme reproductive difficulty normally experienced by increasingly powerful supernatural Beings.[46]
- Conception Inducement: Victor states that he can choose to impregnate a compatible partner rather than depending completely upon ordinary probability.[46]
- Offspring Number Manipulation: Victor states that he can influence how many children are produced during conception, although he generally chooses not to consciously micromanage the process.[46]
- Offspring Sex Determination (Passive / subconscious demonstration): Victor's reproductive Authority responded to his underlying [[Will Solace|Will]] strongly enough that his children were consistently female, with the effect tied to his subconscious reluctance concerning male offspring.[46] This does not prove unrestricted Gender Manipulation over unrelated existing Beings.
- Subconscious Conceptual Activation: BEGIN can respond to deeply rooted intent without Victor consciously issuing a specific Divine command.[46]
- Love Manipulation (Conceptual access): Love exists within BEGIN's confirmed conceptual family, giving Victor access to the Law without proving the same specialized mastery possessed by dedicated Love Goddesses.[2]
- Sexual Concept Manipulation (Conceptual access): Sex is explicitly contained within BEGIN because of its relationship with reproduction.[2]
- Race Creation: Victor can use BEGIN to establish a genuinely new Race rather than merely altering members of an existing species.[9]
- System-Recognized Species Creation: The significance of BEGIN extends beyond constructing a body. A sufficiently legitimate lineage created through the Concept can be recognized metaphysically as a new Race.[9]
- Progenitor Authority: Victor's position as God of Progenitors gives him conceptual Authority connected to Beings who themselves represent racial beginnings.[9]
- Racial Authority: BEGIN reinforces Victor's Divine relationships with Vampires, Dragons and lineages descended from him.[14]
- New Lineage Initiation: Victor deliberately used his greater Authority while developing the new race that eventually became the Leviathans, beginning a lineage that was not simply another generation of ordinary [[True Dragons]].[47]
- Dragon-Dominant Inheritance (Composite): Victor explains that his power over Souls and BEGIN allows offspring with different parental ancestries to remain genuine True Dragons while assimilating compatible traits from the other parent. He also credits Velnorah's research in developing the process.[6]
- Command Inducement / Divine Voice: Victor's Voice gains broader compulsory properties through the combination of his Progenitor nature and his status as God of Beginnings, allowing commands to affect sufficiently weaker individuals outside the Vampire and Dragon racial hierarchy.[48]
- Cross-Racial Command: BEGIN-enhanced Authority allows Victor's command to function beyond his ordinary Progenitor hierarchy when the target is sufficiently beneath him.[48]
- Blessing Bestowal: Victor can bestow limited properties of Beginning without transferring the entire Greater Concept. Natalia received the clearest early example.[14]
- Enhanced Vitality Bestowal: Natalia's Blessing of Beginning granted her monstrous vitality.[14]
- Longevity / Eternal-Youth-Like Effect (Blessing-derived): Natalia's vitality became so great that Helena questioned whether conventional aging would ever kill her.[14] This is not proof of unconditional immortality against external death.
- Divinity Perception Bestowal: Beginning's Blessing improved Natalia's ability to perceive Divine phenomena.[14]
- Spatial Perception Bestowal: The same Blessing improved Natalia's perception of Space.[14]
- Monster Creation Foundation: Greater BEGIN is an explicit prerequisite for He Who Creates Monsters.[18]
- First-Generation Soul Creation (Composite): Victor can produce genuine first-generation Souls for the creatures created through the Leviathan system. This requires BEGIN, Creation, Progenitor status, System recognition and sufficient Energy rather than BEGIN alone.[18]
- Reincarnation-Cycle Establishment (Composite): Victor became responsible for sustaining the reincarnation mechanism of the Beings created beneath He Who Creates Monsters.[18]
- END Counterforce: BEGIN and END represent directly opposing metaphysical functions: one establishes beginnings and continuation while the other represents terminal cessation.[9][45]
- END Resistance / Protection: BEGIN protects Victor against END because his Concept embodies the opposing principle of beginning and continuation. This is a demonstrated conceptual counter rather than proof that Victor possesses END itself.[45]

###### Comparable Life and Beginning Applications
BEGIN includes Life, its continuation and fertility, but other Life- and Nature-related Beings display specialized abilities that do not automatically follow from Victor holding the greater Concept. They can nevertheless identify branches he might investigate further.
- Life Detection (Potential through BEGIN): [[Aphrodite]] Elderblood described the Blessing of Perpetuation of Life as granting awareness of nearby Life. Victor received that Blessing, and BEGIN independently includes Life. An unrestricted detection range through his personal BEGIN Authority has not been established.[31][14]
- Life Inducement (Potential): Aphrodite described the ability to influence the presence and development of Life through her lesser Life-related Divinity. Victor's demonstrated new-species creation employs the broader BEGIN, Creation and Progenitor combination; inducing Life in unrelated surroundings through BEGIN alone has not been isolated as an individual feat.[31][18]
- Life Healing and Restoration (Potential as an independent BEGIN application): [[Roxanne Elderblood]] and other [[World Trees]] can restore living Beings through their Life-related powers. Victor has demonstrated composite reconstruction of destroyed Beings, but that feat does not establish a separate unlimited BEGIN-only healing technique.[42][49]
- Nature–Life Nurturing (Potential): World Trees use their Nature and Life connection to sustain living environments. Victor's related authorities and Blessings make a similar nurturing application plausible, although planet-scale World Tree functions require their own racial and cosmic responsibilities.[42][14]

###### BEGIN, Creation and Life
BEGIN and Creation are closely connected but are not identical.
Creation specializes in producing, constructing or bringing forth things. BEGIN provides the higher principle through which something becomes a new beginning and, in Life-related applications, establishes the legitimacy and continuation of that new existence.
Their interaction is particularly visible in Victor's Leviathan project:
✦Leviathan lineageBEGIN + Creation + Progenitor Authority support He Who Creates Monsters, first-generation Souls and the created species’ reincarnation cycle.[18]
Victor therefore does not require BEGIN to duplicate every ordinary Creation feat, nor should every BEGIN feat be reduced to Creation. He possesses both independently and can combine them when the desired result requires both construction and the metaphysical beginning of a genuine new lineage.

###### Relationship with END
BEGIN is repeatedly presented as the conceptual opposite of END, but this opposition should not be misrepresented as proof that END is simply a Negativity sub-Concept. Later cosmological explanations distinguish several fundamental Primordial systems from the overwhelming majority of ordinary Concepts supported by Positivity and Negativity.[11]
The relationship is more accurately represented as:
✦Conceptual oppositionBEGIN concerns beginnings and continuation. END represents terminal cessation. Their opposition does not make END a Victor Divinity.
BEGIN opposes what END accomplishes. That does not automatically make the two part of an ordinary parent-child Divinity hierarchy.

##### War
War was among Victor's earliest principal Divinities and eventually reached complete mastery.[32][2] Unlike specialized Gods whose authority reflects only one interpretation of warfare, Victor's War is presented broadly. He is not confined solely to strategic warfare, battlefield frenzy or another narrow aspect.
Known applications and associated properties include:
- War Manipulation: Victor possesses conceptual Authority over War itself.[32]
- War Instinct: War can react to environments, conflicts and developing situations associated with its Concept. Victor's Divinities have repeatedly demonstrated instinct-like responses to phenomena corresponding with their Laws.[41]
- Conflict Resonance / Perception: In the Sixth Heaven his War Divinity answered the conflict. That response is not awareness of every battle in Creation.[41]
- Strategic Knowledge Bestowal: Victor's Blessing of War granted Natalia instinctive knowledge concerning warfare and the ability to recognize when War begins.[14]
- War-Onset Awareness Bestowal: Natalia acquired instinctive awareness that War was beginning; this power is demonstrated through Victor's Blessing, not direct global surveillance by Victor himself.[14]
- Strategic Warfare Knowledge Bestowal: Victor could impart military-strategy knowledge through War Authority, allowing Natalia access to practical information she had not acquired through ordinary study.[14]
- War-Craft Comprehension (Divinity-specific): Victor's fully mastered War Authority gives him a conceptual connection to warfare as a whole. The story does not establish automatic awareness of every battle in Creation.[2][41]
- War Resonance: War naturally resonates with genuine large-scale conflict, causing Victor's Divinity to respond conceptually to environments defined by warfare.[41]
Victor's War Divinity should nevertheless not be treated as proof that every individual combat technique automatically originates from War. Most of his martial abilities derive from his own training, racial abilities, Dragon powers, Bloodline powers or other supernatural systems.

###### Comparable War Applications in Other Gods
The following are potential applications for Victor because another deity has demonstrated or explained the same branch of War. Victor's complete mastery of War makes their conceptual principles relevant, but it does not prove he has individually performed every application with his own War Divinity.
- War Initiation / Escalation (Potential): [[Aphrodite]] Elderblood explained that her minor War Divinity gives instinctive understanding of how to initiate and prolong warfare. This is an expressly explained War-derived function, and Victor received her War Blessing before developing his personal Divinity.[31]
- War Cessation (Potential): Aphrodite also identified instinctive knowledge of how to end a War as a property of her Blessing. He holds the Blessing. Closing a war by the Divinity alone is Aphrodite's account of what the Blessing knows, not a war he has closed that way.[31]
- War Strategy and Warfare Comprehension (Blessing confirmed; personal application possible): Aphrodite's War Blessing increased Victor's understanding of warfare. Natalia later received an independent War Blessing from Victor granting military strategy and the instinct to recognize War's beginning. These are supported transfers, not a separate proof of unrestricted tactical omniscience.[31][14]
- Concept-Construct Harmfulness (Potential, composite): Aphrodite demonstrated combining Beauty and Love to construct an arrow while using her minor War authority to make the projectile harmful. Victor holds War and Beauty and has access to Love beneath BEGIN, so a comparable combination is conceptually conceivable; the arrow technique remains Aphrodite's feat, not a demonstrated Victor technique.[50][2]

##### Blood
Blood is one of the Concepts most naturally compatible with Victor. It developed from an existence already centered around Blood long before Godhood: Victor was a Vampire, possessed [[Sanguis Noctis Regis]], became a Vampire Progenitor and ultimately evolved into the Blood Dragon Primogenitor. When Blood manifested during his ascension, his compatibility and pre-existing understanding allowed him to dominate the Concept far more easily than abstract Concepts such as Negativity or Destruction.[1][9]
Known Divine applications include:
- Conceptual Blood Manipulation: Victor can manipulate Blood on the level of Divine Authority rather than ordinary Hemokinesis alone.[1]
- Conceptual Reinforcement of Blood Manipulation: Blood Divinity adds conceptual Authority to Victor's pre-existing racial ability to create, shape and weaponize Blood instead of replacing the Blood powers he already possessed as a Progenitor and Blood Dragon.[1][9]
- Blood Authority: Victor's Divine relationship with Blood reinforces his already exceptional affinity with Blood-based phenomena, while the practical expression remains intertwined with his Progenitor and Blood Dragon nature.[1][9]
- Bloodline Synergy: The Concept developed with unusually high compatibility because Blood, Bloodlines and Vampirism had already defined Victor's supernatural existence long before ascension.[1][9]
- Advanced Blood-Law Comprehension: Blood was one of the personal Divinities Victor understood most easily at the outset because its Law was already central to his existence.[9]
- Blood-Concept Spell Potential: Victor lists Blood among the Divinities available when explaining how his collection can supply Divine attacks and spells. A named Blood spell must still be demonstrated separately; his earlier Hemokinesis is not automatically a Divine feat.[3]
- Blood-Aligned Faith Channel: Andrew's later invocation of the God Emperor manifested Blood alongside Fire, Ice and other effects. The feat demonstrates transmission through Victor's Divine religious framework, not permanent acquisition of the entire Blood Divinity by Andrew.[51]
The Divinity does not replace Victor's racial Blood manipulation; it exists above and alongside it, giving conceptual weight to abilities he already possessed naturally.

##### Destruction
Destruction awakened during Victor's ascension but initially developed poorly because Victor possessed little true understanding of the Concept despite being extraordinarily capable of physical destruction.[1][9]
Victor eventually mastered Destruction completely.[2]
Known applications include:
- Conceptual Destruction: Victor can invoke Destruction as a Law rather than relying solely upon physical force.[52]
- Destructive Energy Manipulation: Victor can manifest power aligned with the Law of Destruction instead of relying exclusively upon physical impact or ordinary elemental damage.[52]
- Attack and Structure Destruction: Conceptual Destruction can be applied against supernatural attacks and constructed phenomena rather than being restricted to ordinary matter.[52]
- Conceptual Interaction: Destruction acts through a metaphysical Law, allowing it to interact with targets whose defenses are not purely physical.[52]
- Negativity Synergy: Destruction is explicitly powered through Negativity, allowing Victor's two Concepts to reinforce one another.[20]
- Destruction Resistance: Victor's own mastery of Destruction and higher Negativity Authority provide increasing resistance against hostile Destruction-based effects.[20]
- Destruction Conceptual Insight: Victor developed enough comprehension of Destruction to share his understanding with [[Shiva]] as a specialized conceptual report delivered by Kali. The gift was knowledge, not a separate transfer of his entire Divinity.[53]
- Divinity-Fueled Offensive Spellcasting: Victor explicitly associates Destruction with his ability to cast extremely dangerous Divine spells alongside Fear, Despair, Murder and Strength. The statement does not identify an individual named spell for each listed Divinity.[3]
- Existence-Damaging Destruction (General Law property): Conceptual Destruction destroys a supernatural existence or structure. Ordinary damage does not. It is not END. END deletes the record.[54][55]
Destruction is not identical to END. Destruction remains part of a cycle in which something can be destroyed and subsequently recreated, reconstructed or replaced. END represents a more terminal metaphysical function associated with the definitive cessation of existence.[55]

###### Comparable Destruction Applications in Other Gods
The most instructive comparison is [[Kali Elderblood]], whose exceptional specialization in Destruction approached conceptual embodiment. These are possibilities for Victor to develop, not confirmed automatic transfers of Kali's unique personal mastery.
- Destructive Aura / Passive Erasure (Potential): Kali's excessively developed Destruction affected weaker Beings even when she did not deliberately perform an attack; Speaking was already enough to end a weaker being. Victor's Destruction does not erase every nearby being the same way.[55]
- Destruction Energy Armor (Potential): Kali has employed Destruction Energy as a protective coating rather than solely as an offensive force. The concept demonstrates a defensive path for the same Divinity, but Victor has not separately demonstrated this exact Kali-style armor.[56]
- Destruction-Energy Threads (Potential): Kali can shape Destruction Energy into controlled fine structures without indiscriminately destroying every contacted object. This suggests precision material interaction as a learnable branch, not confirmed possession of Kali's technique.[56]
- Hostile Enchantment / Charm Destruction (Potential): Kali's Destruction has been associated with dispelling intrusive Charms and similar effects. The existence of a comparable application by another Destruction Goddess provides a possible conceptual countermeasure, but does not automatically make Victor immune to every mind-affecting Divine ability.[57]
- Selective Destruction and Destruction Timing (Potential): A highly specialized God of Destruction can refine what is affected and when the destructive effect occurs. Victor has mastered Destruction, but the degree to which he can reproduce Kali's finest applications must be shown individually.[20]
- Near-Embodiment of Destruction (Not transferable): Kali's closeness to the existential state of becoming Destruction results from her own extreme comprehension, not simply from the Divinity's name. Victor's complete mastery of his tracked Destruction percentage does not establish that he automatically occupies Kali's exact near-Primordial state.[55]

##### Creation
Creation became one of Victor's completely mastered Divinities during the post-ascension period and is one of the most important Concepts supporting his ability to produce independent worlds, species and complex supernatural structures.[36][2]
Known applications include:
- Conceptual Creation: Victor can produce structures and phenomena through Divine Creation rather than ordinary material fabrication.[18]
- Matter and Environmental Creation: Creation supplies physical and supernatural components used in artificial environments and world-building projects.[18]
- World Creation: Creation was one of the major Authorities involved in developing the World of Water and the environment required for the Leviathans.[18]
- Life-Creation Synergy: Creation combines with BEGIN and Progenitor Authority when Victor wishes to create genuinely new living lineages rather than merely artificial bodies.[18]
- Soul-Creation Synergy: Creation participates in the composite system through which Victor can generate first-generation Souls beneath He Who Creates Monsters.[18]
- Reconstruction: Creation can be combined with Time, Space, Life-related Authority, Negativity and Soul manipulation to restore a destroyed Being.[49]
- Dimension and Environmental Formation: The World of Water was constructed through Victor's Creation Authority as a distinct environment for the new Leviathan Race.[18]
- Autonomous-Cosmos Research (Incomplete construction): Victor assembled a miniature galaxy whose material and conceptual structures exceeded those of a simple artificial dimension, although it lacked enough fundamental Rules for complete independence.[5][6]
- Conceptual Anchoring (Creation + BEGIN + Negativity): Victor integrated Greater Concepts into constructed Reality to increase its existential weight and resistance to casual external overwriting.[5]
- Created-Lineage Soul Generation (Composite): Under He Who Creates Monsters, Victor can generate first-generation Souls when Creation is combined with BEGIN, Progenitor Authority, energy and System recognition.[18]
Creation's relationship with BEGIN is hierarchical but not redundant. Victor completely mastered Creation while BEGIN remained only twenty-percent understood during the same recorded training period, demonstrating how much broader the Greater Concept is.[2]

###### Comparable Creation Applications
Other deities associated with Creation demonstrate the general distinction between creating forms and becoming the universal source responsible for them. The following are potential directions only where Victor's existing feats do not already establish the application.
- Concept-Construct Materialization (Potential): [[Aphrodite]] Elderblood used Beauty, Love and War together to create functioning weapon constructs. This illustrates that a Divine Construct can arise from the creative use of several Concepts; Victor's own Creation Divinity can already produce matter and environments, but Aphrodite's specific arrow composition is not his feat.[50]
- Nature-Compatible Living Habitats (Potential composite): [[World Trees]] can terraform hostile worlds and sustain their ecosystems through Life and Nature. Victor has reconstructed worlds through his own composite authorities, but reproducing every World Tree function without the Tree's special office is not established.[42][58]
- Independent Universal Law Creation (Not yet confirmed): The Universal Tree and the other Primordials administer native functions that an ordinary creation of matter cannot substitute for. Victor's miniature galaxy remained incomplete precisely because its conceptual Laws were insufficient to constitute a wholly independent Cosmos.[5][6]

##### Chaos, Order and Balance
Dragon God of [[Chaos]] describes the composite Divine existence produced by Victor's abnormal ascension rather than a separately enumerated personal Divinity named "Chaos" within his original catalogue. His simultaneous compatibility with opposing and unrelated systems produced an existence that generated unborn Chaos while also creating Order and Balance around itself, causing The Owner of Limbo to recognize Victor as a fundamental Pillar of Balance.[1]
This stabilizing effect is an emergent property of Victor's complete existence rather than proof that he owns the Primordial office of Balance. The later designation <CHAOS> likewise refers to a broader transformed state: Victor became a Unique Being with no ordinary parallel counterpart across the alternate timelines, but that existential condition is not inserted into the named native-Divinity catalogue as an unconfirmed standalone Chaos Divinity.[59][60]

##### Comparable Divine Powers — Potential Applications for Victor
This index records abilities shown or explicitly explained for another God or Goddess who shares a relevant Concept with Victor. The citation supports that deity's demonstrated or explained power and Victor's separate citation establishes ownership of the common Divinity. These entries are not feats personally performed by Victor; their use remains conditional on comprehension, comparative conceptual jurisdiction, Energy and the mechanisms of the original technique. When the other deity additionally holds a unique office or a second necessary Divinity, that limitation is stated rather than silently transferring the complete ability to Victor.

###### Beauty — Aphrodite
- Beauty-Induced Attraction (Potential): [[Aphrodite]] Elderblood's developed Beauty-based presence naturally attracts the attention of other Beings, and her greater state can exert a Charm far beyond ordinary Vampiric fascination. Victor owns Beauty and previously trained with Aphrodite's Beauty Blessing, but her current near-embodiment and personal Charm cannot be assumed identical to his.[50][61][2]
- Beauty Alteration / Beauty Bestowal (Potential): Aphrodite previously changed Adonis' appearance through a Beauty Blessing and explained that the recipient could borrow her Beauty power. This establishes beauty enhancement as a reproducible Divine application; Victor's own identical Beauty-Divinity application has not been separately narrated.[30][2]
- Beauty-Based Constructs (Potential, composite): Aphrodite formed a bow using Beauty while combining Love and War to produce the arrow and its harmful effect. As Victor has Beauty and War, and Love falls under his BEGIN umbrella, a comparable combination is plausible; the exact bow and arrow remain Aphrodite's technique.[50][2]
- Beauty-Divinity Suppression (Potential at superior conceptual dominance): Aphrodite's specialization became capable of contesting other users of Beauty and suppressing their development in the same field. This rests upon hierarchical superiority, not merely ownership; Victor having 100% of his own tracked Beauty Divinity does not automatically give him Aphrodite's position among competing Beauty Gods.[62][2]

###### Destruction — Kali and Shiva
- Destructive Presence (Potential): [[Kali Elderblood]]'s extremely advanced Divinity caused an almost continuously dangerous destructive presence. This is a model of conceptual Destruction rather than proof that Victor erases nearby Beings passively when not restraining his power.[55]
- Status-Effect and Charm Destruction (Potential): Kali demonstrated a Destruction-based response to certain intrusive Divine or mental conditions. Comparable targeted destruction of hostile effects could be developed through the shared Divinity, but absolute immunity to every Charm or Concept is not confirmed for Victor.[57]
- Destruction Energy Armor and Threads (Potential): Kali's controlled Destruction Energy can be formed into defensive or fine-manipulation structures; these applications are recorded as Kali's feats until Victor personally reproduces them through Destruction.[56]
- Selective / Timed Destruction (Potential): Kali and [[Shiva]] are specialized representatives of Destruction whose detailed comprehension suggests applications targeting particular stages or properties of destruction. No unlimited Victor-specific command over every destroyed object or event is established by analogy.[55][20]

###### War — Aphrodite and Specialized War Gods
- War Initiation, Prolongation and Cessation (Potential; Blessing previously received): [[Aphrodite]] identified these as War-Blessing functions while offering the Blessing to Victor. They represent an explicitly established conceptual scope and a power Victor could explore within his own War Authority.[31]
- Warfare Intuition / Strategy (Blessing confirmed; personal technique potential): Aphrodite's War Blessing transmitted instinctive military knowledge. Victor later conferred a War Blessing on Natalia with strategic understanding and recognition of the beginning of War.[31][14]
- Combat-Construct Enhancement (Potential composite): Aphrodite made a Beauty-and-Love construct harmful through her minor War authority, illustrating War as an auxiliary modifier of another Divine attack. Victor has not shown the same arrow-based manifestation.[50]

###### BEGIN / Life — Aphrodite and World Trees
- Life Detection (Possible through BEGIN): [[Aphrodite]] described sensing nearby Life as part of her lesser Life-related Blessing, which Victor received. The same general domain lies within his own BEGIN, but unlimited BEGIN-only life sensing is not independently established.[31][14]
- Localized Life Inducement (Potential): Aphrodite explained life-inducing functions associated with her Life-related power. Victor possesses far broader composite Life-creation feats; an isolated counterpart to Aphrodite's specific application has not been shown.[31][18]
- Life Nurturing / Restoration (Potential as an isolated Divinity application): [[World Trees]] display Life healing and ecological support. Victor already performs composite healing and Soul reconstruction, but the World Trees' full planetary source-functions are not automatically duplicated by BEGIN.[42][49]

###### Nature — Gaia and the World Trees
- Plant Manipulation / Vegetation Growth (Compatible racial ability; Divine Nature attribution unconfirmed): [[Roxanne Elderblood]] demonstrates plant and root control as part of her World Tree nature. Victor can access comparable power through synchronization with her, but that should not be relabeled as an exclusive feat of his Nature Divinity without further evidence.[42][14]
- Terrain and Earth Manipulation (Compatible racial ability; Divine Nature attribution unconfirmed): World Tree Nature can influence earth, soil and surrounding terrain. Victor has related powers through his own Dragon and World Tree connections; his independent Nature-Divinity-only application is not isolated by these examples.[42][63]
- Ecological Regeneration and Terraforming (Potential composite): [[Gaia]] Elderblood and [[World Trees]] nurture living environments. Victor's reconstruction of habitable worlds shows related composite abilities, but the source's distinctive World Tree function cannot be claimed solely from sharing the Nature domain.[42][58]

###### Dream — Specialized Dream Beings
Victor's Dream Divinity is confirmed and fully mastered.[37][2] Other dream-related beings, including [[Morpheus]] and the dream-using [[Morgana Elderblood]], establish that this field permits specialized forms of dream and consciousness interaction. However, the cited portfolio confirmation alone does not independently demonstrate every possible sleep-induction, dreamwalking or dream-injury negation technique. These remain comparison directions pending a chapter showing the specific action, rather than additional verified Victor feats.

###### Darkness — Erebus and Nyx
- Darkness-Induced Sensory Deception (Potential): [[Erebus]], an exceptionally advanced God of Darkness, used his Divinity to deceive observers' supernatural senses and conceal his presence. Victor possesses Darkness through his own conceptual inheritance, but the exact sensory-deception effect remains Erebus' demonstrated technique rather than proof of Victor's independent Darkness-Divinity mastery.[64][34]
- Impenetrable Darkness (Potential): Erebus covered the [[Greek Underworld]] encounter in supernatural Darkness through which normal light could not pass. Victor's Darkness access makes this a relevant possible application; an Erebus-level area and suppression effect is not automatically conferred by merely sharing the Concept.[44][34]
- Darkness Transformation and Concealment (Potential): Erebus transformed his body into pure Darkness and attempted to escape into it. These are potential expressions of the shared Concept, but Victor's own similar-looking forms may instead be Eldritch, Draconic or absorbed powers unless the scene specifies his native Darkness Divinity.[65][34]
- Darkness Counteraction (Confirmed through Negativity, distinct mechanism): Victor actually dragged Erebus out of his Darkness using Negative Energy, demonstrating a confirmed Negativity counter rather than proving he used the same Darkness transformation technique himself.[44][35]
- Darkness and Night Separation: Nyx Elderblood can combine Darkness with her distinct Night and Concealment Divinities. Effects arising from the complete Night sky or a separate Concealment authority should not be assigned to Victor's Darkness alone without evidence that the specific technique requires only Darkness.[64][34]

###### Time — Natalia
- Time Acceleration / Time-Stop (Potential specialist-grade application): [[Natalia Elderblood née Alioth]], explicitly identified as a Dragon Goddess of Time, stopped and accelerated the flow of Time around a developing planet. Victor controls Time's flow through his own Divinity, but the specific precision and efficiency of Natalia's deployment are her feats.[66][38]
- Planetary Time Acceleration (Potential specialist-grade application): Natalia rapidly advanced the temporal development of a planet by changing its flow of Time. Victor possesses the Time Divinity and supports her during this operation, but his direct replication of this specific form through Time Divinity alone should be separately established.[66]
- Fine Temporal Reversal (Possible, specialist-limited): Natalia's specialization illustrates a more refined application of temporal Authority. Victor's own temporal influence is confirmed, but the limitations and expenditure of each technique remain individual.[38]

###### Revenge, Assassination, Strength, Martial Honor, Family, Vampires and Demons
Other Gods sharing related titles do not provide sufficiently isolated, chapter-confirmed abilities transferable by analogy for these personal Divinities in the material audited here. They remain confirmed Concepts, but invented skills such as automatic retaliation upon injury, guaranteed assassination, unlimited strength, moral compulsion, involuntary family control or complete racial command through Divinity alone should not be added without an actual deity performing that specific Concept-derived feat.[3]

##### Indexed Powers of the Named Personal Divinities
The following distinguishes personally demonstrated functions, demonstrated Blessings or Faith-channel effects, and ownership without a separately narrated personal technique. A confirmed Divinity is not by itself proof of every theoretical power implied by its name.
- Assassination — Conceptual Assassination Authority: Victor explicitly lists Assassination among his mastered personal Divinities. The confirmed effect is ownership and complete comprehension of that Divine category; the cited material does not isolate a newly named Victor-exclusive Assassination spell.[2][3]
- Murder — Divine Killing Authority: Murder awakened with Victor's original Divine portfolio and remained separately named from Assassination.[1][3] Victor subsequently described Murder as a principle underlying his worldview; this establishes his conceptual alignment but does not mean every killing he commits must use Murder Divinity.[67]
- Strength — Divine Strength Authority: Victor fully mastered his named Strength Divinity, which exists alongside his racial physical strength and martial reinforcement.[2] His statement about the frightening spells possible through Fear, Despair, Murder, Strength and Destruction establishes the set's offensive potential, but not a specific standalone Strength-enhancement multiplier.[3]
- Beauty — Borrowed Beauty-Charm Invocation (Confirmed Victor feat; [[Aphrodite]]'s Blessing): Victor released Aphrodite's pink Charm Energy during the assembly of Gods and angels, enchanting even Ariel before withdrawing the Blessing's effect. This is a direct Victor demonstration of borrowed Beauty power, not proof that his independently mastered Beauty Divinity reproduces the full potency of Aphrodite's Primordial embodiment.[61]
- Beauty — Conceptual Beauty: Victor owns a fully mastered Beauty Divinity.[2] His supernatural appearance can fascinate observers, but Aphrodite's separate Charm feats must not be automatically assigned to Victor's own Beauty Law. The Imperial presentation of Victor and Violet nonetheless elicited intense visual fascination.[15]
- Revenge — Divine Vengeance Authority: Victor owns and fully mastered Revenge, a separate personal Concept corresponding to his identity and retributive conduct.[1][2] It should not be conflated with [[Nemesis]]' personal techniques merely because both share the same conceptual field.[9]
- Martial Honor — Divine Martial Code: Victor personally calls Martial Honor his Dogma and associates it with the responsibility assumed by anyone who raises a weapon against another person. This demonstrates a conceptual and ethical expression of the mastered Law, not an automatically confirmed new martial attack.[67]
- [[Rex Invictus|Home]] — Environmental Harmonization (Home + Nature): Victor can combine these Divinities to modify surroundings into a comfortable, harmonious location fitting his conception of a home.[48] He later described and consecrated [[Etherea]] as the home and sanctuary of his family, explicitly invoking his connection to all of the planet's natural elements.[63]
- Family — Familial Conceptual Alignment: Victor possesses the fully mastered Family Divinity, and his explanation of the natural progression from Family to Home, Dreams, Life and Nature reflects his direct comprehension of these connected fields.[68] It is not independent proof of unrestricted telepathic control over family members.
- Nature — Positive Nature Energy Bestowal: Victor's Blessing of Nature gave Natalia direct access to Positive Nature Energy drawn from him.[14] His Nature Divinity also instinctively rejected the unnaturally corrupted condition of the Sixth Heaven, independently of a manually cast attack.[41]
- Nature — Living-World Affinity: Victor identified the animals, plants, biomes, water and other living features of Etherea as part of his protected home and said that he had blessed everything there.[63]
- Yandere — Compatible Obsession Empowerment: Victor's unique Divinity fed Violet's emerging Obsession Divinity, confirming a mutually compatible conceptual interaction rather than universal compulsory obsession.[69]
- Dream — Conceptual Dream Authority: Victor fully mastered his Dream Divinity after acquiring the corresponding Primordial Essence.[37][2] Its conceptual role supports dream-related environments, but a Nightmare phenomenon should not automatically be classified as native Dream Divinity unless the scene identifies that mechanism.
- Madness — Conceptual Madness Authority: Victor independently owns and mastered Madness, distinguishable from the cognitive hazards of his Eldritch existence. The existence of the Divinity does not make every observed mental disturbance a deliberate use of it.[37][2][70]
- Time — Time-Flow Manipulation: Victor can alter the flow of Time within his own territories through Divine Time, slowing or accelerating the passage of Time for subjects of his domain.[38]
- Time — Limited Temporal Reversal and Travel: Victor understands and can attempt higher temporal effects, but Natalia can manipulate the past and timelines far more efficiently due to her specialization and Eyes. A risky or costly operation is not evidence that Victor possesses her ease of application.[38]
- Space — Conceptual Spatial Authority: Victor possesses a confirmed Space Divinity, but ordinary dimensional travel, Dragon Runes and Personal-Universe ownership remain separate possible mechanisms for spatial feats.[38]
- Darkness — Inherited Concept Transmission: Nigredo inherited a Darkness Concept from Victor. Her black-hole manifestation and Primal/Eldritch specialization belong to Nigredo's development rather than serving as independent demonstrations of Victor's same powers.[34]
- Vampires — Divine Vampire Identity: Victor identifies Vampires as a distinct Divinity in his later Faith-developed portfolio.[3] His Progenitor-based commands and racial transformations are not automatically proofs of an additional Vampire-Divinity-only technique, although they share conceptual affinity.[48]
- Demons — Divine Demonic Identity: Victor names Demons among his personal Divinities, reflecting his history as King of Hell. No distinct personal Demons-only named spell is established by the index chapter.[3]
- Fear — Negativity Invocation and Projection: Frederick used Faith in Victor as the God of Fear to release a sphere of Fear-aligned Negativity through a talisman. This is an actual demonstrated downstream effect of Victor's religious channel.[3]
- Despair — Divine Emotional Authority: Victor possesses Despair independently in addition to its place among the Negative emotional Concepts.[1][3] His statement about combining Despair with other Divinities for dangerous spells establishes potential, not an individually named Despair spell.[3]
- Creation — World and Soul Construction (Composite): Victor can use Creation to build the World of Water and combine it with BEGIN and his Progenitor status to produce first-generation Souls for the Leviathans.[18]
- Blood and War — Conceptual Blessing and Power Channeling: Victor's Blood Divinity is one of his most comprehensively understood Concepts, while War can grant military knowledge and the instinct to recognize the beginning of conflict. Such effects are not equivalent to every attack performed through his innate Blood Dragon physiology.[9][14]
Victor's Yandere Divinity is rooted in obsessive and possessive devotion, not unrestricted mind control.[1] His Yandere Divinity fed Violet's new Obsession Divinity. Compatible Concepts resonate, and his strengthened hers.[69] His Dream and Madness Divinities are separate native Concepts.[37] Passive cognitive hazards produced by his incomprehensible Eldritch existence originate from a different, foreign system.[70]
Time and Space are separately established Divine authorities of Victor, although Natalia is the more efficient Time–Space specialist.[38] Darkness can also appear in multiple forms: Victor copied an [[Erebus]]-derived Darkness power for Kaguya.[71] Nigredo inherited Darkness from Victor but manifested a distinctive Primal/Eldritch interpretation.[34] Similar-looking outcomes from Time, Space, Draconic reality alteration, personal dimensions and Eldritch power should therefore be assigned to the mechanism stated in the scene.

#### He Who Creates Monsters
He Who Creates Monsters is a System-recognized sub-Concept created because Victor assumed a new metaphysical responsibility rather than inheriting an older Divine office. The Leviathan project produced a genuinely new living Race whose Souls, existence and reincarnation required stable integration with the systems maintained by the Universal Tree, [[The Judges of The Abyss]] and the wider System, causing Victor's new function to be formally established beneath Greater BEGIN.[18] The recognized requirements are:
1. possession of the Greater Concept BEGIN;
2. possession of Creation;
3. status as the relevant Dragon Progenitor;
4. sufficient Energy to maintain the lives and reincarnation cycle of the created species.[18]
The Concept therefore represents more than a title.

##### First-Generation Souls
One of its most extraordinary functions is Victor's ability to create first-generation Souls.[18]
A normal reincarnated Soul carries Records associated with its prior existence. A first-generation Soul begins without previous incarnations or former-life Records. Victor can produce such Souls for the Beings created beneath this system because he simultaneously possesses the authority to begin Life, create, establish a lineage and maintain the resulting existential cycle.[18]
This feat should not be simplified into "BEGIN alone creates Souls". It is explicitly a composite result involving multiple requirements.

##### Reincarnation Responsibility
Victor also becomes responsible for sustaining the reincarnation cycle attached to the creatures created beneath this Concept.[18] This does not make him the universal Primordial of Reincarnation. His authority is tied to the specific existential system he established and to the Beings whose creation falls beneath his responsibility.
↑ Return to top

#### Absorbed Divinities
Victor's ability to permanently consume supernatural beings radically expanded his Divine portfolio. Victor first demonstrated extraction of a Divine foundation without killing its owner by taking Ra's Sun Divinity.[27] His later method can also preserve Divinities belonging to Gods he permanently consumes, but possession of the Concept does not automatically grant the prior wielder's completed understanding of its Laws.[16] [[Poseidon]]'s Seas Divinity provides an individually named example of a Concept retained following consumption.[17]
The scale eventually became enormous:
- [[Shiva]] detected more than one thousand Divine presences inside Victor.[13]
- Victor later clarified that through absorbed Gods he possesses most of the known Divinities.[3]
Only a small fraction of the absorbed portfolio has been individually named; the remainder stay unidentified rather than being inferred.

##### Confirmed Absorbed Example
Sun is the earliest individually verified acquired Divinity in this record. Victor extracted Ra's Divine foundation while Ra was alive, consumed the Sun Divinity and immediately created a miniature Sun using the newly acquired power. He said it gave him a connection to the Sun inside his personal dimension. Ra survived as a mortal after Victor restored his body and damaged Soul; this was extraction, not proof that Ra was killed.[27]
Seas is another named example. Victor retained [[Poseidon]]'s Divine Concept of the Seas after consuming him permanently.[17]

##### Demonstrated Powers of Acquired Concepts
- Sun Divinity Extraction: Victor forcibly removed Ra's Sun Divinity while Ra remained alive, demonstrating conceptual extraction without a required kill.[27]
- Divine Solar Creation: He created a miniature Sun through the Sun power he had acquired from Ra.[27]
- Personal-Dimension Sun Authority: Victor obtained a Divine connection to the Sun existing within his own dimension. This does not establish control of every star in the Universe.[27]
- Seas Divinity Retention: [[Poseidon]]'s Seas Authority survived within Victor after the Sea God was permanently consumed.[17]
- Aquatic Conceptual Access (Ownership confirmed; techniques unindexed): Retention of Seas grants the corresponding conceptual connection, but no separate Victor-exclusive named Seas attack has been established in the cited chapter.[17]
- Darkness Power Duplication ([[Erebus]]-derived): Victor made a copy of a compatible Darkness power for Kaguya without transferring its entire conceptual source or claiming her Darkness Divinity as his own.[71]
- Divine-Law Knowledge Transfer: Victor contributed advanced understanding of Destruction to a report for [[Shiva]]; this is intellectual and conceptual assistance, not another acquisition of Shiva's Divine authority.[53]
↑ Return to top

#### Divine Power Replication and Distribution
Possessing a Divinity and reproducing a power produced by a Divinity are not the same thing.
Victor can reproduce or distribute supernatural abilities derived from Concepts he possesses or has absorbed without necessarily transferring the entire underlying Divinity to the recipient.[67]
The distinction can be represented as:
✦Power distributionDivinity is the conceptual connection; a Divine power is an effect produced through that Law. A power can be reproduced or bestowed without transferring the complete Concept.
Victor can reproduce a compatible Divine power without transferring the complete underlying Concept. He gave [[Kaguya Elderblood Blank]] a copy of Darkness-related power acquired from [[Erebus]], reinforcing Kaguya's existing Darkness Divinity rather than replacing it.[71]
Compatibility matters. Victor specifically notes that conceptual power should align with the recipient's existing Divinities. Darkness was appropriate for Kaguya because she already possessed a compatible conceptual foundation. Giving the same power indiscriminately to someone whose principal Concepts directly opposed it could create incompatibility.[71]
Victor therefore possesses compatibility-limited Divine bestowal rather than an unrestricted ability to arbitrarily implant any Concept into any target.
Divine Concepts taken from defeated Upper-Sector Gods can likewise be treated as resources, either reinforcing compatible Concepts already held by Victor's faction or being reserved for suitable recipients.[45]
↑ Return to top

##### Conceptual inheritance and Eldritch source
Victor's children demonstrate inheritance and source transmission, which differ from bestowing a temporary blessing. [[Nero]]'s Apocalypse and Ophis' Eldritch Infinity draw their metaphysical source from Victor rather than the ordinary native conceptual hierarchy.[4] Akasha's Control / Loss of Control belongs to her own foreign Domain.[12] Nigredo inherited Darkness and developed a distinct specialized expression.[34] These are not additional standalone Divinities personally demonstrated by Victor.

##### Compatibility and limits
Compatibility governs distribution. Kaguya could safely receive Darkness-related power because she already possessed a matching Divinity, while an incompatible conceptual grant could create problems; captured Upper-Sector Divinities are therefore reserved for recipients whose existing nature can support them.[71][45]

#### Faith and Divine Identity
Faith is a major reason Victor's portfolio continued changing after his initial ascension.
Even before becoming a God, Victor's followers worshipped him under numerous titles: God of Blood, War, Fear, Despair, Murder, Strength, Destruction, Vampires, Vengeance, Martial Honor, Family, [[Rex Invictus|Home]], Nature and Beauty.[28]
Later explanations establish that Faith has power. When a compatible Divine Being is repeatedly perceived and worshipped under a particular conceptual identity, that collective belief can contribute toward the formation or strengthening of a corresponding Divinity.[15]
Many of Victor's later Divinities were strengthened or developed through the interaction between his own growth and the immense Faith surrounding him. Among the Concepts he explicitly associates with this developed portfolio are:
- Assassination[3]
- Strength[3]
- Beauty[3]
- Revenge[3]
- Martial Honor[3]
- Home[3]
- Family[3]
- Nature[3]
- Yandere[3]
- Creation[3]
- Dream[3]
- Madness[3]
He also listed:
- Blood[3]
- War[3]
- Demons[3]
- Vampires[3]
- Fear[3]
- Despair[3]
- Murder[3]
- Strength[3]
- Destruction[3]
The statement that many of these were strengthened or developed through Faith should not be interpreted to mean every Concept in the second list originated from worship. Blood, War, Destruction and Murder were already present during Victor's original ascension.[32][1]
The chronology is therefore:
✦Faith and identityWorship and compatibility can strengthen or develop a Divine identity. A religious title alone does not establish an awakened Divinity at the time it is adopted.
Those early religious titles establish Victor's public Divine identity at that period, while later evidence is required before treating each title as an independently awakened personal Divinity.

##### Faith as a Channel of Victor's Power
By the late Imperial era, Victor's religion had developed beyond passive worship. Faith could function as a channel through which trained practitioners invoked powers associated with Victor and the Dragon's Nest system.
[[Andrew Walter]], for example, invoked Victor as the God Emperor and allowed Divine power to descend into him. Golden lightning struck Andrew, his body entered a Vampiric state and he manifested abilities involving Energy, Fire, Ice and Blood while acting as Victor's Divine instrument.[51]
This does not mean Andrew permanently possessed Victor's complete Divinities. It demonstrates that Victor's Divine identity had matured into a functioning religious system capable of distributing usable supernatural power through Faith.

#### Divine Applications
The following are major abilities directly produced by Victor's Divinities or by combinations of multiple conceptual Authorities.
- Conceptual Manipulation: Victor can directly use the Laws of numerous Divine Concepts to affect Reality.[9][3]
- Passive Order and Balance Generation (Composite): Victor's contradictory Divine existence naturally generated Order and Balance around the [[Chaos]] produced by his ascension, causing Limbo to recognize him as a fundamental Pillar of Balance without making Victor the Primordial of Balance.[1]
- Unique Existence (<CHAOS> state): Victor's transformed conceptual existence became unique across the alternate timeline structure, leaving no ordinary parallel Victors corresponding to him as there would be for normal inhabitants of Creation.[59][60]
- Divinity Manipulation: Victor can interact with and absorb Divine powers and conceptual connections.[16] He can also replicate and distribute compatible Divine powers in appropriate circumstances.[71]
- Conceptual Absorption: Victor can preserve Divinities belonging to Gods he permanently consumes.[16][17]
- Conceptual Empowerment: Compatible Divinities can reinforce one another, such as Negativity supporting Destruction or BEGIN supporting Creation-related Life projects.[20][18]
- Conceptual Resistance: Possessing higher or opposing Concepts can provide resistance to subordinate or countered conceptual effects; the effectiveness depends upon mastery and context.[20][45]
- Conceptual Perception: Victor can perceive Divine Laws, conceptual presences and spiritual developments inaccessible to ordinary senses.[41][10]
- Fear-Aspect Faith Empowerment: Victor's worshippers can invoke a portion of his Fear-aligned Negativity; Frederick demonstrated such an effect using a talisman.[3]
- Divinity-Driven Emotional Resonance: Victor's native Divinities can respond to aligned environmental qualities without a manually constructed spell, as shown by War, Nature and Negativity reacting differently to the Sixth Heaven.[41]
- Compatible Concept Empowerment: Victor's Yandere Divinity nourished Violet's Obsession Divinity, demonstrating positive reinforcement between distinct but aligned personal Concepts.[69]
- Time-Dilation Administration: His Time Divinity allows localized manipulation of Time's rate of passage in controlled territories; the effect is explicitly more costly for him than comparable specialized work by Natalia.[38]
- Divine Knowledge Transmission: Victor shared accumulated Destruction insights for [[Shiva]] through Kali, improving the recipient's conceptual comprehension rather than transferring the whole Destruction Divinity.[53]
- Existential-Weight Manipulation: Victor can deliberately reinforce a constructed Reality by integrating higher Divine Concepts into its foundation, making it metaphysically harder to alter.[5]
- Conceptual Anchoring: Victor can use major Concepts such as Negativity and BEGIN as foundational anchors when creating complex cosmic structures.[5]
- Conceptual-Law Construction: Victor can begin assembling Reality from multiple conceptual Laws rather than merely creating matter inside pre-existing Laws. His miniature galaxy possessed immense existential weight but remained incomplete as a fully autonomous Universe because it lacked the complete set of fundamental Rules required for self-sustaining Reality.[5][6]
- Reality-Architecture Analysis: Victor can distinguish subordinate dimensions from more deeply anchored structures by examining the conceptual rules supporting them and can teach others to perceive the same distinction.[5]
- Conceptual-Key Understanding: Victor understands that fundamental portions of Reality require the correct conceptual Authority or "keys" to access normally, and that raw Energy alone is not equivalent to possessing those permissions.[6]
- Divine Blessing Bestowal: Victor can grant portions or effects derived from his Concepts without transferring the entire Divinity.[14]
- Soul Manipulation: Negativity allows Victor to manipulate Souls as spiritual existences.[10]
- Apotheosis Inducement: Victor accelerated Evie's latent spiritual development until her Research Divinity manifested.[10]
- Race Creation: BEGIN allows Victor to establish legitimate new [[Races (Flamel)|Races]].[9]
- First-Generation Soul Creation: The combination of BEGIN, Creation, Progenitor Authority and He Who Creates Monsters permits Victor to create new Souls without previous incarnations.[18]
- Reincarnation-Cycle Establishment: Victor can sustain a reincarnation system attached to a Race he created beneath the specialized Concept governing that responsibility.[18]
- Reproduction Manipulation: Victor can conceptually control conception and aspects of the reproductive process through BEGIN and his Progenitor existence.[46]
- Divine Command: Victor's Beginning-enhanced Voice can impose commands beyond his normal racial hierarchy when the target is sufficiently beneath him.[48]
- Environmental Manipulation ([[Rex Invictus|Home]] + Nature): Victor can use Home and Nature together to alter an environment's atmosphere and qualities, making the surroundings resemble an ideal natural home.[48]
- Yandere–Obsession Divinity Resonance: Victor's Yandere Divinity fed Violet's newly developing Obsession Divinity, demonstrating compatible Divine empowerment. This does not prove forced Yandere transformation of arbitrary targets.[69]
- Dream Manipulation: Victor can create and control conceptual dream environments through his mastered Dream Divinity.[37][2]
- Madness Manipulation: Victor possesses direct native conceptual Authority over Madness separately from the passive insanity caused by his Eldritch nature.[37][2]
- False-Reality Construction (Dream + Madness + supporting powers): Dream and Madness can be combined with Victor's mental and Eldritch systems to construct extremely convincing artificial experiences.[37][2]
- Temporal Manipulation: Victor possesses Divine Authority over Time, although his specialization is inferior to a dedicated Time Goddess such as Natalia.[38]
- Spatial Manipulation: Victor possesses conceptual Spatial Authority alongside several other independent spatial systems.[38]
- Akashic Retrocognition: Victor can use Negativity's universal connection to retrieve information preserved from past events.[35]
- Past Projection: Retrieved Records can be externalized and observed by others.[35]
- Race Reconstruction (Composite): Victor understands the Soul as containing the information defining an individual and can rewrite that information to reconstruct a person's Race. He applied this principle when transforming Andrew into a High-Human.[73]
- Existence Reconstruction / Resurrection (Composite): Victor can reconstruct a completely shattered individual by combining Negativity, Life-related Authority, BEGIN, Time, Space, Soul manipulation, Eldritch power, Dragon-like Reality distortion, prepared Runes and dimensional isolation. The process forcibly reunites the dispersed Soul while reversing bodily and temporal destruction until the target exists normally again.[49]
- Repeated Death and Restoration: Victor deliberately repeated the target's death and reconstruction 623,596,777,174 times while extracting information, demonstrating repeatable control rather than a one-time restoration accident.[49]
- Akashic Registration Delay (Composite / controlled environment): During the same interrogation, Victor stated that the target would not be entered into the [[Akashic Records]] until he had finished extracting the information he wanted, using the isolated reconstruction system to delay the ordinary finality associated with death and cosmic record transfer.[49]
- Divine-Fragment Soul Extraction: Victor removed a Light-related invasive Divine fragment that had attached itself to [[Ryujin Ikaros]]' Soul and would have turned him into a foreign vessel.[8]
- Soul Damage Restoration: He repaired the Soul injury caused by the extraction through his abilities and his Negativity Authority.[8]
- Fragment Sealing: The extracted Divine fragment was sealed and rendered unable to influence its former host. Its complete origin remained unknown.[8]
- Latent Desire Revelation: Victor caused Ryujin to disclose the deeply buried wish for strength that even Ryujin did not expect to be his greatest desire. This is a demonstrated targeted effect, not unrestricted Mind Control.[8]
- Racial Lineage Purification: Victor purified Ryujin's diluted Japanese Dragon ancestry to the quality of its ancient ancestors, giving him the potential to become an elite warrior while leaving his advancement dependent on training.[8]
- Cross-Racial Dragon Lineage Stabilization: Victor explained that BEGIN and his Soul powers support the natural predominance of True Dragon traits in children of his lineage, while allowing traits of other Races to be incorporated.[6]
- Rank-0 Successor Authority: As Negativity's chosen successor, Victor carries the Negative half of Rank 0 Authority and can influence the Negativity component permeating native Reality, including the System.[22]
- Universal Negativity Destabilization (Threat / unperformed): Victor can concentrate his connection to Negativity strongly enough to threaten catastrophic failure of the Concept, an event expected to damage roughly half of the native Universe and destabilize the Positive/Negative foundation supporting Reality.[22]
- Universal Eldritch Corruption (Threat / unperformed): Victor can theoretically inject foreign Eldritch information into the Negativity network and spread that corruption throughout the native Universe; this was threatened and analyzed but not actually unleashed.[22]
