#### Conceptual Instinct
Victor's Divinities are not passive tools that react only after a deliberate command. Developed Concepts possess an intrinsic relationship with their Laws and can produce instinctive reactions when Victor encounters strongly compatible or incompatible phenomena: Nature rejected the Sixth Heaven's unnatural condition, War responded positively to the conflict associated with it, Negativity resonated with its abnormal qualities, and BEGIN/Life-related aspects reacted according to what the environment represented. These responses allow Victor to register conceptual compatibility, rejection or interest before consciously analyzing every underlying Law.[41]
↑ Return to top

#### Relationship with the Primordial Structure
Victor's native Divinities exist inside a conceptual hierarchy far larger than any Pantheon. [[Primordial Chaos]] represents the native Creator-level foundation, later divided into Positivity and Negativity, which permeate native existence.[22] Specialized [[Primordial Entities]] perform fundamental functions such as Life, Soul, Death and Infinity without being independent of the greater cosmological architecture.[11][23] The higher offices serve as essential components of a self-sustaining Reality, as Victor explained while discussing the conceptual architecture needed to construct a genuine Universe.[6]
✦Native conceptual structurePrimordial [[Chaos]] → Positivity / Negativity → fundamental Primordial functions and the universal conceptual field → individual Divine Concepts and their Gods. Functional overlap does not make two Authorities identical.
BEGIN gives Victor Life-related Authority, but The Universal Tree remains the corresponding native Primordial regulator.[11] Negativity enables him to influence Souls without replacing [[The Judges of The Abyss]].[10] His Beginning Authority can oppose END, but it does not mean he owns END.[45] The essential distinction is between accessing a Concept, embodying its principles, and occupying its formally recognized universal office.[6][23]
The Primordials therefore function as fundamental components of a cosmic machine, whose conceptual removal could disrupt the universal processes they embody.[6] Complete Primordial Chaos stands above these specialized offices as the foundation of the entire Cosmos.[23] Although Attributeless Energy is the substrate from which native Energies derive, it does not rank above Positivity and Negativity: the original Creator produced and used that Energy, while the two polarities are the Creator's divided state.[23]

##### One-Primordial Rule
The native Universe currently permits only one completed Primordial Being to occupy a given Conceptual office. The three Judges of the Abyss do not violate this rule because they are fundamentally one Primordial existence divided into three expressions, while complete Creator Authority could alter the rule itself because the restriction belongs to the current native cosmological architecture rather than to an absolute law above all Universes.[23]
The restriction applies to the completed universal office, not to ordinary Gods. Hundreds of Gods can share the same Divine Concept and compete for influence, while only one completed native Primal Force can become the universal foundation from which those Gods ultimately draw the corresponding function.[23] Victor's Eldritch lineage creates another possibility because a descendant can become the Primal Force of a foreign conceptual system rather than contesting the occupied native office; Kassandra, for example, could theoretically develop as an Eldritch Primal Force of Destruction instead of replacing the native Destruction representative.[23]

##### Victor's Alternative to Native Primordial Ascension
The conventional native route progressively brings a God closer to embodiment of a Concept through knowledge and internalization of its Laws.[9][24] Complete embodiment is not automatically the same as inheriting its unique cosmic administrative office, because recognition and compatibility with Reality's structure also matter.[6] Victor's foreign Eldritch nature offers a separate possibility: adding properties from outside the native Cosmos to Divine Concepts that he has already mastered.[2]
Victor initially avoided fully externalizing his modified Divinities because the [[Regulators of Existence]] might detect his foreign nature.[2] He later became the conceptual source of several Eldritch descendants.[4] His developing Negativity Authority approaches genuine embodiment but remains distinguishable from a completed native Creator-level existence.[45]

#### Outer God Conceptual Powers
Main article: [[Outer Gods]]
Victor's Eldritch conceptual system is a separate conceptual architecture existing alongside his native Divinity. A native God normally connects to a Concept already sustained by the local Universe, whereas Victor's mature Eldritch [[Chaos]] can operate as a conceptual source itself, supplying foreign Divine development to compatible descendants without requiring their Concept to draw from the ordinary native hierarchy.[4][19]

##### Victor as an Eldritch Conceptual Source
When [[Nero Elderblood]] began developing her new Divine existence, Victor discovered that her Soul was not receiving conceptual sustenance in the ordinary manner. His own Nightmare Essence filled the role normally performed by native higher Concepts. Victor realized that from [[Nero]]'s perspective, he was becoming the source from which her conceptual power originated.[4]
Nero subsequently manifested the foreign Concept of Apocalypse. Because its source was Victor rather than the native Cosmos, the Concept possessed Eldritch characteristics and was not bound to the normal Divine framework in exactly the same way.[4]
Ophis presented another example. Her developing Concept possessed a connection to the native Primordial Infinity. Victor removed that external influence and replaced the source with his own Nightmare/Eldritch power, allowing Ophis to continue developing an Eldritch form of Infinity whose source was Victor.[4]
Victor is therefore not merely an unusually powerful God drawing from many Concepts. For compatible Eldritch descendants, he can occupy the metaphysical position normally held by a higher cosmic source.

##### Hierarchy of the Eldritch Branch
Victor's Eldritch branch functions as a foreign conceptual hierarchy comparable in role to a Pantheon, except that its higher metaphysical source is Victor rather than a native Primordial framework. ##### Demonstrated Eldritch Conceptual Abilities
The hierarchy of the foreign branch: Victor and Azathoth stand among its highest creators, followed by Divine Eldritch descendants; Great Old Ones created by those higher Beings possess Divinity, while lesser servants of the [[Outer Gods]] do not. [[Cthugha]] was created by Victor's daughters using a Dragon scale from him and combines a native Star Concept, foreign Eldritch Space and the Progenitor nature of Fire Vampires. These are the created Being's powers, not automatically Victor's own named Divinities.[7]
- Extracosmological Conceptual Manipulation: Victor can develop and manipulate conceptual power containing properties originating outside the native Cosmos.[2][4]
- Conceptual Source Generation: Victor can become the higher source supplying conceptual power to another Eldritch God.[4]
- Conceptual Source Replacement: Victor replaced Ophis' native connection to Infinity with his own Nightmare/Eldritch source.[4]
- Eldritch Apotheosis: Victor's descendants can become Eldritch Gods whose Divinities develop through him rather than through the native system.[4][19]
- Foreign Domain Generation: Eldritch Concepts can generate Domains whose behavior differs from conventional native Divine Domains.[12]
- Conceptual Contradiction: Eldritch Concepts can manifest apparently contradictory expressions simultaneously, as demonstrated by Akasha's Control causing Loss of Control.[12]
- Eldritch Conceptual Augmentation: Victor can infuse native Divinities with Nightmare/Eldritch properties, altering the manner in which they relate to native Creation.[2]
- Conceptual Transcendence Potential: Victor theorized that fully externalizing a native Divinity through Eldritch development could bypass the conventional native path toward Primordial existence.[2]
- Rule Independence: Foreign Eldritch power can operate in situations where the ordinary Rules governing native Divine Beings are restrictive, although this should not be interpreted as complete immunity to every Law or opponent.[4][35]
- False Primordial Synchronization: Victor used his foreign nature to imitate a native Primordial phenomenon that his Negativity comprehension was insufficient to perform legitimately.[35]
- Corruption Authority: Victor's relationship to the creation of [[Abhoth]] allows him to exercise control over Corruption produced through that Eldritch source.[45]
- [[Eldritch Pantheon]] Formation: Victor can function as the central source of an expanding hierarchy of foreign conceptual Beings.[19]
- Great Old One Conceptual Generation (Descendant creation): Victor's daughters used his Dragon scale and their own powers to create Cthugha, a Divine Great Old One with native Star, Eldritch Space and Fire Vampire progenitor characteristics. The daughters, rather than Victor acting alone, are the confirmed direct creators.[7]
- Foreign and Native Concept Fusion: Cthugha's hybrid existence shows that Victor's Eldritch line can sustain combinations of Concepts which would ordinarily be contradictory under the native Racial framework.[7]
- Native-Eldritch Combination: Victor can combine native Divinities and foreign Eldritch power within a single application rather than being restricted to one conceptual system at a time.[49]
- Foreign-Cosmos Energetic Nature: Victor explains [[Eldritch Energy]] to his daughters as analogous to Attributeless Energy from outside their Universe: it operates through a different cosmological logic and produces corruption or distortion when introduced into native Reality. The analogy describes its origin and behavior, not literal identity with native Creator's Energy.[23]
- Eldritch Runic Rule Distortion: Victor explains that Eldritch Runes operate through the language of foreign Gods and can distort surrounding Reality according to external Rules, which is why he ordinarily limits the number of symbols he deploys.[23]
- Native-Rule Limitation: Later experiments by Velnorah and her family reinforce that changing native Creation from within is strongly resisted by its system; external Eldritch influence makes distortion easier but does not automatically abolish all fundamental cosmic Laws.[7]

Victor's greatest conceptual advantage is not simply possessing a large number of Divinities. It is that two different conceptual architectures coexist within him.

These systems are not mutually exclusive. Victor can combine them, allowing foreign power to reinforce, modify or compensate for weaknesses in a native Concept. #### Current Conceptual State
Victor's present conceptual existence combines numerous mastered native Divinities and the two Greater umbrella Authorities, BEGIN and Negativity.[2] His absorbed portfolio contains over a thousand detectable Divine presences and, by his own statement, most known Divinities.[13][3] The System recognized the specialized Concept He Who Creates Monsters when he created and assumed responsibility for an entirely new race.[18] In parallel, Victor's Eldritch nature allows him to serve as the foreign conceptual source of compatible descendants.[4]
His conceptual portfolio is no longer defined only by the number of Divinities he possesses. He can manipulate compatible Souls and facilitate their Divine awakening through Negativity.[10] He can reproduce and distribute certain acquired Divine powers without passing on the whole Divinity.[71] Composite Divine and Eldritch techniques allow him to reconstruct a destroyed individual repeatedly.[49] His higher Concepts serve as foundations for created structures, raising their existential weight and supplying portions of Reality's conceptual architecture.[5][6] He also serves as an Eldritch source for concepts developed by [[Nero]] and Ophis.[4] Akasha's Control / Loss of Control is her own Domain.[12] Nigredo inherited Darkness and developed a specialized version that is not identical to Victor's.[34] He has cut an intrusive Divine fragment out of a Soul, repaired that Soul at once, and purified a diluted Dragon Bloodline.[8]

##### Rank-0 Succession and Universal Negativity Authority
Victor is Negativity's chosen successor and carries the Negativity half of Rank 0 Authority. Because every native creation contains Negativity, his influence extends through approximately half of the native Universe and even reaches the System; this is a form of conceptual jurisdiction rather than simple attack power, and Victor explicitly treats his racial foundation, martial skill, Eldritch nature and accumulated mastery as separate pillars of his actual combat strength.[22][23]
Victor remains short of completed Creator-level embodiment because he possesses Negativity without the corresponding Positivity half. He therefore cannot directly administer the whole of native existence as complete [[Primordial Chaos]], even though his Negativity Authority is already close enough to full embodiment that completed Primordials recognize him as only a step from becoming living Negativity.[45][22]
The scale of that connection allows catastrophic conceptual actions that ordinary Gods cannot reproduce. Victor can gather the Negativity under his control into a single manifestation and was prepared to force the Concept into failure, an act expected to damage roughly half of the Universe and destabilize the native Reality that depends upon the Positive/Negative duality. His Eldritch nature also gives him the theoretical option of infecting the Negativity network with foreign cosmological information and spreading corruption on a universal scale; both possibilities remain demonstrated threats rather than completed events.[22]

##### Mature Understanding of Divine Concepts
Victor's mature conceptual model treats Divine Concepts as pre-existing possibilities sustained by the Universe. They can exist without an active wielder, with extremely specialized Concepts potentially arising from qualities or phrases, although Victor's broad speculation about every adjective is not itself a proven universal law.[21] The same Concept remains conceptually identifiable between Sectors, but stronger competitors alter each God's relative influence in a larger Sector.[23]
A completed Primal Force is fundamentally different from another God competing for the same Concept: it occupies the associated universal office and becomes part of the Concept's foundation.[23] Victor has begun studying how higher Divinities serve as conceptual access keys and anchors of existential weight.[5] His miniature-galaxy demonstration also reveals why creating matter alone is not equivalent to assembling the complete fundamental Laws of an autonomous Cosmos.[6]

About this record
This page contains a chronological list of Victor Elderblood's fights, confrontations, training matches, executions, massacres and other direct combat encounters.
Only encounters in which Victor personally participates are listed, including directly initiated lethal absorptions when their non-combat nature is stated. Competitive and non-combat confrontations retained from earlier versions are expressly identified in their rows. Off-screen encounters are included only when the novel explicitly confirms that Victor personally fought, defeated or killed the target. Battles involving a clone, avatar, possessed body or other manifestation are identified separately so that the result is not confused with defeating the original Being.

#### Excluded or Corrected Entries
Why this section exists: These encounters have appeared on older versions of the fight record, or are easy to misclassify as Victor's personal battles. They are retained here so that corrections remain transparent instead of silently disappearing.
The following encounters have previously appeared on versions of Victor's fight list, or could easily be mistaken for his personal battles, but should not be represented as ordinary fights without qualification.
- Chapter 160 – SWAT Force: The police confrontation occurs in Chapter 160 (Carnage), not Chapter 161. Victor uses Charm to order a controlled officer to fire upon other officers; this is not an ordinary swordfight or proof that Victor personally shot the officers.[20]
- Chapters 286–287 – [[Adonis Snow]]: Adonis’s death is now explicitly identified as a requested, voluntary absorption. It is indexed under Victor’s personal lethal encounters only because this archive includes executions and personal kills; it is not a combat win over an enemy.[35][36]
- Chapter 296 – [[Violet Elderblood Snow]]: Violet physically attacks Victor while grieving her father’s death. He accepts the blows without retaliating, so the event is a one-sided assault and cannot be classified as a victory or a loss.[38]
- Chapter 926 – [[Anna Elderblood]]’s manifestation: The feared image of Victor’s death is a Reality-based ability demonstration, not a separate opponent or an actual duel. It was therefore removed from the main chronological fight table.[106]
- Chapter 1173 – [[Scathach Elderblood Scarlett]]: The novel confirms an additional off-screen spar initiated by Victor after he stops [[Scathach]]’s excessive punishment of Albedo. Its outcome cannot be assigned because only the challenge, departure and aftermath are described.[100]
- Chapters 485–488 – Scathach’s “Battle for Dominance”: The deliberately suggestive chapter titles describe the development and consummation of Victor and Scathach’s relationship rather than a separately established lethal or formal martial contest. Do not insert a combat victory based on the titles alone.
- Chapters 1051–1054 – War Games with the Daughters: Victor sets up and supervises controlled war games involving his daughters. Their competitive encounters do not become Victor’s personal victories simply because he creates the arena or explains the rules.
- Chapters 1172–1173 – Scathach vs. Albedo: Their disciplinary fight belongs to Scathach and Albedo. Victor’s subsequent direct spar with Scathach is separately indexed, but her assault on Albedo is not attributed to him.[100]
- Chapters 1192–1195 – Horsemen vs. Black Eclipse: War and his brothers battle [[Azrakar]], [[Kaelith]], [[Nerath]] and [[Vhalor]]. [[Vaelthar]] then enters with the remaining Chief Gods. Victor created [[Gol-goroth]] and dispatched War, but he does not personally fight in these chapters. Those battles stay on the Horsemen's record. His own intervention is the Chapters 1196–1197 entry, and it must stay marked as a projection fight.[107][102][103]
- Chapter 197 – [[Carlos Reiss]]: Carlos has already been decisively defeated by Victor in Chapter 192. Chapter 197 concerns the continued investigation, interrogation and experimentation performed upon the imprisoned Carlos rather than a second independent Victor vs. Carlos battle. The material is therefore incorporated into the Chapters 192–197 entry above.[28][29]
- [[Ch02 - Rex Imperator II|Chapter 2]] – Weapon correction: Victor kills the three bandits with his hands, not an ordinary knife.[1]
- Chapter 478 – Twenty [[Titans]]: Victor and Eleonor's expedition discovers approximately twenty enormous Titans roughly 42,000 kilometers beyond [[WarFall]], but the group deliberately chooses not to attack them because doing so would be unnecessarily dangerous. Merely encountering potential opponents does not qualify as a fight when Victor specifically decides against engaging them.[108]
- Chapter 685 – [[Lilith Elderblood]]: Victor does physically intercept an attack from Lilith while she is controlled by [[Diablo]], so the encounter remains on the table. However, it is classified as Interrupted rather than a Win because Victor specifically refuses to treat the controlled Lilith as a legitimate opponent and instead removes Diablo's control over her.[66]
- Chapters 739, 742–743 – [[Adam William Lykos]]: Earlier versions began Victor's spar with Adam at Chapter 742. The duel actually starts in Chapter 739, when Victor restricts himself and engages Adam through physical skill and [[Martial Arts]]. Maya's arrival shifts the confrontation during Chapters 740–741 before the Adam fight continues through Chapters 742–743.[70][71]
- Chapters 913–914 – [[Heavenly Father]]: These chapters concern Victor's discussions and discoveries involving Divine and Positive Energy rather than a completed physical battle against the Heavenly Father. Earlier versions listing this encounter as a Victor victory should therefore remain corrected.
- Chapter 834 – [[Thoth]] & [[Khons]]: Victor discovers the two Egyptian Gods spying on events within the Arcane Realm and threatens them after drawing his weapon. Thoth and Khons withdraw rather than entering a physical confrontation with him. Intimidating and expelling them should not be represented as Victor defeating both Gods in combat.[109]
- Chapter 859 – [[Carmila Fulger Elderblood]] & Natasha: Victor does not fight and defeat either woman. Chapter 859 concerns Victor's investigation of Natashia's damaged Soul, within which the spiritual existences of Carmila and Natasha are discovered. Victor repairs Natashia and separates the relevant spiritual components rather than defeating them in combat. Carmila subsequently enters the Tower of Nightmare to fight independently.[110][111]
- Chapter 972 – Kali: Chapter 972 is not the major Victor vs. Kali combat-training sequence previously attributed to it. Kali's directly documented combat-training battle against Victor is represented by Chapters 1033–1035.
- Chapter 1007 – Kali: Earlier versions incorrectly treated Kali's Divinity-development session as a Victor vs. Kali fight. Victor uses his Negativity to stimulate Kali's Destruction Divinity, monitors her Soul and later drains the excess Energy overloading her body, but the two do not exchange attacks or conduct a combat spar. The verified direct Victor–Kali combat-training battle is recorded in Chapters 1033–1035.[112]
- Extra 2 – Ninja-verse: Destroying, deleting or otherwise affecting a Universe is a destructive feat rather than a "fight" against the Universe itself. The foreign System User may be listed as Victor's opponent, but the Cosmology itself should not be treated as a combatant.[104]
- Chapters 958–960 – [[Odin]] Conflict: The principal direct battle against Odin is carried out by Hela and her forces. Victor's wider plans influence the conflict, but he should not receive a personal fight entry merely because the battle benefits his faction.
- Chapter 959 – Norse Forces: Battles performed by Victor's wives, daughters, Heralds, soldiers or allied forces during the Norse conflict do not automatically count as Victor's personal fights.
- Chapters 1175–1176 – System and Primordials: The final standoff is included for continuity, but the System withdraws and no battle with the five Primordial Beings takes place.[101]
- Chapter 1129 – [[Ophis Tepes Elderblood]] vs. [[Nero Elderblood]]: Victor is responsible for much of both girls' Martial Arts development, but the confrontation shown in this chapter is a fight between Ophis and [[Nero]] rather than a Victor battle.

#### Notes
- The source audit covers the nine Volume chronology records through Chapter 1182 and the later Chapter 1163–1197 transcript. The entries represent independently identifiable personal events, not one entry for every chapter.
- Chronological rows are sorted by the earliest confirmed occurrence, with future/Extra material placed after the main-story entries rather than interrupting the sequence.
- Training matches are included because the purpose of this page is to document Victor's direct fights and confrontations rather than exclusively lethal battles.
- An opponent escaping does not automatically constitute a loss for Victor. Where Victor clearly dominates a confrontation but the opponent successfully escapes, the outcome may list both Victor's victory and the enemy's escape.
- Likewise, killing subordinate combatants does not automatically convert an overall lost encounter into a victory. Victor's first serious battle against Mizuki is the clearest early example: although Victor kills several ordinary [[Hunters of Artemis|Hunters]], Mizuki incapacitates him and Victor's family is forced to retreat with him.[5]
- An interrupted fight is not automatically considered a draw. [[Corneliu Funar]] and Victor, for example, never reach a decisive conclusion because Victor voluntarily abandons their fight after detecting Ruby in danger.[4]
- The destruction of a possessed body, avatar, clone or manifestation is distinguished from permanently defeating the original Being. Victor destroying the vessel used by [[Belial]] therefore does not count as killing Belial himself.[32]
- Battles performed entirely by Victor's wives, daughters, Maids, Heralds, armies or other subordinates without Victor personally participating are not counted as Victor's fights.
- Battles performed through a combat clone or projection may be included when that manifestation is deliberately used by Victor, but the entry must say that the original body was not the one trading blows. The Chapters 1132–1134 clone is destroyed after its mission. The Chapters 1196–1197 projection is not destroyed; it leaves with War and the fallen Gods while the true body releases the galaxy. Defeating [[Vaelthar]] there is not a kill, and it is not a duel won by the original body.[98][103]
- Deaths caused by another combatant during a battle are not automatically credited to Victor. During the Elder God battle, for example, Victor defeats [[Lucifer]] and the unnamed Four-Armed Giant, but [[Ikor-Kar-VI]] is the one who consumes them and later consumes [[Var-Kar-VI]].[88][89]
- Similarly, Victor receives no kill credit for the Werewolf group in Chapter 176. Victor defeats and restrains them, but Bruna personally performs their executions.[24]
- Off-screen fights or executions may be included only when the novel explicitly establishes Victor's personal responsibility. [[Dantalion]] qualifies because his later fate is directly confirmed as Soul consumption by Victor.[50]
- [[Kurama]] should not be described as remaining under "eternal punishment". Although Victor repeatedly destroys and restores him during Chapter 934, Chapter 935 establishes that Victor ultimately consumes Kurama through Predation, permanently ending the Kitsune's existence.[90][91]
- The separate Famine, Pestilence/Death and War entries are intentional. Although all four Horsemen participate in the same broader confrontation, their individual outcomes are substantially different: Famine, Pestilence and Death are permanently killed and consumed, while War continues fighting Victor after the others' deaths, reaches Godhood and is ultimately spared because Victor respects him as a warrior.[62][63][64]
- The Chapters 799–804 conflict against [[Tartarus (Realm)|Tartarus]], [[Erebus]] and [[Nocturnus]] is divided according to the progression of the battle rather than treating every chapter as a completely separate encounter. Tartarus falls first, while Erebus and Nocturnus survive until Victor permanently eliminates them in Chapter 804.[80][83]
- Future/Extra chapters are identified separately rather than being assigned false chapter numbers within the main-story chronology.
- Non-combat competitive encounters such as Victor’s basketball match against [[Luan Davis]] and Uno match against [[Thanatos]] are retained because this page historically records significant direct competitive encounters in addition to conventional battles. Voluntary supernatural deaths and one-sided assaults are marked distinctly from contest victories.

### Former Powers

VICTOR ELDERBLOOD · HISTORICAL POWER ARCHIVE
Former Powers & Transformations
A record of the Count transformations and transitional power systems Victor used before his Vampiric and Draconic characteristics were unified within the Blood Dragon Primogenitor physiology.
Former abilities
Count transformations
Integrated powers
Before his evolution into the Blood Dragon Primogenitor, Victor possessed several different Vampire Count transformations derived from the abnormal circumstances of his Vampire Ritual. Unlike an ordinary Noble Vampire, who normally develops a Count Form corresponding to their own Bloodline, Victor inherited the powers of [[Snow Clan]], [[Scarlett Clan]], and [[Fulger Clan]] alongside his own Blood-based power. This allowed him to access the Count transformations associated with all three Clans while also developing a unique fourth transformation created from the combination of all of his powers.[1]
These transformations are considered former abilities because Victor's Vampiric and Draconic characteristics eventually fused into the entirely new physiology of the Vampyric/Blood Dragon Primogenitor.[2] The elemental powers, Bloodline characteristics, and combat abilities associated with the old Count transformations were not simply discarded; they became incorporated into Victor's increasingly unified physiology and could later be used without relying upon the old Count Forms.

##### Vampire Count Transformation
The [[Vampire Count Form]] is an advanced transformation available to sufficiently powerful and talented Noble Vampires. Rather than simply being a conventional temporary power-up, the transformation progressively brings the Vampire closer to the ancient state of their Race while greatly amplifying their physical characteristics, racial abilities, elemental output, and control.[1]
According to [[Scathach]], the Count transformation possesses three known levels:[1]
- Level 1 — Incomplete Transformation: The Vampire becomes covered by the physical manifestation of their source of power, their ears sharpen, and their body may grow slightly larger. Elemental output and the amount of power that can be used without exhaustion increase significantly. An ordinary Level 1 Count transformation provides approximately a twofold increase in power.[1]
- Level 2 — Semi-Complete Transformation: The Vampire develops a more monstrous appearance while their natural racial abilities, physical strength, durability, and control over the power obtained in the first stage increase further.[1]
- Level 3 — Complete Transformation: The complete Count Form combines and perfects the characteristics of the previous stages, greatly increasing both the Vampire's base powers and their control over them. This stage is extremely rare and is associated with highly experienced Vampires who have completely mastered their Bloodline.[1]
Victor was abnormal even by Count standards. His personal Blood Count Form combined the powers inherited from the three Count Houses with his own Blood Manipulation, causing even its incomplete Level 1 state to provide approximately a threefold increase rather than the ordinary twofold increase.[1]
Victor eventually possessed four distinguishable Count transformations:

SNOW CLAN

###### Snow Clan Vampire Count Form
[[Pyrokinesis]] · Firepower · Heat
The [[Snow Clan]] [[Vampire Count Form]] was the first foreign Count transformation awakened by Victor, originating from the Snow Clan Bloodline he inherited through [[Violet Elderblood Snow]].[3][4] It was primarily centered around Pyrokinesis, greatly increasing Victor's fire output and allowing him to use the [[Snow Bloodline]] at a much greater level than in his ordinary state.

###### Appearance
Victor first manifested the transformation as a newborn Vampire. His entire body became engulfed in fire, causing his clothing to burn away from the heat. His ears became long and sharply pointed, the sclera of his eyes became black, his irises turned blood-red, and his pupils acquired a vertical, Dragon-like appearance. His teeth simultaneously developed into the much larger and more predatory teeth of a Demonic Beast.[3] The form also greatly heightened Victor's predatory appearance and emotional state. During this initial awakening, Victor experienced rapidly increasing anger and sadistic impulses while his senses became dramatically sharper.[3] By Chapter 479, after considerably improving his control, the transformation had developed a more stable appearance. Fire smoothly enveloped Victor's body before two long wings composed of fire appeared behind him. His ears became pointed, his teeth sharpened, his hands transformed into claws, and his feet developed into monstrous paws. The heat generated during the transformation was still sufficient to vaporize ordinary clothing.[4] Despite the more developed appearance, the narration explicitly identifies this as Victor being proficient in the first form of the [[Snow Clan]]'s Count transformation. It should therefore not be described as Victor's second stage or Level 2 transformation.[4]

###### Abilities
- Enhanced [[Pyrokinesis]]: The transformation massively increases Victor's ability to generate and manipulate fire. Count transformations increase the amount of elemental power a Vampire can output while reducing the relative strain of doing so.[1]
- Enhanced Physical Abilities: Like other Vampire Count transformations, the Snow Form enhances Victor's physical abilities alongside his Bloodline power.[1]
- Enhanced Senses: During his first awakening, Victor described his sight, hearing, feeling, and general perception as becoming dramatically more powerful.[3]
- Fire Body: Victor's body becomes completely surrounded by fire while transformed. The heat produced is intense enough to destroy ordinary clothing simply through proximity to his body.[3][4]
- Fire Wings: With greater control of the first transformation, Victor developed two large wings composed entirely of fire.[4]
- Enhanced Flame Temperature: While using the Count Form, Victor was capable of taking an enormous mass of fire and continuously compressing it until it became a basketball-sized sphere of blue fire. Even while transformed, performing this required considerable concentration, demonstrating both the enormous output and the control provided by the form.[4]
- Large-Scale Incineration: Victor used the compressed blue flame to completely destroy the structures of an entire monster-occupied city, leaving the area incinerated and reduced to a large depression.[4]
- Fire Resistance: Members of the [[Snow Clan]] naturally possess extraordinary resistance to fire. Complete mastery of the Snow Count Form can elevate this to complete immunity even against normally superior flames; however, Chapter 479 specifically identifies Agnes as having achieved the Level 3 transformation, while Victor is explicitly shown using the first stage. Full Level 3 fire immunity should therefore not be listed as a demonstrated property of Victor's own Snow Count Form at that point.[4]

###### Drawbacks
The [[Snow Bloodline]]'s fire possesses an emotional side effect. Fire amplifies strong emotions already being experienced by its user; anger becomes more intense, jealousy becomes stronger, and an inexperienced Vampire can consequently lose control more easily.[5] Victor experienced this directly during his first transformation, when his anger and predatory impulses intensified alongside his power.[3] This weakness could be overcome through sufficient training and mastery of the Bloodline.[5]

FULGER CLAN

###### Fulger Clan Vampire Count Form
[[Electrokinesis]] · Speed · Acceleration
The [[Fulger Clan]] [[Vampire Count Form]] originated from the Bloodline Victor inherited through [[Sasha Elderblood Fulger]]. Its specialization was extreme speed, acceleration, reaction speed, and destructive Electrokinesis.[6] Victor eventually developed two distinguishable versions of the transformation: his original Fulger Count Form and a heavily modified variant created by incorporating characteristics from Demonic Beasts whose memories and traits he had obtained through his connection to the World Tree.[7]

###### Standard Appearance
When Victor first deliberately manifested the Fulger Count Form, a massive yellow pillar of lightning erupted from his body. His entire body became covered in lightning in a manner similar to Sasha's transformation, while his eyes remained blood-red.[6] Unlike several other Count transformations, this early Fulger Form did not produce large bat wings. Instead, electrical power became heavily concentrated throughout Victor's limbs, with an especially high concentration in his legs.[6] This appearance reflected the form's primary purpose: speed.

###### Abilities
- Enhanced [[Electrokinesis]]: Victor's already powerful Lightning Manipulation receives the Count Form's standard increase in elemental output and control.[1][6]
- Extreme Speed Enhancement: Speed is the defining characteristic of the Fulger transformation. Immediately after first using it against Anderson, Victor demonstrated enough acceleration to attack through a sonic-speed kick.[6]
- Enhanced Acceleration: Lightning is concentrated particularly heavily in Victor's legs, allowing enormous instantaneous acceleration during physical movement.[6]
- Enhanced Reactions and Perception: Victor's [[Fulger Bloodline]] allows his thought process and perception to accelerate alongside his physical speed, producing the effect known as Time Difference, where the surrounding world appears to slow from his perspective. This ability is not exclusive to the Count Form, but the transformation greatly enhances the same Bloodline responsible for it.[7]
- Lightning Reinforcement: Victor can coat his body and weapons in electrical power, using the increased output both offensively and to reinforce his movement.[6][7]

###### Modified Fulger Count Form
During his battle against General Leonardo, Victor demonstrated that his Count transformation was not immutable. Using memories and characteristics belonging to Demonic Beasts absorbed through the World Tree, Victor modified the Fulger transformation itself.[7] Victor crouched in an animalistic posture while extremely dense golden lightning surrounded his body and held [[Junketsu]] in his mouth. A gigantic bolt of lightning then descended upon him, further altering the transformation.[7] Two golden bat-like wings manifested behind him alongside a large sharp tail and animalistic claws formed from Demonic Beast characteristics. His head transformed into the appearance of a lightning beast, with electricity wrapping around his face like a helmet. His ears sharpened, his lips disappeared, and only his predatory teeth remained visibly exposed.[7] Sasha immediately recognized the similarities to a Demonic Beast, while [[Scathach]] realized Victor had somehow used the memories of creatures absorbed through the World Tree to modify the Count transformation.[7]

###### Abilities of the Modified Form
- Extreme Speed Specialization: The modified transformation pushed Victor's speed to such an extreme that Leonardo was unable to perceive how many attacks Victor had performed within a single instant.[7]
- Lightning Claws: Victor manifested Demonic Beast-like claws composed and reinforced by lightning, changing his fighting style into a considerably more feral form of close combat.[7]
- Animalistic Physiology: Wings, claws, a tail, a beast-like head, and other characteristics derived from absorbed Demonic Beasts became incorporated into the Count transformation.[7]
- Accelerated Perception: Victor remained capable of perceiving and responding to attacks while moving at the form's extreme speeds, with his subjective perception causing the outside world to appear slowed.[7]
- Storm Generation: Victor caused the clouds across the battlefield to become saturated with golden lightning and gather together above his opponent.[7]
- Lightning Weapon Creation and Compression: The accumulated storm formed an enormous blade of lightning in the sky. Victor subsequently compressed the surrounding lightning and clouds down around [[Junketsu]], concentrating the accumulated power into his attack.[7]

###### Specialization and Limitations
The modified Fulger transformation heavily redistributed Victor's combat performance toward speed and offensive power. [[Scathach]] interpreted the transformation as Victor sacrificing or reducing the emphasis placed upon raw physical strength in order to devote far more of his available power toward speed and destructive output.[7] This should not be worded as Victor literally having no physical strength while transformed; he continued producing substantial physical impact. The chapter presents it as a specialization or redistribution of his capabilities rather than the total removal of strength.[7] Victor also initially lacked the effortless activation speed possessed by experienced Fulger Vampires such as Natashia. During a later emergency, Victor specifically noted that entering the Fulger Count Form would have made him faster, but the time required for him to transform prevented him from using it when every instant mattered.[8]
↑ Back to archive index
SCARLETT CLAN

###### Scarlett Clan Vampire Count Form
Cryokinesis · Defense · Battlefield Control
The [[Scarlett Clan]] [[Vampire Count Form]] originated from the Bloodline Victor inherited through [[Ruby Elderblood Scarlett]]. It focused upon Cryokinesis, defense, environmental control, construct creation, and the ability to impose Victor's ice upon the surrounding battlefield.[9] Because ice was the first element Victor had extensively trained under [[Scathach]], he was considerably more proficient with Cryokinesis than with most of his other inherited powers when he first accessed the form.[9]

###### Appearance
Victor's transformation initially manifested as a pale-blue pillar of energy rising into the sky. His armor was destroyed because it could not withstand the power released by the transformation.[9] When the pillar disappeared, Victor's skin had become completely pale-white and his hair had become snow-white. Large ice claws covered his hands and feet, his ears became sharper, and long bat-like wings extended from his back.[9] White scale-like structures also spread across his body, covering important regions and forming a natural form of ice armor.[9] Victor himself described this state as only the initial transformation, while immediately noticing the enormous increase in the amount of ice power available to him.[9]

###### Abilities
- Enhanced Cryokinesis: The Scarlett Count Form massively increases Victor's ice output, range, precision, and control.[9]
- Ice Armor: White scales of ice form naturally across Victor's body, protecting vital regions like armor.[9]
- Ice Claws: Victor's hands and feet develop large frozen claws usable in close combat.[9]
- Elemental Weapon Coating: Weapons wielded by Victor can become covered by the element associated with the Count Form. While in the Scarlett transformation, [[Junketsu]] became enveloped in ice.[9]
- Instant Freezing: Victor can emit extreme cold around himself and rapidly freeze opponents or structures.[9]
- Large-Scale Environmental Freezing: Victor froze the surrounding city on an enormous scale, transforming buildings, trees, monsters, mountains, and the battlefield itself into a completely frozen environment.[9]
- Ice World / Battlefield Creation: Following the large-scale freezing, numerous weapons made from Victor's ice emerged throughout the battlefield, effectively converting the environment itself into an extension of his power.[9]
- Ice Weapon Creation: Victor can create swords, spears, spikes, and numerous other weapons from the ice covering the battlefield. These constructs possessed enough durability to be effectively wielded by the Valkyries against [[Nightingale]]'s monsters.[9][10]
- Freezing Effect through Constructs: Weapons created from Victor's ice could freeze monsters after striking them.[9]
- Ice Mirrors: Victor created multiple gigantic mirrors of ice around his opponent, using their reflections to interfere with an enemy whose power depended upon visually identifying Victor.[10]
- Ice Clones: Victor could leave behind a complete ice duplicate of himself while changing position. This ability is particularly important because Victor explicitly states that creating such a clone was something he could only perform in this form at the time, explaining that a Vampire Count becomes one with their own power while transformed.[10]
- Ice and Reflection Substitution: Victor could use his mirrors and ice clones to misdirect attacks and powers targeting his actual position.[10]
- Ice Spike Generation: Existing ice, including shattered mirrors, could immediately be reshaped into thorns and projectiles. Victor could manifest thousands of spikes around an opponent and attack simultaneously from every direction.[10]
- Limited Spatial Freezing: Through imitation and the enormous amount of energy available in the Count Form, Victor used his ice to freeze the air/space around himself in a manner that reduced the effectiveness of an opponent's spatial teleportation, preventing the monster from appearing directly beside him.[10]
This application should be described conservatively. Victor himself admitted that he did not completely understand how the copied technique worked at the time; he was reproducing an effect he had previously observed through overwhelming energy and Cryokinesis.[10]
- Protective Wings: Victor could prevent the indiscriminate freezing of allies positioned behind him, with his wings serving as part of the protected zone while the rest of the city was frozen.[9]

###### Later Development
By the Demonic War, Victor's mastery of the Scarlett transformation had progressed substantially. He used the form against Pestilence, covering his weapon in both ice and blood before invoking Absolute Zero and instantly freezing the Horseman into an ice sculpture.[11] This represents one of the strongest explicitly demonstrated uses of Victor's former Scarlett Count Form before the Count transformations became obsolete.

VICTOR'S OWN FORM

###### Blood Count Form
Hemokinesis · Combined Bloodlines · Regeneration
Victor's personal Blood Count Form was the most abnormal of his original Count transformations. Rather than specializing in one inherited Clan Bloodline, it represented the simultaneous joining of Victor's five principal Vampire powers at the time:
IceWaterFireLightningBlood
[[Scathach]] discovered the transformation during Victor's training and immediately recognized it as fundamentally abnormal. While a normal Level 1 Count transformation gave approximately twice the user's ordinary power, Victor's incomplete Blood Count Form produced approximately a threefold increase because his existence simultaneously contained the powers inherited from the three Count Houses.[1]

###### Appearance
Upon activating his Blood Count Form, Victor grew taller and his skin acquired a gray coloration. His eyes became completely red, while every tooth in his mouth transformed into sharp predatory fangs.[1] His hair floated upward as though ignoring gravity, his hands transformed into large claws, and a single enormous bat-like wing manifested from his back. Pure blood continuously floated around his body, moving almost as though it were naturally protecting him.[1] The form demonstrated in Chapter 113 was still explicitly incomplete. Victor's first uncontrolled manifestation had been even less developed, with the wing appearing as little more than exposed bones and Victor lacking proper control over the blood surrounding him. By Chapter 113, the wing and Blood Manipulation had developed considerably and Victor could remain mentally conscious while transformed.[1]

###### Abilities
- Threefold Level 1 Amplification: Victor's incomplete Blood Count Form increased his overall power approximately threefold, exceeding the ordinary twofold amplification of a normal Level 1 Count transformation.[1]
- Combined Elemental Power: Unlike the individual Clan transformations, Victor's Blood Count Form joined his Ice, Water, Fire, Lightning, and Blood powers into the same state.[1]
- Enhanced Vampire Physiology: Victor's speed, physical strength, elemental output, and other common Vampire characteristics were all significantly increased.[1]
At the time, Victor possessed power comparable to an approximately 500-year-old adult Vampire in his normal state, while the Blood Count transformation allowed him to contend with beings around the 1,500-year range.[1]
- Enhanced Speed: Victor's movement speed increased considerably. Although he remained slower than Natashia, the transformation allowed him to react and fight at a vastly greater speed than his ordinary state at the time.[1]
- Enhanced Strength: Victor's physical strikes became powerful enough to noticeably damage Natashia despite the large difference in their experience and power.[1]
- Massively Enhanced Regeneration: Of all the characteristics amplified by Victor's Blood Count Form, his regeneration was specifically identified as having improved the most. Severe damage caused by Natashia's lightning was regenerated within only seconds.[1]
- Enhanced Hemokinesis: Blood Manipulation was originally Victor's most difficult power to control. While transformed, however, he could manipulate blood naturally and with dramatically greater ease.[1][5]
- Blood Barrier Creation: Victor could gather the blood surrounding his body into defensive barriers capable of intercepting attacks from Natashia.[1]
- Blood Weapon Creation: Victor transformed surrounding blood into multiple swords and launched them as projectiles.[1]
- Blood Weapon Recall and Reshaping: Blood weapons already launched at an opponent could be recalled and immediately converted into another construct, such as changing returning swords into a defensive barrier.[1]
- Direct Blood Manipulation: Victor could affect the blood of another Vampire, forcing Natashia to bleed before drawing her blood toward himself.[1]
- Blood Absorption: Victor could pull blood from an opponent and consume it directly, simultaneously replenishing himself while weakening the target.[1]
- Blood-Based Body Reconstruction: After suffering otherwise catastrophic physical damage, Victor demonstrated the ability to dissolve or reconstruct his body through blood and reform elsewhere during combat.[1]
- [[Pyrokinesis]]: Victor remained capable of immediately invoking the [[Snow Bloodline]]'s fire while transformed, including using fire to completely incinerate William's remains.[1]
- [[Electrokinesis]]: The [[Fulger Bloodline]]'s Lightning Manipulation remained incorporated into the transformation alongside Victor's other elemental abilities.[1]
- Cryokinesis and Hydrokinesis: The Ice and Water inherited from the [[Scarlett Bloodline]] were likewise components of the Blood Count transformation even when Victor did not demonstrate every element simultaneously during its earliest appearance.[1]

###### Limitations and Recoil
The Blood Count Form initially placed extreme strain upon Victor because he had not yet mastered the five powers being forced together within the transformation.[1] [[Scathach]] consequently prohibited Victor from freely using it until he had properly mastered his basic abilities and the transformations inherited from the three Count Clans.[1] An earlier uncontrolled manifestation left Victor comatose for approximately one month despite his Vampire regeneration. Scathach concluded that the recoil had damaged Victor's Soul rather than merely injuring his physical body.[1] Even during the more controlled use shown in Chapter 113, Victor understood that he could only maintain the transformation for a limited period before Soul damage began accumulating again. He therefore required additional training before the form could be safely maintained for extended periods.[1] Blood also played an important role in maintaining the transformation at this stage. Victor actively sought blood during the battle and used Natashia's blood to sustain and replenish himself.[1]

###### Blood Manipulation Outside the Form
Victor originally found Hemokinesis so difficult to control that the Blood Count Form was effectively the only state in which he could comfortably use it.[5] After continued training, Victor eventually succeeded in creating and manipulating a Blood Greatsword without transforming. He explicitly recognized this as the first time he had successfully used Blood Manipulation outside his Count Form, although doing so remained considerably more difficult and exhausting than controlling blood while transformed.[5] This development is important because many abilities first demonstrated through the Blood Count Form later became normal components of Victor's unrestricted power set rather than remaining transformation-exclusive abilities.

##### Evolution of the Count Forms
ENERGY EVOLUTION

###### Post-Roxanne Evolution
After Roxanne evolved and Victor underwent his subsequent rebirth, the quality and quantity of energy within his body increased enormously. Victor recovered full control of his ordinary powers relatively quickly but temporarily became unable to use his Count transformations as naturally as before.[12] The reason was not that the transformations had become weaker. The opposite occurred: when Victor attempted to enter a Count Form, his newly developed [[Senjutsu]] Energy mixed with the transformation and caused the amount of power involved to become drastically greater.[12] Chapter 621 describes the energy being used within his Count Form as approximately one hundred times greater than before the rebirth.[12]
This statement should not be written as:
"[[Vampire Count Form]] = x100 power multiplier."
The chapter is specifically comparing the amount/scale of energy Victor was handling after his rebirth with the energy his Count Forms had used before that evolution. It is not replacing the established Level 1 x2/x3 transformation multipliers with a universal x100 multiplier.[12]
BLOODLINE CULMINATION

###### Complete Bloodline Synchronization
By the Demonic War, Victor eventually achieved something that his original Blood Count Form had foreshadowed: using every Bloodline inherited on the night of his transformation simultaneously at 100% capacity.[13] At this stage, the five powers functioned together as a coordinated system:
Bloodline
Function during Victor's combined use
Lightning
Speed and destructive electrical power.
Fire
Physical/offensive power and the ability to reduce targets to ashes.
Ice
Resilience, freezing and the conversion of targets into ice constructs.
Water
Flexibility and the manipulation of liquids.
Blood
Manipulation and destruction affecting both Blood and Souls.
Victor no longer needed to alternate between one Bloodline at a time or reduce the output of several powers in order to use them together. A single attack could simultaneously damage the target's Soul, burn their body, electrocute them, create ice within their body, and use Water to further propagate the Ice and Lightning effects.[13] This state should not necessarily be called a new Blood Count Form, since Chapter 666 focuses upon Victor finally using all of his inherited Bloodlines simultaneously rather than explicitly naming a new Count transformation. It is better understood as the culmination of the control that his original Blood Count Form had represented.[13]

##### Loss of the Count Transformations
The old Count transformations eventually became obsolete as independent states when Victor's Vampiric and Draconic Progenitor characteristics completely fused.[2] Rather than remaining a Vampire who transformed into several specialized Count states, Victor became the Primogenitor of the Vampyric Dragons, an entirely new Race standing above the Vampire and Dragon subspecies from which it originated.[2]
The elemental Bloodlines and abilities developed through the Snow, Scarlett, Fulger, and Blood Count Forms consequently became integrated components of Victor's much greater Blood Dragon physiology. Their historical transformations are retained in this section because they represent major stages in the development of Victor's elemental mastery and combat style, even though the forms themselves are no longer required for him to access those powers.

Victor Elderblood's Growth is the cumulative evolution of his body, Bloodline, Race, Soul, internal world, Divine existence and deepest Eldritch foundation. His development is not driven by one mechanism. [[Sanguis Noctis Regis]] gives him exceptional learning and adaptation, Vampirism provides the first supernatural vessel capable of expressing that potential, Progenitorhood creates an independent lineage and abnormally large Soul, [[Roxanne Elderblood]] continually refines the vessel from within, centuries of accelerated development allow accumulated resources to be assimilated, the bond with [[Zaladrac Zeovnur Elderblood]] introduces genuine Draconic development, adaptive reconstruction eventually creates the Blood Dragon Race, and Divine Ascension adds Concepts whose further maturation depends increasingly upon comprehension.[1][2][3][4][5][6]
At the same time, Victor possesses a second developmental route beneath the progression recognized by his native Creation. The cosmic existence encountered within his deepest Soul is eventually identified by [[Azathoth Elderblood]] as an Eldritch Chaos, placing Victor upon the developmental path of an Outer God. That path follows its own logic of nourishment, assimilation, self-development and eventual transcendence of a single native cosmology, and is therefore presented separately from his Vampire–Dragon–God progression.[7][8]

#### Primary Growth Path
Victor's principal evolutionary sequence is built upon integration. Each stage preserves and develops the foundations produced by the previous one rather than requiring him to begin from nothing. The Vampire body releases the potential of his Human Blood; Progenitorhood establishes an independent Bloodline and vastly larger spiritual foundation; Dragon Rider development introduces authentic Dragon characteristics into that Progenitor vessel; adaptive evolution unifies those characteristics into the Blood Dragon Race; and the completed Blood Dragon Soul subsequently crosses the threshold into Godhood.

#### Vampire Foundation
Victor's supernatural development begins with a Human foundation that was simultaneously fragile and extraordinarily valuable. His RH-null Blood belongs to the lineage later identified as [[Sanguis Noctis Regis]] — the Blood of the Night King. When Victor asks what the Blood provides, its benefits are described as enhanced learning speed, superior adaptation and the ability to grow stronger more efficiently, making the Blood itself one of the earliest explanations for why Victor responds to training and supernatural evolution so abnormally well.[1] Chapter 1152 later places Victor within the longer [[Walker Bloodline]], establishing that the unusual Human foundation behind him was the product of an ancestral line rather than an isolated accident.[14]
The Vampire transformation supplies the body needed to exploit that inheritance. A constitution that had previously suffered under Human limitations becomes supernatural, durable and compatible with Blood-based development; the ritual also connects Victor to the Snow, Fulger and Scarlett lineages, giving his early Vampire existence an unusually broad foundation. Training beneath [[Scathach Elderblood Scarlett]] then turns this potential into practical growth at a rate that repeatedly surprises older Vampires, with Victor progressing through experiences that would ordinarily require far longer periods.

##### Vampire Maturation
Main article: Vampires
Vampires continue maturing after transformation. Chapter 361 establishes that accumulated age, training, experience and power contribute to later biological metamorphosis instead of leaving a Vampire permanently fixed at the condition of their awakening.[15] Victor inherits that mechanism but experiences it under abnormal circumstances, especially after becoming a Progenitor. Chapter 660 describes a roughly five-hundred-year first cycle relevant to his early maturation, while the enormous subjective time spent within Hell allows centuries of growth to be compressed into a comparatively small amount of outside time.[10]

#### Vampire Progenitor
Main article: Progenitors
Victor's recognition as the Second Vampire Progenitor fundamentally changes the scale of his growth. A Progenitor is not merely an older Noble Vampire: Victor becomes an origin of Vampirism in his own right, possessing an independent Bloodline and a Soul whose size and robustness are already abnormal even before his internal world develops into something cosmological.[2][16] This creates the foundation for a development pattern that dominates the rest of his Vampire era—Victor can acquire extraordinary quantities of Blood, Souls, memories and supernatural information, but his body and Soul must continue developing so that the accumulated material can be safely contained and processed.
Alter Victor is closely connected to this incomplete Progenitor development. Alter represents a portion of Victor's own Progenitor existence that his normal state initially cannot contain completely. As Victor's vessel matures, more of that existence can be reintegrated; after centuries within Hell, approximately 99% of the Progenitor power represented by Alter had already fused into Victor, and the remaining division is eventually resolved as the vessel and Victor's internal state become sufficiently complete.[17]

##### Hell and the Overdrive State
Victor's most intense Progenitor maturation occurs within Hell. Hundreds of subjective years are filled with Demon Blood, Demon Souls, Negative Energy, warfare, martial development and continuous supernatural accumulation. At the same time, Roxanne processes the resources entering him, producing what Alter describes as an Overdrive State: Victor is acquiring more than the current vessel would normally be capable of handling, and his existence is forced to keep adapting while Roxanne regulates the influx.[10]

#### World Tree Refinement
Main article: [[Roxanne Elderblood]]
Roxanne Elderblood transforms Victor's development from ordinary personal growth into a long-term symbiotic system. A World Tree normally supports a planet and the Life developing upon it; Roxanne instead becomes rooted within Victor's Soul. Her growth therefore improves the environment that houses her—Victor himself. Chapters 593–594 directly connect her development with the refinement of his body, Soul, Inner World and the amount of accumulated power his existence can safely support.[16][3]
The relationship is reciprocal. Victor continually supplies Blood, Souls, Energy and other forms of nourishment, allowing Roxanne to mature; Roxanne's maturation in turn increases the quality and stability of the vessel supplying those resources. This feedback loop is one of the major reasons Victor can continue acquiring power at a rate that would otherwise become self-destructive, and its importance becomes especially clear during the Hell era when Roxanne functions as the regulator of the Overdrive State.[10]

#### Dragon Rider
The Dragon Rider state is the decisive transitional stage connecting Victor's Vampire Progenitor development with the later birth of the Blood Dragon Race. In Chapter 685, Victor forms a full supernatural bond with [[Zaladrac Zeovnur Elderblood]]. The chapter explicitly describes Victor as a connected Dragon Rider and explains that a Rider linked in this manner grows stronger together with the Dragon, giving Victor a direct route into Draconic development while his underlying Race remains Vampiric.[4]
The same chapter also establishes Dragon maturity as a genuine biological and spiritual process. Victor examines Zaladrac's Soul and realizes that, despite her enormous body, she is still an adolescent Dragon: her Soul has not yet acquired the solidity and brilliance associated with an elder. This observation becomes important much later when Victor himself reaches Elder Dragon maturity, because it shows that Dragon age is reflected in the development of the Soul rather than being defined only by physical size or destructive strength.[4]
As Victor and Zaladrac's connection develops, Draconic characteristics increasingly become part of Victor's combat body and supernatural physiology. Dragon senses, scales, a [[Dragon Heart]], horns, wings, instincts, [[Draconic Energy]] and Dragon Breath cease being isolated borrowed features and form an increasingly integrated system around his Progenitor foundation. The process is still incomplete during the Dragon Rider period, but it supplies the biological and spiritual information that his later adaptation transforms into his own permanent Race.
Established RaceVampire Progenitor

The importance of Zaladrac is reaffirmed far later in Chapter 1177. The narration states directly that it was thanks to Zaladrac that Victor's Bloodline evolved into the Blood Dragon, describing the resulting Race as a Dragon possessing the powers of both a Dragon and a Noble Vampire.[21] The Dragon Rider stage is consequently not an isolated transformation: it is the evolutionary bridge through which the mature Progenitor vessel acquires the Draconic foundation later converted into Victor's own species.

#### Adaptive Evolution
Victor's regeneration becomes a developmental mechanism once the damage inflicted upon him is severe and repetitive enough that restoring the previous body is no longer the most suitable response. Chapter 801 demonstrates this during the battle surrounding [[Olympus]]. Victor is repeatedly destroyed beneath the pressure and attacks of Beings such as [[Erebus]] and [[Nocturnus]], but the tissue reconstructed after each destruction begins returning in a condition better adapted to the forces acting upon it.[11]
The clearest change occurs in his skin. During earlier Dragon Rider development, Dragon scales functioned as a layer covering a fundamentally Vampiric body. As the Greek battle continues, the regenerated tissue itself becomes Draconic: rather than merely producing scales over his skin, Victor's skin becomes Dragon scales. Similar integration affects his [[Dragon Heart]], Blood, Soul, horns, wings, instincts and Progenitor characteristics until the distinction between a Vampire body using Dragon traits and a Dragon body carrying Vampire traits begins disappearing.[11][12]

This process reaches its racial conclusion in Chapters 802–803. The Dragon and Vampire systems no longer behave as two supernatural structures occupying the same vessel. Their convergence becomes permanent enough for Creation itself to recognize the anomaly as resolved, allowing a new Race and a new Progenitor to be formally established.[12][5]
↑ Return to Growth Archive

#### Blood Dragon Primogenitor
Main article: [[Blood Dragons]]
Chapter 803 marks Victor's greatest biological breakthrough. The Primordial Beings witnessing the event recognize the birth of a new Progenitor, and the Universal Tree describes Victor as a Progenitor standing above the existing Dragon and Vampire subspecies.[5] The new Race is the completed result of his Vampire Progenitor foundation, Zaladrac's Draconic influence, the Dragon Rider bond and the extreme adaptive reconstruction occurring during the Greek conflict.

The breakthrough integrates rather than discards Victor's earlier development. Blood manipulation, Progenitor authority, the independent Bloodline, the immense Soul accumulated during his Vampire era and the predatory characteristics of his species remain present, but they are now expressed through a genuine True Dragon body. The Draconic side similarly ceases to depend upon remaining a separate system provided through the original Rider connection: [[Dragon Heart]], scales, senses, Breath, Energy, instincts and compatibility with Reality have become properties of Victor's own Race.[11][5]
By the later Imperial era, the Blood Dragon lineage has matured into an aggressively assimilative True Dragon Bloodline. Chapter 1168 explains that Victor's direct descendants do not operate like ordinary hybrids whose incompatible traits dilute one another; the True Dragon foundation assimilates useful maternal characteristics while Victor's Blood, Soul Authority and wider biological structure preserve the Draconic base.[22] The result is a lineage whose capacity for adaptation and assimilation reflects the same developmental principles that created Victor himself.

#### Divine Ascension
Main article: Victor Elderblood/Divine concept
Victor's primary evolutionary path reaches Godhood in Chapters 883–885. The decisive change is centered upon his Soul. Chapter 884 describes conceptual Energy entering and establishing itself within Victor's powerful Soul as the wall preventing his progression is finally broken; the resulting awakening produces multiple Divinities simultaneously and establishes a Divine existence built upon everything Victor had already become.[6]
Five major Divinities awaken during the initial ascension: War, Destruction, Negativity, Beginning and Blood. Ten minor Divinities awaken alongside them, including concepts connected to Murder, Strength, Beauty, Revenge, Martial Honor, [[Rex Invictus|Home]], Family, Nature and Victor's own highly personal Yandere Concept. [[The Universal Tree]] explicitly notes the abnormality of Victor awakening five major and ten minor Divinities at once.[6] Chapter 885 subsequently establishes the resulting Divine identity as the Dragon God of [[Chaos]].[13]

Divine growth introduces a mechanism different from Victor's previous biological maturation. Energy remains important, but a Divinity develops according to Victor's comprehension of the corresponding Concept. The contrast appears immediately during his ascension: Blood is already extraordinarily developed because Victor's supernatural existence has revolved around it for years, while Beginning initially possesses almost no proficiency because its scope is vastly more fundamental and difficult for him to understand.[6]
After approximately two thousand subjective years of further development, Victor had completely mastered most of the Divinities being cultivated during that period while the enormous Concepts of Negativity and Beginning remained much more difficult. Chapter 987 gives a snapshot of 17 Divinities, with 15 already completely mastered and Negativity and Beginning progressing much more slowly despite Victor's talent and the enormous amount of time available.[23]

#### Outer God Growth
Main article: [[Outer Gods]]
Victor's Eldritch development forms a second progression distinct from his native evolutionary path. His Vampire, Dragon and Divine states are developed within the cosmological structure of his original Creation; the Eldritch existence discovered at the deepest level of his Soul belongs to the broader category of Beings represented by Azathoth, whose nature can exist outside the normal Rules and restrictions governing native Gods.[8]
The first conscious breakthrough occurs in Chapter 889. Within the deepest region of his Soul, Victor encounters an incomprehensible cosmic existence and realizes that it is not a foreign invader: it is himself, a deeper True Self existing beneath the forms through which he normally interacts with Reality.[7] Chapters 979–980 later reveal Azathoth's own development and the reason she becomes interested in Victor. After emerging from foreign [[Chaos]], Azathoth grows through consumption, experience, information and self-understanding; when she discovers Victor, she recognizes beneath his Dragon, Vampire and Divine characteristics the same fundamental type of Eldritch existence.[34][35]
Chapter 1015 provides the direct classification: Victor has developed into an Eldritch Chaos. Azathoth explains that his condition remains immature relative to a completely developed Chaos Being, but the growth route itself is extraordinarily open-ended. An Eldritch Chaos can consume and assimilate resources beyond the ordinary framework of one native Divine system, and sufficient development can eventually create an existence that the Reality which produced it can no longer normally contain or define.[8]

#### Index Notes
i
How to read the harem indexRelationship status, chronology, [[Soul Marriage]], time skips and separate continuity
- Numbering: The number beside each woman is a chronological/indexing aid. It does not represent authority, affection, seniority, combat strength or Victor's personal preference.
- Marriage and wife status: Victor's marriages were not all established through the same ritual. His family includes women joined to him through the original Vampire marriage ritual, Soul Marriage, direct acceptance into the Elderblood family, Divine or Draconic bonds and relationships confirmed retrospectively after long periods together.
- First Interaction: The listed chapter records Victor's first meaningful interaction with the character from Victor's perspective. A character may have appeared to the reader earlier.
- Mentions: (Mention) means that the listed chapter confirms an event that occurred earlier rather than depicting the event itself.
- Off-screen relationships: A considerable portion of Victor's later romantic life occurs during time skips, between chapters or inside accelerated Space-Time environments. Where the novel only confirms the result afterward, the index records it as Off-screen or uses the later confirmation chapter rather than inventing a missing scene.
- Love interests are separate from wives: Attraction, one-sided love, sexual interest, a proposed courtship or Violet identifying somebody as a possible addition does not by itself make that character one of Victor's wives.
- [[World Trees]] are classified separately: [[Yggdrasil]], [[Qliphoth]], Aurora, Aria, [[Diana]], Diane and numerous other World Trees possess unusually intimate Soul-level bonds with Victor, but the story does not consistently classify every World Tree connected to him as an ordinary wife. They therefore remain in their own lover/Soul-bond index.[1][2]
- Extra-continuity entries: The daughter-wife material from the Extra chapters is indexed separately from the main wife registry because it represents later/future continuity rather than the same point of the principal chronology.
- Continuity corrections: Later corrected text takes priority where the novel itself revises an earlier inconsistency. Hilda is explicitly one of Victor's wives by Chapter 1096. [[Tyche]] remains a prospective wife through Chapter 1170, consummates her relationship with Victor in Chapter 1171 and is subsequently treated as his wife and the mother of [[Moira Eutychia Elderblood]]. Evie Moriarty remains outside the confirmed-wife registry as of Chapter 1179.
- Intimacy labels: A First Intimacy citation does not automatically identify a dedicated R-18 chapter. The Intimacy & Preferences Index separately identifies dedicated scenes, ordinary consummations, off-screen confirmations, fetish disclosures, group encounters and time-dilated bedroom periods.

One-sided, rejected, purely sexual and ambiguous cases are labeled separately rather than being presented as equivalent relationships.
