##### Imperial Central System
The Empire's technological infrastructure eventually developed into a civilization-wide central System connected to the [[Dragon Heart]], planetary management technology and countless subordinate systems. Victor created [[Akasha Elderblood]] to act as its living guardian and administrator, but Akasha herself is his daughter and is not classified as a possession. The network she coordinates is nevertheless one of Victor's major Imperial assets, linking scientific, military, administrative and logistical information across the civilization.[85][86]

##### Imperial Knowledge Database
The mature Empire maintains a civilization-scale digital and informational archive connected to its central technological network. Even an ordinary bookshelf inside the Elderblood household could function as a physical interface with the greater Imperial database: touching the pages and thinking of an ancient work caused the shelf to reproduce the requested book, while advanced users could access the same information directly through personal terminals or their own supernatural abilities.[87] This infrastructure should be distinguished from Victor's private Library. The Library preserves Victor's accumulated personal and Soul-derived knowledge behind heavily restricted physical and metaphysical security, while the Imperial database is a distributed state information system intended for routine access.

##### Imperial Afterlife and Reincarnation System
The [[Elderblood Empire]] eventually required a civilization-scale spiritual infrastructure rather than relying upon the much smaller afterlife systems inherited from the old Pantheons. During the accelerated Imperial era, Victor, [[Hela Elderblood]] and the women associated with Death and Souls reorganized the movement of the dead into dedicated regions for judgment, punishment, rest, preservation and reincarnation.[88] Hell continued to receive Souls suited to its punishments and Demonic systems, while separate spiritual territories handled ordinary Imperial dead and exceptional individuals whose Souls were to be preserved. Victor personally controlled the deepest parts of this architecture because his Authority over Souls exceeded that of the surrounding Death Gods.[88] Death and reincarnation then became formal Imperial administration: deceased citizens could be evaluated, exceptional Souls retained for future service and ordinary citizens returned through a controlled reincarnation structure.[56]

##### Sector Teleportation and World Tree Network
Victor's early Sector-scale logistics were built around teleportation nodes established after his Cosmic Consciousness mapped the [[World Trees]] distributed throughout the Mid-Level Sector.[55] Chapter 1178 introduced a much deeper living network. Victor brought the World Trees connected to his Soul into the Mars project and had them plant roots and seedlings into a shared Core. That Core was installed on Mars and linked directly to the [[Dragon Heart]], creating the World Tree Network.[58]
The network improved Galactic communication so dramatically that [[Akasha Elderblood]] reported information from the Empire's most distant connected galaxies reaching the center immediately. The same living architecture supports virtually instantaneous long-range transport between connected Imperial worlds.[58] The network also possesses a deeper theoretical connection with the greater [[The Universal Tree|Universal World Tree]] system, but Victor's presence interferes with that external information flow and prevents data inside his protected Reality from casually leaking outward.[58]
The World Trees themselves are not possessions. They are sentient beings connected to Victor and living inside the security of his Soul. The infrastructural asset is the network they voluntarily form. Because the true Trees remain inside Victor's Personal Universe, destroying Mars would not permanently destroy the system's living foundation; Victor could rebuild the planet while the Trees remained safe.[58] Later discussion describes younger Trees learning from older Trees in an ongoing lineage that has become fiercely loyal to Victor, to the point that even the Universal Tree observed that Victor was effectively developing a small army of World Trees. This describes a sentient allied network, not private property.[54]

##### Sector-Wide Time-Acceleration Megaproject
One of the [[Elderblood Empire]]'s largest engineered systems was the long-term project designed to give its civilization enormous amounts of developmental Time before confronting the Upper Sectors. Planning began when Victor, Natalia, the [[World Trees]], Divine craftsmen, Imperial researchers and the [[Dragon Heart]] were incorporated into calculations for a mechanism capable of affecting a region vastly larger than one planet or isolated Dimension.[95][96]
The resulting project could not be reduced to a single spell. It became a civilization-scale ritual and infrastructural system whose operation consumed tremendous Energy while allowing the Empire to experience approximately 200,000 years of internal development. Approximately 190,000 years had elapsed within the project and the original population objective had already been exceeded, yet Victor continued the final stage because he considered additional preparation worth the cost.[87] Maintaining the system had become so demanding that Victor was consuming Energy faster than even his extraordinary regeneration could replace it. The Dragon Heart, his private world and the World Trees connected to him all slowed when his reserves fell, demonstrating how directly the entire Imperial Energy architecture depended upon him.
Chapter 1184 further clarifies that the strain was not merely ordinary depletion: Victor was simultaneously preventing the entire Sector from naturally advancing while the merger and accelerated development altered its condition. His physical body entered an Energy-saving sleep while his Soul remained active, with the Universe itself attempting to push the Sector along the course Victor was forcibly delaying.[97]

##### Absolute Paradox Project
The [[Absolute Paradox]] is the most dangerous weapon concept developed by the Elderblood research group in the material currently available, but it must be classified as a project rather than a completed possession. Its strategic origin can be traced to the confrontation with the Primordial Beings: after seeing Victor prepared to sacrifice or catastrophically damage part of his own Soul to protect Moira, Violet and Sasha concluded that the family required a weapon capable of threatening the entire Universe if a similar confrontation became unavoidable. They specifically intended to combine the Empire's strongest researchers with resources such as Eldritch power and <END> rather than leave Victor as the only possible deterrent.[98]
The specific Absolute Paradox design originated when Velina studied the old thought experiment of Schrödinger's cat and brought the concept to Velnorah. Together with Aline and Ruby, the researchers developed the proposal further before Victor applied his own Draconic reasoning to the design.[87]
Instead of destroying a target conventionally, the proposed weapon would force two mutually contradictory states to be accepted by Reality at the same time: a person could be alive and dead, an object could be present and never have been present, an event could have occurred and never occurred, two locations could remain separate while occupying the same point, or a law could simultaneously hold and fail.[87] At its theoretical maximum, the researchers considered imposing the contradiction upon the Universe itself—the Universe exists and the Universe never existed—forcing Reality to lose the ability to determine which state was true.
Victor divided the theoretical mechanism into three required components: a Core of Contradiction containing two normally incompatible states without allowing either to cancel the other; an Energy source capable of sustaining the paradox against Reality's natural attempt to correct it, with Primal Energy considered as one possible stabilizer; and a transfer mechanism capable of applying the paradox to a person, object, law or Concept.[87]
The project remained at the conceptual and feasibility stage. The researchers had not yet begun the decisive experiments, and Victor recognized a severe problem: the native Universe would naturally attempt to erase a contradiction that fundamentally should not exist. Safely constructing the weapon might therefore require conducting the work outside the Universe, a problem for which the Empire did not yet possess an established route.[87] It should consequently be indexed as a developing strategic project rather than a completed superweapon comparable to Polaris.

##### Weaponized Imperial Galaxy
Beginning around the seventieth millennium of the accelerated Imperial era, Victor and his Dragon Goddesses began turning the Empire's home galaxy itself into defensive infrastructure. Asteroids, moons, stars, nebulae, black holes and other celestial structures were deliberately repositioned or altered, while Eldritch organisms originating from Hela's earlier forces were distributed throughout strategic locations and strengthened by Victor and [[Azathoth Elderblood]].[57] The creatures were modified so they did not require ordinary feeding and could remain hidden or dormant within hostile astronomical environments, making apparently empty space part of the Empire's defensive system.

#### Possession Versus Authority
CLASSIFICATION
The distinction between direct ownership, metaphysical incorporation and sovereign authority.
Victor's progression makes the meaning of "possession" increasingly broad. Early in his supernatural life, the term primarily referred to weapons, armor, enchanted equipment, storage artifacts and physical property. By the time Victor became a Demon King and later God-Emperor, his directly controlled assets included billions of absorbed Souls,[20] supernatural Dimensions,[45][48] entire planets,[41] worlds created through his own Divinity,[62] planetary management artifacts,[73] Sector- and Galactic-scale infrastructure,[55][57] strategic Divine superweapons,[89] artificial military species,[101][102] and the armed forces of a multi-Galactic interstellar Empire whose current capital is Mars.[56][63][58]
This does not mean that every citizen living beneath Victor's authority should be considered his personal property. The [[Elderblood Empire]], allied Pantheons, Imperial citizens, members of Clan Elderblood and Victor's subordinate commanders remain independent sentient Beings. They fall beneath Victor's sovereignty, command or political authority, whereas objects such as [[Junketsu]] and [[Cain's Dagger]] are genuine personal possessions and the Souls or worlds physically contained within Victor form part of his own existence.

#### Notes
EDITORIAL NOTES
Clarifications on scope, historical figures and classification.
- The current list of named Souls represents only a tiny fraction of Victor's actual collection. He came to hold billions of Souls.[20]
- The Souls Victor obtained through Roxanne should be retained on this page. They were present in earlier versions of the possessions list but had disappeared from later revisions despite Roxanne's growth being directly tied to the Souls and resources Victor supplied her.[25]
- Raum, Focalor and Sabnock are retained because they were part of the sequence of Demon Pillars and forces absorbed during Victor's campaign through Hell.[29]
- Michael and [[Gabriel]] were not individually defeated and consumed by Victor. Their relevant spiritual characteristics reached Victor indirectly through [[Diablo]], who had already incorporated their hearts/essences before Victor consumed him.[34]
- [[Var-Kar-VI]], [[Lucifer]] Morningstar and the probability-manipulating giant gorilla are indexed separately from [[Ikor-Kar-VI]] because the novel establishes that Ikor had already consumed them before Victor devoured Ikor. They therefore entered Victor indirectly as components of Ikor's composite existence rather than through separate victories by Victor.[21]
- Older possession lists also grouped unspecified Demons said to have pursued [[Nero]] under Victor's Soul collection. The available chapter material for the Tokyo incident identifies multiple supernatural attackers but does not individually establish that Victor consumed every one of their Souls, so they are not inflated into named entries without a direct chapter confirmation.[118][119] [[Sitri]]'s Vatican army, by contrast, is explicitly retained as a mass Demonic absorption.[27]
- The [[Egyptian Pantheon]] should not be listed as having been conquered or incorporated in Chapter 822. Victor's conflict with Ra occurs much later, in Chapters 875–876, with the conquered Pantheon being reorganized beginning in Chapter 877.[47][14][48]
- The former Egyptian territory subsequently became [[Elvenorah, the Eternal Utopia]], meaning it remains a current Victor-controlled territory even though the Egyptian Pantheon itself no longer exists as an independent political power.[49][15]
- Victor's custom black armor should be distinguished from the earlier generic Clan Adrasteia armor he used. The later armor was specifically tailored for Victor and modified for his style of combat.[8][9]
- [[Junketsu]] eventually makes most conventional personal weapons and armor largely redundant because it can change weapon forms and manifest equipment directly around Victor.[6][7]
- The dimensional bags and suitcases are restored as a genuine possession category because Victor explicitly purchased and personally used multiple units. Later private pocket-dimension inventories created for his daughters represent an evolution of that technology, but those inventories belong to the daughters and are therefore not listed as Victor's personal property.[11][12][120]
- The Olympian and Egyptian treasuries are classified as faction/sovereign assets. Victor did not personally carry every Divine weapon or resource taken from those Pantheons.[12][14]
- Material wealth is separated from literal personal ownership. Victor had access to Hell, allied Vampire-Clan resources and a growing political network sufficient to make ordinary financial limits largely irrelevant, but this does not mean every coin or later Imperial treasury account should be listed as his private money.[16]
- The [[New Dawn]] laboratory is archived as a former holding because Clan Alucard deliberately removed its equipment, research, specimens and technology before destroying the remaining facility.[116]
- The Tower of Nightmare and Tower of Challenges, Babylon are separate systems. The former is Victor's specialized high-level artificial training Reality, while Babylon was created as the Empire's mass training and advancement network.[75][61][56]
- The [[Dragon Heart]], City/World Core technology, Imperial Central System, Imperial Afterlife/Reincarnation System, [[Abhoth]] fragment network, teleportation infrastructure and World Tree Network are included because each is civilization-scale infrastructure directly created, transformed or controlled by Victor and the [[Elderblood Empire]].[84][73][88][56][89][58]
- [[Shiro-Hime]] is an Elderblood strategic construct created by [[Velnorah Xyphora Elderblood Thaloria II]], but it is not indexed as Victor's personal possession because its confirmed owner is [[Violet Elderblood Snow]].[75]
- Mars replaces [[Yggdrasil]] as the Elderblood Empire's official capital. Yggdrasil is deliberately preserved as the historic cradle and garden world of the Empire.[58]
- The first completed Polaris was assigned to Hela. A second Polaris was later finished and was also given to her to learn, rather than kept as Victor's private ship.[89][18]
- The Imperial Supergalaxy is the gathered form of the galaxies already under rule: six regions and an Imperial Core. It is not the whole Sector.[59][60]
- The figure of 777 Demonic Legions comes from Chapter 864 and represents Victor's forces at that stage of development, not the permanent size of his later military.[100]
- Similarly, the approximately 25,000 Emperor's Soldiers mentioned in Chapter 1080 are an early production figure rather than their final population.[103]
- Approximately one hundred million recruits are described as training on [[Scathach]]'s military world in Chapter 1142, but this number should not be equated with the complete Elderblood military.[65]
- The Imperial fleet is indexed as an institutional military asset rather than Victor's private collection of ships. One recorded operation used more than fifty spacecraft participating in one operation, including an Explorer-class command vessel, but does not establish the Empire's total fleet size.[104]
- Sentient people created by or subordinate to Victor—including [[Akasha Elderblood]], the Heralds, the Emperor's Soldiers and beings such as Abhoth—are not personal property. They appear only where necessary to describe the military or infrastructure under Victor's command.
- Items merely handled by Victor, equipment explicitly gifted to his wives or children and unspecified miscellaneous storage items are not added as current personal possessions. This excludes objects such as Nero's Divine firearms, Ophis' gloves, the Valkyries' gifted weapons and [[Tyche]]'s private chamber despite Victor having created or commissioned them.
- Junketsu's origin has been corrected. Victor created the Odachi from his own Blood-based experimentation after developing Blood Sacrifice; Kaguya named it Junketsu. It should not be described as a sword originally forged for him by Mizuki.[1][2]
- The old restriction gloves are classified as retired legacy equipment rather than universally destroyed. The early active set ceased being part of Victor's combat equipment, but Chapter 1150 explicitly shows Kassandra treasuring limiter gloves Victor had once used.[108][109]
- [[Etherea]] is not the entire extent of Victor's Personal Universe. It remains a principal family world/sanctuary inside an internal Reality that contains stellar, Galactic and other cosmic structures on a vastly greater scale.[43][42]
- Arcane should not be reduced to a district of Elvenorah. Late canon still treats the Witch world and its Lower Sector as a distinct civilization under Imperial authority before its merger into Victor's Mid-Level Sector.[51][52]
- The Lower-Sector merger spheres are historical strategic anchors rather than permanent handheld weapons. Their confirmed purpose was to draw Arcane, [[Nightingale]] and Samar into the Mid-Level Sector during the completed merger operation.[51][52]
- The [[Absolute Paradox]] is included because it is a major Elderblood strategic weapon project, but as of Chapter 1183 it remains at the conceptual/feasibility stage. It must not be described as a completed Universal weapon until the novel explicitly confirms construction.[87]
- The [[World Trees]] connected to Victor are sentient allies/family-associated beings and are not property. The possessable or institutional asset is the World Tree Network and its Core, not the individual Trees themselves.[58][54]
- Victor's consumption of Ra's Sun Divinity is indexed separately from the Soul archive because Ra survived the extraction as a Mortal. This is an example of an internalized conceptual asset without complete Soul consumption.[14]

Victor Elderblood's Power Progression records the development of Victor Elderblood's practical combat ability, Energy output, destructive potential, existential state, Conceptual Authority and operational reach. It is distinct from Growth, which focuses on the biological, racial, spiritual and metaphysical mechanisms that caused Victor's existence to evolve.
Victor does not follow an in-universe cultivation system with formally named Realms. His progression instead has to be reconstructed from direct transformations, comparisons made by other characters, explicit Author rankings, demonstrated feats and the later Imperial Threat Level system. The cultivation-style chart used on this page is therefore an editorial organization of canon milestones rather than a new power system.
A central principle of Victor's progression is that Energy quantity does not equal combat power. When the Author directly calibrated Victor during his Vampire-Progenitor era, Victor already possessed approximately God-King quantities of Energy while his practical combat level remained much lower.[1] The novel later states the same principle directly: power is the combination of Energy, techniques, mentality, racial characteristics, equipment and the ability to use all of those elements effectively.[2]
The Five Axes of Victor's Progress
Combat StandingThe class of opponent Victor can realistically fight or defeat.
Threat LevelThe total destructive and strategic danger Victor represents.
Existential ScaleThe level of Reality his existence can naturally perceive, endure and interact with.
AuthorityControl over Concepts, Energy, systems and Rules of Reality.
Operational ReachThe largest structure he can continuously manipulate, sustain or restrain.

#### How Victor's Progress Is Measured
Victor's power cannot be represented accurately by one statistic. His development repeatedly produces situations where one aspect of his existence advances before another: his Energy reserves reached God-King quantities long before his practical fighting ability did,[1] his later <Negativity> grants Authority extending through a vast portion of native Reality without automatically turning every physical attack into a Universal attack,[3] and his current sustained control reaches the scale of his merged Sector even though his last explicit conventional Threat classification remains V-06.[4]
Measure
Meaning
Application to Victor
Combat Standing
The general class of opponent Victor can meaningfully fight or defeat.
This progresses from Noble Vampires to [[Combat Gods]], [[God-Kings]], Primordial-class opponents and eventually Galactic-level cosmic entities. Defeating an opponent establishes that Victor's complete fighting system could overcome that opponent; it does not automatically transfer every statistic belonging to that opponent.
Energy Reserves
The quantity and quality of supernatural Energy available to Victor.
Victor possessed roughly God-King quantities of Energy while still being ranked substantially lower in practical combat, demonstrating that reserves establish potential rather than automatic fighting performance.[1]
Threat Level
The scale of danger posed by a target when its entire ability set is considered.
The Empire classifies threats from V-01 through V-07. Victor's conventional Dragon state using Non-Attributed Energy is explicitly used as an example of V-06, the Galactic category.[5]
Existential Scale
How deeply an existence is established in Reality and what kinds of structures it can naturally perceive or affect.
By the late Imperial era Victor must suppress the information radiated by his existence around sufficiently weaker observers because perceiving too much of him can itself become harmful.[6]
Authority
Control produced by Divinities, Conceptual succession, Reality ownership and higher-order understanding.
Victor's status as the chosen bearer of <Negativity> gives him Authority associated with one half of the divided [[Primordial Chaos]], but this Authority is explicitly distinguished from his raw fighting power.[7][3]
Operational Reach
The largest structure Victor can continuously manipulate, preserve, sustain or restrain.
Victor currently maintains the enlarged Mid-Level Sector after three Lower Sectors were integrated into it, continuously preventing the Sector from naturally advancing while its barrier remains extremely thin.[4]

#### Detailed Progression

##### I. Vampire Awakening
Victor's transformation immediately removed the limitations of his sick Human body and introduced him to a level of physical performance that he could not initially control. While experimenting with supernatural movement he accidentally generated enough force to create a crater more than a kilometer across.[8] After several months of [[Scathach]]'s training, even the pressure produced by his enhanced attacks could devastate the surrounding forest.[25]
The later Imperial Threat system retrospectively uses awakened Victor as an example of V-02, the City-level class.[5] This should be understood as a threat classification rather than a statement that every casual punch performed by newborn Victor destroyed a city. Threat Level evaluates the overall danger posed by an entity and its complete available arsenal.[5]

##### II. The Count Transformation
Victor's earliest Count-related transformation was not a stable permanent advancement. The first level of a normal Count transformation provides approximately twice the user's base power, while Victor's abnormal version produced a roughly threefold increase because his existence contained the powers of three Count Clans.[9] The transformation also increased regeneration and other Vampiric characteristics, but the recoil was severe because Victor had not mastered the power being forced through his body.[9]
The consequences reached deeper than ordinary physical exhaustion. [[Scathach]] determined that reckless use had damaged Victor's Soul, and Victor had previously remained comatose for approximately a month after an uncontrolled release.[9] She therefore prohibited him from relying on the transformation until he could properly control his fundamental Bloodline powers and use the Count states without destroying his own foundation.[9]
This is important for Victor's later progression because the Count state establishes an early recurring pattern: Victor frequently acquires access to more power before his body, Soul and control are ready to use that power efficiently.

##### III. Second Progenitor
Victor's status as something beyond a normal Noble Vampire becomes explicit when Limbo examines him. The prison's supernatural gate analyzes the Energy and characteristics of those entering and lists Second Progenitor among Victor's titles.[10] Limbo's analysis is described as an attempt to understand the kind of existence before it, making the classification more meaningful than an honorary title bestowed by another ruler.[10]
His combat ability was developing alongside that racial distinction. During his confrontation with Anderson, Victor used the fight to demonstrate the martial and weapon training accumulated during [[Nightingale]]'s isolation, repeatedly changing weapons and styles instead of relying on one preferred method.[26] Anderson eventually released a Divine-infused Werewolf technique powerful enough that Natashia considered intervening, yet Victor deliberately confronted it and endured the attack to test his own development.[27]
Victor's offensive ceiling continued rising in Japan. When he attacked the mountain protected by [[Ebisu]], the Low-Level God's reaction was to question whether the mountain itself would survive Victor's technique.[28] The feat demonstrates that Victor's attacks could already interact meaningfully with Divine-reinforced structures before Victor himself possessed true Godhood; it does not mean every statistic of this version of Victor equaled a God.

##### IV. Refined Progenitor
By the later stages of the Demonic War, Victor's Base form had ceased being meaningfully comparable to young Noble Vampires. Watching Victor fight Haruna, [[Scathach]] concluded that his pure Base power had reached the class of an Elder Vampire Count and might already surpass the normal standard because Victor's Energy was considerably more refined.[11]
The distinction between Base power and transformation power matters. Scathach specifically notes that Victor had previously required his Count transformation to access comparable raw power, whereas his Base had now reached that level without transforming.[11] Victor himself warns Haruna not to use him as the standard for ordinary [[Vampire Counts]] because his existence is anomalous.[11]

##### V. Combat-God Calibration
The clearest formal calibration of Vampire-Progenitor Victor comes from the Author's direct ranking explanation. In raw Energy, Victor already possessed approximately the quantity expected from a God-King because of Roxanne and the passive impulse of the Progenitor.[1] His ordinary practical combat level was nevertheless placed around Low-Level Combat God, proving that the quantity of Energy available to him was well ahead of the amount he could efficiently express in battle.[1]
With proper control, efficient use of his body and correct execution of the techniques he had learned, Victor could contend with Mid-Level Gods such as Susanoo, [[Apollo]], [[Tsukuyomi]] and Inari.[1] His [[Vampire Count Form]] elevated him farther, allowing him to fight High-Level [[Combat Gods]] such as [[Ares]] and [[Thor]].[1] The Author further stated that complete mastery of the Count Form could allow Victor to challenge several [[God-Kings]] because his Progenitor advantages, anti-God characteristics and greater Energy reserves gave him tools [[Scathach]] did not possess.[1]
CORE RULEVictor's Energy reserve establishes potential; control, body, Soul, technique and experience determine how much of that potential becomes combat power.

##### VI. Hell-Tempered God-King
Victor's forced stay in [[Biblical Hell]] supplied what his earlier development lacked: enormous amounts of subjective Time spent continuously fighting, ruling, consuming enemies and refining the use of powers he already possessed. By the time he returned, approximately seven hundred years had passed from his personal perspective despite far less Time passing outside Hell.[12]
The distinction between possessing God-King Energy and actually being a God-King-level fighter had largely disappeared by this point. The narrative's discussion of Victor's power emphasizes that raw Energy alone does not determine strength and treats his complete combination of Energy, techniques, mentality, racial traits and equipment as the relevant measure.[2] Victor's current state is consequently evaluated in the God-King class rather than merely possessing God-King-sized reserves.[2]
The Hell period also gave Victor something raw Energy could never provide: centuries of practical combat experience. The young Vampire who previously needed [[Scathach]] to construct nearly every dangerous training situation returned as a ruler who had spent centuries fighting Demons, Demonic Beasts and supernatural armies while managing an entire infernal civilization.[12]

##### VII. Primordial-Class Challenger
The fall of [[Olympus]] forced Victor into battles where conventional God-King comparisons were no longer sufficient. During the confrontation with [[Zeus]] and Kronus, Victor's abilities were used against armies of Gods while his Soul-severing attacks prevented the normal Divine recovery that made killing Gods difficult.[29] Zeus and Kronus were ultimately defeated and killed during the battle.[13]
The conflict then escalated into direct confrontations involving [[Tartarus (Realm)|Tartarus]], [[Erebus]] and [[Nocturnus]].[14] The pressure exerted by those battles pushed the Draconic characteristics that had been developing through Victor's relationship with Zaladrac together with his Vampire-Progenitor foundation until the two systems could no longer remain separate.[14]
This period is better described as Primordial-class combat capability than as Victor already being a Primordial God. He could defeat or survive against beings from that class before possessing the same kind of racial or cosmic foundation himself.

##### VIII. Blood Dragon Primogenitor
Victor's greatest racial breakthrough occurs when his Vampiric and Draconic characteristics stop functioning as two different supernatural systems. The fusion begins during the final stages of the Greek conflict and reconstructs his body into a genuinely new existence.[14]
The completed result is recognized throughout the cosmic system: Victor becomes the Primogenitor of the Draconic Vampires.[15] [[The Universal Tree]] describes him as a Progenitor above the existing Dragon and Vampire subspecies, while the cosmic anomaly associated with his previous condition is considered resolved because a legitimate new lineage has been born.[15]
The importance of this stage should therefore not be reduced to a simple transformation multiplier. Victor had changed the type of existence carrying his power. His Vampire-Progenitor predation, regeneration and Blood were now integrated with the physiology, Reality compatibility and supernatural foundation of a Dragon.

##### IX. Dragon God of Chaos
Victor's next major advancement occurs during the battle with the Elder Gods at the [[Edge of the Cosmos]], where normal assumptions about Time and established Reality become increasingly unreliable. Prolonged combat continuously improves his martial arts, adaptation, perception and control rather than wearing him down.[30]
His Soul eventually crosses the barrier into genuine Godhood. Divinities begin forming from the paths and characteristics that define Victor's existence, including major Concepts such as Blood and Beginning together with numerous more personal Divinities.[16] Blood begins with extremely high mastery because Victor has spent virtually his entire supernatural life developing around it, while Beginning initially possesses very little mastery because its conceptual scope is far more complex.[16]
Victor ultimately awakens fifteen Divinities during the ascension.[17] The number is explicitly contrasted with ordinary Mortal ascension, in which successfully becoming a God may produce only two or three Divinities.[17] The resulting existence becomes known as the Dragon God of [[Chaos]].[17]
At this stage Victor's combat system is no longer merely enormous physical power supported by supernatural abilities. His Blood Dragon body, martial skill and Energy are now supplemented by genuine Conceptual Authority.

##### X. Eldritch Chaos
Victor's development does not stop at the native Divine hierarchy. Azathoth eventually explains that Victor has become an Eldritch [[Chaos]], meaning his deeper existence is increasingly comparable to beings that originate outside the normal Rules governing the native Cosmos.[18]
This does not mean Victor is already a fully matured Outer God. Azathoth specifically treats his Eldritch Chaos as immature.[19] Its importance lies in the path it opens: Victor can consume, assimilate and develop supernatural systems without remaining completely dependent upon the mechanisms used by native Gods.[19]
The Eldritch side therefore operates as a parallel progression track layered over the Blood Dragon God Victor rather than replacing everything that came before it.

##### XI. Sector Overlord
Victor's political development eventually reaches the same cosmic scale as his personal power. After the [[Elderblood Empire]] becomes the dominant civilization of his Mid-Level Sector, Victor is recognized as its Overlord.[20]
Overlord should not be treated as a simple combat rank positioned automatically above Primordial God. The later explanation of Sector hierarchy describes Overlords as the comparatively rare rulers who obtain complete dominion over their own Mid-Level Sectors.[24] Two Overlords can therefore possess radically different personal fighting ability while occupying the same geopolitical position.
For Victor, the title matters because it reflects the point where his personal reach, Empire, military, territory and cosmic infrastructure become large enough that the entire Sector effectively functions as his domain.

##### XII. Attributeless Energy
Victor's understanding of Energy changes fundamentally when he reaches the state referred to as Attributeless or Non-Attributed Energy. Rather than treating Fire, Lightning, Miasma, [[Divine Energy]] and other powers as completely separate substances, Victor reaches the more fundamental medium from which differentiated Energies can be expressed.[22]
The breakthrough increases versatility and efficiency because Victor can think in terms of what property Energy should possess rather than selecting only from a fixed inventory of existing attributes.[22] It is nevertheless a breakthrough in understanding and control rather than an automatically quantifiable increase of one Attack-Power tier.
This distinction becomes important when the modern Threat system is established, because Victor's Dragon Form using Non-Attributed Energy is later used as an example of V-06 while other versions of his power can be placed differently depending on their complete threat profile.[5]

##### XIII. Galactic Apex
Victor's late Imperial development finally provides direct astronomical measurements. When he stops restricting his Dragon body, he grows beyond the size of a Solar System and continues until his physical form surpasses the dimensions of a galaxy.[5] He simultaneously uses his power to stop the surrounding planets and stars from being thrown out of orbit by his presence, demonstrating control proportional to the scale of the transformation rather than merely uncontrolled size.[5]
Victor then expands what had previously been Divine perception into Cosmic Consciousness. His awareness continues spreading until it encounters the barrier enclosing his Mid-Level Sector.[5] Millions of [[World Trees]] answer his call, and their locations allow Victor to create a map of the galaxies throughout the Sector for Imperial administration and expansion.[5]
The same discussion establishes the Imperial Threat system. V-05 corresponds to Solar-System-level threats, while V-06 corresponds to Galactic threats.[5] Victor in Imperial Dragon Form is used as a V-05 example, whereas Victor in Dragon Form using Non-Attributed Energy is directly used as a V-06 example.[5]
Victor's control is not restricted to changing his own size. He subsequently manipulates a Galactic environment and its central supermassive black hole while preparing the Empire's long-term development project.[31]
Later Imperial discussion clarifies just how broad V-06 is. Ordinary Galactic threats occupy the lower portions of the category, while Victor and the strongest comparable faction leaders stand near its summit and can annihilate multiple galaxies simultaneously.[23] This is the strongest direct conventional destructive classification currently given to mainline Victor.

##### XIV. Chosen of Negativity
Victor's position in the cosmic hierarchy changes again when the surviving [[Will Solace|Will]] associated with <Negativity> recognizes him as its chosen bearer. The System identifies Victor as the Chosen One of Negativity and states that he possesses half the Authority of Rank 0.[7]
The scale of that Authority is extraordinary because Negativity permeates the native Universe. The System reasons that Victor consequently possesses influence through approximately half of the Universe's underlying Positive-Negative framework, including the System itself.[7] Victor has not yet become the complete embodiment, however, and therefore cannot simply command all existence in the way a completed Rank-0 state theoretically could.[7]
This advancement must not be confused with an ordinary combat promotion. Victor later explicitly corrects his daughters when they attribute his strength primarily to Negativity. He explains that Negativity gives him much greater Authority over Concepts rather than being the foundation of his fighting power.[3] Victor identifies that fighting foundation as his accumulated martial skill, Blood Dragon Progenitor lineage, Eldritch nature and control over his powers.[3]

##### XV. The Lower-Sector Merger
Victor later applies his power on a scale larger than individual galaxies. Fragments of himself placed within Arcane, [[Nightingale]] and Samar influence the three Lower Sectors strongly enough for Victor to call those entire cosmological regions toward his Mid-Level Sector.[32]
When the merger begins, the barrier surrounding Victor's Sector expands and the galaxies belonging to the three Lower Sectors emerge inside it.[24] Victor immediately separates and organizes the incoming structures so that Galactic systems do not collide.[24] The operation therefore transfers far more than the three inhabited worlds: the Lower Sectors bring their own young galaxies and developing astronomical structures into Victor's territory.[24]
Victor then reorganizes the enlarged Sector personally. His Dragon body expands until it surpasses the scale of an ordinary galaxy, after which he envelops an entire spiral galaxy with his power and moves billions of stars while keeping its Solar Systems and orbital structures intact.[33] His control subsequently extends over entire groups of galaxies, allowing him to guide different Galactic structures into separate regions without destroying their internal organization.[33]
[[The Universal Tree]] describes the finished reconstruction as a "flawless job" and compares watching Victor work to witnessing part of the Universe being recreated.[33] The feat is fundamentally different from destroying a galaxy: Victor is preserving billions of individual astronomical systems while moving the larger structure containing them.

##### XVI. Merged-Sector Stabilizer — Current Stage
Victor's latest sustained feat occurs after the Lower-Sector merger and the prolonged Imperial development ritual begin placing an enormous burden on the structure surrounding him. The integration of the smaller Sectors leaves the enlarged Sector's barrier extremely thin.[4] At the same time, the Sector is attempting to proceed along its natural advancement while Victor deliberately prevents that transition from occurring.[4]
Anna identifies the actual source of Victor's exhaustion: he is continuously expending Energy to prevent the entire Sector from advancing and is the one holding everything together.[4] Victor is therefore maintaining the long-running ritual while forcibly holding the complete enlarged Sector in its current state against the natural course being imposed by the Universe.[4]
The burden is large enough to exceed even Victor's extraordinary rate of Energy recovery. His physical body enters an Energy-saving sleep while his Soul remains active and continues functioning normally.[4] After Moira replenishes approximately twenty percent of his reserves, Victor's Energy immediately begins falling again because his continuing expenditure still exceeds his production.[4]
CURRENT SUSTAINED BENCHMARKVictor continuously maintains the complete merged Mid-Level Sector in place after the integration of three Lower Sectors and their Galactic structures, preventing its natural advancement while holding its extremely thin barrier and enlarged cosmological structure together.[4]
This is currently Victor's greatest sustained operational feat. It should not be rewritten as an automatic V-07 Attack-Power statement because the feat measures continuous stabilization, restraint and Energy expenditure rather than a direct statement that conventional Victor can destroy an entire Universe.
↑ Return to Power Archive

#### Threat Level Track
Main article: [[Power Hierarchy]]
The Imperial Threat Level system is specifically designed to avoid many of the problems created by trying to force every supernatural species into one conventional Power Level. A target's classification represents the complete threat posed by its strength, powers, equipment, Divine access, technology and other dangerous characteristics rather than the destructive radius of one ordinary attack.[5]

##### The Internal Range of V-06
The later story explicitly demonstrates that V-06 is not a narrow tier in which every member has identical power. Velnorah's discussion of mature Imperial standards describes Planetary combatants as merely above average, places serious Solar-System threats among elite forces and reserves Galactic status for much rarer entities.[23]
Even inside V-06 the difference remains enormous. Most Galactic elites occupy the beginning of the classification, while Victor and the leaders of the strongest factions stand at its top and can destroy multiple galaxies simultaneously.[23]

#### Current Mainline Standing
CURRENT MAINLINE PROFILEVictor Elderblood — Mature Imperial Era
Conventional Threat Class: Top-end V-06 — Galactic Apex. Victor's Dragon Form using Non-Attributed Energy is explicitly classified in the Galactic category.[5] Later Imperial standards place Victor among the rare V-06 entities capable of destroying multiple galaxies simultaneously.[23]
Physical Draconic Scale: Victor can expand beyond the size of a Solar System and continue until his body exceeds the dimensions of a galaxy.[5] He can simultaneously suppress the gravitational consequences of that body so surrounding stars and planets remain in their proper orbits.[5]
Perception: Victor's Cosmic Consciousness can spread throughout his Mid-Level Sector until it reaches the external Sector barrier.[5] Millions of [[World Trees]] can answer his call and provide additional points through which the Galactic structure of the region can be mapped.[5]
Galactic Manipulation: Victor can manipulate an entire Galactic environment and its central supermassive black hole.[31] After the Lower-Sector merger, he can envelop complete galaxies, move billions of stars while preserving their Solar Systems and manipulate entire groups of galaxies at once.[33]
Conceptual Reconstruction: Victor can reconstruct an existence after both its body and Soul have been destroyed by an existential contract.[34] The reconstruction uses Beginning, Life, Time, Space, Soul Authority, Negativity, Eldritch power, Draconic Reality manipulation and prepared Runes together.[34] The process is repeated 623,596,777,174 times during his interrogation of the foreign fragment.[34]
Rank-0-derived Authority: The System identifies Victor as the chosen bearer of <Negativity> and attributes half the Authority of Rank 0 to his current position.[7] This provides influence through the Negative component permeating native Reality but does not make Victor the completed embodiment of all Negativity.[7]
Latest Sustained Operational Feat: Victor maintains the complete enlarged Mid-Level Sector after three Lower Sectors and their Galactic structures are integrated into it.[24] He simultaneously prevents the Sector from naturally advancing and holds its extremely thin post-merger structure together.[4] The continuous expenditure becomes greater than his normal Energy recovery, forcing his physical body into an Energy-saving state while his Soul remains active.[4]

##### Existential Weight
By the later Imperial era, Victor's development can no longer be described solely as "having more Energy." He suppresses the amount of information and existential presence emitted by his body because sufficiently weak beings can be harmed by perceiving too much of what he actually is.[6]
The story uses simplified numerical levels as an analogy for the difference between orders of existence, but explicitly treats those numbers as an explanatory model rather than a formal combat hierarchy.[6] A higher existence may naturally perceive, resist or interact with structures that a lower existence cannot process, but this should not be converted into an unsupported dimensional tier system.

##### Reality Architecture
Victor's understanding of Dimensions and Concepts becomes increasingly sophisticated during his lessons with his daughters. He creates an ordinary subordinate Dimension and separately constructs a miniature galaxy reinforced through powers such as <Negativity> and <Beginning>, causing the latter to possess dramatically greater existential weight.[35] Norabell can alter ownership of the simple Dimension after understanding its Rules but fails to take control of the Conceptually reinforced galaxy because the structure is far more deeply entrenched in Reality.[35]
Victor later clarifies the limitation of the miniature Eldritch galaxy: the apparent living organisms inside it possess form, Energy and convincing behavior but lack the deeper Conceptual anchor required for truly independent Life.[36] He therefore treats the structure as an extremely sophisticated imitation rather than a completely independent Cosmos.[36]
This distinction is important to power progression. Victor can already construct highly complex Galactic structures, but the narrative itself distinguishes those feats from creating a fully autonomous Universe with its own complete Conceptual foundation.
↑ Return to Power Archive

#### Authority and Combat Power
Victor's late progression makes it especially important to separate what he can govern from how strongly he fights. The greatest example is <Negativity>. Because Negativity forms one of the two foundational halves of the native Universe, Victor's succession to it creates influence on a scale far larger than ordinary Divine Authority.[7]
The System reasons that Victor possesses influence over approximately fifty percent of the native Universe through the Negative component permeating its structures.[7] This even includes portions of the System itself because the System exists inside the same Reality built from Positivity and Negativity.[7]
That does not mean fifty percent of the Universe can be converted directly into one physical punch. Victor later explains that Negativity primarily grants him Authority over different Concepts.[3] He identifies the actual foundation of his fighting strength as the accumulated system he personally constructed: his martial skill, Blood Dragon Progenitor lineage, Eldritch side and control over his powers.[3]
Victor further states that even if the powers unlocked through Negativity were removed, he would still remain extraordinarily powerful because those other foundations would remain.[3] His predatory Blood Dragon nature also gives him a route to reacquire powers through consumption and assimilation rather than depending exclusively upon one inherited Conceptual office.[3]
AUTHORITY<Negativity> determines an enormous portion of what Victor can influence conceptually.
COMBATBlood Dragon physiology, Eldritch nature, martial mastery, control, adaptation and accumulated abilities determine how Victor actually fights.

##### The Primordial Confrontation
Victor's confrontation with the Primordial Beings demonstrates why Authority can matter more than conventional destructive scaling. When Death asks whether Victor believes he can defeat the assembled Primordials directly, Victor answers that he cannot.[7] He does not need to win a conventional battle: destroying or catastrophically corrupting <Negativity> would damage approximately half of the Universe and destabilize the interconnected Positive half as well.[7]
Victor's Eldritch nature makes the threat still worse because he can theoretically contaminate Negativity instead of merely destroying it, spreading foreign corruption through structures connected to the Concept.[7] The Primordials therefore have to account for the damage Victor can cause to the system they exist to preserve, even though the encounter never establishes that conventional Victor simply possesses greater raw combat power than all of them together.
This is a textbook example of why the Progress page keeps combat standing, Threat Level and Authority as separate measurements.
↑ Return to Power Archive

#### Eldritch and Future Progression
Victor's Eldritch progression follows a different path from his ordinary Blood Dragon and Divine development. Azathoth describes him as an immature Eldritch [[Chaos]] rather than a completed Outer God.[19] The Author's later mechanics explanation similarly treats Victor's Eldritch side as a route capable of developing toward the scale occupied by fully matured Outer existences.[38]
The same Author material distinguishes the much later Victor shown in Extra/Future material from the normal mainline character and places that future state in a Multiversal class.[38] That future ceiling should not be back-scaled into present Victor because the amount of development separating the two states is unknown.

#### Interpretation and Limitations

##### Energy Is Not Combat Power
Victor is one of the clearest examples in the novel of why supernatural Energy cannot be used as the sole measure of strength. He possessed roughly God-King quantities of Energy while his practical combat was initially calibrated much lower.[1] The novel later states directly that actual power includes techniques, mentality, racial characteristics and equipment in addition to Energy.[2]

##### Defeating an Opponent Does Not Transfer Every Statistic
A victory proves that Victor's complete fighting system could overcome the demonstrated opponent under those conditions. It does not mean Victor automatically receives every physical statistic, resistance, Authority or destructive feat possessed by that opponent. Victor routinely wins through superior martial skill, adaptation, regeneration, Soul attacks, Blood control, Conceptual attacks, Runes, elemental counters and attacks against the foundation supporting an enemy's powers.

##### The Blood Dragon Evolution Should Not Be Backdated
Victor fights Primordial-class opponents before becoming a Blood Dragon, but his actual racial reconstruction occurs only during the transition of Chapters 802–803.[14][15] Earlier Victor should therefore be described as possessing Primordial-class combat capability where supported, not retroactively classified as already having Blood Dragon physiology.

##### The Fifteen Divinities Belong to Chapter 885
Victor begins crossing into Godhood and developing his Concepts during his ascension in Chapter 884.[16] The explicit statement that he awakened fifteen Divinities appears in the following chapter and should therefore be cited to Chapter 885 rather than using the two chapters interchangeably.[17]

##### Eldritch Chaos Is Explicitly Identified Later
Victor's deeper abnormal nature is foreshadowed much earlier, but the explicit explanation identifying him as an Eldritch [[Chaos]] comes through Azathoth's explanation during the later Eldritch-God discussion.[18][19] Earlier chapters should not be cited as if they had already supplied that exact terminology.

##### Threat Level Is Broad by Design
The Imperial Threat system evaluates danger rather than creating perfectly equal statistical tiers. Fred and Andrew, for example, possess Planetary personal power but are classified V-05 because their complete Divine systems can produce Solar-System-level threat potential.[39] The same principle explains why the difference between lower and upper V-06 entities can be enormous.[23]

##### Multiple-Galaxy Victor Is Chapter 1164
Victor's direct V-06 classification is established with the Threat system in Chapter 1136.[5] The later statement placing Victor and the strongest faction leaders at the top of V-06 with the ability to destroy multiple galaxies simultaneously appears during the Imperial threat discussion in Chapter 1164.[23] These two statements should therefore not share one ambiguous cluster of references.

##### Rank-0 Authority Is Not Raw Fighting Power
Victor's succession to Negativity grants Authority extending throughout an enormous portion of native Reality.[7] Victor himself subsequently explains that this Authority is not the foundation of his combat power and identifies martial skill, Blood Dragon lineage, Eldritch nature and control as the core of his strength.[3]

##### Cosmic Consciousness Is Not Unlimited Omniscience
Victor's Cosmic Consciousness spreads across his Mid-Level Sector but stops when it reaches the enclosing barrier.[5] It should therefore be described as Sector-wide perception rather than unrestricted omniscience.
LIMITSector-wide Cosmic Consciousness ≠ absolute omniscience.

##### Personal-Reality Supremacy Is Contextual
Victor possesses exceptionally high control within his own Personal Reality because the domain is part of his existence and operates according to Rules he can impose. Such local sovereignty should not be converted into a claim that Victor possesses unrestricted absolute omnipotence throughout every external Reality.

##### Artificial Galaxy Is Not a Complete Universe
Victor's conceptually reinforced miniature galaxy possesses enormous existential weight and contains sophisticated Eldritch replicas.[35] Victor himself clarifies that those organisms lack the proper Conceptual anchor of independent Life and that the structure is not a genuinely self-contained Cosmos.[36]

##### Merged-Sector Stabilization Is a Sustained Feat
Victor holding the complete merged Sector together is not equivalent to casually releasing the same amount of Energy as one attack. He is continually maintaining a ritual, preventing Sector advancement and stabilizing a structure whose barrier has become extremely thin.[4] The feat establishes extraordinary sustained output and control while simultaneously providing a concrete limit: its Energy demand eventually exceeds Victor's rate of replenishment.[4]

##### Current Conventional Victor Remains V-06
The last direct classification of Victor's normal combat state places him in the Galactic V-06 category,[5] while later material establishes that he occupies the category's uppermost range.[23] Sector-scale Authority, Reality control or sustained stabilization should be recorded separately unless the novel explicitly assigns his conventional state a new Threat Code.

##### Future Victor Is Separate
The Future/Extra incarnation represents an unknown amount of additional development. Author material uses that later Victor when discussing Multiversal scaling, but the statement does not make present mainline Victor automatically Multiversal.[38]
↑ Return to Power Archive

About this archive
This page describes the personal relationships of Victor Elderblood, including his parents, wives, children, friends, associates and enemies throughout [[MTWABV Series|My Three Wives Are Beautiful Vampires]].
Victor's understanding of "family" differs considerably from an ordinary Human household. His family contains Humans, Vampires, [[Blood Dragons]], Gods, Demons, [[Werewolves]], [[World Trees]], Angels, reincarnated beings and [[Outer Gods]], with relationships established through ordinary birth, Blood Rituals, Soul Marriages, contracts, adoption, reincarnation and direct creation. Victor nevertheless makes a strong distinction between individuals who are technically related to him and those he actually accepts as his family. He is extraordinarily protective toward the latter and repeatedly treats threats against them as personal attacks against himself.[1][2]
Likewise, merely being descended from Victor's Progenitor bloodline does not automatically make someone his child in the personal sense. The children listed here are individuals explicitly treated by the story or Victor's family as his daughters, sons, adopted children or created offspring.

#### Parents
Victor's relationship with the two people who connect his supernatural identity to his Human life.

##### Leon Walker
[[Leon Walker]] is Victor's biological father from his Human life. Leon and Anna Walker raised Victor while he suffered from his extraordinarily rare RH-null blood condition, and despite their son's poor health they maintained a generally affectionate and humorous household. When Victor returned after his transformation into a Vampire, Leon was shocked by the enormous physical change but ultimately accepted both Victor's new condition and Violet as his son's wife.[3]
The relationship became considerably more complicated as Victor's supernatural life expanded. Leon eventually entered the supernatural world himself while Victor ceased being biologically Human, but Victor never stopped recognizing him as the father who raised him. Their greatest personal change occurred after thousands of subjective years had passed for Victor's family. By then Anna had become one of Victor's wives and had given birth to [[Stella Elderblood]]. Leon initially struggled with the reality that his former wife and son had formed an entirely different relationship during the enormous period of supernatural development he had not personally experienced in the same way. Victor nevertheless continued treating Leon as family and allowed him a privileged position around the Elderblood household because of their shared past.[4][5]
Leon eventually accepted that neither Anna nor Victor remained the people they had been during his Human life and began pursuing a life independent of his former marriage. His relationship with Victor is therefore no longer that of an ordinary Human father controlling or advising his adult son, but Victor continues to recognize Leon as one of the few people connected to the life of Victor Walker before the supernatural world transformed everything around him.[4]

##### Anna Elderblood
Anna Walker, later [[Anna Elderblood]], is Victor's biological mother, one of the people he respects most and eventually one of his wives. Anna's blunt honesty, lack of embarrassment and unusually direct way of discussing relationships heavily influenced Victor while he was growing up. When he first returned home as a Vampire, she almost immediately recognized that something impossible had happened to his body, but continued treating him as her son rather than responding to his supernatural transformation with fear.[3]
Anna eventually became a Vampire herself. The transformation amplified emotions and instincts that had previously remained suppressed, forcing her to confront desires and aspects of herself that had existed beneath the restrictions of her Human life. Victor did not encourage her to surrender to those instincts blindly; after returning from centuries in Hell, he instead taught Anna that becoming supernatural did not mean allowing one's impulses to control one's identity.[6]
Over the enormous periods of accelerated Time experienced by the Elderblood family, Anna's relationship with Leon ended and her relationship with Victor fundamentally changed. She eventually became Victor's wife through [[Soul Marriage]], and the two had a biological daughter, [[Stella Elderblood]].[7][8] Despite the unusual change in their relationship, Victor continues to retain both aspects of Anna's importance to him: she remains the mother who raised him while simultaneously being one of the central women of his present family and Empire.
Anna is also among the people most capable of managing Victor's enormous number of daughters. By the late Imperial era, even the children themselves recognize her as one of the principal maternal authorities of the family; in Chapter 1160, Stella, Hinata, Irene and [[Yog-Sothoth]] ultimately go directly to Anna when their schemes concerning photographs of the younger Victor collapse.[9]
