02 · IMPERIAL HOUSEHOLD

#### Wives
The marriages and partnerships at the core of Clan Elderblood and the [[Elderblood Empire]].
Victor's wives form the core of the Elderblood Clan and, eventually, the ruling household of the Elderblood Empire. His marriages originated through numerous supernatural systems—including the original Vampire transformation ritual, Blood Rituals, racial marks, contracts and [[Soul Marriage]]—but Victor ultimately places far more importance on personal recognition than the ritual used to establish the relationship.
Once Victor genuinely accepts someone as his wife, he regards her safety and happiness as his personal responsibility. This possessiveness existed long before he became overwhelmingly powerful; even during his early life as a Vampire he explicitly counted Violet, Ruby, Sasha, [[Scathach]], Natashia and the women of the [[Maid Squad]] among the people who were "his" and whom nobody would be permitted to harm.[1]
By the Imperial era, the women surrounding Victor are no longer merely a harem centered around him. Many independently administer Pantheons, military forces, scientific institutions, planetary projects and major portions of the Empire. Victor increasingly relies upon their individual expertise rather than attempting to personally micromanage every part of his civilization.[10][11]

##### Founding Wives
The three women bound to Victor through the abnormal ritual that transformed him into a Vampire remain emotionally distinct within the much larger family. Their marriages predate Victor's status as a Progenitor, God, Dragon or Emperor and formed the emotional foundation upon which most of his later family was built.

###### Violet Elderblood Snow
[[Violet Elderblood Snow]] is Victor's first wife and the person most directly responsible for his entry into the supernatural world. Violet had already formed a strong attachment to Victor while he was Human and used the Vampire transformation ritual to save him when his health catastrophically deteriorated. The ritual was originally intended to bind Victor specifically to Violet as her husband, but Ruby and Sasha's participation resulted in all three becoming connected to him.[12]
Victor adapted to Violet's obsessive jealousy unusually well because many of the same possessive traits already existed within him. Their early relationship established several patterns that later became characteristic of Victor's family: blood exchange, mutual possessiveness, extreme loyalty and refusal to abandon loved ones merely because remaining together creates political or supernatural danger.[13]
Their bond remains unusually intimate even after more than a hundred thousand years of Imperial development. Violet can immediately notice small changes in Victor's mood and remains one of the wives most willing to interfere when she believes something is troubling him.[14] Their daughter is [[Valentina Victoria Elderblood]].

###### Ruby Elderblood Scarlett
[[Ruby Elderblood Scarlett]] became Victor's wife through the same abnormal transformation ritual, although the two initially knew considerably less about one another than Victor and Violet. The ritual created a powerful blood connection between them before they had properly established an independent romantic relationship.
That changed when Victor deliberately spent time alone with Ruby. Rather than treating her merely as [[Scathach]]'s daughter or one member of his original trio of wives, he gave Ruby private attention and allowed the normally emotionally reserved woman to build memories with him that belonged specifically to the two of them.[15][16]
Victor deeply respects Ruby's intelligence and scientific obsession. By the Imperial era, she has become one of the principal researchers responsible for [[Stellar Arsenal]], integrating [[Magic]], supernatural biology, alien technology and large-scale weapon development.[10] Their relationship therefore functions simultaneously as marriage and one of Victor's most important intellectual partnerships. Their daughter is [[Rosemary Lavina Elderblood]].

###### Sasha Elderblood Fulger
[[Sasha Elderblood Fulger]] became Victor's wife through the same ritual but entered his life during an emotionally catastrophic period. Shortly after Victor's transformation, Sasha returned home to discover that the Inquisition had slaughtered her household and murdered Julia, the maid who had effectively raised her as a mother.[17]
Victor learned Sasha's history through their exchange of blood and understood how completely Julia's death had destabilized her. Rather than encourage suicidal revenge, he ordered Sasha to remain near him, gave her somewhere she could regard as home and made clear that she no longer needed to face her problems alone.[18]
This emotional protection became the foundation of their relationship. Even after the Empire has existed for immense periods of internal Time, Sasha remains openly irritated whenever Imperial responsibilities prevent her from receiving enough time with Victor.[11] Their daughter is [[Silvia Elderblood]].

##### Maid Wives
Several of Victor's wives originally entered his life as maids, servants, rescued dependents or women placed under his protection. Victor gradually rejected the idea that women who had become central to his emotional life should remain permanently defined only as servants.

###### Kaguya Elderblood Blank
[[Kaguya Elderblood Blank]] originally served Victor because she was Violet's maid and Clan Blank had historically existed beneath Clan Snow. Over time, inherited duty became genuine personal loyalty. Kaguya increasingly acted as Victor's shadow, confidante and intelligence gatherer rather than merely Violet's attendant.[19]
Victor openly recognized Kaguya as one of the women precious to him long before their marriage.[1] She later joined Clan Elderblood and became both Victor's wife and chief maid.[20] Her loyalty remains exceptionally direct; by Chapter 986 she is willing to kill a God for attempting to steal credit from Victor and damage his reputation.[21] Their daughter is [[Yuno Elderblood]].

###### Roberta Elderblood
Victor encountered [[Roberta Elderblood]] at the Lost Club and immediately noticed abnormalities surrounding the memories of everyone interacting with her. Instead of killing a potentially dangerous unknown being, Victor restrained her through a supernatural contract and brought her into his household because he wanted to understand what she was.[22]
That decision eventually exposed Roberta's connection to [[Medusa]] Elderblood. Victor's willingness to protect both women and support their desire for revenge gradually transformed Roberta from a dangerous curiosity into a loyal member of his household. She later entered the Elderblood family and became one of Victor's wives.[23]

###### Bruna Elderblood
[[Bruna Elderblood]] was a Human nun rescued by Victor from [[Werewolves]] intending to use her in a supernatural ritual. Victor allowed her to personally take revenge against those responsible before transforming her, completely changing the direction of her life.[24]
Bruna's gratitude developed into near-religious devotion toward Victor. She became part of his [[Maid Squad]] and was one of the women Victor explicitly regarded as personally precious to him.[1] She later entered Clan Elderblood and became his wife.[23]

###### Eve Elderblood
[[Eve Elderblood]] was originally a severely abused child whom Victor rescued and gave a new identity, home and family. She consequently first regarded him principally as a father figure and became both his adopted daughter and maid.[25]
After immense periods of supernatural development, Eve matured and their relationship changed. She eventually joined Clan Elderblood and became Victor's wife as well.[23] She therefore retains an unusual dual role within the family. Their biological daughter is [[Evelyn Elderblood]].

###### Maria Elderblood
[[Maria Elderblood]] began as an Inquisition hunter involved in the attack upon Sasha's household. After Sasha transformed her into a defective Ghoul, Maria was forced to experience existence as the kind of supernatural being she had previously hunted.
Victor later stabilized Maria with his own blood rather than leaving her an incomplete Ghoul, strengthening her existence and giving her a permanent place in his household.[26] Her worldview and loyalty changed dramatically until she became one of Victor's most dependable maids and ultimately one of his wives.[23] Their daughter is [[Melina Elderblood]].

###### Natalia Elderblood née Alioth
Natalia Elderblood was initially one of Violet's attendants and one of the earliest supernatural women Victor met. Her extraordinary Space abilities rapidly made her indispensable for transporting and protecting Victor's family.
Natalia gradually became Victor's personal maid and trusted logistical specialist before their relationship became romantic and was formalized through a supernatural contract and [[Soul Marriage]].[27]
Victor's trust in Natalia becomes even more important during the Imperial era. She is entrusted with controlling the temporal mechanism behind the Empire's 200,000-year accelerated-development project while Victor, Jeanne and the other Empresses maintain the enormous Energy requirement.[28][29] She later demonstrates the ability to accelerate billions of years of geological development for an entire planet.[30]

##### Mother-in-Law & Family-Matriarch Wives
This group contains Victor's literal mothers-in-law as well as several older family matriarchs whose relationship with him eventually became marital.

###### Agnes Elderblood Snow
[[Agnes Elderblood Snow]] first knew Victor as Violet's husband and as the young man carrying memories belonging to her deceased husband, [[Adonis Snow]]. Her attraction toward Victor was consequently complicated by uncertainty over whether she loved Victor himself or merely what remained of Adonis inside him.[31]
Victor refused to become a replacement for a dead man. Agnes eventually accepted that her feelings were directed toward Victor independently and entered his family through the Elderblood Blood Ritual.[32] She later became a Blood Dragon and gave birth to [[Agatha Agnessa Elderblood]].

###### Annasthashia Elderblood Fulger
Victor's earliest relationship with Natashia was openly hostile because he blamed Sasha's parents for much of her childhood suffering. Victor fought both William and Annasthashia directly and forced the latter to confront how badly her relationship with Sasha had deteriorated.[33]
The confrontation helped restore Natashia's original personality. Her attitude toward Victor rapidly became affectionate and obsessive, but Victor refused to allow attraction to erase her responsibilities toward Sasha. He expected Natashia to repair that relationship rather than simply become another woman pursuing him.
Natashia eventually succeeded sufficiently to enter Victor's family as a wife.[34] Victor later repaired the damage in her Soul and separated Natasha and Carmila into independent existences instead of erasing either personality.[35] Their daughter is [[Angelina Elderblood]].

###### Scathach Elderblood Scarlett
[[Scathach Elderblood Scarlett]] is simultaneously Victor's former mother-in-law, martial master and one of his most important wives.
[[Scathach]] recognized Victor's potential extremely early and subjected him to six months of brutal training. Rather than resenting her, Victor came to admire Scathach precisely because she shared his obsession with combat and continual self-improvement. Their personalities became increasingly similar and their master-disciple bond gradually crossed into mutual romantic attachment.[36][37]
After Victor became the Blood Dragon Primogenitor, Scathach was reborn through his lineage and became the Ancestor of the Red Dragons.[38] Even after Victor surpassed nearly every conventional fighter, he continued treating Scathach's accumulated martial experience with exceptional respect.
By the Imperial era, Scathach commands an entire military-training world containing approximately one hundred million recruits, extending the philosophy she once used on Victor to the Empire's armies.[39] Their daughter is [[Siren Elderblood]].

###### Maya Elizabeth Lykos Elderblood
[[Maya Elizabeth Lykos Elderblood]] is the ancient Matriarch of Clan Lykos and Leona's grandmother. Her earliest significant interactions with Victor consisted of direct tests of [[Will Solace|Will]], predatory instinct and martial ability rather than conventional courtship.[40]
Victor's refusal to be intimidated by Maya's age or status earned her respect, while Maya became increasingly interested in his abnormal ability to learn and adapt martial techniques. Their relationship eventually developed into [[Soul Marriage]].[41]
Maya retains her identity and authority as the Lykos Matriarch rather than simply becoming an extension of Victor's household. Their daughter is [[Mirabelle Elizabeth Elderblood]].

###### Anna Elderblood
[[Anna Elderblood]] is Victor's biological mother and later one of his wives. Their early relationship remained parental even after both entered the supernatural world, but enormous periods of accelerated Time fundamentally changed Anna, Victor and Anna's former marriage to Leon.
By the later two-thousand-year period, Anna had become Victor's Soul-Married wife and the mother of [[Stella Elderblood]].[7] She nevertheless remains one of the strongest maternal authorities within Victor's household. Even in Chapter 1160, adult Divine daughters such as Stella, Hinata and Irene still treat Anna as someone capable of resolving family disputes.[9]

###### Carmila Fulger Elderblood
[[Carmila Fulger Elderblood]] is the ancient founder connected to the Fulger bloodline and therefore one of the senior-most matriarchal figures in Victor's extended family.
Her surviving Soul fragment had remained inside Natashia for generations until Victor's Soul abilities allowed Carmila to be separated and restored as an independent existence.[35] She later joined Victor's family during the large-scale Dragon transformations.[42]
Their daughter is Aline Elderblood Fulger.

##### Clan, Martial & Racial Wives

###### Siena Scarlett Elderblood
[[Siena Scarlett Elderblood]] began as Ruby's sister and one of [[Scathach]]'s daughters. Unlike Ruby, she was not connected to Victor through his original transformation ritual, meaning her eventual marriage was a later voluntary decision.
Repeated battles, training and the near-total integration of Clan Scarlett into Victor's household gradually brought Siena into his family. She joined through the Elderblood Blood Ritual with her sisters.[27] Their daughter is [[Sylvia Elderblood]].

###### Lacus Scarlett Elderblood
[[Lacus Scarlett Elderblood]] similarly developed from Victor's sister-in-law into one of his wives as the Scarlett and Elderblood families became increasingly intertwined. She joined Victor through the later family rituals alongside Siena and Pepper.[27]
The novel has given Lacus less individual romantic focus than Ruby or [[Scathach]], so her relationship is primarily shown through the collective Scarlett/Elderblood family dynamic.

###### Pepper Scarlett Elderblood
[[Pepper Scarlett Elderblood]] began as Ruby's eccentric younger sister. Victor consistently encouraged her growth rather than sheltering her, providing training, weapons and opportunities appropriate to her talents.[43]
Pepper eventually entered Clan Elderblood with Siena and Lacus.[27] Their daughter is [[Priscillia Penny Elderblood]].

###### Victoria Fulger Elderblood
[[Victoria Fulger Elderblood]] became increasingly close to Victor as Clan Fulger was rebuilt around Sasha, Natashia and the women Victor had restored.
She eventually joined the Elderblood family through the Blood Ritual.[44] Victor's marriage to Victoria also makes him the stepfather of [[Tatsuya Rider]], whom he already knew independently.

###### Eleanor Elderblood Adrasteia
[[Eleanor Elderblood Adrasteia]] originally interacted with Victor as one of [[Nightingale]]'s [[Vampire Counts]] and a respected military leader. Their relationship developed through mutual martial respect and Victor's cooperation with Clan Adrasteia.
Eleanor eventually entered Clan Elderblood alongside Rose.[45] Victor values her precisely because she remains an independently competent warrior and commander rather than becoming dependent upon him.

###### Rose Adrasteia Elderblood
[[Rose Adrasteia Elderblood]] is one of Victor's most martial wives and entered Clan Elderblood alongside Eleanor.[45]
Even after Victor becomes overwhelmingly more powerful than most beings around him, Rose remains relevant through restricted training in which Victor deliberately suppresses his higher abilities and relies upon martial technique.[46] During the Imperial era she is trusted with responsibilities within the Imperial Guard.[10]

###### Otsuki Elderblood Haruna
[[Otsuki Elderblood Haruna]] originally dealt with Victor as the ruler of Japan's unified Youkai. Their relationship became personal after combat gave Haruna something centuries of political rule had failed to provide: a meaningful challenge and a new reason to pursue growth.[47]
Haruna also became one of Victor's teachers by introducing him to [[Senjutsu]].[48] Their relationship eventually became marital through her Youki Mark and [[Soul Marriage]].[27]

###### Mizuki Elderblood
[[Mizuki Elderblood]] was originally one of the most dangerous Inquisition hunters Victor encountered during his first days as a Vampire.[49]
Their relationship later changed beyond recognition. Mizuki trained Victor in Hunter methods and [[Martial Arts]], while Victor eventually came to understand the trauma that had originally driven her hatred toward Vampires.[50][51]
The former Vampire hunter ultimately became part of the Elderblood family through an Onmyō-based ritual and [[Soul Marriage]].[27]

###### Leona Elizabeth Elderblood Lykos
[[Leona Elizabeth Elderblood Lykos]] is one of the few wives who knew Victor while he was still the sickly Human Victor Walker.
Their childhood history gives Leona a perspective that almost none of Victor's later wives possess. Despite the complications caused by Leona's hidden Werewolf identity and disappearance from Victor's ordinary life, the emotional connection between them survived.
Leona later joined Victor through a Werewolf Mark and [[Soul Marriage]].[52][27] Their daughter is [[Leone Elena Luna Elderblood]], who inherits the family's obsession with strength and eventually requests direct training from [[Scathach]].[9]

##### Goddess & Divine Wives

###### Jeanne Elderblood
[[Jeanne Elderblood]] became close to Victor through [[Nightingale]]'s supernatural conflicts and the hidden truth surrounding her relationship with [[The Universal Tree]]. Victor helped Jeanne recover important parts of her forgotten past, while Jeanne became one of the people capable of understanding increasingly cosmic aspects of his development.
Their relationship eventually developed into marriage.[53] Jeanne later becomes one of the few beings powerful enough to act alongside Victor as a principal anchor during the Empire's massive Time-acceleration ritual.[29] Their daughter is [[Isabelle Elderblood]].

###### Aphrodite Elderblood
Victor's relationship with [[Aphrodite]] Elderblood began through mutual fascination and caution. Victor distrusted the influence of a Goddess whose powers governed Beauty, Desire and Love, while Aphrodite was fascinated by his abnormal existence.
Their relationship changed when Aphrodite showed genuine concern regarding the dangerous Blessings surrounding him. Victor recognized that concern as sincere and asked Aphrodite to become his wife, resulting in a true [[Soul Marriage]].[54]
Aphrodite later becomes emotionally committed enough to Victor's household that she ultimately disowns [[Eros]] after concluding that he cared more about the advantages of her new family than rebuilding a genuine relationship with her.[55] Their daughter is [[Irene Elderblood]].

###### Medusa Elderblood
[[Medusa]] Elderblood originally existed through Roberta and carried a deep hatred toward the Gods responsible for her suffering.
Victor earned Medusa's loyalty by refusing to dismiss her desire for revenge and promising that she would eventually receive an opportunity to settle her past. Her affection consequently developed independently of Roberta's own feelings, and Medusa eventually became recognized as Victor's wife.[56]

###### Tasha Fenrir Elderblood
[[Tasha Fenrir Elderblood]] is an ancient Divine Werewolf whose relationship with Victor combines attraction, political cooperation and mutual respect between powerful racial figures.
Victor eventually openly declared that he intended to keep Tasha beside him regardless of attempts by others to dictate her choices.[57] Their relationship subsequently became an acknowledged romantic union and [[Soul Marriage]].[58]
Through Tasha, Victor also becomes stepfather to Anderson, Thomas and Fenir, although his friendship with Anderson predates the marriage.

###### Amaterasu Elderblood
[[Amaterasu]] Elderblood originally stood before Victor as the supreme Goddess of the [[Shinto Pantheon]]. Their relationship developed as Victor's political influence over Earth's Pantheons expanded and personal attraction gradually replaced distance between sovereigns.
Amaterasu eventually became one of Victor's Divine wives.[59] Their daughter, Hinata-Omikami, later becomes a Goddess of the highest rank within Amaterasu's Pantheon.[9]

###### Persephone Elderblood
[[Persephone Elderblood]] originally existed on the opposite side of Victor's interests as one of the great Greek Goddesses.
Their relationship developed through conflict and negotiation after the collapse of the former Greek order. [[Persephone]] ultimately entered Victor's family through [[Soul Marriage]].[60]
Their conversations also helped define Victor's possessive philosophy: once he recognizes someone as belonging to his faction or family, he tends to consider their problems part of his own responsibility.[60]

###### Gaia Elderblood
[[Gaia]] Elderblood was originally a genuine enemy during Victor's conflict with the Greek Primordials.[61]
Victor defeated Gaia but did not permanently destroy her. She later entered the Elderblood family and became one of his wives during the large-scale Dragon transformations.[42]
Their daughter, [[Gina Elderblood]], develops extraordinary authority over Life.[62]

###### Nyx Elderblood
Nyx Elderblood originally existed as an ancient Primordial Goddess whose influence around Victor was sufficiently dangerous that [[Aphrodite]] warned him about her Blessing.
Over time Nyx ceased being an external Primordial influence and voluntarily joined Victor's family, becoming one of his wives during the Dragon transformations.[42]
Their daughter is [[Nikolina Nia Nefela Elderblood]]. Victor also becomes stepfather to [[Nemesis]], [[Hypnos]] and [[Thanatos]].

###### Hestia Elderblood
[[Hestia]] Elderblood became closely connected to Victor through the Concept most compatible with the central motivation behind his entire civilization: [[Rex Invictus|Home]] and Family.
Before becoming his wife, Hestia Blessed Victor's entire family rather than Victor alone, explaining that he was automatically included within the household she had protected.[63]
Hestia later entered the Elderblood family directly during the Dragon transformations.[42]

###### Hela Elderblood
[[Hela Elderblood]] began as Victor's strategic ally during the conspiracy that destroyed [[Odin]]'s rule and triggered Ragnarök.
Their cooperation gradually became genuine personal attachment. After Hela defeated Odin and inherited the remains of [[Asgard]], she continued acting independently rather than becoming merely Victor's subordinate.[64]
Hela later became one of Victor's Soul-Married wives.[65]

###### Ariel Elderblood
[[Ariel Elderblood]] began as one of the highest-ranking Angels of [[Biblical Heaven]]. Her connection to Victor grew as the separation between Heaven and Victor's faction steadily diminished.
Their relationship developed through repeated cooperation and mutual trust rather than conquest or inherited ritual, ultimately culminating in [[Soul Marriage]].[66]
Their daughter, [[Ariella Victoria Elderblood]], later freely moves between the Elderblood family and the [[Heavenly Father]], demonstrating how completely Ariel's marriage connected the two previously separate Divine families.[67]

###### Kali Elderblood
Victor's relationship with [[Kali Elderblood]] is strongly defined by battle and training. Victor repeatedly restricts himself during their fights so Kali can improve her technique rather than depending exclusively upon Destruction and overwhelming Divine power.[68]
Their similar enthusiasm for combat produces a comparatively playful dynamic, and Kali is formally included among Victor's wives by Chapter 1123.[65] Their daughter is [[Kassandra Kashvi Elderblood]].[69]

##### World Tree, Dragon & Cosmic Wives

###### Roxanne Elderblood
[[Roxanne Elderblood]] is one of the most structurally important people in Victor's existence. Their relationship began when Victor unknowingly completed a form of Dryad marriage by consuming Roxanne's fruit/core while she consumed his blood.[70]
Victor named her Roxanne and consistently treated her as a person rather than a supernatural resource. Roxanne later became deeply integrated into Victor's Soul, refining his existence, supporting his World Tree functions and becoming one of the foundations of his Personal Universe.
Together with Amara, Roxanne later reorganized Victor's immense collection of abilities around the deeper duality of Negativity and Beginnings.[71] Their children include [[Metis]] Elderblood and [[Rosalyn Elderblood]].

###### Amara Elderblood
[[Amara Elderblood]] is a Positive World Tree and the natural counterpart to Roxanne's Negative nature.
Her relationship with Victor developed through the increasingly cosmic structure of his Soul and his attempt to understand the Positive/Negative duality underlying his existence. Amara eventually became one of his Soul-Married wives.[72]
She later worked with Roxanne to reorganize Victor's absorbed powers and internal cosmology.[71] Their daughter is [[Amaya Elderblood]].

###### Zaladrac Zeovnur Elderblood
[[Zaladrac Zeovnur Elderblood]] is an Ancient Dragon whose relationship with Victor originated through Draconic hierarchy and combat rather than conventional courtship.
Victor's ability to defeat and interact with Zaladrac demonstrated that he had become capable of standing within the social hierarchy of [[True Dragons]] despite originally being Human. She eventually became one of his Soul-Married wives.[73]
Zaladrac later assisted in reinforcing Victor's world with Dragon Runes and defensive systems.[74]

###### Velnorah Xyphora Elderblood Thaloria II
[[Velnorah Xyphora Elderblood Thaloria II]] originates from an advanced extraterrestrial civilization and therefore approaches supernatural phenomena through a perspective radically different from Earth's Gods and Vampires.
Victor values Velnorah's scientific intelligence and ability to merge technology with supernatural principles. Their cooperation eventually developed into marriage, and Velnorah later became a Blood Dragon.[42]
Their daughter, [[Velina Velnorah Elderblood Thaloria III]], became directly relevant to research surrounding the [[Dragon Heart]].[75]

###### Azathoth Elderblood
[[Azathoth Elderblood]] is Victor's most cosmologically unusual wife. Unlike the Gods and Dragons within his native Creation, Azathoth exists far beyond the conventional boundaries of Victor's Universe.
Their connection became sufficiently personal to be recognized as [[Soul Marriage]].[76] Even immense cosmological separation does not sever their relationship; Azathoth later succeeds in inserting an avatar into the private communications used by Victor's wives.[77]
Their union produces [[Yog-Sothoth]] Elderblood, [[Nyarlathotep]], [[Shub-Niggurath]] and [[Cthulhu]]. Victor treats these otherwise incomprehensible Outer-God entities simply as members of his family rather than cosmic tools.

##### Demon Wives

###### Morgana Elderblood
[[Morgana Elderblood]] entered Victor's life with extensive knowledge of Hell and the Demonic hierarchy. Her allegiance gradually shifted from the old Demonic order toward Victor's household, and during the Demonic War she increasingly treated Victor's family as her own.[78]
Morgana ultimately entered Clan Elderblood alongside Jeanne.[53] Through Morgana, Victor also becomes stepfather to Elizabeth and [[Lilith Tepes]].

###### Vine Elderblood
[[Vine]] Elderblood originally confronted Victor as a Demon King in Hell. Victor destroyed her armies and children but deliberately spared Vine herself.[79]
After Victor reorganized Hell, Vine ceased being an enemy and eventually became one of his Demon wives.[80]

###### Vepar Elderblood
[[Vepar Elderblood]] was another Demon who survived the collapse of the old Hell hierarchy and eventually entered Victor's household.
The novel gives comparatively little individualized romantic focus to Vepar, but by Chapter 888 she is explicitly recognized among Victor's Demon wives.[80]

###### Helena Gremory Elderblood
Helena Gremory Elderblood originates from the Gremory Demonic lineage and became part of Victor's family after the destruction of the old Hell structure.
She is recognized among Victor's Demon wives by Chapter 888.[80] Victor and Helena later have a daughter.

###### Lily Elderblood
[[Lily Elderblood]] also became one of Victor's Demon wives during the restructuring of Hell.[80]
Her marriage makes Victor the technical stepfather of [[Luka Bael]], despite Luka's earlier association with hostile Demonic factions.

###### Lilith Elderblood
[[Lilith Elderblood]] was once one of the most important rulers of old Hell and originally stood opposite Victor during his rise.
Victor defeated Lilith but did not permanently eliminate her.[73] After witnessing the civilization he built from the collapse of the former Demonic order, Lilith eventually became integrated into his family and is recognized as one of his wives by Chapter 888.[80]
Their daughter, [[Liriel Elderblood]], inherits characteristics from both a True Demon Progenitor and Victor's Blood Dragon lineage.[81]

###### Aline Elderblood Valefar
[[Aline Elderblood Valefar]] originates from the Valefar lineage and became one of the later Demon women incorporated into Victor's family.
Her marital status is established after the first group of Demon wives.[82]

##### Later Imperial Wives

###### Hilda Snow Elderblood
[[Hilda Snow Elderblood]] had long existed within the wider Snow-family sphere before entering Victor's central family.
Her marriage is formally established during the later Imperial-development period.[83] The novel gives her less individual romantic focus than many earlier wives, so her relationship is best understood through her long-term integration into the Snow/Elderblood household.

###### Natasha Elderblood Fulger
[[Natasha Elderblood Fulger]] originally existed as a personality created by the spiritual damage surrounding Natashia and Carmila.
Victor refused to erase Natasha merely to restore Natashia. Instead, he separated her into an independent existence possessing her own body and Soul.[35]
Natasha subsequently entered Victor's family as one of his wives during the Dragon transformations.[42] Their daughter is [[Julia Elderblood]].

###### Dun Scaith Elderblood
[[Dun Scaith Elderblood]] became close to Victor through the martial circles surrounding [[Scathach]] and the Elderblood household.
Their relationship is heavily associated with training and shared pursuit of strength. She is explicitly included among Victor's wives by Chapter 1123.[65]

###### Albedo Moriarty Elderblood
[[Albedo Moriarty Elderblood]] influenced Victor long before becoming his wife, secretly Blessing him while still operating principally as the legendary [[Chaos]] Witch.
Victor later became increasingly interested in Albedo because her magical knowledge, scientific curiosity and willingness to investigate dangerous phenomena closely matched his own intellectual tendencies.
She formally enters Victor's family by Chapter 1123.[65] Through Albedo, Victor also becomes connected to Evie Moriarty as extended family.

##### Daughter-Wives & Created Wives
Several of Victor's daughters or created offspring later acquired an additional marital relationship with him after reaching adulthood. Their later position as wives does not erase their original familial relationship; they remain listed in the Children section as well.
By the late Imperial era Victor had already accepted that several of his adult daughters possessed romantic feelings toward him, and Chapter 1153 establishes that his household could eventually expand dramatically because of this.[84]

###### Ophis Tepes Elderblood
[[Ophis Tepes Elderblood]] originally entered Victor's life as Vlad's young daughter. Victor treated the quiet child affectionately before knowing her political identity, causing Ophis to attach herself to him and begin calling him "Father".[85]
Victor later treated Ophis increasingly as his own daughter rather than merely Vlad's child, personally training her and eventually incorporating her into his lineage.[86][87]
By the Imperial era Ophis had matured into one of the leaders of the Imperial Guard.[10] Her relationship with Victor later became marital as well, giving her the dual position of lineage daughter and wife.[84][88]

###### Nero Elderblood
[[Nero Elderblood]] initially resisted Victor considerably more than Ophis, but Victor's consistent refusal to abandon or mistreat her gradually produced a genuine father-daughter bond.
He formally adopted [[Nero]] into his lineage and personally trained her alongside Ophis, expecting both girls to develop discipline rather than rely upon overwhelming natural talent.[87]
By the Imperial era Nero serves alongside Ophis within the Imperial Guard.[10] Her adult relationship with Victor later becomes marital as well.[84][88]

###### Metis Elderblood
[[Metis]] Elderblood was fundamentally reconstructed and reborn through Victor and Roxanne. Upon awakening she instinctively recognized Victor as her father, and Victor accepted her as his daughter rather than treating her as a political remnant of her previous Divine existence.[89]
Her position within the family is later reinforced when Victor's household explicitly treats her simply as one of his daughters rather than an extension of [[Zeus]]' old Pantheon.[90]
Metis eventually also became one of Victor's Soul-Married wives, giving her a permanent dual status as daughter and wife.

###### Akasha Elderblood
[[Akasha Elderblood]] was created directly from Victor's Soul, Blood and Eldritch Divinity as an independent ego designed to protect his family and administer increasingly complex systems.
Victor deliberately gave Akasha genuine free will rather than creating a mindless program, treating her as a daughter rather than a mere artificial intelligence.[91]
She later becomes one of the most important administrative existences in the Empire and, by Chapter 1155, is also recognized among Victor's wives.[88]

###### Melida Charlotte Elderblood
[[Melida Charlotte Elderblood]] was created from the remaining Soul foundation of [[Merlin]], but Victor reconstructed her so extensively that the resulting being was treated as a new person rather than a revived Merlin.
Victor named her, gave her the Elderblood identity and accepted her as his daughter.[92] Melida's extraordinary understanding of Energy later helped Victor advance his comprehension of Attributeless Energy.[93]
By Chapter 1155, Melida is also counted among Victor's wives.[88]

##### Confirmed Fiancée

###### Tyche
[[Tyche]] served within Victor's civilization for an immense period before their relationship became romantic. Victor had already invested heavily in her growth because of the strategic importance of her Luck Divinity and had received her Complete Blessing.
Violet eventually decided that Tyche should be brought closer to Victor, but Victor refused to allow Violet to manufacture the entire relationship. He approached Tyche directly and proposed that the two spend time together so they could determine their feelings naturally.[94][88]
By Chapter 1156, Tyche privately regarded Victor as her fiancé; the narration explicitly notes that she was not yet technically married to him.[95] She should therefore remain immediately adjacent to the wife roster as a confirmed prospective spouse until a later chapter explicitly records the completed marriage.

03 · HOUSEHOLD DYNAMICS

#### Victor's Relationship with His Wives as a Group
How Victor and his wives function collectively as a family and ruling household.
Victor does not organize his household according to a strict conventional ranking in which later wives are inherently less important than earlier ones. Violet, Ruby and Sasha retain unique significance because they were present at the beginning of his supernatural life, but Victor repeatedly refuses the idea that a later wife becomes disposable simply because someone else came first.
The result is an unusually cohesive family composed of women who historically belonged to mutually hostile species and civilizations. Vampires, [[Werewolves]], Goddesses, Demons, Dragons, Angels, [[World Trees]], Witches and [[Outer Gods]] eventually cooperate in raising Victor's descendants and governing the [[Elderblood Empire]].
By the mature Imperial era, many of Victor's wives possess major responsibilities independent of him: Ruby and Velnorah advance Imperial science; Natalia governs enormous Space-Time systems; [[Scathach]] trains armies; Kaguya executes sensitive Imperial operations; Jeanne sustains civilization-scale rituals; [[Aphrodite]] and the surviving Greek Goddesses preserve their culture; and the Fulger women administer their own branches of the family and Empire.[28][10][96][30][39][11]
Victor remains the emotional center of the household, but the Elderblood Empire increasingly functions through the independent competence of the women surrounding him.
↑ Return to Relationship Index
04 · DYNASTY

#### Children
Biological, adopted, reconstructed, metaphysical and directly created children.
Victor's relationship with his children is one of the clearest examples of how little becoming an Emperor changed his core personality. When he returned to a family that had experienced roughly two thousand years of accelerated development, he immediately became excessively affectionate and protective toward the enormous new generation of daughters. His wives quickly realized that Victor's already extreme possessiveness became even stronger where his children were concerned.[7][97]
However, Victor does not want his children to become helpless simply because they were born overwhelmingly powerful. He spends time learning their personalities and ambitions individually,[98] personally trains several of them, and eventually creates large-scale War Games that deliberately strip away familiar advantages so his daughters are forced to adapt and think independently.[99] By Chapter 1160, this philosophy has become a formal family rule: Victor forbids his daughters from casually using supernatural powers against one another outside agreed training or combat because he does not want them solving every disagreement through overwhelming force.[9]

Victor personally observes Gina's extraordinary Life-related abilities while spending time learning about the new generation.[62] He later includes her in his War Games as a Dryad specifically to force adaptation outside her normal advantages.[99] Gina appears to have inherited Victor's tendency to push talented people toward improvement, as shown when she provokes Isabelle into training seriously in Chapter 1160.[9]
[[Angelina Elderblood]]
[[Annasthashia Elderblood Fulger]]
Angelina is introduced during Victor's period of personally becoming acquainted with the daughters born during the accelerated years.[62] Her individual relationship has not yet received extensive standalone focus, but she is included within the intensely protected second generation and the Fulger branch of Victor's family.
[[Yuno Elderblood]]
[[Kaguya Elderblood Blank]]
Yuno is one of the daughters Victor later places inside the family War Games. Rather than allowing her to use her normal Blood Dragon inheritance, he temporarily assigns her the role and powers of a Necromancer, forcing her to solve problems through unfamiliar abilities.[104][99] This reflects Victor's tendency to turn even family activities into training intended to make his daughters more adaptable.
[[Julia Elderblood]]
[[Natasha Elderblood Fulger]]
Julia is born after Victor gives Natasha an independent existence, making her family line possible only because Victor refused to erase Natasha when repairing Natashia.[35][105] Her individual father-daughter relationship has not yet received extensive focus.
[[Evelyn Elderblood]]
[[Eve Elderblood]]
Evelyn belongs to the daughters introduced during the period in which Victor's children constantly gather around him and compete for his attention.[106] The story has not yet given her a major independent father-daughter arc.
[[Nikolina Nia Nefela Elderblood]]
Nyx Elderblood
Nikolina is another daughter introduced during Victor's intensely doting-father period.[106] Victor treats her as part of the same family regardless of the immense age and Primordial status of her mother, reinforcing his tendency to disregard supernatural hierarchy inside his household.
[[Irene Elderblood]]
[[Aphrodite]] Elderblood
Irene inherits an extreme form of Love and displays a particularly strong attachment to Victor. In Chapter 1160 she conspires with Hinata to obtain rare photographs of Victor from his youth, demonstrating that even after reaching adulthood and Divine status she remains openly obsessed with sentimental objects connected to her father.[105][9]
[[Melina Elderblood]]
[[Maria Elderblood]]
Melina is introduced among the daughters surrounding Victor during the post-time-skip family chapters.[106] Her individual relationship has not yet received substantial independent focus beyond Victor's general affection and protectiveness toward the second generation.
Aline Elderblood Fulger
[[Carmila Fulger Elderblood]]
Aline represents the continuation of the restored Carmila/Fulger lineage through Victor. She is introduced during the same period in which Victor's children constantly compete for his attention.[105] Her relationship with Victor has not yet received a major standalone arc.
[[Velina Velnorah Elderblood Thaloria III]]
[[Velnorah Xyphora Elderblood Thaloria II]]
Velina's unusual biology and Energy become directly relevant to research surrounding the [[Dragon Heart]]. Victor therefore encounters her not only as a daughter but as proof of the unprecedented kinds of life his family is producing.[75] Nothing indicates that he treats her principally as research material; she remains his daughter while her existence also becomes scientifically important to the Empire.
[[Rosalyn Elderblood]]
Roxanne Elderblood
Rosalyn is one of the daughters associated directly with Victor's World Tree family. Chapter 1007 places her within a strongly paternal sequence centered on Victor's promise to remain with his daughters regardless of where they are, reinforcing the emotional security he attempts to give the younger generation.[107]
[[Amaya Elderblood]]
[[Amara Elderblood]]
Like Rosalyn, Amaya is part of Victor's World Tree branch and appears within the family material of Chapter 1007. Victor's relationship with these daughters emphasizes that even children whose nature is tied to cosmic World Tree forces are treated first as his family rather than as embodiments of Positive or Negative power.[107]
[[Agatha Agnessa Elderblood]]
[[Agnes Elderblood Snow]]
Agatha is one of Victor and Agnes' daughters and another extension of the Snow branch of his family.[108] Her individual relationship with Victor remains less explored than those of the daughters featured during Chapters 987–1007.
[[Priscillia Penny Elderblood]]
[[Pepper Scarlett Elderblood]]
Priscillia is explicitly included among the daughters involved in the era of Victor's large family-training exercises.[109] Like the others, she is expected to learn through experience rather than being protected from every difficulty by her father.
Hinata-Omikami
[[Amaterasu]] Elderblood
By Chapter 1160 Hinata is a Goddess of the highest rank within her mother's Pantheon, yet her behavior around Victor remains highly personal and childish compared with her public status. She conspires with Irene to steal rare photographs of the younger Victor and openly admits that when her father is involved she is willing to abandon the dignity she normally claims to possess.[9]
[[Liriel Elderblood]]
[[Lilith Elderblood]]
Liriel inherits characteristics from both Victor's True Dragon lineage and Lilith's True Demon lineage. Her enormous pride and dangerous potential require active discipline, with Lilith personally training her rather than allowing such inherited power to develop without restraint.[81] Victor's wider parenting philosophy similarly treats her strength as something requiring cultivation rather than an excuse for indulgence.
[[Sylvia Elderblood]]
[[Siena Scarlett Elderblood]]
Sylvia belongs to the later Scarlett branch of Victor's descendants.[110] Her individual relationship with Victor has not yet received extensive narrative focus, but she exists within the same martial family culture created by Victor, Scathach and the Scarlett women.
[[Mirabelle Elizabeth Elderblood]]
[[Maya Elizabeth Lykos Elderblood]]
Mirabelle represents the direct union of Victor's Blood Dragon lineage with the ancient Lykos family.[111] Her individual bond with Victor has not yet been explored extensively in comparison with Leone or Kassandra.
[[Leone Elena Luna Elderblood]]
[[Leona Elizabeth Elderblood Lykos]]
Leone clearly inherits Victor's obsession with growth. By Chapter 1160 she openly admits that she is dissatisfied with the gap between herself and several sisters and establishes Scathach as the level she wishes to reach. Leona responds by arranging direct training with Scathach, and Victor's family culture treats Leone's unreasonable ambition as something to cultivate rather than suppress.[110][9]
[[Ariella Victoria Elderblood]]
[[Ariel Elderblood]]
Ariella freely travels between Victor's family and [[Biblical Heaven]] and is close enough to the Heavenly Father to visit him together with Ariel.[67] Her existence embodies Victor's approach to family: the daughter of a Blood Dragon God and one of Heaven's greatest Angels is not forced to choose between the two sides of her heritage.
Kassandra Kashvi Elderblood
[[Kali Elderblood]]
Kassandra displays one of the strongest inherited versions of Victor's possessiveness. Her attachment to him becomes so intense that when Kali disciplines her she threatens to report the punishment to Victor, treating her father as the person who will inevitably take her side.[69][112] When she suspects Kali of behaving improperly toward another man, her expression becomes eerily similar to Victor's own possessive state, demonstrating how strongly his personality influenced her alongside his powers.

Relationship with Victor

Victor met Ophis without knowing she was Vlad's daughter and immediately treated the lonely child affectionately. Ophis quickly began calling him "Father".[85] Victor later trained her personally and increasingly treated her as his daughter rather than merely a princess under his protection.[86][87] By the Imperial era she has matured into a commander of the Imperial Guard,[10] and later also acquires the dual role of Victor's wife.

[[Nero]] initially resisted Victor's attempts to become close to her, but his refusal to abandon her eventually produced a genuine father-daughter relationship. Eve was originally rescued as an abused child and given a new identity and home by Victor.[25] She therefore first regarded him as a father figure before later becoming his wife after immense periods of supernatural development. The relationship retains both historical aspects.

Victor created Akasha directly from his Soul, Blood and Eldritch power but deliberately gave her an independent ego and free will rather than treating her as a disposable artificial intelligence. He recognizes her as his daughter and Guardian of the family.[91] She later becomes one of the most important administrative existences in the Empire and eventually one of his wives.
[[Melida Charlotte Elderblood]]
Victor reconstructed the surviving foundation of [[Merlin]]'s Soul into a new person and explicitly accepted that new existence as his daughter rather than treating her as Merlin restored.[92] Melida's unusual understanding of Attributeless Energy later contributes directly to Victor's own advancement.[93] She eventually also becomes one of his wives.
War
Victor created War by combining powers and Essences associated with the Four Horsemen. Rather than treating the resulting Progenitor as a manufactured weapon, Victor recognizes War as his son, while War instinctively acknowledges Victor as both creator and King.[113] By Chapter 1158 War has become Victor's strongest Herald and is trusted to resolve Upper-Sector incidents independently before Victor needs to personally intervene.[114]

05 · COMPANIONS

#### Friends
Personal relationships preserved beyond rank, race and supernatural power.
Victor has relatively few people he calls ordinary friends compared to the enormous number of wives, followers and subordinates surrounding him. His oldest friendships are particularly important because those individuals knew Victor Walker before he became a Progenitor, God or Emperor.

##### Edward Jonathan Lykos
[[Edward Jonathan Elizabeth Lykos|Edward Jonathan Lykos]] is one of Victor's oldest friends and Leona's older brother. During their childhood, Edward defended the physically frail Victor and the albino Leona from bullies and taught Victor basic forms of self-defense. Victor, Edward, Fred and Andrew maintained a joking "bro code" throughout their youth, making them among the few people who interact with Victor without beginning from fear of his supernatural reputation.
Thousands of subjective years and an enormous difference in power did not erase that friendship. When Victor reunited with Edward, Fred and Andrew during the Imperial era, he became frustrated at how little some of them had developed but still personally Blessed all three and promised that the Emperor would remain with them wherever they traveled.[118]

##### Frederick Winter
[[Frederick Winter]] is one of Victor's closest Human-era friends. Fred's supernatural development never approached Victor's absurd rate of growth, something that eventually annoyed Victor enough that he threatened to personally retrain him through brutal methods.[118] That frustration is itself evidence of Victor's affection: he expects Fred to make use of the opportunities and body he has been given rather than remaining mediocre.
Fred later changes his Faith toward Victor, significantly strengthening his supernatural techniques, and receives Victor's personal Blessing alongside Edward and Andrew.[119]

##### Andrew Walter
[[Andrew Walter]] is another member of Victor's original group of Human friends and one of the increasingly rare people connected to his ordinary pre-supernatural life. Like Edward and Fred, he survives into the Imperial era and receives Victor's personal Blessing in Chapter 1118.[119]

##### Adam William Lykos
[[Adam William Lykos]] knew Victor from his Human life and later encountered him again after both men's supernatural identities were impossible to ignore. Despite the traditional hostility between Vampires and [[Werewolves]], the two can speak with the familiarity of people who remember the physically weak Human Victor.[120] Victor respects Adam's martial ability and frequently teases him about his romantic life.

##### Anderson
Anderson is the second son of the [[Lycaon|Werewolf King]] and one of Victor's most natural combat friendships. Their similar battle-maniac personalities caused them to connect almost immediately. A prolonged duel ended without a decisive victor because Victor voluntarily stopped once he was satisfied, after which he simply invited Anderson inside for a drink.[115] Anderson later became Victor's technical stepson through Tasha, but their friendship predates that family connection.

##### Tatsuya Rider
[[Tatsuya Rider]] became a recurring ally through the Fulger family and supernatural conflicts surrounding Victor. Their relationship is substantially more relaxed than Victor's relationships with most political allies. Tatsuya later also became Victor's technical stepson after Victoria joined the family.

##### Big Guy
[[Diablo|Big Guy]] was originally Roxanne's guardian. Victor met him in the Fulger territory while investigating the strange being who would later become Roxanne. Victor's protection of Roxanne allowed the two to become allies and eventually friends rather than enemies competing over the young World Tree.

##### Valkyries
Victor developed an amicable relationship with the Valkyries associated with Clan Adrasteia after fighting and traveling alongside them in dangerous supernatural territory. The relationship later became part of the much larger military and Divine network surrounding the [[Elderblood Empire]].

##### Yotsuba Kuroka
[[Yotsuba Kuroka]] is one of Haruna's closest subordinates and became Victor's friend during his time among the Youkai. Their interactions are considerably less formal than his relationships with most supernatural rulers, with Victor frequently teasing her verbal habit of ending sentences with "-nya".
↑ Return to Relationship Index
06 · ALLIES & CONTACTS

#### Associates
Political partners, cosmic contacts, allied institutions and strategic relationships.
This section covers major allies, political partners, cosmic contacts and institutional relationships that are important to Victor but do not fit cleanly into "friend" or immediate family.

##### Vlad Dracula Tepes
[[Vlad Dracula Tepes]] was simultaneously Victor's King, political superior, rival and predecessor as Vampire Progenitor during Victor's early life. Victor respected Vlad's experience but never accepted the idea that becoming a second Progenitor made him another subordinate of the Tepes crown. By the [[Supernatural Gathering]] he openly treated Clan Alucard as an independent power rather than an extension of Vlad's rule.[121]
Their relationship therefore remains complicated rather than purely friendly. Victor has fought beside Vlad and became related to several members of the Tepes family through marriage, but he also surpassed and ultimately erased Vlad's residual influence from his own Progenitor lineage.

##### The Universal Tree
[[The Universal Tree]] is one of Victor's most important cosmic associates and is additionally related to him through Roxanne and Amara. Victor first gained the entity's gratitude after restoring Jeanne's forgotten relationship with it, after which the Universal Tree repaired damage to Victor's Soul.[122] Their relationship became increasingly important as Victor created planets, manipulated Souls and developed a Personal Universe. The Universal Tree is one of the few beings capable of intervening in cosmic disputes involving Victor without automatically being treated as an enemy.

##### The Heavenly Father
The [[Heavenly Father]] began as the ruler of a major external Pantheon whose ideology and powers did not naturally align with Victor. Their relationship eventually developed into cooperation as Heaven became increasingly integrated with Victor's family and Empire. The connection became even more personal after [[Ariel Elderblood]] became Victor's wife and [[Ariella Victoria Elderblood]] was born.[123][67]

##### Shiva and the Hindu Pantheon
[[Shiva]] and the [[Indian Pantheon|Hindu Pantheon]] were initially independent powers whose interests repeatedly conflicted with Victor's growing influence. By Chapter 1085, Victor gave the Hindu rulers the choice between submission and destruction; they chose submission.[124] The Pantheon subsequently became a subordinate Imperial faction rather than an enemy, receiving Elderblood resources so that it could strengthen itself for the coming Upper-Sector war.[125]

##### The Owner of Limbo
The Owner of Limbo is neither a conventional ally nor an enemy. As the Primordial associated with Balance, he observes Victor because Victor's growth is capable of altering the cosmic equilibrium the Regulators maintain. Their conversations are unusually direct for interactions between Victor and a cosmic administrator, with the Owner openly explaining aspects of the Universe while simultaneously acknowledging his interest in what Victor will eventually become.[126]

##### Evie Moriarty and the Arcane Realm
Evie Moriarty began as a difficult political opponent during the Demonic War. Victor confronted her over her negotiations with [[Diablo]] and succeeded in forcing the ancient Witch Queen into a position where she had to acknowledge that he had manipulated their discussion more effectively than she expected.[116] Their relationship later shifted from opposition to alliance, and by the Imperial period the Arcane Realm functions within Victor's wider sphere. Albedo's later marriage to Victor also makes Evie part of his extended family.

##### Viviane and the Fairies
[[Viviane]] and the surviving Fairies entered Victor's wider alliance during the Demonic War after Natashia and Sasha offered them protection. Their relationship with Victor is based primarily on sanctuary, mutual benefit and the security offered by his expanding faction rather than romantic or personal intimacy.[127]

##### Clan Scarlett
Clan Scarlett was Victor's first major Vampire-clan alliance and eventually became nearly indistinguishable from his family because he married Ruby, [[Scathach]], Siena, Lacus and Pepper. Its martial traditions and members form an important part of the Elderblood military structure.

##### Clan Fulger
Clan Fulger moved from a damaged Count lineage into one of Victor's strongest family alliances. Through Sasha, Natashia, Victoria, Natasha and Carmila, the Fulger bloodline became deeply merged into the Elderblood dynasty.

##### Snow Clan
Clan Snow is tied to Victor through Violet and Agnes. What began as the family of Victor's first wife eventually became one of the central bloodlines of the Elderblood dynasty.

##### Blank Clan
Clan Blank became formally tied to Victor through Kaguya. Its expertise in assassination, concealment and service later became useful within Victor's increasingly enormous political and military structure.

##### Clan Adrasteia
Clan Adrasteia developed from a political and military ally into a family-connected Clan through Eleanor and Rose. Its martial traditions and Valkyries remain closely associated with Victor's faction.

##### June
June was the first Witch Victor regularly dealt with after becoming a Vampire. Their relationship began as business rather than friendship: June supplied specialized magical services and proved sufficiently reliable that Victor continued working with her despite the distrust surrounding Witches.

##### War
War is simultaneously Victor's created son, Herald, subordinate and one of the strongest military extensions of his authority. By Chapter 1158 Victor trusts War with Upper-Sector incidents occurring far from [[Yggdrasil]], and War's response demonstrates that Victor's most important servants can independently resolve planetary and lunar-scale crises before the Emperor personally intervenes.[114]

##### Akasha Elderblood
[[Akasha Elderblood]] is technically Victor's created daughter but also his most important administrative associate. Her fundamental objective is the protection of Victor's family, and she increasingly manages enormous quantities of information and Imperial infrastructure that Victor could not efficiently administer alone.[91]

##### Former Enemies Who Became Family or Allies
One of the clearest patterns in Victor's life is that hostility does not always end in death. Victor is perfectly willing to accept former enemies who prove useful, genuinely change allegiance or become emotionally important to his family. This has resulted in an Empire where several former adversaries now occupy positions of enormous trust.

08 · CORE PRINCIPLE

#### Relationship Philosophy
The recognition-and-loyalty principle that underlies Victor's family, alliances and enmities.
Victor's relationships are ultimately governed less by blood, species or conventional morality than by recognition and loyalty. Someone can possess a technical family connection and still mean very little to him, while an adopted child, resurrected enemy, World Tree, Demon, Outer God or old Human friend can become indispensable once Victor accepts them as "his". This principle explains both extremes of his behavior: the extraordinary patience and generosity he shows toward the people inside his family, and the disproportionate violence directed toward anyone who deliberately harms them.[1][2]
The same philosophy eventually influences the [[Elderblood Empire]] itself. Victor's civilization accepts Gods, Vampires, Demons, [[Werewolves]], Humans, Hybrids, Witches, Dragons and numerous other species under one political structure; loyalty and behavior matter more than racial origin. Former enemies can therefore become citizens, soldiers or even members of Victor's family, whereas allies who betray those he protects can immediately become enemies.
By the late Imperial era, Victor's family is no longer simply a harem gathered around one supernatural ruler. His wives govern major parts of the Empire, his daughters have matured into Goddesses and conceptual beings, his created children operate Imperial institutions, and several generations have lived entirely beneath Elderblood rule.[10][67][9] The enormous dynasty remains held together by the same principle that defined Victor when he was still a newly transformed Vampire: once he truly accepts someone as family, he refuses to abandon them.
